turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you absolutely must come to Sunday's event—I've already sworn to everyone you'll be there; don't you dare bail on us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't swing it this time; I've got to take my mom to her doctor's appointment—it's all set in stone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How am I supposed to handle this if you skip out? The whole crew has swapped shifts and is counting on you; for someone usually so dependable, this is a real letdown.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a bit of a bind with such last-minute notice—couldn't you show a little understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This whole setup is tailored for you; skip it and the event collapses—talk about squandering everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, I'll see if I can duck out briefly to pop by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! And rope in a few extra hands while you're at it to keep things lively.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Li family is hosting a gathering next month. As neighbors, you really should go and socialize. Everyone's looking forward to seeing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm absolutely swamped. Not sure I can spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These get-togethers don't happen often. People will feel like something's missing without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't squeeze out time. Maybe I could drop by later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's about nurturing old connections. Such a shame if you're not there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to adjust my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's for staying connected. Everyone's hoping you'll come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll see what I can do. Just don't keep pushing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elevator's been broken for a week. You should fix it urgently, or it's inconvenient for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parts are out of stock. We'll handle it next week. Please wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Waiting too long shows your service efficiency isn't great. Is that reasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sourcing parts takes time. We're doing our best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So we're supposed to share the repair costs? Well, we're considering not paying the fees then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Paying fees is the owners' choice. Repair costs follow the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your approach to fairness is questionable. Compensation ought to be mentioned.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Compensation isn't realistic. Suggest discussing with management. Feel free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You haven't been looking well lately, you should really go get checked at the hospital soon and not put it off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been crazy busy. Would it be okay if I went tomorrow instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Health is your most important asset, after all. Look at how conscientious Lao Liu is—he gets checked out for even trivial matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't waiting a day or two for the checkup be fine? Besides, I'm feeling okay right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: And yet, you're making me really worried. Could you possibly squeeze in some time to go today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, fine. I'll let my colleagues know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to bring the report from last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you share that post for me on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just not feeling like sharing that kind of stuff lately. Handle it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You won't even help with such a small thing? How stingy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who are you to tell me? Ask someone else if you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! All my past kindness to you was wasted!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? Who wants your phony kindness anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. Don't expect any help from me at work going forward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm moving next Saturday and I absolutely can't handle it alone - you've got to come help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I've got plans with an old classmate that day, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you moved last time, I came to help without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I help you pack beforehand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A move without a crowd just feels wrong - you had people over for your move too, didn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might only be able to stay briefly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whenever I remember us teaming up for that last move, it warms my heart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to swing by and lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How's that report coming along? If we keep dragging this out, the whole team's gonna suffer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, it's brutal. Can't find all the research materials, progress is crawling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other teams submitted ages ago. They pulled all-nighters for the group - we can't be dead weights, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nobody wants to hold things up... but this is seriously tricky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll get Xiao Zhang to pitch in. Everyone's watching us now - gotta wrap this up properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll grind it out tonight and won't screw up the timeline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, need to discuss something. The project is entering a critical phase next week, and we're genuinely short-staffed. Regarding your scheduled leave, would you consider adjusting the timing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, boss... But this vacation was planned well in advance, and I've already paid the hotel deposit. It's a bit tricky to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your situation. Unfortunately, project demands have surged unexpectedly, and we're critically short-handed. Would you consider shortening your leave duration, or perhaps taking it later? We'll definitely provide extra compensation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shortening the leave... I'll think about it. The main issue is that rearranging family plans would be quite a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's true this inconveniences you. It'd be best if you could manage to overcome this. We really need your support to meet the tight deadlines. Let me know your adjusted plans as soon as possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll discuss it with my family and get back to you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've got an unexpected business trip—could you watch my cat? Just three days, food and water are all set.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This week's brutal with my proposal deadline, really can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't find anyone else—we're swamped wrapping up the project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's rough—I'm pulling overtime past 10pm every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any chance you could squeeze it in? I can even drop the food off at your place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll swing by during lunch break. Three days max, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Drinks on me when I'm back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you're taking leave next week? Nonsense! Can't you see what state the project is in? Get back to work immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've completed all the procedures, and family arrangements are set. I've even finished my tasks ahead of schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Who'll handle your workload? New requirements are piling up like shit! You're just ditching responsibilities—zero sense of duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've handed everything over in advance. And per company policy, I'm entitled to this annual leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw the rules! This is an emergency! Cut the crap—you damn well better be at your desk Monday! Mess this up and you'll be fucking responsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it. I'll be back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard Xiao Chen goes for a morning run every day. Maybe you could give it a try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps later. I'm not really a morning person.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's lost ten pounds after keeping it up for half a year. Seems quite effective.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's great, but I still prefer running at night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about you two go for a run together this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see. Work's been quite hectic lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. Feel free to reach out to him when you have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you must help with my son's job! After all we're fellow villagers, won't you even give me this face?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, but rules are strict now. Pulling strings could get me in real trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! How come you didn't say that when helping Lao Wang's son last year? You ungrateful bastard, forgotten your roots, have you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's different this time! Lao Wang's case went through proper procedures...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If you refuse, don't even think about showing your face back home! The whole village will be backbiting you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll try... What a pain...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember to get it done by month-end. Don't you dare play tricks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh man, working overtime every day is killing me, my bones are about to fall apart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's having a tough time. Look at Xiao Zhang, he pushed through even with a fever last week—that kind of spirit really sets the tone for all of us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is no way to keep going. What are we supposed to do down the road?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's wrapping up soon. Slacking off now would just waste all our hard work, wouldn't it? What a pity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is endless—who can handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a senior employee; you ought to lead by example for everyone at a crunch like this, or it'll be tough to keep the team on track.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try again for now. If I really can't cope, we'll see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get my son into that elite middle school, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are too tightly controlled these days, impossible to arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! What a waste of all those years as a department head!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd better watch your tone when speaking to me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help or don't - spare me the pretentious act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Believe whatever suits you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw this! Don't expect another word from me ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dude, my debt lawsuit is freaking out, I'm losing my mind here—you gotta help me figure this out ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm swamped with this company project, meetings all day—can't handle your mess right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, you'd just watch me drown? Stop playing dumb and step up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm clueless about debt stuff—what if my lousy advice screws you over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who hooked you up with a job when you got fired last year? Now I'm in deep shit and you're throwing me under the bus?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, fine. I'll ask around when I get a minute—happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do me a favor and submit the report tomorrow? Your desk is right next to the print room—it’d be no trouble at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I’m swamped with my own work right now, not sure I can manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss checks strictly—late submissions mean docked bonuses. Weren’t you quite willing to help Xiao Wang last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my project’s a complete mess. I’d probably mess this up too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember who lent you theirs for a whole week when your computer crashed? You’d refuse to do a little favor like this for a friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. But just this once—don’t ask me again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You’re a lifesaver! Remember to submit before 2 PM—don’t drop the ball.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're going to Guangzhou for business? The wife cakes there are a local specialty – you must bring some back for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is jam-packed; doubt I'll have time to buy any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang managed to bring some last time, so you can't just show up empty-handed, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you think everyone will say if Xiao Li doesn't bring anything back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's truly impossible, then never mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You wouldn't let everyone down, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see when the time comes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work, shouldn't you step up more as the mother?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been cooking after overtime myself—couldn't you come home earlier to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A child needs their mother most, and I'm breaking my back to provide.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making money doesn't excuse neglecting our kid—you owe him time this week at least.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll spend time with him after this project wraps up. He'll understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll just take him to the amusement park tomorrow then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Wang, could you find some time to handle the team event reimbursement? Everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm swamped with work right now, and the reimbursement system is a nightmare to use. Can't manage it at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on now, teammates should support each other. Get this done and you can rest earlier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The system's completely frozen. Could you give me a bit more time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all struggling here, but without reimbursement sorted, the team event can't move forward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll force myself to push through with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good brother, knew we could rely on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll update you when it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's furious! If you don't go apologize now, the team will collapse!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't going now just begging for a scolding? Their phone's completely off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Xiao Liu owned up last time? His bonus doubled. Why can't you step up like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better mean it! Don't pull a Xiao Zhao and half-ass it, wasting months of our work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This groveling is humiliating. Are we really that pathetic?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this project fails, it's entirely on you! Every ounce of our effort will be for nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, the system crashed and I can't pay. Can I borrow your employee access to swipe the card?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't we get penalized if caught?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when your mom was hospitalized, didn't I cover three night shifts for you? Now the project's going down the drain, and we'll all suffer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the surveillance is really strict...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang paid for me last week without blinking an eye, and only your access works in our team. We're desperate to save this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Then hurry up and finish it, then void the order!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're awesome! I'll split the end-of-month bonus with you 30-70!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But never again, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how about hosting a party at your place this weekend? You're renowned for your hospitality after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, I've been swamped with overtime lately—just can't find the energy to go through all that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a casual get-together. Would you really turn down such a small favor? That's not very decent of you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... just promise you guys won't touch my treasured collections, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Of course we won't mess with them! Now cut the excuses and just agree already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright fine, let's settle for Sunday afternoon then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Knew I could count on you to come through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Has your child's piano exam results come out? Our kid did exceptionally well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet, my child keeps complaining about being exhausted and refuses to practice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's unacceptable! Only perseverance brings results—it'd be such a waste to quit now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly because the academic workload is overwhelming...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No matter how busy you are, you must prioritize talent development. All other kids are learning—surely we can't fall behind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll try to fit it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't push harder now, there'll be no making up for it later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm dealing with some legal issues - could you help me think of any solutions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you tell me what happened? Let me hear the details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a contract dispute - the other party refuses to pay what they owe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For such cases, I'd recommend seeking professional legal help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you happen to know any lawyers you could refer me to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll ask around with friends and let you know if I hear anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad haven't been getting around too well lately. If you happen to be free this weekend, could you come keep them company?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been crazy with this project deadline. I'll try to make time, but if I can't swing it I'll have a housekeeper help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They've been missing you and mentioned you several times. Just come whenever it works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this: I'll take two days off next week to take them for their follow-up hospital checkup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be even better. I'll handle the cooking and meal deliveries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, we can work out the specifics later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey classmate, is this seat taken? I see belongings but no one here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, that's my spot, I just stepped out to take a call. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thing is, library seats are pretty scarce. Seems you've been gone awhile with your stuff here. Mind if I sit temporarily? I'll vacate immediately when you return.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see how my schedule looks. I'll head over after finishing my current tasks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, call me when you're going and I'll get things ready for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. I might need your help sorting the labels for the stacked supplies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. Where are the labels? I'll grab them first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're next to the warehouse. Let me know when you have them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll call you as soon as I'm ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. We'll catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you sign in for me at tomorrow morning's meeting?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid that won't work—I've got a client meeting scheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is everyone in this family so heartless? This is your responsibility, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be like this, I'm truly stuck between a rock and a hard place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family comes first, right? Shouldn't decent people show some gratitude?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll shuffle my schedule then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Get there early—don't be late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hotel expenses are capped at 200 yuan. Any overage gets deducted from your paycheck. Got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Even budget chains cost more than that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take it or leave it! Can't afford it? Go sleep under a bridge. Think this is a charity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Was that 'charity' when you booked five-star suites for your mistress?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Looking to get fired? I'll have you terminated right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it! Let's see what talent your pathetic excuse for a boss can hire!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pack your things tonight, you good-for-nothing! You're done here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm definitely gonna be late for clock-in again tomorrow! Do me a solid and punch my card for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if we get caught and fined? This feels way too risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you took leave, I covered your report! What's wrong with helping out between good friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the surveillance is super strict this time. I'm afraid we'll get busted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making excuses over such a tiny favor? How can you even call yourself a friend? Even colleagues help each other out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! Just this once. Never again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man! I'll buy you a drink sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you have to help with this guarantee—after all these years as buddies, how could you just stand by and do nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, I'm not making excuses, but if this goes wrong it could cost me my head—I just can't shoulder this responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Does our friendship count for nothing? If that's how it is, then all I've done for you before meant zilch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't paint me into a corner—you're basically forcing me to make a huge mistake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If our roles were reversed, I'd jump in without hesitation. But now it's my turn and you're dragging your feet—what kind of friend is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly sorry, but this is beyond me. You can't expect me to take the fall for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it. I must've been blind to call you a friend. Don't you dare come crawling to me next time you're in trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going on a three-month business trip. Could you look after this pothos plant at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. Is the balcony okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Let's grab a fancy meal when I'm back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been over four months now. When are you taking the plant back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately. But look how thriving the leaves are with all that sunlight at your place...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is packed with stuff now, really running out of space...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I recall jumping in right away when you moved last year... Never mind, guess you're in a bind now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've canceled that group order.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, that's so abrupt—what about the rest of us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But doesn't it allow individual cancellations?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I even went out of my way to wait for you. This is pretty inconsiderate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The policy clearly states cancellations are allowed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone was counting on you to take charge when they joined. And now this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey intern, the project is about to launch. Could you help me review the proposal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I actually have dinner plans with friends tonight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll manage if you really can't. It just might take longer to finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this task Xiao Wang's responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's on leave. Check it if convenient, but no pressure at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll take a look after dinner then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Sorry to eat into your time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt's leg has been bothering her a lot lately—maybe you could take her to see a specialist when you get a chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped wrapping up the project this week, pulling overtime daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, alright. It's just tough seeing her struggle to walk, thought I'd check if it works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Truly can't spare the time. How about asking aunt to take her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Do visit her once you're free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll bring some gifts to see aunt once this workload eases up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! I got nowhere to crash tonight. Can I stay at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell you talking 'bout? My place is a pigsty—can't even find floor space!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! That's your excuse? You're just being a cheapass not lettin' me crash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! I'm drowning in rent—can't deal with your crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're fucking heartless! Then lend me 200 bucks for a motel?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Still owe me from last time—think I'm your damn ATM?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Knowing you's the rotten luck of a lifetime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Power bank, please? My phone's dead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting all high and mighty—would it kill you to lend it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Can't stand pricks like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You begging for a beating? I'll trash your stuff, watch me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring it on! Like I'd fear a worthless piece of shit like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You goddamn ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the hell out! Quit your damn tantrum here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get me a website ASAP, it's urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with 996 lately, no time at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making excuses? Like you're the only busy one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Get someone else then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic! Can't even count on you for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a psycho! Don't ever come to me again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off. Good riddance, as if we're not even related.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, your sister works for the airline, right? Could you ask if she can hook me up with an employee discount?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Employee benefits are only for family members, can't extend to outsiders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... bummer. It's just that my budget's tight, and I figured since we're close friends I'd ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't help on this one, company rules are strict.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll figure something out elsewhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe next time there's a promotion I'll give you a heads-up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We must visit grandma this weekend. She's been counting the days waiting for us – imagine how heartbroken she'll feel if we don't go!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about Sunday morning? I'm swamped with this project deadline and genuinely can't spare time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The only thing she looks forward to is our handmade dumplings. Can't even put in that little effort? Guess all her doting on you as a child was wasted?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making them from scratch is exhausting! Why not get premium frozen ones? Stop making everything a moral lecture!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her entire life revolves around family reunions. As her grandson, you won't even give her half a day? Have you considered how many tears she's secretly shed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll squeeze it in! But don't you dare nag if I'm running late!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. What matters to elders is exactly this kind of sincere gesture.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The prenuptial agreement requires your signature. Please review the terms.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The asset division completely favors your family. How do you explain this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Signing is ultimately your choice—it's our family tradition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I must protect my own interests; this arrangement is completely unfair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're free to decline, but then we'll need to reconsider the wedding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need time to think this through—it concerns my entire future.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Decide within three days: no signature means we're through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm moving this Saturday. You, as my cousin, have to come help! Isn't it just wrong for family not to show up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moving again? You're such a hassle! Got plans to play cards with friends, no time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cards are more important than your own flesh and blood? Who brought your dad meals every day when he was hospitalized? Now you're making excuses just to help me move?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop bringing up the past! It was just a few meals! You keep harping on it, how annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful bastard! Be at my place at 8 AM sharp Saturday, or I'll bang your door down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking crazy? Think I'm your free labor? Screw that, I'm not going!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just try skipping it! Don't come crying to me when your family needs help, you white-eyed wolf!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Cursed for lifetimes having kin like you! Fine, fine, whatever, I'll go!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, why haven't you blocked him on socials yet? Keeping an ex around is morally wrong—you should block him immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We ended things cleanly. He's just an ordinary friend now—why so sensitive?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who are you kidding? Not blocking means you're hiding something! Is this how you treat me? Selfish jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't see the issue here. Must you escalate things like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough nonsense! Block him or we're through—that's your obligation! Got it, idiot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whatever! Blocked. Stop with the moral coercion already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Should've done this ages ago. Don't be disloyal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, done. Happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless lump! Always on your phone instead of studying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't care! My grades won't change anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thickheaded fool! Wasted all those reference books I bought you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then quit nagging me! So irritating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hopeless loser! Don't come begging to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I'd ever want to!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, you're the only one I can count on to co-sign this car loan—you can't back out on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, the risk is pretty high though... household budget's been extremely tight lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that what family's for? You can't possibly leave me hanging without a car, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But if things go south on my end, your car payments and kid's tuition could both get messed up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back in the day when I got you that job opening... shouldn't you return the favor now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... you're making it really hard for me to say no...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, have you checked out the materials yet? Mind if I borrow them for a quick look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just got them and haven't even finished going through them myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're tied up, feel free to use them first—I can take a peek later when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, swamped with deadlines this week, so I'll pass them straight to you after I'm done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, anytime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must help me review the paper right now; it's due tomorrow morning!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh man, I'm swamped with work right now, I honestly can't help out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I pulled an all-nighter for you? And now you're forgetting that? Doesn't seem very loyal, does it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, alright, send it over and I'll take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, hurry up—don't be so sluggish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, just send it over already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, you're a real pal after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, you must lend me 8000, or you're heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think I'm stupid? Last time you swore you'd repay in three days—it's been half a year!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A sister who watches her brother suffer doesn't make you human!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the pathetic act! Your phone's newer than mine!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lend or I'll tell the whole family how cold-hearted you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! A scammer like you has the nerve to talk?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's a disaster and everyone's up in arms. You must clean up this mess and find a solution immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it my part that's the issue? Weren't we understaffed from the start?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at how smoothly Xiao Wang handled that crisis last time! Your screw-up is dragging the whole team down, get it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been working non-stop, but this mess is huge. Anyone would struggle with this, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still want your year-end bonus? You signed up for this job, so start pulling your weight right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll deal with it! But just so we're clear, the challenges are massive.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling! Lao Zhang's team is already ahead. You want our group criticized because of you? Move it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, my buddy Xiao Wang urgently needs a loan, how about being his guarantor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? I don't even know this guy, why should I shoulder the risk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your conscience? Family won't even do this small favor - are you even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop the moral blackmail! What's conscience worth? You gonna pay when things go south?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! I've got your number now! All that fake respectability, yet so heartless when it counts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Play saint yourself if you want, don't drag me down with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, you soulless bastard! Don't you dare call me family ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's eating you? You look like a wilted eggplant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got laid off... feels like an anvil's on my chest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you think you owe your parents some honesty after all they've done? Keeping this from them—is that how you repay them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't tell them... I just can't bear making them worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly care about them, don't let them agonize in the dark. Make the call tonight! Finding out through the grapevine would crush them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... this is one rough patch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at me last month—I video-called home the minute I lost my job. That's how anyone who truly cares about their folks would step up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright. I'll try later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, this client email concerns the team's reputation—you must personally oversee it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's your fundamental responsibility; as an employee you should overcome difficulties yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you helped Xiao Li with his report last time—not helping me now would seem like favoritism.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A truly responsible employee wouldn't constantly seek shortcuts—this reflects on your professional integrity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we lose the client over this email, everyone will feel leadership failed its mentoring duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mature professionals know shirking responsibility is never the right choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consider it training a newcomer—guiding subordinates is the natural order for a leader.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just this once. Remember—this growth opportunity is one you owe the team.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I need to take some leave next week for personal matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, the whole team's grinding right now. You picking this moment to bail isn't great timing, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
