turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As elders, it's our duty to step up. Turning down family would leave them deeply disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if this gets reported? I could lose my job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our relatives are just counting on us. You must get this done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me see what I can figure out, but I truly can't guarantee anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! The whole family depends on you now—get moving on this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got time to help me with a logo for a personal project?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's piled sky-high lately, might not be able to assist.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, I'll sort it out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not send it over? I'll glance if I catch a free moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't push yourself, really—your main work comes first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah it's fine, fire it my way, just don't expect quick turnaround.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal, thanks! If it doesn't pan out, just give me a shout.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the project's a bit tight tonight. You've got so much experience, could you pitch in and work overtime? The whole team is counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've got to accompany my wife back to her parents' place today. It's previously scheduled and can't be changed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, family comes first then, don't let that be delayed. I'll figure out a way to find someone to take care of the project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I do work overtime, would it be possible to get compensatory time off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely, absolutely, overtime all counts as comp time. Wouldn't shortchange you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll let my family know and will be in later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, the exam is coming and I'm freaking out. Could you give me some key points to review?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're panicking? Why didn't you say anything when I stayed up late compiling materials for you last year? Ungrateful much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My bad, senior. I was just hoping you'd give me a hand...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, want my help? Then report to me every single day. No half-assing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every day? But I've got my evening job...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Job or future—which matters more? With that attitude, you deserve to fail! Want the key points? Do exactly as I say!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, you look quite pale recently—not getting enough rest? Your health matters, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, a bit tired with all these projects, but it's manageable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just keep up if you can; don't push yourself too hard and collapse.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, boss. I'll do what I can within my limits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If there's any issue, just say it—don't overdo things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, got it. I'll be careful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Agent Li specifically reserved an insider price for you - if you don't hire him, wouldn't he be utterly heartbroken?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My current agent's been quite diligent too, and the deposit's already paid. Switching last-minute would be terribly awkward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must you be so pigheaded? I've got all the details sorted - do you actually think Agent Li would scam you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly because he's already made multiple trips upfront - backing out now seems rather unethical, doesn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole crew's been hustling for ages - you should at least do them the courtesy of considering his offer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll try contacting him when free, but switching genuinely isn't guaranteed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, it's time to contribute to the mutual aid fund this year. Are you planning to join in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, money's tight right now. I might have to skip it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else is participating. It'd be kind of a pity if you missed out, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should it be mandatory? This feels like a huge burden to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, it's a family matter. Helping each other out is how it should be, though I won't force you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll think about it some more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better make a decision soon. Don't hold everyone up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, I'll go ahead and contribute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come to Lao Wang's birthday bash next month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too far though – the bullet train ticket alone costs nearly a thousand, plus I'm scheduled to work that weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even make this little effort? Are you even a real friend? Decent people don't act this ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly it's not about money – my boss assigned this shift last minute, I've got no choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the excuses! Would it kill you to take leave? Pull this shit and don't expect any favors from us again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop talking like that, will you? I'm genuinely trying to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Skipping this means you're dissing the whole crew – consider yourself uninvited to future hangouts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll fucking beg for time off against my better judgement!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, we've got a lot on our plate at work lately. If you've got time, could you come help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my arthritis is acting up again. Need to do hot compresses at home these days, afraid I can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would really appreciate if you could come. The new folks just don't have your steady hands.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My wife's blood pressure has been high lately, need to look after her at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, take care of family first. Maybe come when things settle down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't Lao Zhang at the office? He could hold down the fort, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang's good with tech stuff, but you're the one who really knows the ropes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suppose I could swing by for half a day next week. If nothing else, I can give guidance over the phone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard your uncle handles tax matters? My small business has some tax issues I wanted to ask about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Depends, what's going on exactly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're stuck on a tax problem. Given our relationship, wouldn't you help me figure something out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Compliance requirements are strict on this. It's a bit complicated for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I thought with our friendship, you wouldn't just leave me hanging?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to understand, this is genuinely tricky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... and here I thought I could count on our bond.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you forward this message for me? It's super important.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's it about? I might not be able to share it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a true friend, you're obligated to forward this—it's your moral duty. Non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need some time to think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't even think—just forward it now. It's an ethical imperative; you've got no choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, what've you been up to lately? Need to discuss something with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My cousin's internship hit a wall and the whole family's worried. You've got wide connections—surely you can help out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The situation's particularly tough this year. Really not easy to manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's losing sleep every night. If you've got connections, how about lending a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try, but don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only hope we've got for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh no oh no, my kid's teacher wants me at school now—who can watch the shop for a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got client meetings scheduled tonight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Last year when you were hospitalized, I brought you meals every single day. For emergencies like this, you're the only one I can count on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this involves business contracts! Standing them up could cost me the deal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being a mom is tough—always having to shoulder everything alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe...I could switch to a video conference? But only for an hour, max.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect, perfect! You always come through in a pinch, sis!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry back—my meeting's breathing down my neck too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I'm moving this Saturday and need to pack things up. Are you free to come lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? This Saturday? I've got plans to play basketball with friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well if you're not too busy, you could still come by. I did hire movers too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I finish up early in the afternoon, I'll swing by to help for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. Anyway, all the relatives are coming, so having an extra pair of hands would be nice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, sis. I'll try to make it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay then, no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, we'll touch base later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could I ask about the exam highlights when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, check out this material first—feel free to ask if anything's unclear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll review it tonight and reach out if I have questions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll be at the library three days before the exam—come find me if you need in-person help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! So if I have questions, should I message you on WeChat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Either way, whatever works for you. Good luck with your studying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, call Mom and apologize right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I apologize? It wasn't just my fault!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just because you're the youngest! Do you realize how hard Mom raised you? How dare you make her so upset—are you even human? Don't you know what filial piety means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You screamed at her too! Why aren't you apologizing? You always order me around—what kind of brother is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough nonsense! You're the one who messed up most! If you've got any shame left, apologize this instant! You've humiliated our entire family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Apologize yourself if you care! I owe you nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It would be so lonely going to the class reunion alone tomorrow without any company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I barely know your classmates - it'd be awkward being the odd one out unable to chat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li's husband always attends with her - I'm envious! I'd feel ashamed walking in solo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd just freeze up like a wooden post standing there - I honestly don't want to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't come with me, the whole thing will feel utterly pointless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I pick you up later instead? You could leave early then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already told everyone you're coming - it'll look terrible if you bail. Please try to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine I'll go. But next time? Absolutely not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The report is a total mess. You've got to bail me out for the inspection this afternoon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Messed up again? Clean up your own damn mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With team evaluations coming up, how could you live with yourself if I drag us down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's quite the guilt trip... But wouldn't getting caught faking be way worse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as partners, what kind of brother refuses to help now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unbelievable... Fine, but swear you won't pull this crap again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, this paper absolutely requires your expertise – no one else can pull this off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped with my own work these days, can't even handle my thesis.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I helped you crunch data until 2 AM last time? Consider this returning the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm mostly worried I might hold you back...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The director specifically said we need mutual support. Turning this down would really impact team morale, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, I'll try to figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Knew I could count on you to be a big-picture thinker.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've run into this minor legal issue lately and feel quite unsure about it. Mind chatting with me about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm swamped with a pile of projects right now, running around like crazy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you think I should do about this? Just need some simple advice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best, but really can't guarantee I'll be any help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, was just asking casually. You focus on your work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll take a look when I get some free time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, how's that new camera working out? I want to capture some quality photos for Aunt's birthday this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just bought it and barely had time to get familiar. What exactly did you have in mind for the shoot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's her 90th milestone birthday after all. We should preserve some crisp images - your photography skills have always been top-notch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This equipment's incredibly sensitive though. What if wind kicks up dust during outdoor shooting?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what - I'll personally guard the gear the whole time, guaranteed nothing gets mishandled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. I'll preset the parameters that day, but you must remember the stabilizer tripod.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, heard there's been a lot of string-pulling lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, some, but I feel that violates ethical boundaries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True, it's hard to say whether calling in favors like that is right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think friends should help each other case-by-case, not just abuse connections.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll be more careful about leveraging relationships like that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right, maybe mention it to friends too - being a decent person matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, talk later. See you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, have you cleared your weekend schedule? Is everything arranged at home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No special plans. What's up, dear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, my brother and I decided we must visit you this weekend. As children, this is our fundamental duty and filial obligation. Keeping parents company is the natural order of things - our family tradition must be upheld without exception.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't trouble yourselves if you're busy, we're perfectly fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, this isn't up for debate. Elderly parents deserve their children's care and visits. This is the bare minimum of responsibility and moral decency we're duty-bound to provide. Sunday, it's final.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, alright alright, I understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, that's more like it. Don't forget to have dinner ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, look how hard Nini's struggling with school—you being her elder, you've GOT to take responsibility, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our mortgage payments are really tight too...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're her own blood aunt! How could you possibly refuse? Her whole future hinges on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I honestly don't have spare funds for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you really abandoning family loyalty? If this spreads, how'll you even show your face among relatives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, would you mind covering that meal expense from my last business trip? I've forwarded you the receipt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already covered two expenses this month, so my cash flow's a bit tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, shouldn't friends support each other? I'm really in a pinch this time—just help me out, okay? This is how friends should treat each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but your previous reimbursement took ages to process...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise it won't drag this time! We're so close—can't let such a small thing create distance, right? Mutual help is non-negotiable. Just cover it for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright alright, I'll cover it. But please process the reimbursement promptly this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry! Knew I could count on you—that's what real friends do!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mmhm, I'll handle it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey sis, mind if I ask you something? Would it be possible to borrow your new camera for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? What do you need it for? Where are you planning to use it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, the company trip is next week. I was thinking of taking some nicer landscape photos. If you're not using it lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... Travel does involve bumps and knocks. It's just that this camera was quite pricey, so I'm a bit worried.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand! That makes sense, there is some risk. No worries at all, I'll figure out another way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, appreciate you understanding. Maybe next time, or I can see if there's something else you could use.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, I heard that pharmacy in the new district has really effective calcium tablets. Could you pick up two bottles for me when you're out for a walk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, my e-bike broke down these past couple days. Walking there would take a full half hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, Aunt Zhang goes to the morning market every day, doesn't she? You could always take a taxi.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My legs haven't been cooperating lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consider it exercise then? How about I book you a massage next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This heatwave's been unbearable...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, whenever it's convenient for you then. Do take care in this heat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're signing this prenup or you don't trust me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it's completely one-sided! Should I be left with nothing if I marry in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly loved me, you'd make sacrifices! Are you just in it for the money?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm here for the relationship, but this agreement is pure insult!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't spit on the hand feeding you! Signing it proves you want this marriage!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're trying to take me for a fool! Do you even have a conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough talk! Sign by tomorrow or get out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you clock me in for the morning meeting tomorrow? My water pipe suddenly burst and I need to wait for the repair guy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's a bit risky. Why not ask your supervisor for leave directly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't take leave—the plumber says he'll arrive at 9. Your seat is close to the punch clock anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I asked Lao Wang for a similar favor, the supervisor called me out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nothing will go wrong this time—the supervisor doesn't check attendance until 10. I'll treat you to BBQ this weekend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, but just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! I'll treat you right after the pipe's fixed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get your ass to Starbucks after work and grab me an Americano. No dawdling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I have a doctor's appointment at six...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who gives a damn about your appointment? Getting coffee won't kill you. Cut the excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The registration fee was two hundred yuan. If I miss it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell does that have to do with me?! On my desk in thirty minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make it iced! Last time you messed up and got me sick. Did you leave your brain at home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can I borrow your expensive equipment? I want to do a risky activity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of activity? That equipment is pricey—what if something goes wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you not trust me? As a friend, it's your duty to support me! Refusing to help makes you a lousy friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about trust, but the potential loss would be significant if it breaks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why bother calculating losses between friends? You damn well should help me! What kind of friend would you be otherwise?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine, you can borrow it. But be careful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what I call a real friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, make sure you return it undamaged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old classmate, I heard you're close with Mr. Zhang?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not bad, just tell me what you need straight up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm at my wits' end now; knowing Mr. Zhang could save me, you really ought to help me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really not a good time right now, so don't put me on the spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've always backed each other up, and now you're the only one who can give me a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please understand, I just can't help this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I guess I'm not worth your trouble after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, with work stress this high, physical contact is completely normal—why overthink it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, this is harassment, okay? How can you just dismiss it like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making a mountain out of a molehill? You're just a rookie—cut the act. Do whatever, but don't blame me if I stop covering for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, that's absolute bullshit! If shit hits the fan, will you take responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me the drama! This crap happens daily at work—just suck it up instead of playing holier-than-thou.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unbelievable. Then tell me your solution? Or just expect me to endure silently?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Such a non-issue—handle it yourself. But don't cause trouble, or I'll make you regret affecting work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, noted. Hope you won't regret this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, lend me your staff card to buy some clothes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, why are you always coming to me for rule-breaking stuff?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the act? Last month you covered for Xiao Li!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! My card, my rules!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Mr. Stingy suddenly got an attitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buzz off! Keep bothering me and I'll report to the supervisor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk tsk, look at that spineless look!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, I'm heading to Guangzhou next week. Everyone says their cured meats are the real deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guangzhou cuisine is indeed impressive, you should definitely try some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: While you're at it, could you grab two boxes of Ronghua sausages for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Luggage weight restrictions are strictly enforced, I genuinely don't have any spare capacity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was actually hoping you'd help me decide what to bring back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the layovers being so hectic, my suitcase is pretty much packed solid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone raved about the cured meats you picked out at the last gathering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can do and try to make some room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, since you've got so many credit card points just sitting there unused, why not help me book a flight? They're going to waste otherwise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm actually saving my points for something else, so I can't really lend them out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How selfish can you be? What kind of friend refuses to help when someone's in a bind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped you with that shopping, I lost money. Shouldn't there be some mutual understanding here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! Have you forgotten how I helped you move? And now you're giving me the runaround over such a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this just moral blackmail? Helping you is a courtesy, not some damn obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Book that flight for me today or we're done as friends!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, have it your way... Go use the points. Honestly, the sheer audacity of you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, I fucked up the report! You dare snitch and I'll fucking end you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! You screwed up and now want to shut me up? Try me - I'll report you right fucking now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! I'll make sure your career in this department is over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Loser! Clean up your own damn mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! We'll see about that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! One more word and I'm going straight to the boss!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, are you free this weekend? My grandma needs care, could you help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I've got prior commitments this week, hard to schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Caring for elders is our duty – you ought to prioritize this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best, but it's genuinely tricky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping friends care for family is basic decency. If you bail, who'll tend to Grandma?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consider it settled – you're going this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things have been hectic at home lately, and Mom and Dad are quite exhausted. Would you be able to come back this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a mock exam this weekend. Let me check my schedule after the exam?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, alright. It's just that Dad's back hasn't been great, and he's been struggling a bit with moving things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I could squeeze in a visit next week? This exam is really important for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then focus on your exam first. Just let us know if you need any help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll come straight back after the exam.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, with blood ties right here, partnering in this shop is your non-negotiable duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I've already committed to other investment plans...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't family supposed to be what matters most? Imagine how heartbroken the elders would be if they found out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I need to reconsider this carefully.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's there to reconsider? Surely you wouldn't make the whole family condemn you for being heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, as you can see, both of us are tied up at the Disability Federation, could you please go the extra mile for our child's internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The process is transparent and based on overall performance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's burning the midnight oil every night! You know firsthand how much these kids sacrifice, so could you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Special cases have bonus policies, but spots are scarce.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our family's had a rough time, and the kid's under immense pressure...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do my best to inquire.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child's pinning all their hopes on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crying over a failed exam? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All that year's effort wasted...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just die stupid! Failing again would be humiliating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe look for a job instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do whatever! You'll fail at anything anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What about Mom and Dad...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not my damn problem! Clean up your own mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hanging up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you have a YouTube Premium subscription, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah. Want to borrow it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind letting me use it for a while? These ads on shows I'm watching are getting annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... but I'm a bit worried about security since my payment's linked to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Maybe I'll just get a trial myself. Any good shows you'd recommend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That XX series is pretty hot lately. Feel free to check it out. Let me know if you need help finding it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome! Thanks, man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you just make an exception and help me get rid of that awful review hanging there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the product itself was faulty—wouldn't it be inappropriate to whitewash that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't even pay rent now—are you just gonna watch me go under, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this clearly cheating the customers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you needed money, I lent it without hesitation. Isn't it time you returned the favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These are completely separate issues...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as classmates, how could you possibly let my business go bankrupt?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll take care of it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are the requirements for the hardship grant application?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better get it done early, otherwise you might miss the boat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does the income proof require an official stamp?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Usually it does, saves you the headache of redoing it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the absolute deadline for submitting the materials?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: By the 15th, everyone's scrambling to meet that cutoff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long does the approval process usually take?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need to rush now, everyone waits the same few days anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, can I borrow your shopping membership? I'm in a rush to place an order.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account has personal info stored. Worried about theft, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it. I'll figure something else out then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, too many scammers these days. Can't take risks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Safety first. No problem at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll treat you to dinner sometime to make it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, appreciate it, Lao Wang!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I discuss something? Would it be okay if my friend stays over for a few weeks?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long exactly? Might this affect our living space?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Three weeks maximum—he'll cover his share of utilities, and I guarantee he won't disrupt your routine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How will cleaning responsibilities be divided? What about kitchen scheduling?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll assign cleaning zones per person, and I'll notify you in advance when he needs the kitchen.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it through—can I give you an answer within two days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll wait for your reply. If it doesn't work, I'll arrange alternatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give you a definite answer by tomorrow at the latest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and share your location with me now, stop dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell should I? My phone's dead, got a problem with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your damn sense of responsibility? If you actually loved me, you'd report your whereabouts willingly! This sneaking around proves you're hiding shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck this! I'm breaking my back working overtime daily, and you're playing detective?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Refusing to share means you're guilty as hell. What's the point of keeping a shady partner like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jesus fucking Christ! Fine, it's shared! Happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this from the start. Why'd I have to explode before you'd act right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wang, can I borrow your employee card to buy a laptop? It's urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Regulations forbid this – if we're caught, we'll both be screwed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be so damn rigid! Remember that dinner where I drank on your behalf?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not that I won't help, but this truly violates company policy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Colleagues must support each other – can't you even show this basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... just this once. Make damn sure nobody sees you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. Remember: karma rewards good deeds!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never again, you hear me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm hungry, go grab me some food from the cafeteria now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you handle it yourself? I'm busy gaming here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a boyfriend, you refuse to do even this? Do you have any sense of duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the moral blackmail! Can't we just order delivery?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Delivery is unhealthy! A caring person should fetch it themselves, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? Are you out of your mind? Do I owe you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't meet basic obligations? What kind of partner is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Fine, I'll get it, I'm so damn fed up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I've been swamped lately - haven't visited my mom in three months.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you lost your mind? How could work trump your own mother? Suit yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's about to be audited - I'm pulling all-nighters daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the act! You're just a selfish prick. Fine by me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Who gave you the right to lecture me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Don't ever dump this crap on me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you happen to know roughly what Xiao Zhang's salary is? Just curious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably better not to ask about that—it's not appropriate to discuss private matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haha, fair enough. My bad for prying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Glad you understand. Salary isn't really a good topic even in private chats.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. By the way, how’s your project going lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It’s going well, right on schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you must get this done ASAP, otherwise it's just irresponsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't make heads or tails of all those complicated procedures.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After raising you all these years, can't you even handle this basic duty? Don't disappoint your children.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't do it, my memory's just not what it used to be.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep dragging your feet like this, and don't expect my help next time something comes up at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll give it a shot, I suppose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is more like it. Parents should know how to take responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad have been working overtime quite a bit lately, so I want to do more housework.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's good. You can do more then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was thinking of doing the dishes. Do you want to join in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see when I have time. I'm busy with my thesis lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I was just mentioning it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After this busy period, I'll see how it goes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, it's nice to have some help at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you busy? I need to take leave next week for some urgent family matters. Would you mind covering my work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave next week? Which specific days? I'm worried I've got too much on my plate already and might not manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably three or four days. Mainly just follow up on the project daily reports and nudge them for weekly submissions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Daily and weekly reports... Well, I've got important clients to handle those exact days – the timing's really tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh I see... no worries, totally understand. If it doesn't work, I'll ask our supervisor to arrange someone else or just take half-days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this: I can cover for you on Monday and Tuesday, but later in the week I'm completely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's fantastic! Getting these two days covered saves me big time! Really appreciate it, mate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're going to Guangzhou for business? Their wife cakes are quite tasty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed. Doubt I'll have time to buy any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang brought some back last time he went, and they were quite nice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try, if it doesn't interfere with things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember what Xiao Li brought? Everyone loved it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing back some local treats would keep everyone happy, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see about that later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's follow-up appointment is scheduled. How could you possibly justify not caring for her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a big client meeting tomorrow—can't possibly spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can her health wait for you? Last time she was sick, she kept bragging about how filial you were!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasn't it me who stayed with her last time? You wouldn't be losing out by taking one turn.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She only feels comforted when you're around. How can you even push back on such a small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll squeeze in a morning visit but gotta rush back for the afternoon meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like a dutiful son! Her happiness is what truly matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang? I'm at my breaking point—the hospital just sent another bill!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I get you're in a bind man. What's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What else could it be? Money! I made a Waterdrop crowdfunding link—you HAVE to repost this on Moments RIGHT NOW! With our friendship, how can you stomach watching my dad suffer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... money's tight lately. Reposting is fine, but donating...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that supposed to mean? Can't even repost on Moments? Are we friends or not? You can't be this heartless! How can you live with yourself refusing to save a dying man?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's harsh! Fine, fine—I'll repost, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reposting alone is useless! You MUST lead by example and donate! After all these years as brothers, you'd cheap out on life-saving funds? You're downright cold-blooded!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it. Hanging up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, are you free this weekend to help out with taking some event photos? We're short of a reliable photographer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with jobs lately, afraid I can't squeeze in any openings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I see. I was counting on your expertise since your skills are quite seasoned.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Indeed, my schedule is packed tight, with several wedding shoots waiting to be edited.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it. So, maybe you could recommend another photographer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang is relatively free these days, and his skills are solid too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll reach out to him. How about we catch up when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, things should ease up next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, isn't your sister at the education bureau? My boy's starting school next year and I'm worried sick. Look how smoothly the Liu family got their kid sorted last year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah she is... but they're cracking down now. What worked last year might not fly this year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ain't parents supposed to fight for their kids? Everyone in our complex with connections tries something. My boy's too sharp to be held back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly not brushing you off - her department just penalized two rule-breakers last week. Too much heat right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah come on, I went all out for your promotion review. For my kid's schooling, I'm banking on you to make the connection.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... best I can do is ask around. Don't get your hopes up though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just asking helps! Try to circle back by Wednesday? Won't feel settled till I hear from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, bring back some local specialties from your business trip. The team's been working tirelessly for weeks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm not sure my luggage can fit much...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li managed two whole suitcases last time. Can't a young fellow handle such a simple task?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Team cohesion matters, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze in what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone remembers how we praised Lao Wang's souvenirs last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, would it be possible to leave the package at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There are quite a few people at home lately, and I'm concerned they might get lost.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, I'll figure something else out then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps you could leave it at the property office? I've seen them keep packages there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks Brother Wang.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all, just give me a heads-up next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The data is way off, could you help me make up the numbers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't that be a bit tricky to pull off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so experienced, this is nothing for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work right now, can't spare a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, the boss is gonna chew me out! Could you bear to see me take the fall?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't help this time, you'll have to figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. Guess I misjudged you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new braised chicken at Cafeteria Four is amazing, could you grab me a portion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped with assignments here, total chaos. Why not go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My ankle's sprained – can't move an inch. Real friends ought to help each other out. Won't you even do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's hellishly crowded at peak hour... The queue would take forever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you had a fever, I stayed up the entire night with you. Now I'm merely asking for a meal – you call that decent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Want rice or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Double the meat! Use my card – remember the PIN?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll bring it back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma's been really unwell lately, you absolutely must spend a few days with her at month-end, or she'll be heartbroken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm completely swamped at work, can we make it early next month?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how Grandma stayed up with you all night when you were sick as a child? And now when she needs us, you're dragging your feet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't put it that way... I'll try to rearrange my schedule, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this what family does? Stepping up during tough times is what brings real peace of mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... what if I come for weekend care?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just be here the last three days of the month - seeing you always perks Grandma right up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's crazy busy now, and it has to be month-end...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, taking care of elders is an obligation – you've got to help me look after my mom.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped these days. Maybe ask someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A decent person repays favors. When you were in trouble before, I never brushed you off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But... I genuinely can't leave work right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, you'd abandon filial duty? I'm only asking because I respect you enough to request this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you quit weaponizing morality against me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be here this weekend, or you're showing your true ungrateful colors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, since you're putting it like that... I'll do what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you save me a front-row seat tomorrow? Heard the signal's better there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid I might not make it on time—probably cutting it close tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries then, I'll check with Xiao Zhang and others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I arrive early, I'll grab one for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good! Appreciate it if you can, but no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I need a parking spot; the committee should give me special treatment!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parking is tight; you've got to wait in line, and we can't make exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! What are you committee members pretending? Taking care of long-term residents is your damn duty—you have to do what's required!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This really isn't possible; everyone has equal rules, and I can't undermine fairness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You hypocrites, morally bankrupt! Why do others get special treatment, but I can't?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please calm down; this can't be accommodated—the rules must be followed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, you just wait! I'm going to cause trouble for sure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle isn't feeling well with his heart. Could you take him to see the doctor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped right now. How about next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really not ideal for seniors to go out alone. Family should be there to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... I'll see if I can rearrange my shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thursday at 9 AM, don't forget.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I'll make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, that works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you help me out with the work summary? Can't be bothered to do it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell is wrong with you? I've got my own crap to handle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, I just asked a simple question—what's with your lousy attitude? Can't you even manage this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw that! Would it kill you to write it yourself? You're such a lazy ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, I'll ask someone else. Quit your whining!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Stop bugging me while I'm working!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just my luck—I won't bother you anymore.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm exhausted from looking for a parking spot! You committee members need to fix this for me immediately! I'm desperate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, it's not that I'm unwilling to help, but parking spots are strictly allocated with a queue waiting, and we can't bend the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a long-term resident who always pays property fees early, how come Lao Wang in the same unit gets a spot? This is blatantly unfair to honest folks like me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please calm down—Lao Wang also queued for half a year. Making an exception for you would spark chaos from others, making it impossible to manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does the committee disregard us who've contributed? My minor request isn't even prioritized—it's utterly disheartening!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not the case! Everyone's watching closely; if I make an exception for you today, everyone will swarm me tomorrow, and my job becomes unmanageable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I get it—handle things your way; I'll wait patiently! Just don't complain when I share this with the neighbors later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sister Li, the company's rushing me to relocate out of town by month-end. You've gotta help me out with the deposit, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract clearly states no deposit refunds. This puts me in a real bind with your request.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two years renting your place without a single hiccup! Now when I'm desperate, you'd cold-shoulder me? Not even throwing me a lifeline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules. If we bend them for you, how do we handle other tenants? Fairness has to count for something, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All the neighbors praise your big heart. If word gets out you abandoned a longtime tenant in crisis, think how that'd crush community trust!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, seeing your hardship, I'll refund half the deposit. But mark my words—never again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, Sister Li! Knew you'd soften up. I'll cherish this kindness forever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, grab me some food, will ya? Can't be bothered to go down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not order takeout yourself? I'm not your personal errand boy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Everyone knows you stroll for coffee daily. Would bringing a meal kill you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck's wrong with you? Who gave you the right to dictate my time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! When you asked me to edit your PPT, I didn't hesitate. Now you turn your back over a tiny favor? Ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You changed two fucking words! Acting like you're some savior? Get real!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't fucking ask colleagues for help anymore! We all see through you – see who gives a shit about you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Think I need trash like you? Say whatever the hell you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, paper's in your inbox. Revise it ASAP! No dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Who the hell are you? Handle your own garbage!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the act! With your skills? Forgot how the director ripped you apart last presentation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own damn business! How dare you ask for help with this trash paper?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! Yes or no? If not, I'll find someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go find them now! Sick of seeing your face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Won't even glance at your crap from now on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The braised chicken at Cafeteria Four smells incredible. Bring me back a portion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've only written half my paper. You're closer — why don't you go?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My sprained ankle's killing me. Isn't this exactly when a real friend should step up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's peak hour — the crowd's insane to even squeeze through...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who pulled all-nighters tutoring you after you failed last semester? Surely you haven't forgotten that debt?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Want rice with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Double the chicken! Swipe my meal card directly — you remember the PIN, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Wait up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, is now a good time? I'm really worried about getting my niece an internship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead, I'm listening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid sent out over a hundred resumes with no response. Don't we have an obligation as elders to lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The industry's been tough lately; I'm swamped myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't my sister be heartbroken if she knew you had connections but wouldn't help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's a bit unfair... I've got my own difficulties here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship—remember how I made that late-night call to the CEO for your kid's internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll do what I can, but don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you clock in for me tomorrow morning? I might be late again. Pretty please?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With checks this strict, what if we get caught? Not sure if that’s doable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I covered your shift when you were sick? Aren’t we colleagues supposed to have each other’s backs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the risks are way too high. What if we get caught...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just this once. Don’t make it a habit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a million! I owe you lunch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The package is at the pickup station. Go get it for me now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really convenient. Can you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping neighbors is an obligation. How can you just dodge responsibility like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely tied up, stop pushing me okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A real neighbor steps up. Do I need to teach you basic human decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you need help, but it's really not doable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Don't expect any help from my family ever again. You're on your own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's just end this here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just forgive me this once! I've already apologized, so stop harping on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forgive you? What were you thinking when you cheated? You expect forgiveness now? In your dreams!
