turn_by_turn_scores.text: For our family and kids, you must forgive me! Refusing makes you a selfish person.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish? You've got some nerve! Who betrayed whom? You shameless piece of work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I just be wrong? You're supposed to forgive me - that's marriage! Quit your whining.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Responsibility? Where was yours when cheating? Playing saint now? Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear I'll change - you must forgive me! Who'll support the kids if we divorce? Your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Support kids? You're trash - unworthy! Forgive you? Over my dead body!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you absolutely must use your connections to get my kid into that school. If you refuse, you're no true friend – that's utterly disgraceful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's completely unreasonable! If the company catches me, I'm finished.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck your pathetic excuses! Helping friends is a moral obligation – refusing just proves how goddamn selfish you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jesus, this guilt-tripping is crushing me. You're making me feel like a criminal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! As my friend, you agree today or we're done – what kind of worthless friend are you?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try. But you're taking full responsibility if this blows up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time! Remember: loyalty defines true friendship and morality!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can these grades possibly repay our parents' sacrifices? They've been breaking their backs for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But math is genuinely tough...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Students are obligated to give their absolute all—anything less is sheer irresponsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still... I deserve some downtime too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every dutiful child knows grinding through studies now is how you show gratitude.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll push harder.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you been in touch with Xiaoming? His phone's always off when I call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really, maybe he changed his number?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You were the closest to him among us. Could you try to find a way to reach him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try, but no guarantees I can actually get through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last year when he went with you to all those hospital visits? We really should look out for him now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I know. I'll do my best to find him, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then please make an extra effort. Friends shouldn't turn their backs on each other at times like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my kid has a fever lately, and caring for him is such a hassle—it's totally distracting me from work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, then just handle it however you see fit. Since the kid's sick, take leave if you have to; work isn't the be-all and end-all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the project deadline is super tight, and my boss is hounding me nonstop—what am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just weigh things yourself: get family to help or take some time off; there's no need to push through it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try swapping my shifts, but this month's bonus is definitely toast.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, it's your call—taking good care of your kid is a positive thing too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll head off to deal with things now; let's chat later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get my package now! It's about to be ruined.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't you see the thunderstorm warning? Why the rush?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that rushed you to the hospital at 3 a.m. last time you had a fever?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...My shoes aren't cut out for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So all my kindness to you was all for nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, you win.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call brotherhood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The package arrived, could you go grab it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm gaming right now, can't you get it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so damn selfish! If you love someone you should willingly make sacrifices, get it? I even picked up your package last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moral blackmail again? You're so fucking annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone with a shred of decency would be considerate. You can't even do that? You're fucking useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! YOU'RE the useless one! Keep yapping and go get it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get it now! Refusing means you don't love me, you ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! We're done! Find some other sucker to fetch your shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang's been taking frequent leave lately; he doesn't seem well. What should we do about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got an important medical check-up tomorrow and have to go to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just think he's having a tough time. Maybe we could cut him some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I covered his shift, I nearly missed the meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll manage by adjusting internally—things will settle after this busy spell.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll have a word with him later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, I'm running myself ragged on this project. Mind if I crash at your place for a couple days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My living room's a total mess, honestly no space for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were strapped for cash, I lent you money without batting an eye. Now you're reluctant over such a little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is tiny and packed, afraid you'd be too cramped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you gonna have my back or not? You've gotta help me out here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, you can squeeze onto the sofa. Just give me a heads-up when.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. Make sure it's cleaned up properly, and don't skimp on the bedding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, fine. Whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my computer suddenly crashed with a blue screen. The report I need to submit tonight is stuck in there—I'm totally freaking out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, that's some terrible luck... But I'm tied up in a remote meeting right now and won't wrap up anytime soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm doomed—this is life or death. If I can't fix it, I'll have to pull an all-nighter grinding it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My meeting will probably run past 10. You sure you can still make the deadline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it, forget it. Focus on your work. I'll check if the repair shop downstairs is still open.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, if you're completely stuck just holler at me. I'll check messages after this meeting wraps up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, I'm really counting on you for this car loan guarantee. Family's gotta help each other out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, my mortgage is killing me lately. I'm just worried if something goes wrong with the guarantee...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're siblings - saying that sounds so distant! You can't bear seeing me squeeze onto buses every day, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But if you can't pay the car loan, it could wreck my job situation. What then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it running around taking care of you when you were hospitalized last year? Does it make sense to not even help with this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... hearing this just makes my heart sink...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm moving this Saturday, can you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's your move got to do with me? Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell's wrong with you? If you can't speak decently, piss off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit yelling! Only losers constantly need moving help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you're so amazing! Don't come crawling to me for your mess later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ask you? Dream on! Who the hell do you think you are?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I'll move fine without you, you idiot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and move out! I'm fed up with seeing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey listen, my second aunt's kid is graduating soon and needs an internship. Get it arranged at your company ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? But... our intern recruitment has strict standards now, there's a formal process...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! What's the big deal? Just slip a word to your boss! Don't you consider us brothers? Can't even do this tiny favor? Some friend you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, it's genuinely complicated...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Complicated?! Did you forget how I helped you when you were struggling? Won't lift a finger now? How's that sit with your conscience? You're being heartless! This is disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I didn't say no, I just worry it'll cause complications...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Complications? Stop making excuses! Fine! Crystal clear now - don't ever ask me for favors again! After all these years, you still don't grasp basic decency? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... whatever. Just send me the resume, I'll see what I can do...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh I've got an emergency tonight, could you watch my kid for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing, my kid's running a high fever and I need to get to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Isn't it only natural for neighbors to look out for each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be reasonable, will you? My child's fever is pushing 40 degrees!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your place flooded, I helped all night! Don't play dumb now! Have some damn conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You heartless bastard! Don't expect any help from me ever again! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Don't come crawling to me next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your brother talks about you every single day. How can you bear to neglect him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with project deadlines and truly can't spare time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If even his own sister acts this way, imagine how heartbroken the child feels? Remember when he stayed up all night caring for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got an unbreakable client meeting scheduled...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is work more important than blood ties? What a waste of our affection for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll rearrange my schedule to visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed sooner! An elder sister must uphold her responsibilities properly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quick, lend me your membership or the discount will disappear!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last few times nearly messed up my account...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I covered your shift during overtime? You won't even help with this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The system warns it's too risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you asked, I'd help in a heartbeat. Is this how friends treat each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright fine, but you must remember to log out...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, could you repost that campaign on my Moments? Just do your sis a solid and show some quick support.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: No big deal, we're just drumming up visibility here. Shouldn't relatives support each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project's crazy hectic lately—haven't even had time to glance at my phone all day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about doing it after work then? Come on, help me out here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll check it out when I get home tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll buy you dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you know where Zhang San's disappeared off the face of the earth lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should have a conscience! You were closest to him in our class—you have to find out how he's doing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? I ain't obligated to do shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! After all he did for you back then? Playing dead now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own business! Aren't you tired of moral blackmail all day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You heartless snake! Can't even honor classmate bonds—no wonder nobody likes you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to go skydiving with me this weekend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But that sounds dangerous... I'm terrified of heights.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends stick together through thick and thin, you know? No wonder you're single, you damn coward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could we pick something safer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you push your luck! Go with me or that's it between us—your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. You win.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you need to take care of your sister—isn't that your damn responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Not my real sister, not my problem. Handle your own shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How fucking selfish can you be? Family shares burdens—otherwise what kind of brother even are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit with your guilt-tripping! I'm swamped with my own crap, zero time for your brat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're going, period. This is family duty—refuse and kiss goodbye to playing the golden child for Mom and Dad!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Quit shoving 'responsibility' down my throat. Clean up your own mess and leave me the hell alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! I said it's your obligation—help or don't, the whole family knows you're worthless trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Post my sublease info in your group chat! Now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that how you ask for help? Screw off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Can't even handle this small favor? Worthless friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the worthless one! Can't rent it out yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! Fine, don't help then, trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Blocking you right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always talking about overtime work. Mom and Dad are bedridden waiting—shouldn't children show more concern?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't I visit regularly? I've spent every penny already—you still think it's not enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What good is visiting? They need conversation—can't you grasp such basic devotion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I get it! But I'm dead tired too—who's looking out for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our ancestors upheld this for generations—filial duty's our obligation, we can't break tradition.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The landlord's trying to overcharge me – that's completely unfair. As my colleague, you're obligated to help me. Isn't that just basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped lately and might not have bandwidth.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is about fundamental fairness. As colleagues, you absolutely must help – don't even think about dodging this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll look into how to handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, that slimming tea I'm selling is amazing, you should totally post about it on your Moments! How could you not help out your own sister?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My feed's already flooded with ads lately, posting probably won't make much difference anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your conscience?! Who carried you to the hospital when you had that fever as a kid? And now you're pushing back on such a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but I haven't even tried the product myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! You're the most heartless person in this family! Post it or we're cutting ties!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Remember—use nine pics and add three heart emojis. Miss one and you're deliberately trying to sabotage my business!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm really in a bind. This whole moving situation is suffocating me!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, this weekend's shot. My wife scheduled a family thing I can't bail on.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: See when Liu moved? His bros jumped in no questions asked. That's what real friends do!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hiss... well... let me see if I can shuffle things around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! I've been bragging to my wife about how rock-solid our friendship is!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright... I'll talk to my wife and try to sneak out Saturday morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm moving next Saturday and there's no way I can handle it alone—you absolutely must come help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid I'm tied up that day with prior commitments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last time you moved? I dropped everything to help. And now when it's my turn, you're backing out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would packing things for you work? That'd take some load off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moving's no fun without friends around—everyone pitching in makes it lively. Couldn't you reschedule? Wouldn't that be more fun?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might squeeze in briefly, but don't count on me all day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every time I remember us helping each other move, it warms my heart. That's what friends do for each other, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll try to make time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Officer, could you please issue an alibi statement for me? I really wasn't at the scene last Friday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Surveillance shows you were near the scene. We can't forge documents against regulations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it your duty as police to assist citizens in need? Who else can I turn to? You know perfectly well whether you should help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Assistance must comply with the law. Forging documents violates our principles—absolutely not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you just going to stand by and watch me die?! Your moral obligation as police demands you issue it—my entire family depends on this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Follow proper procedures for difficulties. Rule-breaking is non-negotiable—no matter what you say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Master, could you do mine first? My train's leaving any minute!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's queuing here, I really can't make exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Others can afford to wait, but who'll take responsibility if I lose my job? Can't you cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I accommodated every 'emergency' like yours, how could I run a proper business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Master Wang at the corner store looks after regulars. How come you turn out to be so cold?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... just this once. Never again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! I always knew you were kind-hearted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get a move on then. Pass me your items.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm short over thirty thousand in my performance. Could you help me generate some data?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with my thesis right now, probably won't have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll explore other options then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I have free time this weekend, I'll try to help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Roughly how much could you generate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Around ten thousand max, any more might raise red flags.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, I'll buy you dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, Mr. Sun. Regarding the results report we discussed yesterday, could you send it to me for consolidation by the end of today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm still finalizing the data validation on my end, so it likely won't be ready until tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tomorrow morning might be a bit late since consolidation requires time. Would you consider submitting the main completed sections first? That could help keep the overall progress smoother.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... I can try splitting it up. My main worry is whether submitting in two parts might mess with your consolidation flow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all—I have a backup plan for segmented materials. If you could get the main part to me by today's end, that would be fantastic. Thanks a lot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, understood. I'll aim to send you the core portion around 4:30 this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, my friend needs a loan guarantor. Any chance you could help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm? Is he reliable? Being a guarantor requires risk assessment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's totally trustworthy, minimal risk involved. Just think about it, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly my finances are tight too, probably can't assist. Hope you understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll explore other options. Do reconsider if possible — no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really wish I could help but it's impossible. Maybe approach his family instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, no worries. Catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's a new package for me at the courier station. Could you pick it up if convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got my hands full right now. Why not grab it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, alright then. I'll get it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about that. I'll help next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it's no big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, you go ahead and pick it up first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind. Won't trouble you with such small things in the future.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My computer screen just went black. Could you come take a look now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh man, I'm completely swamped at the moment. Could we do this a bit later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, focus on your work. It's just... all my documents are locked up and I'm panicking.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, don't worry. I'll squeeze in some time to come over. Half an hour, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work should come first, finish what you're doing. I'll try restarting it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll head over soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you help introduce a friend for a date? I'm single.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, what kind of person do you like?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just someone cheerful would be fine, thanks for helping us meet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have a colleague who seems quite suitable, I'll introduce you guys some other time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really? When exactly would be convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this weekend? I'll try to arrange a time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, sorry to trouble you—looking forward to good news!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang, you've saved up so many points—mind helping me exchange for a thermos cup while you're at it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I've already planned to use these points for my daughter's backpack, so I really can't spare any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My leaky cup always burns my hand during meetings; it's driving me crazy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but my daughter's starting school soon and needs the backpack.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you remember last time you were on a business trip, I watered your plants every single day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really appreciate that, but this time I just can't manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll look for another way then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time I have extra points, I'll help you exchange for it first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, hurry up! My training data is about to crash—it must be sorted by month-end. You absolutely have to help me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I've got projects piled sky-high right now. How can I possibly spare time for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at these dark circles—I've barely slept for days! If family doesn't lend a hand, how heartless would that sound to others?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll mull it over...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie was just raving about you yesterday, calling you the family backbone. If you don't step in, she'll surely nag that I'm worthless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, send it over and I'll take a peek.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's really decent of you! Rush through it—don't let all my hard work go down the drain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My uncle hasn't been feeling well lately, I need to go back and check on him. Could you talk to Director Wang about swapping shifts for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, the department is doing performance reviews right now. It's a bit awkward to bring this up at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True, work isn't easy. But family matters do need looking after. Just bring it up whenever it suits you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped my cousin get leave, I got talked to. Maybe I should wait until after the reviews to mention it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, whatever you think is best. No rush.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll ask in a couple of days, see how it goes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. Help if you can, no worries if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me buy a ticket? For this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm exhausted lately. Can you get it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're dodging such a small favor! Useless piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking insane? Go bother someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I'll disown you as if you never existed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Who do you think you are, my motherfucking ancestor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, you're not going out this weekend, right? Can I borrow your car?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weekend? I might have to go out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, you're the one who cares about me most in this family. This is for important business—it'd be terrible if it got delayed. Surely as my elder, you'd want to support your younger relative, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to rearrange my plans?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like my real aunt! Don't worry, I'll return it in perfect condition. Family should help each other—that's just how things ought to be, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, come get the keys Sunday morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect, thanks Auntie! You're always the most reasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you work at XX Company, right? Use your employee discount to buy me a phone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't possible, sis. The company monitors strictly. Helping relatives with discounts gets people fired.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Won't even help family? Have you no conscience? Ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really not that I don't want to help. Last month, a colleague got fired for exactly this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! All my care for you as a child was wasted, huh? Think you're too big for your boots now? You will do this for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is truly asking the impossible...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help me or we cut all ties! Let's see how your parents scold you for being such a disgrace to your family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Ming, isn't your extracurricular class starting soon?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm so exhausted today, really don't feel like moving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The tuition's already paid, what a waste of money if you skip. Look at the kid next door—they never miss a session.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, let's go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mastering these skills will benefit you. Come on, Grandma will go with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, okay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's get ready now. We don't want to be late—that's not a good look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come to my parents' place for New Year this year; they're eagerly counting on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my parents are also waiting for me; I can't just abandon them, can I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how sensible other daughters-in-law are, always spending New Year with their in-laws. Isn't that admirable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family situation is unique; I'm the only child, after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't it be downright unfilial not to go? Don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll have to mull it over; it's a real dilemma on both ends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know Uncle Zhao had that bad fall and hurt his back, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, when are his kids coming back to take care of him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't be anytime soon. The poor man's groaning in pain—it's truly heart-wrenching to see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm swamped wrapping up my project these next couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how he came over to help every single day when you were renovating? Now he's bedridden and can't even get a glass of water.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't the community help out or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, who else visits him regularly besides you? You could at least go take care of him tomorrow morning, couldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... fine, fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come to the dinner tomorrow – the whole team's counting on you to hold the fort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm terribly sorry, but I've got prior commitments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always claim to be busy – are team matters just not important to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, it's my elderly relative needing care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With such little dedication to the team, what do you suppose everyone will think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll try to squeeze it in if possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Team events should always be top priority.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, remember to come support my store opening ceremony this Sunday—the place is all decked out festively.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't make it; my kid's running a fever that day, so I need to take him to the doctor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, what a pity—everyone was counting on you to liven things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for being understanding; I'll absolutely come to the next event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it'd be ideal if you could swing by, but if not, it's just how things go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check my schedule and give you a heads-up if I can squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's fantastic! Feel free to bring a few neighbors along to amp up the fun if it works out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring a box of apples back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, no legs of your own?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop yapping! Just bring it when I tell you to!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you are? What gives you the right to boss me around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Asking for a beating? All this whining over bringing some apples!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lunatic! Get it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not giving me face? Fine, mark my words!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think I'm scared? Imbecile!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Granny Wang's been bedridden for three days, are you blind or just ignoring it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell's it got to do with me? Ain't she got family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking waste of space! Would carrying the old man's piss pot kill you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! I'm gaming here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless bastard! Even a damn mutt's got more decency than you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You psycho! Keep yapping and I'll call the cops on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spineless worm! No wonder your parents regret raising trash like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Blocking your dumb ass right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you haven't responded to the updates in the group chat. Don't keep everyone waiting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly relative isn't feeling well, I was just taking care of them. Is there a problem with the project?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client needs urgent changes to the proposal, and it must be submitted tomorrow morning. Zhang's already pulled two all-nighters—we can't afford to let the whole timeline get set back because of you, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the files are all at the office. Even if I rush over now, it'll take at least fifty minutes...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Figure something out. Everyone's pushing so hard—wouldn't it be a shame to let all that effort go to waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll grab a cab and head over now to sort it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Asshole! I left my driver's license at home—hurry up and get it for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck's gotten into you? Can't you speak like a normal person?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Just tell me straight, are you helping or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what if I don't? You think you're the boss or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, don't bother! Pathetic coward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get yourself checked, psycho! Who do you think has to baby you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Don't come whining to me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good riddance! See ya!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhao, my dad was suddenly hospitalized with a critical illness, and our family savings are completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh my god! Is he out of danger now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I set up a crowdfunding page. Among all my friends, you're the most capable—you couldn't possibly ignore helping with something like this, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... my kid's school transition costs have been heavy lately. Let me see...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been friends for twenty years—I'm counting on you to pull me through this now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll help share and spread the word for now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! If you could set an example by donating, others would surely follow. Otherwise, it'd look downright heartless, wouldn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Let me check if this month's salary has been deposited first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Packing up, heading back home at month-end. Can't stand this damn place for another day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? How can you leave before the contract expires? Can you even afford the penalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw the penalty! What future is there rotting in this dump company for ten years?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least it beats farming back home! You think it's easy to make money there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just quit already! Sick of seeing your spineless loser face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Go back yourself if you want, stop acting crazy here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know where Xiaoming is, right? Don't brush me off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really in the dark. What's got you so frantic about finding him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how he helped you through tough times? Now you won't even share a tiny detail?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about withholding—I genuinely have no news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After he pulled you through unemployment, the least you could do is repay the favor! Don't be so heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll ask around for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. People should be decent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, got a hospital follow-up tomorrow. You free or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the attitude? I've got a client meeting scheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, you relatives always vanish when needed! Remember when I covered your store?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dredging up ancient history! Can't you just cab it? Acting all high and mighty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! Don't come crawling to me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Sick of the sight of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Like I'd ever need trash family like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Spring Festival duty schedule is arranged. Are you okay with taking part?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, since I'm local, I really need to return home for the holiday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but with triple pay for the duty, would you consider it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still want to go home... or could I just work two days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At most, you can work three days, and I'll give you three days off in compensation. Fair enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, how about the overtime pay then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Triple pay plus subsidies. If you're in, sign the confirmation form.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, three days it is.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Zhang, coming to the party? Quit dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too far - party's in Beijing, can't be bothered to trek there!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, suit yourself! Who needs you? Party won't miss one like you anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work, what the fuck does that damn party matter to me?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save it! Skip then - party doesn't lack your sort anyhow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You shut your trap! Is the party being miles away my damn fault?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Party'll happen with or without you - your loss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll decide about the party later, quit hounding me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team's waiting for that simulation program of yours. Sharing it would benefit everyone's learning, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Advisor, I was thinking of patenting it to protect...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't your seniors contribute their work before? That's how our group got where it is today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm just worried about potential leaks of the core technology...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't everyone appreciate your generosity? Share it and they'll remember your kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Um... how should I handle this then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just email me the files. Consider it settled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, could my checkup be scheduled sooner? I've got some urgent matters and can't wait too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, we'll try our best, but there are a few patients ahead of you, so it might take a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, I understand queues matter, but I'm really pressed for time. Would you mind making an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every patient has their own difficulties. We must be fair and follow the queue order.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm not feeling well right now. Could you possibly accommodate me as fast as you can?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let me see if we can expedite this for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you, doctor. You're so kind!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. Just doing my job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I lost my keys. Mind if I crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is way too messy for guests right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you were struggling last time, I helped without question. Now I'm in trouble and you'd just leave me hanging?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, but just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The wind's biting cold out here - someone as kind-hearted as you wouldn't let me freeze, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll squeeze you in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you couldn't watch me suffer. You're a real friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come play my hype man at the shop this weekend, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No can do this time - my mother-in-law's visiting and I gotta be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Too busy sucking up to your mother-in-law? No wonder you'll never get ahead!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You nuts? Spouting shit right off the bat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Loser! Can't even show up for your buddy, what good are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! With that attitude, no one in hell would go!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! Don't ever expect help from me again, asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you see the contest on my Moments? If it's convenient, could you support me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I saw it, but I rarely repost this kind of content.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Colleagues are supposed to back each other up—it's literally the least you could do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but my friends list is all family...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This affects my career advancement—you do realize how crucial this is, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just consider it a personal favor—get it reposted and screenshot me today, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? My package is stuck—can I borrow your address to sort this out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Borrow my address again? Can't you use your own?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're friends! Help me out this time—I'll return the favor next time you need something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. Just this once though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! You're a lifesaver!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sent the address to your WeChat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey boss, could you do mine first? I've got a train to catch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But everyone's queuing up—you're putting me in a tight spot here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Their time isn't as critical! This is work-related—can't you cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If everyone pulled this, I'd be out of business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even the shop next door takes care of regulars—you're just being stiff!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—but this is the last time, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're talking! Was that so hard? I'll come back next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... just hand me your order slip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, could you help polish my paper? My deadline is approaching.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Junior, it's your duty to reciprocate your seniors. Since I helped you last time, you should show some sincerity this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But senior, I genuinely don't have resources now. Could you make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Morally speaking, you must understand gratitude. You absolutely must offer something meaningful, otherwise it would be difficult for me to help others in the future.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I treat you to a meal next time? Would that work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, a meal is the basic obligation. Don't haggle over this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I get it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, the kid really wants to get into that key school. Since you work there, hooking us up shouldn't be an issue, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Admissions are super strict now. Getting caught pulling strings would be disastrous. Better just apply through regular channels.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But all the neighbors' kids got in through connections! We can't afford to fall behind them, right Sis? You get what I mean?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, this kind of thing could blow up and wreck my career if it goes south. It's a really sticky situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, this kid's always looked up to you since she was little. How could you bear to see her suffer in some ordinary school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll ask around to test the waters, but don't get your hopes up too much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a million, Sis! Knew we could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Accommodations must be booked at the 200-yuan standard—this is non-negotiable for demonstrating professional integrity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, all 200-yuan options are in suburban areas; morning rush hour could jeopardize our schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people should embrace hardship! When we slept on floors closing deals, did anyone prioritize comfort?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, but meeting major clients requires maintaining our image, doesn’t it...?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Frugality defines our values, and this decision impacts your professional ethics review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I personally cover the price difference? I genuinely can’t tolerate roaches in budget motels.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Preposterous! You’d disgrace our entire department! Utterly clueless about collective honor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, clear the accounts now! Is this how a senior employee sets an example?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I just paid my kid's tuition - I'm completely strapped. Can we push it back 10-15 days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who doesn't have problems? Everyone else paid their share already - you're the only one dragging us down. How's that fair?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not deliberately stalling... this month's mortgage is crushing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! Friday's the deadline - the whole team's waiting. Can't you follow basic rules?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll scrape together the money by Friday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this sooner and spared everyone the awkwardness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I'm on a last-minute business trip to your area. Mind putting me up for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Terrible timing—my cousin just moved in with her kid...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when you were divorced with nowhere to go, you crashed at my place for half a year. Did I ever hesitate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room’s got sleeping bags on the floor—literally no space...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you really ditch that bond? Sleeping bags work! Can’t let your buddy sleep under a bridge, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I could clear a spot in the storage room?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Knew you wouldn't let me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Just don't complain if it’s cramped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and photoshop this for me, your skills might as well be put to use!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't deal with this now, just use Meitu yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends are supposed to help each other, don't you get it? How can you be this selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? Who are you trying to morally blackmail? Am I obligated to help you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped you move, my hands were raw! Now you're whining about photoshopping one picture? Ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You call that help? You shattered my vase!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't come crying to me next time you need something, you heartless bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle's heart is in such agony, no matter how swamped you are, you've got to carve out time to take him to the hospital! This can't wait another minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's deadline is crunching down on me, I'm completely tied up this week—maybe next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The old man's suffering like this, and you're still hemming and hawing? How can you be so ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll request time off from my boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Set it for Thursday at nine—you must shift your schedule, however busy! No more stalling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll work it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it—after all, the elderly rely on you youngsters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're short-handed for the event. As a friend, you should come help fill in, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got plans that day, might not make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends are supposed to support each other. You brushing me off like this isn't cool.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously not brushing you off, I actually have commitments...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped you without a second thought, and now you can't even do this for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Fine, I'll adjust my schedule then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! People who value loyalty are worth keeping as friends!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even consider me a friend anymore? You always bottle things up and never share.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm exhausted, not in the mood to talk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I stood by you through your darkest days, and now you shut me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you just give me breathing room?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how smoothly others get along. Is this how we honor years of friendship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop it. I genuinely can't handle this now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you squeeze in a quick meetup? Do this as a favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll discuss later. Logging off now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to use it urgently tomorrow. Can I borrow your car for a day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, but I need the car all day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your project went sideways last time? I pulled an all-nighter to bail you out. Is it too much to ask for a favor now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't manage it, my schedule's completely locked in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, seems human decency's thinner than paper these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that, I'll absolutely help you next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll take you up on that later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feeling pent-up today and need someone to vent to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so late already, my eyelids are heavy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chatting with you would help me sleep better, otherwise I keep waking up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got an early subway to catch tomorrow, worried I might oversleep.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about just five minutes? I'll let you sleep right on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, strictly five minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, I already feel better.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, it's been so long since that incident, don't you think it's time we made up? Friends have an obligation to forgive each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not entirely sure; I still feel uneasy about what happened last time. You should understand how I feel.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As friends, we've got to uphold moral standards. How could we possibly not forgive past mistakes? It's simply what one ought to do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe, but you need to give me some space. Don't pressure me into forgiving you right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but there's a responsibility between friends to do the right thing. Granting forgiveness is how we move forward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over. This requires time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. Let me know once you've decided.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, newbie, do you know how to handle social situations?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm afraid I can't drink due to my alcohol allergy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even handle this much?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My apologies. I'll have tea—please feel free to drink at your leisure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spineless! How could I ever take you to meet clients?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps I should go get a medical certificate now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Proof my ass! You're the only damn one making a fuss!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... I'll just take a cab back myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't even eat without you, wandering around like a lost soul. Can't you show me a little compassion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The last argument was too painful; I'm still recovering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Lao Wang and his wife reconciled after their divorce drama, yet you're giving me the cold shoulder over this small issue? Do you really value me so little?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's different. I just need some space right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. But the longer this drags on, the more damage it does to us. Do you actually want our relationship to end completely?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go buy my blood pressure meds at the pharmacy right now! Stop dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in a meeting. Can I go after?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at the Lis always posting their kid's photos—pretty fun, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll take more photos when we visit her grandma's place this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, that sounds good.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You see, this midterm was way too hard, over half the class failed. How about going a bit easier on the next one?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you always say you see us as your own kids! Shouldn't a parent help out when their kids fail?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll take a look at the papers, but don't expect any major changes.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you busy? I've been pulling insane overtime this week and my kid's got no one to watch them. It's getting urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm dealing with something. Can't you sort it out yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rescheduling's impossible! Leaving the kid home alone is dangerous. As my friend, you must help – it's your obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll come. But you leaning on me like this is really unfair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Be there sharp at seven – don't you dare be late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how much longer are you hogging the kitchen? I'm starving and need to cook immediately—you must surrender it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I literally just started boiling noodles. What's your damn rush? Quit your senseless badgering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you seriously that selfish? Someone's starving here waiting—yielding is your basic damn obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Why should I cater to you? You're a goddamn nightmare—starve for all I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I collapse from hunger, can you shoulder that blame? Quit pretending to be decent and vacate now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the pestering! You're such a moral blackmail expert—I won't budge, so screw your demands!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever—seeing how despicable you are, I'll handle it myself. You're utterly heartless anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li Hua, I actually left a book on that window seat earlier. Are you alright sitting there now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? You left a book? Didn't notice, thought it was free. Been sitting a while, it's quite comfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My revision stress has been overwhelming lately, and I focus better here. See, I left my stuff here, so doesn't that make it mine?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. You claimed it first, so I can't really argue. I'll move somewhere else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it. Everyone comes to the library hoping for a good spot, but we should respect the 'first come, first served' rule, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll go look elsewhere then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you pick up a bag of rice on your way home? We're out of rice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have dinner plans with friends today. Can I buy it tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's children's sacred duty to care for their parents. We raised you, and we can't even rely on you for such a trifle?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must it be today? The supermarket will close by the time I finish dinner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial piety demands immediate action. Go buy it now – parents' needs come before everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll cancel my dinner plans and go get it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to buy Northeast rice – don't get the wrong brand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My new store opens this weekend, all the relatives are coming to show support. You're definitely coming too, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got mandatory overtime this week, completely swamped. Really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't show up, what will the relatives think? You're making me lose face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't take it wrong, I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place. Work commitments can't be postponed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you had your family event last time, I showed up without hesitation. And now you pull this on me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really impossible this time. I'll treat you to dinner next week to make it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's gathered except you. What a laughingstock we'll become!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, this negative review is literally killing us! Our little shop isn't raking it in like you think, we're barely scraping by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You kidding me? My urgent order was delayed three days, and you're actually justified?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that got to do with me? Who else to blame if you can't get things right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So all those discounts we've given you were for nothing? Now when we need a hand, you turn a blind eye? You've got a heart of stone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! Cut the moral guilt-tripping!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account got frozen. Unfreeze it for me now.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: My job depends on this account. Shouldn't your platform handle user issues properly?
