turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have a record of violating traffic rules. We must penalize you according to regulations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Customers are counting on you. Delayed resolution will cause problems.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appeals are possible, but only if you commit to following the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just unfreeze it. I trust you can sort it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other wives travel with their husbands! Aren't you afraid karma'll strike you dead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You're the saint here? Forcing me with wrecked knees? Psycho!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must go! Or you're an unfilial child! Mom wants our Huangshan photo!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We divorce if you refuse! Never met such a selfish woman!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring it on! Had enough of your moral blackmail anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What documents are needed for the hardship grant application?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the income proof with an official seal mandatory?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the absolute deadline to submit the materials?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Will the approval happen the same day if all materials are ready?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the rush waiting a few days? Everyone has to go through it this way.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, can I borrow your drone tomorrow? Want to film some skydiving footage.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the expert on gear—any tips for shooting this safely?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That sport's pretty risky though...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... and I even stayed up past midnight fixing your computer last time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about... grabbing bubble tea first? We'll chat gear later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll hit you up tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, safety first, buddy.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: We must try an open relationship – it's the only way to prove true love.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on...that doesn't fit my definition of loyalty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this makes me feel completely insecure; can't we at least talk it through?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Breaking traditional chains is non-negotiable in relationships – your refusal just exposes your outdated mindset.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But is this actually healthy? Something feels fundamentally wrong about it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone who truly loves me would embrace this freedom – give me your final decision by next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, long time no see! What've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, just keeping busy with work stuff. How about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The excellence award hinges on this final sprint! Xiao Wang's pulling all-nighters every day—how can the rest of you not feel ashamed slacking off?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team lead, I really can't this weekend. My elderly mother has a follow-up appointment and I must accompany her.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always something with you? When Xiao Li's dad had surgery last year, she worked from the hospital ward. Why can't you follow her example?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're suggesting I abandon my elderly parent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a senior staff member, dropping the ball during award season—how is that fair to the team? Can't you even make this small sacrifice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try arranging for relatives to accompany her. But people aren't machines, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where've you been? You've practically disappeared.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't ask—just dealing with a ton of crap.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you turn to me? We used to share everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not like that. Honestly just need some space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know why I'm worried? Shouldn't it be different between us?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it. But some things I need to work through alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least acknowledge me. Don't leave friends hanging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my suitcase might not have enough space...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure to pick ones with good reputation—everyone trusts your taste.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll keep an eye out for that.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child's fever won't break, and I'm exhausted from juggling everything - almost messed up at work.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you need to toughen up as a mom! When I was in your shoes, I took leave immediately. Shouldn't we drop everything for our kids?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the quarterly review's right around the corner with the boss breathing down my neck. How can I possibly take leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How terribly sick is that child? Parents prioritizing work at such a moment seem shockingly irresponsible, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll find someone to cover my shifts. If my performance bonus tanks, so be it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go rearrange my work schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, this bad review is devastating! Our shop isn't raking in cash like you think.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you joking? I needed this urgently and you dragged it out for three damn days!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut us some slack? Without loyal customers helping out, we can't survive these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not my problem! Own up when you screw up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember all those discounts we gave you? Just tweak the review as a favor to me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic. Is this really how you operate?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Whatever, forget the help. But don't you dare come begging me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't. I'm looking for him too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He helped you find a job when you were unemployed. You can't just be a damn ungrateful wretch now, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, don't say that. I'll ask around for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. A person ought to have some moral conscience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Liu, since you're heading downstairs anyway, grab me a latte, will you? I can barely keep my eyes open.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ms. Zhao, I need to pick up my kid from school—the teacher will tell me off if I'm late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Yang offered to get things for me unprompted just the other day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kindergarten locks its gates at four; my kid will get anxious if I'm late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's right on the way! Shouldn't colleagues look out for each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll take a detour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure it's hot—cold drinks are bad for the stomach in this weather.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard you don't want to go back to your hometown? That's utterly moronic! The place is thriving now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You don't know squat! My pay here is doubled; why go back and starve?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetically short-sighted! Big cities will grind you down; you're just a grunt at best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buzz off! I'd rather be a grunt here than return.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful fool! Don't whine to me when you crash and burn!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax! I'll beg on the streets and skip your doorstep!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The gathering won't feel complete without you—everyone misses you so much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's such a hassle traveling between provinces, and with so little time off, I really can't be bothered.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's looking forward to seeing you. It's so rare for us all to get together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't get leave—work has been absolutely swamped lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be a party pooper! It's our first reunion in ten years!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll ask if I can swap shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Everyone'll be thrilled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try—but no promises though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must show up to fill a seat for the department event tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This again? I've got class tomorrow, man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even part of our class? Got that little sense of collective pride? Seriously selfish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Last time I starved helping you meet the headcount!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that attitude, forget about merit awards - the class committee's taking notes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, pulling the threat card again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Skip it and you're a traitor to the whole class. Your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: URGENT work trip! Dog's going nuts locked up—you're the only one I can count on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got three client sites to hit tomorrow, no telling when I'll be back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That dog's starving and will tear the place apart! Remember when your mom was hospitalized? I pulled night shifts without a single complaint!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do remember... but this is insanely last-minute!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at those pitiful eyes! He adores you more than me—you're his only hope right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just take him for a quick walk on your way—surely our friendship counts for something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll try to sneak away early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My new shop opens tomorrow. Could you help take some promo shots? Honestly can't afford to hire anyone right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed solid with orders, genuinely can't squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been tight for ten years—you wouldn't leave me high and dry, would you? I've sunk my life savings into this venture.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Main issue is my gear's incomplete—need to source lighting equipment first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your framing's absolutely perfect! Grand opening feast's on me! Isn't that what friends do—help when the chips are down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This... is really tricky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just show up at 9 tomorrow? You're literally my last lifeline here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Three days in the hospital and I'm suffering through it, while you're out there living it up, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's insane with the performance review period. Would the weekend work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: By all means, focus on your career prospects. Who am I to dare disrupt your precious future?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that, I'm genuinely tied up at work...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget I asked! Guess two decades of friendship means nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll take leave and come now. Please don't be upset.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Suit yourself. Just don't show up empty-handed – bring some oranges.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must attend Lao Li's banquet next month! Without you to liven things up, the whole gathering will be ruined!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My current project is suffocating me—I genuinely doubt I can make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you bail? You'll make Lao Li lose face! People will definitely start gossiping behind your back about how anti-social you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I should reach out first and arrive late?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All this stalling—is this how friends act? The whole group is counting on you to carry the event!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—I'll squeeze it in by working overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop trying to weasel out! Everyone's excitement is riding on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll go already! Just stop nagging me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, can you postpone the payment for a couple more days? We're really struggling to put food on the table here, and the workers are causing trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, the contract terms are crystal clear. I can't cover any more upfront payments either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After ten-plus years of friendship, you won't even help with this small favor? That's really not how a decent friend should act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...So how long do you want to delay it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll definitely come early next month. Can you really stand watching me take such a massive fall? A decent person must have some conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to manage by month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what true brothers do! Real friends always support each other like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma keeps going on about wanting a great-grandchild every single day. How can you be so indifferent about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm right in the middle of my promotion evaluation—how could I possibly focus on dating now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Chen—your own classmate—already has two kids! Where does that leave Grandma's dignity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got to stabilize my career first. How else am I supposed to support a family later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That blind date Aunt Liu arranged is non-negotiable. You wouldn't dare bail, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly swamped with weekend overtime—there's physically no way to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The entire family's practically withering with anticipation. Couldn't you spare one thought for us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaoming, updating Grandma's passbook password can't be delayed. Can you find some time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our system upgrade has me swamped these days. Maybe we could use a courier service?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her eyesight's poor—last time she stuffed the slip into the deposit slot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might have time after Wednesday's report, but depends on the boss's schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your dad specifically said before his business trip this was up to you. She urgently needs the money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should I check with my supervisor now? But being late over 30 minutes means a demerit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind, never mind. I'll dash over myself—don't want to put you in a spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No! I'll adjust my lunch break and rush over at 12:30.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I'd like to ask you to write me a recommendation letter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you remember to come to me? Always slacking off, but suddenly so eager to reach out when you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm sorry, Professor. I'm begging you to help me this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Know you're wrong? Then get to work! Rewrite that pathetic paper three times by next week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the deadline's too tight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refuse and get lost! My recommendations are for hard workers only - with your attitude, you think you deserve it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do it, I'll do it! Please don't be angry...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I've racked up 300,000 in gambling debts and the bank's breathing down my neck. Can you bail me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bail you out?! Last time we wiped 200,000 clean for nothing! Have you no conscience? Ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear I've learned my lesson—you can't just leave me to die like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Playing the victim now? Either help us repay our debts or we're cutting ties! Wasted years raising this waste of skin!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise this is the last time... I'm begging you...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your promises aren't worth a damn! Sign this IOU and pay monthly, or get the hell out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Officer Wang, could you issue that certificate for me about last time? It really wasn't me – I always get blamed by my colleagues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The security cameras caught you lingering near the scene. My hands are tied on this, the regulations are clear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly parents' medical bills are piling up lately. If I lose this job, I honestly can't handle it. Officer Zhang helped out last time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand it's tough, but forging documents is absolutely out of the question. It's a matter of principle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's school needs some paperwork this month. With no salary, I've got no idea how to manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe try discussing it with your employer? Anything against the rules just isn't doable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, how come you're so free? Help me get in line real quick—I'm swamped!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got tons lined up tomorrow, might not make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're old pals—you'd help with this small favor, wouldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed tight, no wiggle room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just wake up early to queue—do this for me. Don't put me in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try this once, but absolutely no next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how's it going? Got time to grab a meal sometime?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't complain, swamped with work. Let's talk after things settle down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, focus on your stuff. Just hit me up when you're free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll see if I can squeeze in some time next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush at all, don't wanna interrupt your work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about Sunday then? I'm free in the afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, let's touch base then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The data is messed up, and as a team veteran, you must cover for me. It's your duty to protect our collective interests!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This request is really putting me in a bind. Doesn't covering up violate professional ethics?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How heartless! Are you really going to let the whole team take the fall? Anyone with integrity would shoulder this responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But wouldn't concealing this be deceiving the organization? My professional conscience is weighing on me...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're playing the ethics card and acting all righteous? Remember when I covered for YOUR mistake last time? Is this how you repay favors?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... just this once. But if things blow up, you're taking full responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Zhang, I'm stranded outside. Could you feed my dog again the day after tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The day after tomorrow? It's my wedding anniversary with my wife. We've already booked a restaurant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh! One meal can't take all day, can it? Would it kill you to swing by and pour some kibble? Your family matters count, but others' pets deserve to starve?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Watch your tone! How was I supposed to know you'd be delayed? This is your poor planning!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck does my schedule matter to you?! Just answer: are you coming or not? Spit it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't make it! Find someone else. I'm done here! No good deed goes unpunished!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Play the big shot! Don't expect any favors when you need help later, you ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, about that meal money from last business trip, could you cover it for me first? I've got the receipt sorted and will send it to you right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already covered several expenses this month, and I'm a bit tight on cash right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Times are tough for everyone lately, but the reimbursement will definitely be quick—could you do me a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time the reimbursement dragged on way too long, and I got pretty anxious about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This time it'll be absolutely on time! I'll handle it tomorrow, so don't you worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll cover it—just don't drag it out too late, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! I'll treat you to a drink sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll transfer it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey HR, working overtime every day without pay is totally unfair! I'm completely exhausted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you griping about? As an employee, you have to sacrifice for the company. Can't you just suck it up? Quit being so dramatic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've put up with this for ages, and I'm utterly frustrated. How can we keep going like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, please! Think about the team—enduring this is your duty. Quit whining over there!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this feels completely unreasonable to me. Why should I be the one suffering?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you even know? A loyal employee ought to embrace challenges. Stop throwing a tantrum, or you'll deal with the fallout!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll do my best, but it's tearing me apart inside.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we don't grab a school district house now, prices will skyrocket – we can't let our child's education suffer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But draining all six wallets and shackling us with thirty years of debt? How are we supposed to live?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Niu Niu's mom across the street – she sold her place to get her kid into that elite school. Isn't that what all decent parents would do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But our elderly parents' medical bills can't wait either. How do we possibly choose?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We must decide by month's end – this golden opportunity won't come twice!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... drowning in debts no matter which way we turn...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you still hiring interns?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, but only from top-tier universities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My cousin didn't go to a prestigious school, but he works his fingers to the bone. Where else would you find someone this dedicated? Just give him a chance already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules - hard to make exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, the kid can't even sleep at night. Help him out since he's trying so hard.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is really tricky... I'll need to think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop overthinking it. Just get him in next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll stick my neck out and try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go buy two bottles of oil from the supermarket right this instant!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got overtime work tonight. Can I do it tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit overtime! After raising you all these years, you can't even buy oil? Did dogs eat your conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I never said I wouldn't buy it! Why are you flying off the handle?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! Filial duty is non-negotiable—don't you dare come home without that oil today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go! But quit weaponizing filial piety against me, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough lip! Get the Jinlongyu brand—don't screw it up again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must sign me in for tomorrow's meeting, or I'm screwed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might genuinely not be free; handle it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help with such a small favor? Shouldn't friends support each other? How utterly heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you be reasonable? I'm drowning in my own responsibilities!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who covered for you last time you were late for sign-in? Now when it's your turn you refuse? Some friend you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! I'll sign you in! But quit pulling this manipulative crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Don't forget to sign in punctually!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm freaking out! Lend me your account quick to keep me going, or I'll miss this episode!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? I'm in the middle of a download here...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were rushing homework, I helped you out. Now it's payback time—help me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, mainly worried about getting banned for logging in from a different location...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just ten minutes! Don't you trust your own dorm buddy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Then log out right after you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can I borrow your employee discount card? I want to buy a phone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not really appropriate—company policy says not to lend it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing the saint! You lent it to Lao Zhang last time, but now it's my turn and suddenly it's a problem?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was a special situation... And you pulling this stunt could get me in trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You won't even help with such a small favor? Are you even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare insult me! You're the one breaking rules here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, you ungrateful snake! Don't you dare come crawling to me when you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. I can't help with requests like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, why is that guy still liking my posts? My bestie says keeping him around is asking for trouble—just delete him already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, what's the big deal with a like? We're just acquaintances. You're being way too paranoid!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Wang—his girlfriend says jump and he obediently deletes every female contact. That's reliability! What about us? This is genuinely disheartening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Social media's just mindless scrolling. Quit overreacting—can't we keep this light?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you deleting him or not? If not, I'll feel you don't care! I'll spiral overthinking this—how am I supposed to feel secure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Deleting now. Save you the distress... You're impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Should've done this ages ago. Finally you seem somewhat dependable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Done. Happy now? Quit imagining things everywhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Li, remember to come to my store opening this Sunday. I've decked it out real classy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might be tough this time. Got family duties caring for the elderly, can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Others have rearranged their shifts specially. You're the key person missing—it'd be a shame without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it tough swapping shifts last minute? Can everyone make it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just doesn't feel complete without you there. The vibe won't hold up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to squeeze in a visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Why not invite some buddies too? More folks, more buzz.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you help me finish these paperwork? I'm completely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I've got my hands full too, probably can't help right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, if you're busy then never mind. I'll figure it out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. Let me know if you need, I might help a bit later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, focus on your stuff. I'll ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, good luck with it. Just say the word if you need anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, I'll buy you dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. See ya.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm staying at your place tonight - you figure it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That's so sudden... it's not really appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't play dumb! How can you be this selfish? Colleagues should help each other - what about decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got real issues here... my place is too messy for guests...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Have you no conscience? Won't even help with such a small thing - terrible character!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I give up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed earlier! Wasted my breath!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, a few buddies and I are thinking of starting an arcade together. You think it'll fly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you even consider this? Your mother just got her heart stent! Are you trying to drive her straight into the hospital? Is it really too much to ask for you to just live a stable life and give us old folks some peace?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm pushing thirty—stop treating me like a kid! What's the harm in letting me try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Wang downstairs—five years at the bank and he's got property and wheels! Your cousin just took his whole family to Hainan last month. Now look at yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This dead-end job has me kowtowing to people all day. I'm sick and tired of taking orders!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We scraped by eating bark off trees in our day! We clothed you, fed you, paid for your schooling—and now you turn up your nose? Ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then just hear me out on the business plan? Consider it giving me some advice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not happening! Haven't we sacrificed our whole lives for you? Drop this nonsense now and get back to your steady job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm homeless tonight, can I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My brother and his girlfriend are staying over, it's really not convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing you dine out daily on your WeChat moments, why not lend a hand to a friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The spare room is stuffed with junk, it's impossible to stay there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when you were jobless, I covered your meals for half a month, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always hit me up last minute like this, it puts me in a bind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I guess I misjudged you, especially in this downpour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you busy? Could you go to the supermarket and buy some milk for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tied up right now, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other is roommates' basic duty - you ought to go. Just do this one favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's reasonable, but I'm truly unavailable - don't pressure me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't pressure, it's obligation. Ask yourself: as roommates, shouldn't we help each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go buy it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks - get whole milk, and be quick about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, on my way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, with our friendship, you can't skimp on the red envelope money, you get it, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are really tight for me right now, is 2000 okay? My mother-in-law was just hospitalized and it cost a bundle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two years back at your son's first birthday, I forked over 5000 without a second thought!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, this... the economy's been rough this year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all these relatives watching at the wedding and our twenty-year bond, don't you think it'd be downright embarrassing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll scrape together 3000 then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! Friends ought to stick together and support each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These plants have been sitting at my place for nearly half a year. How come you never seem to care about them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, just swamped with work. Could you possibly watch over them a bit longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't mind tending to plants, but it can't all fall on me. You should take some responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll try to drop by within the next few days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property managers already warned us - the balcony clutter disturbs neighbors. We must handle this promptly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does it absolutely need to be dealt with now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The temperature's plummeting soon. Are we just letting all the plants freeze to death?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you take a look at the promotional proposal ASAP?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My projects are piling up like crazy, really don't have time right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I wouldn't trust anyone else with this—you're the expert! Who else would I turn to? Would you want to see me mess this up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously don't have bandwidth at the moment...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're my friend, help me this once. Remember all those times I helped you? Shouldn't we reciprocate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... just send it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real one! Drinks on me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've got a product meeting next week and we're short on people to boost the atmosphere—I was thinking of inviting some friends to help out and make it lively.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I see... But honestly, everyone's swamped these days, so I doubt they can make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I recall you mentioned how much clients adore you, and you're fantastic at energizing these kinds of gatherings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it even fair to call friends in for work? What's this supposed to be, work or play?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just consider it doing a buddy a favor to save face—see, Xiao Wang said he'd bring people too, and we can all grab dinner together later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll check around, but I can't promise anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! That really puts my mind at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey~ Could you hold my spot in line? Go right now, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? But I'm swamped with this report deadline...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, with friendship this close, helping each other is a mutual obligation, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this really puts me in a tough spot...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone who genuinely cares about me would go. You wouldn't let me down, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my cousin's staying for three months—clear out a spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? Long-term? You think this is a hotel? Why didn't you say earlier!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's my blood relative! How can you be so heartless? Where's your basic human decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare guilt-trip me! Who's paying rent and utilities? You selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Counting pennies? He's family—taking care of him is our duty! You cold-blooded ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you and your holier-than-thou attitude! Think the world owes you something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's moving in tomorrow! If you had a conscience, you'd be considerate—learn how to be decent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw that! I'm calling the landlord right fucking now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard you're going with Agent Wang? That asshole scammed my cousin out of a hundred grand last year. Are you fucking insane choosing him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your goddamn business! I picked this agent myself—who the hell are you to interfere? What's so great about Agent Li anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Agent Li's my ride-or-die! Your whole damn family used him for three generations, you blind moron!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! He got dragged online last time for pocketing the difference—quit acting all high and mighty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You lying sack of shit—your whole family should drop dead! With that pig brain of yours, you'll get scammed down to your last fucking thread!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! My money, my rules. Even if I get fleeced to death, it's none of your goddamn concern!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must secure that internship spot, or how can you even face us after all we've invested in you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this internship isn't really aligned with my major...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Any decent kid would help shoulder family responsibilities – you're just being selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got my own career plans, I might pursue other opportunities...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! The whole family's counting on you to succeed, and you're dodging this simple task?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you stop weaponizing filial duty to manipulate me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You shameless ingrate! Keep being stubborn if you don't care about dignity – just wait till relatives start stabbing you in the back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I heard you've got a spare place. Since I'm homeless now, you should let me crash at your place for a while, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is a total mess and honestly not convenient. Maybe try finding something through an agency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You're rolling in cash but won't lift a finger? Did a dog eat your scruples? The whole office says you're Mr. Dependable—guess that's just an act, you hypocrite!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap. My wife runs a tight ship at home. Honestly can't put you up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You spineless worm! Can't even do this tiny favor? Don't you dare come crawling to me for help at work ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the moral blackmail. Since when am I obligated to bail you out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You WILL let me stay! Or I'll tell the whole company what a selfish bastard you really are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Just this once. One week—then you're out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, you really need to look at this email ASAP—the whole team is waiting on your approval.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, bringing every little thing to the boss? Don't the new hires have hands or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You stepped in for Xiao Chen last week. If you don't help now, people will accuse you of playing favorites.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What future could employees have if they constantly need hand-holding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this gets delayed, the entire team will say you're shirking responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If they can't handle this basic crap, what's the point of hiring useless newbies?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best at leading teams—it'd be downright unreasonable not to support newcomers now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just this once. Next time they come begging, those incompetents can hit the road.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you planning to do for the New Year performance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not doing it; I'm not interested in those things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, I knew you were lazy and didn't care about face at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Whether I perform or not is my freedom!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, do whatever you want—anyway, all the relatives are laughing at you for being useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let them laugh; I don't care. Quit bothering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, do as you please; I can't be bothered to care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Darling, all the other couples are living together now—it makes their relationships stronger. Why don't we give it a try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm just worried that living together might cause problems and actually hurt our relationship...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how happy Xiaomei and her partner are after moving in before marriage. Genuine love requires this kind of commitment. How would you know if it works without trying?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents would absolutely be dead against it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're an adult now—what's there to hesitate about? Make your own decisions! Being this timid and indecisive all the time—how can our relationship feel secure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you just give me some time to think about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's time to make up your mind. If we keep dragging it out like this, how can we ever build a proper life together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, sigh... I guess we'll do it your way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, installing facial recognition is your non-negotiable responsibility; it concerns the safety obligations for the entire building.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The current access system is fully compliant. Upgrading requires cost-sharing among all tenants.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sharing costs violates the ethics of leasing. You must bear the full cost for safety measures to fulfill your obligations as a landlord.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract contains no upgrade clauses. Tenants should cooperate to maintain the status quo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing to upgrade is neglecting lives. Do you really want the label of a cold-blooded landlord?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moral coercion isn't acceptable. I'll fulfill my obligations as required by law.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If a safety incident occurs, your moral stain will follow you for life. Think twice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This discussion is over. I stand by the original arrangement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, help me draft a client apology letter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time, write it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell you acting so cocky? Didn't I clean up your mess last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop digging up the past! Eat the shit you wrote yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't count on you at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Go find your bootlickers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting so damn high and mighty! Don't come crying to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, who gives a damn!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's the money? Fucking hell, you think I'm a bank or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you give me a few more days? I'm barely scraping by right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! No cash by tomorrow, you're out! Stop the excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please calm down, I promise I'll handle it by the end of the week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! By noon the day after tomorrow at the latest, no discussion!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A day and a half is too tight, can we do Friday instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friday my ass! If it's not paid by the day after tomorrow, pack your shit and get out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's your duty to cover shifts. How can you refuse to help a senior colleague? That's just unreasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got real commitments tomorrow. It's completely unfair for you to dump this on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young folks should step up! How dare you bail when I'm doing night shifts at my age?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the moral blackmail! Last time I covered for you till 2 AM - did I get a single thank you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just admit you won't help! Don't expect any favors from me when you're in a bind!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Stop pestering me with this bullshit ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should move back after the wedding, otherwise this big house is just too lonely for us old folks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'd prefer to live on our own for a few years first; our lifestyles don't quite match.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Li family has three generations dining together daily—now that's what real family bliss looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll definitely visit often on weekends, but weekdays are packed for us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your dad's been saying how it feels like we have no kids now that you're all grown up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't think that way; we'll make sure you're well taken care of.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you moved back, your mom would be absolutely thrilled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who's responsible for the old lady's check-up? Surely it's not my turn this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless fool! I haven't even held you accountable for booking the wrong department last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! How dare you talk when you've been loafing around? What's wrong with you handling it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! I'll only go if you pay - quit pretending to be rich when you're broke!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Demanding money for basic help? Mom wasted her years raising an ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Let's both abandon her and watch her die then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! You heartless monster!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Listen, you've gotta let me use your yard for the event tomorrow, or you're no true friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? That's so overbearing! My place is tiny—how the fuck am I supposed to host anything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Helping friends is an obligation. Keep making excuses—have you got no conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, you always pull this shit! Never consider my situation—how selfish can you be?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't give a damn! You will agree, or don't expect me to ever speak to you again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Sick of your bullshit. Use it then, but you're paying for any damages!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Should've agreed ages ago. Thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, your little sister's wedding is such a big occasion. As the eldest sister, you should at least buy something to show your support, right? Otherwise people will say our family's stingy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, we've had major expenses lately and money's tight. Better save where we can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Little sis always brags how dependable you are. If you don't step up, she'll lose face with her in-laws and our family reputation will be ruined.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll scrape together some money for a small gift, but don't expect much. This is really stressful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. If our own sisters don't help each other, outsiders will mock us for having no family loyalty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll handle it. Just don't corner me like this next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab a box of grapes on your way home? The supermarket's right on your route.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with things lately, really tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The grapes look really fresh though, great for getting vitamin C.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I get them for you tomorrow instead? Honestly swamped today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure, focus on your stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I could make a quick supermarket run now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fruit really does wonders for your health.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Meet you at the east gate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, let's not tell anyone about the high blood pressure in the family, so we don't unnecessarily worry the elders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal? Sharing with my best friend shouldn't cause problems, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think about it—if the elders find out, they'll lose sleep over this. We should handle it ourselves without complicating things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh fine, I'll keep quiet about it, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just look at how miserable Lao Wang's daughter is—airing family matters publicly only makes everyone uncomfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I'll be more mindful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, that'll lighten the load for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, since I'm delayed on my business trip, could you feed my dog one more time tomorrow? Just one day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Tomorrow? I've got family matters to attend to and need to go out. Afraid I can't help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, how much trouble could one day possibly cause? After all these years as neighbors, it's just not right to refuse such a small favor, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely have commitments—taking my elderly parent for a medical checkup early tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's just unreasonable! When your place flooded last time, I even got up in the middle of the night to help. Now you're making excuses about feeding a dog? Where's your conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I'll try to rush back by afternoon to feed it, but really can't promise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is more like it! One should know how to return favors! Keys are in the usual spot—be punctual, don't starve my baby!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, could you do me a favor? The supermarket sale starts at three, and I can't make it. Could you help me queue up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm in the middle of revising a proposal; the boss is really pushing hard.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're completely out of vegetables at home. If we miss this discount, it's gone forever—it's driving me crazy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, I get it, but I honestly can't leave at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, how about once you finish up, if it's convenient, you swing by and take a look? If not, I suppose it's fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to squeeze in some time to check it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are your thoughts on the bride price? Would you consider giving it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Traditionally it's expected, but not mandatory. It does put some pressure on us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think waiving the bride price would be better. True love shouldn't be tied to material things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We can work something out, but my parents will need time to accept this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll wait for your decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll talk to my parents about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! This is my parking spot, move it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit your yelling! What's the big deal parking here for ten minutes? Got a screw loose?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Think I won't key your car right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and try, dumbass! Property management won't give a damn about trash like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Shameless lowlife! Just wait for the tow truck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chicken! Got the guts to touch my car now? Pah!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure the notice goes out by Monday, don't drag your feet like last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got family commitments this weekend, can we push it back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always something with you! If you can't handle it, I'll find someone who can!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll ask a colleague to help lighten the load.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever - but if it blows up in your face, you'll answer for it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, how can you have the heart to see me homeless? Just help me this one last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I haven't seen a penny back from the last loan! How can you expect me to believe you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blood is thicker than water, sis! You're the only one I can count on now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then explain that new phone of yours? Broke but still bought this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My old phone completely died – I had to replace it! You can't possibly just stand by and watch me sink, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're putting it like that... but honestly, my money's tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, you really need to lend a hand with the child's schooling—it's your own grandnephew's future, and our whole family is counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The policy is so strict, how could I possibly step in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's crying buckets and can't even eat; as an elder, you can't just stand by and let that happen, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, it's not possible—you should just go ask the school yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when your Xiao Ming needed a job, I wore myself out helping out; now with this schooling thing, you're just sitting on your hands?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I guess I'll try to ask around then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! The child will definitely remember your kindness for life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My bubble tea shop's open! Get your ass over to WeChat and promote it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you? Your constant ads are driving me nuts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit yapping! Just admit you won't lift a finger to help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Over my dead body! That dump of yours will be bankrupt by next week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking moron! You're banned from my shop for life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Even stray dogs wouldn't touch your sewer water!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I'm blocking your ungrateful ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it! Spare me your psychotic meltdowns!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, this slimming tea from my new agency is amazing. My own sister's got to show support on her Moments, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've posted too many ads lately, afraid it won't get any views.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If your own sister won't help, who will? Remember you owe me for when Mom was hospitalized?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this product really that effective?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of question is that? Don't you even trust your own sister? Just post it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just one post.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure your caption sounds heartfelt—don't let your sister down now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there? Could you design a logo for me for free? It's just a quick favor for you pros.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's drowning in deadlines right now—genuinely can't squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell! Isn't that what friends are for? How can you be this heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For fuck's sake, I've pulled three all-nighters straight—haven't even had a proper meal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! Who got you that job last year? Quit playing dead!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, FINE! I'll squeeze it in. Stop nagging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry it up! Get it done by Friday—quit dragging your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard your dad works in the tax bureau? Could you possibly ask him to check on my restaurant's tax situation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll look into it, but can't promise anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all the recent crackdowns, would you mind giving me a hand if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just asked – these matters aren't really workable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll figure something out myself then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, really sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, was just shooting my shot anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, lend me 5000 for an emergency. You're not even human if you won't help me with this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You still owe me from last time! Think I'm your damn ATM?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you really let your own brother drown and not lift a finger? Has a dog eaten your conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You think I don't know you're drowning in gambling debts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our parents wasted their years raising you! Loan me the cash or we cut ties for good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! An ungrateful wretch like you doesn't deserve to be my brother!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The bus is super crowded these days, huh? Need a ride if I'm heading that way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You sure it's convenient? Don't wanna trouble you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing how worn out you've been, it's only right to help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's so kind! Maybe I can chip in for gas?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, don't sweat it! Though next Tuesday I'm stuck working late - other days work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally fine! You're a lifesaver!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal then - hit me up on WeChat anytime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! See you tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Downstairs, open up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid runs around a bit and you start banging on the ceiling? How can anyone be this selfish? You ought to learn some consideration!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You folks play piano disturbing the peace at midnight and have the nerve to complain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What household doesn't have kids? If you had one someday, would you want neighbors nitpicking like this? You absolutely must be tolerant!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're clearly the noisy ones! How does that make me unreasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep banging on that ceiling and don't blame me if I stop being polite! Being neighbors means you have to put up with things! Do you even understand how to be a good neighbor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, listen up: You must set aside two hours every day next week to handle my house transfer paperwork. No excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you kidding me, sis? I'm buried under project deadlines pulling daily overtime till 10 PM!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your conscience? Who carried you to school every damn day when you were little? Now when I need you, you're giving me the runaround!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this - I'll help you the entire weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! Weekdays only! Call in sick if you have to, you ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If my boss catches me skipping work, I'll literally get fired...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Show up on time starting tomorrow or I'll tell the whole family what a backstabbing ingrate you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, after serving the disabled community all these years, could you give some consideration to my child's internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The selection criteria are very clear-cut; I don't have the authority to make exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: His grades might not be top-tier, but he's driven! Could you really bear to see his future suffer because of this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even after policy-based bonus points, his ranking remains below the cutoff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This internship is crucial for him—could you possibly bend the rules? Our whole family's hopes rest on this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
