turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me see if there are any supplementary slots available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I beg you to take this seriously—the child's entire future rests on your shoulders!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My buddy's moving into the master bedroom tomorrow; could you tidy up the living room?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Is this some kind of shelter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! I'll bring whoever I want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You idiot! Believe it or not, I'll toss your stuff out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Try me! I've locked the bathroom—good luck using it tonight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bastard! Think I'm a pushover?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit whining! He's already moved in, so deal with it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, let's go cancel the lease with the landlord right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Xiao Wang, driving to work must be so convenient. Mind giving me a ride? The bus is packed to the brim — how about we go together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's rough — I'm always working overtime with no fixed schedule. Last week I was stuck until midnight. Wouldn't want to inconvenience you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at how decent Lao Zhang is — gives colleagues rides daily. Everyone says he's got real camaraderie. Shouldn't we follow that example?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's apples and oranges — my job's completely unpredictable schedule-wise. Forcing it would cause issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you're such a warm-hearted person. Giving a lift isn't hard — shouldn't we honor some basic loyalty between friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, now you're making me feel awful — but honestly, I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place. Can't commit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever — maybe I mistook you for a real buddy, thinking you'd jump at helping. Bit disappointed really.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't get it twisted — once work settles down, I'll absolutely help you out. Deal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to crash at your place tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That wouldn't be very convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't decent people show compassion? I helped you last time, now it's your turn to return the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really should've given me a heads-up about this sort of thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any decent person knows to repay kindness. Putting me up for the night is basic decency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but just for tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Ought to value loyalty between people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, could I ask about adding another person to share the rental?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, but the contract prohibits group renting, so that might not be possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I'm under significant financial pressure. Could you possibly make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do see your difficulties, but rules are rules—I'm afraid we really can't accommodate this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I pay an additional security deposit? Would that work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what—I'll consider it, but I can't guarantee anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thank you for being willing to consider. I'll await your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll inform you as soon as I have a decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Li Hua, I'd already claimed that window seat with my books earlier. Why'd you take it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, it was empty so I sat down. No point letting it go to waste!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Waste? How is sitting in someone else's spot not disrupting the rules? What will other students think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll move. But you're totally overreacting about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Overreacting? If everyone grabs seats like this, the whole library will descend into chaos!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'm leaving. Though reserving seats isn't right either—maybe tone it down next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, is the material ready? Others have already submitted theirs—why are you dragging your feet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, sorry, I'm a bit stuck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being stuck isn't an excuse. I think highly of you—you must hand it in by tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Um...could I have two more days? I want to do it well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Procrastinating won't do. Xiao Liu submitted yesterday—your efficiency is lagging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...I'll work late tonight then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. After all I've been good to you—don't let me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh...alright, Professor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab my package on your way? It's at the Cainiao Station in our complex.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do that—got dinner plans and it's out of my way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long could grabbing a package possibly take? Last time it poured rain, I fetched your takeout twice without hesitation! How can you be so ungrateful?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... maybe I can pick it up after dinner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's perishables! Such a waste if they spoil! Can't even do this small favor for a friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just send me the pickup code...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to check the packaging—don't be careless like last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my old lady needs looking after, you coming or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? I've got my wife and kids to spend the weekend with!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing dumb! Forgotten how you groveled when begging for my help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You lunatic! Since when do I owe you a damn thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself! You heartless piece of work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're the only one with parents? Get the hell outta here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your loss! Don't come crawling to me for favors later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beg you? Keep dreaming in your fantasy land!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've been grinding through practice problems these days, though a bit slow on the pace.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The questions are so tricky, can I just take a breather?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Zhao next door—even after his night market stall, he's studying tirelessly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Some questions just stump me completely...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on your results—just grit your teeth and push through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it another shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, are you there? Could you help me with some likes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Likes? This platform has strict checks; I'm a bit concerned about the risks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's fine, you can think about it; I'm not forcing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding; I'll reconsider the platform rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, no rush; it's your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I checked into it; I can't help for now. Maybe next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bastard, are we fixing this relationship or not? I'm pissed waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're pissed? You've broken my damn heart! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit about heartbreak! Stop being so overly sensitive! Let's focus on fixing this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fix my ass! No way in hell without your apology!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What fucking apology? You're so damn difficult about fixing things!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Difficult? You knew this when you started messing around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Fix it or not, I'm done dealing with your highness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Open the door, let me stay for the night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We broke up and you still come to my place? No way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have some conscience! I took your mom in last time, so you owe me a place to stay now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You owe me way more than that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! Decent people have morals, I'm staying whether you like it or not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Just one night, get the hell out after you sleep!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed earlier. Was showing some human decency really that hard?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang, doesn't your company have great benefits? I'm unemployed now, you've gotta put in a referral for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, the internal referral rules are crazy strict lately, no way to swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you're doing so well - can't let your buddy starve now, can you? With our friendship, how could you possibly say no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't help, company's got ironclad rules. It'd be awkward for me to even ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, my partner's breathing down my neck about finding work. If you don't help save face, where does that leave me? Given our relationship, can't you at least try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll look into it - but don't hold your breath.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Excuse me, could I cut in line? I'm in a real hurry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I'm actually pressed for time myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we show some mutual understanding here? Society thrives on positive energy – doing someone a small favor is only right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get the principle, but it's genuinely not convenient for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you have basic decency as a person? Couldn't you try putting yourself in my shoes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please ask someone else, thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey everyone, if you're free this weekend, come lend a hand. Many hands make light work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my elderly parents haven't been well lately. I need to stay home to look after them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Lao Zhang's wife was giving birth? He still made it. More people really do help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't leave - have to care for my hospitalized parent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This event is quite important. You're usually so helpful, it'd be ideal if you could come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll see if I can rearrange things at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team really hopes you'll be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to make time and come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, everyone's looking forward to you at Friday's dinner—don't let us down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't make it, I'm stuck with my shift. You guys have fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The atmosphere won't be the same without you. Everyone wants to chat with you—surely you can figure something out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't be helped, shifts are packed with no swaps. Maybe next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team spirit takes collective effort to maintain. You can make it happen if you try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll ask about swapping shifts—but no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that sounds more like it. Everyone's waiting for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up! Spots are running out—go save me one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm swamped with work here...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd refuse such a small favor? Does our friendship mean nothing after all these years?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! It's practically effortless for you anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah... got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, what are you up to? I'm recommending this health insurance - keeps you safe and it's perfect for family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, insurance? Don't really see the need, risks are pretty low.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've GOT to support this! It's your duty - the whole family's signed up! How can you call yourself safe without coverage when disaster strikes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finances are tight though. Can't this responsibility wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family loyalty means you should buy it. Tons of benefits - everyone'll be crushed if you don't.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll support you. Lower risks do mean better safety.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That burden's on YOUR shoulders now. Safety secured.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, I'm in a real bind and need 20k urgently. You've gotta help me out on this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Times are tough for me lately too...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been friends for 20 years! If you won't help your brother in need, it's just not right—anyone would say so!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really don't have that kind of spare cash...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your mom had surgery last year, I transferred the money instantly. You'd think people would reciprocate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright then, I'll see if I can borrow from some friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you cover my clock-in tomorrow morning? Worried I might not make it on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's against the rules, actually. We could get penalized if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. How about this—I'll definitely be here before 9?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe not? The risks are pretty high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll figure something out myself. Won't push you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate you understanding. Next time it's aboveboard, count on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing! I'll grab you coffee soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, why's the reimbursement taking forever? The whole team's starving waiting on you—couldn't you hustle a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've tried a million times, man—the system's completely frozen. Can't even log in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one here who knows this system inside out. Gonna ditch us and leave everyone hanging? Get it sorted now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Server's crashed—what exactly am I supposed to do? Think you could do better? Give it a shot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last team dinner was on my dime, and now you can't even handle this? How's that fair to any of us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—I'll wrestle with it again. Unreal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it—team'd fall apart without you. Just make it snappy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll text when it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, how's it going? There's something I'd like to ask a favor of you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My relative's kid needs an internship opportunity. Could you help him get one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Internships are really scarce right now. I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to help with this, or you're not being a true friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, it's just genuinely really tough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're conscienceless if you don't help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll do my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, your credit card points are just sitting there unused, why not redeem an air fryer for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm saving them for holiday shopping myself, and I've nearly maxed out this month's card.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nickel-and-diming your own family? Don’t come crying to me next time you need help, you selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be reasonable! My credit card isn’t some public fund.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Elders looking after younger siblings goes without saying! I demand that redemption code tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You’re being utterly unreasonable! Since when do you control my points?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you’re refusing? Ungrateful wretch! You’re the stingiest person in this whole family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Call me whatever you want. My points mean I call the shots.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, where've you been hiding lately? Don't want friends anymore?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No no no, just swamped with work, couldn't find time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends gotta stay in touch, or the bond fades away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but I'm truly tied up these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your health matters, right? Don't overdo it—squeeze out some time to meet up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to make time next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Promise? No stand-ups this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, save me a front-row seat tomorrow, will ya? I need to record a clear video.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not sure I can, got a meeting first thing in the morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, remember last time you forgot your materials? I sent them to you. Just do me this one favor this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, what's that got to do with anything? Fine, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! I'll grab you bubble tea sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. You're impossible, you know that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going on a business trip for two months. Would you mind keeping these potted plants at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, bring them over first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much, I'll treat you to a meal when I'm back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been almost three months. Could you pick up the plants when convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, might need to leave them a bit longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The balcony space is limited, so it'd be best to take them sooner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll swing by next week to get them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you busy right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Throwing a get-together next Sunday. The family wants everyone to pitch in—mind lending a hand if you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got plans with friends that day, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. No worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time for sure—I'll definitely come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. Catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, go change the diaper. It reeks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you have hands? Why boss me around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You worthless! Can't hear the baby wailing? Deaf or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You insane? Quit screaming!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lazy slob! Starve for all I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beat it! I'm done waiting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good-for-nothing! Fine, I'll handle it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you grab me some lunch? I really can't be bothered to move.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not order delivery? I'm actually heading downstairs myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, it's just a quick favor! Shouldn't teammates support each other? Remember when I covered your shift during your time off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really pressed for time today... Maybe next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just this once! We can't lose our sense of camaraderie in the office, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. What combo do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Colleagues ought to help each other out—anything less would damage our rapport.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, I want to quit my job and open an internet cafe. I see classmates making fortunes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You? Running a cafe with that pig-brained idea? Stop chasing pipe dreams!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have a solid business plan. It's guaranteed to make money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Business plan my ass! You almost flunked college—stop acting like some hotshot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then how about finding a business partner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Losers attract losers! Just look at those deadbeat friends you hang with—no future there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just let me give it a try. I'll take the loss if it fails.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop it now! You're born trash—utterly hopeless. Go wherever you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must show up for Friday's dinner—no exceptions!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm on duty and can't make it. Enjoy yourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a killjoy! Can't even support group activities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't swap shifts. Hope you have a great time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Team building is non-negotiable—bailing means you're irresponsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to get someone to cover my shift.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! Always prioritize the team first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you make it to the shoot this weekend? We could really use your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got elderly family members to care for, so I might not be able to come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any chance you could rearrange things? We're seriously short-staffed for the shoot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do my best to free up some time and come over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's truly impossible, even half a day would work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll come help in the morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, really appreciate it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Happy to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so pitiful that your sister has been home alone these days. As her brother, you should go keep her company after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're not close to begin with. It'd be pointless even if I went.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Girls her age feel particularly neglected. If you ignore her, she'll think her family doesn't care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let it be. We've never had much to talk about anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Zhang—he takes his sister out daily. Now that's what a proper brother does.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll go check on her, but don't expect me to stay long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. Family bonds need to be maintained, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a moment, Lao Zhang? Need you to take photos for a commercial event—free of charge.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed lately, might not be able to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand! Could you recommend another photographer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang's available recently. I'll share his WeChat with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it! I'll treat you to dinner next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it—just a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll reach out to Xiao Wang first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, hope the event goes well!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, go grab me a seat in the cafeteria right now. Look at me starving with stomach pain—how can you call yourself a classmate and just ignore this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I? I need to rush to the library for a seat soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Last time you begged for my help, I didn't hesitate. Why act all high and mighty now? Do you even know what basic decency means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Who's always cleaning up your messes? Think you're some kind of royalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't go today, don't expect me to cover for you when the homeroom teacher scolds you later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Who you threatening? Fine, fine—guess I'm cursed with bad luck today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lushan is perfect for summer retreats. All my coworkers say couple trips really keep the spark alive.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This month's mortgage is tight. How about somewhere closer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Lius just went after paying their down payment. Isn't being this stingy a bit much?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about counting pennies. My credit card bill isn't even cleared yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your own sister said we should make more memories together last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe take her to hot springs next payday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The young couple upstairs make less than us but still go out weekly...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me see if I can scrape something together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, can you stop obsessing over this? The kids see your gloomy face every day - it's damaging their mental health!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get over it? That's easy for you to say! I can't even sleep at night!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our son's refusing meals and constantly asking why you're upset. How can you stomach putting him through this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you care about the kids? Where was this concern when you were fooling around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I messed up, but our child shouldn't pay for our mistakes. You've got to move on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop pushing me! I can't handle this right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know Xiao Li's boy upstairs got depression after their divorce. Is that what you want for our child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I get it. But you could at least give me some breathing room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, has the internship slot been finalized? Everyone's getting really anxious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, not yet. With so many qualified applicants, each bringing unique strengths, it requires careful consideration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chen's been pushing herself relentlessly - last time she worked overtime until she visibly lost weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chen is indeed exceptional, but given budget constraints, we must be extremely selective with openings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We understand the company's challenges, but it would be downright unfair to overlook Chen after such dedication! The whole team feels she's been shortchanged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team motivation matters, but we can't ignore practical constraints either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really must decide soon - opportunities like this won't wait, and young talents can't afford such setbacks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sharing accounts between colleagues is an absolute obligation—don't tell me you're clueless about that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't share my account for security reasons; just create your own new one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You refuse to shoulder even this minor risk? Utterly selfish! What happened to colleague accountability?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about you cover part of the cost? That'll keep everyone at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fee is irrelevant! You have to grasp that sharing is a core moral duty, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, you can borrow it now and then, but stay off my main devices.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About time! Be more self-aware from now on—stop needing lessons on basic decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My computer crashed, can you fix it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tied up right now, maybe sometime later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Weren't you bragging about being a computer whiz? Chicken out when it matters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Watch your damn mouth! Who do you think I owe you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All bark and no bite huh? Should've cut ties with trash like you ages ago!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Go hug that computer and jump in the river!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any news about Zhang San lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really, what about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard he started his own business. Wonder how it's going.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shall I text him to check?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, but no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll update you after asking, though he might not reply.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just asking casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab me a box of apples later? The ones from the store at the supermarket entrance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it today, rushing to pick up the kids.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that how people should act? When you needed help last time, I didn't hesitate for a second.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about tomorrow? Really can't make it today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you have any sense of responsibility? Shouldn't colleagues help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...How many pounds then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pick fresh ones. Shouldn't you have basic human decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, don't you think we should manage our money jointly after marriage? It’d be easier to keep an eye on things together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, joint management is fine, but let’s handle our own small personal expenses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, you decide on minor things yourself, and we’ll discuss major spending.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, that seems fair. We’ll adjust gradually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly, having transparency in household finances is wise after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, settled then. Less hassle this way anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweet. Keeping things civil between us is what matters most.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you busy right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad's health is failing. As their son, it's your damn duty to take care of them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I want to, but work's insane. Honestly can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You're just being selfish, dodging your filial duty. So irresponsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you say that? I'm struggling here! I have to work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You WILL take care of them this week, or the whole family will curse you out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll go! God, you're annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, parking is such a hassle. Could the homeowners association help arrange a spot for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All spaces are taken with a long queue already. We have to follow the procedures.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, after living here all these years, it's exhausting hunting for parking daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your situation, but spots are limited until one becomes available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is there any way to expedite this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies, everyone waits their turn fairly—no exceptions can be made.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thank you. I'll await your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I screwed up the report data – you absolutely must not tell the boss! With how close we are, if you dare snitch that's a total betrayal of our brotherhood!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? You fucked up and now want to drag me down with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell kind of person are you? Abandoning team honor just like that? Refusing to help makes you a selfish fucking traitor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the moral blackmail! You're the idiot here – blaming others? Not a chance in hell!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Next time you're in trouble don't come crawling to me. Let the whole company see what a heartless bastard you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Go die in a ditch for all I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Son, your math score isn't ideal this time; let's work harder next time to aim for better results, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, the questions were really a bit tough this time, and many people didn't do well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know it's not easy. Look at your cousin—he faced the same thing last year, but he improved after practicing more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, then I probably need to practice more too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right, you've got to stick with it and not give up too easily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll keep at it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, for that quality report, just write it up as 'no issues' and handle any problems quietly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Manager, the data clearly has major flaws—we can't just gloss over this, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Such a tiny issue! If you don't fix this, are you just gonna stand there and watch the project crash? All talk no action!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about avoiding responsibility, I just think the risks are too high...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Risks? Bullshit! Just make the edits—stop dilly-dallying! If that report isn't written my way, kiss this month's bonus goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir... you're asking the impossible here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take it or leave it! If you can't handle a simple task like this, you might as well pack up and leave! I want that 'passing' report by tomorrow morning!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll do it! I'll make the changes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so selfish! Not cleaning the kitchen again—isn't that your damn obligation as a roommate? Clean it up right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who are you to play the saint? When did YOU last tidy up? Stop calling the shots here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I did clean! Who'd want to live with someone as lazy as you? Get scrubbing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap—I don't buy it. Clean yourself if you care, don't order me around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Since you've got zero morals, don't expect to use ANY shared spaces later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! As if I'd want to anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The in-laws are counting on us to save face—don't be stingy and make everyone laugh at us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm strapped for cash—4,000 is my max. Year-end bonus isn't even in sight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's 4,000 gonna cover? We'll look downright shabby! Won't the youngsters laugh their heads off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what amount would look decent to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our whole relationship's on the line here! At least make it presentable—don't let outsiders talk behind our backs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll tighten my belt and cough up 6,000.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, could you give me a hand with this pile of data? I'm drowning here, and you know how rough things have been for me lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm swamped too and can't really spare the bandwidth right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, without your help I'm totally screwed today. What kind of friend doesn't back you up when you're down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm genuinely tied up here too. Cut me some slack, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least Xiao Zhang stepped up without hesitation last time - that's what real reliability looks like. Not like some people making excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll carve out some time to sort it. But you owe me big for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a million, you're a lifesaver when it counts. Knew I could count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, well, just don't expect miracles or anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie Wang, could you buy me a ticket? You go to the station often, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't, I'm swamped these days. Go get it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, so stingy! Won't lift a finger to help, you selfish jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell's wrong with you? I don't wanna help, so screw off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself! Get lost! Might as well pretend I've got no neighbor like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You damn psycho! Like anyone would want you around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Zhangjiajie glass walkway is such a thrill! They say only true love makes you brave it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know I have acrophobia—can we pick somewhere else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sister Li's nearly fifty and dared to go. What are we youngsters so scared of?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not fear—I got dizzy for hours after the Ferris wheel last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's always talking about wanting to see us challenge ourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about taking Mom to an ancient town? She shouldn't do intense activities either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's posting adventure photos online... compared to them, we look kinda timid...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guess I'll need to mentally prepare myself then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're just ashamed of me, huh? Too embarrassed to even post about us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why do you always jump to that? I just don't see the need to broadcast everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How ridiculous! All my friends think I'm single - are you just stringing me along?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you dial back the aggression? I've got my own perspective on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic perspective! You don't give a damn about making me feel secure! Absolute trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever you say. Can't be bothered with that attitude of yours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, get me that supervisor position ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spots are tight right now, it's tough for me to pull strings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Won't even help your own nephew? Got no shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you talk like that, kid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bet I do! Keeping ungrateful relatives around? Get it done today or this ain't over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, isn't there a spare room at your place? You MUST let me crash for a few days. Fellow villagers must help each other—it's only right!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really inconvenient lately. My wife is pregnant and needs quiet...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pregnant? So what? Who do you think you are?! You won't even help with such a tiny favor? Are you even human?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare swear at me! You need to be reasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reasonable?! Fellow villagers should help for FREE! I'm bringing my luggage TONIGHT. Just see what happens if you dare lock me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is utterly outrageous! What gives you the right?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fact that I'm your damn fellow villager! Help me or I'll expose you to the whole village as an ungrateful, backstabbing ANIMAL!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... THREE days. One more and I'm calling the cops!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, wanna try bungee jumping with us? It's more fun with a crowd!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't, I get dizzy just standing high up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be such a wimp! Wouldn't it be nice if we all supported each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's way too high, my heart really can't take it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've bailed on us so many times now... that's not cool.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. I'll try it just once. Stay close to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go sign in for me at tomorrow's company meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why on earth should I go? Can't you just take leave yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you completely ignorant of filial piety? How dare you disobey your elder after all I've sacrificed raising you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Stop pretending to be some big shot when you're just being lazy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Family must help each other, understand? You're going whether you like it or not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go! No need to yell like a psycho trying to intimidate people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough nonsense! If you're not there by 9 AM, I'll slap you silly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My new shop's opening, could you take some promo shots for me for free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a lot on my plate lately, might not be able to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With our friendship at stake, you won't help? Decent people honor mutual favors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Commercial shoots should be paid work, my equipment costs alone...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends support each other, don't they? If you won't even do this, what kind of friend are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, this request is completely unreasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be here Saturday 10am sharp - our entire friendship rides on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll need to think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you repost this on your feed? My kid's competition needs family support - this is our duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped lately, might not get around to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relatives ought to support each other. Shouldn't you... let the child down, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These votes are kind of pointless honestly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blood ties don't lie - you must shoulder this responsibility. Screenshot saved while I wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Applying pressure like this feels kind of inappropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family loyalty's the most basic moral expectation. Checking your feed in five.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, let me copy your modeling assignment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your damn mind? Can't you do it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut your trap! You pretentious study snob, always putting on airs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beat it! Trash like you deserves to fail that course!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, you stingy jerk! Who wants your lousy assignment anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Quit making a spectacle of yourself here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The package has arrived. Could you help me pick it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm a bit tired now. Can I grab it later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The delivery point is closing soon. I helped you last time, so could you take care of it this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but next time it should be your turn.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for the hard work. I'll get you some bubble tea later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then, while I'm out, could I toss the trash?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, appreciate it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No big deal, I'll be back in ten minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother-in-law, I'm a bit short for restocking the shop. Could you lend me five thousand to tide me over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We just finished renovating the house—I genuinely don't have that much to spare right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how good Sister was to us both? She'd be heartbroken to see us being so distant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about distance—I'm really strapped for cash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that what family is for—helping each other out? Next time you need me, I'll be at your beck and call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll scrape together two thousand for you. Please remember to pay back on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, you must attend the team-building event—this is when we demonstrate team spirit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I already have other commitments this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a team member, isn't it inappropriate to skip such a collective activity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to adjust my schedule, but I can't guarantee attendance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not 'try'—it's mandatory. You should fully grasp the importance of team building.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll figure out how to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly right. Absences from group events undermine the entire team's dynamic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me stay over, for goodness' sake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Quit being so repulsive here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting all high and mighty! Your place is practically a pigsty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still better than trash like you! Go ahead and sleep on the streets.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You thief! Forgot how you stole my money during the breakup?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop dead! I'm calling the cops if you knock again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Serves you right to die alone and miserable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, will you partner up for this shop? Just give me a straight answer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The market's terrible right now, I'm afraid...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the holdup? Scared I'll scam your life savings?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you say that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Face it—you're just stingy! Can't even trust family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think whatever you want, I'm out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there, got a sec? I've got a little design here - mind taking a look if you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been crazy lately, might take me a while to get to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all! Zero pressure, just whenever you've got time. Totally fine if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mmm, maybe when things calm down? Honestly swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it! Focus on your stuff, seriously no stress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! How 'bout we circle back in two weeks?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds perfect! Whatever works for you. Thanks man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kitchen is such a mess I can barely step in. I'm aching all over from cleaning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been spinning like a top this week, no time for anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other households keep everything shipshape, while ours looks like a pigsty. Can't we do better?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can we push it to the weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you worried about getting sick in this filth? Don't just brush it off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I get it. I'll handle it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our cousin just got kicked out by her landlord and wants to stay with us for a bit. We should really step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long though? Adding people to our shared lease might break the contract.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just temporary! If we won't help family in a crisis, what kind of relatives are we even?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then who's handling the extra costs and cleaning? We need clear arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop nitpicking details - keeping the peace matters most. We ought to show some basic human decency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the lease specifically prohibits extra tenants. Rules are rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All our relatives pitch in like this. If we refuse, we'll look completely heartless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check with the landlord before deciding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard your side hustle is thriving? I'm just starting out and totally clueless – it's driving me crazy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, just scrambling around. My main job's swamping me lately, barely any bandwidth for anything else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I see... Was hoping to learn from your experience since you're full of ideas.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Happy to share insights eventually, but honestly swamped right now. Let's circle back when things ease up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll keep tinkering. I wish I could get your pointers on initial direction though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, just need to catch my breath first. Next week might clear up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be perfect! With your expertise, even quick tips would beat my trial-and-error.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah yeah, I'll reach out later. Keep pushing forward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, are you busy? Could you do me a favor? Would you promote my newly arrived collagen oral solution on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... my Moments feed has been too chaotic lately, I'd rather not post ads.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, just help me out! We're such close friends - supporting my small business is the least you should do! I wouldn't even bother asking others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you tried this product yourself? Is it effective?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Obviously it works! Isn't promoting friends' products basic decency? A real friend wouldn't disappoint me like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll copy-paste your promotional material then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Knew I could count on you! You'd better remember to post it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Son/Daughter, we were wondering if you'd be willing to hold some assets on our behalf?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom/Dad, what are the risks involved in asset holding? I should look into the specifics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There are some risks, primarily for tax avoidance purposes, but we can work out an agreement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll consider it and make a decision after that. Please give me a bit of time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, just let us know once you've decided. We respect whatever you choose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll research the risks and get back to you as soon as I can. Don't worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, we've all been working overtime a lot lately and everyone's exhausted. It's common among colleagues to pat shoulders for encouragement, so do bear with it alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, physical contact really makes me uncomfortable. Could we maintain some distance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, we'll try to be more mindful. But maintaining team atmosphere is still important, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly that I'm slow to warm up to people. Are there other ways to integrate into the group?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about chatting more during breaks and joining more team dinners? You'll get familiar gradually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That sounds reasonable, but how should I handle social interactions at dinners? I'm not good at that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just go with the flow and don't overthink it. Everyone's pretty easygoing actually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll give it a try then. Could you also remind everyone to be mindful about personal space?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, why haven't you written the supporting documents yet? This is your fundamental duty as a student—stop slacking off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I genuinely don't know how to write it... it's too difficult.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What fucking difficulty! Can't even handle this trivial task? You worthless piece of shit! It must be done today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've truly done my best—could you possibly extend the deadline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Extend what? This is your obligation! Fail to submit by tomorrow and mark my words—you'll regret it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't be like this, Professor—I'll get it done immediately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Deliver it to me tonight or people like you are nothing but society's garbage!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright... I'll go work on it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, it's time to contribute to the mutual aid fund this year. Have you decided yet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm still hesitating. It feels like a heavy burden.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See how enthusiastic everyone is? You're part of the family too, ought to chip in something, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must I contribute? I'm really tight on cash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mutual aid is a family obligation. The amount doesn't matter—it's a matter of face, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm genuinely struggling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No matter how tough it gets, you should still support this. Don't let the family down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... guess I'll participate then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been working overtime every day this week and I'm really about to collapse.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who isn't exhausted? You're just trying to slack off and make everyone suffer, aren't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got other pressing tasks piling up too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Liu's pushing through with a cold – is that all the responsibility you can manage? The whole team's counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll push myself harder to catch up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the attitude! Quit dragging your feet and keep up with the rest!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure to book a hotel under 200 yuan — we're all cutting expenses now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At that price point, they're all in the suburbs. We'd have to wake up at 5 AM to commute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young folks shouldn't fear hardship — we stayed in hostels during business trips back in the day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But if clients see us staying so far out, wouldn't they question our sincerity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thrift shows real sincerity. Putting these savings toward the project makes more sense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I pick a slightly pricier option and cover part personally?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That wouldn't sit right — what would the team think if they found out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, my colleague needs a cosigner for their loan—could you possibly sign for them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you kidding? I wouldn't dare guarantee someone I don't know!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So family loyalty means nothing to you now? Won't even do this small favor? What will the relatives think of you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop twisting this! If you care so much about loyalty, YOU sign for them—don't drag me into it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How hypocritical! You always preach about family being everything, but it's all just empty talk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hypocrisy my ass! Push me again and I'll block you right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! With that cold-hearted attitude, let's just cut ties!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaowei, your aunt's package arrived at the pickup point. Could you grab it on your way home from work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, it's really not on my route today. I can't detour that far.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly now, young folks like you should be eager to help elders! Making excuses over such a trivial favor – how utterly disappointing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that I'm pressed for time and don't want to delay your affairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What delay? Consider it exercise! Your elderly aunt can barely walk, yet you refuse this simple courtesy? Is this how little family bonds mean to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll get it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There now! That's my responsible nephew. Family ought to support each other – that's how we honor kinship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll call when I have the package.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle's heart condition is so severe; no matter how swamped you are, you must squeeze out time to take him to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's deadline is crunching right now. Can't we go next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the elderly in such poor health, isn't it the younger generation's duty to step up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine... I'll try talking to my manager.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thursday at 9 AM – this absolutely cannot be postponed regardless of your workload.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I've got it marked down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Isn't this exactly what the old folks yearn for?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Ming, you've been pretty free lately, haven't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad. Did you need something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About Grandma and Grandpa's check-up—you being their grandson, shouldn't you show some care?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't spare time this week. Work's piled up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how happy they were last time you visited? They'll be talking nonstop if you miss this one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I just took leave last week...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're counting on you to be the filial grandson. Surely you can make some time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You MUST promote my new bubble tea shop on your Moments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My feed's flooded with ads lately... don't wanna post.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends would support unconditionally! Refusing makes you a selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? Pulling this moral blackmail crap?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there? My computer crashed and I lost all my files. Got this damn English document to translate - it's driving me nuts.
