turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crap, the boss is breathing down my neck! Could you help me fix it? My English is garbage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rolling my eyes. Figure it out yourself. Not your personal tech support.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheapskate! Don't expect me to help you ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Do whatever you want. Hanging up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, help me finish the lab report!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell should I do it again? Got hands and feet—can't you write it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I covered for you in last modeling class! Don't you know how to return a favor? You ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Always pressuring people with moral blackmail—you got any fucking shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get it to me by 12 today! Or I'll make sure the whole class knows what a selfish prick you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I'm a bit short on the dowry, would you consider pitching in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just wanted your thoughts—no pressure, let's talk it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll figure something out, but it might only be a small amount, is that okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll get back to you soon and we'll discuss in detail.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely wiped out from work lately. How about we take turns looking after the kid? I know you're pretty beat too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, I can hang out with him this afternoon. Can you take over tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Works for me. I'll clear my Sunday schedule—if work can't wait, I'll just cut back a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, it's settled then. The kid'll be over the moon seeing both of us around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, my mom's been so lonely at home lately. You really ought to find time to visit her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't - work's been insane this week, completely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you forgotten? When you moved last time, I killed myself watching your kids. Now when it's your turn to help, you're backing out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but circumstances just won't permit it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After how much that dear old lady adores you, can you really stomach leaving her alone and miserable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, you're making me feel tremendously pressured here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must go this weekend - she's counting on seeing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll see if I can rearrange my shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? Can you receive a package for me? Sending it to your place is more convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? To my place? That's not really appropriate—my family's all home, it'd be troublesome.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You call this friendship? Won't even help with such a small favor? Got no conscience at all? So damn selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hell no! How dare you say I'm not decent? I've got no space to store stuff here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Real friends help unconditionally! You're such a piece of shit! Gimme your address now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, Professor. Could we discuss extending the assignment deadline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it about the difficulty or time management? Most classmates seem to be handling it fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Admittedly it's my poor planning, but I truly can't complete it. Might there be any flexibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Complete it by next Monday. That's the final arrangement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crunch time on the project, boss is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie flew all the way from Australia just hoping to see you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me check my schedule and try to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how cousin always had your back growing up? We should be there for her big day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll arrange my work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you gotta help me write this report - it's due the day after tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that, I'm drowning in work myself and haven't finished my own shit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be this heartless? Real friends support each other - don't make me think less of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me the guilt trip! What're you gonna do if I refuse? Handle your own mess instead of dragging me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish prick! You need serious moral reflection - you're finishing this for me, no arguments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll handle some basic sections.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! You're doing the whole damn thing or you'll regret it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, you must come to the team-building this weekend! Everyone's counting on you—don't let us down!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project is at a critical stage this week. I'll likely need to work overtime—really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you skip it as a core member? Even Xiao Wang dragged himself here with a fever! This is utterly irresponsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The task is burning hot—I'm completely tied up with no free time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang insisted we can't do this without you. Your absence is crushing team morale.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, what am I supposed to do now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not find someone to cover for you? Xiao Chen got a friend to help last time—you can too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best to arrange something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been crying at home for ages and feeling awful—how could you, as her daughter, not even go check on her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, you're her daughter too—can't you at least do your part?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop beating around the bush. Mom needs you with her right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. I'll call her later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, the community event needs your photography skills. What a waste not to use that professional gear of yours!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly swamped this weekend - gotta take my family to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping neighbors is basic decency! Remember when everyone covered your property fees last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really appreciate that, but this time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Put yourself in others' shoes! Community harmony needs everyone pitching in, or you'll disappoint the whole neighborhood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my family's medical appointment is crucial...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Half a day's all we need! You wouldn't ignore everyone's goodwill, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to squeeze in two hours then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Bro! My dad's medical bills are goddamn killing me, going down the drain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! That bad? Didn't mention it before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, set up a fundraiser link. If you've got nothing better to do, pass it around on your Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No prob sharing it. But donating... Damn mobile game drained me dry lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Up to you, donate or not. Can't count on you people anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whoa! That's harsh! Who owes you anything?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're insane! Blocked!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm attending a wedding next month. Lend me your designer watch, will you? Friends should support each other - refusing would feel wrong.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? That watch is quite expensive, I'm worried about damaging it. Is it really necessary for the event?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Of course it's necessary! After all our friendship, do you even have that little sense of responsibility? You must lend it to me, no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I get it. Is the event that important?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely! You should be sensible. Lending it shows respect between friends - don't make it seem like you're not being a good friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you can borrow it. But be careful not to damage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, the tech department is completely swamped—everyone's backs are breaking from the workload. Could you hurry over and lend a hand? We can't just let everyone wait in vain, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Manager, my technical skills really aren't up to par. I'd only slow things down if I went. Maybe send someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's on the verge of collapsing from exhaustion now. If you don't pitch in, the whole team's burden gets heavier. Can't you show some consideration for everyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But with my limited skills, I'd not only be inefficient but likely make mistakes too. I'm not really cut out for this, am I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time, Xiao Li didn't know anything either but jumped right in without issues. That's what teamwork and mutual support are about. It's really unreasonable for you to keep dodging like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I suppose I could try handling some simpler tasks?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, got a minute? My computer crashed with a blue screen and won't start up. Plus there's an English document that needs translating today – deadline's tight. Could you help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously panicking over here. The boss is breathing down my neck for it. You're so good at English – could you at least handle the translation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can manage the translation, but troubleshooting your computer takes ages. Got meetings all afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just focus on the translation first. I'll sort the computer situation myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, shoot the file over. I'll squeeze it in ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place just lost power. Mind if I crash at yours tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing, man. My uncle's whole family is staying over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were on business, I took you in without hesitation. Now it's my turn and suddenly it's impossible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room's full of people sleeping on floors - literally zero space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hearing that... guess our friendship meant nothing after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, talk later. Hanging up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going on a three-month business trip. Could you take care of these plants for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, just leave them here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, buddy! I'll treat you to dinner later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been almost four months now. Shouldn't you take these plants back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you help a bit longer? Isn't supporting each other what true friends ought to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been considerate enough by caring for them this long. Shouldn't a decent person have basic responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True friends should understand my situation. Why are you being so petty over such a trivial thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and get your cousin into your school! This can't be delayed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, it's not that I won't help, but rules are strict now. Pulling strings could make me lose my job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Family counts on us. If you won't help, you have no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You want the whole family to starve if something happens? Can't you be reasonable?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! After raising you all these years, you beat around the bush over such a small thing? What good are you?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop using 'raising me' to guilt-trip me all the time! It's impossible, just impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So be it! From now on, I no longer have a son. We cut ties with you for good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you do me a favor? Take my exam next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's really not right... We'd be screwed if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends take daggers for each other. You wouldn't actually fail me, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this violates my principles...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You owe me for that favor. No excuses this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... I'll think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what are you up to? Do me a favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? Just say it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need tomorrow off but my boss demands a guarantor, claims he thinks I'll go mess around. You HAVE to vouch for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: FUCK! Are we brothers or not? Won't even take this tiny risk? Real brothers show loyalty—can't even help me get leave? Such a coward! You even a real friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not cowardice! This demand's ridiculous—why should I take responsibility? This is straight-up emotional blackmail!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blackmail my ass! You never saw me as a friend! Won't shoulder this small thing? Fine! Don't come to me when YOU need help. Pathetic excuse for a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine! Damn it, I'll do it! Happy now? Fucking unbelievable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Zhang! You absolutely have to come to the old colleagues' reunion next month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so far? The gathering's in Beijing, I'm in Shanghai—flying over is a real pain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you skip this, you're just ungrateful! As an ex-colleague, can't you spare this little respect?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been slammed with overtime, no free time at all. I really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Everyone else is showing up, only you're wimping out—how damn selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop the nonsense, I genuinely have commitments! It's not that I'm dodging it, the reunion's just too distant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're disrespecting all of us! Ethically, you ought to be here backing us up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll try to go. What a headache!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you gotta come to next week's shoot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got something on that day, probably can't make it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! How can you bail on our friendship? Some true friend you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that's unfair! I'm on a business trip!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Real friends take bullets for each other. You call this brotherhood?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking kidding me? I told you it's work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work over loyalty? Don't ever say you know me if you bail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck... Fine I'll swap shifts. Goddamn moral slut!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Bao keeps saying other kids have both parents taking turns attending meetings. It's your turn this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why me again? I just went last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The teacher keeps asking if we neglect Xiao Bao. Your constant absence reflects poorly on us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project deadline is this week. The boss is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing classmates with both parents present will make the child heartbroken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but taking leave means pay deduction.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What matters more—work or your child's feelings? Can't you spare two hours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stay late tonight and finish this job! Team interests come above all else—since when are you so immature?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, it's a real family emergency—my wife's in the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Always some excuse with you! Zero work ethic—what a waste training an ungrateful wretch like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But last month's twenty days of overtime never got comp time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit if you dare! Skip tonight and pack your things tomorrow—this company carries no dead weight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll stay. But this is downright unfair—you're pushing people around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still short over thirty grand in sales, really annoyed. Could you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're checking everything super strictly, I can't even sort out my own stuff. No time to look after you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were in a tight spot, I took it on for you without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the risk is way too high this time, I don't dare get involved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hearing you say that makes me feel even worse. What about our bond?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll see what I can do to pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, that's a bit of relief then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must swap exam times with me next Wednesday!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must I? I've got plans that day too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have a job interview! Where's your basic decency? Refusing to help—what kind of friend does that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to review other subjects that day. Really can't reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish much? Can't even do this tiny favor? You're not even a classmate! Swap now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even listening? I told you I'm busy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Refusing means you've got a character flaw—that's on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you cover my shift this Saturday? Something came up and I'm swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh man, bad timing. I've got plans with friends and won't be free that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... could you possibly reschedule your plans? This is really urgent for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Their plans are set in stone, can't get out of it. Sorry man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll figure something out. Don't want to put you on the spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. Next time you need help, I've got your back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna try bungee jumping this weekend? Dare to give it a shot for a change?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, I'm terrified of heights. Just thinking about it makes my knees weak.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no pressure. But it does build courage, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, you guys go ahead. Have fun!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're really passing? Huh... kinda disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time. Let's pick something not as high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come to the shoot this weekend—it just won't work without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly relative is hospitalized recently; I really can't leave at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on you; can't you figure something out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly can't; I can't get any time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's worked so hard; it'd be such a shame if you didn't show up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I know it's tough for you, but I really can't drop this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just think it over again; the whole team's waiting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I'll try to find someone to cover for half a day and do my best to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, the points are expiring soon and my keyboard's broken—quick, redeem a new one for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was planning to get a massager actually, my back's been killing me lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: God, you're so selfish! Always putting yourself first! Look how swamped I am—how am I supposed to work without a functioning keyboard?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got urgent needs too, y'know. Can't just cave to you every single time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how many times I took Mom's scolding for you? And now you won't even lift a finger to help? Quit being such a cheapskate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why dredge up old history? I need time to think this through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's coming to check my work any minute! If she sees the broken keyboard, she'll blame YOU for neglecting me—how's that gonna look for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine, fine. I'll redeem it for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, could you let me put my furniture in the hallway corner for a few days? My place is a total mess – would you do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the hallway's communal space. Leaving things there could cause problems – people might trip over them or complain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been neighbors for years! Seeing you hesitate like this makes me feel awkward. Can't you make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, but rules are rules. Breaking them would get us both in trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just three days! I'll move it out on time. Have a heart for your old neighbor, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two days max. If it's not cleared by then and security comes, don't blame me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh. Can't even count on you for a small favor. Giving me the cold shoulder like this... feels pretty heartless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've been quite busy lately? Grandma keeps saying she misses you at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped with wrapping up the project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She tells everyone you're the most dutiful grandchild, especially now when she needs you most.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't make time recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even your cousin took leave to visit last week despite his crazy workload.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come this Saturday - Grandma's waiting for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll crunch overtime to make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, got time to whip up a simple webpage for me? Just a basic one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped with project deadlines lately, pulling all-nighters every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I pulled an all-nighter fixing your PPT? Didn't sleep a wink.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I can squeeze some time next week to try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Know you're busy – lunch is on me later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No biggie, I'll check the specs this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! Looking forward to hearing from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely gotta come to tomorrow's team building. We can't hold the fort without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing, I've got prior commitments and can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on you. Don't you think it's inappropriate to keep making excuses like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't manage it, gotta care for the elderly at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always being the exception—don't you think people will take notice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll try my best to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Team matters gotta be taken seriously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn brainless to book a $400 hotel? Don't you know company policy caps it at $200?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, the $400 one's right by the client's office. The $200 option requires three subway transfers - this is merely for work efficiency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even save this petty cash? Have you no professional ethics? Which employee wallows in comfort like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last business trip at a $200 hotel, my laptop got stolen overnight. Is that what you call wallowing in comfort?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! As senior staff you should lead by example. Refusing $200 lodgings means dragging the team down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, you're right. But this pathetic standard's five years old - inflation nowadays...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! One more word and you'll sleep on the street! Zero dedication yet shameless enough to demand performance bonuses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, after all we're so close, you should tell me your salary, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's not really appropriate to say, salaries are private matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so stingy! With our friendship, you won't even share your salary? Don't you trust me at all?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about trust, I just think it's unnecessary...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You must tell me today, or it means you look down on me! We're done otherwise!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... but don't go blabbing about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, I've been waiting over an hour already. Are you people even capable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Terribly sorry, we're short-staffed today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: An elderly person with poor legs like me waiting this long - does your conscience feel clear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie please don't be upset, I'll hurry as much as possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young folks should show more consideration for elders. Don't just focus on your own business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I'm handling it right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If something happens to my frail health, you'll have to answer for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Almost done, just bear with us a little longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how have you been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too great, feeling really down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you're hurting, but you owe it to our past to at least give us another chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need time to think this through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Time won't wait. I expect you to make a responsible decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I hear you, but I've got concerns.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please think carefully—that's the fair thing for both of us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll consider it. Goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, my paper's due at the last minute! Lend me a hand? I'll treat you to hotpot after fixing it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Procrastinating again? Forget how I stayed up past midnight fixing it last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This was a real emergency! You're the only reliable person I know, please help me out～

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Send it over quick. But I'm only fixing grammar, not content.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks senior! BBQ's on me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, you've got to learn to handle things yourself. Can't keep relying on others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Absolutely next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, let's discuss the prenup properly? Might save us some arguments down the road.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It just feels like the terms are stacked in your favor. Are we really doing this right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, Xiao Zhang's couple signed one too, worked well for them. Maybe we could give it a shot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't shake this uneasy feeling—what guarantees do we actually get after signing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about we rework the post-marriage income division? Fairness is key here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's workable, but the numbers need to be clearly specified.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, settled then. We'll get the lawyer to revise it tomorrow before signing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you cover my shift tomorrow? A colleague took leave and we're critically short-staffed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got prior commitments tomorrow and really can't back out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project's deadline is crushing us - the team's running on fumes. Shouldn't you show some consideration?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies, but I genuinely can't make it this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take Xiao Zhang for example - jumped right in last cover shift without hesitation, earned everyone's respect. Now you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must rearrange your plans. The entire team's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright then. I'll try to reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't just skip the gathering, can you? Everyone's relying on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too far—a few days off aren't enough for all that hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all old classmates; missing it would really hurt our bond.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My boss is piling on overtime; there's no way I can leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You owe us at least this much affection, right? It's our ten-year reunion!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Then I'll see if I can swap some time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit—otherwise, the whole group would be let down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, I'll do what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've got to solve this problem ASAP; the whole team is counting on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client isn't picking up calls—probably still fuming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how proactive Xiao Wang was in this situation last time? Even the boss praised him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll give it a shot this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your attitude—this affects your year-end evaluation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is groveling with an apology really appropriate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think about all the overtime everyone's put in. We can't let that hard work go to waste, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang said you're going to the station today? This crappy phone of mine can't book tickets, you gotta help me out—I'm desperate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I gotta dash right after this meeting—really worried I'd hold you up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're throwing shade now? Last time I stayed up till 3 AM helping you with that project—didn't even get a thank you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not trying to dodge you—just genuinely afraid we'll miss the window.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't even lift a finger for this tiny favor? That's pretty lame—especially when everyone else helps you out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine. Send me the train info.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Did you see the department video? Go and show your presence ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that got to do with me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you blind? The whole team's done it except you playing dead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business whether I click or not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Just don't come crying to me about the bonus pool later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh! You're such a pain in the ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Was that so damn hard earlier? Quit acting difficult!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you guys still taking interns?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, but they've gotta be from top-tier schools.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My nephew's school isn't exactly top-tier, but that kid's willing to work hard. You don't see many young folks this grounded these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, these requirements are sort of set in stone. Hard to bend the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's really upset about this. Couldn't you make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'd be tricky to handle. I'll need to think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just arrange it - have him come learn the ropes by month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can do and try to sort it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Wang Ming, what gives you the right to push my books off the seat I claimed? Ever heard of dibs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, you've been gone two hours - hoarding seats like that's ridiculous. Wasting space when others need it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Can't I grab a meal? If everyone snatched seats like you, where's basic decency? Don't you know postgrads are swamped? Got no conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
