turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who's got time at a crucial moment like this? Everyone's swamped with their own piles of work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the real MVP here! Lao Zhang just praised how savvy you are. My job's on the line if this flops.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it kinda shady to ask friends to be free labor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut me some slack! Lao Liu's bringing three buddies already. Just get two acquaintances to chill and snack—I'll owe you big time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll see what I can scrape together then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a legend! Barbecue's on me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you busy? Things are tough at home lately, maybe consider dropping the grad school/civil service exams to pitch in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I've been preparing for ages. What about my future if I quit now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, just throwing it out there. Supporting family is a duty, but it's your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'm trying to figure things out too. Passing those exams might put me in a better position to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, suit yourself about helping out. Filial piety depends on how you define it, I suppose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Yeah, I'll give it some more thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My computer screen went black! Come help me fix it right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, Auntie, can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you were sick as a kid, didn't I stay up night and day caring for you? And now you won't even do this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just wait, Auntie, I'll come after my meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at neighbor Xiao Zhang—he jumps whenever his mom calls. Didn't I rush over when your cousin had a fever last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll head over soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jay Chou tickets are impossible to get, you gotta snag one for me too! No way I'm scoring one alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My plate's overflowing with projects right now, really doubt I can handle this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You wouldn't just leave me hanging with our friendship, would you? Watching alone would suck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, you win. I'll squeeze out some time to figure it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call a real bro! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll try to work on it when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You there? You must cover for me at tomorrow's meeting since I won't make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't promise that, sort it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell kind of friend are you? Can't even do this favor? Don't be such a selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish how? You're the unreasonable bastard always guilt-tripping people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful piece of shit! Who covered for you last time you were late? Quit pretending now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck this! Handle it yourself if you're so great—not lifting a finger for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Never come crawling to me for help again. We're done, asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This damn elevator's been broken for a week! You property management jerks haven't lifted a finger - fix it NOW or answer for any accidents!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Li, parts are out of stock but already ordered. They'll arrive next week. Please remain calm, we're handling it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit waiting! You're downright negligent! As property managers, you're MORALLY OBLIGATED to ensure our safety - fix it TODAY, no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't repair without parts. Show some mutual understanding - property fees still need timely payment though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understanding? You're just heartless profiteers! Fix this damn mess or we're withholding fees - show some accountability instead of pocketing cash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Threats won't work - procedures must be followed. Owners must share repair costs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Share my foot! This is professional misconduct - you MORALLY OWE us compensation! Pay up or I'm reporting you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Report away. We're not miracle workers. We follow protocols - don't act recklessly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh! Work's got me swamped, can't even spare a minute for my parents. Man, I just wanna quit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! You're just selfish! Don't use work as an excuse to ditch your parents. Absolutely no sense of responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! I'm buried under insane pressure here, and you come stirring trouble? You're acting like a fishwife!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Serves you right, drowning in work yet tossing aside basic family bonds. You're just an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Quit the holier-than-thou act. If you wanna deal with it, go ahead! Just leave me the hell alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Can't be bothered wasting words. Go ruin your life. Who'd bother persuading the likes of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Master Wang, we park in this spot every single day. How come you're hogging it again? Move your car right this minute!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh gee, I'm really sorry. My dad's leg is killing him - he can barely walk. Could you please cut us some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parking outside always causes trouble for us! Last time someone keyed a huge scratch on our car. How is that fair?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been neighbors for years - can't you show some flexibility? If the old man takes a bad fall, who'll take responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we're paying good money to rent this spot. How's it right for you to just squat here? Doesn't seem proper, does it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how miserable the poor old man is - just do us this solid, alright? Swear I'll move it first thing tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, isn't it time to settle that debt? As a senior employee, you should set an example and fulfill your obligations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I just paid the kids' tuition. Could you give me a two-week extension?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all struggling, but that doesn't excuse shirking responsibility. How do you think the team views you when you default?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I'm barely scraping by right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be resolved by Friday. It's a matter of principle—don't betray the company's trust.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll find a way to get the money together and repay it by Friday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I trust you have that awareness. Only those who keep their word can go far in life.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you fucking better show up to help me move this Saturday! If you're really my bro, no god damn excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! You're making me your free labor whore again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You heartless bastard! Since when did you ditch basic loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Got plans Saturday! Why the hell should I always drop everything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! A real friend would step up! Bailing makes you a god damn disgrace!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a fucking pro at guilt-tripping!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just answer this: you man enough to keep your word or not? Skip this and we're fucking done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! Done is done! Think I'm scared of your threats?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss Wang, I can't handle this client email—write one for me on the double!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I ain't got time to babysit a man-child!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You wrote one for Xiao Zhang last time—what's the big idea pretending to be busy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell do you think you are? You're not fit to lick Xiao Zhang's boots—at least he's not a total fuckup!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Let the email rot then—see who gets blamed when the client complains!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I give a damn? This company ain't short of deadweight like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just give me a straight answer: write it or not? Quit yapping!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go die! One more word and you can kiss your bonus goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Taking the bus every day is exhausting. Let me drive you instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't trouble yourself...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends help each other out. Refusing would be downright unreasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just don't want to waste your time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True friendship means helping in hard times! You pushing me away genuinely hurts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright then... thank you...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finally! Decent people show gratitude – I'll be here at 7 sharp!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm... okay...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, we really need you to review this client email.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let the newbie try handling it, they need the practice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li's report last time was quite well done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Newcomers ought to learn to take charge independently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This client is crucial – I'd suggest you personally oversee it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: One must learn to tackle challenges solo at work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps the newcomer requires your guidance though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll step in to assist just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Has your kid taken the piano exam yet? Mine did quite well this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet, the child can't sit still—runs off after a few tries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, kids are all like that. Take it slow. If there's really no interest, don't force it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that schoolwork piles up, no time to spare.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If schoolwork's the priority, might as well focus on that first. Piano can wait until there's time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll figure out the schedule later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just let nature take its course. Don't be too hard on yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the disappearing act? Abandoning your friends now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not avoiding anyone; the project deadline's just swamped me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends should be on call whenever needed, got it? Your attitude's cutting me deep!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll reach out after month-end wraps up—genuinely tied up right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Excuses! You're coming to the gathering tomorrow night. Bailing means disrespecting me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright...I'll try to arrange a shift swap.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of that 'try' nonsense! Flake on this, and we call off the friendship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kid, your math grades weren't great this time. We need to talk about your studies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I know. The test was pretty tough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to work harder for your future—this is non-negotiable as a student. You can't let the family down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm drowning in pressure right now. It's suffocating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pressure or not, you must push through. Getting into a top high school is our responsibility and your fundamental duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I get it. I'll step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's asking if you're coming to the old classmates gathering next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm a bit socially anxious—these gatherings make me uncomfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Wang made it right after his business trip! How about joining us? It'll be all the more fun with more people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's just been overwhelming lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We chose a restaurant right by your place—super convenient to drop by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been absolutely exhausted recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We all miss you—it's been ages since we last saw you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to make time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I canceled that group order.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was a bit sudden though, everyone had already picked their items.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can the platform process individual refunds?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, refunds are doable, but it's quite time-consuming to find replacements now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Group orders are inherently refundable anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do remember to give a heads-up next time, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind grabbing lunch for me? Don't forget.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped with work, can't step away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on! I pulled an all-nighter till 2am for you last time, and now you're making a fuss over lunch? What kind of friend is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, what do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good call! Hold the onions – you know my taste.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seal the container tight. Last time was a total mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaowei, there's a package for Auntie at the parcel station. Could you bring it back on your way home from work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't make that detour today—I'm heading straight home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see, no problem. I'll pick it up myself later then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How busy have you been lately, Auntie? Should I grab it for you this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it's just a small package. You focus on your own things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just let me know if you need anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, take care on your way home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Bye, Auntie.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We all want to gather at your place this weekend. It's spacious and great for bonding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kitchen's under renovation with tools and materials everywhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couldn't you tidy up a bit? Everyone's so excited about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The tilers are working here daily, it's really not feasible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should team activities keep getting postponed like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My apologies this time - I'll host everyone next time to make up for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I guess we'll settle for some cramped spot then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you lend me 8,000? I'll pay back next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scamming again? Ain't you paid off last time's debt?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheapskate! Having money but refusing to lend really sucks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Serves you right! Who told you to gamble away all your cash every day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it! You're such a tightwad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save it! Your bottomless pit can never be filled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Officer Zhao, please do me a solid—can you issue that certificate today? I swear I was framed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The surveillance footage shows everything crystal clear. Forging documents hurts everyone—don't put me in this spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mom's terminal cancer treatment depends on chemo—if you won't help, she'll lose medication!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it's a special case, but rules are rules—we can't bend them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole neighborhood knows you're the most big-hearted—surely turning your back now wouldn't sit right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apply for a hardship certificate at the community office—breaking laws is absolutely off-limits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, your dad's been feeling down lately, just staring out the window all day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... I've been swamped with this project deadline, pulling all-nighters every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He knows you're busy. He just mentioned that braised fish you loved as a kid the other day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you maybe bring him some fruit for me? I'm completely tied up here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're free this weekend, why not pop over for a casual meal? He's been wanting to talk with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me check my schedule and see. I'll do my best and text you beforehand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, hoping for good news. Don't overwork yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parents are constantly worried sick about your marriage; dragging your feet like this, how unfilial you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My job is exhausting me to death; how could I even think about marriage?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Once the Zhou family's daughter got married, her parents were beaming with pride—you ought to understand how your folks feel.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but these things need to happen gradually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must go to this blind date, so they stop fretting needlessly every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll just go and take a quick look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help share my kid's voting link in your friend circle? Every other parent has chipped in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a bit too much on my plate right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid kept mentioning you when looking at the participant list—it was really heart-warming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These activities are fine to join casually, no need to take them too seriously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think of it as a token of encouragement for the child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is making me feel really awkward...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe when you have time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got something urgent for the afternoon meeting, could you help me sign in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? I'm pretty swamped this afternoon too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's a sudden family emergency, or I wouldn't have troubled you about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll sign in for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton, I owe you a meal later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, it's no big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just drop me a line after you sign in, don't miss it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Liu, mind sharing your membership? Got a quick purchase with a discount.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, my family members are using the account right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll sign up for a trial myself then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Actually you could wait for the promo day - everything's half-price on the 8th monthly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks anyway, it's just that this order's kinda urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe next time I could place the order for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't want to trouble you, I'll look into other options.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Wang, could you work overtime tonight? The project's a bit urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm sorry, but I'm running a fever and not feeling well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see. Could you try to push through? If not, that's fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My temperature is pretty high, I'm worried it might affect my performance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, health comes first. Don't force it if you can't.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll rest for a bit and see how it goes later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, when are you finally going to sign those reimbursement forms? They're gathering dust on your desk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit nagging! Can't you see I'm swamped? Wait your turn!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm about to run out of the money I fronted! Could you please pick up the pace? How long does this trivial thing need to drag on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? Is this life-or-death for you? Stop breathing down my neck! I'll sign them when it's time—quit rushing me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then at least give me a definite answer! Making me come for nothing every day—are you messing with me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Some of your invoices are illegible. Go verify them yourself! Don't bother me until it's sorted!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! You and your endless nitpicking! Hope you won't find new excuses to stall when I fix this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Who cares about your petty paperwork anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey everyone, remember to vote for Xiaoming's drawing! Link's in the group chat, could you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm absolutely swamped lately, meetings every single day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaoming's been counting down the days, waiting eagerly! Didn't we all pitch in for Lili's kid's competition last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The thing is, it requires voting consecutively for days, and I'm worried I might slip up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid checks the vote count every day, you know. Our group can't possibly lag behind the other parents' classes, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll try to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Much appreciated! If everyone votes, the kid's bound to win the prize.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, the project is at a critical stage, everyone's burning the midnight oil. Could you postpone your leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my trip was booked six months ago. Canceling now would cost me a hefty penalty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Chen—he even skipped his kid's parent-teacher meeting. Work should be our priority.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've pre-paid nearly twenty grand... that really stings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The team's shorthanded right now. Your absence would pile extra work on everyone. Push through this crunch, and I'll approve extra annual leave days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try rescheduling then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Li, you home? Is your kitchen free right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, yeah I'm here. Not using it for now, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need to borrow your spot to stew some soup, my stove's acting up. You know what they say - 'Good neighbors outshine gold' - so we're supposed to help each other out, aren't we? How about cutting me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Er... I might need to cook dinner later...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a quick one, won't hold you up at all. Another proverb goes - 'Helping hands help yourself' - as neighbors, can't we at least show this basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine fine, come use it. But make it snappy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks Brother Li! Knew you'd honor the neighborly bond!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely overwhelmed by moving all by myself, it's driving me crazy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project schedule is packed solid lately, I genuinely can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else volunteered to help, yet you keep making excuses—that's not very loyal of you, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time after helping you move, I was bedridden for days—I really can't risk that again this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the friendship we share, how can you possibly justify not lifting a finger when I'm in need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly stuck this time—let me make it up to you with dinner next time, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, I've seen how cold people can be—nobody's reliable when it really counts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, I'll cover the cost for a professional moving company—at least that way I'm contributing something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must go grab a hospital queue number for me tomorrow - your aunt's condition can't wait!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got mandatory overtime tomorrow, can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd actually brush off an elder's needs? Ungrateful snake! After all these years of caring for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How am I ungrateful? My overtime is legitimate work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Legitimate my ass! You disgraceful brat! Remember how your aunt doted on you? Some gratitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go! Guess I owe your whole damn family now, happy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaowei, you must go pick up Auntie's parcel from the depot today—it's been sitting there forever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't detour today. Got plans with someone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all I did staying up caring for your sick mom last time—won't even lift a finger for this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Who'll help family if we don't?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze in a trip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're talking. Blood's thicker than water after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My computer crashed, get over here and fix it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I'm in the middle of a meeting, really can't leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who lent you the down payment without hesitation when you were short? And now you're dragging your feet over such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll head over right after the meeting, just half an hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang's daughter drops everything to help. Have you forgotten how your cousin pulled an all-nighter revising your proposal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll ask for leave and come now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, working overtime till midnight every day is killing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all struggling here. Lao Wang didn't even take leave when his wife was in confinement—that's what I call putting the team first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two months of this! My body can't take much more. What am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss always says you're the reliable one. If we slack off now at this critical moment, our team's annual performance bonus will be completely ruined.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But isn't this just taking advantage? Why always pick on me alone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's watching you. If you throw in the towel, what message does that send to the new hires? They'll follow your example.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. I'll tough it out for a few more days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, can you help me grab two concert tickets? You're quick with your hands—you're my only hope for this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling overtime daily lately, might not make the ticket rush timing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember who stayed up all night revising your resume when you changed jobs last year? Now you're making excuses over such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must be front-row seats—don't half-ass it with some random spot! What I've done for you goes way beyond this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. We'll see how it goes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come to the ancestral worship this weekend! How disgraceful is it that you're the only family member missing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My work schedule won't allow it. Can't you just handle the ceremony without me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you prioritize work over ancestors? This is sheer filial impiety! You heartless ingrate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the moral blackmail! Must you turn every ritual into such an exhausting ordeal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then get struck from the family registry! We'll disown you permanently!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me! You honestly think I value this wretched kinship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Go get me some braised chicken from Cafeteria 2 right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of my paper and can't go. Why don't you just order delivery?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How selfish can you be? Who brought you medicine when you were sick last time? Now you won't even do this small favor after all I did?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was a one-off thing... and I really can't leave now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! Is this what passes for basic decency among classmates? No wonder you'll end up friendless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. Just my luck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure you ask for extra spicy! I won't accept it if you get it wrong!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Pay me back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you've got to say it exactly as I say in that inspection report—just claim everything's normal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, but... there are actual issues. Isn't faking reports a bit... wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with it? Don't you care about the team? If the project tanks, the whole group gets left out in the cold! Is undermining your own team how you show loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand thinking about the bigger picture, but my conscience just can't handle this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your conscience? What's that worth? If you don't want the job, just say so! With no backbone like this, how do you expect to survive in this team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's... not what I meant...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The report gets submitted like this tomorrow! Don't you dare stir up trouble. Refusing to pitch in for the collective is pure selfishness!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the application process for hardship assistance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a citizen you're obligated to proactively learn policies; these documents should be prepared voluntarily without prompting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does the income certificate require an employer's stamp?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Meeting obligations demands full documentation submission - that's every applicant's non-negotiable duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the final submission deadline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Truly needy applicants handle this promptly; delays prove your lack of commitment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can approval happen immediately if documents are complete?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Responsible applicants cooperate with vetting procedures - you should recognize this essential process.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, the store suddenly needs to receive a shipment. Could you spare half an hour to keep an eye on things? We're really swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Half an hour's fine, I'm passing by on my walk anyway. I'll sit for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, the shipment's bigger than expected, might take two hours. Could you possibly keep an eye on things a while longer if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two hours? But I have plans to play chess with Lao Li...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this is a mess, the truck got held up. If you need to go, just head out, I'll find someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind, I'll have Lao Li wait. I'll help you finish up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much! I'll treat you to a meal later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, but hurry it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard your company offers employee discounts on electronics? My sister's been wanting to buy a tablet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... company policies are pretty strict about this. Tricky to arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I took you to amusement parks when you were little? Time really flies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There is some risk involved though – could cost me my job if things go sideways.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should help each other out, right? It's such a positive thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll look into it, but don't get your hopes up too much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll buy you dinner sometime to return the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you spot me for the meal expenses from last business trip? I've got the receipt ready, will send it to you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This month I've already covered several expenses, things are really tight for me right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all struggling these days. Remember that time I helped you out? This is urgent, I'm really counting on you here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last reimbursement took forever to come through, I'm worried it'll happen again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise it'll be quick this time! We go way back, you wouldn't leave me hanging, would you? You're always the helpful one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll cover it. Just don't bail on me like last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll process it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, how's it going with the internship spot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still comparing candidates. It's competitive this time; several stand out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Xiao Wang is truly outstanding—top grades and solid experience, miles ahead of others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know he's good, but resources are tight. We have to be careful with this placement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, not giving Xiao Wang this opportunity would be unfair. As a leader, it's your duty to treat every candidate fairly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your point, but the company's overall interests matter too. Selection can't hinge solely on excellence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just think it over. Missing this chance would be a loss for the company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, we need someone to arrange the child's school enrollment. Could you help look into it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I've been tied up lately, not sure if I can spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child's future is at stake—this cannot be delayed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... it is quite crucial.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline is approaching fast—you'll need to push harder.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must it be done this week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just consider it as thinking of the child's best interest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come with me to the dinner with Lao Li tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? That chain-smoking, booze-guzzling crowd is damn annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop being such a priss! Who do you think you are with that holier-than-thou act?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I'm so 'prissy,' why even ask? Begging me now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're pathetic! Just rotting away at home every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still better than you hanging with those drunks! Go by yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't expect me to ever take you out again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank god! Now get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, would you mind letting me borrow your notes? I want to review before the exam.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, but I'll need them back myself. Can you return them tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much! I'll finish going through them tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, take them. Just be careful not to get them dirty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll return them in the exact same condition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. We can compare key points after the exam.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Darling, it's time to enable joint payment. All truly in love do this voluntarily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is account binding really necessary? Keeping separate finances keeps things clear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Love demands mutual surrender. You should prove your sincerity through action.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this isn't about trust! Can't we discuss this reasonably?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real partners must be unreserved. Enabling it proves you're responsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're being too absolute... Relationships shouldn't be measured this way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is fundamental to relationships. Refusing is just shirking your commitment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, take care of my dog next week, I've got a business trip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way, I've been working overtime every day this week, dead tired.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your conscience? You want my dog to starve to death?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Can't you figure it out yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who took you to the hospital last time you had a fever? Ungrateful bitch, you're helping me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn emotional blackmail, huh? None of my damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help or we're done! If anything happens to my dog, I'll curse your whole family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! Get your mom to take care of it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, whenever it's convenient for you, could you take a look at that team expense reimbursement? No pressure at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm swamped right now and the reimbursement system keeps glitching out. Might need a couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just handle it whenever you're free. Team stuff can wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You need it soon? Want me to try again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not urgent at all! Focus on your work - this isn't critical for the team.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll try to squeeze it in when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks bro, I've got full confidence in you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll shoot you a message once it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is Lao Wang home? Need to discuss something urgent with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's so urgent? Just say it straight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm using your yard for my kid's birthday bash next Saturday! Neighbors should help each other out - you wouldn't deny me this small favor, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... my yard was just renovated, afraid it might get messed up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! How can you be so selfish? Decades as neighbors and you won't spare your damn yard? You're a worthless piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the insults? I've got legitimate concerns too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the victim act! You're helping whether you want to or not - or the whole block'll know what a heartless bastard you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you write me a recommendation letter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your recent performance has been adequate, but it's still not outstanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'd be such a shame to miss out on this opportunity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd feel more confident writing it if you kept me updated on your progress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't spare much time lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Students who truly want opportunities wouldn't let time be an issue, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, have you got the documents ready for tomorrow's inspection?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Terribly sorry, my kid suddenly developed a fever—I need to rush home immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, then you'd better go. We'll figure something out about the documents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My household is in chaos right now—I'm truly swamped and can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, don't stress too much. Someone in the team will step in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to squeeze in time to handle it if possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's great—just work within your capacity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, are you free now? My computer just blue-screened out of nowhere and I lost all my unsaved files. There's this English report that absolutely must get translated today - you've gotta help me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You didn't back up again? I'm swamped myself right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, as good friends you should help with this much, right? My job's on the line here - you can't just abandon me when I'm drowning!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got my own workload too - I can't keep sacrificing my time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I took you to the hospital last time you were sick? Now it's my turn - it'd be pretty messed up if you didn't help. Isn't that what friends do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine, I'll see what I can do. But reinstalling the system will take ages if it comes to that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a sec? The platform's giving cash red packets for real-name verification. Mind helping me out with it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does this seem sketchy? Having to enter my ID number makes me kinda paranoid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's there to worry about? I just did it last week, got the red packet instantly. Free money is free money, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mostly scared my info'll get used for online loans. See that kind of news all the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what, after you finish, I'll keep an eye out on your bills. If anything's fishy, I'll tell you right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds alright, I guess. What info exactly do I need to fill in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just name and ID number. Get it done and I'll cut you 30 bucks from the red packet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Send me the link. Remember to delete the records after we're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The bride's red envelope must be 8888 - it's the tradition, we can't ruin the good luck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't afford it. The monthly mortgage and car loans are suffocating me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You only get married once - wouldn't you worry about gossip if you give less? The newlyweds would be humiliated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't we make it 2000? It's more realistic and the number's still auspicious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang received 8888 last time - wouldn't that make you look cheap?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, let's scrape together 5000. I truly can't offer more than that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I absolutely can't trust anyone but you to design my startup's logo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My plate's completely full with piled-up projects right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After twenty years of friendship, I'd be truly disheartened if you wouldn't do me this favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always do this... Fine, I'll try to squeeze it in somehow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Real friends should be supporting each other. I'll send you the specs tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, could you stop weaponizing our friendship like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, between us, isn't this exactly the kind of thing friends are supposed to help with?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As your parents, it's our absolute duty to support your startup—don't you understand that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can handle this myself! Stop meddling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful wretch! After all we've sacrificed raising you, you won't even listen to us now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Emotional blackmail again? You just want to control me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You disgraceful brat! Take this money or get out of this house—no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of parents are you? This is completely unreasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough talk! Consider this money payback for raising you. You WILL launch that business tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do whatever you want then—my life’s yours to command anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The old man needs someone to accompany him for the check-up; you handle it since I'm not free anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always on your damn phone and not free? Last time I was the one who went!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! With your high salary, can't you take a day off? You stingy jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you say that? Damn it, I've always covered most of the medical expenses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Big deal that you chipped in a bit? If you're so tough, hire a caregiver yourself, you broke wannabe rich!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you useless piece of crap, go or not as you like, I'll go alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Standing here is damn useless, you annoying eyesore!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must know about Xiao Ming's recent situation, right? Don't try to hide it from me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He really hasn't been in touch with me lately. Why don't you ask him yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a mutual friend, you are obligated to tell me the truth. That's a fundamental moral responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your concern, but I genuinely don't know the details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all he's done for you back then, you can't even do this for him? That's truly disappointing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about whether I'd do it for him. I really don't know anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Reach out when you've figured out what it means to be a friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you Photoshop my picture and clean up the background?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you have hands? I'm swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, why you acting all high and mighty when I'm just asking a favor?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're hot stuff? Can't even edit photos yourself, loser?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit frontin'! Your trash skills ain't worth shit anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beat it! Like I'd waste time helping your ass.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Stay the hell away from me from now on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help me with the real-name verification quick, the platform has cashback.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah man, real-name verification is way too sketchy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you needed a new phone, I sent you cash instantly. Now you're dragging your feet over this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I gotta enter my bank card details – what if something goes wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With our friendship, you still don't trust me? I'll cut you 40% after it's done – fair enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's my bro! I'll treat you to a proper meal after it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up then – I'm unsubmitting my info the second we're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! What are you doing? No reply for ages, you dead or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! Boss just reamed me out over the messed-up project. Stop adding fuel to the fire when I'm drowning here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh please! Think you're the only one drowning? I've been waiting all damn night! What's with the crap attitude?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell else you good for besides bitching? Can't see I'm buried alive? Wanna break up? Spit it out instead of this psycho act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Break up? As if you could handle it! Workaholic freak like you deserves to rot alone! I'm done—go marry your overtime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Best fucking news all day! Being harassed by a dumbass like you daily—I'm way past my limit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Who needs you! Remember every damn word today—don't come crawling back begging, you pathetic loser!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax! I'd need brain damage to beg trash like you! Now vanish before I puke!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, I heard there's an internship opening at your company. If it's convenient, could you possibly keep an eye out for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, sure. I'll look into it, but you should prepare yourself properly too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks Aunt, I just think this opportunity seems really promising. I'll take you out for dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries. Focus on polishing your application first - our company procedures are quite formal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll go study the requirements now. Do let me know if there's any news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I've made a note. But remember you need to put in your own effort too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much Aunt. I'll have my mom follow up with you about it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old classmate, you there? I'm sick, you've gotta grab me some meds ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I'm in the middle of a game, not really convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even help an old classmate who's sick? That's no way to treat a friend—you have to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, can't it wait? That's not cool.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't wait, you have to go right now. That's on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but give me ten minutes. You're way too pushy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up, no stalling! I'm suffering here—this is about our friendship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go to the pharmacy now. I give up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign this for me tomorrow, I'm taking leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign it yourself, damn it! I'm not your father.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You signed it last time! Quit playing dumb!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time was last time. Not doing it this time. Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, you're such a pain in the ass! Will it kill you to sign?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right! Seeing your face makes me wanna die! Get lost now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Don't expect any favors from me ever again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, like I've ever asked you for anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, grab me some food, and make it quick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you? Go buy it yourself, asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic loser! Can't even handle a simple meal—no wonder you're a failure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Big talk coming from you! What, like a fucking manchild waiting to be spoon-fed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blind or what? Can't see I'm swamped? Zero goddamn awareness!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not my fucking problem! Rot here for all I care—ain't lifting a finger!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless coworker! Don't you dare crawl to me for help ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking finally! Get lost already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lend me your power bank, hurry up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop ordering me around! Buy your own!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna get smacked? Keep yapping and see what happens!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Son of a bitch! Think you're special or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goddammit! If you won't give it, I'll fucking take it myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Touch it and I'll fucking kill you! Try me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! What a piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Keep yapping and I'll slap the shit out of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Wang, mind lending me your camera for the annual party performance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This camera is quite pricey – I'm worried it might get damaged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, stingy much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously not about being stingy, it's just really valuable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, your loss then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've applied for a big data analyst position and need a recommendation letter. Would you be able to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you tell me? It would've been better if we'd communicated earlier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry Professor, I was tied up with lab projects and didn't get to it sooner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can write the letter, but you might want to explore other positions too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll keep looking for more suitable opportunities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, send me the materials later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could I borrow your notes? The exam's coming up soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh sure, just give me two minutes, I'll be ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! No rush, just pass them to me after you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, here are the notes. Return them after the exam's over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! Might ask you about some parts if I get stuck later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, ask anytime. Good luck with your exam!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You better show up for the Saturday event! Don't wanna come? Guess you look down on me, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got legit stuff going on, can't make it. Stop with the moral blackmail, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a joke! After that huge favor I did you last time? Can't even show some loyalty for this small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck is wrong with you? I said I can't fucking go! Drop it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Skip it then! Don't come crawling to me next time you need 'friends' who 'aren't loyal enough'!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you threatening? Cut ties if you want, see if I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Ungrateful bastard! Guess I was blind trusting you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you there? Been wrestling with this damn English email for ages, mind giving it a quick look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't today, boss is breathing down my neck to revise this proposal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you moved, didn't I take time off to help you out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh yeah, I remember... but I'm genuinely swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about after you're done? Just a quick glance would do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to squeeze in some time tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! My treat for BBQ next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, gotta get back to work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My birthday party must be in your yard, no question about it! All the relatives are expecting a lively celebration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the grass is newly planted. What if it gets ruined?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you say that between us? Last time your pipes burst, I rushed over without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but the grass...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's coming the day after tomorrow. Think how disappointed they'll be if you refuse.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then. Just remember to clean up afterward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! This is how relatives ought to treat each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, Mom, we're skipping the wedding ceremony and just doing a destination wedding. Simpler and less hassle for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But what's wrong with our choice? Why cling to outdated traditions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've applied for a data analyst position and urgently need a recommendation letter. Could you possibly spare some time to write one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You never even call normally, and now suddenly remember your professor? How utterly pragmatic of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about that, Professor. I got completely swamped with project deadlines and it slipped my mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can write the recommendation, but you must switch to a stable employer. Those internet startups could collapse overnight—how could I recommend you with peace of mind?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: But that state-owned enterprise pays significantly less...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young man, stop obsessing over money! After all my painstaking efforts mentoring you, would I ever steer you wrong? Change your application immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, shouldn't you post about our kid on Moments? People will think we don't care otherwise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd rather not overshare. Privacy matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But parents have a duty to share their child's milestones. Refusing to post just shows irresponsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely not! All parents should post - every family does this. You ought to share at least one photo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, settled then. I'll take half-day leave and rush over.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, the Meituan coupons are such a steal! You've got a membership, right? Quick, team up with me for this order!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, group orders feel like such a hassle. I'd rather just use it solo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'm just nervous about running out of uses.
