turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, we probably should consider affordability, and need to balance our parents' expectations too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True, a wedding place that big isn't necessary. Maybe we should explore other options?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do care about security and social image, but we've got to be realistic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then how about we discuss smaller homes? The pressure wouldn't be as intense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, that could work. Let me think it over some more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, you've got to help with this—use your connections to get my daughter into your school. As her aunt, it's your responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... this isn't really appropriate. Backdoor arrangements violate rules and could jeopardize my position.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, a child's education is everything! You're her own aunt—you can't just stand by and do nothing, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but the risks are substantial. I need to weigh this carefully.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please Sis, just this once—for her future, you must help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try, but don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks Sis, I knew you'd do what's best for her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dude, my roof's leaking and the house is unlivable. You gotta put me up for a few days, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aw, seriously can't. Every inch of my living room floor is covered with sleeping relatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After ten years of friendship, this is how you treat me? You'd actually let me sleep on the street?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, there's literally no space! Even the beds are taken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The sofa then! Just five days! If you say no, you clearly don't consider me a brother!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... four days max. And don't you dare overstay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's decent! Knew you wouldn't let me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Move in tomorrow then. Bring your own bedding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your little brother's waiting eagerly for you, why haven't you gone to see him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, can't spare a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If his own sister won't visit, won't all his longing for you be in vain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just made plans to catch a movie with someone...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why prioritize strangers over your own flesh and blood?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll push back my plans then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it - family should always come first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! I'm staying at your place tonight, that's final.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck! You didn't even ask if I'm available? My place is a total pigsty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brothers don't need formalities! You're fucking unreliable! Shouldn't friends help when they're in trouble?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! How can you be so unreasonable? I've gotta get up early tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Too selfish to help with such a small favor - you're just plain selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goddammit, are you fucking pressuring me? You still owe me money from last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dragging up old grudges now? Real buddy you are! Would it kill you to host me one night? Open the damn door already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tomorrow's company team building requires bringing family members. You're coming with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know I despise these social obligations. Can I skip it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Trying to humiliate me before colleagues by refusing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop twisting this! I simply have no desire to attend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you grasp basic spousal duties? Have you no conscience at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your reasonableness? Is emotional blackmail entertaining to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Be there at 3 sharp tomorrow or we're divorcing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Do whatever the hell you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you're going to Guangzhou on business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is packed tight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you lack even this sense of responsibility? Think about the commitment required for team building.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, three bags then, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you absolutely must stay home this weekend—don't make any other plans!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... if you're busy, don't rush back just for us...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! If we don't come back, the whole village will laugh about our family being estranged. You must be here by Saturday noon—no dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, we'll do as you say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then see to it that you prepare a lavish spread—don't be stingy, or people will say our family is cheap.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Zhao, is that shoddy work of yours finally done? The whole team is waiting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the rush? Can't you see I'm swamped? You're always causing trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, busy? Your efficiency is truly touching. Every extra hour you hog the proposal means all-nighters for the rest of us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop bossing me around! Think you can do better? Put up or shut up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, I'd do a far better job! Just tell us if you'll deliver today or not? Don't waste everyone's time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Mind your own! Wait if you want, or get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given our friendship, you should at least comment on the salary issue, shouldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Um... better not. Not really comfortable discussing this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else told me already—only you're holding back. Is this how friends treat each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not holding back, just don't see the point in talking about it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you share a little? Otherwise it feels like we're drifting apart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's probably just average.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, can you grab me a Jay Chou concert ticket? I'm stuck working late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You're just lazy and dumping this on me? Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still asking? Just yes or no—cut the crap already?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not happening, you loser!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! What kind of friend would bail like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost. Stop bothering me—we're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? Wanted to discuss something with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind helping promote the collagen oral solution I'm distributing on your Moments? Only if it's convenient though—no pressure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, no worries! Totally understand! Just whenever works for you—we can circle back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome, thanks for being cool about it! Hope business booms for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweet! Really appreciate it—catch up soon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, with that supervisor position open, if you won't help me get it, who will? The whole family is counting on you to pull some strings!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your qualifications are way off the mark. It's really hard to arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All the relatives are watching! Other families help each other out—are we really going to be the cold-hearted ones who won't lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But... I have to play by the rules too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be settled by Wednesday, or Mom will say you're turning your back on family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best to figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely MUST come bungee jumping with me this weekend—no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's terrifying... I don't think I can do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends are OBLIGATED to share life's thrills and ordeals—this is fundamental human decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But what if there's an accident? I'm genuinely terrified.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly consider me a friend, you WILL conquer your fear—friendship demands this proof right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I suppose I'll attempt it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you get a moment, could you help me set up a website? It's super basic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't right now, been swamped non-stop for two weeks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you asked me to fix your resume, I pulled an all-nighter without a word.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe this weekend? I'm wiped out these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't wait till the weekend. If you really consider me a friend, you'd do it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. You're impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's my mate! Knew I could count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A dutiful child should support their parents' remarriage. That settles it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I think it's too sudden. Can we hold off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial children understand—this is the best choice for the whole family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you considered my situation at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must learn to be understanding. As a child, you've no business objecting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I at least reserve my opinion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be sensible. The whole family is waiting for your approval.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've completed the draft of my paper. Could you spare some time to review it and provide feedback?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This simply isn't up to par – it's disorganized and misses the core innovation point. Your academic capabilities are quite problematic.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the structural issue that significant? Where should I focus my revisions?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The entire framework needs restructuring, and the conclusions are unconvincing. You need to put in considerably more effort. You might want to consider getting help or taking courses to improve your writing.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you suggest addressing the framework first before refining the content?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thank you, Professor. I'll reorganize my approach.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed earlier! All that dilly-dallying was pathetic nonsense.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, where are those notes from last time? Lend them to me!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! The exam's tomorrow! Have some loyalty, will you? God, you're such a selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I never said I wouldn't lend them... it's just...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just what?! Real friends help each other out! Quit stalling and send me the digital version right now! I demand it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't push yourself; do what suits you best.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey HR, could you approve my leave for tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project is in full swing right now, what's the reason for taking leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly parent is ill and I need to go care for them. Could you possibly consider approving this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave requests require advance notice - this puts me in a tight spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to arrange my work schedule. Would that work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let me evaluate the project timeline first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind deciding at your earliest convenience? Thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Approved. Do remember to notify earlier next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, feel free to come to the team event that day if you're available. Everyone misses having you there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've already made plans with friends over the weekend, so I might not make it. Really sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, got it. No problem at all, we'll have other chances.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to see when I can make it. I'll come if possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush. Just enjoy your time with your friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks Boss, I'll try to arrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, looking forward to hearing from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, colleagues have mentioned you're being overly sensitive about minor physical contact. You should understand work pressure demands some flexibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, physical harassment isn't trivial though? This doesn't seem reasonable to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop blowing this out of proportion! These are company norms—you must comply with the team or you're just being selfish, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is fundamentally wrong—your argument is utterly ridiculous, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting all fragile over nothing? Workplace norms require tolerance—stop being a troublemaker embarrassing everyone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! But at least provide a proper solution—how can I continue working like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Endure it for the collective good—as a rookie, drop the holier-than-thou act and learn the rules!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever—I'll take the hit. But don't blame me when this blows up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my project is really tight right now. Mind if I crash at your place for a few days? Clean up your room though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, it's a bit messy here right now. Might not be very convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends are supposed to help each other out. This is a moral obligation, so could you make the arrangements?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's actually a bit cramped. My family's all here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to help me out no matter what. How else can we call ourselves friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, you can stay in the living room then. Just let me know the timing in advance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay. Remember to tidy it up and have some daily necessities ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, it's settled then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, you done yet? The wait's killing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's work, but look how well Xiao Chen prioritizes his partner. Shouldn't we nurture our relationship too? Come by this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's brutal—deadline's strangling me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's this relationship headed? Don't you think we deserve some time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your constant comparisons just pile on more pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not to pressure you, but taking cues from good examples keeps relationships alive. Let's meet and reconnect.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Today's brutal - I've got three reports piling up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Youngsters ought to gain more experience, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd love to help, but my plate's completely full.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just saying, Xiao Li's last assist got recognized in his performance review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li's efficient indeed, but I need to prioritize my core duties first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself - the opportunity's right here though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to cover my shift tomorrow! How can you refuse to help a colleague? That's just heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What for? I've got my own plans. Can't you find someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How selfish can you be! We're supposed to help each other out! Refusing will ruin team morale!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You didn't even thank me for covering your shift last week! Stop pretending to be righteous!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful much? I'll make sure no one votes for you in the performance review! See who helps you then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Saintly you win! I'm done with this crap - last time ever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, mind if I borrow your car tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unfortunately I can't—gotta drive my kid to school.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, things haven't been smooth lately. Even getting a cab's a bummer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about day after tomorrow? I'm free then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! Thanks man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it possible to return it same day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bet! Right on time. Seriously, you're a lifesaver.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Failed math again? Is that how you repay your parents' blood-and-sweat money?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The exam was brutal... I really tried...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Students must grind themselves to the bone, or they're worthless trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I genuinely can't grasp the material...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Being a disgrace to your parents makes you heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll get tutoring.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Ming, why are you still dawdling? You're gonna be late for your extracurricular class!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know, stop nagging me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You good-for-nothing! All you do is play around—have you even finished your homework?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your business! Quit bothering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that attitude, you'll never amount to anything! Go get ready, damn it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, so annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get a move on, don't waste any more time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help sort out this data? It's only right for newcomers to learn and gain experience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my own tasks are packed until the end of the workday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are young people nowadays so selfish? Don't you understand teamwork?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't about selfishness—we should maintain reasonable division of labor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back in our day, we proactively supported seniors! This generation's just too opportunistic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Times have changed—responsibilities should be clearly defined.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but as someone who's been around: remember, you'll never advance without dedication.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, about that supplier complaint mess, why don't you go apologize to the boss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I take the blame? You're the one who caused this mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit whining! Just go and do it, why all the fuss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you are? Ordering me around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not going? We'll see who gets punished first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! You're digging your own grave, don't drag me down with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle has heart issues. As the eldest son, you ought to accompany him for his check-up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with the project deadline this week. Can we do it next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could filial duty wait? Think how much your father sacrificed for you! One must reciprocate kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to ask my boss for leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what a dutiful child should do. Remember, Thursday at 9 AM sharp.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll rearrange my work schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good boy. Now the whole family can rest easy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's talk about you working out of town?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This opportunity is great, but it's quite a long time away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm a bit concerned about the kids' school drop-off and pick-up.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about hiring a nanny? I'll cover the cost.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: That might work, but I still hope you'll reconsider carefully.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll think it over and give you an answer by the weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I do understand your career development.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, we can discuss this further.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you free? My computer won't start up. Could you take a look when you have a moment?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand. I'll reach out when it's convenient for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe you could try resetting the BIOS first? I'll send you the tutorial.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Much appreciated! If I can't get it working, I might ask for your help again if that's okay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll help you sort it out once I'm through this busy patch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you cover a shift tomorrow? A colleague called in sick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I've got plans tomorrow, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? The team needs you and you're just making excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not being selfish, I genuinely have prior arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should prioritize the team! This is your responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've already committed to someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so heartless? Would standing in line actually kill you? You're clearly free and ought to help—what kind of neighbor refuses such basic responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unbelievable! Why the aggression? I'm just busy—no need to scream at me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap—you're buying it today or never step foot in my house again! Let's see if you dare show your face then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll go buy the damn ticket! Enough already—you always push people around!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, where's that report? If we don't submit soon, our team will hold everyone back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I'm stuck on research and still have a long way to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The next group submitted two days ago—they pulled all-nighters. Our slowness makes us all lose face.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm stressed too, but this is genuinely difficult...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get Xiao Wang to pitch in? Can't let our team become the laughing stock.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll work overtime and rush it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I treat you to bubble tea? I'm begging you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll try to arrange it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's tired, shall we just go ahead and start?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's been talking all day about wanting to see you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll aim to be earlier next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: So about what time can you get here next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best to be there by five.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: We really ought to be more mindful of time when it comes to the child.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, this supplement is supposed to be good for joints, how about giving it a try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the point spending money on this? At my age, anything simple is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My colleagues all say their elderly parents started moving around easier after taking it. Why not start with just one packet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really no need. I'm still in perfectly good shape.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, let's just leave it here for now. Try it whenever you feel like it—it can't hurt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, might as well leave it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's crying at home, says he misses you dreadfully and can't stand it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't make it right now, I've got a client meeting scheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can we reschedule for tomorrow? This really can't be postponed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you vote for me in the Best Employee contest? It's just a quick favor, really.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Honestly, it's just a tap of the finger - super quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a champ - I owe you lunch next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, catch you later!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, all my besties use the shared payment feature—it feels really nice to spend on each other. Don't you want to check it out too?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: True, being upfront works for others, but our way's fine too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a subordinate, sharing leadership burdens is basic workplace etiquette. Shouldn't you have that awareness?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should I go after finishing this section?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work priorities matter - team harmony trumps personal tasks. You ought to grasp this principle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... what would you like to eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Newcomers should learn proactive responsibility, not bargaining.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'm heading out now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, old buddy, what've you been up to? Mind doing me a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? Tell me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My niece wants to join your company. Could you be a bit more flexible and give her a recommendation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not so straightforward to arrange. It really depends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're old friends - helping out should be expected, right? When you were in trouble last time, I didn't hesitate to step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real pal! Counting on your good news!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get your ass over here to help on shooting day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! I've got real business to handle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too good for me now? What could you possibly have going on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Say one more word and I'll block you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you ungrateful bastard! Won't beg you—I'll find someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buzz off already! Think everyone's as jobless as you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Waste of space! Don't ever ask me for drinks again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Terrified me! Like I give a damn? Screw that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Taking care of the child is your duty as the elder sister. Go be with him immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got some matters to handle. Could I do it later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family bonds aren't transactional. Fulfilling your responsibility is non-negotiable—you must go right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I just promised a friend I'd go out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family comes first—that's your obligation as an elder sister. Cancel everything else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll change my plans then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. You can't just dodge family obligations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you know the supermarket has milk on sale today? My stomach's been killing me, and I could really use something warm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not sure if I can make it today—got my hands full with several deadlines.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh...I'm sweating bullets from the pain. Remember when I brought you that midnight snack during your overtime last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just...worried about the time crunch. If I don't finish this, I might get docked pay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe forget it, I'll tough it out...though this stomach cramp is brutal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well...I suppose I could make a quick run.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! Make sure it's whole milk, and watch your step after dark.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Back in no time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, your sister definitely has pull at the Education Bureau! You've got to help with Xiao Bao's school situation. Look how smoothly Lao Wang's family handled it last year next door - we can't afford to fall behind!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really impossible. The scrutiny's extremely tight now - even my sister's walking on eggshells. One slip-up would be catastrophic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't possibly be unaware how crucial a child's future is? Sending such a bright kid to some dump of a school - how could you live with yourself as his uncle? Everyone in this neighborhood pulls strings desperately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two people just got fired from her department last month. It's not that I won't help, it's that I truly can't risk it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your daughter was hospitalized last year? I drove you to three hospitals overnight! Now for my Xiao Bao, who else can I possibly turn to besides you? Can't you even honor that basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll grit my teeth and ask. But don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! I need a definite answer by Wednesday - the whole family's waiting with bated breath!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, come lend a hand with my move tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't. Got plans to play cards.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your damn mind? A stupid card game over something important?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! I do whatever I want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Next time your mutt steps into my yard, I swear I'll break its legs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! Lay one finger on my dog and see what happens!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic loser! Like you'd be any damn help anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost, deadbeat! Too broke to hire movers or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know, my little brother keeps talking about you lately. Maybe you could drop by to see him when you're free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll make time to visit him tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's been a bit clingy recently, and he keeps saying you're his favorite.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll bring him some snacks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, he'll definitely be thrilled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of food does he like?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, just bring whatever you have on hand. He just enjoys seeing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project result is disastrous—you MUST accept it, quit stalling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell should I? That's completely unfair!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Because you're on the team—own your damn responsibility. Cut the crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've slaved my ass off for this company, and this is unjust. Are you stupid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop your entitled bullshit! It's your OBLIGATION. Take it or get out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll swallow it. But you're crossing the fucking line here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit whining and get it done. Don't you dare let the company down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, would it be possible to adjust my travel dates?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We can adjust them, but there's a 300 yuan change fee. Would that be acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could the fee be reduced a bit? I genuinely have an unexpected conflict.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this: I'll request to lower it to 200 for you. Would you like to confirm now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll consider it and get back to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all—I'll wait for your decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you still hogging the kitchen? We're all starving to death, could you hurry up and clear out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big rush? I'll be done in a sec, can't you just wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wait till when exactly? How selfish can you be – we're all waiting here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'm moving now. So damn annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done that ages ago. Did you really need me to spell it out? What's wrong with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's free now, just take it already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time show some damn consideration. Quit making people nag you – got that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! It's already ten? The kid's so tired they're banging their head on the wall! Are you some fucking turtle?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck you yelling for? Had a moron cabbie taking detours – my fault somehow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! I ditched a dinner for this wait! Your whole damn family's like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who gives a rat's ass about your dinner? You volunteered to be a sucker!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bitch! Go jump in the river with your brat someday!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dickhead! Your kid pissed on my sofa last time – still waiting on compensation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Your face makes me wanna puke!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Failed the exam and still lazing around? Get up and study now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just can't move anymore...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Zhao grinding away even after failing three times!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't have his drive...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your parents sacrificed so much for your education—is this how you repay them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's been staying up late supporting you—how can you have the nerve to quit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll give it another shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, I'm coming to your city next week, so I gotta crash at your place for a few days, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? My folks are staying with me right now, might not be convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, with our friendship? Plus, remember when you were unemployed, I put you up and fed you for three whole months? You owe me this one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really just that there's no spare room at all...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other out is what friends do! Even your couch works. You can't possibly refuse.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just really crowded here, didn't want you to be bothered by the noise...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just not right to refuse someone who helped you out like that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Wang, the kid really wants to get into that school, but spots are so scarce—I'm wondering if I should look into it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly, the policies are tight now, and pulling strings could cause problems.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid doesn't mind where he ends up; I was just saying it offhand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps encourage the kid to work harder; there are other opportunities out there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're right; I'll just relax and not worry about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If needed, I can help you inquire about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, you're so thoughtful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my landlord suddenly kicked me out. Could you let me crash at your place for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I just had relatives arrive and every bed's taken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Others get help in these situations, but I always get screwed over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't help, the place is tiny.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just put up with me for three days? With our friendship, can't you do this for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Five days max.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you! You always come through when it matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just grab your stuff and come over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, my mom suddenly needs surgery on exam day—I'm desperate. You must help me figure this out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The exam schedule was set long ago; changing it would disrupt the entire teaching plan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've always been the most understanding teacher. You helped Li last time when he had an issue—please help me out this time too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rescheduling means rearranging exam halls and proctors. It's not that easy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't help me, I'll definitely fail this course. You wouldn't just watch me fail, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll discuss it with other teachers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! I knew you cared about us the most!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next month there's an emergency back home - it's really worrying having no one to watch the shop. Such a headache.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, I'm drowning in overtime lately, doubt I'll have time to help you out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit making excuses! With our friendship this close, how could I trust anyone else? You're my only hope!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm terrified of messing things up for you - my days are pure chaos, completely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of friend does this? You helped Lao Li last time, but suddenly can't when it's my turn? That's just not how friends act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best, but I'm buried in work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come for the weekend shoot - it's the most fundamental duty you owe the company!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I genuinely have a family emergency. Could we possibly reschedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reschedule? How utterly selfish can you be? Do you think the team can function without someone like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not selfishness - my child is hospitalized...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Everyone has difficulties! If you're this irresponsible, just quit now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I'll try to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare pull any tricks! I expect to see you on set tomorrow - that's a direct order!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Understood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello teacher, I wanted to ask how the consideration for the internship spots is going? My child really values this opportunity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're still reviewing; there are many applicants and the competition is quite intense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He ranked in the top five for his major courses and has extensive internship experience. Do you think he stands a chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: His strengths are quite apparent, but the allocation of positions needs to factor in overall team composition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then, could you please give it some extra consideration? This child has dedicated a lot to preparing for the internship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, the final list will be released next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you, we'll await the notification.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Intern, help review the proposal ASAP—we're on a tight deadline!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I made plans with a friend I haven't seen in six months...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people should prioritize their career! This is a golden opportunity to shine!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this isn't even my responsibility...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, the more capable shoulders more work! I'll make it up to you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I suppose I could take a look...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Dinner's on me soon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should lend me your yard for the birthday party. Family ought to help each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the newly laid turf...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where are your manners? After all I've done for you, now you play dumb?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Vacate the yard by tomorrow or the whole clan will shame you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... go ahead and use it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Smart move. Could've saved us both trouble if you agreed sooner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, since you're a teacher at the school, arranging a spot for your niece should be the only right thing to do, shouldn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're cracking down hard these days. Making backdoor deals can get you disciplined. I don't dare mess around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, she's such a bright child! It'd be such a shame to hold her back. As her aunt, you can't just stand by and do nothing, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do want to help, but this is way too risky. I'm really scared something will go wrong.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, Sis, don't hesitate! You're the only one in the family with any pull. She's been dreaming every single day about going to the same school as you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Alright, alright. I'll ask the principal. But don't blame me if this blows up in our faces.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, you're the best! I knew you've always doted on her the most!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old man, where the hell did you disappear to last weekend? Didn't even answer your damn phone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of way is that to talk! Your mom and I were home, phone was on silent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, playing hermit holed up at home? I was just thinking since I've got nothing going on this weekend, might as well swing by and check on you two.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What nonsense! We like staying home! Come if you want—we're not going out. Don't expect us to roll out the red carpet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Look at you! Like I'm dying to visit you two old farts! Fine, saves me the trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Suit yourself! Don't expect a warm welcome if you come! Just a damn pain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Was afraid you'd jinx me anyway! Later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I borrow your data structures textbook? I need it for my assignment ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need it myself these couple of days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you kidding me? How many times did I carry you through group projects? Now you won't lend me a damn book?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weren't we just helping each other back then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Real friends lend stuff, or you're not being a true friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch... Fine, take it. You're so calculating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to show up for the shoot! The entire crew is waiting on you alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't make it—my elderly relative is ill and needs care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're dodging work over minor family issues? Xiao Wang pushed through last time even while burning up with fever, why can't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elderly needs surgery and truly can't be left unattended—doctor's orders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't just flake out like this! What was the point of the whole team's hard preparations? Are you even worthy of everyone's efforts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you spare a moment to glance over my promotion proposal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped lately—worried I might hold you up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
