turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...My schedule's packed tight, honestly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With a bond like ours, I just know your character wouldn't let me down. Helping out is like accumulating good karma, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright... Send it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, this project's driving me nuts, I'm dead tired. Mind if I crash at your place for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room's a total mess, wouldn't be comfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you were broke last time, I lent you cash without hesitation. Now you won't even do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's crowded and cramped here, you'd feel suffocated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are we friends or not? You've gotta help me out here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, squeeze into the living room then. Just confirm the timing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. Clean it thoroughly and get the bedding ready properly, no slacking.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, settled then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Repost my top WeChat Moments post right now! How could you call yourself family when you won't even support my daughter's competition?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you sick of begging for votes every single day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even have any sense of family? All those years caring for you wasted on an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Addicted to moral coercion? Save it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You MUST repost! Don't you dare call me Auntie again if you refuse, and forget about my help with your family matters!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? Who do you think you're threatening?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You conscienceless thing! Repost it this instant—the dog ate your conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you damn well have to babysit this Saturday! It's a sacred duty for uncles to look after nephews!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got work to finish. Can't you ask someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! What kind of person refuses to help family? Don't expect me to lift a finger for your kids ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? I'm swamped with a project deadline!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! What kind of irresponsible bastard uncle are you? Ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll fucking cancel my work! Goddamn ridiculous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember—this is your damn duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, could you help me move the sofa this Saturday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry boss, my child has a parent-teacher meeting this weekend...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just take leave already; can't you handle such a small task?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't skip the meeting; maybe next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No! Do you still want to pass the quarterly review?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll rearrange my schedule then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you'd agreed earlier, it would've saved us all this trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, could you buy some health supplements on Renmin Road for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That place is too far, my back hurts and I can't walk that distance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of mother would refuse to do this for her child? Stop making excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know how bad my health is...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know all about filial duty - now it's your turn to show it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I understand you young folks are busy with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you know what's good, hurry up and go - that's what being a mother is all about!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feel like a drink? The vibe is nice tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, but I'm not really in the mood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, sure, no worries. Whatever you prefer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, you go ahead and drink. I'll keep you company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll pour myself one. Water's fine for you too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheers to that, hope you enjoy it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, old friend. Just go with the flow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, this conversation's really pleasant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing you work so late, Mom and Dad must help you out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really unnecessary, I can manage on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't let us help, we won't sleep a wink tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This just makes me feel worse...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you understand? Parents just want to lighten their child's load!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get what you mean, it's just...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're coming to help next week – this isn't up for discussion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad are really concerned seeing you stay single for so long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with work lately, haven't even had time to think about marriage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Lis downstairs were thrilled when their daughter got engaged—such a happy occasion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I think I'll just wait a bit longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe you could check it out next time there's a matchmaking opportunity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go when I get a chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, could you help me raise my child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? I can't even manage my own problems.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that tone about? Just admit you don't want to help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't wanna help, what's it to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're utterly heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the irresponsible one, having kids on a whim.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! You don't deserve to lecture me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't be bothered with this nonsense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My dad just fell and got hurt! We need to get him to the ER immediately - can you drive us to the hospital?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? But I've got clients coming to sign contracts at the office, I can't just leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who else can we possibly count on at a time like this? He's writhing in pain - how can you be so cold-hearted?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this deal falls through, my year-end bonus vanishes. My boss specifically warned me last week not to mess up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you find someone to cover for you? My dad never hesitated when he helped you back in the day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last-minute cancellations mean penalty fees... I genuinely can't handle that financial hit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll just call a cab myself. But if something terrible happens, how would you live with yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... let me try postponing the client meeting. Wait there for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, I've been miserably single for so long, yet you never help set me up! You just don't care about me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, there aren't many young people around these days. I can't find anyone suitable either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you my real aunt? Finding a match for your nephew is practically your duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The good ones are all taken; the leftovers are way below par.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how eager you were to help Cousin! With me, you're just half-hearted. Such favoritism!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll try contacting my colleague's kid to arrange a meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd better take this seriously. Find someone reliable – don't just brush me off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, as close friends, you're morally obligated to leverage your connections for my child's school admission—that's what friendship demands.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This feels inappropriate. Abusing connections could cause trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing violates basic moral principles. Friends must help each other—this is fundamental.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, you're making me feel indebted. This is undue pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True friends act without hesitation. This assistance is non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's commendable! True honor among friends—utterly righteous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, are you free to chat now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, kind of. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next Sunday I'm hosting an event—can you come help me out? Are you available?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might not be free; I've got other stuff going on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, come if you can; I won't push it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, thanks. I'll try to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let's keep in touch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you busy? Got something to discuss with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? Just lay it out straight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My car paperwork's stuck - need to register it under your name. You've always looked out for me since we were kids, so help your bro out, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hiss... that's pretty risky though, you realize?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't ask if I weren't desperate. When your brother bought his place, didn't I pitch in no questions asked?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The way you say that... lemme mull it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Know it's tricky, but family not helping family - that just ain't right, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll get back to you in a couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After getting married, should you hand over your salary for me to manage? It'd be more convenient to handle household expenses together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really keen on that, I'm perfectly capable of managing my own money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then let's discuss it. You don't have to hand it over, but you'll need to manage your own expenses properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll cover utilities and such. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. I'll pay the rent then. This way we're sharing things fairly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal! Who handles the money doesn't matter, as long as we don't end up arguing over it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Agreed. Let's not interfere too much in each other's affairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, I heard your company is hiring? My daughter's been having a tough time finding a job lately, so worried she can't even eat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, we are hiring, but the procedures are quite strict now; pulling strings might be a long shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard the process is formal, but if an acquaintance could vouch for her, wouldn't you at least offer an interview? After all, your Lao Li's kid got connections when job hunting back then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, this situation... I'll see if there's any way I can help and ask around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be great if you can ask! Her mom's so anxious about it that she's getting blisters on her lips.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go check out the specifics first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll leave it to your care; looking forward to your good news!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How do you feel about the D situation? I personally support him taking a stand, but you're free to choose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really? I think I'll stay neutral for now and see how things develop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, supporting or opposing is fine—it's a personal moral call, no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly, whether taking a stand is worthwhile, I don't see a need to state a position this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then why not think it over? I feel supporting him aligns better with ethics, but you decide in the end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll consider it. But on this stance-taking matter, I believe free choice is key.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, between friends, no need to force anything—feel free not to support it, it's all good.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you got a minute to talk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sort of, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You gotta come fill seats for my event next Sunday! Won't even help family with this tiny favor? That's just heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't make it, already got plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Busy my ass! Selfish prick - can't even handle basic family duties? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't mean that, genuinely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Skip this and you're dead to us! Your call - don't come crying later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and help me check this data, I'm seriously overwhelmed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do, I'm swamped with the boss's assignment and genuinely can't spare time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't we supposed to be buddies? Remember how I bailed you out when your project crashed last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe after 4 PM I could take a quick look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline's at five! As a senior staff member, can't you even handle basic responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's way more urgent than yours - honestly can't assist.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll find someone else then. Just don't come crying to me next time you need help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come back for Spring Festival! The whole family's waiting for you — have some filial piety, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't take time off work, and flights are ridiculously expensive...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Excuses! Your aunt's in bed sick asking for you, you ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, my project deadline's immovable...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! The worst unfilial act is abandoning family reunions — are you ditching us now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Triple pay during holidays helps me save for the apartment...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money?! What matters more — kowtowing before ancestral tablets or cash? You conscience-less brat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll try snagging a ticket.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been working so much overtime lately that I've got this pounding headache.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really don't look well—maybe you should take some sick leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't afford it—the mortgage is killing me this month. I'll just push through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ran into your mom yesterday—she mentioned you've lost a scary amount of weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parents are supposed to work hard—it's all worth it if our kids have better lives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm...well make sure you're getting proper rest then.
