turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, wanna sign up for this finance course together? We're old classmates—we could keep each other accountable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mortgage payments are absolutely killing me lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's exactly why you need this! Wang already earned back his tuition last month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much is the course fee anyway...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just 299 if we team up! How could penny-pinching this small amount make you rich? Investing in yourself pays off best!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I guess we can try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're talking! Would I ever steer you wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll transfer the money later...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaoming, are you ready for the interest class?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma, I don't want to go. I'm exhausted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must attend the interest class—it's your responsibility. Your parents will be devastated otherwise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, alright then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Studying benefits your future. We really should hurry now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma, I understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mmh, don't waste another moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, Lao Zhang, long time no see! What've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, not bad, just muddling through at work. How about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm job hunting. Could you put in a word for me at that opening in your company? Come on, we're old classmates—if you don't help, what kind of person are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, it's kinda tricky. I'm afraid my recommendation might not help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? Tricky? Aren't you even gonna help with this? You're fucking selfish! Ungrateful dog!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, you've worn me down. I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatcha doing? Gotta discuss that scholarship thing with you pronto.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Out with it, I'm swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Some classmates are flat broke. You're the class monitor, so shouldn't you allocate more scholarship funds to them? Quit stalling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got bills to pay too, why should I prioritize them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even fulfilling your duties as monitor? Help them now, or how d'you think everyone will see you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, I need to put food on my table too, quit hounding me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep dodging this and you'll betray everyone's trust. Chop-chop!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I get it already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there? Could you do me a favor and buy some milk from the supermarket?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tied up right now, might not be able to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh no worries, when would work for you to grab it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Later maybe. Still busy – if it's urgent you could get it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, could you pick up whole milk later? Thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, noted. I'll swing by after handling my stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate the trouble – I'll get you a drink when you're back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, no big deal. Don't sweat it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your parents are longing for a grandchild with such desperation; how can you bear to disappoint them like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just changed jobs, and the pressure is overwhelming; I genuinely can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Continuing the family line is an absolute duty; our lineage simply can't end with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still haven't paid off the medical bills from my last hospitalization; I really can't handle it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Which family hasn't endured this struggle? You can't just focus on your own comfort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I catch a break? I'm worn out from daily overtime work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, sign me in for that meeting this afternoon. Doesn't matter if you're not going—you're signing for me anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell? I'm not your damn babysitter. Can't you handle your own shit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be this selfish? Roommates are supposed to help each other—it's basic decency! You WILL sign for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! I'm dead fucking tired today—are your legs broken or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even do this tiny favor? You're such a lousy friend! Just say yes already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whatever! God, you always pull this emotional blackmail crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time! Try being less of an ice queen next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, Niuniu absolutely adores clinging to you, even more than to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid is indeed affectionate, but I'm worried I might not be able to manage everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She lost her dad when she was little, and I never feel quite at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It hasn't been easy for you, but my own situation isn't great either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Niuniu keeps talking about how happy she was that time you took her to the park.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll figure out a way to lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With you helping out, I won't worry quite so much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can do. I'll do what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, see how sweet my girlfriends look with their couple's wallet? Could we set one up too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What for? Keeping our finances separate feels cleaner, doesn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just wanted to see if you'd spend for me. It'd show you care, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that got to do with caring? Using our own money is fairer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All the other boyfriends have it! They say it's true love. Won't you even give it a shot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why listen to them? Can't we just handle things our own way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly cared about me, wouldn't setting up a couple's wallet be the simplest sign?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, thinking of dropping by your place next weekend. Mind putting me up for a couple of days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my niece's family is visiting - they've taken the guest room already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? How about I come another time then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this - the house is in utter chaos right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I get your situation. Staying at a hotel works fine too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe next time give me a heads-up? I'll save the room for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal! Knew you'd have my back, man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely! When you come, I'm taking you to this awesome new joint in town.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Zhang, been swamped lately? Noticed you're always burning the midnight oil.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss is breathing down my neck. Pulling ten-hour days every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My client's pushing for the proposal. You're the market guru—mind giving it a once-over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly swamped. Even weekends are shot with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends are supposed to have each other's backs, right? When you moved last time, I showed up without a word.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll burn the midnight oil to help you sort it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mom's been crying a lot lately, saying she raised a child but can't even see him now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There are literally no decent jobs for me in our hometown. What am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After raising you for twenty-plus years, is it really too much to ask to see you more often?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When will you ever consider my side? Do you know how tough it is for me out here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Liu downstairs—he visits home weekly without it affecting his job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll squeeze out time to come back. Satisfied?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, it's time to contribute to the family mutual fund this year. Are you considering joining?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm still on the fence and leaning toward not paying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you possibly hesitate? Family duty is an obligation everyone must fulfill - you're required to join!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why required? The burden-sharing seems unfair to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fairness doesn't matter - it's non-negotiable. Family bonds demand every member contributes, or you're not truly family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm financially strained and fear I can't afford it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Afford it or not, you'll make it work! Obligations can't be dodged. This fund is mandatory - skipping payment makes you irresponsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll join just to avoid complications.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Uncle, Qiangqiang's tuition is short by five thousand, could you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are really tight right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Flaunting overseas trips daily but crying poor when helping family? Classy move!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you say things like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Truth hurts! Got money for luxury watches but none for your own nephew? What a tightwad!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think whatever you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your little sister's been so bored at home lately, maybe you could find some time to hang out with her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I wouldn't even know what to talk about—we've never been close.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She seems really lonely all by herself. Just thinking about it makes me feel sad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, it's awkward. We both feel uncomfortable around each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The sister next door plays with her every single day. That's how real families act.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll drop by, but just for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, that'll make everyone feel better.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, you must be free this weekend, right? Mind if I borrow your car?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I might have something to do and need to head out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's only for half a day—honestly, I feel you're the most dependable relative. Could you lend a hand, please?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, let me think about it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear I'll drive super carefully. Family ought to help each other out whenever possible, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, come grab it Sunday morning then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See, Auntie, you really do care about me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, my paycheck's late this month. Mind lending me a thousand for an emergency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's rough timing—I just paid rent and I'm tapped out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, everyone's struggling. I'll figure something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate you understanding. I'll definitely help when things ease up next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So... how'd that company bonus turn out for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, don't get me started. Boss is stingy as hell—didn't hand out a dime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll scout other options.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, catch you later. Gotta take my wife for her prenatal checkup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, use your connections to get my kid into that school pronto—don't drag your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! You think I'll just pull strings for anyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you're no friend at all! Can't even help with this tiny favor?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! I owe you nothing—quit your bitching!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Playing holier-than-thou? Fine, screw you then—pisses me off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, you're impossible... I'll ask around, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get a move on! Don't screw this up—what a pain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, could you help polish my paper? My deadline's approaching.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your paper is utter garbage. Are you incapable of revising it yourself? Quit bugging me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your words are really disgusting, but I genuinely need assistance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off, don't count on me! Deal with your own mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then could you recommend someone else? Please?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not in the mood for this. Don't waste my time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll figure it out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid keeps talking about you at home, and Auntie always says you're never around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is packed this weekend; I really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child is counting on you, saying Uncle is the dearest one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll pick him up for a bit, but it can't mess with my plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it—family should always look out for each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time, give me advance notice; these last-minute things are a real pain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid was so excited for this; I suppose I'm just too uptight about things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Teacher Wang, we need to discuss something. We're planning to install a remote camera in Xiao Bao's room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? A camera? Monitoring 24/7? That... that doesn't seem quite appropriate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's inappropriate about it? Can't we parents even watch our own child? You're practically family, Teacher! Unless you've got something to hide you're afraid we'll see?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant! How could you think that? I'm saying the child deserves some privacy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Privacy? What does a little brat need privacy for? Everything we're doing is for his own good! Any responsible teacher would understand this! If you refuse, we'll have no choice but to find someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...That's too harsh. You know how dedicated I've always been to this job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're truly dedicated, you should agree then! It's settled – the camera goes in next week, for our peace of mind. For heaven's sake, understand a parent's heart!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you've absolutely got to get this done today! The whole family's survival depends on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These old eyes can't see clearly though. What if I mess up the form?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all the pension money I give you every month, you won't even lift a finger for this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't manage anymore, even my legs won't obey me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you back out now, our grandkid will have to drop out of school. Would Grandma really be so heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll go first thing tomorrow. Don't blame me if it goes wrong.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There we go! I knew Mom dotes on her grandchild most!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, would you be able to leave a few good reviews for my store? Maybe help with a couple fake orders?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fake reviews... Is that even legal? I'm a bit worried about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Perhaps when you have time? No worries if it's inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mostly concerned about risking your account. Is it really that risky?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Small batches are actually manageable. If you're uncomfortable though, just forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll give it a try. Send me the link.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much! I'll treat you to a cup of boba later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you come to fill seats at tomorrow's event? Participation is voluntary.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might have something going on, not sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, if you're free just show up briefly. No pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If time allows, I'll try to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, no problem if you can't come. Don't push yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do my best, thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. Let's leave it at that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey dumbass, my bubble tea shop's opened. Repost the promo pic on your Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off, always asking people to share ads.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting all high and mighty - your feed's the tackiest anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Find someone else then, I ain't your errand boy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheapskate. No wonder you're going nowhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own damn business. Don't come bawling when you go bankrupt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh you're so mighty now? Forget about getting discounts here ever again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I care! Go ahead and block me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, any suitable matches for me? Don't just focus on your own daughter!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that hot temper of yours, who'd dare introduce anyone? You'd scare them off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ha! And that stubby guy you found for my cousin is such a great catch? Seems your taste is really questionable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He runs his own company now! Way better than some wage earner!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, just some nouveau riche! If you actually cared, you'd introduce someone reliable, not try to pawn off trash on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then! Lao Wang the butcher's son at the market is freshly divorced. Perfect match for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep him as a backup plan for your precious daughter! Really shows your level!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really annoyed by the whole dowry thing, why does your family insist on this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Insist? It's only proper to give a dowry! Your family is so stingy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stingy? You're the greedy ones! Who even follows such outdated customs now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Paying dowry shows filial respect, don't you understand tradition?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me! Your family just worships money, I won't enable this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Someone like you doesn't deserve marriage!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can I borrow your credit card points? I need to redeem a flight ticket.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nope, I need them for myself next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You cheapskate! Go ahead and be stingy then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you cursing at? Serves you right I won't lend them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bastard! Hand over the points today or I'll smash your car!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Just try touching my car, I dare you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Waste of space! Last chance, giving them or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I'm blocking you, asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, you gotta pull strings and refer me for that position in your department ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... spots are super tight right now, not sure if I can swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of buddy are you? After decades of friendship, you won't lift a finger? Got no damn conscience left?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: C'mon now... that's unfair, I'm genuinely stuck here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stuck my ass! Hoarding connections instead of helping your bro? You're just selfish! Get it done today or we're finished!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine! I'll see what I can do, just quit your yelling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie's leg is really bothering her; you should take tomorrow off to take her to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project is at a critical stage right now—the boss definitely won't approve leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's always talking about you, you know. She doted on you the most when you were little.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know, I know. But taking leave means losing the full-attendance bonus, and this month's mortgage payment is due.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Someone's got to look after the elderly when they're ill, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll squeeze in an early morning visit to take her, and drop her back home before work. Will that do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you have YouTube Premium, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I do. Need to use it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! Sharing with friends just goes without saying, doesn't it? I've treated you to movies several times already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That makes sense... but account security...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's there to worry about? Trust is the bedrock of friendship! With our bond, you'd really hesitate over this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll send you the login later. Try not to log in from different locations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, come take free photos for my new store opening ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed, can't take it on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing the big shot! How much crappy work can you even get?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Commercial shoots always charge fees.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the damn crap! Come or don't—your skills wouldn't produce anything decent anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts talking like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saturday 10 AM. Skip this, don't ever ask me for drinks again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like hell I will!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm in a bit of a hurry. Could you help me out first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, there's a queue ahead—it might take about fifteen minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fifteen minutes is cutting it close. Any chance to speed it up? I'm willing to pay extra.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For an express service, it's thirty yuan to skip the queue. Does that work for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thirty? That's a bit steep... Can you charge less? I really have an urgent matter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but skipping the queue delays other customers—the cost is fixed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... forget it this time. Can you take care of me next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll pack it up for you—just a few minutes more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you repost that event on my Moments? I'd really appreciate your support! It's practically an obligation between friends, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? What event? Been swamped lately, might not get to it until later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, do me this favor! Our ship of friendship needs to keep it afloat! Just one repost and you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll check out the content later then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline's approaching, you gotta repost it now! Everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll go repost it right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! This is exactly the kind of support friends are for!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, I need a loan guarantee urgently. Can you help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm broke too. Isn't being a guarantor way too risky?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Can't count on anyone when it matters. So damn frustrating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Loans aren't trivial. You sure you can repay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Help or don't—your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with that attitude? Since when do people beg so rudely?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! I'll ask someone else. Goddamn hassle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Move it! Quit wasting my time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so stuffy in the ward, you should come keep me company soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with overtime lately, might not make it this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you were injured last time? I delivered meals for you every single day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got no one to watch the kid at home, truly can't break free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other families bring soup daily, yet I'm stuck here all alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll squeeze in some time to visit tomorrow then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come in the morning, we'll have a proper chat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you still using the kitchen? I'm starving, so you've gotta let me cook first—that's my basic right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just started cooking, so hold on a sec. Can't you see others are waiting too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop being so selfish! I've been waiting ages—clear the spot right now, that's your damn duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll hurry up. Just quit lecturing about responsibilities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See? Should've done this earlier. You oughta know what's reasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, come on in. Just stop harping on about obligations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finally acting right. Remember to yield next time—basic consideration isn't rocket science.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We need to fix our relationship immediately—this is an obligation we must fulfill as partners.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must we? Your past actions make it hard for me to trust again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Because I've realized my mistakes, and in relationships, both sides have a duty to mend things. That's fundamental moral obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Responsibilities are mutual, yet you only mention my efforts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I admit my faults, but you should give me a chance now. Repairing this is the only way forward if we're to fulfill our responsibilities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need time to figure out how to approach the repair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but the repair process can't drag on. Only prompt action counts as being duty-bound.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must have a second child, otherwise you're being completely irresponsible to this family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane, Mom? Do you have any idea how exhausting it is to raise a kid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exhaustion my ass! We raised three back in the day and survived just fine – stop being so damn dramatic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even grasp how insane childcare costs are these days? Easy for you to preach when you're not bearing the burden!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! Refusing to give us grandchildren is sheer filial disobedience – don't you dare show your face at New Year's!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have it your way then! Keep tormenting people like this and karma will wreck you sooner or later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you do me a favor and forward something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, let me see what it is.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just this link, hurry up and share it! What's taking you so long!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd rather not forward it, let's skip this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking moron, can't even help with such a small thing! Useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the real asshole! Get someone else to do your shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piece of shit! I'll handle it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't show up for this gathering, Grandpa probably won't even eat properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't help it; the school event date was fixed six months ago.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He counts the days every day—how could a school event outweigh his own grandson's affairs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I must honor my promise to the child; stop pulling this stunt all the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Second Aunt just praised you as the most filial yesterday—do you really want to let them down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll squeeze in a visit on New Year's Day—satisfied now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we hash this out face to face? Keeping things frozen isn't helping anyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you remember me? Where were you when I needed you before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends should cut each other some slack. What good is avoiding each other gonna do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: And where was that slack when I needed it from you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on now, just give me a chance to make it right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why drag comparisons into this? Our issues have nothing to do with anyone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Throwing away all these years of history over this would be such a waste.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, are you free? Could I ask you for a favor? I'm not very familiar with this paperwork.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, what kind of paperwork? Let me check my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's about organizing some reports. Not really my main responsibility, so I need assistance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see, but I've got quite a bit on my plate today too. Might not be able to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no worries. I'll ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry about that. Hope you find someone who can help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, sorry to trouble you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. Bye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kid, how's the startup going? Remember to ask for help anytime you need it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's going alright, no need to worry too much. I've got this under control.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your health comes first—don't push yourself too hard.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I know. I'll make sure to rest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you need funds to tide things over, just tell us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, no need. You should keep that for your retirement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, take good care of yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll stop by to see you guys this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, could you use your saved points to help me exchange for a tableware set? Mine are all chipped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tableware? I was actually planning to get my wife a new wok with those points.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been cutting my mouth at every meal lately. Those points of yours are just sitting idle anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My wife's been talking about that wok for half a year. Really can't help you this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when you were hospitalized two years ago, I delivered bone broth for you daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... sigh. Maybe next month? I'll accumulate more points?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it. Pretend I never asked. I'll manage on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be like that. How about... I redeem two bowls for you as a stopgap?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Li, the project needs to be rushed tonight. With your experience, you can't possibly miss this. Everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, it's my dad's birthday today. I have to go home for the celebration, the timing can't be changed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family matters, sure. But if the project gets delayed because of you, the whole team suffers. Don't you have to think about everyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I work overtime, will I get compensatory time off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take a longer view. Constantly nickel-and-diming these minor things seems rather petty. Team interests should come first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. I'll tell my dad I'll be home later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Have my package delivered to your address!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your damn mind? Why should I take it for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless idiot! Can't even handle this simple thing right!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get your head examined! Stop dumping your crazy on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just wait! Your packages won't set foot in this neighborhood again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who you trying to scare? Get the hell out of here now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I must have my birthday party in your yard—all the relatives are waiting! You can't say no!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the grass was just planted—what if it gets ruined?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the stinginess? Last time your place leaked, I came without hesitation. Aren't we close enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do want to help, but the grass is still new...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's coming the day after tomorrow! How disappointed they'll be if you refuse—you're spoiling my big day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Just clean up afterward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Relatives should always help each other out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, the project's really tight and I'm exhausted—mind if I crash on your sofa for a few days? Could you do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room's just piled with stuff, afraid you won't sleep comfortably.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I can rough it out—just for a few days, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a small place, probably cramped, afraid you won't get used to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're not going to refuse such a little favor, are you? I'll just sleep in the living room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, give me a heads-up before you come, I'll tidy up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks then—make sure it's clean and get the bedding ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, no problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, we're short-handed for the club event this weekend—you gotta come lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my schedule's completely packed this week, really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you keep skipping out, everyone would think you're not pulling your weight, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not that I don't want to, but things are set in stone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All the dorm brothers are coming—it won't be the same without you. Just throw your support behind us, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll try to cancel my other plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. It'll be fun when we're all together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my computer just went black—get over here and fix it right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't right now, I'm swamped with work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What work? I'm your own flesh and blood! Was raising you with love just a waste? You won't even lift a finger to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, it's not that I won't—can we do tomorrow? My proposal deadline's tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! Even a dog knows loyalty! Can't even fix a damn computer without excuses—got no shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. I'll be there in thirty minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm swamped with projects and dead tired. Mind if I crash at your place for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room's jam-packed with stuff - honestly not super convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, after all these years of friendship? I've done plenty for you before, how about returning the favor this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's cramped here and people come and go constantly - worried it'll disturb you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't seriously expect me to sleep on the streets, can you? It's just a couple nights!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, make do with the living room then. Just tell me exactly when you're coming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great. Clean it up properly and stock all daily essentials - don't leave anything out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would it be convenient for you to help prepare the application materials?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been quite busy lately and might not have enough time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, I can handle it myself if needed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps I could try working on it this Thursday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only help if it's manageable, no pressure if it's too difficult.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What specific materials are needed for preparation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just the income statement and a copy of the household registration should suffice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best to get it ready by Thursday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, if it's convenient, could you use your connections to help my child get into school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll try, but I can't guarantee it'll work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's great, thanks for helping out—this is quite urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, it's nothing much; we're friends, after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I owe you a big favor; I'll treat you to a meal sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, it's no big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks in advance—just let me know if you hear any news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cuz, what're you doing at home? Get over here and help me sort these rags!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Sis, these rags are ancient - no way I'm taking them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop being so damn ungrateful! As my cousin, you're obligated to take them - refusing means you're disrespectful! Wasting resources is a goddamn sin, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You think I'm some junk collector? Take your trash and shove it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you to complain? Saying no means you're looking down on me - the whole family says you're selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! I'm done with your hypocritical bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you must get the project done tonight—how can you skip overtime as the veteran? The whole team's counting on you to lead us to success.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager Wang, it's my mom's birthday today—I really need to be home with her. Can't reschedule this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family matters, sure—but if you skip it and delay the project, the entire group suffers. You wouldn't want to disappoint everyone, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Will overtime come with compensatory time off? At least offer some benefits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always fixated on petty gains—how petty! If this project tanks, nobody wins. Can't you sacrifice a little for the team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: (Sigh) Alright then... I suppose I'll tell Mom I'm coming home late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screwed up the report—can you help sort it out before the afternoon check?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, messed up again? That's your job—do it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you let our performance review go down the drain? How dare you waste the whole team's hard work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fabricating data when things go wrong? What if we get caught?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years working together, you won't even help with this? You're not much of a partner!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh for heaven's sake... Fine, last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, save me! I've got a 39-degree fever—can you grab some fever reducers for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now? I'm in the middle of a ranked game...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember back in college when I had a fever? You just hauled me to the hospital without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, this match is crucial... Maybe order delivery through Meituan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even hold my phone steady—you see how bad it is...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll AFK and go. Satisfied?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you, man. This fever's wrecking me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hang tight—I'll call after buying the meds.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, where are you slumming it? Wanna swing by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Maybe when I get around to it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell? Can't even do me a solid? Selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buzz off, quit bugging me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself! Don't come crying to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ooooh scary! Whatever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you really have to pick this exact time to go study out of town? Who's supposed to clean up this mess at home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This opportunity is too rare to miss – my promotion will fall through if I pass it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's crying for Daddy every single day. How can you be so heartless and leave them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't want to either, but my entire career is on the line here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been run ragged lately. Couldn't you at least consider how I feel?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe... I could take some leave and come back early?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take Lao Chen next door – the second his kid needs him, he drops everything to be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll stay then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and send me your address! The delivery got stuck near your place again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why does this keep happening? My address is practically turning into your personal pickup spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're dragging your feet over such a simple favor? With our friendship, you won't even do this much?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I refuse to help, but how can anyone tolerate you constantly doing this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you complain about tolerance? Remember how I supported you during your tough times? Send the address now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... sent. Seriously, don't come to me with this again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, turn on the damn Close Payment for me! What's the holdup?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You loaded or something? Ask properly if you want it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You're being stingy as hell—it won't kill you to turn on a damn feature!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You nuts? My choice whether to activate it—who made you the boss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Keep it off then—acting like some big shot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got water in your brain if you think shouting insults works!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Forget I asked—you stingy bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, got a minute? Something came up last minute, could you watch the store for me? About thirty to forty minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, sure, no problem. Half an hour or forty minutes is manageable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah shoot, sorry about this - hit a snag and might need another hour. You think... you could hang on a bit longer? Really appreciate it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: An hour-plus? Hmm... that's tricky. I've got plans with someone at 5:30.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get it. If you can stretch it, great - but no pressure if not. I'll race back ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll see if I can push my appointment back. Can cover till five max, but later's impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolute legend! Count on me to be back before five! You're a lifesaver!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No sweat. Drive safe and go sort your stuff out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, my landlord suddenly kicked me out. Any chance I could crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awkward timing—my mom's in town for medical treatment and staying with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, this is such a nightmare timing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've converted the living room into a temporary sickroom—literally zero space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guess I'll check if Xiao Li's place works then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry man—next time give me a heads-up and I'll definitely hook you up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No sweat, I'll sort something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, the payroll might be slightly delayed this month due to some cash flow constraints at the company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? President Sun, how long exactly? I do have my mortgage payment due.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand! Probably around a week? Would you be able to discuss a short extension with the bank? We'll expedite this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A week... I'll try, but no promises. Hope it won't be delayed too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! I'm pushing on my end too! We'll process the payment immediately upon receiving funds this week. Really sorry about this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, hope it's soon. Keep me updated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem! Will definitely keep you updated! Really appreciate your understanding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab a box of grapes for me? It's right on your way to the supermarket.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really convenient right now, I'm swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends should help each other out. Are you really going to be this unaccommodating?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I bring it tomorrow? I genuinely can't get away today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you moved last time, I helped you all day long. Now you're trying to get out of bringing one little thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant... Fine, I'll go now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's being a helpful friend. People ought to learn to be grateful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, meet you at the supermarket entrance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work has been incredibly stressful lately, with an overwhelming number of extra tasks. I'm really at my breaking point.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That does sound exhausting. Perhaps you could discuss it with your supervisor to find ways to share the workload.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I doubt it'll make a difference even if I speak up—they're all swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really should try though—it's better than bottling it up. We can all brainstorm solutions together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll bring it up when I get a chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, keep me updated if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ms. Li, the company suddenly transferred me, I have to move out by month-end. You should really make an exception and refund the deposit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract states the deposit isn't refundable for early termination. This last-minute change puts me in a really tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't people act with a conscience? I paid rent on time for two years! Facing hardship now, don't you think you ought to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But a contract is about contractual integrity. Breaking it casually just isn't fair to others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, if you're going to be this heartless, I can't force you. But surely you care about your reputation? The whole neighborhood knows you're my landlord!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not heartlessness, it's principle. But considering your situation, I'll refund half the deposit. Just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you for your understanding! I knew you'd be the most reasonable. Good things will happen to good people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just swamped with random stuff. Did you need something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since you've got connections at the tax bureau, could you help my brother land a job?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're cracking down hard these days, genuinely can't swing it

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even count on family for a tiny favor like this? Real classy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut me some slack here, it's genuinely impossible

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Relying on you's more useless than doing it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take care of my kid this Saturday, you hear me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you? Do I owe you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You piece of shit! Is watching a kid gonna kill you? I helped your family when shit hit the fan!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I ain't got time for this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish prick! Don't ever set foot in my house again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good fucking riddance! Think you're the Empress Dowager?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking bastard! Should've known better than to count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the landlord's pulling this rent hike stunt and I'm totally helpless. You're the legal expert—you've absolutely got to help me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Again? What exactly happened?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He jacked up the rent without even notifying me—I haven't slept for days. You're the only pro around here; if you won't help me, who else can I count on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's piled mountain-high lately, genuinely no bandwidth.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, I still remember how you helped Lao Wang last year. Now you've gotta reach out and pull me through this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll try to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get me a ticket tomorrow, you hear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck you can't buy it yourself? Think I'm your errand boy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough crap! Just tell me if you'll do it or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like hell I will! Who the fuck are you to boss me around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking moron! Forget I asked then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Can't stand the sight of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li Hua, that's my seat by the window—I left a book there. Do you mind moving?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you left something? Didn't notice it. Thought it was free and just sat down for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Placing it there was reserving the spot—that's how it works in the library. Plus, I really need this seat for studying. Would you mind vacating it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, since you put it that way, I'll move. But reserving seats isn't really right, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks. Library resources are tight—let's all be understanding, shall we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll find another spot. But maybe avoid reserving seats next time? It affects others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, with our kind of relationship, you can't skimp on the red envelope, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are really tight lately - how about 3000? Mom's hospital bills cleaned me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year at your daughter's full-month celebration, I made a point to give a 'generous' red packet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... circumstances are different now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole wedding party will be watching. After all these years of friendship...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to scrape together 4000 then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There we go! Reciprocity is what friendship's all about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's crying from hunger. Can't you hurry back as a father?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This networking event can't be skipped. Shouldn't a friend show some understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Their forehead feels scorching hot. Parental responsibility isn't something to abandon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I pulled an all-nighter caring for your sick mom last time? That's what friends do - help each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dredging up old favors. The child's emergency comes first now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You never kept score when I helped! How's this hypocritical double standard fair?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! Just drop it for now - my mind's in chaos.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you're going to Guangzhou for business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, leaving tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guangzhou sausages are famous – you gotta bring back ten pounds or so to share.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed with meetings, no time to shop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Xiao Li brought a whole case – everyone praised his thoughtfulness. You can't possibly come back empty-handed, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll bring some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Someone who lacks basic social graces will never get help later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, I've been feeling a bit lonely lately being on my own; seeing others paired up leaves me feeling empty inside.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't something to rush. I haven't been meeting many people recently, so I genuinely don't have any leads to share with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, I just want to find a steady person to settle down with—is that really too much to ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The right person is truly hard to come by; it's all about chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you happen to know anyone suitable, just keep an eye out for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll reach out to my old classmate's child this weekend and set up a meeting for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and arrange things as you see fit; let it unfold naturally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For this outstanding evaluation, collective contribution rate is paramount. Everyone should voluntarily work overtime to demonstrate dedication.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, I need to accompany my elderly parents to a medical appointment this weekend. It's really impossible for me to come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Such a lack of ideological awareness! Is placing personal difficulties above the collective appropriate? The team is utterly disappointed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, how can you say that? Does caring for a seriously ill family member equate to backward thinking?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The organization has nurtured you for years. Who do you think you're letting down by shirking responsibility at this critical moment? I expect to see you here tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it. I'll arrange for family to help instead. But honestly, your approach really chafes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I've got gambling debts again... could you bail me out one more time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You hopeless loser! Was helping you last time just throwing money down the drain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll really quit gambling this time, just help me clear the debt...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop lying to my face! You make me sick—get out of here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please, I swear I'll keep my word this time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep your word my foot! Go die alone if you must, but don't drag us down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you help me check my paper? It's due tomorrow morning, I'm totally swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I just started my own work, probably can't squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, that's not very friendly. What about our friendship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then, I'll try to make some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man, next round's on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... send it over, but don't keep me up too late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome, knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The notice needs to go out by Monday. Will we make the deadline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got family matters this weekend. Could we push it back to Tuesday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you like Xiao Zhang to give you a hand if needed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good idea. I'll work out my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feel free to speak up if you hit any difficulties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you order takeout for me? I'm starving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just order it yourself. I'm swamped right now.
