turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then could you help me check later when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hang on, I'll order for you in half an hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Don't forget!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Decided what to eat yet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Braised chicken rice, the usual.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, order placed. Arrives in 30 mins.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, working overtime every day... haven't seen my parents in three months. I've really been thinking about them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No matter how busy work gets, you must care for your parents! They're eagerly waiting for you every day—you absolutely need to find time to visit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't get away. This project is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're treating them so unfairly—after all they've sacrificed raising you? Arrange time immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop nagging! I'm stressed enough as it is—the pressure is overwhelming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't go back now, and something happens to them someday, you'll regret it forever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wang, you've got way too much free time on your hands, huh? Go queue for me right now - I'm buried in work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got mountains of work tomorrow, honestly can't squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So all these years of friendship meant nothing? Can't even lift a finger to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swear it's not about unwillingness, just slammed with back-to-back commitments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How hard is it to queue at dawn? If I meant anything to you, you'd stop making excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine - but this is the one and only time, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, I need a hand—my video traffic's crashed and I'm losing sleep over it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling daily overtime lately, can't spare a moment. Cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing everyone else's numbers climb while mine flatline... feels like a gut punch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not that I don't want to help, but I'm stretched razor-thin right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just toss me some quick pointers? Think of it as shooting the breeze with your buddy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to carve out half an hour to glance it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, that tech sharing session next week is really substantial, you should check it out if you're free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Afraid I can't make it—I'm swamped with work and pulling overtime these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, weren't you always interested in this field? You can always squeeze in some time, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just worried I might not understand it and waste a whole afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No harm in listening anyway, and spots are going fast. I only mentioned it because I thought it'd be perfect for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, since you put it that way, I'll try to make time for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Wang, what're you up to at home? Mind if I borrow your kitchen?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh Xiao Zhang, the kitchen's free. What's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My pot just blew up and I desperately need to make soup. Helping neighbors is a moral duty—you can't be this heartless, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I actually need to cook soon, so it's a bit inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll only take twenty minutes! As a decent neighbor, you ought to understand common decency. Refusing would make you look so stingy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, fine. But make it quick—don't take too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, Bro Wang! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm taking five days off next week for house repairs. You'll figure it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Five days? Are you out of your mind? You expect to wrap up the project yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: To hell with wrapping up! My business is a hundred times more important than this damn project!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dare to leave and it'll count as absenteeism! Kiss your entire bonus goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! Who needs your money? I quit right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the hell out! Worthless piece of crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me! This lousy company deserves to go bankrupt anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the holdup with my cousin's school thing? Get moving already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I told you the checks are strict—if something goes wrong, I'll lose my job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even handle such a small thing—what good are you?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Easy for you to say—why don't you pull strings yourself?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Waste of space! Too scared to take this little risk? No wonder you're going nowhere!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swear all you want—I'm not doing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get out! Never set foot in this house again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang is taking leave again this week? You're perfectly healthy—can't you just back me up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with my move and can't spare a minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't he help you out plenty before? Now when it's your turn to chip in, you're acting like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I covered for him, I almost lost a client. So frustrating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you keep stonewalling, how are we supposed to work together? I'll talk to Xiao Wang later—just take this for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. After I get through this crazy period.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone must come to the weekend shoot—no exceptions whatsoever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team leader, I've got urgent family matters; an elderly needs care, so I can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Xiao Wang came despite a high fever? That's what real team spirit looks like, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't step away; the hospital requires constant attention.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This outcome directly impacts everyone's performance review—your absence would be such a pity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll manage to free up some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit—don't let the team down on this group event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll head over once I sort things out at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, heard you're pretty tight with Mr. Zhang?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, we're somewhat acquainted. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really struggling here—could you introduce me to Mr. Zhang? Just a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, it's not a good time lately. He's swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given our friendship, couldn't you just make a quick intro?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't. Hope you understand my position.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, won't push you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you send me your department's budget data?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These are confidential files, I really can't share them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Pushing back on such a small favor after all these years? Pathetic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I'm refusing, management has strict oversight on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! You're being so lame about this. Don't come to me for help in the future then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You're overreacting...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our neighbor Xiao Zhang is showing off his kid again. It’d be such a waste not to share about our adorable baby.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I always feel it's not safe to post kids' photos online.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends are asking, and if we don’t post, people might think we don’t care about our kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and post if you want, but just don’t show the face.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about just a back view shot? So everyone can see how attentive we are with parenting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you’re set on posting, fine, but don’t rope me into liking it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, deal. I’ll just pick some flattering ones.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, do whatever you want then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you help look after my sister for a bit? She needs some company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, let me check my schedule—I'm a bit tied up right now, not sure if I can free up time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just help if you can. If it's inconvenient, I'll figure something else out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll try to make arrangements. What snacks does your sister like? I'll prepare some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She eats snacks, but maybe not too much. Just use your best judgment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll keep that in mind. Text me anytime if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks then! Let me know when it's sorted. Really appreciate it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you do me a favor? My medical reimbursement is kind of urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project's got me running around lately, not sure I can squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just checking. You did mention you're familiar with the process.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It shouldn't be hard if the documents are ready. Want me to walk you through it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The thing is, I'm stuck here getting an IV right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... let me see if I can find some time during lunch break.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would really appreciate the help if you can! I'll treat you to barbecue later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, send over the documents and I'll take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you bear to focus solely on your exams when your parents are exhausted like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been studying late every night; I can't let all that effort go to waste now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial duty comes first. With the family urgently needing someone around, what are we supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Passing the civil service exam would let me support the family better. Can you just wait two more weeks?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you were sick as a child, Mom and Dad stayed up all night with you? Now that we need you, you're pushing back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: (Sigh) I suppose I can find some time to come back these next few days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must guarantee for me—with our friendship, there's no room for debate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm a bit tight on cash right now, so acting as a guarantor might not be the best idea, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you can't act like that! True loyalty means being ready to take a bullet for a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your demand came out of nowhere; I wasn't prepared at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dodging! If you're a real friend, you help without question—or you're just plain heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're being way too pushy; at least give me time to think it over, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unbelievable! Can't count on you when it matters—what kind of brother does that make you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's just drop it for now; we'll talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: B, come over here for a sec. We need to talk about the scholarship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead, what's so important?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Some classmates are really strapped for cash. It'd only be decent to share part of your scholarship with them, wouldn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm tight on money too—what am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As class monitor, everyone's watching you. Least you could do is help out a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chop-chop, don't leave everyone hanging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, that's the plan for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you've got to help me out this time. My friend is pressing hard for the money I owe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, why didn't you mention it earlier? I just got a car loan and have zero spare cash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With a friendship like ours, you can't seriously just stand by and watch me struggle, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that - I genuinely can't assist. Just paid for my kid's after-school programs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you started your business last year, I wired you five thousand immediately. Now it's my turn, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember that debt of gratitude, but honestly there's no spare money right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, forget it. Pretend I never brought this up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's revisit this in a few days. Gotta run to pick someone up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, we've got a minor money hiccup at home. Since you're busy with work, just wondering if you could lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, that sounds a bit messy. I'm worried I might not figure it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh well, no pressure if you can't help. We'll take our time—after all, you're usually quite detail-oriented.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll ask around to see if my friends have any good ideas.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, good. Seeing you so willing to help out puts our minds at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll give it a shot. Gotta find someone who knows the ropes anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhao, can you make it to the team-building event this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry boss, I've got some family matters to handle - might not be able to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, whatever works for you. It'd be great if you could come though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. I'll try to wrap things up and swing by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure at all, just play it by ear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll keep you posted once I know for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, we'll see how it goes then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account's been frozen for three days—you must unfreeze it today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you first explain the specific violation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My whole family depends on this account to eat—is this appropriate? Get this sorted out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We detected prohibited traffic redirection. Per regulations, it must remain frozen.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Countless users rely on this platform to survive. How can you freeze accounts this recklessly—do you feel right about this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll need to file an appeal. We'll only unfreeze if requirements are met.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unfreeze it NOW! Users trusted your platform—how dare you let down the trust and break everyone's hearts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll transfer this to our tech team. We'll contact you shortly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new store opens this weekend and all the relatives are coming. Shouldn't you be there too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work and genuinely can't make it this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't that be rude if you don't show up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't get me wrong, it's really just work piling up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped you out without a second thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's truly impossible this time, but I'll definitely come next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else is coming except you—won't it look bad?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you're going to pick up the packages later, right? Could you bring mine up too? Thanks a lot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Um... I'm afraid it's not very convenient. I have something else urgent to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a small favor. Look how busy I am here—as colleagues, isn't it only right to share the load? You can't just refuse to help, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But time is really tight, I'm worried I'll be delayed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, you won't even help with such a tiny thing? We're all one team—show a bit of mutual support spirit. What will everyone think if you act like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, alright, just this once. What's the package name?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I knew you'd be sensible and know what's important. It's at Cainiao Station, name is XXX.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, could you check this package for me first? I'm kind of in a hurry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There are two orders ahead, please wait a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you make an exception? I'm really pressed for time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't let you cut in line, others are waiting too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll go handle other things and come back to pick it up in half an hour, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, just leave the slip here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, sorry for the trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, you go ahead with your business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you follow up on the proposal for me? I've got some personal matters to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... I have to submit my own materials by 3 PM.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shall I handle the latter part myself? Then you can fill in the first half before 5?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The preliminary materials are all with me. That could work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to be back by 3. Really appreciate your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all the blood, sweat and tears your parents poured into you? You owe it to them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need half a year off...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's counting on you to make it big—how can you quit halfway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm scared I'll let everyone down again...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to snap out of it! Hit the books starting next week—I'll be watching you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, I'm having some issues with my retirement paperwork. Would you have some time to look into it in the next couple of days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old Uncle, we're swamped with quarterly reports lately. I'm afraid I'm completely tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I totally understand. I'll just figure it out myself then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what—I can connect you with a colleague who specializes in these matters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That could work. I just wouldn't want to impose on them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No trouble at all. I'll check with him first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you go ahead with your work. Just drop me a message if there's any news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The paper requires major revisions, and you must submit the new version tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've been overwhelmed with commitments lately. Could you possibly grant me an extension?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The research group's progress cannot be compromised. You need to prioritize team interests here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This section genuinely demands substantial time to rewrite properly...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Considering all the guidance I've invested in you, completing this tonight is your non-negotiable responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll expedite the process immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ensure it's in my inbox by 8 AM tomorrow - the team's credibility hangs on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you vote for me for the Most Beautiful Employee? Just a quick click.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, got a lot on my plate right now, might get to it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Give me a hand here? Everyone's pitching in for the company event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze it in if I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends should help each other out - it's all about the spirit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, done. I voted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! Hope you'll keep supporting when free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm, we'll see later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my buddy's in a real bind here - could you co-sign for him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've never even met the guy... this feels risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, you're gonna leave me hanging when I need you most?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't I be fully liable if something goes wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last year when you got laid off? I scraped together 30 grand overnight for you! And now you're chickening out on me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just need some time to think it through, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We need this settled TODAY! Is our friendship really worth so little that you won't even do this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, Grandma's been coughing really badly lately. I have to travel out of town next week—could you go keep her company?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, my kid's running a fever right now, and with all the household chaos, I probably can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Grandma's getting old. It just worries me sick thinking of her alone at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The doctor insisted she must take her medicine on schedule, twice a day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know about the meds, but I'm genuinely tied up with the kid over here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, your child's needs come first. I'll check if other relatives can pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright Sis, handle your things first. If it gets overwhelming, I'll sort something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family's pressuring me to get married and it's driving me crazy. Could you do me a solid and pretend to be my partner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whoa... wouldn't that seem too fake? Do you really think your parents would buy it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't you see how Lao Zhang helped Lao Li out? Come on, with our bond, you wouldn't just leave me hanging like this, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm mainly worried I'll mess things up and make it worse. You know I can't lie to save my life.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This whole thing is driving me crazy – I can't even eat properly. Could you just help me get through this rough patch?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... alright, I'll give it a shot? But just so we're clear – this is a one-time thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! Dinner's on me next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey colleague, since your side gig is doing so well, shouldn't you feel obligated to help promote it for free? That's just basic workplace camaraderie.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Free promotion? When do I have time for that? Your demand is downright annoying—stop pressuring me like I owe you this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What pressure? As colleagues, you must do this promotion. Or are you questioning whether our friendship even matters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, you always pull this moral blackmail shit! Promotion should be my choice, right? Forced help defeats the whole purpose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! You're earning plenty—helping with a small promotion is the bare minimum. You must post it on your Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You selfish bastard! Expecting free help like I'm slave labor? Not a chance in hell for promotion!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Decide if you value this friendship. You must promote it, or this relationship is over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Forcing people like this is trash behavior. I'll consider the promotion on my own damn terms.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, let me use your membership account. There's a discount today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Again? My account's almost getting banned from this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you're so goddamn selfish! Shouldn't roommates help each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I lent it to you, it auto-renewed and charged me extra!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Still hung up on that petty crap? You're a shitty person!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whatever. Just don't screw with the password!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time. Quit acting all holier-than-thou!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm under so much pressure, I really can't handle this anymore.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing the victim! Real friends gotta stand by me no matter what—don't you get that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is genuinely beyond what I can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! What kind of friend doesn't have the guts for this? You're just selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hearing this really hurts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Serves you right! People who ignore basic decency deserve to be yelled at!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're having a company dinner this Friday, wanna join? Just casual eating, drinking and chatting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A dinner? Might have plans that day, not sure if I can make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, come if you're free, forget it if you're not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to squeeze in some time to drop by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great, thanks. Feels more comfortable with you around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well then don't go overboard with drinking.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll just make an appearance and bounce once the formalities are done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, we'll play it by ear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've got a landlord dispute, legal stuff. Could you help me sort it out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? Give me the specifics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That bastard landlord is trying to screw me over! Quit dragging your feet and help me figure this out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck's that got to do with me? Handle your own shit, I'm busy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a fucking idiot! Can't even handle this simple crap? Worthless coworker!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Stop bothering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, I want to quit my job and open an internet cafe with my friends. The gaming industry is really lucrative right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you lost your damn mind? How dare you get involved with those soul-destroying internet dens? Quitting would make you a disgrace to your family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm 25 already, shouldn't I be allowed to live my own life?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Live your own life? Who paid for your college, you ungrateful wretch? Earning for this family's retirement is your fundamental duty now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My current job's exhausting me with constant overtime...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tired? I endured ten times worse during my sent-down youth! Refusing to endure your job shows you've got no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I at least take a leave of absence to try it out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare test me, you worthless brat! Sign that contract renewal today, or you're no son of mine!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old buddy, hit a temporary cash crunch in my business—could you lend me eight thousand to tide me over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just paid for my kid's tutoring classes, genuinely don't have spare cash right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I helped you buy your car? Consider this returning the favor to get me through a rough patch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I hear you, but this month's spending has already gone way over budget.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With a bond like ours, you wouldn't just stand by watching me drown, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I can shuffle three thousand your way—just pay me back ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cover my shift tomorrow, heard me? No fucking excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! Who the hell are you to order me around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing? Believe it or not, I'll make your life here impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scaring dogs now? Cut the bullshit and spit it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you damn ingrate! Don't come crawling to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw your sister! Get lost, asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, the landlord raised the rent again arbitrarily—I can't survive like this! You're in law; shouldn't you step in and help now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much did they raise it this time? What does the contract say?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract expired and they flipped on me! I'm so stressed I'm falling ill. With twenty years of friendship, if you truly see me as a brother, you've got to handle this pronto!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been buried in work lately—cases are piling up nonstop...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ran around helping Lao Li last time, but now you're giving me the runaround? Are friends graded into different tiers or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll try to squeeze in a look, but don't bank on a quick fix.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, about that XX book you mentioned last time, would now be a good time for me to borrow it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh that one, I'm still reading it - the second half is pretty challenging so I'm taking it slow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, maybe I'll just wait until you're done then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, probably next Friday? I'll bring it to you then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great! No rush at all, thanks! Or actually, could I check out your notes in the meantime if that works?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Notes are right here in my bag, want them now? Just remember to return them later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad worry about you getting married every single day. If you don't take it seriously soon, it really breaks their hearts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with work lately, just haven't had the headspace to think about any of that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young Zhao next door just got engaged, and his parents lit up like sunshine. Shouldn't you step up your game?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but I just can't right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go find someone to meet this weekend, spare Mom and Dad the constant worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: (Sigh) Alright, fine. I'll go take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, there's no way I can handle this move alone. With decades of friendship between us, you must come help tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, tomorrow's really impossible. I'm swamped with urgent matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're not being a good sport here, are you? Isn't it just basic decency to help neighbors?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely not making excuses—I'm buried up to my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your sister got married, I helped without a word. Now that I'm moving, you're making excuses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to squeeze in some time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! People ought to honor commitments—help me this time, and I'll absolutely return the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My cousin just lost her job and wants to crash at our place for a few days. Would that be okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long exactly? Our lease might have issues with extra people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She said about a week—just until she finds work. Family should help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about shared spaces and expenses? We should clarify the split.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She'll pitch in for bills, and we'll handle extra cleaning. No big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The lease probably doesn't allow extra tenants. We should check the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't we make it work? It'd be unthinkable not to help family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll ask the landlord and get back to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, my paper is stuck at the polishing stage—you have to help review it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My desk's buried under project completion reports; no bandwidth for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You said leaders should be accountable last time—backing out now isn't appropriate, is it? Team interests outweigh individual convenience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't pin labels on me! You'd have finished edits if you weren't wasting time on this bullshit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you care about departmental KPIs? My failure reflects poorly on you too. This is your job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My job? I clean up after your drafts while you play scholar—am I your damn nanny?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. I'll take this paper to the Associate Dean for guidance tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, are you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got nowhere to stay tonight. Mind if I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, not really possible. The house is packed with relatives already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? You MUST take me in as family! Zero family loyalty - you're utterly heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making a scene. I've got my own problems, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Remember how heartless you were today! When trouble hits you, don't come crawling to me for help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough already. Hanging up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you guys are hiring interns?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, but the requirement is a degree from a top-tier university.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My nephew's school isn't prestigious, but that kid's dead serious. Hard to find such a solid worker nowadays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The criteria are pretty firm, tough to bend the rules honestly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kid's eating his heart out over this, just do us a solid will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's sticky to pull off... lemme mull it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just slot him in, have him shadow the team end of the month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll see what strings I can pull.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help forward that project content on Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on, I'm working on something urgent right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you dawdling for? It's just a small favor, and you're putting on airs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't really agree with the content, so let's drop it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, you don't even care about colleague respect—is this your true nature?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're really something, whether to help or not is my own choice, okay!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I must have been blind to ask you, you heartless piece of work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lately I've been feeling this emptiness inside, just not used to you not being around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still haven't recovered yet, that thing last time really got to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand you need time, it's just... thinking about those happy days we shared makes me really nostalgic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feelings can't be rushed like this, I'm still figuring things out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you ever think about the times we had before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just let me think about it some more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but I'm afraid if it takes too long, things might fade.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cuz, the quarterly review is down to the wire! Get me some fake course completion stats ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That's sketchy... If I get caught, my career's toast.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with that? We're blood relatives! Can't even do me this solid? Should we just bring shame to the family? Refusing means you look down on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not it... but this is way too risky, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Risky? Don't you know the value of family? The whole clan counts on your skills to eat, and now you're whining? Will you help or not? If not, don't bother contacting me ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, fine! Send me the login! You're unbelievable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Now that's what family does! Remember – make the data look flawless. Don't you dare screw this up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might not make it to tomorrow's morning meeting. If you pass by the conference room, could you clock me in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got my own stuff tomorrow morning too. We'll see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard supervisors are doing roll call. Latecomers get marked absent. Didn't you help someone sign in before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was only because it was on my way. Really can't promise anything now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you worked late, I made a point to bring an extra bento box for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasn't that bento box just a spare? Alright, if I can get there before 9, I'll sign for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll try to hurry up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab lunch for me? I'm swamped with work and can't step out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got to submit a summary, and it's really urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a newbie, taking on more tasks helps you learn faster—it's great practice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to squeeze in some time to go?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly right—the team matters more than the individual; you must develop that mindset.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, what do you want to eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fried rice is fine. More experience will benefit you in the long run.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'll head out now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? Need to talk to you about something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I want to buy a place using your name. Do me this favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way. That's too risky. I won't do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? You're actually saying no? What a pal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you say that? Why should I shoulder such a big risk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Loser! Can't even help with this? Wasted all these years knowing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Don't come looking for me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, cousin, how's it going lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't complain, just keeping busy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard Auntie's sick. Maybe visit her when you get the chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably can't make it, swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? How can you be so careless about your own mother? Whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, quit nagging. I'll go when I'm free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The data gap is massive; we've got to find a way to cover it up or we'll all lose our quarterly bonuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But can we actually pull this off? Who's gonna take the fall when it blows up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every other department fudges their numbers! If our team ranks last, our six months of hard work goes down the drain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know the logic, but something about this just doesn't sit right with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you messed up last quarter? I burned midnight oil to fix your disaster! Consider this repaying your debt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... then you'd better bury the raw data deep. If this backfires, you're taking full responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my kid's been running a fever lately - such a hassle to care for, can't even focus on work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: God, you're unbelievably selfish! Your child's sick and you're still obsessing over work? Hope you work yourself to death!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the project deadline's crazy tight, boss is breathing down my neck - what should I do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not my damn problem! Should've cared or not, you deserve to collapse from exhaustion. Quit playing the victim here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, I'll try swapping shifts - but kiss this month's bonus goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, cut the act! You've always been self-centered anyway, that poor kid's stuck with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, gotta run for now. Catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a sec to help me edit a photo? Should take about ten minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kind of got my hands full with something at the moment. Would two hours from now work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, that works! Or I could try doing it myself, though I'm a bit rusty—it would probably take me longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll get it done for you. I'll send it over when it's ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! Need the original file?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, send it over. Maybe add a natural-looking filter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You got it! Whatever you say works for me. I'll buy you bubble tea sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? I'm burning up. If you're really my brother, hurry up and grab me some fever meds.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of a promotion match... Can you wait a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who dragged themselves out at midnight with medicine when your stomach was killing you last time? And now you're prioritizing some game?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it just started... Ten minutes tops, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ten minutes? You gonna take responsibility if this fever cooks my brain? A real friend wouldn't drag their feet like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine, whatever. I'm quitting the game now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what I'm talking about. And make sure you get the most expensive fever reducer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll be there soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even going to that damn blind date or not? You're not getting any younger! What a loser!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Buzz off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So this is how you repay me after all I've done? Ungrateful brat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Call me whatever you want. Still not going.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Stay single forever then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Save your breath!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, I heard you're the manager at that XX Mall?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up? Need something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect timing—I want a new phone! Can you get me that employee discount? Family discounts must be dirt cheap for relatives like us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's tricky right now with strict checks. Employee discounts have usage limits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? 'Tricky'? We're family! Can't even do this small favor? Are you even my aunt? Zero family feeling! What's the big deal? Helping out won't kill you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. I'll try. I'm at my wit's end with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind helping me revise an apology email?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a moment, I'm tied up with something urgent right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just whenever it's convenient for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about sending it over? I'll try to fit it in later when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect, I've forwarded the email to you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, but it might have to wait until after dinner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely, I really appreciate it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for thanks, we help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, you've gotta talk to the boss for me about this—my whole livelihood's on the line!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could I possibly bring that up? Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be this selfish? After all we've worked together—morally you're obligated to help me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell should I? Keep your mess out of my way!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit pretending, you heartless bastard! Refusing to help proves you've got no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! I'm done with your crap—deal with it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! When you're screwed later, don't come begging to me. Good riddance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This opportunity should be a piece of cake for you, right? The newcomers are really counting on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd like to pursue it too, to better myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just cut the newcomers some slack – everyone agrees it's the right thing to do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But that's unfair – company policy requires fair competition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team spirit must be preserved. If you yield, we'll all get along better.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I believe sticking to the regulations is more appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm genuinely disappointed. We really need more unity in the team.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, I've been waiting for 40 minutes without any assistance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies for the delay; we're experiencing high call volumes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given your professional role, clients enduring extended waits deserve priority handling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We empathize with your position and are processing queries sequentially.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Operational efficiency is non-negotiable in service roles – it's core professional integrity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We acknowledge our duty and are expediting resolutions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly grasp your obligations, subjecting clients to excruciating delays is unacceptable. Process my case immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your request has been escalated and we'll follow up shortly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there? My packages keep getting stolen, so sending them to your place would be safer. Could you receive them for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ship them to me? My place is tiny and already packed with stuff. Won't that be inconvenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, packages got stolen multiple times already. It's driving me crazy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then why didn't you mention it sooner? I'm completely swamped myself right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries if it doesn't work for you, I'll just ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just send me the address. I'll hold onto them for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, that supervisor position has opened up. I'm constantly getting pushed around at work, and the whole family is counting on you to lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The requirements are pretty strict. Your background isn't a good fit, so it's tricky to manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at other families—they all pitch in to support each other. It's only here that things aren't going smoothly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but it's genuinely troublesome. I'll have to find someone to pull some strings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you give me an answer soon? That way my mom won't keep worrying about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, cousin, I've been swamped at work lately, pulling overtime every day. I just can't spare time to visit Mom and Dad back home, and I feel really guilty about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not acceptable. Being filial is your responsibility. No matter how busy you are, you ought to make time to visit them. Otherwise, you're failing their sacrifices.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm truly buried in this project right now. Let me catch my breath first before making arrangements—I'm absolutely not neglecting my duties intentionally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work obligations don't excuse neglecting your fundamental familial duties! As their child, fulfilling your filial piety is mandatory. Making time to see your parents is your bounden obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, hearing this every time just piles on the pressure. It feels like filial duty has become a burden.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not forcing you, but you must understand the responsibility rests with you. Honoring your parents is non-negotiable—try harder to consider their feelings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhao Grandpa hasn't had anyone cooking for him these days. Do you think we could figure out a solution?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, can the community step in and help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've set up a schedule. If it works for you, could you pitch in on Wednesday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a client meeting on Wednesday. How about moving it to Thursday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! I'll tweak the schedule. Appreciate you making the trip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. I'll bring some dumplings along; the elderly love them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's really dependable! I'll take your shift next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, just ping me in the group chat if anything changes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, are you done with work? I was getting worried not hearing from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, just clocked out. This project's been crushing me - pulling all-nighters for a week straight. I'm completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you're swamped, but relationships demand consistent nurturing. When you committed to us, tending to each other's emotional needs became non-negotiable. You'll make time to visit me this weekend, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This weekend's honestly impossible... I've got reports piling up and deadlines breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work matters, sure - but is this remotely fair to us? Keep this up and our foundation crumbles. Real partners prioritize each other and honor basic commitments like showing up. I need you to truly weigh my feelings here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This guilt-tripping just piles on more pressure... Feels like I'm failing either way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not cornering you - it's because we cherish this that we must uphold our duties. Carving out half a day this weekend is the bare minimum expected of a committed partner. That's what'll ease my mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I hear you. I'll shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, how utterly shabby is your red envelope! 5000 yuan isn't even worth showing off; by tradition, it must be at least 8000!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really strapped for cash lately... 3000 is the best I can scrape together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that your idea of knowing the rules? You're the cheapest one in the whole family! Skimping on 8000 is a total insult to all of us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I honestly didn't mean any harm... maybe I can bump it up by 1000?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 1000? Are you handing out charity to beggars? If you don't pony up the full amount, forget about being family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll figure out how to cough up 8000.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you thought about the family when considering this out-of-town training?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This promotion opportunity won't come again if I miss it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a wife, you MUST prioritize the family above all else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is crucial for my career development.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A good partner MUST know how to sacrifice. Go decline it tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then all my hard work will go down the drain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You HAVE TO make some concessions for this family, don't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must give up this inheritance. Mom and Dad loved me most, so you should be considerate of me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: On what grounds? I'm their child too. Quit playing the hypocritical filial piety card!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! After all Mom and Dad did for you? Giving it up is the bare minimum you owe them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop your moral blackmail! You just want to hog everything yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Either surrender your claim or get out of this house. I refuse to acknowledge a brother like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Cutting ties it is! Like I give a damn about this family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me take care of my pet? I have a business trip tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm not free tomorrow, got my own things going on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you always unavailable? That's some questionable work ethic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not always unavailable, just tied up this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You pulled this last time too - totally unreliable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was an exceptional situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll handle it myself. You're utterly undependable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, who the hell organized this supply distribution? What a pain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly, it's a complete mess. What a bunch of losers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You going? I can't be bothered either way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Let whoever wants to go handle it. Not my problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a bullshit arrangement. So damn inefficient!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, whatever. Not our circus, not our monkeys.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time they pull this crap, I'm cussing them out on the spot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right, screw it. Let's just chill.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li Hua, I claimed that window seat earlier, why are you sitting there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? I sat down because it seemed vacant. You weren't here anyway—seemed wasteful to leave it empty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasteful? My stuff being there is claiming it! Do you not know library etiquette? How are we supposed to reserve spots if people just take seats like you did?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, no need to get worked up. I'll move. It's not that serious anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It is serious! If nobody follows the rules, how can the library function for everyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'm leaving. But claiming seats isn't right either—maybe don't do that next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, Lao Zhang. I've got something to ask for your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My relative's kid needs an internship. Can you refer them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
