turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your overpriced junk works like sugar water! Sharing that crap would be scamming people—I've got standards!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit you know anything! Post it or don't—whatever! Goddamn pointless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, won't post it! Handle your own mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Never contact me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you know the rule? You have to fork out 1000 for Lao Wang's wedding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's tight right now. Can I just give 500?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you that fucking broke? Can't even show basic respect? Do you even want to stay colleagues after this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely don't have that much cash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! You paid without blinking at that dinner party last time, now you're playing the fucking coward?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Guess I'll borrow some more then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're talking! Decent people always act with a conscience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My relative's kid needs an internship hookup, got any leads?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped right now, internships ain't easy to arrange!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal? Shouldn't be that complicated, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can toss out some advice, but don't count on me going above and beyond!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, least you could do is give a recommendation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, maybe later if I'm free. Gotta go!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and get that damn bank thing sorted for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rushing me to death? I've got my hands full here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dilly-dallying! By the time you finish this trivial task, it'll be too damn late!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got the skills? Do it yourself! All you know is bossing people around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Utterly useless! Can't even count on you for this tiny thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so capable? You do it then! Think I've got nothing better to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, don't go then! Must've been blind to rely on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone who wants it done can go! I'm out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remarrying is my decision, and I hope you'll come to accept it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It makes me uneasy honestly; I'll need some time to process.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get how you feel, but this is how I'm choosing to find happiness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is he actually trustworthy though? I have some concerns.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're welcome to meet him anytime to form your own opinion—no pressure to approve.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then let's take it gradual; please don't rush me into accepting this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, we'll talk whenever you feel ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, our sister's dowry needs support. As family, you ought to chip in - this is a moral duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's tight for me lately; might not help much. Household expenses are heavy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That won't do. As her blood sister, helping is non-negotiable. Otherwise folks'll say you're not family-oriented.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do my best, but truly can't cover it all. Let's see how others pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must pay up - this is family obligation. Stop dodging responsibilities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll scrape something together later. But don't always expect this from me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This new project is urgent. Can you lazy ass even handle it? Don't expect others to bail you out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Me again? What's the rush! I'm swamped here. Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless and full of excuses! The project's right there. Take it or leave it – the liability falls squarely on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit liability! Can't handle it so you dump it on me? Shouldn't partners be fair?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair? You think slacking off is worry-free? Decide whether you'll take it or not. Cut the crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw weighing options! You dump all the pressure on me while kicking back? I'll think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself. Do it or don't, just don't screw it up. The project responsibility? Handle it however you see fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, bottoms up! For old friends, it's about showing affection.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my stomach's upset today—mind if I take it easy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your body's fine, a sip won't kill you. With bonds this deep, we must drink it all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll sip it slow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Friendship demands it—this is the rule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, down it goes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, cheers! Our bond just got stronger.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, that's enough for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I need to talk about the scholarship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? What's up? I'm kinda busy right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole class thinks you should step aside and help those in greater need. That's your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why? I've put in so much effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on this opportunity. As class monitor, you must prioritize the collective good.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need this scholarship too. Don't act like I'm the only one supposed to sacrifice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to give it up, or people will hold it against you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I need to think. Let's end this for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, set me up with someone right now—it's your duty as a friend! Stop beating around the bush!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now. How am I supposed to find time for this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! What kind of friend are you? Zero sense of decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? I have my own life too, you know!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Get me someone by next week or I'm cutting you off—your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try. What a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. Remember your responsibility—don't keep me waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Panicking! My dog's got no one to look after him. Could you lend a hand these two days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I landed an urgent work assignment—afraid I won't be able to manage these next couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've known each other all these years! What if he wrecks the house chewing things?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Terrible timing—my boss is breathing down my neck. Skipping work means docked pay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you just do this one thing for my sake? I'll even drop off the dog food.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll swing by after 9 PM to feed him. Don't let the dog starve.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a pal! I'll bring you local treats when I'm back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What documents are needed for hardship allowance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you blind? It's posted on the wall! Figure it out yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are the requirements for the income certificate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you people stop pestering? Just bring your damn pay stub!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any rules for the stamping unit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With your IQ applying for aid? Take it or leave it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How many working days does it take?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the rush? Wait your turn! Can't you see I'm busy as hell?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, we really can't get the shop running without your help – you're the most capable one in the family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, my project's at a critical stage right now – I'm worried I might mess things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't come, we'll be seriously understaffed. Mom and Dad talk about you every day, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... if even Mom and Dad are saying that... I'll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! The whole family's counting on you to come through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll see if I can shuffle my schedule around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, how about working for another couple of years? These young folks are damn useless – none can handle pressure like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I really can't. My health is failing – I was hospitalized just last week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always some damn excuse! Give me a straight answer: either commit to staying or get the hell out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My grandson needs care at home, and my wife can't manage alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every family has their troubles! Suit yourself – but know this: quit early and you forfeit all bonuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is there... really no room for negotiation? I brought my medical records.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop waving those records around! Sign the extension if you can work, or pack up and leave immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... I'll need more time to consider.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, is your kitchen free? Hand over the keys now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I was just about to start cooking...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Elders need the kitchen - you won't starve waiting! Where's your damn filial respect?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You could've at least given some notice...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Can't even do this little thing? Ungrateful wretch! Keys!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. Here you go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Should've done this earlier! Don't complain if it gets messy - that's what you get for being my niece!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come back on moving day. Your mom and dad are counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't make it. The company's been really strict about attendance lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're not here, we can't move all this piled-up stuff. Your dad's back is acting up again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any chance we could reschedule for Sunday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The date's already fixed. All the relatives are coming to help on Sunday. How come they can manage it, but our own child can't?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll figure out how to take time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Family ought to support each other, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, there's something you absolutely must help me with! My friend's friend is in an emergency, you've gotta agree to co-sign.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? A total stranger? The risk is way too high—I don't want that liability. Stop pressuring me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dodging! This is what friends owe each other. Refusing to help means you've got no loyalty—you think that's acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The issue is I genuinely don't know him. Who takes the fallout? You're putting me in an impossible position.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The burden falls on you—period. That's the duty of friendship. You can't weasel out of this! Or do you want to ruin our bond?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The stakes are too dangerous—I simply can't comply. Quit forcing me against my will.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. But this shows how little you value loyalty. Prioritizing responsibility is what decent people do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I noticed you left a negative review. It's really tough for a small shop just starting out, man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You took three whole days to ship it, you realize that made me miss my event, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couriers are swamped with packages lately. Maybe we could send you a little gift to make it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Skip the gift. What really matters is you guys need to step up your game.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We know you're a regular customer. How about we waive shipping on your next order?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm keeping the review as is for now. We'll see how you improve.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate your understanding! We'll fix things immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just be more careful next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cover for me at the afternoon meeting, will you? With our friendship, how could I not ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with this report. Can't you go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I covered your shift for that concert without a word of complaint? And now you won't do this small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must you always bring up the past? I genuinely can't leave right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're gonna keep score like this, don't expect me to lift a finger for you next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! What a pain. I'll just sign in for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like a true friend! Text me the second you're done signing in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me put together a simple webpage? Won't take much of your time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling insane overtime lately, just no bandwidth for side projects.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I edited your resume till 3am last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this weekend? Swamped for the next couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This tiny task needs dragging on? Thought we were true friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright alright. I'll squeeze it in tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call being a mate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, this is taking too long! Why aren't my test results ready yet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies, the procedure requires time. We're handling it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Processing my ass! I've waited for ages—are you doing this deliberately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No deliberate delay, we're truly swamped. Please try to understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's there to understand? My time is valuable—hurry up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll follow up with the lab, but please remain calm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could I possibly stay calm? You're dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, we'll update you once there's news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you absolutely must come to the old colleagues' gathering next month. Everyone misses you so much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The round trip is such a hassle – commuting from Beijing to Shanghai is really exhausting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Wang's flying all the way from Shenzhen! Everyone's so eager to see you. Could you really bear to disappoint them all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project's at a critical stage right now. Taking leave would be genuinely difficult.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You already missed Xiao Li's wedding last time – everyone kept asking about you. It'd be such a downer if you skipped this one too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The distance is a real dealbreaker here. I need to properly think this through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With old colleagues, each reunion could be our last. Everyone's counting on you coming – how awful would the group photo look without you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the tech department's buried under a mountain of work—everyone's pulling all-nighters. Mind pitching in ASAP?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm a total amateur in tech stuff. Won't I just create more mess? Maybe send someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The team's already stretched thin. If you don't help, everyone's pressure will skyrocket. Show some understanding, won't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But wouldn't my involvement just mean slow progress and mistakes? That doesn't seem right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang dove in last time despite being unqualified, and nobody complained. Teammates should back each other up—surely you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is forcing this really viable? How about I handle logistics support instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, this arrangement benefits you too. Picking up new skills never hurts—you'll thank yourself later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline for the competition class is approaching, you've got to sign up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too much pressure, I want to wait a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all your parents have sacrificed for this opportunity, any decent child would know better than to hesitate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I genuinely can't keep up with the pace... signing up would just be a waste of time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're only thinking about your future – our entire family is pinning all our hopes on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll sign up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Spots are limited, get this sorted now – don't drag your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, mind sharing last project's notes? I'm a bit stuck on this task.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm still working on it myself—haven't even finished mine yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But back when I helped tweak your proposal, didn't things move pretty quick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... maybe Friday? I'm rushing to finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal. We help each other out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll pass them along once I wrap up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We need to talk about our marital duties. It's not right for you to keep dragging this out, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must everything be your way? You're just being unreasonably stubborn.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couples have obligations to fulfill. What exactly are you trying to achieve by constantly avoiding yours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moral blackmail again? Your manipulative tactics are utterly exhausting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fixing this relationship by following my lead is your fundamental duty. Anything less makes you downright selfish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can anyone tolerate being cornered like this? I'm done with this argument.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make your choice now: either step up as a responsible partner or admit you're abandoning your duties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, those credit card points of yours should be used to get me a headset, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What for? I need them myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! I helped you with the delivery last time, so you owe me. Have you got no conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fck off! That was barely a two-minute walk! God, you're such a shameless motherfcker!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! People living together should help each other out. If you don't do this today, you're just a terrible person!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell do you think you are? My points, my rules!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't ever ask me for favors again, you selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Go bother someone else then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you're going on a business trip to Shanghai next week, right? Grab me that limited-edition bag while you're there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed tight—zero time for shopping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ha! After all these years of friendship, you won't even do this? You're so goddamn selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck is wrong with you? I owe you nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone with decency cares about friendship ties. But you? Only your petty crap matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck me! Think I'm your personal shopper? Buy your own shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Skip my birthday then. Clearly you don't give a damn about friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck me sideways for knowing a piece of work like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, want to learn how to make some extra cash with micro-business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Micro-business? Does it require upfront fees? I'm concerned about pyramid schemes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Depends on your goals. I've made decent side income these months, and building a team is another option.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Building a team sounds pyramid-schemey though? Isn't that too risky?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll keep it legal - I'm just earning pocket money here, no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll think it over and reach out if interested.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, just call me when you decide.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you come back for Dragon Boat Festival?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with a project deadline, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not coming back again? Do you even care about this family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mailed Wufangzhai gift boxes, enjoy them first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Eat shit! We don't need your damn mouth here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I take compensatory leave in July?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop the hypocrisy! Go cry at your parents' graves!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family is waiting for you. It feels strangely empty without you here, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't get away from the school parent-child event. I've already promised my child I'd go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elders have been talking about you for days. Could you ask the teacher to reschedule? After all, we only have this family gathering once a year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It wouldn't be proper to change arrangements last minute. Besides, the child won't be happy about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle even asked specifically if work kept you too busy. I told him you've always been the most family-oriented person.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll spend extra time with them at the old house in a couple of days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, what's been going on lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Same old. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been coughing badly lately, always talking about you. You should be more attentive as her son.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm at a critical stage with the project, really can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She won't even make your favorite braised pork anymore, says without you it's no fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got this month's mortgage hanging over me, pulling late nights every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about coming over Sunday? Seeing you would do Mom more good than medicine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to work something out, see if I can rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, finish this damn report for me, you hear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, are you missing hands? Do your own work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, newbies these days are impossible to boss around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All you old foxes do is bully newcomers. Got any shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You got the balls to say that again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only losers constantly make others clean up their mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just you wait and see who'll last longer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, can you help me out real quick? I'm in a real bind here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's got you so worked up? Spill it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents are in the hospital and I'm short on cash. Isn't it our duty as children to be filial? Friends shouldn't just stand by when someone's drowning, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh man, that's rough. But I'm strapped too – my business has hit rock bottom.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I always thought true friends lend a hand when it counts. Otherwise, I'm completely out of options here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, that really piles on the pressure. I genuinely want to help, but I'm tapped out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, I'll ask someone else then. Let's hope I can find a kind-hearted soul somewhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, you have to drink this glass, no excuses; everyone's been holding their glasses up for ages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, please understand, I just had a gastroscopy and am still on medication.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who bailed you out when the project crashed last time? Can't you even honor this bit of loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get your kindness, but I truly can't drink today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new guy Wang already downed his; how can you, an old hand, make me look bad?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... what about just half a glass?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Chen just had surgery and he finished his; who are you tricking with half? Only a full glass proves real sincerity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, just this one glass.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, get me two concert tickets for next week – this must be done right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's tight lately, maybe next month?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasn't it me who stayed up all night when your mother was sick? And now you won't even help with this? What an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I demand VIP tickets! If you can't even grant your elder this one wish, how can you call yourself family? What a disgrace!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, whatever you say...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, what you up to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely can't miss our cousin's wedding next week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doubt I can make it, swamped with work. Hard to get time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so heartless! The whole family's going - you think you're special? Don't you care about face?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Why the hell should I be obligated? Stop trying to guilt-trip me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't give me that damn excuse! Skipping this means you've forgotten your roots. All relatives will despise you - believe me, they'll curse you out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! My damn luck - I'll go! So annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Wang, could you do me a favor and take in my package? Nobody's home these couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm actually away myself these days—not sure I can help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll figure something else out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would it be alright to leave it at the pickup station? It's really not convenient for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks for the tip Bro Wang! I'll update the address now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this—next time give me a heads-up earlier, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, why haven't you posted anything on Moments lately? Don't tell me you're looking down on us old friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No no, I just haven't been in a position to post recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My bubble tea shop just opened and I saved a free voucher especially for you! Remember how you always loved this flavor at my place? It'd be such a letdown if you didn't show!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really not appropriate for me to post about these things on Moments right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone praised your loyalty at last week's reunion! When I'm struggling most with my startup, it'd be downright unreasonable not to help out - especially with the photos I've prepared for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With our friendship, imagine what the others would think if you couldn't even post once? I know how much you value loyalty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I gambled again and got into debt... can you help me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you betray our years of sacrifice by doing this? Didn't you learn anything when we paid off your debts last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly regret it, won't you please just help me this once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, we'll help you, but you must quit gambling and get a decent job—that's your duty as our child!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise you, I'll turn my life around...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Empty words won't cut it. You'll hand over your salary card to us from now on—this is for the family's sake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lend me your car tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I? Take a cab yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Won't even help with this—what good are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dumbass! Buy your own car if you can!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a joke—how does the company keep trash like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Not worth my time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Puh! Damned unlucky to have a coworker like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Darling, you must promise not to tell anyone about our family's genetic hypertension history—this is your obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why though? I don't see the harm in telling friends; seems pretty normal to me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This concerns family ethics. You must consider the long-term consequences—concealment is our moral duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but you're being overly strict. Personal privacy isn't that big a deal, I suppose?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is a moral bottom line. You should agree, unless you want to embarrass us all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, since you insist so strongly, I promise not to mention it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. That's the moral choice—the right thing for us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to swap exam times with me next Wednesday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must it be swapped? I've got other commitments too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have a crucial job interview—as a classmate you should show some consideration, isn't that basic solidarity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need to study that day too—rescheduling would throw off my whole plan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Collective needs trump personal ones—you ought to prioritize the greater good. It's decided.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How is that fair? I need prep time too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making a fuss—helping classmates is your obligation. See you next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Wang, aren't you heading to the station for tickets? Grab one for me while you're at it. Such a small favor—you should help out, right? This is how neighbors should support each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I really can't queue these days! I'm swamped and running around like crazy myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this you shirking your responsibilities? It's time to do your part! As a decent neighbor, you should queue for tickets—don't you think we'll grow distant otherwise?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, enough already! Fine, fine, I'll go! You just love bossing people around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go early then, no dilly-dallying! Why drag out such a little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll get it for you. Honestly, listening to you is utterly draining.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you do me a favor and place some fake orders for my shop? Way too many bad reviews lately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Fake orders seem shady though... Could get the shop banned if caught...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting all holier-than-thou! Who bailed you out when your project crashed? Can't even return a tiny favor? Utterly heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's completely different! Fake orders are illegal – don't you know that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the sanctimonious act! Need my help later? Forget it, you ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... just this once. God, you're impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed from the start! Making me feel like I owe you or something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kitchen needs cleaning; it's gotten a bit messy lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I've been busy this week, might not have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, we could take turns or clean it together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds like a plan. Let's do it together this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, it's settled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, can you give me a hand with this guarantee for taking leave from work? You see, other families are always willing to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, this guarantee comes with risks; I can't agree to it lightly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lately, work has been exhausting, and taking leave isn't easy. Could you consider it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time, the guarantee really put me through the wringer; you should understand that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it only right for relatives to help each other out? Don't you try to shirk it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't do it this time; why don't you ask Third Aunt?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright, alright, I'll figure it out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll go pick up the kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we neighbors step in about Miss Li still being unmarried in her thirties? If she drags this out any longer, she'll be left on the shelf!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've just been swamped with work lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her mother was crying in the hallway yesterday, saying her daughter will die alone. We've been neighbors for over a decade—can we really just stand by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But these things really can't be rushed...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must set her up with my nephew over May Day! He's such a catch—she can't afford to miss this boat. As her elder, you've got to take responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! The whole neighborhood is watching—if you don't intervene, you'd be doing her a disservice!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you have an employee discount? Mind helping me buy an appliance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry Uncle, company policy doesn't allow sharing discounts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, just feels like a bit of a shame though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I check official promotions for you? Discounts should be similar.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, but your company's rules seem pretty rigid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It is troublesome indeed. Maybe I could offer you a voucher to use instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, but I'll figure something out on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could everyone please vote for my child? I've shared the link in the group—must remember to cast all 10 votes daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These voting campaigns are everywhere lately, honestly don't have the energy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As group members we ought to support each other. How could that be justified if you don't help? Last time your family needed something, I was first to respond.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just... needing to vote repeatedly every day feels rather troublesome.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our child's future depends on everyone's support. If you don't vote, our entire family will be heartbroken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze in some votes when possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for cooperating! Don't forget to vote daily—I'll be monitoring the backend tally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you heading out? Could you grab my package while you're at it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not sure yet, it feels a bit chilly out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back during finals when you needed my notes, I handed them over without a second thought. And now you won't even do this little thing for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. What's the tracking number? It must be urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! That's what friends are for! You're heading downstairs anyway, right? I'll wait by the elevator.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... you're making it impossible to say no.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See? That's how it should be—we're all close here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... just give me the tracking number already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you still using the kitchen? I've been waiting forever—mind stepping aside?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Almost done, just five more minutes okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh Others are waiting to cook—please wrap it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine fine, I'm finishing up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would've been easier if you'd done this sooner—for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All yours now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't hog shared spaces this long—be considerate of others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about drafting an anonymous letter to show our stance? Everyone's waiting to see where we stand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why drag me into this? Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After Lao Wang did this last time, everyone saw him as decent. Don't you want people to view you the same way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But what if we get exposed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least it's taking a stand—better than doing nothing, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over for a couple days? What's the rush?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Writing sooner puts everyone at ease sooner. What's the point of dragging it out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll write it with you. What a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis! I custom-blended this wellness tea just for night owls like you—works like a charm! Wanna help your sis out and share it on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh sis, my feed's drowning in ads lately. Posting more might make me lose followers...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you ignore family business? I'm drowning in work daily, and you won't even lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... is this tea actually good?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that supposed to mean? Would your own sis trick you? Even Mom praised your thoughtfulness—surely you'll help with this tiny favor? Post it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine. I'll post it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Put some heart into it—my reputation's banking on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sleeping again? Can't even chat with me? Lazy pig!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who's lazy? I'm dead tired!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish! Only care about your own sleep!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll stay up. Whatever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Go sleep then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chat then, stop your yapping!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind, I'm over it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on everyone, vote for Xiao Ming's artwork! Link's in the group chat—it's just a tap away!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dead tired lately, pulling all-nighters every night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when we didn't hesitate to help Lily's daughter last time? The kid's been refreshing that vote count nonstop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might forget with this multi-day voting marathon, especially when work piles up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't let our class group lose to the other class, right? The kid's counting on us uncles and aunties!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a bunch! With everyone's votes, that trophy's in the bag—can't let the kid down now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li! The supermarket sale starts in three minutes! Get over there and save me a spot right now! I'm completely stuck here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got to submit this proposal today—my boss is literally watching from his office.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year when your mom was hospitalized, I worked three straight night shifts to cover for you! And now you won't even queue for half an hour? Some friend you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely not making excuses—if I lose this job, my livelihood's on the line...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How utterly shameless! Remember what I've done for you? Is this your attitude when I finally need a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh... Fine, fine. I'll squeeze in time to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Staring at your phone too long will strain your eyes, why not give them a break? Your dad’s working late again tonight, past ten.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm just watching ten minutes of Douyin to unwind a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know you're tired, but you've got to keep up with your homework too. Your dad’s working so hard with all that overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, getting watched like this every day while studying is so dull.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you want to relax, but putting in the effort now means you won't regret it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. I'll dive into some problems for a while then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, have you been busy lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad, a bit busy. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're planning a cross-district gathering. Could you come and help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, my schedule's packed right now. Probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll check with others then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, hope it goes well for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, let's keep in touch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, see you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, are you asleep?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place just lost power and I'm freezing. Can I crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Terrible timing - my sister's whole family is camped out on the floor here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you forgotten who took you in during your overtime crisis last time? Now that I'm in trouble, you're suddenly a stranger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even the balcony's occupied - truly no room to spare.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. So our friendship isn't even worth a sofa corner to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's talk later. Hanging up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, my new store's opening soon, and with your killer design skills, you've got to help me brainstorm a poster concept!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm swamped lately – got a mountain of work piled up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even lend a hand for such a small favor? Does our decade-long friendship count for nothing? That's really not cool!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, my plate's just too packed to free up time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you moved? I ran around helping you the whole damn day. Now I ask for this tiny thing and you keep making excuses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still remember that, but my current workload's too tight, genuinely can't break away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this poster doesn't work out, my opening's doomed. You'd just stand by watching me fall? What kind of friend is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll squeeze out the time and help you get it done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you're running late. The kiddo has been waiting for a while.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, got tied up with something urgent. On my way to pick him up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, but he's getting a bit anxious. Do try to keep track of time next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks for helping out. I'll definitely remember.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's okay, just worried you might be delayed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll set an alarm next time. Won't drag my feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, you can take him home now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you chat with me late into the night? I'd like to spend more time with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, but I'll tell you when I get sleepy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, stop whenever you're tired. Don't force yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'm not sleepy yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What should we talk about?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anything's fine. What do you want to discuss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then let's keep the conversation light.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, my mom's got nobody to watch her next week, you absolutely have to come help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got a business trip scheduled, how's that supposed to work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your damn conscience? Who helped when your dad was sick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this some kind of moral blackmail? Just state your case properly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful snake! Can't even do this basic duty—are you even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the real piece of work! Bullying me just because we're old classmates?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're coming! No show means we're done—figure it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Never met anyone so shameless in my life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, you there? Got something to talk about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin's wedding is coming up soon. Consider coming if you can?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need to check my schedule. Might be tied up that day, not sure yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family bonds matter. You'd bring joy by coming, but no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah I know. Let me figure out my plans, will try to arrange it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just let me know once decided. Won't push you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks for understanding. Catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, ask your relative for a discount—isn't your dad at the Apple store?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Employee discounts only, can't help for real.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You're so damn stingy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say whatever, rules aren't mine to make.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even leverage such a basic connection!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ask someone else then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm working overtime till I cough up blood every day, isn't it your sacred duty to handle the kids?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think I'm living it up? Are they solely my responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm the one putting food on the table for this family. Is it too much to ask for you to shoulder more housework?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next week you must take the kid to cram school – I can't take it much longer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even know how hard it is to earn money? The kid's old enough to be more considerate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll handle it. But remember, you owe the kid for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, mind sharing your account? This show's blowing up and I gotta watch it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm actually in the middle of it right now, not really convenient...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Not cool! We're supposed to be tight! Would it kill you to share?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it's linked to my phone number. If it leaks, it could be a real hassle...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! If you won't even do this small thing, do you even consider me a brother? You're not being a bro!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, alright. Just don't go messing with my stuff, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just opened a bubble tea shop. Would you mind sharing it on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's been quite a few ads lately, so it might not be the best time if you don't mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, it's entirely up to you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I recommend it privately to colleagues instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be amazing! Absolutely no pressure to post on Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shared it in three group chats! Best of luck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! I'll treat you to our new drinks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds great! I'll come check it out soon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have your kids received their piano exam results? Mine did exceptionally well!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet. My child keeps saying they're too exhausted to practice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That won't do! After all this time learning, it'd be such a shame to give up now. Shouldn't you parents step in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But schoolwork is overwhelming—there's genuinely no time for practice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other children are pushing forward—if you don't persevere, they'll get left behind! You should at least ensure an hour of daily practice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to work it out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! If you don't put in the effort now, your child would regret it later—and blame you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the project deadline looming, shouldn't we all step up our efforts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped this week - my kid's school event requires my presence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps you could put in some extra hours at night? That's how we handled it when Xiao Li took leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last overtime shift left me bedridden with fever for days - my health simply can't endure it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you push through just this once? We'll arrange compensatory leave after this crunch period.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already got five unused comp days piled up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Project delays would inconvenience everyone, and you're our most seasoned expert.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... see what I can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, my mom talks about you every day. How can you possibly not go keep her company?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project is too demanding right now, I genuinely can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your dad was hospitalized last time, I dropped everything to accompany him without hesitation. And now you're just making excuses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know I owe you, but work commitments really prevent me from leaving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all her kindness to you? She'll be heartbroken if you treat her this way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, now you've made me feel terribly guilty about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then stop making excuses. You must visit this weekend - she's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll try to rearrange my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next month the Zhang family is holding a wedding banquet; are you free to attend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I probably can't make it; I'm quite busy that day with things piling up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I understand. Between relatives, we should keep things casual.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for your understanding. I'll send a gift later to express my appreciation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, then go ahead with your work. You can share updates in the group chat later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll remember. I'll arrange for someone to deliver the gift.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I won't insist. You're certain you can't come, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I really can't make it. Wish them a joyful time, bye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Ming, Grandma's medical bills absolutely must be paid today—you have to go wire the money at the bank now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Client's coming for project inspection this morning, I'm completely tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you let Grandma suffer through sleepless nights in agony? What would the neighbors think if they found out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lunch break's only an hour—bank lines make it impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All these years I've wasted doting on you! Lao Li's grandson took leave yesterday for his grandpa's treatment—now that's real filial piety!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I hire an errand runner to get a queue number? I'll sneak out when it's our turn.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Without that money, are you expecting Grandma to live on thin air? What job could possibly outweigh your filial duty?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine—I'll get approval from my boss right now and head over immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you grab that class spot for me real quick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit bugging me, I'm swamped and have no time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you, friends are supposed to help out, got it? How selfish can you be!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell are you pressuring me? It's so fucking annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough talk, you must decide today—take it or we're done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll do it, but it's absolutely sickening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I borrow your video streaming account?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really comfortable with that—it's linked to my bank card.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll just use the public account then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I help you access the web version? (Not keen on sharing my password)

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, that works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want me to set that up for you now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, did you know Old Lady Zhang's been coughing something awful lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I noticed. Why isn't her daughter looking after her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's swamped with work! You youngsters should step up and care for her - don't you understand filial duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tied up with this project, genuinely can't spare time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing the busy bee! Did dogs eat your conscience? Won't even help neighbors after all these years!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you be reasonable? I've got mouths to feed too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You heartless wretch! Deliver that meal today or the whole neighborhood will shame you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine, I'll go, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you thought through how it'll affect the family, going so far away for this study opportunity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've made some preparations, but things might not be fully settled yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child is so young and in desperate need of their father right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this training opportunity won't come around again if I miss it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Juggling work and childcare alone, I'm at my breaking point.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if... I ask my mom to come help out for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take a look at Xiao Zhang. He even turned down business trips just to be with his child.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Would it be okay if I just went for fewer days then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I need someone to guarantee my work leave, could you help me out? You see how enthusiastic other people's relatives are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm worried I can't handle this guarantee thing—the risks are huge.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's crushing me, and my own family won't lift a finger—isn't that just wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time was a disaster; can't you think about my situation for once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's our duty as relatives to support each other, but you keep dodging—I'm almost ashamed to ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't do it; why not try Uncle Si instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget I said anything; I'll just deal with it myself from now on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, you get on with your stuff; I'm off to buy groceries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, I forgot my keys. Can I crash on your couch tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... my mother-in-law is staying with us. We've turned the living room into her temporary bedroom.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I understand. It's just that locksmiths are hard to find this late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, and she's a light sleeper. Wakes up if there's any noise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I sleep on the balcony? I promise I'll be quiet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll get you a sleeping bag—but you need to be out by 5 AM.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, you really saved me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, the paper's almost done. Could you hurry up and review it? I'm getting jittery about this final step.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm drowning in reports – absolutely swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you won't help, who's gonna take the fall when this paper blows up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit shoving this onto me. Own your damn work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Year-end evaluations are coming. If you drop the ball here, the fallout won't be pretty, will it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Primary responsibility's yours – quit trying to saddle me with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll just take this to the associate dean then. Can't afford delays.
