turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, probably can't manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help your own blood? How disgustingly selfish can you be!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously not refusing, my phone's completely frozen.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relatives are supposed to have each other's backs - your ice-cold attitude is inhuman!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll squeeze it in sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Post. This. Instant! Or consider our family ties severed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Honestly, you're unbelievable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, I've been talking with some buddies about starting an arcade. Young folks are really into gaming these days—seems like a solid moneymaker.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: An arcade? That's a risky business. Take time to think through the market carefully; don't be rash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just want to take this shot before I turn 30. Feels like my last chance to really go for something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're serious about this, do your homework first. See how others run similar setups—don't jump in headfirst.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This dead-end job's killing me. Feels like I'm just going through the motions every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We didn't have many options back in my day either. But you've got to take responsibility—don't chase get-rich-quick dreams.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I draft a proposal for you to review? Could you help me vet it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but stay grounded. We don't expect you to strike it rich—just don't take big risks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm moving next Saturday, you must come and help! If a roommate doesn't help, are they even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got plans that day, why can't you just hire a moving company yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think moving companies are free? You're so selfish! I helped you when you moved last time—don't you know how to return a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you be reasonable? I don't owe you a damn thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If an ungrateful wretch like you skips out on helping, we're done for good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Who exactly are you trying to guilt-trip here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting all high and mighty! Can your conscience handle skipping out? No decent person would stoop this low!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine—I'll chalk it up to bad luck! After I help you move, we part ways for good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ought to come back and help with the move—it's your duty as a child, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's pretty tight; it might not work for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a child, you're supposed to put family first; helping your parents is non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, but could we pick another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely not—this family obligation demands our joint effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll see if I can shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't forget this falls squarely on your shoulders; I'm counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll do what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about we write an anonymous letter to show our stance? Everyone's waiting to see where we stand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with always pushing these things on me? Can't you write it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weren't you the one praising Lao Wang when he wrote last time? What's got you so unwilling now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll write one then. But what if someone recognizes my handwriting? That'd be awkward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, it's just stating our position. Folks just need to know where we stand—no need to overthink it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the rush? Can't I take a couple days to mull it over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really rushing you—just thinking it's better to get it over with sooner than later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. I'll write the damn thing. For heaven's sake.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, you must block Xiao Wang's Moments. He constantly posts inappropriate content—failing to restrict his access shows utter irresponsibility toward our family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must it be blocking? I think limited visibility groups would suffice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Group settings are unreliable! Only blocking guarantees security. This protects our privacy—you have to do this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But isn't arbitrarily blocking people rather inappropriate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How is it inappropriate? Family security comes first! As my partner, you're obligated to prioritize this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you're right. I'll adjust the settings now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, notify me once it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, already blocked him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, my landlord suddenly changed the locks and I can't get in. Mind if I crash on your couch tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do tonight, man. My wife's got a bad flu - worried about passing it on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been tight since we were in diapers! Won't even do this little thing for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thing is, she just took meds and conked out. Opening the door would make a racket.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember crashing on my couch for half a month when you got laid off? Now you're being distant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... There's a storage room by the bathroom. Keep it down when you come in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what I'm talking about! Real friends step up when the going gets tough!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, my wife needs emergency surgery next week and I'll be at the hospital—could you cover my workload for a few days? Don't say no now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next week? My project's nearing deadline—I'm swamped with overtime as it is. Can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year when your mom was hospitalized, I covered for you without hesitation. And now you're giving me excuses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I appreciate that, but the workload's crushing. Forcing it might cause mistakes that'd backfire on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all our years as friends, helping out is basic decency, no? You're really being unreasonable here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine. Send me the specifics and I'll squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! I owe you big time—anything you need later, just say the word!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to come to the party tomorrow night! It won't be the same without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are crazy busy right now, genuinely can't make it. You guys have fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But last time you were busy too, and you still managed to make it, didn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't swing it this time, the boss is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A true friend should show up for his buddies, man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut it out, I'm swamped and up to my neck here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Guess all my effort was wasted then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rain check? I'll make it up to you. Seriously swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would it be possible for you to give up the training spot? I really need this learning opportunity this year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I've prepared extensively for this, and it's quite important to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Maybe I'll try applying for other programs then? I heard there's another chance next quarter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly, why not focus on next quarter's opportunity? I'd be happy to refer you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really? That's wonderful! But would you mind sharing your application materials with me this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll email them to you later. Helping each other is what we should do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll take you out for dinner sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, could I use your employee discount to buy a bag?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company monitors this closely, might not be too convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, no worries then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're really in a rush, maybe I could buy it under my name?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No no, wouldn't want to trouble you for that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about waiting for the weekend sale? Discount's almost the same.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great idea! Thanks~

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it, just ask if you need suggestions!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The paper needs revisions in a few sections. Could you handle it when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, I've been swamped with experiments recently. Would submitting it next week be possible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, but prioritize adjusting the logical structure for this part.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This part is indeed challenging; I need to mull it over more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can manage your own schedule. Feel free to reach out if you run into any issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll revise it as soon as possible and send it over to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, just ensure it's completed by next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, if it's convenient, could you help me look after the shop for about two hours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll try to get back as soon as I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must stay longer until dark—after all, it's only natural for relatives to help each other, so you can't just refuse.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why do I have to extend? I was planning to leave early; this doesn't seem right at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, family doesn't keep score; doing this favor is your filial responsibility, or people will call you ungrateful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I really have commitments; isn't it out of line for you to always force demands like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself, but for family's sake, you ought to know the proper thing to do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it some thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, could you front the meal expenses from our last business trip? I've got all the receipts ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've covered too many costs this month already – things are really tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Times are tough lately. You're the most stand-up guy, could you help me out this once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last reimbursement took ages, I'm kinda hesitant now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I won't drag my feet this time! With our friendship, how could you just stand by without helping?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll cover it. Just don't be late with repayment this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real friend! I'll make it up to you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, send me the transfer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, my leg's killing me! You must take me to the hospital for a check-up tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got that meeting tomorrow, and the boss is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the damn meeting more important than your aunt's life? You ungrateful wretch! All that love I wasted on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll go! Had enough of this emotional blackmail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blackmail?! Isn't this what family's supposed to do—look out for each other? You heartless thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll pick you up downstairs at 8 tomorrow morning. Just don't start ranting and raving if I'm late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. At least you've got a shred of decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to come with me to my bestie's birthday bash tomorrow night—no excuses allowed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That lame party sounds torture—I'd be totally left out while you all gab about makeup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How utterly selfish can you be? Refusing to even fulfill basic partner duties?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the moral blackmail! Party attendance ≠ love—stop equating them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't even grant me this dignity? Proves you disregard my feelings! Non-negotiable—you're going!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That tired guilt trip again? When do MY preferences get considered?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! 7 PM sharp tomorrow or we're THROUGH!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're completely unhinged! Screw it—do whatever the hell you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? Do me a favor—promote that collagen oral solution I'm selling on your Moments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... I've been posting too many ads lately, worried friends might block me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blocked? Who cares! Real friends should support each other! Can't even help with this tiny favor? How stingy can you be?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That oral solution you're selling... seems totally useless. Scamming people? Feels wrong to post shady ads like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! How dare you? Never even tried it and you're talking shit! Friends back each other NO MATTER WHAT! Post it now—yes or no?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Should've agreed sooner! Hurry up and post—send me the screenshot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm so stressed I'm about to break down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You piece of trash can't even handle small stuff?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is genuinely beyond me this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couldn't care less, not my damn problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really aren't going to help me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help you? Look in the mirror first—see if you're even worth it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle Zhang, I'm being transferred for work and moving out next month. Could we discuss refunding the deposit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: According to the contract, deposits aren't refunded for early termination. Have you found a subtenant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet. Could you possibly make an exception? I have rented for three years without ever missing a payment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your situation, but I'll face vacancy losses. Tell you what - if you find a new tenant, I'll return the full deposit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I can't find anyone within two weeks? Could we do a partial refund?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't a one-month vacancy period reasonable? Beyond that, I'll deduct monthly rent from the deposit until it's exhausted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal, I'll find a replacement ASAP. Thanks for giving me this chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been over half a year since that thing between us. Don't keep it bottled up inside—let's chat about it, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'm still a bit hung up on that. It's tough to shake off right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're not comfortable, we can take it slow. I'll wait for you to be ready—no rush.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, I want to move on too, but it's still weighing on me. Let me sit with it for a few more days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Li and his partner—they had a tiff and patched things up fast. Now they're living easy—could be us too.
