turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I did warn you to back up important files last time! I'm up against a client proposal deadline here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You wouldn't just watch me go down in flames, would you? You're the only one in the team who knows hardware. If you can't help, I'll be packing my bags for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch... My situation's hot on my heels—the boss has already pestered me three times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as classmates, you gotta pull me out of this mess when it counts, right? Gotta have some loyalty, man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... Get the hard drive out first. I'll plug it into the backup rig to see what's salvageable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to be there for the shoot, no negotiations!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that, I've got client meetings that day – impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A real brother would step up, your attitude is downright heartbreaking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit, you make it sound like I'm ditching on purpose?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True friends don't make excuses – figure it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck me then, I'll cancel the client! Textbook guilt-tripping!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's loyalty! You're on standby all day, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goddammit... fine! So fucking annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, are you still keeping that guy who liked your WeChat Moments post? My friends say it can be easily misunderstood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, it's just a like from a friend, what's the big deal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how clean Xiao Li's Moments are, everyone says she's so reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: WeChat Moments is just for fun, why make such a fuss about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her boyfriend proactively deleted it, I think security is quite important.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll deal with it, are you happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it, I knew you were the most reasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Done, stop overthinking it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's only natural for a wife to move in after marriage—that's her fundamental obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We feel it's more appropriate to live separately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial piety is a universal principle! How heartless of you to make such a choice—don't you care how much this pains your elders?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll visit you regularly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every other daughter-in-law follows this tradition—are you some special snowflake? Step up and take responsibility like you're supposed to!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please respect our decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't up for debate. Tradition is sacrosanct—the entire family is counting on you to fulfill your filial duties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, could you do me a solid? My credit card bill's due and I'm really in a bind. Just five hundred would get me through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My wife keeps a tight leash on the finances. My allowance was wiped out last week already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, you're still the only decent one around. Everyone else bolts the second they hear 'borrow money'.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that... Maybe next week? When I get paid on the 15th?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you got laid off? I brought you lunch every single day. Never thought twice back then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Think I might have about two hundred left in WeChat. I'll send it over for now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help! I'm desperate to sublet my apartment—could you post it in the main group chat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project's swamping me... got hundreds of unreads already...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh I'm so stressed I'm losing hair... all our buddies pitched in already, you're my last hope! With our friendship and all...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Putting me on the spot like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please! You're literally my only option here—you're the most loyal one I know!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. You got me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, I have to move out early at the end of this month. Refund my deposit in full.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract's black and white: no deposit returns for early termination. You're being completely unreasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! We're decent people here – how can you call yourself human withholding deposits? Don't you know basic empathy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How am I inconsiderate? Can't you read a contract? Integrity matters, you get that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlords like you deserve public shaming! Refund today or I'll protest daily – let's see who cracks first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reason triumphs over nonsense! The contract says no refund – sue me if you disagree!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you win! Profiting through guilt will backfire eventually – mark my words!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should finish these problems right now! How can you face your parents after wasting their money?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely drained. Can't I just do them tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real scholars endure hardships! Who deserves this pathetic attitude of yours? Get back to work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I genuinely can't solve them...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Flunk and your whole family loses face, understand? Finish them NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, quick, lend me your membership! Things are selling out fast!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my personal info's in the account—worried about leaks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you worked overtime, I pulled an all-nighter to help you, remember?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember, but accounts carry risks. Try to understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we help each other out as neighbors and colleagues? No need to keep score, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, fine then. Just stop bringing up past favors all the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! This is how neighbors/colleagues should look out for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've been waiting almost an hour—why isn't it my turn yet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry about that, it's unusually crowded today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My back's killing me—could you possibly speed things up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't worry ma'am, I'll check on the progress for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Waiting's pure agony for seniors—though I know your job's tough too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely, I'm looking into it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These old bones might give out if I wait longer—just give me a definite answer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll get you sorted immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, cousin, been busy lately? There's something I wanted to ask you about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm looking to buy a property, but there are purchase restrictions. Would it be possible to use your name for the purchase? I'll handle all the arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see, though I have some concerns about potential risks, like legal complications.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand completely. I'll take full responsibility for any risks. Just think it over when you can—no pressure at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate your understanding. I need some time to consider this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, take your time. Just let me know once you've made a decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll think about it then. Talk to you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you swap exam times with me next Wednesday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What for? I've got plans that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! I've got an interview—take it or leave it, ain't begging you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! You wanna ruin my study schedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing victim! Just say no instead of yapping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Cry to the teacher yourself—none of my damn business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Cheapskate! Don't come crawling to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: May I ask about the hardship grant application process?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just submit a hardship certificate and income statement with the completed form at the counter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does the income statement require bank stamping?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We recommend providing three months' records - stamped versions are more compliant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can family members apply on my behalf?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Simply bring both parties' original IDs and a notarized authorization letter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Approximately how long for approval?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Complete submissions take under two weeks; we'll call for missing documents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help watch my kid for a bit? I need to go out and handle something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? About how long?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Around two hours. If it's inconvenient, I can just take him along.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be such a hassle - just leave him with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Formula's in the left cabinet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it - I'll call if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll bring you back some treats.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, lend me your power bank! My phone's about to die.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I really can't. I need it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your computer broke, I dropped my homework and rushed to help you all day. Have you forgotten?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was you helping me, but right now I need to use it too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So this is how you treat someone who helped you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you implying by saying that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, next time you're in need, I'll have to think twice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li Qiang, get your ass down to the tech department right now! This is your responsibility—stop being such a selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I don't know the first thing about technical work. Won't that just hold things up? Can't you send someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! The company's interests come first. Your attitude is downright irresponsible—you will follow orders!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not shirking responsibility; I genuinely don't know that area. Forcing me into it won't help anyone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Where's your team spirit? Refusing makes you a damn traitor—get the hell out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is bullying! I don't owe the company anything—why force me like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Force my ass! Duty is duty! Shut up and report tomorrow, or face wage deduction!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, I've got a conflict during next week's exam. Can we reschedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The timetable was fixed long ago. Changing it would disrupt the whole class arrangement. It's quite difficult.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you as a teacher show some understanding? How utterly heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rescheduling requires coordinating with other teachers and students. It's not solely my decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're just being selfish and avoiding hassle! Will you take responsibility if we fail?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, we'll adjust it! Quit making a scene here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this from the start! Total waste of time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, little sister, you must give up that study spot for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I? I earned this fair and square!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so selfish! As a sister, you should sacrifice for the family, you idiot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's rich coming from you! Lazing around all day—why should I yield to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Listen here, if you don't back down, don't expect me to help you ever again, you waste!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buzz off! I'm going no matter what—none of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I've got a short business trip next week. If it works for you, do you think you could find time to check on Uncle? Just making him dinner would be great.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next week? I might be traveling for a few days myself – the timing probably won't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I see. Well then, if you finish up early over there, could you possibly swing by his place on your way back that evening?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, by the way, Auntie prepared two days' worth of herbal medicine that's in the fridge. If you do go over, could you help heat up a small bowl for him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heating the medicine? I'm not really familiar with that... And honestly, I'll be pretty worn out from my trip, worried I might not have enough time to do it right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, no worries then. I can handle the medicine when I'm back. If you really can't make it, I'll just ask around some other relatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best. If I get back early enough, I'll go see Uncle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For our child's future, we must get a fake divorce—this is the duty of parents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is far too risky; what if you actually fall for someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a disappointment—won't you even make this tiny sacrifice for our child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not fair; responsibility is shared between us both.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We must decide by Friday, or if we miss this school district house chance, how on earth can you face the entire family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... you always corner me like this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, are you free these couple days? Need to ask you a favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? Just say it straight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My relative's daughter is burning with anxiety over finding an internship. You've got plenty of connections, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Openings are pitifully scarce nowadays, but I'll try asking around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's a real go-getter, just missing that one break.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This year's been brutal, no doubt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would be fantastic if you could lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll mull it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey sis, hurry up and post that promo on your feed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped lately, can't get to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Just do as I say!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My phone's crawling at snail pace, how am I supposed to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a lousy excuse! How utterly clueless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you done?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Post it today or I'm blocking you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You mentioned Xiao Wang's always posting all kinds of messy stuff on Moments. It really bothers me - I'm worried the kid might pick up bad habits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it really that serious? Just create a separate group for the kid, you know? Out of sight, out of mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what Lao Li's family did, said it saves trouble. But I'm afraid if the kid accidentally scrolls past it, how awkward would that be?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, we'll try this approach first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, mainly for peace of mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll go set it up right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me know once it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, all sorted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie Zhang, I'm really at my wits' end here—getting the kid into a good school all depends on your help now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly can't touch this, Auntie. The policies are too strict—I might lose my job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got all those connections and resources, surely you have more ways than us. The kid talks about you every day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'd help if I could, but I just can't shoulder this kind of risk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know it's difficult for you, but this is the kid's only chance. Could you figure something out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What about trying for the gifted program? I'll help find a tutor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright. Guess family is more reliable after all...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello? 110? That damn mahjong parlor downstairs is driving us nuts with noise every single day! Aren't you gonna do your damn job?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Copy that. Need the exact address first. Gotta follow protocol on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw your protocols! Cops should handle this NOW! Got any decency? We pay taxes so you can stuff your faces while we suffer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We hear your frustration, but documentation takes time. Can't intervene without the location.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Listen here - if you don't send someone IMMEDIATELY, you're aiding criminals! You'll regret this! Fix it NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Address. That's non-negotiable for action. Otherwise we can't fulfill duties. Cooperate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Building 3 Unit 101, XX Estate! Mark my words - if that racket continues, I'll report you lazy bums to your superiors! This isn't over till it's fixed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I'm a bit strapped for cash lately. Could you spare some?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you still haven't paid back what you borrowed last time, remember?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know this puts you in a tough spot, but my rent suddenly went up this month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wait, didn't you just come back from vacation? Saw it on your social media.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was a mandatory company retreat. I'm literally surviving on instant noodles now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mortgage payments are killing me this month too. Honestly can't swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm over thirty grand short on this month's targets, it's killing me. The boss chews me out every single day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Same boat here, drowning in work and genuinely can't help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, forget it then. I'll just shoulder this alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's brutal like that sometimes. You'll have to push through!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly stings a bit – I really thought you'd pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't swing it this time for real. Let's circle back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it. Thanks for the sympathy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Baby, trial marriage shows you're serious about commitment. Anyone truly invested would do this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I have reservations... I'm afraid it might damage our future relationship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That mindset is wrong. Responsible people recognize the need for premarital adjustments—don't you want to prove our love matters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents might disapprove of living together before marriage...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True love means making your own choices. Hesitating shows you don't value this relationship—fully committed people wouldn't waver like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I take a few more days to decide?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Decisiveness is crucial when it counts. Being responsible means agreeing now; anything else is dodging your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... okay then, we'll try it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, I've placed that business trip reimbursement form on your desk. Could you sign it for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, you actually made a special trip for this trivial matter? What's wrong with covering expenses yourself while serving the company? Utterly lacking dedication!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all due respect, sir, that's unfair. I've covered substantial costs. If you keep delaying approval, who pays? Should I just foot the entire bill?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal about covering expenses? It proves your shallow loyalty! During economic downturns, we must unite - yet you obsess over petty personal accounts. How pathetically small-minded!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, 'dedication' is it? Then kindly note some receipts might be non-compliant. Your call, boss - if you're unconcerned about audits, proceed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you take that tone! Threatening me? Trying to frame your superior? Where's your basic human decency?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't dream of it, sir! Just a lowly employee wanting reimbursed. If you'd honorably sign, we'd avoid this circus. Must you endlessly exploit people's goodwill?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Your sort... Whatever! Hand it over! Never again! Absolutely refusing any sacrifice - how'd we get stuck with such an ungrateful viper!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, lend me your car for a couple of days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might not be able to recently...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you're so stingy! I won't ask you for anything anymore!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant, it's mainly because I need it myself...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you're pretty slick with excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I lend it to you next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need! And don't come to me for anything in the future either!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Add Deputy Dean Zhao's name to the paper, get it revised today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Dean Zhao wasn't involved in the project. Isn't that a bit inappropriate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough of your crap! Just add it when I tell you to! Do you still want lab access or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we at least follow basic academic standards...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Standards my ass! Keep yapping and I'll freeze all your project funding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I'll add it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this ages ago! Email it by 5PM sharp - no dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard you're heading to Guangzhou for work? Perfect, grab me some wife cakes while you're there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This trip is packed; I probably won't have time to shop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As old classmates, you've got to save face a little, right? Don't disappoint me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to squeeze it in, but no promises if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even manage this tiny favor? People will call you socially inept.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll check if my schedule allows it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it—real friends always go the extra mile for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm in a bit of a tight spot right now and need some cash urgently. If you've got some to spare, could you spot me five hundred? I'll pay you back when I get my paycheck at the end of the month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's been tight here too lately. Just paid the kids' tuition fees, so I really don't have anything extra this month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it. Well, just give me a shout whenever things ease up for you? No rush on my end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can swing after next month's paycheck comes in. If I can free up some cash, I'll set some aside for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome, thanks man! Knew I could count on you—you've always been reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. That's what friends are for, right? Help where we can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. Drinks and skewers on me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Zhang, could you grab some fried chicken on your way back since it's on your route?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, I actually have plans to meet someone today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't a newcomer show some team spirit? How can you talk about career growth if you won't even handle such small tasks?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that I'm really pressed for time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other is our department's tradition. How come you young folks don't appreciate upholding good values?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then... which shop should I go to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There we go. Remember, it never hurts for newcomers to put in a little extra effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Zhang, mind letting me use your shopping account for an urgent order? I really need it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That doesn't seem appropriate—the account involves personal privacy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're old colleagues—shouldn't we help each other out? Why are you being so distant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that the platform has login restrictions, and I'm worried it could cause issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I cover three shifts for you last month when your kid was sick? Can't you even show me this tiny bit of consideration?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll think about it... but this is absolutely the last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Colleagues ought to always look out for one another.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must co-sign this loan for me! After all these years as brothers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm strapped myself. Isn't guaranteeing a loan too risky?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell is wrong with you? Real brothers should have each other's back! Refusing means you're ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you say that? I don't owe you anything, do I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Sign the damn papers today, or you're basically saying you look down on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you forcing my hand here? What if the loan defaults?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! All those years of brotherhood wasted! Bailing when I need you most—you're a real son of a bitch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey I'm going on a business trip for a couple days, could you look after my mom at my place? Just cook some meals and keep her company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I can swing by Thursday afternoon, but don't make things too complicated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember you MUST cook braised fish every meal - that's her favorite. Don't you know the bare minimum about respecting elders?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? I can't cook fish! I don't even know how to use your kitchenware. This is asking too much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even bother with one proper meal? You're utterly heartless! Where's your sense of filial duty? Real friends go through fire for each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you psycho? Moral blackmail my ass! Go find someone else - I'm done with this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Don't come crawling to me next time you need help. Guess I misjudged you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare fucking bail on tomorrow's team-building with some excuse!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your fucking business! I just don't wanna go to that bullshit team-building!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You're always so difficult, pulling this special treatment crap every time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own damn business! You're treating garbage like it's treasure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come or don't come! Quit playing the big shot here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, finally talking sense. Saves me the trouble of making excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Sick of the sight of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Puh-lease! Think you're hot shit or something?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're working at a snail's pace, seriously? Could you pick it up a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The problems are pretty tough. Mind if I catch my breath for five minutes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Five minutes? Look at Xiao Ming—he's skipping meals just to study, and you still think you deserve a break?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My head's spinning from all this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think about your parents' expectations! They're counting on you to ace this exam!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll push through a bit longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna come in? Straight up hand over an 8888 red packet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You cheapskates! Do you make a habit of bullying the meek?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too stingy to even give a proper red packet? Is this how you show your sincerity? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Since when does money prove your love for the bride? Have you no shame?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No red packet? Forget about entering. How utterly inconsiderate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. 5000 it is. Just spare me your nagging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, the code just won't run. Could you please help me debug it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with business travel. Figure it out yourself—even Xiao Wang submitted three drafts while running a fever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly stuck. Could you just help me this once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scholarship requires grit. Look at Xiao Zhao—they grind in the lab till midnight every single day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I genuinely can't graduate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the most demanding student I've ever advised. Don't betray my expectations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll just grind through it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must demonstrate substantive progress at the group meeting. Your pace is far behind schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at how great Xiao Zhang's two kids are, what's the hold up with you having another one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our eldest is already in tutoring classes, no energy left to raise another kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's a little hardship for parents? It's sad for a child to grow up without a companion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With mortgages and car loans weighing us down, adding another kid is really too much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other families manage just fine with two kids, aren't you worried yours might resent you for this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll think about it later, truly can't handle it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, mind if I crash at your place tonight? Got no ride back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's kinda messy right now, might not be comfortable for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll figure something else out if needed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I check nearby hotels for you later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. Even a subway card would work in a pinch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a spare one here, wanna use it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! I'll treat you to a meal next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you pretty free lately? You've got to step up for this new project, or the whole team will be on pins and needles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Me again? My plate's overflowing over here—couldn't you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this project tanks, we're all screwed. You're the senior here—shouldering this is what you ought to do, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm buried under three other tasks. Can't someone else share the load?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole group's counting on you to save the day—don't tell me you don't have the guts for it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine. I'll pull an all-nighter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew we could count on you! Work fast—all eyes are on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, our class is at the bottom now, and we can't even hold our heads up! The class next door got their scores adjusted—if you don't give an explanation, how are we supposed to survive in school? Please hurry up and adjust our scores!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scores can't just be changed on a whim, you know. The school rules are strict about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But didn't you always brag about our class being the top? With scores this awful, won't everyone mock your teaching skills? You've got to step in and fight for us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about we just add an extra class after school on Friday? Honestly, the scores can't be touched.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What good is an extra class this late? If the scores don't change, we're stuck at the bottom! Come on, bend the rules and help us out—the whole class is depending on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll bring it up with the grade leader. For now, you all need to get your mistakes sorted out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with this project lately, burning the midnight oil every day and barely able to keep my eyes open.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help me wrap up this proposal, will you? Last time you worked overtime, I covered for you without hesitation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got piles of work on my plate and absolutely no bandwidth to spare.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, you're being so evasive—that's hardly what I'd call decent behavior, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't do it, I'm completely wiped out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even spare half an hour? When I pulled an all-nighter for you, I didn't see any hesitation on your part!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello? What's going on with you? Not even picking up calls?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was in a meeting, phone on silent. Listen, the project's been crushing me lately—I'm completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Too busy? You just don't want to see me! Can't spare a minute for your own girlfriend? Am I just disposable to you? How utterly selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? I'm pulling all-nighters just to breathe! Zero consideration from you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consideration? When have you ever considered ME? Shouldn't a girlfriend care for her boyfriend? You're coming over this weekend—no excuses! If you don't come, it means you don't love me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you even hear yourself? I'm losing overtime pay over this! This is pure moral blackmail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right it is! You chose me—now act like it! Quit playing dead! You WILL come—got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You lunatic! I'm done with this! Screw you and your delusions!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ms. Li, the company suddenly assigned me to work out of town, and I have to leave by the end of the month. Could we discuss the security deposit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract states the deposit isn't refundable for early termination. This is really difficult for me too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You see, I've lived here for two years, always paid rent and utilities on time. This is truly a special situation. I wonder if an exception could be made?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone has to follow the rules. Making an exception wouldn't be fair to other tenants, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know you run things fairly, Ms. Li. It's mainly that my situation is so sudden. Is there any flexible way we could handle this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Since you've always been reliable, I'll refund half the deposit. But don't make it a rule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly appreciate this, Ms. Li. I'll be sure to give more notice next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard your cousin works at the DMV? Any chance he could help me expedite my vehicle inspection?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With full camera surveillance lately, he can't risk any violations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I completely understand. How long does the normal queue usually take?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me check the process for you, but there really aren't any shortcuts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all! I was just asking casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe consider going early? Getting there before 7am usually means basically no wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Thanks, I'll try the regular queue first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's running a fever and needs to go to the hospital. Could you help me rush this report out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm buried in work too today, okay? My own tasks are piled sky-high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I covered three night shifts when your mom was hospitalized! Quit playing dead now—where's your damn conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I thanked you properly with that fancy dinner already. Quit dragging it up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful snake! How can you call yourself human abandoning someone in crisis? Do this today or I'm taking it to the boss!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Always with the emotional blackmail! Snitch away for all I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team's watching your backstabbing ass, you thankless bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you seen Aunt's post about her new store opening on Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't come across it yet. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe give it a like? Though totally up to you, of course.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll do it when I'm free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would be even nicer if you added a compliment in the comments—only if it's convenient though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll check the content first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just tossing out a suggestion anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, I'm 30K short on my sales target—you must help me fudge the numbers tonight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck? Too lazy to do your own work, so you drag me down with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who bailed you out when you failed last term? Stop playing saint now, you ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! That's completely different! Who takes the fall when the fraud gets caught?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Either help or get the fuck out of the dorm, you backstabbing asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, hotshot! Pay your own fucking rent this month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Never met such a cold-blooded piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cover my shift this Saturday, something urgent came up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No can do, I've got plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't helping each other out the very obligation between friends? Can't even do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely have commitments—you're really putting me in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think carefully: true friends take responsibility. You must help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to work it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you design the menu for free? Need it by month-end for the opening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tied up with a major project that'll consume me these two weeks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help with such a small favor? Is our friendship really this shallow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client's breathing down my neck, pulling all-nighters daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it, I'll find someone else. This is seriously inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll make it up to you with dinner after this crunch time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, whatever. Let's drop it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't pick up my kid today, could you look after him for a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Your brat smashes my window every single day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, it's just one broken glass—why hold a grudge? So petty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You raised a little monster and still dare to ask for favors? Deal with it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Like I give a damn about you? I'd rather ask the old guy in the bike shed downstairs than beg you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Your brat drives me crazy just looking at him!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You snob! Don't ever speak to me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My cousin's literally got nowhere to lay her head! If we don't take her in, who will? We absolutely must help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But our lease explicitly forbids extra tenants. What if the landlord finds out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How do you expect a young woman to manage alone? If it were your sister, would you just stand by? Can you even live with yourself refusing to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then how should we split utilities like water and electricity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How petty can you be bringing up money now? Since when do family members keep score? Let's get her settled first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about keeping score—if the landlord cracks down, we'll get evicted too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rigid but people aren't! If we abandon family in need, what'll the neighbors think of us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try calling the landlord first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, we're short-staffed at work. Doesn't it seem unreasonable for a veteran like you not to step up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My back injury flared up days ago. The doctor ordered bed rest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we lose your expertise, who'll take responsibility when the junior staff make mistakes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My daughter's in postpartum confinement - I'm shuttling my grandson to school daily. My schedule's stretched thin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A twenty-year veteran like you dropping responsibilities before retirement would reflect poorly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, would this work? I could provide remote guidance via phone for urgent matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team feels adrift without your leadership. Could you really bear watching this project collapse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll talk with my daughter to see if I can free up two days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, run down and grab me lunch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I'm swamped with an urgent task right now—afraid it might delay your lunch...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the excuses! Don't you know how to respect your superiors? How do you expect to survive in the workplace without basic initiative?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant—it's just that this report has to be submitted before 2 p.m...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Which is more important—my lunch or your report? With this lack of basic decorum, do you even care about your career performance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... what would you like to eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Remember: helping your superiors is basic professional ethics. Stop thinking about slacking off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Understood. I'll go now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, we absolutely must buy that school district house! Mom and Dad keep harping on about their grandchild's education—how could we possibly skip this? Get it sorted immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The money's just not there—monthly payments would crush us. What if we can't afford it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad are counting on us to prioritize our child's future. It's worth the extra cost! Think how devastated they'll be if we don't buy it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why insist on a school district place? Can't regular housing provide decent schooling too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's upgrading to bigger homes—we can't fall behind! Find a way to make this happen or you'll break Mom and Dad's hearts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, mortgage payments scare me to death... Fine, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be finalized by month's end—Mom and Dad are waiting to celebrate! Quit dragging your feet and get it done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I just opened a bubble tea shop. Mind helping promote it on your social feed when you get a chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Congrats! But lately I've been blocking ads on my Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, just whenever you're free—totally up to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I share it in some group chats instead? Might get better reach.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good! Whatever approach you think works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Send me the event details—I'll rephrase them a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome, really appreciate it! Drinks on me next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, don't sweat it—just a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, are you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got nowhere to stay tonight. Mind if I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, not really convenient. The house is packed with relatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, you MUST help me out as family! Not even accommodating such a small request? How can relatives be so calculative with each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but it's genuinely difficult. All guest rooms are occupied.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As family, SHOULDNT you find a way to make it work? Refusing like this REALLY undermines our harmony.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, haven't seen much on your feed lately. Wanna try this new collagen drink I got?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been insane, haven't even had time to scroll through feeds.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get it. But if you get a free moment, could you help me promote it on your feed? Might as well test out this new product.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does this stuff even work? How do you feel after drinking it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feel like my skin's a bit more hydrated. Sharing with friends is good for everyone, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, shoot me the caption and I'll take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheers mate! Let me know how it goes if you try it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You there? Need you to write an English email for me ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got projects piling up. Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Friends are supposed to have each other's backs! Remember when I pulled an all-nighter helping you move?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was on a weekend. Seriously swamped now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! I need it by noon tomorrow, or you're basically saying our friendship means nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Will you fucking listen to reason?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful bastard! Did I complain once when helping you? Stop playing dead now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. Last time though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I bet you know where Xiaoming's been hiding, don't you? Quit playing dumb!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely don't know. Isn't he contacting you himself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You're thick as thieves, and now he ghosts me? You fucking owe me the truth!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Believe what you will, I sure as hell don't know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You backstabbing ingrate! Who begged for your pardon back then? Pulling this shit now – call this friendship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save your breath! Since when do I owe you jackshit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! With loyalty like this, don't ever expect another damn favor from me! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're short on hands for the event - you absolutely must come and save the day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got prior commitments that day, really can't make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you bail, won't everyone be disappointed? This whole thing hinges on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't move things around. Hope you all enjoy yourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I jumped in to cover your shift last time? Now you won't even lift a finger for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then, I'll try to rearrange my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it, mate! The whole crew's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you bear with the renovation delays for a few more days? We are neighbors after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But construction isn't allowed during lunchtime, right? How are we supposed to rest like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's facing difficulties here. We should show mutual understanding - neighborly relations matter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been tolerating enough already with the daily overtime construction.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just hold on a bit longer. This benefits the whole building - let's all be reasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we follow basic principles? This is disrupting everyone's rest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The schedule's tight. Could you kindly endure this for our relationship's sake?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This internship spot looks great; I'm a bit strapped for cash lately and could really use this opportunity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm job hunting too. Just submit your resume and see what happens.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I helped you prep for that certification exam? Wasn't a big deal at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, that went smoothly back then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Golden chances like this are rare – we should have each other's backs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair competition then – may the best candidate win.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me, as long as this doesn't come between us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, Aunt Wang takes these calcium pills every day and her legs are so much better now. You should really follow suit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're wasting money again buying useless stuff. At my age, nothing makes a difference.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle Li could barely walk before from knee pain, but now he's brisk walking everywhere just because he took my advice. How could we live with ourselves if you refuse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always comparing. I'm perfectly fine—stop overreacting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you keep being stubborn and take a fall someday, we'll be the ones to suffer. I beg you to listen just this once so we can sleep peacefully at night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll take the damn pills. Enough with the nagging already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you screwed up? Too chicken to even send an apology letter, coward?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your fucking business! I'll send it if I damn well please!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ha! Spineless as expected - explains why you ranked dead last in the review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking looking for trouble? Want me to blast your slacking-off records to the whole group?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it! Let's see what trash like you can do besides making threats!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I'll handle it my way - who died and made you boss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch. Worthless fool can't even mail a fucking letter after days of dithering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: One more word and I'll publicly curse your ancestors with your real name attached. Try me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the landlord's making noise about raising the rent again. I'm totally scrambling here. You're the legal expert—think you could lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? How much is the increase that's got you so frantic?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They just jacked up the price without warning—my contract might as well mean nothing now. You're the only one I know who understands this legal stuff. Mind taking a look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's been crushing lately—worried I might hold you up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, come on—given how close we are, you wouldn't just brush off a small favor like this, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll squeeze in some time to check it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Baby, could you enable Alipay Family Payment for me? If you won't even do this, how much do you really love me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What does that have to do with love? Mixing money just creates chaos.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Anyone who truly loves me would do it! You're just stingy and selfish - can't even show this much goodwill!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the emotional blackmail, would you? When have I ever shortchanged you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Enabling it means trust, refusing means hypocrisy! Do it today, no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're absolutely unreasonable! Always demanding proof after proof!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Love should be all about total commitment! Refusing means you don't love enough! Think carefully about where you stand!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With math scores barely passing, do you think this repays us for working overtime day and night to fund your education?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The test was unexpectedly difficult; I didn't foresee this outcome.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't shift blame! How come Little Hong downstairs aced it perfectly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her parents are both teachers—how could I possibly compete?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you be doubling your efforts then? We're working ourselves to the bone all for your sake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll be more careful next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must hand over your salary to me after marriage—this is about being responsible for our family. You should understand that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why does it have to be this way? I can manage my own spending just fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly love me, you’d do this. It’s our duty as a couple. Refusing means you don’t trust me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It’s not about distrust—I just don’t see the need for such a rigid approach.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every decent couple does this. Just hand it over already—don’t let me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but I want us to discuss it together, not make it a dictated approach.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn’t dictating—it’s necessary. For the sake of our happiness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, police station? The mahjong noise downstairs is deafening - shouldn't you officers handle this? It's spiking the elderly's blood pressure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please provide the exact location, we'll address it immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Building 6! Frankly, you should patrol more often - how many times must this happen?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll improve our patrols. Currently, we require the specific unit number to assist.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unit 2! We pay your salaries through our taxes, so fixing this minor issue is the least you could do, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: En route. Could you specify which floor approximately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: First floor! Get moving quickly - the entire building's relying on you to deliver justice!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, my child's school admission entirely depends on you. You absolutely must help us out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, I've still got unfinished business over here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family ought to be able to count on you, right? Can't let the child suffer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... since you put it that way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline's next week. Surely you wouldn't want the child to miss out on schooling?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Already? I'm afraid I might not manage in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You dote on them most. We can't possibly let something this important slip, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll do my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my kid suddenly has a fever. I need to take three days off to care for them. Do you think that would be possible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, family comes first. Go handle things at home. I'll have Xiao Wang cover the team project temporarily; we should manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding! The kid's got pneumonia and needs hospitalization—my wife can't handle it alone. I'll try to check work emails when possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't stress about work—family is priority. Remember when Lao Li's daughter had that fall last year? We managed just fine. Focus on your family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Alright then, sis. I'll squeeze in some time to go check on her.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Wang, the project is really tight lately, everyone's quite busy—how about postponing your vacation?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but the project needs testing next week, and we're short-staffed—could you try to work something out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll ask the travel agency if I can reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my kid's been running a fever lately - such a hassle to care for that I can't even focus on work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? All you care about is your damn job? When your kid's sick, you drop everything as a parent! If you don't, you don't deserve to be called one - selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the project deadline's crazy tight, boss is breathing down my neck... what am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! Your kid's health is non-negotiable - you take leave now or you're a godawful parent. Period.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try swapping shifts... though this month's bonus is toast for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Parents oughta sacrifice like this. Work's bullshit - quit being so damn self-absorbed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah... I'd better get going. Catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family is exhausted! Is your exam more important than your parents?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Passing this exam means getting a good job—isn't that ultimately for the family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Little Kai next door takes time off to help his family every day, and he still manages his job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll come back for half a day this weekend—that should be enough, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, the passing grade for the midterm is ridiculously high; you must lower it to 50! How dare you make students suffer like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: School policy requires 60 to pass; I can't arbitrarily change it. The questions are fair; you should put in more effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: How utterly selfish! Everyone's drowning in stress while you spout insensitive remarks? Can't you show any consideration?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Learning is inherently challenging, and lowering standards won't help. The policy stands—I have no authority to alter it.
