turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Lower the passing grade now! Otherwise you're morally bankrupt and unfit to teach!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help with the data analysis? I really need the results for this urgent project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped this week—my own tasks are piled up.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's held up here—could you possibly manage to finish by Friday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good man. The team counts on reliable pillars like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: After marriage, your salary must be handed over to me—that's the duty of a good husband, you know that?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're just selfish! If you really love me, prove it. What kind of man are you if you won't even hand over your money?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you crazy? I work my ass off to earn money, and I have to take your crap too?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the crap. Give me your pay card tonight, or don't expect any peace in this house!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, classmate, could you do me a favor with the report? Time's a bit tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have it on my desk before I come in tomorrow. Don't you dare be ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forward that voting post in your feed for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get treated if you're sick, psycho! Stop this nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! And never step foot in my house again!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so late and I can't get home. Shouldn't neighbors help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my place isn't really suitable, and we've only met a few times in the elevator...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Put yourself in my position - wouldn't you panic if your daughter was stranded on the street at midnight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's genuinely not about space... my elderly parents are home, it's really awkward

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I get the picture. So much for neighborly goodwill.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, it's only fair for you to put in a word about that company internship, isn't it? I've been waiting forever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My major isn't quite... I'm worried it'd seem unfair. Better to go through official channels.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always said you'd look out for us kids growing up. Now that my cousins are all settled, you can't just focus on them and forget about me, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll try asking around. But keep it hush-hush, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd come through for me, Auntie. Family's got your back when it counts.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, is that report done yet? The whole team's waiting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sister Wang pulled an all-nighter to finish hers even with a fever. How can you possibly have the heart to make everyone stay late with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our parents have had a tough time all these years. Don't you think we should support them finding companionship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at the kids in the Liu family - they're totally supportive of their parents' choices. Their lives are so happy now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, their situation is different. Can't I have my own thoughts about this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all, our parents' happiness is the top priority.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's talk face to face, shall we? It's really stifling to keep this awkwardness between us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you want to talk? Where was this urgency before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends should take time to work things out. Quit dodging me, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where were you back then? When I was hurting, you vanished into thin air.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please calm down. Give me a chance to make it right, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: We shouldn't just toss aside so many years of friendship - that'd be such a waste.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, there's an old colleagues gathering next month. Can you make it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you hook me up with an employee discount? Isn't your sister at Huawei?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no problem at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property management called again. Could you hurry up and pay the fees? We all share this building; you can't just look out for yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, I'm going crazy here! Work's piling up with all this overtime, and my kid's stuck home alone all day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, what were you doing earlier? That's on you if the kid's gotta endure this. Can't you just get a different job?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: What damn job switch? What do you know, you idiot? Easy for you to say when it's not your problem. You think raising a kid single-handed is a walk in the park?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, who told you to have kids in the first place? All you do is whine. That poor kid's stuck with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Poor kid my ass! You're the damn loser here! What would a single loser like you know squat about this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, suit yourself! Not wasting my breath. Handle your own mess and freeze me out of the kid's business!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still got any leads on that registration channel? My license has been stuck for three freaking months—I'm losing my mind here! Hurry up and figure something out!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who dares to touch this when we're in hot water? You gonna take responsibility if it blows up in our faces?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the bond we share, you'd just stand by watching me get screwed? Is this how you treat a friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you busy? Got something urgent to discuss.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: My car registration's hit a snag—need to put it under your name. Come on, we're brothers! You can't just stand by while I'm drowning here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This sounds risky though. You sure about the consequences?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your brother bought a place, I didn't hesitate to lend you cash. Now it's my turn, and you're dragging your feet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... what am I supposed to do...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even count on your own flesh and blood? That's just heartbreaking. Quit stalling and help me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haa... let me think it over and get back to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless piece of shit! After this colossal fuck-up, you better get on your knees and apologize to the client! The company's fed you all these years for nothing? Has your conscience been eaten by dogs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, the circumstances were complicated... I never expected...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Own your damn mistakes! Is this how you repay the company? Refuse to grovel today and you've got no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll contact the client now to explain...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Explain my ass! You beg for forgiveness on your knees, got it? Fail to pull this off? Kiss this month's paycheck goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You call this too much? Maximizing company interests comes FIRST, understand? Fix it or get the hell out! I'd get more use keeping a dog!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, my new store is opening soon. Since your design skills are top-notch, could you brainstorm a poster concept for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this; my schedule genuinely won't allow it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, work comes first—don't push yourself. I'll consult others for ideas.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
