turn_by_turn_scores.text: You wouldn't turn down such a small favor, would you? I really need to post these on social media.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly don't have the energy right now. What do you expect me to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're closest friends. This shouldn't be such a big deal for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Send me the photos.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what I call a real friend! Love you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been three days since my surgery. As an old friend, shouldn't you come visit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got too much going on at home lately. Would weekend work for a visit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends show up when needed. Do you even get how hard it is for me to get out of bed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's hospitalized with pneumonia... really can't leave now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our thirty years of friendship can't measure up to this? Honestly, I'm crushed by this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll shuffle things around and come tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be here before 10 sharp - that's non-negotiable for someone who calls themselves a friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go guarantee for my friend right now, and stop wasting time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell is wrong with you? It's none of my business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit pretending! Can't even do a simple favor like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! If you're so capable, do it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You spineless wimp! I must have been blind to trust you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only a fool would take this blame. If you want to bear it, go ahead yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Don't you dare expect any help from me ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to help me snag Jay Chou's tickets tomorrow – you absolutely must get them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? But I'm trying to get my own tickets too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't friends help each other? Have you forgotten how I scored those sneakers for you last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember, but these tickets are insanely hard to get.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends would make this happen, or I'll be seriously disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is so much pressure... what if I fail?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to find a way – isn't that what friendship means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, we gotta finish the project overnight—the whole team is ready to pull an all-nighter. You think you can manage?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've been dizzy all day and just took my temperature—I'm running a fever. Honestly don't think I can power through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh! Then don't push yourself—get some rest now. I'll have Lao Zhang cover your part.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is Lao Zhang up for it? I'm kinda worried he's not too familiar with my section.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's been practicing lately—should be passable. Just focus on recovering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Thanks, Boss—I'll come in early tomorrow to pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must bring your spouse to the company dinner on Friday—no excuses for skipping! Everyone else is all coupled up, and I'll look utterly pathetic standing alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work has been draining me dry lately; any chance I can get out of it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you even willing to make this tiny sacrifice? Spouses have to back each other up—isn't that the bare minimum duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine, I'll go—you always twist my arm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Would've saved us the hassle if you'd agreed sooner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then try to keep it short, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll just say my hellos and bolt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, catch you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grab me some roast duck rice from Canteen Three, will you? Since you're passing by anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now. Wouldn't it be faster if you went yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're supposed to help each other as classmates. Remember how much I covered for you in that group assignment last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the cafeteria line is super long right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you won't do this favor, future cooperation during class activities isn't going to be easy. We all need to show some collective spirit, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine. Any sides?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: NO ginger or scallions. DOUBLE portion of rice. And you MUST get it from that exact old-established shop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. I'll give it to you when I'm back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You MUST come back home this weekend - this is the MOST basic filial duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with a project crunch time right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you lack such basic decency when our parents' heavenly debt can't even move you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I make it up next month? Airfare is crazy expensive right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since when was filial piety measured by money? You WILL return this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be reasonable - it's not like I'm being unfilial.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True filial devotion is supposed to be proactive. When will that day come if we wait for your initiative?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you repost that stray animal rescue campaign on your Moments? All the kind-hearted people are sharing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been getting bombarded with these lately... feeling a bit numb to them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those poor animals are suffering! Reposting costs you nothing—look, so-and-so already shared it, don't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll check the details later, I suppose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deadline's tonight, come on now! It's such a small thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, shared it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! See? Now that's more like a kind-hearted person!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This data is super urgent, can you handle it right away? A little extra work never hurt anyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Today's been brutal — I've got five projects all hitting their deadlines.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut down on your phone scrolling and you'd find the time. Can't even lend a hand with such a small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, but I'm swamped over here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Xiao Zhang pulled an all-nighter for me — now see how much the boss values him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang's got skills, but shouldn't I prioritize my own workload first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. Just remember how you're acting now when others need help later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Long time no see, old classmate. How've you been?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting by, just swamped with this company project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I desperately need a document translated. Given our twenty years of friendship, you owe me this favor, don't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't spare time this week - got hard deadlines looming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that nursed your mother in the hospital? And now you'd throw away that debt of loyalty over this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... send it over. But this is absolutely the last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, has the internship slot been finalized yet? Everyone's getting really antsy waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, we're still selecting! Too many candidates, each with their strengths – it's giving me a headache!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Chen's been grinding nonstop! She worked herself to the bone on the last project, even lost noticeable weight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's solid, but spots are limited and budgets are tight. It's a real pickle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's just not right! After how hard she's worked, denying her this chance is downright unfair – the whole team's upset about it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm torn too. Need to keep the team motivated, but company profits can't be ignored.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make the call already! Passing up such a dedicated employee will demoralize everyone – aren't you just exploiting someone who plays by the rules?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, Director Zhang has helped us so much, don't you think it's unreasonable not to include his name on the paper?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But he wasn't involved in the experiment at all. Is that really acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you being so inflexible? If everyone else is doing it and we make a stand, how do you expect us to survive professionally?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But isn't this essentially faking data?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd cross leadership right during promotion reviews? Can you afford next year's lab funding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll adjust the authorship order then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done that earlier! Send it to me by 8 AM tomorrow—don't drag your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you should really help me talk to the boss about my situation. This is way too important.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why does it have to be me? Can't you go straight to the boss yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're colleagues, aren't we? Morally, this is your obligation. Not going would show you've got no heart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's this got to do with my obligation? I've got my own pile of things to deal with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dodging it. If you don't do this, you're shirking your responsibility to an old colleague.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll try. But just so we're clear, this isn't my duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, waiting for your good news. Remember to hurry up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard the Wangs just had another baby, we should hurry up and have our third!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you crazy? We can barely afford formula for the ones we have!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're just complaining about being tired! Other families manage fine with two kids.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut your trap! How many days have you actually spent taking care of them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, then don't complain later if the kids feel lonely!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Go have your own if you're so capable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The ward is suffocating—come keep me company right now, I can't stand it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have to take my kid to tutoring this weekend, really can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you moved, I took leave to help. Now you're dragging your feet over such a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents aren't well lately, need to look after them at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang visits every weekend—that's how friends should act. What's your problem?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll try to make time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dillydallying. Be here by 10—no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you vote for me? It's for the Most Beautiful Employee contest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm a bit swamped right now, might not be able to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As close friends, shouldn't supporting each other be expected? This isn't something you can just brush off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm really tied up at the moment, maybe later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends have a duty to help one another. It's just one vote - won't take more than a minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go vote then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Remember you've got to vote daily - no exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try to vote when possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, remember to bring souvenirs for everyone on your business trip. It's a team tradition and what's expected of you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my luggage might not have space for too many items...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young man, you ought to know how to repay the group. Remember how everyone looked after you during the last team-building?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to streamline my luggage...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! This is exactly how someone with integrity acts - Lao Li and the team are all watching, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll do my best to bring them back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure they're from reputable brands too. Wouldn't want to let everyone's expectations down, would we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This school enrollment can't be delayed, you must give a definite answer today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's tough. With inspections so strict now, who'll take responsibility if something goes wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other parents sorted it out ages ago! Are we supposed to let our child starve? You, as his uncle, have no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want us all to starve if I lose my job? Will you support my family then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one in the whole clan with connections! How can you call yourself family if you cower now? Even our ancestors would rise from the grave in anger!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll stick my neck out and try, but don't count on it being guaranteed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's counting on you! Get this sorted properly by noon tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you signing up for that tutoring class? There's only a few hours left!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign up? All you do is nag nonstop, how annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you yelling at? Total waste raising a useless piece of trash like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Me, trash? Go find someone else to sign up then! Screw off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're independent now? Don't come begging me for any damn thing later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I care! Not signing up and that's final! Whatever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hopeless loser! You'll regret this someday!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is your iQIYI membership still active?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, they just added a new movie. Wanna watch it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I ran around arranging that free exhibition for you last time? Lending me your account isn't too much to ask, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Accounts have login limits - too many devices could get it suspended...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just three days! I'll treat you to dinner after I finish, fair enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, just remember to log out afterward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! Let's definitely grab food soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, I've got a bad cold and probably can't make it to next week's exam. Cover for me, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not sure about that—if the cameras catch us, we're screwed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm running a 38°C fever and honestly can't push through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we get caught, we'll both fail the course.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I cover for you during your gym makeup exam last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Let me think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must contribute your simulation code – team sharing is non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I intended to patent this portion...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people shouldn't be so profit-driven; repaying kindness is fundamental morality.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this compromises my intellectual property...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you even have developed this without lab resources? Show some basic conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... how exactly would the sharing work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just hand it over to me directly – this is your absolute obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you brain-damaged? Flunking math like this! What a waste of money sending you to school!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop yelling, I know I messed up. I'll do better next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better my ass! You always say that but never deliver! Look how well the kid next door scored—that's a slap in your face, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really tried my best. Stop comparing me to others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trying my ass! Quit school already—you're too dumb for this! Go flip burgers instead!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Got it. Can we just drop this now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My cousin's going through a tough time and has to stay with us for a while.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long? That might be inconvenient, since we're sharing the apartment after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we help family in need? It's a basic human responsibility - you're obligated to support this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about rent sharing? And arrangements for common spaces?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's downright selfish to fuss over such details. Caring for relatives is a moral duty - you should understand this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't this require mutual agreement? What does our lease specify?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have some conscience! She'll just take the spare room - this is how it should've been handled from the start.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to confirm with the landlord before giving you an answer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've got to sign the prenup to keep our relationship pure, you get that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But why's every clause favoring your family? That's downright unfair!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Wangs only stayed loving because they signed one. How can we skip it? Don't you see you're putting me in a tough spot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So if I get the short end, you won't care? Signing this feels like abandoning my own family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly wanted this marriage, would a signature scare you? Refusing just means you don't trust me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There you go dragging feelings into this again—what's that got to do with paperwork?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Signing proves our hearts are true to each other. How else could we build a future?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! I'm dying for some bubble tea. Since you're passing by, mind grabbing me one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that! Can't you see I'm gaming? Are you blind or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking idiot! You care more about games than your bro? Worthless piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Would it fucking kill you to go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit yapping! Fine, I'll ask someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Stop your fucking whining!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang, can I discuss leaving some cardboard boxes in the stairwell corner for three days? My place is really out of space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But wouldn't that get in the way? It is a common area after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise to keep them tucked against the wall and handle them within 72 hours tops.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, try not to block the path, and you need to clear them out after three days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, thanks for being understanding. I'll definitely tidy it up before the weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'm just concerned the property management might raise a fuss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, rest assured.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to get rid of that dog! Keeping a damn beast during college entrance exams is outrageous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What for? It doesn't interfere with my studying at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! We slave away for your education, yet you care more about that mutt than your own parents!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since when have I been unfilial? Is owning a dog disloyal now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! No more allowance unless you ditch it tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're completely unreasonable! Always using money to bully me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got compassion for animals but not for your folks? After raising you all these years, you won't even obey this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Whatever you say goes! I'll surrender it! Satisfied now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and buy a bag of rice; it's all gone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have plans tonight; can't I buy it tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your parents worry about you all day, and you're not even willing to do this little thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already made arrangements; canceling last minute looks bad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family matters take priority; what's the harm in asking friends to wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, I'll go buy it now then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mess up; get Northeast rice specifically.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cover my shift this Saturday? I'm in a real bind and can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dude, my weekend's packed solid. Probably can't swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all our years as pals, you won't even lend a hand with this tiny favor? Not much of a friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got prior commitments with friends. Tough to bail on them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, just do me this one solid for old times' sake. I'll owe you big time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll see if I can shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you should block Xiao Wang's moments already. All he posts is nonsense, it's annoying as hell!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! I'll watch whatever I want, screw off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch. I was trying to be nice, but fine, be ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who asked you?! Stop butting in, you damn busybody!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Suit yourself, I'm done caring!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right I will! Shut your trap and leave me alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Suffer all you want then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go fucking fix the client you screwed up yourself! Call them right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client blocked me, I can't reach them...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then go ambush them at their office! Fail and you're fired tomorrow, you useless waste of space!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll go wait at their company now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring expensive gifts! Fail and I'll dock your whole year's bonus!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much will this cost? Can I expense it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Expense my ass! Pay for your own damn mess! Can't fix it? Get the hell out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, your plants have been taking up my balcony space for half a year!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! It's not like I asked you to water them daily!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have the nerve? This nonsense has wasted so much of my time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! If they die, it's on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll dump them in the hallway tomorrow! Sick of seeing them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! Like I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't ever ask me to handle such stupid stuff again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, cousin, can you lend me that big gold chain for a couple days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? That thing's expensive! What if you lose it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? My own cousin's wedding - you won't help me save face on such an important occasion? Think you're better than me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, that's not what I meant! I'm nervous - you know how careless you are with things!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family talking like this? You have to lend it! What kind of brother refuses such a small favor? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, you win! But mark my words - damage it and you're selling your house to pay me back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After we get married, I should manage the money—that's what genuinely caring about our family looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I handle my own money? Why on earth should I have to do what you say?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you really cared about this family, you'd let me manage it. Stop being so selfish—can't you understand that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. But you have to leave me some allowance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Day-to-day stuff is up to you, but major decisions fall to me—fair enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, fine. You handle it then—saves me the trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. A family ought to pull together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, could you put in a word for me with the boss? I'm at my wit's end here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why can't you do it yourself? Quit being such a slacker!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Who're you calling a slacker? I'm just asking for a favor—what's wrong with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! I can't be bothered with your nonsense. Handle your own damn mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Suit yourself then. Just don't come crawling to me for help later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! I damn well won't lift a finger. Sort it out yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Have it your way. See ya!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard your dad's at the tax bureau? Help me sort out my restaurant's tax stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That might be tricky to handle...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dilly-dallying! What's with the spineless hesitation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about courage, it's genuinely against regulations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Fine, forget it. Don't come crawling to me next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you dial down the aggression a bit...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aggression my foot! Talking to a useless waste like you is exhausting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Li, how's the material coming along? This could affect your scholarship eligibility, so be careful with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I'm worried about messing up—I'm feeling quite pressured.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, didn't we all do it? Just put in some extra hours and leave it in the office by tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, could I have one more day? I want to make sure it's thorough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Submitting early saves you trouble. Look at Zhang—he turned his in this morning. That's efficiency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to finish it tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Putting in effort pays off, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, Professor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, you absolutely must come to the team-building event - everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I really can't make it this weekend since I've got prior plans with friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you bail? It's such a shame you'd skip a team activity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I suppose I could try rearranging things to attend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No 'trying' - you need to be there. It'll be totally dull without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll shuffle my schedule then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. The vibe just won't be the same without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Little sis, I've got an important conference out of town next week and I'm really worried about Grandma. Would you be able to go take care of her for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, next week is really not convenient. The kids just got over being sick, and the house is still in disarray.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Little sis, you're her favorite granddaughter. Taking care of her right now isn't just kind, it's your responsibility. Our family values filial piety above all – you can't let everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Plus, her medicinal diet is crucial – it has to be prepared and taken twice daily on schedule. The doctor stressed this is vital for her recovery.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Medicinal diet too? That must take a lot of time to prepare... and I still have to...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the most meticulous among the younger generation; Grandma's counting on you. This is the kind of burden family takes on willingly; we can't shirk it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright then, Sis. I'll do my best to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you must go to the hospital today! Last time you said you would but never did.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm perfectly fine, isn't this just nonsense...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you really care about us, you ought to get regular checkups instead of keeping us in constant anxiety!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always saying such unlucky things...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If something really goes wrong, even if you don't care about yourself, we'll still be heartbroken over the medical bills!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I just can't win against you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've seen reason earlier! Why make people have to get harsh with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, your place is so big—let's just have the birthday party at your house! Stop dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, with so many people at home, it's really inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're such close friends—you won't even help with this small favor? That's so not cool!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid the noise will bother the neighbors and cause trouble later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you worked overtime, I covered for you all night. Now it's this hard to ask for a tiny favor? Isn't this what friends do—help each other?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll try to tidy up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal then! Clean it up properly—don't ruin everyone's fun!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Zhang, long time no see! What have you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, just hanging in there, busy with work stuff. How about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm job hunting right now. Would you be able to refer me for that opening at your company? No worries if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this is a bit tricky. I'm not sure my recommendation would make much difference.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, just thought I'd ask. Thanks anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let's catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The shop's opening this weekend and all the relatives are coming. You have to show up, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, my workload's piled up lately. Gotta work overtime this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on you coming. Won't it be disappointing if you're not here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not making excuses, the workload's genuinely overwhelming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your family had that celebration? I was the first one there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This time's special. I promise I'll make it next time, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one missing. It'd be such a shame if you skip it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, my kid's school transfer has me tossing and turning all night. You know people at the school, right? Could you ask around for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, things are strictly enforced these days. I really can't risk pulling strings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your nephew always says he wants to be like you. What a dream it could be if he got into that school.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I do feel for the kid, but this could land us in major trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any chance you could look into other options? The boy's quite bright.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I can ask about special talent admissions? Get your materials ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really appreciate it. The kid would be over the moon to hear this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind lending me your analog circuits textbook for a couple days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: In your dreams? I need it myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Shouldn't have asked you! I'll find someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Quit clogging up my space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You asshole! Don't ever touch my stuff again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think I care? Only a dumbass would want your crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there? Saw your work on Moments—it's so professional! My poster's a mess, and I must have you step in!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's jam-packed with projects lately, really can't help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't just leave a friend hanging in trouble, can you? I remember you saying pals should back each other up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been burning the midnight oil to meet deadlines, honestly at my limit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you needed cash urgently last time, I wired it straight over. Now that I'm stuck, shouldn't you pitch in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll finish it for you by Sunday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could rely on you! How about getting it to me before Saturday? I'll take you to that new Japanese spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you take a day off to come back on moving day? Your parents really miss you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably not, the project is in a crunch period and I'm swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There are quite a few large items at home. Your dad might struggle handling them alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I come back over the weekend instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll have finished moving by then. The main thing is we need someone home while the movers work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll talk to my supervisor about swapping shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'd be ideal if you could come, but don't push yourself if it's truly impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll do my best to arrange it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the one we're counting on for this family matter, after all you're the most resourceful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just covered medical expenses last month, my accounts are running on empty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Business is business between brothers, but family can't just stand by when things get tough, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me figure something out, I'll get back to you before month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hearing that puts my mind at ease—blood is thicker than water after all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just so we're clear, five thousand is my absolute max. Not a penny more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good man! The whole family won't forget this kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As family, you're obligated to co-sign. How can your conscience be clear if you refuse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the risks are enormous. I've got my own burdens to bear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dodging! Family must support each other - are you really this heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least let me consider it. This responsibility is crushing...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw considering! Refuse to co-sign and you're dead to me! Never call me family again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're cornering me here. Can't we discuss this rationally?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rational? You'll damn well co-sign or be branded an ungrateful snake! Go sign it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, help! My computer crashed and all files are lost. If I don't submit this report by midnight, I'm totally screwed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn... How come you always pull these last-minute disasters? I'm only halfway through my own PPT.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My head's pounding like crazy. At this critical moment, you're literally my only lifeline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but I need my materials for tomorrow's morning meeting too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last month when you were racing against deadlines? I pulled an all-nighter with you till 3 AM without hesitation...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Give me half an hour to wrap this up, then I'll take a look at yours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The reunion list is closing tomorrow, and you're the only one who hasn't confirmed yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped at home lately; things have piled up like a mountain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Lao Wang's dad dragged himself here after a stroke landed him in the hospital—if you skip this, what will the group think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that everyone's eager to meet up, but my situation's tough...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've all pooled money for the dinner and drinks already—if you bail, that cash goes down the drain, doesn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll mull it over again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: In ten years since graduation, you've only shown up twice—if you miss this reunion too, it'll truly shatter the guys' hearts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll try to carve out some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must change my schedule for next week! Handle it for me right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even realize how much loss a last-minute change causes us? You can't be this selfish as a human being!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the moral blackmail crap! You're in this industry to bear risks - now change it ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've never seen a client like you! Do you understand responsibility? You'll damn well pay the price difference by the rules!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Try me and I'll report your scam operation! Rules exist to serve customers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring it on! We won't cater to ill-mannered clients like you anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you do me a favor and grab me some lunch?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm swamped with this report and can't step out. Maybe you could order delivery?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, focus on your work then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really sorry about that, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, work takes priority.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're pressed for time, I could grab it after finishing this report?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need, just concentrate on your tasks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks boss!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Wang, it's scorching out here—could you really stand waiting in line? Since I'm in a rush, how about grabbing a ticket for me while you're at it? After all these years as neighbors, no need to be formal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, my old bones ache just standing here—hardly in any shape to fetch tickets for others!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're already in line—what's one more ticket? With decades of friendship between us, surely this little favor isn't too much to ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, you leave me no choice! But don't blame me if it takes ages!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do hurry up now—no dawdling! This is what neighborly support is about, wouldn't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good grief, all right already! Such nagging!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, would you consider signing as a guarantor for my friend's acquaintance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hell no! That's insane! Signing for a total stranger? You've got some nerve asking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure there's risk, but the responsibility falls on you. What the hell are you afraid of, you coward?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Are you out of your damn mind? Why should I take the risk? Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! So selfish! Won't even vouch for someone? Some friend you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piece of trash! That risk is sky-high! Find someone else to bother!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then! Won't lift a finger to help, you're nothing but a coward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you coming back for Mid-Autumn? If not, forget it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My boss scheduled me for duty, really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop dead on duty already! You're worse than a damn dog!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that supposed to mean? I mailed mooncake gifts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who wants that? Only you're missing at dinner, you cursed jinx!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I make up the leave and come back for National Day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beat it! Just seeing you makes my blood boil!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I won't book tickets then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, check out my new product video ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, spotted it, will watch later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's been super supportive, how come you've done zilch? Not very decent of you, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got tons of family stuff lately, genuinely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the sake of our friendship, you gotta back me up—don't make my trust in you worthless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll handle it soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure your comment shows real effort—no half-assed nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you scrolling through Weibo?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, just checking out some stuff, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quickly help me forward this post, I'm freaking out over here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's it about? I really don't want to share these kinds of things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to forward it! As a friend, it's your moral obligation. How can you be this selfish?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's toxic talk! I'm not doing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No forward, no friend! Can't you see this is about ethics? You're downright awful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the inspection is coming up, you have to work overtime tonight to get the documents done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my wife is sick, I need to go home to take care of her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You lazy slacker! Making excuses instead of being responsible! The team's about to fall apart—aren't you going to do anything about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant! I just genuinely have my hands full with family matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the excuses! If things go south in the inspection, it's entirely on you. Who do you think you are, being this selfish?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll see if I can find some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of that wishy-washy nonsense! You must be here tonight—don't even think about slipping away!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, can I borrow your car tomorrow? Got an emergency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do, I need it for a long drive myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But last time you borrowed my car, I agreed right away. Help me out this time, buddy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't - my wife needs it for the kids' pickup, not my call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah well, guess my favor doesn't carry much weight then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah don't say that - next time give me earlier notice and I'll sort it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, remember you said that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you find some time to visit my grandpa recently? Just play chess with him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about Wednesday afternoon? Though I can only stay up to two hours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you have time, could you cook him chicken noodle soup? Otherwise forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm terrible at cooking. Would ordering takeout work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, whatever works for you. I'll figure it out if you're unavailable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll bring some pastries. Really can't manage noodles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll treat you to dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given that Xiao Wang takes leave so often, can't you young and robust folks take on more?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm busy moving and working overtime daily—really don't have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: One ought to have a conscience—when everyone helped you before, did anyone complain about doing too much?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I covered for him three days last time and nearly lost a client—it was beyond frustrating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dragging your feet over such a small matter—how are we supposed to collaborate going forward? Fine, I'll talk to him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—I'll help once things settle down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, the data's messed up. Mind covering for me? I'll owe you one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Screwed up again? I ain't dealin' with your crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You in or not? Give me a straight answer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of my damn business! Fix your own mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Don't count on me for any future work support.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Save your cheap threats!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, would you mind lending me your review materials? I'm completely lost on what to focus on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My notes are right here. Maybe we could find some free time and I'll walk you through the key points?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every single day? I might not have that much time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Up to you—I can just highlight the crucial chapters for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I come find you every other day? Would that be okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, whatever works best for you is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tomb-Sweeping Day is coming up, and your grandpa was just saying yesterday how much he missed you and wondering why you haven't come home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project is in a critical phase right now. I really can't get time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your cousin (Aunt's daughter) visits every weekend, you know. The grandparents see that and get envious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try. Maybe I can arrange some compensatory time off later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're getting older. You really should spend more time with them at their age.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll figure out my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just let us know when you decide on a date. We'll save some qingtuan for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, it's time to pay the mutual aid fund. Haven't seen your contribution yet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are tight right now. Could I have a little more time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you the special one? Everyone else paid promptly. You have the nerve to hold everyone back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly struggling. Couldn't you all cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who doesn't have difficulties? This is an obligation! Stop being selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to pay, I literally can't scrape it together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must find a way no matter how hard it is. Want to become the target of everyone's backbiting?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Something big happened at home, help me fix the PPT now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut it out, I can't even finish my own work by 10 tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you took leave last time, I covered for you without hesitation. Quit pretending to be busy now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. But I can only spare half an hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Format the charts to the same standards I helped you with last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Send it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See how smooth things go when you cooperate sooner? Hurry up and send it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what have you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just drowning in work. Why do you ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The class reunion is all set. Everyone says it'll be pointless without you – you absolutely can't bail on us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly swamped right now, workload's insane.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Chen even flew back from out of town for this. Would you really snub him like that? That's downright inconsiderate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright fine, I'll try to get leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. The whole crew's banking on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll squeeze out some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you busy lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're having a family gathering next Sunday. You've gotta help out—it won't feel complete without everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't make it, already got plans with friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But everyone's counting on you! It'd really spoil the fun if you're not there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't squeeze out the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh well. Just remember next time, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, I want to quit and open an internet cafe—this industry has real potential.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: An internet cafe? I'd advise carefully weighing the risks; policies in this sector aren't stable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've done market research though—the target demographic has strong purchasing power.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your current job provides steady cash flow, while startup income could be unreliable initially.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I keep my job while launching the business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That workload might stretch you too thin. You'd need rigorous time management.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about a three-month trial run to test the waters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You could try that, but I'd recommend keeping your job. Just remember—you alone must shoulder the consequences of your choices.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's new campaign is live. Could you share it on your Moments if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I rarely post work-related content on my Moments, sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, it's completely voluntary. Those who share can enter a prize draw.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are the prizes for the draw?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: First ten sharers get ¥100 red packets, three others win souvenirs through a draw.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I share now, can I still qualify?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shares before 5pm count, ranked by screenshot time. Just participate if you'd like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My in-laws just called saying they really want us to come back for New Year's. They've been looking forward to it for ages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents miss me too. I really ought to spend time with them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Both sets of parents matter. Maybe we should brainstorm a better solution?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's quite a dilemma. How about we each visit our own parents this year?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you sure this arrangement would be proper?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me mull it over. We can finalize tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! I've been waiting for 50 minutes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We sincerely apologize and will handle this promptly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Handle my ass! Are you all just dead weight here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're experiencing high call volumes, could you please be understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap about understanding! I'll file a complaint if this drags on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me transfer you to a specialist immediately, just a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: More waiting? Is your entire company incompetent?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The specialist will take over right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie Wang, you're heading to the station to buy tickets, right? It's scorching hot out there—standing in line sounds miserable. Could you grab one for me while you're at it? After all, it's only right that neighbors look out for each other, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... my back's been acting up lately. I'm not sure if I can stand in line for too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you can take your time in the queue—no rush. (shrug) It's just one more ticket anyway. Helping each other out is the neighborly way, and that benefits all of us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, alright. I'll try my best. Give me the money first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great! You'd better head out early though—wouldn't want to miss your chance. Don't they say neighbors are like family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. This hot weather always brings extra troubles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, did you see that poll on Moments? Mind giving it a quick click for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saw it, but my feed's all relatives—not really convenient to share.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, just one click? Do me a solid—everyone else has done it, just you left!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright. I'll figure out how to do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Results are coming soon—I'm on pins and needles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Done. You're really invested in this, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's so sweet of you! I'll treat you to a meal sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come with me to my parents' for New Year this time! They've been desperately looking forward to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my parents are counting on me too. I can't possibly neglect them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other daughters-in-law go obediently without exception. Why must you be the difficult one? You're completely disregarding my parents' dignity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family situation is truly unique—I'm their only child, and my parents rely entirely on my care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't go, imagine how devastated they'll be! How could you possibly repay their years of sacrifice raising me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... after your words, I feel utterly suffocated. Trapped between impossible choices.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The tech department is understaffed. Kindly report there immediately without making excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I lack any technical expertise. Wouldn't my involvement hinder progress? Might we reassign this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This hindrance concern is unfounded. Your attendance is mandatory to avoid employment review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This arrangement seems impractical given my complete lack of qualifications.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you check for another time then? Or any suggestions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can take care of it the day after tomorrow, would that work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The day after tomorrow is fine, I'll adjust my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks for being understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, that's what relatives do for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, let's keep in touch if anything else comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Giving the bride a red envelope is for good luck—8888 is pretty common these days. How much are you planning to put in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As regular workers, that amount puts way too much pressure on us. Our salaries just can't cover it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't overburden yourself—just do what you can manage. The sentiment matters most, really.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about 2000 to show we mean well? It's just a token of good fortune anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 2000 works too—it's a lucky number. Honestly, the amount should depend on your situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, settled then. Thanks for being understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely overwhelmed with work right now. As my partner, you should understand that taking care of the child alone is your way of contributing to the family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm exhausted too! You can't expect me to handle everything on my own, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family responsibilities are like this. Can't you just think more about the child? This is crucial for their development.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you should pitch in sometimes too. It can't just be about talk of contribution.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't support me, what about our income? Contributing to the family is an obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to understand, but I hope things improve later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have some free time later to organize the supplies? They're still piled up over there unarranged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with a report right now, probably need to wait a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang and Xiao Wang have been at it for ages—it'd be really helpful if you could pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much longer for your report? Think I can wrap it up in half an hour?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Depends, but anyway the whole team's over there working on it together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll finish up ASAP and come help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure, just finish your thing first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just putting final touches on these materials then heading over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I've got a buddy who owes some money. Mind cosigning a loan for him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell? Do I even know him? Are you out of your mind asking me to vouch for a stranger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell's wrong with you? My friend's solid—what's the big deal cosigning? It's practically risk-free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Your friend's debt ain't my problem—quit trying to make me your damn patsy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
