turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck's sake, you selfish prick! I'm saying you could at least consider it. If you won't help, piss off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dumbass! Carry your own damn risks—stop bugging me with this shit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, guess I misjudged you. Help or don't—screw it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you come home for Tomb Sweeping Festival? The whole family misses you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been overwhelming lately, really can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You didn't come last year either – skipping again this time might not sit right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Flights are ridiculously scarce now, and tickets cost a fortune.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I get your ticket? At least make an effort to visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's midterms are coming up – gotta keep them on track.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't filial duties factor into your priorities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, everyone's posting baby photos on social media! At our age, we really should have one already. If we don't, the neighbors will start talking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't we agree to enjoy being just the two of us first? You suddenly changing your mind like this really puts me in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad look so anxious over video calls. Other people's grandkids are running around everywhere, but our parents don't even have a glimmer of hope to hold onto—doesn't that bother you at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're pushing forty without even securing a school district home! What exactly would we raise a child with right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at the Zhangs across the street—their situation's worse than ours! Didn't they still raise a perfectly healthy kid? Isn't bringing grandchildren into the family the whole point of honoring our parents?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every single argument drags filial duty into this, making me feel like I'm being an unreasonable adult...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard you're going to Guangzhou on a business trip? The wife cakes there are really popular, so bring some back for us to try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Time's too tight, I might not have time to buy any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Wang went on a trip, he went out of his way to bring some back for everyone—really thoughtful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try if it's convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When Li brought some last time, everyone praised him for being so considerate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see when it happens.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's never wrong to show a bit of care for colleagues, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to help me verify this batch of data today—I'm completely swamped!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm barely keeping up with an urgent task from the boss right now, honestly can't spare a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, after all these years working together—remember when I stayed up all night fixing your proposal last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe after I push through this workload? Might have some free time after 4 PM.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline's at 5! Shouldn't an experienced colleague like you be helping newcomers cut some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't—my task is even more time-sensitive than yours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: (Sigh) Fine, focus on your work then. I'll find someone else. Don't trouble yourself with my matters anymore.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll discuss it later. Let's leave it at that for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must attend the Zhang family's wedding banquet next month—you cannot skip this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work and have no time for such events—too many things demand my attention.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How utterly selfish! Can't even be bothered with family celebrations—you don't deserve to be part of this family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Stop harassing me with this nonsense—always nagging like it's life or death!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing to go makes you ungrateful! Everyone else attends such events—only you think you're so high and mighty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw this—your family affairs are none of my business, quit pestering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, don't come then. Don't expect us to lift a finger when your family needs help—we'll see who lacks conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Let's cut ties with such relatives—spares us the headache!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you grab lunch for me? I'm swamped with work and can't step out today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, what do you want? I've got nothing on this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just some dumplings would be great, thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Pork and chive filling okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, anything works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll go grab them now—back in a few minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a sweetheart for doing this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, don't mention it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, give me your ID card right now! It's urgent for the family, stop dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Again? What's it for this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit asking! Haven't I helped you enough before? Now it's your turn to repay me, sis!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But with all the scams lately, I'm really uneasy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would your own sister ever screw you over? Remember who bailed you out last time you were in trouble! Now you won't even do this little thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, take it. Return it immediately after using it, don't hold things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're absolutely obligated to help me move! That's what friends are for!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking kidding me? Last time I moved your shit, you didn't even buy me dinner!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends don't keep tabs on favors. Just tell me if you're showing up or not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! You always weaponize friendship – got any damn shame left?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you disrespect our bond like this? You WILL come!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bond my ass! I'm done with your manipulative bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Skip this and you're nothing but a disloyal bastard. Your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you and your demands! Don't you dare contact me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That darn cat scratched the sofa again! Fur everywhere, it's driving me nuts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll discipline it! Quit nitpicking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Discipline my foot! This place is filthy and stinks. How can you be this sloppy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your room's no better! Worry about yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should be reading books instead of keeping cats! What a loser!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your business! I like it this way!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Suit yourself! Don't come crying when the living room gets destroyed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't need your concern! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the inspection is coming up, so we need to work overtime tonight to sort out the documents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I have something on tonight; my wife is sick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always making a fuss! If the inspection goes wrong, can you handle the blame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not dodging responsibility; I'm truly tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, but don't expect anyone to cover for you, you good-for-nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll see what I can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it or not, just make sure the inspection doesn't hit a snag.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, my mom's nagging again, saying she'll worry herself sick if I don't find a boyfriend. Could you cover for me for a couple days? Pretend to be my boyfriend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That seems really strange... Fibbing to Auntie doesn't feel quite right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, look at Xiao Li – he helped a friend put on an act like this. We've known each other all these years, can't you just do me this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm mostly worried I'll mess it up and upset Auntie even more...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you really bear to see me get scolded every single day? If you won't even help me out with such a little thing, what kind of friend are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... But don't blame me if we get caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's a true bro! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, the community event is so lively—it'd be a shame if you missed taking photos. Everyone's hoping to see you there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm genuinely swamped this weekend—gotta take my family to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how much everyone loved your photos last time? They'll surely be disappointed if you skip this, won't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate the thought, but I can't possibly juggle the medical appointments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your family needed help last time, we jumped right in. Least you could do is show your face for everyone's event—that's what decent folks do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't delay the hospital visits—I need to be there start to finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Surely you can carve out just a moment? The whole crew's waiting, and it won't feel right without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then. I'll... try to shuffle things and swing by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I saw that bad review you left. Are you deliberately trying to ruin our small shop? Do you know how tough it is for us running a tiny business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I complain if the quality is crap? Why blame customers for your own lousy service?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut up! If you've got any conscience, delete that review now—our whole family relies on this shop. Are you trying to push us to jump off a building?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a joke! Is it my fault your stuff sucks? What the hell does it have to do with me that you messed up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so vicious? Keeping that review is downright immoral! Could you handle the fallout if our shop collapses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Handle responsibility my ass! Where were you before? Who's buying this pathetic act now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Final warning: Delete the review today or I'll harass you with calls daily. Let's see who cracks first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're insane! Blocked and goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, listen, I'm in charge of the product roadshow next week—you must get a bunch of your friends to come and support me, to help boost the scene!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Next week? My friends are all swamped; it might be tough to pin them down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of attitude is that! Aren't we as thick as thieves? My whole KPI hinges on this! Just having your pals show up is a no-brainer, and you're not even willing? That's downright ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about unwillingness—I'm honestly worried I can't rope anyone in... and it's not exactly earth-shattering, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not earth-shattering? Your stance is ice-cold! Remember all the times I've bailed you out? Now you're dodging a tiny favor—you can't turn into such a thankless snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... sigh, fine, I'll give it a shot. But no promises at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like a true brother! Keep in mind, skipping this means snubbing me and sabotaging my work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Ming, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting by, what's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandparents have their check-up next week. If you're free, mind accompanying them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Schedule's tight with the new project just launching.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll check if Xiao Li's available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If necessary, I'll see if Wednesday afternoon works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You focus on your work then - I'll circle back if we need you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old man, I saw this reishi spore powder—they say it makes you live to a hundred! Only fifty-eight thousand!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fifty-eight grand?! Are you insane? You actually believe this scam?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you know?! It's high-tech extraction! You've pinched pennies your whole life, yet turn stubborn when it's time to spend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Me? Stubborn? You're throwing money down the drain! Buy it yourself if you want—hands off my savings!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Fine! When you're bedridden someday, don't come crying to me! Ignorant fool!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the sick one! Got more money than sense! Cut the crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you free right now? Got something to discuss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what is it? Shoot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's birthday's coming up. Wanna throw the party in your backyard - plenty of space for the kids to run around, and the neighbors could use some fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, not great timing. My folks aren't feeling well and noise would bother them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kids are counting on this. Any chance you could make it work at another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this is tricky for me. Maybe another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, we'll figure it out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there, mind designing a poster for free? Friends should look out for each other, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with five projects right now, genuinely can't take on more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't mutual support basic decency between friends? Pushing back like this just isn't right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Client made me revise three times overnight and still isn't satisfied. I'm completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your rent deposit fell short, I lent you cash without hesitation. Shouldn't that spirit go both ways?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, expect it next Monday. Stop pressing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to get it to me by Saturday though – that's what real friends do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm thinking of spending New Year's at my parents'. What are your plans?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd like to go back to my family too. How about we each go to our own homes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year was at my family's place—it's only fair that this year should be your turn, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about taking turns then? We'll go to my family first this year?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but we need to agree upfront that next year we'll go to mine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, that's settled then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard you haven't been doing well lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I've been feeling pretty down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Down? You're always like this, no wonder nobody can stand you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you mean by that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It means you brought this on yourself - totally deserved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't want to hear this from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me, you'll never change anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, please help out! We've only got three orders left—if you don't step up, our team is doomed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Inspections are so strict now—what if something goes wrong during the operation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the team's senior member! If you don't lend a hand and the team collapses, who'll take responsibility? Everyone's counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be done by 9 AM tomorrow! The whole team's livelihoods are riding on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I'll push through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Brother Wang always knows what truly matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, those red eyes have been bothering you for three days now. Keeping a dog must have some impact on you after all, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh Dad, just some eye drops will do the trick. No need to overreact.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know, ever since Aunt Li downstairs sent her dog away, her kid's grades improved. That's something you might want to consider.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've been walking the dog daily for exercise lately. Honestly, it feels great.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mother's been tossing and turning all night worrying. The whole family's affected. Shouldn't we think this through more carefully?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just give me some time to figure things out. Can't just abandon him like that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your aunt's visiting soon, and you know how terrified she is of dog hair. We should be considerate of family, shouldn't we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... maybe we could board him at a kennel when Aunt comes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you consider voting for me for the Employee of the Year? I really put a lot of effort into this project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm still comparing candidates. Xiao Wang's performance metrics look solid too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand. But I did solve two major technical challenges this quarter—if you could keep me in mind, I'd appreciate it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... I need to think about it some more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just vote based on your best judgment. I'll treat you to bubble tea after the results come out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, you've got my vote.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li didn't come today, and you didn't even bother to check on him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't heard from him. Probably busy with something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: And you call yourselves close buddies? How can you be so heartless when it matters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess I did fall short on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at someone like Xiao Wang - so helpful last time! This cold attitude of ours is just shameful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll call him now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done that ages ago. Hurry up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, a few buddies and I are thinking about starting an arcade business—seems like a solid opportunity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh son, your mom's blood pressure's been spiking again. Now that we're old, we're counting on you to stay safe and not cause us worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just figured I should take a shot before turning thirty—who knows, it might actually work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Zhou's son upstairs—landed a house after just five years at the state-owned firm. Even your cousin treated his folks to a Sanya vacation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This dead-end job feels like prison—I'm suffocating here every single day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back in our day, we starved half the time! How can your generation be so ungrateful for what you've got?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I draft a business plan first? I'd really value your input.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit daydreaming! Just keep your steady job—haven't we parents suffered enough hardships for your sake?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd like to borrow your drone for a potentially hazardous activity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A hazardous activity? I'm concerned about equipment safety.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As colleagues, we have an obligation to support each other. You owe me this trust.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm accountable for the equipment. What if it gets damaged?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understand this is crucial for my work. You're obliged to lend it to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This still feels inappropriate to me. My apologies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I expect you to reconsider in light of our partnership.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've decided not to lend it. I hope you'll understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That bad review hanging there is really troubling. What do you think would be the best way to handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The product does have room for improvement. Perhaps we should optimize it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately with no time to breathe - wish I had some backup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't that approach come off as somewhat inappropriate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly the pressure's been crushing me lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what support I can offer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just knowing you understand already eases my mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll find a way to make it disappear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any progress on your dating life?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet, work has been keeping me too busy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know some great young people—want me to keep an eye out for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for now, I'm just enjoying the single life.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair enough, young people really value their personal space these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll naturally consider it when the right person comes along.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just let me know anytime if you need help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Starting tonight, we're on a 996 schedule. Don't even think about leaving until everything's done. Understood?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Overtime again? Do you think I'm some machine that doesn't need rest?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Quit immediately if you can't handle it. Three-legged toads are rare, but replaceable workers? Plenty around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bravo! Reincarnated as a sweatshop tyrant? Treating labor laws like decorations?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work or walk! Feel like forfeiting your paycheck?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you win! Karma's coming for you sooner or later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Darling, I've noticed many couples moving in together early, and they all say it really strengthens the relationship. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I'm a bit worried - what if we end up arguing more?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take Xiao Mei's case - they tried living together before marriage and now they're really happy. If we truly care about each other, we could take it slow, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my parents would lecture us nonstop if they found out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is just between us - we're only discussing it, no pressure. How does that sound?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I have a bit more time to consider?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Of course, tell me whenever you're ready. No rush at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll mull it over some more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, my tickets are stuck here, gotta figure out a solution quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: New rules are too rigid, my hands are tied on this end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your mom had surgery, I kept vigil for three days AND pulled strings for the doctor. Doesn't that count for anything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really not that I won't help, the manager's breathing down our necks checking the system daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang's team gets their orders sailing through smooth, but mine hits a snag? Don't you dare be an ungrateful wretch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Theirs are...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get this done by the day after tomorrow. How could you face a decade of brotherhood if you can't handle this small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad, I'm thinking of postponing the grad school exam for now. We've got way too many expenses at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful child! What do you think we've been pinching pennies for your education? Who exactly are you planning to let down by quitting now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The landlord hounded me about rent again yesterday... it's got me all tied up in knots.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li's kid passed the exam working construction by day and studying at night! You're our family's only hope to turn things around - and you want to chicken out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we're still over two thousand short for little brother's tutoring fees...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just focus on your books! We'd sell the woks off the stove to fund you. If you quit now, wouldn't all our years of suffering be completely wasted?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how much have you saved for my wedding gift? Counting on a big red envelope from you—don't be stingy and embarrass yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Just like that? You know I just lost my job! Be glad if I can scrape together eight hundred or a thousand! Don't expect me to play big spender!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, eight hundred? That's pathetic! Barely covers a pack of my cigarettes—you dare offer that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take it or leave it! That's all I can manage! Your wedding's none of my damn business! My showing up is a huge favor already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Guess this is all your friendship's worth. My mistake! Don't even bother coming—spares me seeing your measly self!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Better I don't come—saves me a grand! Couldn't care less anyway—your wedding means squat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, settled then! Keep your gift if you want! Won't miss your pathetic token of friendship—my wedding'll be grand without it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you vote for my kid? You're the only one who hasn't shown support yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped with work lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid really looks up to you and believes you'll back them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These online votes are just for fun anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think of it as giving the child a bit of encouragement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This constant nudging is putting pressure on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's waiting to collect everyone's well-wishes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, the inspection report must be finalized exactly as agreed - everyone's anxiously counting on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, the reality deviates significantly from the plan - won't this approach cause major issues?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think how tirelessly everyone's pushing lately - Lao Zhang pulling consecutive all-nighters. We simply must unite as one team.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I recognize their dedication, but...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given Lao Zhang's sacrifices, we owe it to them to deliver flawlessly. We can't squander their sweat equity, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Proceed per our arrangement. Rest assured the team will properly recognize your contributions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, regarding this data error, you need to bear responsibility on my behalf.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't the time to shirk responsibility, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're duty-bound to protect the team; helping me is fulfilling your leadership responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Responsibility can't be shifted like this, can it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must prioritize the bigger picture, or you're simply an incompetent leader.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That logic is truly eye-opening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come back for dinner this weekend, no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't this week, I have to work overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! After all we've raised you, all you care about is work? Have you completely forgotten your filial duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you cursing at me? I just visited last month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit your excuses! Skipping this visit proves you're unfilial - the whole neighborhood is laughing at our family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have to put that label on me? I'll come back if I can arrange time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go request leave right now, don't try any schemes with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Son, you've been sneezing nonstop. Keeping the dog indoors isn't really working out, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, some medicine will fix this. No need to go after the dog.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang's kid in the front building perked right up after rehoming their dog. What parent wouldn't want that for their child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Walking the dog counts as my morning exercise anyway. It's not that big a deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's losing sleep night after night. When both matter equally, how can you only think about yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I am working on solutions here...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandparents are moving in soon—their health is priceless. Shouldn't we younger generation consider this properly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll ask around for potential adopters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, can you do me a favor? Need to borrow your ID card as a reference for filling out this form.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh sure, but sis what kind of form are you working on exactly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just an info registration form for work. I'm worried about messing up the format.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all these data leaks happening lately, you sure it's safe sis?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll just copy the format. Won't take photos or keep copies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, just give it back to me when you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you seen that poll in the Moments? Hurry up and help out! Everyone's already voted, just waiting for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I saw it, but I don't check my Moments often. Can't be bothered with these things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal with helping out? Everyone's already done it, and you're just dragging your feet—it's driving me crazy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my Moments are full of bosses and colleagues. Posting this would be so awkward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're just one vote short! If you vote, we can win! Stop overthinking it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll take another look then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Lao Wang helped me out—if you vote, I'll send you a red packet! Can't you even help with such a small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you go to the supermarket and grab a crate of grapes? Immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's gotten into you? I'm busy as hell!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless! Would it kill you to get some damn grapes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got no legs yourself? Buzz off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jerk! Don't ever ask me for shit again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I'd want to! Block me, you idiot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No wonder a loser like you has zero friends!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my package arrived. Go downstairs and grab it for me right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell? I'm cozy in bed. Get it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Forgot when I got your takeout last time? Don't you know what gratitude means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the moral blackmail already! I just don't wanna go, period!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Won't even lift a finger to help? You're totally heartless! Don't you get basic roommate obligations?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Quit nagging! You just love slapping labels on people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! Either fetch my package now, or forget about ANY favors from me ever again. Your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it... You win. Send me the pickup code.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, you've got to help us figure out a solution for the child's schooling—I'm worried sick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The regulations are extremely strict nowadays, and I don't have any connections here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's grades are mediocre, yet we refuse to settle for a subpar school. It's making me terribly anxious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it doesn't work out, you should just move to a better district. Quit obsessing over shortcuts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With your extensive connections, why not lend us a hand if you can?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can do, but no guarantees.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, thank you ever so much! We truly appreciate your efforts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you have to come help with the move tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unfortunately, I have to travel out of town tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We old neighbors should look out for each other. If you don't come, I'd feel terrible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really have commitments and can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I ran errands day and night when your mom was hospitalized? A person shouldn't act like that, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... maybe I can rearrange things?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Good neighbors must support each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come help me look after my dog next week—it can't be left alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly swamped right now; my workload is overwhelming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you bear to let it go hungry? You won't even do this little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's unfair—I physically can't split myself in two.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that rushed to feed your cat overnight during your business trip? Isn't that what friends are for?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll try to make time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get on it quickly. The vet says it'll get depressed if left alone again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Stop throwing that in my face, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, I'm really struggling here. Could you let my friend crash for a few days as a favor? Have a heart!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't bend the rules, but our contract was crystal clear. You're putting me in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're being way too uptight! What's the harm in a month's stay? Even this tiny favor you refuse—imagine how the neighbors would judge your coldness!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not fair. If I make exceptions for everyone, how am I supposed to manage this property?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You seem decent usually, but now you're ice-cold! Do you even know how hard we laborers have it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't about coldness—rules are rules. If we ignore violations, there's no managing anything!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you scared people'll call you heartless? Everyone needs help sometimes—is lifting a finger too much to ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'm not being cruel. Get approval from the property office? Otherwise I can't explain this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, my store's traffic has been really slow lately, any chance you could help me figure out what to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The platform's cracking down hard on fake orders now, it's pretty risky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, if it's inconvenient just forget it, I'll come up with other solutions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I hook you up with a legit promoter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be awesome! I'll treat you to dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't sweat it, just sent you their contact info.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real one! Next round of BBQ skewers is on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey B, you there? Wanted to chat about the scholarship thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's so urgent? I'm kinda tied up right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A few classmates are really struggling financially—it'd be great if the scholarship could help ease their situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I've had my own struggles to get by, and the exams were no walk in the park.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just lend a hand if it's no trouble—no pressure though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll think it over. Happy to help where I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, buddy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's a family emergency and the PPT has to be submitted tonight. Could you help me polish it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My hands are tied with this jam-packed project schedule. Really can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, my PPT skills are just too lousy. Wish you were here to handle this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I glance over it after 7? But just quick formatting tweaks, nothing major.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! Promise it won't interfere with your real work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just send it over later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reliable as always! Definitely treating you to bubble tea next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, you have to help me with this leave guarantee thing. Other sisters agree without hesitation, you can't back out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't afford this. Guarantees are too risky – if something goes wrong, I'm left holding the bag.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I work late every single night, and my own sister won't lift a finger? My heart sinks. Don't you feel for me at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasn't the last guarantee trouble enough? Think about me for once, will you? This stress is giving me gray hairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that what family's for? Helping each other? If you won't help me now, don't come looking for me when you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I honestly can't. Try Second Aunt. I just can't handle this pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Should've known strangers are more reliable when it counts. I'll just manage on my own!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You get busy. I need to pick up the kids from school.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I borrow your car tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got fieldwork tomorrow, so it's not really convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why do you always refuse? I'll just ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not rent one yourself? Must you borrow mine?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! I'll just ask Lao Zhang.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just go already, stop bothering me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, can't even count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, you should come help with this move—that's what real friends do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I might be tied up this weekend with work commitments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's only right for friends to support each other—you must adjust your schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, let me check how my calendar looks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hope you truly understand the responsibilities between friends—don't let our plans fall through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll make time next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not bad, just spit it out if you need something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been coughing all night, can't sleep, crying while looking at your photo. How could your conscience be clear not visiting her as her son?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the project crunch time, literally can't break away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm running myself ragged between work and the hospital every day. Mom's even worried about disturbing your work—with her thinking of you like this, how could you live with yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The mortgage pressure's crushing me, barely keeping up with overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to come this Sunday! Mom's aching to see you—how could you bear making her wait like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll try to swap shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Starting a business again? Haven't you paid back the money you lost last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit raining on my parade! This time it'll definitely work out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work out my ass! Look how stable Xiao Wang's job is!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own business! Stop meddling in my affairs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Don't come crying to us when you lose everything!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry! I'd rather starve than beg you for help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you've got the guts, get out now! Sick of seeing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'm leaving! Who'd want to stay in this crummy home anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you attend tomorrow's team-building event?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies, I have some family matters and might not be able to join.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, but the event is voluntary, so it's entirely your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This time it's a conflict, I'll aim to be there next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, if you need any assistance, just say so.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding—do I need to prepare anything beforehand for the event?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, take care of your family things; all materials are set.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, wishing the event a smooth run.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, what are you up to? I've got this health insurance to recommend - great for safety, perfect for family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, insurance? Don't really need it, risks are low.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you stupid? Don't even get basic safety? You'll regret it when disaster strikes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with you? My risks are my business, I handle my own safety.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Only a damn fool would skip coverage and dodge responsibility - enjoy your risks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not buying. I'll manage my own risks. Responsibility is personal, not about family ties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever then. Your safety, your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hand over the drone, I need it for bungee jumping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Who pays if it crashes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Are you lending it or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No. Last time you borrowed my lens, it got dented.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tightwad! No wonder you're still stuck being poor after all these years!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say whatever you want. It's my equipment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Don't you dare come asking me for favors later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, how are those documents for tomorrow's inspection coming along?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't manage today—my wife's bedridden with a high fever and I need to rush home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, but our team's project can't be delayed. What's your plan here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are chaotic at home—I genuinely can't spare any bandwidth.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, everyone's on edge. This might fall through without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to squeeze in some time to handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! We're counting on you—it's in the bag with you on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, mind if I stash my furniture in the hallway for a few days? My place is a total wreck - can't you do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's really not feasible. The hallway's common space; blocking it would force everyone to detour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as neighbors, if you won't help me who will? Look how you're acting - you're making me lose face here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about unwillingness, but rules are rules. If this escalates, we'll both face penalties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just three days max, I'll clear it out promptly. Show some compassion for an old pal, won't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two days absolute maximum. If it's not gone by then, don't blame me when I call security!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, getting the runaround over such a tiny favor... it's downright disheartening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you've got to come to the get-together next month! Everyone talks about you all the time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's such a hassle. Round trip takes at least two days. It's tough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang is flying over from Shenzhen just for this! If you don't come, everyone would feel terrible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's at a critical stage right now. I really can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You skipped Xiao Li's wedding last time, and the group took note. It'd really not be very nice if you missed this one too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Distance is really the issue here. I need to think it over carefully.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old colleague reunions are so rare! Everybody's waiting eagerly for you. What's a group photo without you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to move things around then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to help me out with this legal mess I'm stuck in!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, can't deal with your damn thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your conscience? Family's supposed to help each other! How heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the guilt trip! Handle your own damn mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful bastard! Who bailed YOUR family out back then? Pretending we're strangers now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Last time I help you. Such a goddamn nuisance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, how much are you planning to give for the wedding gift?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 500. I've got a lot of expenses lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm thinking of rounding it up to 1000. Could you chip in a bit more?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't swing it—my mortgage payment's due next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll find someone else to chip in with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks. I'll make it up to you at your next event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries. I understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I went through hell to save this outfit for you. Is this how you repay me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I really can't accept it. My closet is already overflowing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I wouldn't even give this to Xiao Liu when he begged! If you refuse now, don't come crying to me later. Don't you know how much I care for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe give it to Auntie's kid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! I set this aside specially for you, and you throw my kindness back in my face? Take it now or don't you ever call me 'sis' again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll take it. Don't be mad, sis.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Quick! Handle my thing first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the rush? Don't you know how to queue? Get to the back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nonsense! My damn train is leaving! Can't you see I'm carrying stuff?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell is it to me if the train leaves? Rules are rules! Can't wait? Then get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Crappy service! Who'd ever come back here? How much for expedited? Move it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fifty! Take it or leave it! Don't block the way if not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Highway robbery? Fucking hurry up and do it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fifty! Pay up! Less talk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, quit dawdling and come toast!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I really can't drink anymore...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic! What's the damn point of keeping a useless drunk like you on payroll?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry sir, I'm trying my best...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sick of seeing you. Get out and sober up, so help me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll go right away...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Disgraceful! Even a dog could hold its liquor better than you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...My apologies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaobao came home in tears, saying you were the only parent absent from the meeting and all his classmates laughed at him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project deadline's breathing down my neck—how could I possibly make time? You should've just gone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The homeroom teacher pointedly asked Xiaobao if his father didn't care about him—now the poor kid won't even lift his head.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been pulling all-nighters back-to-back lately, I'm completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every other parent was huddled with their child while Xiaobao sat alone shrinking in the corner—doesn't that shred your heart as his father?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't tell me you don't care! But if I lose this job, how are we supposed to cover our expenses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All those parents managed to show up—what makes you so special? Imagine what this does to our child's self-worth!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, fine. I'll swap shifts and go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The betrothal gift money is your responsibility to prepare - that's the fundamental duty of a child.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, my savings aren't enough. Could you lend me the money temporarily?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tradition must be upheld. As the eldest daughter, you must bear this responsibility. Making us pay would be unfilial.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I just paid the down payment and genuinely can't produce 300,000 yuan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All our relatives are watching. This isn't negotiable. Show your filial devotion now - don't disappoint us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I take a loan? But the interest rates are too high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cash only - that's the rule. After all these years we've invested in raising you, we deserve some return.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood... I'll find a way to scrape it together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, money's a bit tight at home right now. Since you're making us so proud, don't you think you should help shoulder some of the burden?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, that sounds complicated. I'm worried I might mess things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other people's children help their families. With all that education, who else will look out for us if not you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll ask friends if they know any solutions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good child, finally acting responsibly. That puts our minds at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I suppose I'll try, but I really need to consult someone first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I don't want a formal wedding. Let's just have a simple destination marriage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How come? Traditional customs matter, shouldn't filial piety be considered?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think simplicity's better. What's the point wasting money?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then at least consider your duties, but it's your call—maybe simpler is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, traditions aren't absolute rules. Practical and straightforward is best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just think how to show filial respect. We'll respect your decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How come you're glued to your phone again? Shouldn't you be studying? Don't you get that the whole family is banking on you to make it big!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I even take a quick break when I'm exhausted?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tired my foot! Your parents are barely scraping by to put you through school—if you don't make top three, you're just a thankless ingrate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you please stop bringing this up all the time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must finish three practice tests today! Or else you're nothing but an ungrateful bastard we've raised for nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll go do it, okay...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, I want to quit my job to open an internet café with friends—the gaming industry has solid prospects.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's irresponsible to the family! As the eldest son, you must keep your corporate job to uphold our family's honor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I want to seize my youth to try entrepreneurship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all our family's investments in you, bearing this responsibility isn't optional—it's your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My current role has zero growth potential.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stability trumps everything. Children should appreciate their parents' sacrifices—that's basic morality.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least let me draft a business plan to explore?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Plans are worthless. You will keep working to support this family—that's non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, what have you been up to lately? I've got this excellent health insurance package reserved just for friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Insurance? I'm feeling fantastic health-wise right now, so I don't really see a need for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My colleague Xiao Wang just signed up; last month he got fully reimbursed for a cold hospitalization. If you're interested, you might want to consider the options.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finances are a bit tight at the moment; can we hold off for a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries; I'm just tossing out a suggestion to see if there's a plan that fits your situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, send me the materials later, and I'll check them out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, I'll send it over to you on WeChat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you heading out soon? If so, could you grab my package for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm pretty beat today, might need to rest a bit before going down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, my legs are acting up. Remember last time you needed something? Didn't I get it for you right away?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... alright. Just give me a minute to wash my face, then I'll go?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! This is what mutual support looks like! I'll even wait by the door for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, since you put it that way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! It's barely out of your way anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just send me the pickup code.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, could you please write a recommendation letter for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've noticed you've been quite busy lately, and I don't have a full grasp of your situation across all aspects yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This opportunity is really important to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's convenient, could you share more about yourself? That would make it easier for me to put pen to paper.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got too many classes recently and I'm worried about taking up your time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Time can always be worked out, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll set something up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really need to borrow your car tomorrow. It's an emergency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid I can't spare it right now. I need to use it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't afford any delays on my end. Could you help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Just make it quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! Knew I could count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you return it before noon? Got things to do this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely! You're such a good sport.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you ought to give me a ride to and from work since it's on your way anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't very convenient for me; I often need to leave early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't colleagues support each other? Do you really lack that basic dedication?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone has their own difficulties, isn't that a bit much to ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is a colleague's obligation. Starting tomorrow, you must wait for me punctually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you considered my feelings when making this decision unilaterally?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True colleagues ought to be willing to make such sacrifices. I hope you understand that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I genuinely can't accommodate this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, any chance you could spare some cash? Need to borrow twenty grand for a couple months.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a lot going on at home lately, probably can't scrape together that much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, whatever you can spare is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm good for eight grand tops—that work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That helps! I'll pay you back first thing next payday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush, get your situation sorted first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you be interested in pursuing this internship opportunity?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have some reservations; the content doesn't quite align with my interests.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's good to have multiple options, but it really depends on your preference.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think I'll compare it with other opportunities first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's your decision, but internship experience is always useful after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll give it serious thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, whatever you choose in the end, I'll respect your decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
