turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and refer me internally, I've sent you my resume.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your qualifications are too weak to even bother with a referral.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Are you fucking blind? I got straight A's in last year's performance review!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bragging about such obviously fake credentials? Do you think our HR are idiots?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, no referral then. Quit playing the big shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost, stop wasting my damn time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trash company acting all high and mighty - wouldn't join even if you begged on your knees!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Having a third child is your duty—it's the only way to uphold our virtuous tradition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we just bought a new house; the mortgage pressure is crushing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elders yearn for grandkids every single day. Disappointing them is downright unfilial.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But after my last C-section, the doctor warned my uterine wall is dangerously thin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the sake of our family's wholeness, you must overcome these hardships. That's what being a parent demands.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need time to think this through—I'm truly not ready now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents keep pushing me to get married. Do you happen to know anyone suitable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely tied up with wrapping up this project, even working weekends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know you're busy, but I really don't have many options myself. You've got a wider circle than I do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mostly worried that a careless introduction might just waste your time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being single this long does make me a bit anxious, but no pressure on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll keep an eye out after things calm down next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Lunch is on me sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's been coughing nonstop, I've been running to the hospital every day and can't focus at work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What mother would neglect her child? I pulled three straight days last time - just take leave for work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss needs our proposal this week. Taking leave now is like walking into the line of fire, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if the kid develops pneumonia? Work can always be caught up, but you've only got one child.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll swap shifts with a colleague for two days. Worst case I'll get some pay docked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Haven't all moms pushed through this? Only when your child recovers will you feel settled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, I'll go revise the PowerPoint now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, can you do me a favor? My medical reimbursement is stuck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just switched jobs recently, and my new workplace won't approve any leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You remember helping Lao Ma with this before, right? I've literally got no one else to ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was only because it was on my way... Maybe hold off for a while longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The doctor said they'll cut off my meds if I don't pay up soon... considering how close we are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could rely on you! I'll take you out for dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me check what documents are needed first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bride price is no small matter - proper etiquette must be observed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, I've just started working and have little savings. I really can't come up with 300,000.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Li family's daughter got married last year - now that's what I call a decent ceremony.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She married into a rich family. I'm just a regular office worker...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After raising you all these years, your parents have been hoping for nothing more than this day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Taking out loans would put too much pressure on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's make sure the wedding goes perfectly first. We'll figure out the money situation later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh... I understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm coming to your city next month. Mind if I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, my wife's in postpartum confinement and you wanna impose?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Can't even do me a solid? Remember all those free meals I bought you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Digging up ancient history? Get a damn hotel!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too broke to host an old classmate? Pathetic much?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking rich boy! Go flex at a five-star instead of mooching here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trash! Just wait till I tell everyone at the reunion!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! Like we'd miss your sorry ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm still thirty grand short on my sales target. Go cook the books for me now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: In your dreams! Got no hands of your own?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! What good are you if you can't even help with this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're so damn good? Do it yourself! One more word and I'll smack you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic coward! Scared of fudging some numbers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Annoy me again and I'll report you for cheating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spineless worm! Don't even think about touching my computer ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old classmate, could you handle this reimbursement for me? Your company should be easy with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What expenses? I just sorted it out for you last week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should we really keep score on favors? Back in college, when you were struggling most, I helped you through it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finance is cracking down hard...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we care about saving face? Why are you avoiding such a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me lay out the situation...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It has to be reported by end of day after tomorrow—as an old classmate, you owe me this duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, cover for me right now—I need to take leave this afternoon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't, they're cracking down hard lately, nearly got fired last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, you won't even help with this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to, but the team lead already warned me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your mother-in-law was hospitalized, I covered everything! Now you're giving me the runaround?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll try. But no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what friends are for! I'll treat you properly later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but don't blame me if the boss doesn't approve.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, Nini had such a great time playing today, she was smiling all along.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's quite happy indeed, though my schedule's a bit tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How do you feel about her usual activities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I manage, but work keeps me swamped with overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She still remembers clearly the last time you played with her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's good to hear. I'll see what I can help with when I get a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you for keeping her in your thoughts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best, need to sort things out first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family's pressuring me about marriage till I've got a headache. You've got a wide social circle—help your brother find someone suitable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been working overtime till 10 every night lately. Can barely handle my own stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know you've got it rough, but you're the only one I know with connections. You've got your ways, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly worried I'll mess things up. I'm swamped myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this goes on, I'm going to be driven crazy by their nagging. You're my last resort here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll see if any friends are available when I get a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real one! I'll treat you to a feast later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, help me expense this since your company covers it anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the expense this time? I just processed one for you last month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all we've been through? How could you forget who helped you when you were dirt-poor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Company audits are really strict these days...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Being this ungrateful, huh? You're such a jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can we just talk properly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I demand this gets done by tomorrow! Or this friendship is over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, are you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's got you in such a hurry?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You do understand family obligations, right? Getting my niece an internship is only natural – don't even think of refusing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Easy for you to say! I don't have time for this headache!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not acceptable! You must help. This internship is a moral imperative – a neighborly duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why on earth should I? How unreasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making excuses is immoral! Securing internships is your responsibility. Can't even lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll try. But don't get your hopes up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you cover my shift? Something came up at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh, I've got plans too. Does it absolutely have to be me covering?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're single with flexible time - as a colleague you ought to help. This is our mutual support obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... everyone has their own commitments. I can't just take shifts casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team spirit demands you shoulder this responsibility. You must cover today or the entire team suffers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand supporting the team, but why must I be the one to cover?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! We all have a duty to fill in for each other - agree to it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. Let's just get it over with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, could you help transfer my spot for that training course? I can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? I'm pretty swamped lately, afraid I don't have time to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the attitude? Didn't I help you out when your project was stuck? You won't even do such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't, I'm just worried I might screw it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't drag your feet! Are you helping or not? If not, don't even think about coming to me next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll take care of it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, been swamped lately? Haven't heard a peep from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's here for cousin's wedding except you, her own blood brother. Auntie's been asking about you for days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been buried in overtime lately. Not sure I can get time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt flew back specially on leave. Everyone's waiting to see you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin put so much thought into your wedding favor. She'd be crushed if you didn't come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's an event at the institute tomorrow, feel free to drop by if you have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I simply cannot agree.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. But it's disappointing how you're dragging your feet over a simple favor between us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my computer screen went black. Could you take a look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I care about your computer? Call customer support yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless moron! Charged me five hundred for reinstalling Windows last time, and now you're playing dead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, you think I've got nothing better to do? That's the market rate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lousy skills and still charging money? Screw this, I'll fix it myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Before you start treating me like your damn free repairman!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you free to talk now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sort of, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm hosting an event next Sunday. You must come support me - as family, this is your sacred duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might be tied up, got other commitments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This affects our family's honor. You must come fulfill your obligations as kin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not what I meant, but genuinely can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Skipping this? You're betraying fundamental morality. Choose wisely.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, would you mind helping me forward something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, what is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This link here, it's about a charity event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll check it out and forward it shortly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you get around to forwarding it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just did. All taken care of.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a bunch! You're a lifesaver!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could we possibly borrow the meeting room? We're in a bit of an emergency here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I've just scheduled a video conference with my client...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just half an hour! The whole team's waiting, and we'd have prepared all these materials for nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hiss... my client's quite significant too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been preparing for this for two whole weeks. Missing today means we'd have to postpone everything again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll reschedule for tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Knew we could rely on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it perfect timing to use that new camera you bought? Uncle's family gathering is this weekend. You should pitch in and take photos—you're the best photographer in the family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, really can't make it. Got tons of work before next week's business trip. I'm swamped with overtime these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mom already told me you'd definitely help. Won't you contribute to such an important family obligation? Everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's got me pinned down... my boss is breathing down my neck about deadlines.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weren't you always so eager to help the family before? If you skip this, everyone will be so disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm truly tied up... How about I get a friend to shoot? I'll edit the photos later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Photos must go in the group chat that same day! Get someone reliable lined up pronto—don't you dare drop the ball.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...alright, I'll ask if a colleague can cover for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, doesn't your department have recommendation positions? Could you give me an internal referral?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, we do have openings lately, but the requirements are pretty demanding. I need to see if you fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just refer me if you think I'm suitable. Don't push yourself if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I glanced at your profile—you're quite capable, should be fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks buddy! Whether it works out or not, I'll treat you to dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No big deal, just a small favor. I'll shoot you a message once it's submitted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, do me a solid and fake-marry me to get my family off my back—you absolutely must consider this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way, I can't stomach this sham marriage idea. I won't just agree casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you were any kind of friend, you wouldn't bail. You're doing this, period—otherwise you're just plain irresponsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Irresponsible? I've got my own life to think about! This demand is beyond ridiculous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! This is basic friendship duty—just say yes and quit stalling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My answer's final. Back off—I can't handle this pressure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Can't even lend a hand for something this small? Pathetic excuse for a friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my package arrived, go grab it from the parcel locker for me now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't right now, why can't you get it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Neighbors should help each other! How can you be this selfish?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the moral blackmail! Do I owe you anything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help with such a small favor? Are you even human? Don't you know 'Blood is thicker than water' applies to neighbors too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Get it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't you dare come crawling to me next time your family needs something, you ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Like I'd ever need your help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're short on people for the event. Are you free to join and make up the numbers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've made plans to be with my family that day, so I probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see. That's a bit of a shame.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't spare the time, sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll check with Xiao Zhang instead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hope you all have a great time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, we'll catch up another time when it works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm strapped for cash—lend me twenty grand for an emergency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mortgage is killing me this month—seriously can't spare it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Asking you for money feels like begging for my life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that supposed to mean? Do I owe you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Consider me blind for ever knowing someone like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Figure it out yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cover my shift Saturday, got an emergency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't, I've got plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll ask around then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe try finding someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll figure it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, next time give more notice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, if you have time, could we prepare the social security paperwork?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, those documents are in the bedside drawer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about Wednesday for handling it? If not, we can reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wednesday might be rainy—maybe Friday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, whatever works for you. I'll take leave to go with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I appreciate it—these old bones aren't what they used to be.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, happy to help. I'll pick you up Friday morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really need to secure this internship opportunity; I've been overwhelmed lately and it's stressing me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need it too, let's all strive for it together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were in trouble, I helped without hesitation. You owe me for that, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember you helped me, but regarding the internship...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With our friendship, supporting each other is only right. You wouldn't let my help go unreturned, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think fair competition benefits us all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fairness matters, but friendship should count for more than an internship opportunity, don't you think? Give it some thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, this school-district house location is pretty decent, and it's close for the kids to get to school. Maybe we should think about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, it's convenient, but the down payment is short by quite a bit, and the monthly mortgage payments would be stressful. I'm worried we might not keep up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents did say they could help out a bit, so let's take it slow and not rush.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, it's nice that they care, but I still think we should hold off and see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else has already upgraded to new homes; if we don't hurry up, won't we be in trouble later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, let's not force ourselves too much. Those high monthly payments are really daunting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, then let's put this on hold for now and revisit it when we have more money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property manager is chasing the fees again. Since you're here, could you conveniently settle it? Everyone's waiting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Should tenants pay this? It's not mentioned in the contract.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See how all the other tenants pay proactively? Settling it helps maintain a better environment, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't that be the landlord's responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we keep stalling and they cut off utilities, what a hassle that'd be. Don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll pay it for now just to get it over with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm caught up in a legal dispute—you absolutely must help me with this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's been insane lately, genuinely can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family's supposed to support each other—are you seriously going to stand by and do nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, this case is way too complex for me to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're blood relatives! If you won't help me, who will? This is your damn responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come photograph the community event this weekend! Don't let the equipment go to waste since it's all ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't. Booked with a client meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who's the busybody now? Last time I saw you lazing around the complex for hours!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was work reconnaissance. No need to be so aggressive.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aggressive? With your skill level, putting on airs? Shooting free events is an honor for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! My time's mine to spend as I please.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Stop polluting the neighborhood group feed with your trash photos!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Block me and save the breath.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Haidian paperwork needs handling. Are you available to make a trip?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's quite a trek from Tongzhou, and my schedule's packed this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. If you're free next week, shoot me a text?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next Tuesday should work. Mind sending me the materials?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Sending them to your inbox now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Received. I'll head over Tuesday morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, man! I'll treat you after it's done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it—just a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my roof suddenly started leaking and I can't stay there. Could I crash at your place for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd love to help, but my place is jam-packed with friends who just arrived.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is awful - work's been terrible too, and now I've got nowhere to stay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know you're in a tough spot, but there's genuinely no space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about just two days? I'll sleep on the couch and won't be any bother.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright, but three days maximum.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much, you're really a lifesaver.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then pack your things and head over quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, the hospital's pressing for payment again, and the old lady's condition has been worsening...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the situation now? How much do they need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's eight thousand... We've known each other for decades, hate to bring this up but I'm out of options.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just paid my daughter's tuition last month, cash is tight here too...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but didn't I chip in when your girl was moving up to better school? This is what old friends do...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wait till month-end... I'll see what I can shuffle around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director Zhang, you've got to come to next week's gathering. Everyone would be so disappointed if you were absent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a packed schedule next Friday; doubt I'll make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang and others have already committed to the whole event. If you skip this, team morale will totally tank.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's prepping for exams—I absolutely must stay home to support them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parents shouldn't hover over kids nonstop—give them space. But skipping this gathering? Folks'll think you're blowing it off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... guess I'll shuffle things around then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're talking! Gotta show face at all three events for people to feel you're truly committed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Niece, do me a favor and take event photos for your uncle, since you've got professional gear anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid I can't make it next week—got a business trip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should come before work! Even your mom promised you'd help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, my schedule can't be changed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help when an elder asks? This isn't how we raise our family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I stay up editing the photos for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Email them by Sunday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you free? I need to ask you a favor—could you watch my dog next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I'm swamped with this project right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't friends help each other out? That poor dog has nowhere to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but I'm genuinely tied up. Maybe ask someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you moved, I took time off work to help. You owe me this one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to shuffle my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must help! How could you possibly be heartless enough to abandon a living creature?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but this is the last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you promised to get your checkup today—can't put it off again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aiya, this old body knows its own limits. Nothing serious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't go, I won't be able to focus at work. How can I feel settled?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those checkups cost so much... such a waste of money...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is money more important than your health? We can only feel at ease when you're healthy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll go...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's a sensible way to think!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom needs someone to accompany her to tomorrow's check-up. You're the only one who can take leave, so get it arranged ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's at a critical phase! Taking leave now would be suicidal. Why can't you go instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom talks about you every day and pins all her hopes on you. Last time I brought her home, she wouldn't stop praising you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who took Mom out for her birthday last time? Me! Now it's your damn turn!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could your job possibly matter more than Mom's health? Seeing you is the only thing that'll ease her mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll head over this afternoon, satisfied?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it - exactly how a proper child should behave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, are you free this weekend? Wanted to borrow your car if possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weekend? Afraid I'm tied up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all! Just checking your availability. I'll figure something out if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe when exactly do you need it? Let me see my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sunday morning? Don't worry, I promise I'll drive super carefully.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, but come pick it up early, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Thanks so much for the help, Auntie!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, remember to vote for me in this performance review. Everyone's watching - skipping my vote means disrespect!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I haven't decided yet. Lao Wang's performance has been pretty solid too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! We eat lunch together every damn day and you're hesitating? Don't you understand basic loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chill out, shouldn't votes reflect actual performance...

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you possibly arrange something? Everyone's really looking forward to this.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's quite tricky - maybe you could find another venue?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, just forget I mentioned it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate your understanding! I'll treat you to dinner next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, we'll catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My computer won't start. Could you take a look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't today, swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll find a repair shop then. You free this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saturday afternoon works. What's going on with it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It keeps rebooting. No rush though, focus on your work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll bring my tools Saturday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Zhang, every family installs cameras to watch their kids—we must hurry up and do it too. What if something happens? Where's the responsibility of being parents?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Won't monitoring the kids like this make them think we don't trust them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Someone who loves their kids like you shouldn't be so clueless. With society this chaotic, skipping cameras means abandoning your child's safety. Is that what a responsible parent does?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But... I still feel awkward about spying on kids like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on! If you don't install it, people will say you don't care about your child! What kind of loving parent hesitates like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. When can you come install it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it—now you sound like a proper loving parent. Installing cameras is basic responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, what're you up to at home? Mind if I borrow your kitchen?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh Xiao Zhang, kitchen's free. What's the matter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My pot's broken, need to borrow your spot for stewing soup. Neighbors oughta help each other out, right? You're obviously free anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... I still gotta cook my own meal...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't take long! Someone as big-hearted as you gets helping neighbors. Can't just let me come for nothing, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, use it then. But don't drag it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton Brother Wang! Neighbors like you make everything so easy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, since you're just sitting idle at home anyway, you have to come to my shop this weekend to fill the crowd as family support!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need to shuttle my kid to tutoring classes this weekend—really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is your precious child the only one that matters? If you won't help family, do you even qualify as family? Ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you insult me? I genuinely can't free myself up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! You're the most selfish in the whole family—refusing this favor makes you unworthy of being kin!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even listening to reason? Twisting kinship into a weapon for your commercial event!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't show, we're done! See who helps you next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and grab my package! It's about to get ruined in the rain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you see it's pouring buckets out there? What's the big rush?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who carried you to the clinic at midnight when your stomach was killing you? Forgotten already?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My shoes are all mesh – they'd get completely waterlogged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So why'd I even bother helping you back then? Just wasted effort?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! You're impossible to deal with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call being a decent friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I'm fretting about attending the wedding next month without a decent watch. Yours looks quite suitable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? That one was a gift from my dad; I don't usually wear it much. Maybe check out other options?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, true. Mainly I thought your watch pairs perfectly with a suit, but I was just asking casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So when's the wedding? Is it a big crowd?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next Saturday, just some old classmates. Don't worry about it, I'll figure something else out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about... I come along with you then? And I can also keep an eye on the watch for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, Grandma's seriously ill and I've got a business trip next week. You'd go keep her company, wouldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's down with a cold, Sis. The house is a complete mess right now—I'm really in a bind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Grandma raised us both. How could you possibly not visit her when she's sick like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The doctor stressed the meds must be administered exactly on time—even a minute late drastically reduces effectiveness. This isn't something to take lightly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That complicated? I've been swamped this week...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma's counting on you—who else has your sense of filial duty? If you don't go, I won't feel at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, Sis... I'll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you save me a seat tomorrow morning? Preferably in the first row.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably not, I might be running late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, so you're basically unwilling to do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Believe what you want, I simply don't have the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ha, you're unbelievable. Now I see your true colors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Can't be bothered with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, are you busy right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're having a gathering next Sunday. The family all said they'd come to help. If you're free, you should come too — the more the merrier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got plans that day. Probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, everyone's looking forward to you coming. If it's really not possible, we'll just have to manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to push that thing aside.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, do what you think best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I absolutely can't miss this training session. You're young with plenty of opportunities ahead—let me take this spot first, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've been waiting ages too. This doesn't seem fair at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know how tough things are for our family. This training solves our immediate crisis—as my sister, you should be more understanding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But...this isn't some trivial matter for me either...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's depending on me! If you don't yield, Mom will lose sleep over this again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...I...I'll figure something out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, got a minute? I'm subletting my place—mind mentioning it in the main group chat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with overtime lately, might miss messages sometimes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, but the timeline's tight. If it's no hassle, could you do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would that delay your tenant search?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, it's fine. Your post would actually work wonders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll toss it in the chat when I get a chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, grab me some milk from the supermarket, you lazybones.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off, who cares? I'm busy gaming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trash! Too busy my foot—can't even do a simple favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the trash! Buy it yourself—none of my business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself. Get out of my sight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already—quit bugging me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, don't expect any favors from me ever again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Do what you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely gotta get me those tickets tomorrow—this show means the world to me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it, I'm on a business trip that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you chased sneakers, I didn't bat an eye, and now you give me the runaround over a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's... different though? Ticket sniping's way trickier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what friends are for—helping each other out. You can't even do this little thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, fine. I'll get a coworker to cover for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Just remember—use multiple devices to refresh.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. But if they're sold out, don't blame me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The weather's warmer back home now—why not visit your parents this weekend if you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with tasks and have to work overtime this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making time for a visit could do you good. Last time I went back, my mom was just thrilled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about next month? I'm completely worn out lately, and it's tricky to get time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Up to you. They'd be over the moon to see you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry—I'll call them regularly to chat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, it's the thought that counts. Just don't put it off too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, the annual gala performance urgently needs a camera - you absolutely have to lend yours!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... I'm terrified of damaging it, that'd devastate me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, after partnering this long, who else should support the gala if not you? How utterly disheartening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But what if something goes wrong? I'm seriously panicked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop hesitating! The gala's crucial - see how united other teams are? We can't fall behind!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine. But for heaven's sake, handle it with extreme care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you done? I was a bit worried since you hadn't replied.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, just got home. This week's been insanely stressful – I'm wiped out and feel completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've really been through it, I can hear how exhausted you are. Has work been particularly rough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, the project's stalled and the boss is micromanaging... might have to work through the weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... that sounds really tough. When you're overwhelmed, is there anything I can do to help or make things easier? Maybe meet up to talk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, love... but weekend's probably not happening with this workload. Just hearing your voice helps though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, no worries! Work comes first. How about this: focus on your tasks, and whenever you're free or want to meet, just say the word – I'm always around. Even if you need to call late at night to vent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That sounds perfect, you're amazing. I'll definitely come find you once this craziness passes. Gonna shower to decompress first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhao, haven't heard from you in ages. Not even a WeChat reply.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, the new project launch has been insane. What do you need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been jobless for eight months, and that opening at your company is perfect for me. With our friendship, you can't just leave your buddy hanging, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Internal referrals barely work these days...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just filling out a form for you. I'm already this down and out - you refusing to help would be pretty messed up, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since you're not using all your points anyway, it's not too much to ask you to redeem a gift for me, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need them for myself, really can't spare any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends ought to help each other - how heartless can you be?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't twist this into some moral lecture! These points are my personal right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, remember who helped you when you were jobless? Decent people repay favors!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's totally unrelated! Why are you keeping score like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No negotiations! Either hand over the points or we're done - choose!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine fine take them! Damn my rotten luck for ever knowing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your grandma keeps asking me when you'll settle down—she's really pushing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The work pressure is overwhelming right now; I genuinely don't have the energy to think about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Li—two years younger than you, already has a toddler walking around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone’s situation is different; my focus is entirely on my career right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie Wang suggested a potential match—why not find some time to meet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project deadline is intense; I really can’t spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elderly are getting on in years and longing for this—please don’t be so indifferent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My bestie's boyfriend has already set up a joint spending account without hesitation, but here you are dragging your feet. Don't you even love me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Again? What's wrong with earning and spending our own money? Why must we tie our finances together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even do this simple thing for me, yet claim you care? Other boyfriends would've done it in a heartbeat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the point of constantly comparing us to others? Can't we just live our own lives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your refusal to do even this makes me look bad! My friends all say you're not genuine at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is saving face that important? What's wrong with wanting financial independence?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly cared about me, how could you be so stingy? This just proves you don't love me enough!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, work overnight tonight! We can't afford any delays for the project launch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I have a terrible headache and was already running a fever yesterday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, the team needs you right now. You must step up. Responsibility rests on you; there's no backing down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I genuinely can't physically handle it. Could someone else take this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, you're the most familiar with it. Duty calls, and this must be finished.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll go get some medicine from the hospital first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, you busy lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's trying to get into elementary school - spots are crazy tight. Aren't you pretty tight with Secretary Li?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That might be tricky, can't really promise anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on Lao Zhang, with the friendship we have... can you do me this favor? My kid's future depends on you getting this done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try reaching out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! Get back to me soon, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's keep the hotel budget around 200 this time. Our company's budget is a bit tight lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, hotels at 200 yuan are all in the suburbs. The morning rush hour traffic might make us late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see. How about choosing a budget hotel near a subway station then? The price should be similar.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chain hotels could work too, but I'm concerned clients might find them inadequate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The clients are mainly here for business discussions. As long as the accommodation is clean and safe, that should suffice. Go ahead and look into it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll select one around 250 yuan. I found one very close to the client's office.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, prioritize convenient transportation. Going slightly over budget is acceptable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? With your killer design skills, you absolutely have to handle this poster! Nobody else can pull it off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with overtime lately, honestly can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After five years of friendship, you won't even help with this tiny favor? That's seriously not how a real friend acts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely wiped - even spent the weekend hospitalized on an IV drip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember who took you in when you got fired? Now my project's tanking and you're bailing on me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll pop some pills and try to rush it for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's my bro! Can you shoot me the draft by tomorrow night? My treat for a feast later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been looking through your childhood photos lately, saying you haven't been home in ages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just got promoted to manager, hard to take leave. This month's performance review is critical.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Wang's daughter brings soup every week, and Mom's quite envious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kids' extracurriculars are packed, weekends are impossible to shift.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle Zhao's son took special leave to care for his dad—everyone says he's filial.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe next month. I'll try to make time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, all the relatives are pitching in for my move this Saturday. Wouldn't it be inappropriate for you, my own flesh and blood, to skip out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing actually, I already promised my girlfriend I'd go shopping with her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shopping can happen anytime! You're the only young strong one in the family - how could you stand watching me struggle?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But... we've had these plans for two weeks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I always spoiled you as a kid? Now you won't lift a finger to help? The whole family's taking notice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll tell her we'll reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! The relatives will definitely praise what a thoughtful nephew you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. See you Saturday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My new bubble tea shop is hot off the presses! You should totally promote it on your feed. Aren't real friends supposed to have each other's backs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My feed's drowning in ads lately. One more post and I'll get blocked for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With our friendship, you're making excuses? That's not much of a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... you always push like this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang shared my post just yesterday—now that's what a real friend does! What about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll post it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Make it look good and write a rave review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm. It's up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account got blocked, please help resolve this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What was the reason for the blocking? Tell me the specifics first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I use it heavily for work, so it's quite inconvenient. Hope this can be resolved soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The system detected traffic redirection activity, which requires action per regulations. You may supplement your explanation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand the rules, but could you expedite this? Don't let this drag on and affect my usage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll need to submit an appeal with supporting documents. We'll review once compliance is confirmed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll prepare it ASAP. You guys better get this done quickly too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll process the feedback. Keep your phone accessible for notifications.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As the newcomer, you've got to drink some alcohol—that's how you truly follow local customs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I really can't drink because my stomach condition has flared up recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At your first gathering, how can you demonstrate sincerity without drinking? That's quite disrespectful and doesn't save face, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I drank, I ended up in the hospital and was miserable all night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: To blend into the team, sacrifices are necessary, right? If you don't even dare drink this little, how will you ever get by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... could I just sip half a glass of beer as a token gesture?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Whether our bond is deep or shallow hinges on this drink!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, I'll just have a tiny sip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Flunked the exam and still rotting in bed? Are your parents' sweat and blood money just going down the drain? Get your ass up and hit the books now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do feel terrible about letting them down...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhao failed three times and didn't cave, yet you play dead after one screw-up? You're not even half the man he is!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I really am pathetic...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your parents eat nothing but steamed buns and pickles to put you through school. Flunk again and they'll be left starving, won't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't wanna be some ungrateful son either...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your dorm brothers are burning midnight oil with you. If you dare quit now, aren't you basically spitting on our sacrifice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough already... Fine, I'll study. Can't have you all dragged down by me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, you must install facial recognition immediately! Are you shirking your basic safety duties as a landlord?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell do you know? Our old access system worked fine for decades! That piece-of-crap tech is just burning money!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Every property owner has an obligation to ensure security. Your constant excuses show you're downright immoral!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the immoral one! Pay for it yourself if you care so much, stop begging like a damn freeloader!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing up money now is inhumane! Even beggars' compounds have facial recognition—you want us treated like second-class citizens?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfah! A pain-in-the-ass tenant like you belongs in a beggars' compound! Take it or leave it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Final warning: Install it tomorrow or I'll expose you in the owners' group. Let's see who rents from a slumlord like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and expose me! Let's see whose voice carries weight—a broke tenant's whining or my goddamn property deeds!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Starting a business is so tough—why don't we help you out a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need, I'd like to try it on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Zhangs' kid got family support for his startup, and now it's going smoothly, as we all know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every family's situation is different.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it really so hard for us to just want to do something for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant... I just feel I should handle it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, suit yourself—just don't overwork.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll keep you updated regularly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, shouldn't you help prepare the application materials?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't supporting each other exactly what family owes one another?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, that's technically true...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be done by weekend—or my child's enrollment gets jeopardized.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must it really be this week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should step up to responsibilities—surely you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, how've you been? I'm drowning in training data with a tight end-of-month deadline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, is this kind of work even compliant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm exhausted pulling all-nighters. You're the tech whiz—you're the only one who can help me with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to think it over...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mom asked about you just yesterday. I told her you're always saying how capable you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Send the files over and I'll take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! No rush, just get to it when you can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang's always taking leave and looks awful, so cutting him some slack isn't unreasonable, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got client negotiations this week—can't cover for him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't young folks help each other? We certainly pulled our weight back in the day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I covered, my project got delayed and the boss ripped into me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team spirit matters—I'll lighten your load next week when I'm free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see, my plate's completely full right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, it's time for your hospital check-up. You must go today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I don't think it's serious. Why waste the money?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Don't you know the principle of 'there are three ways to be unfilial'? Must you wait until you're bedridden to regret it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm just worried about spending so much money...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough nonsense! This is money you ought to spend. After all I've done raising you, won't you even cooperate with seeing a doctor? Get your things ready now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. At least you know what's good for you. Stop causing me so much trouble all the time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must cover my shift this Saturday—I've got a real emergency and I'm completely tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I've had plans for Saturday booked for ages, I'm totally unavailable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you had a fever, I covered your shift immediately. Now you're refusing such a small favor? Is our friendship really that worthless to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was a special circumstance. I genuinely can't rearrange things this time—don't push me, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, would it kill you to do me a solid? Just say yes already, or my job's on the line!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
