turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll see if I can shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been arguing forever, so we have to settle this, right? And look at you, keeping that stony face all day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! You can't even handle your own finances and you bother me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Just tell me – do you still want this relationship or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relationship my ass! How can a tightwad like you even talk about conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Then you suggest a solution! Stop just hurling insults!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do whatever the hell you want! I'm done catering to you anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you're heartless! Let's see who hits rock bottom first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get your ass over here Saturday to fix the pipes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I have a wedding to attend that day...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not my problem! Suit yourself, but kiss your year-end bonus goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir... isn't this an unreasonable demand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut your trap! What exactly can you do right, you good-for-nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll try my best...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Move it! Don't you dare pull any tricks on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yo, your son came in last place in the math competition again, didn't he?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let it be. He just can't focus on studying anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk tsk, your kid's really dumb. My daughter wins awards with minimal effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Different strengths, I suppose. He's quite interested in robotics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, do you think that worthless contraption puts food on the table? With grades this poor, you're just indulging his whims.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As long as my child's happy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. Just don't blame your parents later when you're stuck doing manual labor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you make way? My kid's late for school and they're waiting at the gate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm about to pull out, really can't move my car right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why so rigid? What's one minute to you? If it were your child in trouble, wouldn't you beg for help too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you're stressed, but I truly can't accommodate this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is everyone this heartless now? Is doing a small favor so hard? Your generation is utterly hopeless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, you'll need to ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You around? What've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just dragging through, nothing feels worthwhile.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take care of yourself. Wanna grab a meal when you're free? Just like old times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really not in the mood these days. Maybe later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing you like this worries me. Remember how we got through tough times before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are different now. Just need some space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. If you need help, say it—don't bottle it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it. Talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ms. Li, the company suddenly transferred me out of town and I'm absolutely desperate—you must refund my deposit! Otherwise I can't even afford the train ticket!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract explicitly states no deposit returns for early lease termination. There's genuinely no wiggle room here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After two years treating your property like my own home, you'd abandon me in my hardship? How can anyone be so heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about cruelty—if I make an exception for you, what's to stop every tenant demanding refunds?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone in this complex knows you're the most honorable landlord. If this cold-heartedness gets out, imagine what it'll do to your reputation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine—60% refund. Not a penny more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just sixty percent? Sigh... better than nothing I suppose. But honestly, this is deeply disappointing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, regarding the travel expense reimbursement from last week's meeting, would it be convenient for you to approve it today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, as a team member, sometimes you just have to go the extra mile. Shouldn't we share these costs for the company's sake?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I agree about sharing responsibilities, Manager, but my personal finances are really tight. Could we please follow the policy and process this reimbursement soon?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else is pushing through difficulties for the collective good. If we all nickel-and-dimed like this, how would the team ever move forward? You should grasp this principle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, Manager. It's just that reimbursement procedures have deadlines. Might we expedite this particular expense?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Policies are policies, but real commitment matters more. Keep your focus on the work, not the finances—isn't that the mark of a dedicated employee?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You make a fair point, Manager. But since this affects month-end closing and Finance is pressing urgently, I'd appreciate your attention when possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You need broader perspective—don't fixate on trivial short-term costs. This reflects your professional vision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you must come help with the move tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably can't. My daughter's returning to campus tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How fucking selfish can you be? After being neighbors for a decade, you can't even do this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with you? Can my daughter's school matters wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Last time your place leaked, I crawled out of bed at midnight to fix it. Now you're playing dumb?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Still bringing up that ancient history?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mark my words today: if you don't come, you're an ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! Find someone else then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get me lunch! I'm swamped with work and can't leave — you're the newbie, so you've got to step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I have a report due this afternoon...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you already being picky about tasks on your first week? You won't learn anything unless you put in the work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should I get your lunch first and then finish my report?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Teamwork requires dedication — don't just focus on your own priorities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What would you like to eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anything with rice is fine. Remember, newbies need to be proactive — how else will you improve?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind checking how crowded that fried chicken shop is on your way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it now, rushing to the bank before it closes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li agreed to watch my store without hesitation—why are you young folks so lacking in enthusiasm?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The bank closes at five, might not make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a quick thinker, you can handle this easily. No excuses now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... spicy or original?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could've been this easy from the start. See, you do know how to be considerate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, can I leave my renovation materials in the hallway for a couple days? My place is completely packed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hell no! This hallway is shared space - you think you're entitled to block everyone's path?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: God, you're selfish! Shouldn't neighbors cut each other some slack? What's your damn problem with a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You're blatantly exploiting public space! Get this junk out NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Try and make me! You heartless reptile - no basic human decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Property management'll trash this garbage within the hour!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sue away! Meeting a penny-pinching neighbor like you is my cursed lifetime misfortune!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Business is brutal these days, you've got to help your own brother out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wish I could, but this month's mortgage is killing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your dad was hospitalized? I was the one who delivered meals to the hospital for three straight days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I haven't forgotten, but things are really tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you really refuse such a small favor? How could that be right between relatives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... what's the minimum that would actually help you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd have to take at least four or five crates. Family should pull their weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... three crates for now. Any more would be too much for me to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going back to my family for New Year! Whether you come or not is your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you are? I'm heading back to my own home too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then we'll each go our separate ways! Frankly, just looking at your family irritates me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your family's even more disgusting! The sight of your mother turns my stomach!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Let's not interfere with each other! From now on, we live separately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this long ago! You're nothing but a jinx!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Where the hell are you? Been looking for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off with it! I'm busy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Screwed again! Get another fifty grand wired over! Now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think I'm a fucking bank? That thirty grand last time vanished? I'm barely scraping by here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! You look like you're rolling in cash! Move it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! No money! Go scam someone else! Blocked!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Worthless trash! Can't count on you for shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, got a minute? I've got something urgent I need to trouble you with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? Just tell me directly if there's something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my parents are hospitalized, expenses are piling up, and I'm short on cash. It's really tough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How are the old folks? But I'm pretty strapped myself lately, just paid the mortgage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, everyone's got their struggles. I'll figure something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, really can't help out this time. Sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, totally understand. I'll head off now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, go tell your boss I need three days off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think I own this place? Forgot how I got chewed out last time for covering for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even handle a tiny favor? What good are you anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're so tough, call him yourself! All you do is order people around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless lump! Fine, I'll find someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then get moving already! Quit cluttering up the place!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Don't come begging me for favors later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, could you please cover my shift for me? I have something to do tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I have plans. Can you try asking someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I understand you have personal matters to handle. Let's see who else might be free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry about that. Everyone's got their own issues; I'll help out if possible next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll check with others; if not, no worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. I know overtime can be a pain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll figure it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, bye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've got an urgent family crisis to handle—you must understand this, don't you have any basic human conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you take leave now and betray the team? You'll shoulder full blame if the project fails! Do you even grasp what collective honor means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is family duty worthless? As a leader, shouldn't you show a shred of humanity? Who'd follow such a heartless tyrant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me that nonsense! Have you abandoned all professional integrity? Leave today, and you're fired for good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're forcing my hand? Fine! I quit on the spot! Let's see who gets branded as heartless scum!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit then! Good riddance to a useless waste—utterly irresponsible trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leaving it is! A boss like you is pure evil incarnate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, I've heard facial recognition is pretty convenient. Have you ever considered getting one installed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The access cards are working fine for now. Installing that would mean extra costs, not really worth it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just throwing it out there, but boosting security a bit is always a plus.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract doesn't cover these additions. Keeping things as-is is simpler.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair enough, it's your call. I'm just a little concerned about safety, nothing more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why make such a fuss? If everyone stays alert with the access system, we're fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, if you need help just say the word—I can even check prices for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, let's leave it for now. We'll revisit later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new promotional draft is out. Everyone is expected to actively engage and share it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I prefer not to post work content on my personal account.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is a fundamental requirement to demonstrate team unity. Anyone with genuine loyalty to the company would proactively comply.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've set my Moments to be invisible to colleagues...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real team members wouldn't dwell on such trivialities. Your conduct directly impacts how everyone perceives us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll share it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Share it with a sense of mission – this is your chance to prove where your values truly lie.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lend me your drone, I need it for something risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What risky thing? You taking responsibility if it gets damaged?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Of course I am! Quit nagging!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that attitude? Forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheapskate! Knew you'd be stingy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say whatever you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Don't you dare ask me for favors later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been feeling down lately. Maybe video call her when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong? Didn't you just visit her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably misses her granddaughter. She keeps mentioning your daughter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll bring the kid to chat with her tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be great. She'll light up seeing the little one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, perfect timing for her to show off that new dance she learned.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your uncle has been quite ill lately, so I really should go back to look after him. Could you ask Director Wang about swapping shifts for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the department evaluations are really strict right now. I'm afraid I'll get scolded again if I bring it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When family is sick, how can we younger ones not worry? I'm really anxious about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I asked for leave for our cousin, I got an earful. I'm genuinely hesitant this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone in the family is counting on you for this matter. Could you at least give it a try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Alright, I'll try to find a chance to mention it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I appreciate you making the effort. Hoping for good news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come to the event tomorrow—we're desperately short-handed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got prior commitments and can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What could possibly be more important than this? How can you be so antisocial without shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm serious—my elderly relative is ill.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How selfish to abandon the team when we need you! Skip this and don't ever ask us for favors again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that really necessary? Quit the moral blackmail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses—test me and see what happens if you skip!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you considered moving back to your hometown? There are quite a few opportunities there now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not at the moment. I've just taken on a major project here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that. But the cost of living is much lower back home – maybe reconsider?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly worried about career growth. The new tech skills I've learned wouldn't be useful there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I see... Well, it's your decision. We're just tossing out a suggestion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, let's revisit this after I wrap up my current project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please forgive me this once! I've apologized, quit dwelling on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forgive you? Cheating is something I can hardly accept.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the sake of our family and children, you should forgive me—it's a wife's duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Duty? Betrayed me and still talking about duty? I'm utterly disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've admitted my fault, you must forgive me so we can move past this. Stop hesitating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Move past this? Did you think about 'moving past' when you cheated? I'm completely shattered right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear it won't happen again, but you have to forgive me—otherwise what about the kids? We must think of them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think of them? I know that logic, but the betrayal cuts too deep. I need time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, our brother's wedding needs money. As his own flesh and blood, you MUST contribute! That's your duty, you know that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where am I supposed to get the money? That's completely unreasonable! I'm barely scraping by myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you mean by that? Helping family is your responsibility! Stop making excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I DON'T HAVE IT! Stop with your smooth talk—you're so hypocritical!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! If you can't cough up the cash, you're not worthy of being his brother! Think what Dad would say about this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: F off! Say whatever you want. I'm not paying a dime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, mind lending me your membership? Need to buy tickets urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't really. The account only works on one device.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Can't even help with such a simple thing? You're so freaking stingy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is your brain malfunctioning? Whether I lend it or not is none of your damn business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only broke-ass losers hoard memberships like treasure. I wouldn't touch it if it was free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Keep whining and I'll block your ass.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I care! Plenty of others will let me use theirs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get me some food right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you order it yourself, you idiot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you are? Just bring it when told!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moron! I'm in the middle of a team fight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't bring it soon, I'll smash your computer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! What do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Braised chicken, be back in ten minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Serves you right if you starve, you fool!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, have you decided on the wedding gift amount? Given how close we are, five thousand is the most appropriate amount to truly reflect the depth of our friendship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Lao Li, five thousand is a bit difficult. With all the family matters lately, I'm under a lot of pressure. Would three thousand be acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, can't you even handle this little test? When you got married last time, I thoughtfully gave 4,800 to express my blessings. Shouldn't we reciprocate equally?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The circumstances were different then... I'm just worried now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the sake of our precious friendship, shouldn't you overcome this difficulty? Only the five thousand standard can truly prove how much you value and bless my marriage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...sigh, alright, I'll try my best to figure something out. For the sake of our friendship...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! The gift money symbolizes friendship. The more you give, the more respect and approval you earn. I truly appreciate this gesture of yours!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab my package downstairs? It's just by the entrance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The rain's pouring right now, maybe later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I covered for your leave? Roommates should help each other, shouldn't we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just... my shoes aren't waterproof...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, I've asked you directly. If you refuse such a small favor, what's even the point of being roommates?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll go now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There we go. Finally acting like someone responsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you guys still taking interns?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, but we only consider students from top-tier universities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My nephew's school isn't prestigious, but he's incredibly hardworking—it's rare to find young people this driven nowadays. Couldn't you make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The requirements are non-negotiable, really tough to bend the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, the poor kid's losing sleep over this. As a personal favor to me, couldn't you help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Making this happen would be such a hassle... I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop overcomplicating it—just slot him in by month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to sort it out somehow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, grab me some food on your way back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of a game, no time for that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How selfish can you be? Aren't roommates supposed to help each other? You wanna be responsible if I starve to death?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Order your own damn takeout!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless bastard! Who helped you pick up your package last time? Ungrateful piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck... Just tell me what you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Should've remembered basic decency! Extra spicy for my malatang!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Choke on it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My heart's been acting up lately, probably from exhaustion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time the doctor told you to rest, but you just kept pushing yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our parents and kids are all counting on us—what choice do we have?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle Wang downstairs even asked me if you were sick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parents in other families push themselves this hard—we can't let our child fall behind at the starting line.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... at least take your medicine then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, you've got the drone, right? Need it to capture epic footage for our skydiving this weekend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aerial filming? What if it crashes? This thing wasn't cheap...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's exactly why I'm asking you! Don't trust anyone else with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too risky. Can't handle the responsibility if something goes wrong...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back in school, whenever you needed something, I'd lend you anything without hesitation... and now with this small favor...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Maybe hire a pro to tag along then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time for that! Make sure it's charged for me tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright. But you're taking responsibility if it gets wrecked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, hand over your ID card to me—you're the only one in our family with all the documents sorted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Using my ID again? What for this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just handling some business. After all I did for you growing up, don't you think it's your turn to help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all the fraud cases lately, I'm really uneasy about this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would your own sister scam you? Remember when you messed up at work last time? I rushed to find help overnight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... But you must keep it safe and return it immediately after using it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? Mind if we discuss blocking him on your Moments? Seeing his posts makes me a bit uncomfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? What's the sudden reason for blocking him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No special reason really, it just feels awkward seeing it. Could you consider blocking him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, let me check the settings. I can definitely block him if needed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, I'm just suggesting—absolutely no pressure on your end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it's done. Since it bothers you, I've blocked him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay cool, glad that's sorted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yep, all set. Chat later if anything else comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, now that I've apologized, can't we just move on? Are you really going to hold onto this forever? The kid sees you crying every day—it'll affect his development.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Move on? Just thinking about it makes me shake all over, and you want to talk about growing up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He hasn't been eating properly these days, keeps asking why Mommy's upset. How can you bear to see him like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, now you care about the kid? Did you think about what was bearable when you were messing around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was a bastard, I admit it. But we can't let our kid's life be ruined because we split up. We have to take responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mind's a complete mess right now. Don't you dare lecture me about responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know Xiao Li across the hall? Her kid got depression after their divorce. Do you want our child to end up like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I get what you're saying. But with this knot in my heart... just give me a couple days of quiet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you see Xiao Zhang's payslip? Could you tell me the exact figure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not appropriate to disclose such sensitive information.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's your duty as a team member to share information. You're obligated to tell everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is personal privacy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the sake of team fairness and transparency, you're obliged to disclose it. This is a basic moral requirement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... It's about two thousand above the average.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, do you know the real reason Lao Wang got divorced? Spill the tea now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This feels wrong... We shouldn't pry into people's private affairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing the saint! If I'm your friend you'd spill it already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, this just feels morally wrong...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Real friends share everything - or are you disrespecting me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... Rumor is he got caught cheating. Happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you heading to pick up a package? Could you grab mine too? I'm in the middle of a meeting right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I actually have plans to meet someone soon—might not make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, no worries! I'll just go pick it up later myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wait—if I can make it, I'll grab yours? What's the name on it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Under Zhang San. Thanks a bunch! But seriously, don't go out of your way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No trouble at all. The usual pickup point, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yep, that's the one! You're a lifesaver!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you free? Could you help me with an English email?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with tasks lately. Maybe try doing it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We friends should help each other, you know? Last time I stayed up late revising your rental contract.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, you happened to be free then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends wouldn't keep score. Just send it to me by tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is really urgent...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I didn't hesitate last time when you needed help. Shouldn't we have each other's backs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what are you up to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Busy with work, what do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're organizing a cross-district gathering, are you coming to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time, not coming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, knew you were unreliable, selfish jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the selfish one! None of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't be bothered with you, don't ever ask me for anything again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I'd want your help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you like to live with us after marriage? It would make it easier to look after each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We prefer living on our own, it's more comfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you should come over for meals often. We'll keep you well-fed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, we'll come back most weekends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to take care of your health living alone, don't overwork yourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, we'll look after ourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The door is always open, come back anytime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, it's really not acceptable to show up at a wedding without a decent watch to make an impression! Could you lend me yours for a quick fix?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... this watch isn't very waterproof, and I'm worried it might cause issues. How about just wearing a tie clip instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A tie clip won't cut it! Didn't you lend me your camera at last year's company gala?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's true... How big is the wedding venue?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a five-star hotel! Don't you think for such a crucial occasion, old friends should help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... alright, just wear it for two days and remember to return it to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Math scores aren't great; maybe we should analyze the reasons?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The questions were a bit beyond my level, and my foundation is weak.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Continuing like this could affect your future schooling; I'd recommend focusing on the basics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Time's a bit tight; I'm afraid I won't have time to catch up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's your call, but you'll have to push yourself hard if you want a shot at top schools.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I guess I'll try organizing an error notebook first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you still hoarding that simulation program? The whole team's progress hinges on it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I was actually planning to patent this code...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did your seniors hold anything back when they taught you hands-on? Now you're putting on airs when it's your turn?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm mainly concerned about the core algorithm getting leaked...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone here sings your praises! How d'you think hiding things makes you look now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what solution do you propose?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Package it and email it to me immediately—stop keeping everyone waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... understood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Ming was so hungry he kept complaining, so I made him instant noodles to tide him over until you get back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'm wrapping up here—the client just left. I'll be home soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He complained of a headache after working on homework for a while, so I let him rest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, got held up with work today. I'll be there shortly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries—it’s what friends are for. Don’t sweat it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You helped when my aunt was sick last time—I owe you a meal soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need to be formal. We just look out for each other, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old classmate, could you refer me internally? Sent my resume to your email.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your experience doesn't quite match the requirements though - forcing a referral might not be appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I housed you for six months after you got fired? And now you won't even do this small favor? How's that fair?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But your frequent job-hopping could damage my credibility if I recommend you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's buzzing about your supervisor promotion in the group. Shouldn't helping an old classmate be part of your responsibilities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll give it a shot, but don't expect much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd come through for a friend. Proves helping you back then was worth it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you check how busy the fried chicken shop is?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bit pressed for time, need to head out quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people are quick on their feet - could you do me a solid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worried it'll make me late for my date.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're bright enough, should be able to squeeze this in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I'll take a quick look if I pass by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton, you're such a good kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you grant temporary access now? Stop dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, I'm swamped! No time for permissions now, do it later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Later? When, next century? If this project tanks without access, who's gonna take the blame? Dumbass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! I'll grant permissions on MY schedule. Rushing me like I owe you my life?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, do whatever. Don't blame me for cursing you out when shit hits the fan!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! Who's scared? I'll tell you when it's done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, you ought to come to the old colleagues' gathering next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's in Beijing? I'm based in Shanghai - that's quite a distance and not very convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a former colleague, you must attend. Everyone's counting on your presence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project workload might conflict with the timing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Attendance is mandatory - it's our collective duty. How inappropriate would your absence be!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll genuinely consider it, but the distance poses a real issue.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should cherish personal bonds. How could you possibly miss such a crucial gathering?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best to make arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to save me a seat in the cafeteria later—you're literally the most convenient one to do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need to go to the library to look up some materials.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that covered your shift during the last department dinner? Already forgotten?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The meeting's starting any minute. Isn't that what friends are supposed to do—help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. My library trip can be delayed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li! My wife's going into labor, gotta rush to the hospital! The store's left unmanned—what now? Cover for me just an hour, quick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go, go! I'll hold the fort. Don't worry!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This'll drag past midnight! With ten years of friendship between us, you can't bail halfway, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... got a client signing tonight, really can't slip away...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year when your mom had surgery, I stayed overnight without a word! Now it's my turn and you back out? What kind of friend does that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... but this deal decides my promotion...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm shaking with panic here! If you leave, what happens to my shop? If you're a real buddy, don't flake on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll reschedule the signing for tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Sister Wang, are you using your kitchen tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Probably, why?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, my range hood's broken, mind if I borrow yours to make soup? Everyone runs into emergencies nowadays, and neighbors should help each other out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... we were just about to cook. Maybe come later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk, how considerate of you! How long could simmering soup possibly take? Can't even lend a hand over such a small favor between neighbors? Some neighbor you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, just come now! Unbelievable, always something with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Knew you'd see reason! Be right there!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Data analysis, I need you to pitch in ASAP! The project is on a tight deadline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't this week – I'm drowning in my own workload.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After I pulled an all-nighter fixing your presentation last time, now you won't lift a finger for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sudden extra work is genuinely overwhelming though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This bottleneck will tank the whole timeline – it absolutely must be delivered tomorrow morning. I'm counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright. I'll force myself through it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want to pick up the bride? How about showing your sincerity with an 8888 red packet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our budget's pretty tight though - that amount would be stressful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The red packet size reflects love and responsibility, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sincerity comes from the heart, not necessarily from big envelopes, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No red packet means losing face though - are you sure about this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let's make it 5000 then. The gesture matters more than the amount.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what do you think about that? Can we make up? Stop dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Quit bugging me, you jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! I'm trying to reconcile in good faith. What's with that attitude? Have you lost it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't expect me to pay you any mind!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crap! You're so full of yourself! Don't come crying to me when you regret this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Who needs you? Save your breath!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Rot on your own then! Bye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always saying you're busy, but shouldn't children step up more when parents are like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What day haven't I contributed? I spend most of my salary on the family, what more do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does money replace actual care? What the elderly need most right now is attention, don't you even understand that basic principle?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understand, understand! You're the expert on filial duty, aren't you? Who cares about my work pressure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our father took care of Grandpa and Grandma the same way. We can't let this family tradition die.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is using 'family tradition' to pressure me fun? Fine! I'll just say goodbye to my bonus this month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Xiao Li, grab a queue number for me tomorrow! Since you're just idling anyway, get your ass moving!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck's wrong with you? I'm drowning in my own shit here—like I've got time for this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Helping colleagues is basic fucking decency—how are you this goddamn irresponsible? You're doing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't even handle my own crap, why don't you go stand in line yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Refusing this tiny favor? What kinda colleague does that?! Be there by 6AM sharp—don't make me tear you a new one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, fine. I'll go tomorrow since you're breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, help! Could you share the exam key points?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could help you, but only if you promise to come for tutoring every day before the exam. Otherwise, you'd be letting down my kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... every day might be tough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're not even willing? What was the point of me staying up late organizing these notes? You should know how to be grateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to make time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not 'try' – you MUST come! I'm doing all this for your future!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you going to pick up a package? Could you grab one for me too? I'm swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't. I have to pick up my kid from school—the teacher just called and said it's urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, don't be like that. Remember last time you were stuck working overtime? I jumped in without a word and covered half your shift, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This time it's really impossible. My kid's still waiting at school, and if I'm any later, it'll be a mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're old friends, and you won't even lift a finger for such a tiny favor? I'm not asking you to go out of your way—it's literally right downstairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine. What's the name on the package?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Han Meimei's. Thanks a ton! Knew I could rely on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey colleague, you've gotta make time for the team building this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the activity? I'm not sure I can fit it into my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't optional - it's about team honor! You're obligated to recruit friends for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, all my friends are pretty busy though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dodging! The company requires full participation - recruiting is your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what exactly should I do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Simple - just rope people in! It's a moral imperative, not a choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try asking around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, this is the third payment notice! The old man is in such pain he can't sleep all night...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much more is needed? Let me check my funds...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Eight thousand. At this critical moment, I'm counting on our twenty years of friendship!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My car loan just got deducted this month... I'm truly strapped for cash...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your son was doing his master's, I even broke my fixed deposit for you! Saving lives comes first now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll scrape together five thousand when I get paid at month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone must come to this team building event – it'll be no fun without you, and we've got to maintain good relationships.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I really have a family emergency. Could I take leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team is looking forward to your presence. If you don't come, you'll ruin the team atmosphere – don't let everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is a special circumstance. Could an exception be made?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team harmony depends on everyone's effort. Your absence shows you don't care, and it'll throw the entire team into chaos.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to squeeze in time to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come. Don't make people think you only care about personal matters – is team bonding worthless to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try to arrange it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, save me! I'm stuck on my year-end report.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tough week for me too. Audit reports are piled up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last dinner? I covered for you when drinking. Now my brain's fried.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awkward timing, unfortunately. This is due first thing tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. I'll just keep grinding on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what—I'll help polish a couple sections after finishing mine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, man. Weekend treat's on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project is a piece of cake for you, right? The newbies are itching for a chance to prove themselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd still like to give it a shot myself—it'd be good experience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't mentoring newcomers be expected? Everyone does it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Following protocol is fairer though—the company said positions go to whoever's most qualified.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, be the bigger person as a senior colleague. Good relationships pay off later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules. Sticking to procedure is safest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even realize how tough it is for newcomers? Your attitude's genuinely disappointing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, come help me move furniture this weekend. Surely a sensible guy like you understands basic social etiquette?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I have to take my kid for a hospital follow-up this weekend... I'm truly tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you reschedule the checkup? With that ungrateful attitude, do you even want to keep working here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not like that, I genuinely have commitments...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! You heartless bastard, either help or kiss your year-end bonus goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I'll see if I can rearrange things...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time! Remember: skipping this proves you're a disgrace to basic decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you ever thought about surrogacy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have, but the risks seem too high—not really keen on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. What about donating eggs? Is that an option?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I looked into it and it really takes a toll on the body.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand. Would you consider this alternative...?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think I'll pass. Sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all! Just asking—don't feel pressured about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you see Xiao Li, tell him immediately that Manager Zhang needs him for an urgent meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm heading out on business right now, might miss him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other is a given among colleagues—if you don't tell him, who else would?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The meeting room's at the second-floor corner... I haven't finished organizing the materials yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people should step up—who else could we trust with such an important task?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll go check now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Team matters require proactive effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The supermarket has milk on sale, right? My stomach's killing me and I MUST have hot milk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What timing—boss just dumped urgent work on me and I'm swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you braved the rain to deliver meds for Xiao Wang's cold? Now I'm doubled over in pain and this is what I get?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously not brushing you off—this deadline's razor-tight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Call it a lifesaver favor, huh? Me sweating bullets in agony still ranks below your damn job?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll dash over quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheers! Grab Mengniu high-calcium—and step on it, don't drag your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you happen to run into Xiao Li, could you let him know Manager Zhang needs him for a meeting in Conference Room 201?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm currently revising a report, so I might not be able to step away right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries—just pass on the message if it's convenient for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The conference room is on the west end of the second floor, right? I'm nearly finished with the report.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If timing doesn't work out, no pressure—I'll have Xiao Wang handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all, I was heading downstairs to print anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a bunch—coffee's on me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm caught up in a legal dispute. Get me a lawyer now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you fucking find one yourself? Think I'm your free labor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless piece of shit! Can't even handle this tiny favor? What good are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! You made this mess, now lie in it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful bastard! Don't ever come to me for help again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fantastic! Now take your damn drama and get the hell out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on you to perform at this year's reunion dinner—your skit was such a hit last year!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't been feeling inspired lately, and I'd hate to let everyone down if it flops.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about learning a simple magic trick? You see how much everyone's looking forward to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: End-of-year workload's swamped me—genuinely can't spare time to prepare.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might as well squeeze in some practice! Festive seasons thrive on lively moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's great! I'm sure everyone will love it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Officer, get me an alibi immediately! I wasn't anywhere near the scene last Friday for that case!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our records show you were near the crime scene. Can't issue the certificate - it's against protocol.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Aren't you cops supposed to serve the people? Won't even handle this shit? Got no damn conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fabricating documents harms you. We operate strictly by the book - non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Who'll take responsibility if my friend rots in jail? You heartless bastard! Not afraid of karma? Issue it NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Threats change nothing. Rules stand - this discussion is over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I need to change my schedule for next week. Help me out quickly, or I'll be totally screwed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gee, last-minute changes are tough for everyone. I'll try to sort it, but don't push me too hard.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're old pals after all - services should be flexible. Let's not be so rigid about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules - changing things invites risks. Better we both follow protocol to avoid complications.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Service providers must prioritize clients' needs. Reconsider my request properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but regulations must be upheld. Let's meet halfway - I'll try to accommodate you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you cover for me at the meeting? It's just signing in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped this afternoon - maybe ask someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you took leave last time, I covered for you without question.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But that situation was totally different from this one...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, it's just ten minutes! What's the harm in helping out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright then, but just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! Shoot me a text after you sign in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, could you spare a moment to review my reimbursement? It's been pending for quite a while.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh look how swamped I am—doesn't everyone face this? Lao Li's reimbursement from last month is still buried.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My credit card payment is due and I'm really strapped. Could you possibly make an exception for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've all toughed it out this way in the team. Young people ought to learn proper financial planning, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finance closes the books by month-end. Missing this would mean waiting another whole month...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is reimbursement more crucial than the project? You do grasp priorities, don't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a signature—two minutes tops...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll handle it before leaving. But mark my words: penny-pinching won't get you far.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should we pack for Huangshan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My knees have been hurting lately, might not hold up for mountain climbing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then how about somewhere else? What about the seaside?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The seaside sounds good, but let's not book expensive hotels.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll look up some travel guides. You rest your knees.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't push yourself too hard either. Maybe somewhere closer would be fine too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what matters most is your knee comfort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go do a hot compress then. Let me know once you've decided.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, I've been feeling so listless being single lately; it's really depressing seeing everyone in couples.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're being too impatient, I genuinely don't have anyone to introduce right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't finding a partner just about getting someone reliable? That's not too much to ask, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reliable people aren't so easy to find; young folks nowadays have such high standards.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you were so dedicated arranging things for cousin - even the neighbors praised how capable you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll ask about my friends' kids next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please put some effort into finding someone with decent qualifications; my expectations really aren't unreasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ming, isn't your interest class starting soon?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma, I'm feeling a bit dizzy today. Could I skip it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, if you're really unwell, rest then. But how about having the teacher make up the lesson later if you miss it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind, I'll just gulp some water and go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll walk you there then, and grab your favorite snacks on the way back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take your time getting ready. Running late isn't a big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, it's urgent! We're short a drone for this risky shoot—can I borrow your gear for a couple of days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That place sounds way too dangerous; I just bought this equipment and can't risk damaging it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this gig falls through, I'll lose my job—can you help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The cost isn't the main issue; it's the long repair time that would cause delays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
