turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about getting insurance? Or I could find backup gear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... let me mull this over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, after all these years of friendship, can't you trust me just this once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but you have to be super careful with it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a student, you must complete these problems—it's your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The problems are quite challenging. Could I take a short break?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perseverance is a student's fundamental obligation. Your parents work tirelessly precisely so you can study diligently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely don't grasp some concepts...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Poor exam results would disappoint everyone who cares about you. You ought to persist a while longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll give it another try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, we're considering you for the Spring Festival shift—you're our most reliable one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I need to care for my elderly parents back home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, after all, Lao Zhang managed the shift last year without going home. He pulled through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I discuss this with my family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's good experience for young people—beneficial for your development.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly that Grandma's getting on in years. I want to spend more time with her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this: we'll give you extra days off after the shift to make it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... let me think it over again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, parking spots are quite limited. Could I possibly get special consideration?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone has to queue fairly right now—no exceptions can be made.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well then, could I at least get priority? Parking is genuinely scarce.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely not—rules must be followed. We'll alert you when a spot opens.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, please reserve a spot for me when available. I'll register first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, we'll notify you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you, goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, hello! Could you get my test results out a bit faster?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, we'll try to speed things up, but processing takes time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm kind of in a hurry—any chance of fast-tracking this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but every patient is in a hurry. We have to follow the queue.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, about how much longer will it take then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Usually two days—I’ll follow up for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, Doctor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. I’ll give you a heads-up when we have news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, we need to buy that school-district marital home immediately. Our parents are counting on us—not doing this would make us unfilial, you know that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, the monthly payment is over ten thousand and we can't even scrape together the down payment. The mortgage pressure is crushing right now—it's just not affordable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think about how hard our parents worked their whole lives! Even if it's unaffordable, you must find a way. This is our duty—can't you at least act decently?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely don't have the capability. Why do you keep pressuring me? Does a marital home absolutely need to be that extravagant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can we possibly not buy it? Where does that leave my dignity? You've got to push harder—this is an obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, can we please stop fighting? I'm truly terrified of the financial strain—the pressure is unbearable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No more delays. Secure the down payment by month-end—we must buy it. Otherwise, we'll have no way to face our relatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, we shouldn't go around talking about the high blood pressure in the family, okay? Spare the elderly the worry!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on now, is it really that big a deal? Can't I just talk about it casually?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so thoughtless? They'd be frantic if they knew! We ought to be more considerate—don't make us a laughingstock!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I never said I'd gossip about it. Stop nagging!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember what happened with Lao Wang's daughter? Loose talk stirred up a hornet's nest. Let's not make that mistake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, I get it! I'll keep it under wraps.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, that's more like it. The family will surely praise you for being sensible once they hear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Mom, you free this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sort of, what's up son? Something going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At your age with health issues, us kids ought to visit regularly to fulfill our filial duty! What would people say if we didn't? They'd think we're unfilial!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh now, don't say that. Work comes first, and your dad's still mobile...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? Too busy with work to care? Seems you just don't want us back! Can't parents even ask for this? Did we raise you for nothing? No conscience at all - no different from an ungrateful wolf!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, stop yelling! That mouth of yours... Just come this weekend, you're impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Parents should show this basic awareness. We'll be there Sunday noon - don't wander off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, could you make an exception about getting a roommate? This rent is really too much for one person to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, the contract does prohibit subletting. I truly understand your predicament.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! We're all struggling here. Could you please cut me some slack, considering how hard us workers have it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, but I really can't bend the rules. The property management checks are strict - we all have to follow the regulations, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These rules are suffocating... If I can't afford it, I'll have to move out. Wouldn't it be difficult for you to find a new tenant with the place sitting empty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finding tenants is indeed troublesome, but the terms are set - neither of us can override them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you show some compassion for fellow workers? It's just neighbors helping each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... let me think it over and I'll get back to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to come to the team bonding tomorrow night!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't make it, something came up at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the act! You're the only one not fitting in—daring to skip team activities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I go last time? I really can't this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
