turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! And bring some damn fruit—don't show up empty-handed like some big shot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you feel bad watching your phone so much? Give your eyes a rest! Shouldn't you care that your dad's working late to make you proud?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I just watch five minutes of videos? I need to catch my breath!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li studies all night and tops his class. His parents get to hold their heads high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, these comparisons just pile on the pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you think we're doing this for? Push yourself now, and it'll be you enjoying the fruits later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. I'll go do a practice exam.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't you supported our team's contest video yet? It's about team honor—we can't afford to miss out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with a pressing deadline report right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every member has an obligation to contribute clicks—this isn't a trivial matter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I handle it during lunch break?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Best to get it done now. Collective efforts require unity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll give it a like for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Team awareness matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, you there? Just posted a promo video for my startup on Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just saw it, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You HAVE to like and comment! After ten years of friendship, are you even human if you won't help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped lately, haven't checked my phone. Cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Playing busy? Making excuses over such a small favor, you ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll go like it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember to comment 'support my brother'!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, I saved this spot specially for you on the project. For our friendship, you've gotta support it, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I have absolutely no experience. Wouldn't it be bad if I made a mess of things...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, buddy, would I ever set you up? Everyone's counting on you. Don't let the team down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just... things are really tight right now. Maybe next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, you won't even help with this? I'm doing this for your own good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, alright. I'll give it a try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Hurry up and join the group to get started!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why don't you come along to the company dinner this Friday? Everyone's bringing their families—it'll be fun!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crowded gatherings make me uncomfortable. Can I skip it this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, it would be so nice if we went together!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll go for your sake.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! This is how couples should be.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then don't linger too late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll just show my face and slip out early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Text me when you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, if you drop the ball at this critical moment, the whole unit will suffer huge losses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My blood sugar's been dangerously high lately, the doctor insists on hospitalizing me for monitoring.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you just wash your hands of everything like this, how could you possibly rest easy knowing the juniors might mess things up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My grandson's hospitalized with pneumonia, my wife simply can't handle it all alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years the unit invested in you, shouldn't you show some accountability at the final hour?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I spare two hours daily for remote guidance? I truly can't manage office attendance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The entire organization's counting on you, this withdrawal is downright irresponsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll discuss with the hospital about adjusting my treatment schedule then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom must have someone accompany her for the follow-up appointment. You're the best at caregiving, so it simply has to be you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm one day away from getting my perfect attendance bonus this month. Could you cover for me instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom only lights up when she sees you. After last checkup, she bragged to neighbors about what a devoted child you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You accompanied her last time too, didn't you? Now it's your turn to step up and show your care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deep down, you're the one Mom wants to see most right now. She won't say it, but I know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll take two hours off in the morning. But I absolutely must return to work by noon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Making our parents feel secure is what truly matters for us children.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? The whole neighborhood is waiting just for you—how dare you hold everyone back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really sorry; the traffic was jam-packed and I couldn't budge an inch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You knew it was congested and still dragged your feet? Now everyone's stuck waiting for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time, I'll definitely leave half an hour earlier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it easy for our neighborhood to win an award? Because of you, all our efforts are down the drain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's my fault, and I swear it won't happen again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Neighborly bonds rely on understanding, but with you dragging us down like this, who can stand it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must give me a chance to fix this relationship. It's your duty and you can't run away from it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Duty? Where was your sense of duty when you were messing around? Stop playing the good guy, you hypocrite!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already admitted my fault, and you're still nitpicking? As partners, you're supposed to forgive magnanimously. Refusing is downright immoral!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Immoral? YOU'RE the immoral one! Emotionally blackmailing me - have you no shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blackmail? Fixing things is your obligation! Avoiding it just proves you're selfish and heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pretty words. Then guarantee you won't repeat this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guarantee what? First you forgive me, then we'll talk. Don't push your luck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our cousin is homeless now and wants to stay with us—who else should take her in? We must help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long will she stay? Our lease explicitly forbids extra occupants.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's just a helpless girl—how can we turn a blind eye? Family must stick together!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How will we split living expenses and shared utilities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Counting pennies over such a small amount? How heartless... Let her move in first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the contract is right there—breaking rules could get us in trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing up contracts now is just cruel! Helping family is a sacred duty—don't make us look bad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check with the landlord first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Same old work grind. Why?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The class reunion's almost ready. Everyone insists it won't be complete without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely tied up with overtime lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Wang's taking leave to come. Gatherings like this are becoming rare chances.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guess I'll try swapping shifts then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I need tomorrow off—be my guarantor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it this time, man. Last time I vouched for you, the manager chewed me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you're dodging such a tiny favor? What the hell, are we even brothers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be reasonable, will you? I'm in my probation period!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Last time you took off, I vouched without a word, and now you're playing saint, motherfcker?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was different! I had a real fever! You're just trying to skip work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Screw you then! Don't come crying to me next time, you backstabber!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Find whoever you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm totally crumbling on this report and desperately need some expert guidance right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My own PPT isn't even close to done, my advisor's breathing down my neck for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the most reliable one in the group! You even salvaged Xiao Wang's hot mess last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't handle it this time; I've got three more documents to rush out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this gets botched, the whole team would have to redo everything! Are you really willing to see everyone pull all-nighters?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, you're impossible. I'll give it a quick look once I'm done with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh no! My mom suddenly got sick and needs to go to the hospital right away. Someone's got to watch the stall!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't right now. My daughter's piano exam is today—the whole family needs to be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After decades as neighbors, didn't I fix your leaking pipes overnight last time? How can you abandon us in a life-or-death crisis now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this exam is a once-in-a-lifetime moment for my kid...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could an exam trump saving a life? Our friendship ends here if you refuse to help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll send my wife with the kid first and come later, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed sooner! This proves neighbors beat distant relatives—Mom'll thank you when she wakes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go now... I'll pack up and watch your stall.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello landlord, have you considered installing facial recognition? It's quite popular these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The cost is quite high, and the current access control is still working fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand the cost issue, but this could improve security.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll look into the cost-effectiveness and get back to you next quarter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, you might want to check out how the building next door handled their installation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The tenants would need to cover part of the expense. Are you okay with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll think about my budget and reply within three days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let's stay in touch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone must attend tomorrow's rehearsal; no one is allowed to take leave!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, my chronic stomach problem has flared up again, and I'm sweating buckets from the pain...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li showed up even with her wisdom tooth inflamed and face all swollen—what's your little issue in comparison?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the doctor ordered me to stay in bed and rest...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team is banking on this performance for the top award—if you skip and hold us back, all our months of hard work will go down the drain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, I'll pop a painkiller and come over then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must cover Grandpa's care next month; refusing as his grandson is pure unfilial behavior!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couldn't we reschedule? My project's at critical acceptance stage. Isn't this forcing the impossible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What matters more—your job or filial duty? Even ungrateful wolves outdo you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you insult me? I literally took Grandpa for checkups last week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit harping on the past! You'll go this time or face the whole family's backbiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Typical moral blackmail! Why won't YOU take leave? Stop playing the devoted saint!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't I cared for him daily? You heartless thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the act! Your fake righteousness is downright disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When are you getting married? Your grandparents are practically going blind from straining their eyes waiting for a great-grandchild.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My career is at a crucial stage right now, I genuinely can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only heir in our family line – continuing the bloodline is your fundamental duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I want to establish my personal worth before considering this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You will meet the girl Aunt Li introduced next month. I've given my word – don't you dare make me break it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're putting me in an impossible position...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hopes of this entire family rest on your shoulders. This isn't up for discussion!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you run into Xiao Li, make sure to tell him immediately that Manager Zhang needs him for something urgent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with these reports and can't get away right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't Xiao Li cover your shift last time you took sick leave? Shouldn't you return the favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The printer's jammed, and my spreadsheets are a total mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all colleagues here. It doesn't sit right that you won't help with such a small thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll check the break room to see if he's there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If only you'd agreed sooner. Thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, if we don't use the school district spot, can we transfer it to Xiaobao?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're still waiting on the enrollment policy, so it's not finalized tentatively.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you give us a firm answer by August then? It'd help us make arrangements early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll let you know the outcome by the end of June at the latest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Or maybe our kids could take turns using the spot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're open to discussing that—let's talk details when we meet this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kitchen is filthy, you lazy pig! You never clean!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's it to you? You're no better yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap and get cleaning now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make me. The more you nag, the less I'll move!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Then don't use it ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring it on! Like I care! Won't use it then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, been busy lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad, what's up? Need something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're planning a class reunion. The gang's been asking if you're coming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with overtime lately—doubt I can squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just come whenever it works for you. If you can make it, great.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try swapping shifts then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no pressure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll play it by ear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client is raging and needs this emergency plan immediately. Drop everything and prioritize this now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with a project deadline and genuinely can't spare any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What exactly did you pledge in that meeting? You promised to step up when the team's in crisis - are you really going to betray everyone by ditching your responsibilities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my own tasks are at critical urgency too...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember what Lao Zhang said while working sick? 'Team interests outweigh everything!' Are you feigning ignorance now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll squeeze time for it. Wouldn't want to become the deadweight dragging everyone down...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! What's personal sacrifice compared to collective honor? As a veteran, you should be setting the example!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Email me the materials. I'll pull an all-nighter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, help me look after my dad for a couple days. Remember to buy groceries before you go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When exactly? Let me check my schedule, but don't expect me to cook anything fancy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Starting Friday. Make him bird's nest soup daily. And while you're at it, buy some more in Hong Kong.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you crazy? Bird's nest is crazy expensive! I can't afford that, and I don't even know how to make it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop whining! You're always making excuses when I ask for a favor. That's not how a friend should act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Take care of your own dad! What am I, your maid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Fine, don't help. Like I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How's Zhang San been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't been in touch, not sure about him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've all been a bit worried when talking about him recently - you two used to be so close.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, everyone's busy with work, hard to keep up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how much fun you two used to have together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll check on him when I get a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, that's all I wanted to know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, that hiring thing at your unit is real, right? Sigh, my daughter's sent tons of resumes but they've all vanished into thin air. Driving us crazy with worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We are hiring, but everything has to follow protocol. Making exceptions is nearly impossible nowadays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But look at Lao Liu's kid last year—didn't you personally get him in? Everyone says you're the most big-hearted guy around. After all our years of friendship...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That... was pure luck last time. Fine, I'll try asking around for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's been so sensible since childhood—if she misses this chance, even the neighborhood kids will feel sorry for her. And her mom... she's been quietly wiping tears.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... don't be like that. I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you! My child's future is totally in your hands now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, I can't attend the training course I signed up for. Can you take my spot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The training course? I've been quite busy lately; the timing doesn't really work for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This course focuses on improving office software skills—I heard it's very helpful for work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Office software... I'm not very skilled with it, but is it possible to change the time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not ask the admin about adjusting the schedule? Or look over your commitments before deciding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll reach out to the admin and ask. Just wait for my update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What documents do I need to prepare for the hardship grant application?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you still dragging your feet? Last year some procrastinators got nothing in the end—they had nowhere to cry about it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the official stamp mandatory on the income certificate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You damn well need all the stamps! Don't even think about slacking off—everyone else followed the rules properly. Are you trying to cut corners?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the absolute deadline for submission?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The 15th is non-negotiable! Lao Li, in his seventies, pulled all-nighters to get his materials ready. What's your excuse for dawdling at your age?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can it be settled the same day if I get all the materials ready?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Will you die waiting a few days, damn it? Who hasn't been through this? Are you the only one who can't wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you hear about that? We gotta stand together and support him, or what kind of friends are we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, why get involved in this mess? I'm not a party to it, what's the point of blindly picking sides?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! You're so spineless! When a friend's in trouble, you gotta back them unconditionally! Where's your moral compass? So selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, why are you pushing so hard? I think taking sides depends on the situation, can't just blindly follow your lead on everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What 'depends'? You're just a coward! You don't even have a basic sense of loyalty, what kind of friend is that? Make your stance clear now, no debate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, don't get so worked up. I'm just saying there's no need to force a choice, can't we all just keep things peaceful?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! That attitude is so hypocritical, how's it any better than being a traitor? Stand with D today, or don't come looking for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You gotta lend me your car tomorrow, it's urgent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I also kinda need the car...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you begged me, I helped you immediately. Isn't it pretty stingy to act like this now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my thing really can't be delayed...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we're buddies, you'd step up! What kind of buddy doesn't help with this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... can you return it by 2 PM at the latest?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal. Now that's more like it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ms. Li, I just got called for some last-minute overtime the day after tomorrow. Could you please feed my little furball? It’ll only take a moment!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The day after tomorrow? I have to take my daughter to register out of town. My schedule is packed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, Ms. Li—you’re always so warmhearted! This is such a tiny favor, hardly any trouble at all. We’re practically neighbors upstairs and downstairs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The registration has a strict cutoff time. I’m worried I won’t make it back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ms. Li, this is what makes a community warm—neighbors lending each other a hand! Help me out this time, and I’ll absolutely return the favor next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright then. I’ll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Knew I could count on you, Sis Li. The key’s still in the usual spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're short-handed for the Saturday event. Wanna help fill the spots?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't. Who the hell would wanna attend that lame event anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Every time I ask for help you pull this bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck's wrong with you? I ain't your on-call bitch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! After all those times I helped you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Stop digging up old shit - I owe you jack!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Next time you need something, don't come to this 'not decent enough' guy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could we discuss something? How about trying cohabitation before marriage?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That's sudden... I'm a bit thrown off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just thought it'd help us adjust to living rhythms beforehand. But no pressure at all—it's totally your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mostly worried that if we try and find incompatibility... it might damage our relationship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair point... I simply believe early adjustments benefit long-term harmony. Please proceed at whatever pace feels right for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe we could start with occasional weekend stays first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's a sensible approach! Easing into it works well too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, let's try this step by step.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna grab some skewers tomorrow night? Just won't hit right without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling crazy overtime lately, totally wiped. Y'all enjoy though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how you were the life of the party last BBQ? Shame if you missed this one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh don't remind me - work's piled sky-high, zero juice left in me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, crash hard after you power through this workload.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it bro - next round's on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal - saving you two fatty kidney skewers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Legend! We'll sync up soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Listen, could you cover my class? I can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with you? Just cover it and stop the nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the crazy one! Not my damn problem!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must cover it today, or things won't be pleasant!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Grow a spine and drop it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, have you even written that damn group report section? It's due the day after tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... this part is hard to research, I haven't finished it yet...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not done? Can't you show some damn responsibility? This affects our team's reputation! Shouldn't you have basic moral decency? Or do you want us all to fail?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I'm not trying to slack off, but this section's really challenging...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Challenging? Do it anyway! Right now! This is your obligation - everyone else delivered while you're slacking off. Got no shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll try...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, have you decided on the internship placements? Why wasn't my kid selected?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The shortlist is still under review, primarily based on academic records and practical experience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's bull! His roommate games all day with failing grades got a spot—did you take bribes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please mind your language. The selection process is fully video-monitored.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the damn video good for? Clearly picking on honest folks! My son's miles better than your picks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You may submit a written appeal for disputes, but refrain from personal attacks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appeal my foot! This lousy college rigs everything behind the scenes—this isn't over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I've got some online course data I can't complete. Could you help me fake the records? Just to pass the inspection.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Faking the metrics? That doesn't seem entirely compliant, does it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There is some risk, admittedly. If it's convenient for you, go ahead. Otherwise, I'll try to manage something myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd recommend caution here. If you're genuinely stuck, maybe I can inquire about other options?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, forget it then. Don't want to trouble you. I'll figure something out on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for that tone. Perhaps you could try making up actual study hours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, understood. I'll reconsider. Thanks anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been like strangers lately; shouldn't you take the initiative to save our relationship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you obsessing over all day? Isn't peace and quiet just fine?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Zhang next door walking with his wife daily—and you? You just crash on the couch after work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always bringing up others! Can't we focus on our own lives for once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm busting my back for this family; don't you owe it to pitch in a little?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the moral guilt-tripping already! How about you quit the constant complaining?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We need to settle this today: do you want to fix things or drag out this cold war?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, about the budget overrun, can we say it was your decision?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why is this necessary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you step in to explain, it'll be easier to get through—if not, I'll take the blame myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't quite appropriate; it's better to explain the situation honestly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll handle it myself then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you need support, you can speak up, but provide honest feedback on the issue.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What documents are needed to apply for hardship assistance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You don't even know this? Do you deserve the government's care? Submitting proof of hardship is mandatory!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was just asking about the required materials, why are you yelling?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only irresponsible people ask so many questions! Everyone should prepare everything proactively!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much income verification is required?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that attitude, are you even worthy of assistance? Just do exactly as I say—stop wasting state resources!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How is asking a couple questions considered wasting resources?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those with any sense handle it quietly! You need to show some responsibility, don't act like an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, you must design my opening event poster for free! Classmates should help unconditionally!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project schedule is packed solid right now, and my rates aren't cheap either...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Who took care of you in the hospital last year? How dare you charge me for a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember that, but I'm truly swamped right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money, money, money! Is our classmate bond worth nothing to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At most, I can do one main image for free...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The entire VI design suite! Or don't ever call me brother again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still single at your age? You're bringing shame on us old folks! How utterly unfilial!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm dead tired from working overtime nonstop. When would I even have time to date?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just look at the Zhangs' daughter next door—her parents finally held their heads high after she married. Why can't you make us proud? Don't embarrass us like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand where you're coming from, but you can't rush these things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must attend this blind date, or we'll never recover from this heartache!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, you win. I'll go take a quick look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, look, we're fellow townsfolk—since you've got that spare room, it's only right you let me stay awhile.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kids are having online classes at home these days... it's really not convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other is an obligation among fellow townsfolk. You wouldn't just watch me end up homeless, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I find you a short-term rental? I'll cover part of the rent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That won't do! What kind of bond is staying in a hotel compared to staying with a fellow villager? I'll come by tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... shouldn't you at least give me a heads-up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's there to fuss about between folks from home? If you won't help, don't expect me to put in a good word when you need things done back home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... one week tops. I'll rearrange the kids' schedule for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's getting you a new dad for your own good! Dare to object and you're an unfilial brat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you ever care about my feelings? What's wrong with me disagreeing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful snake! The whole family sees your selfishness—even relatives say you should support this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the emotional blackmail! Have you forgotten how recently Dad passed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must understand me! Children have no right to oppose elders' decisions!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since when do you care about reason? I'm utterly disgusted with you people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filth of an offspring! Don't come home for New Year—I'd have done better raising a dog!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best, professor—could the deadline be pushed back just two days? Please?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Here we go again. Think I'm a pushover, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But look, I've pulled three all-nighters—my eyes are swollen! Even other professors showed mercy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut it out! Rules are rules!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't agree, I honestly can't keep going...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How many times? On-time submission is non-negotiable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always preach caring for students, yet won't help when you see how bad I have it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the moral blackmail! For the last time: submit on time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: People in the group chat said the streetlight repair seems stalled again. What a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, but there's not much I can do about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If only everyone could take a moment to follow up with the property management.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably everyone's tied up lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I suppose so. Just worried delays will make it harder to fix later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's wait and see. Maybe someone will handle it in a few days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Alright, waiting might be best for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm, let's just leave it at that for the time being.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been drifting apart lately, so you need to sit down and talk with me about how to improve our relationship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with how things are now? Why do you have to go looking for trouble?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how loving Xiao Li and his wife are - we really should learn from their example.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always comparing us to others! How annoying can you be?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm only doing this for everyone's sake. Don't you want a better relationship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop pushing me like this - I'm under so much pressure I can hardly breathe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then give me a straight answer: do you want to work on improving things or just leave them as they are?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I need a loan guarantor for my car purchase—sign for me right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being a guarantor is too risky. What if you default?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking hell! Won't even help family? Are you even human? Remember how my family treated you back then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's fucking different! Guarantors become liable for debts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Refusing to sign makes you a heartless, ungrateful wolf—my whole family will despise you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! I'm not putting up with this bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my elderly parent was rushed to the hospital—I gotta get there now. Children who abandon their parents deserve to be damned, you understand that, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're leaving right before the project deadline? After all those sleepless nights the team pulled? How's that fair to anyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it's a life-or-death emergency! Blocking me like this—won't people question your conscience if word gets out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, go. But be at your desk by 9 AM sharp tomorrow, or kiss your quarterly bonus goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try to make it back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 'Try'? I need you physically here before midnight. Non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll wrap things up as fast as possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, get my resume in for an internal referral at your company ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This resume looks watered-down as hell. Four job hops in three years plus doctored education? How could I refer this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck? When I hooked you up back in the day, you weren't picky! Why you acting all high and mighty now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You got the nerve to fake credentials and play victim? Who's gonna take the fall if this blows up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Refusing makes you an ungrateful bastard. I'll make sure the whole company knows tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck... Fine, I'll refer you. But don't drag me into this if shit hits the fan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Should've agreed earlier instead of putting on that holier-than-thou act.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, got some free time lately? I emailed you my resume, mind taking a look if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your major doesn't really match our position requirements, might not be the best fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I was just hoping you could check if my resume is properly written.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The resume looks decent, but pushing for an internal referral would be tricky—don't want to waste your time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I treat you to dinner sometime? Just consider it giving me some feedback!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze in some time to review it these days, but really can't promise any internal referral.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man! Definitely owe you a proper meal soon!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, bring my package back from the station for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who are you? Why should I help you get it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blind? It's just a few steps away!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Idiot! Don't you have legs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even help with such a small thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stop barking here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just my luck to run into someone like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the hell out of here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You MUST come back home next month! After all your parents have sacrificed raising you, isn't it time to fulfill your filial duty? What will the neighbors think of our family if you don't?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just got promoted to manager in the city! What future would I have back there? Stop trying to guilt-trip me with this filial piety nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful wretch! We paid for your education just so you could become this disloyal? Isn't it only right that you contribute to our hometown's development?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always slapping labels on me! The city offers real opportunities and decent pay—should I go home and drink the northwest wind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heartless brat! What did we break our backs for? If you won't come back, don't bother calling this family home anymore!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then! Since I'm always the ungrateful son no matter what I say—have it your way!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Zhangs' two kids bring so much liveliness every day; haven't you two thought about having another one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm worn out from daily overtime; how could I possibly manage that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Having another child while you're young is ideal, especially with the grandparents able to pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Baby formula costs are rising; it's tough enough raising just one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Another child adds warmth to the home and means an extra red packet at New Year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's discuss it another time; this decision requires careful thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, if you have time, could you give my kid's little competition post a like on your feed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with work lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, you go ahead with your stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These events are just for fun anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As long as the kid's enjoying themselves, that's what matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I promise to show support next time I'm free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, go ahead with your work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk! How dare you show up with such a pittance? Cheapskate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! I'll give whatever amount I please!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, the pauper's getting feisty? This chump change wouldn't even satisfy a beggar!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still better than you, you miser! Quit acting all high-and-mighty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least I'm more generous than you! This pathetic stinginess shames your entire family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stop bossing people around here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, mind if we use your place for a dinner gathering this weekend? It's pretty spacious there anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, worried I won't host well enough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all close friends, none of us care about that stuff. Do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... just don't mess with my study, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, we'll put everything back exactly as it was. No need to worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, Saturday night works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks bro, I'll treat you to a meal another time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going on a business trip for half a year. Can you keep this plant for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, is the balcony okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! Dinner's on me when I'm back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been over five months. When are you picking up the plant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm swamped and exhausted... You've kept it so well though, the leaves are glossy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is already piling up with stuff. Honestly can't squeeze anything else in...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you worked overtime, I covered for you. When it's my turn for a small favor... never mind, I know you're busy too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Auntie. Is your car free this weekend? Lend it to me for a couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? This weekend? I might need to use it myself...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh please, what could possibly be so important? I'm your own nephew! Didn't my parents help raise your kids when you were struggling? And now you won't even do me this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help... just that it just got serviced and I'm worried about dents...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, you treat this junker like some treasure? Zero family consideration - you're utterly clueless about basic decency! Just wait till the relatives hear how you act - see who'll give you the time of day then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine then. Drive carefully and watch the road.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About time! And fill up the tank before returning it - stop being so damn cheap, what kind of elder acts this petty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing those office lovebirds flaunt their love every day while we've been together half a year with nothing to show on social media—don't you think it's time for a couple pic?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just transferred departments and need to make a good impression. Posting now might not be the best timing, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always made things public in past relationships! I don't even have one photo—friends joke I'm dating a boyfriend in witness protection.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are different now. Can we wait until I'm more established?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my mom keeps asking why she never sees your photo. She doesn't buy the 'too busy' excuse.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax! After next month's review, I'll take you out for photos myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you've been so diligent with your exercises lately, that's really good, really great.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This problem is twisting my brain, mind if I take a breather?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush, just keep chipping away at it bit by bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A few are completely stumping me, it's pounding my head...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hang in there, I know you've got this in you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, I'll give it another shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey everyone, come join in the fun for this team-building event – sounds pretty great!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, something urgent came up at home. Could I possibly skip this one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, family stuff takes priority. Missing this event isn't a big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly, I'm completely tied up this time. I'll make it up later though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, plenty more lively team gatherings ahead. We'll catch up next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks boss, gonna handle the family stuff now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead, just stay safe out there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For sure, I'll absolutely be at the next team event!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have Meituan membership coupons? Share them so we can order takeout together and save money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I usually keep them for myself and don't really want to share.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As roommates, resource sharing is mandatory — you ought to be more generous since it costs you nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That may be true, but I still feel it's somewhat unfair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit being so petty! Since we're colleagues, coupon sharing is non-negotiable — that's only reasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but don't expect this every time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! Sharing coupons shows team spirit — you've made the decent choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll send you the code now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, by rights, this school district spot should go to Xiaobao.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my kid needs it urgently for school too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's rare for me, your younger brother, to ask for something - refusing would mean disregarding our brotherly bond.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This burden's too heavy; I must consult my family first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family sees you as the reasonable one - don't disappoint our elders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over for a few days before responding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must go to the matchmaking session, or you're being unfilial!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't want to go; I can find my own partner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really? Years of searching and nothing to show for it! You're breaking our hearts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant; please stop pressuring me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not pressuring you? After all we've done for you? Don't you understand filial piety at all?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go! Just stop talking about it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hand over your video account password—I need it to binge-watch shows lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rather not, I'm using it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Roommates absolutely must share—this is an absolute moral duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is my personal account.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing to share means violating our dorm solidarity—your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, be my guest with my account. Don't you dare change the password.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got any thoughts about younger brother's schooling?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, it's too risky now with tighter regulations. Hard to pull off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Child's education is crucial, we should brainstorm solutions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If things go south, I could lose my job. Better not risk it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The extended family has been asking, but safety comes first—no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me explore legal channels first. If not, we drop it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair enough. Just do what you can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid got left alone after school again, and I'm completely swamped this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't right now, I'm slammed with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He keeps talking about how thrilled he was when you took him to the amusement park last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe another day? I'm genuinely stuck here at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know, but he got super excited hearing you might come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah well... I'll try to carve out some time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! We won't keep you long at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you know why Xiao Li didn't come to work today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No clue, probably slacking off. That guy's unreliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, you still don't know? You're fucking useless, totally clueless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off, believe what you want! He's probably faking sick, who the hell knows!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. If you've got any info, spit it out already. Quit dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! I genuinely don't know! Go bother someone else, dumbass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, total waste of time. You're absolutely worthless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, how've you been lately? What's keeping you busy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't even ask. Crunch time on the project, pulling all-nighters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got this PPT that needs urgent revisions. Since you always handled these before, could you just take a quick look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doubt it. Gotta pull another all-nighter on this proposal tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll ask Xiao Zhang then. Just thought you were more experienced.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this. I'll make it up to you with dinner next week when things ease up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard you're going to Guangzhou for business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, leaving tomorrow. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must bring me Cantonese sausages! What kind of colleague refuses such a simple favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my luggage is already crammed full...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Selfish people like you who won't even help coworkers don't deserve to be called team players!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. But only two bags max.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Two bags? Think I'm some beggar? Nobody'll help you later if you keep being this stingy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, I'll try to stuff in more then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True fans check in punctually every single day. It feels quite disappointing when someone's absent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got completely swamped today and couldn't make it. Maybe another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The veteran fans show up religiously without fail - that's what real commitment looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do I need to attend daily just to prove I belong here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This whole community thrives on everyone pulling their weight - you understand what I'm saying?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll probably just observe quietly from now on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on the full crowd - it feels noticeably emptier when someone's missing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, how long has it been since we last hung out? When can we meet up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, the project deadline's crazy tight, might not free up until next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True that, remembering how we used to grab skewers together back in the day—those were such good times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been hectic, just can't be helped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pulling all-nighters constantly must be draining—why not unwind a bit? Let's catch up and decompress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal then—I'll be waiting for your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The renovation of my new shop is almost done. Could you please help take some promotional photos? I've poured all my money into this renovation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is packed tight lately, probably can't free up time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Starting a business is brutal – you're the only one who can help, others just don't capture that essence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly because I'd need to get all the props and equipment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll repay you properly once business picks up – I genuinely need friends to pull me through this rough patch now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, it's not that I don't want to help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about coming to the shop Saturday morning? I'll feel completely reassured with you handling this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see, depends on my availability.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, urgent! Can you announce my apartment sublet in the main group?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our project's launching soon, I've got all group notifications muted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man I'm freaking out about losing my deposit this month... With your connections, even an offhand mention would work better than anything I do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why didn't you bring this up sooner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's 'cause I trust you! I'd feel awkward asking anyone else...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll squeeze it in when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li, why are you dragging your feet on those supporting documents? Slacking off again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I haven't started yet... I don't know how to begin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Still dawdling over such a pathetic little thing? Get going and write it, now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll write it, alright? Please stop yelling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're dead meat if it's not done right! Don't waste my time, you moron!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'm working on it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get a move on! Your dilly-dallying is annoying me!
