turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scumbag! I'll cuss you out every time I see you from now on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Enjoy your little meltdown!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, vote for me in the Most Beautiful Employee contest, will ya? It's just a few taps.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, maybe later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not even willing to help with this? Everyone else is pitching in quite enthusiastically.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll do it when I get a minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? What kind of friend would refuse this little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I voted already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Gotta show some support every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm two sales short this month, hurry up and help me fudge the numbers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Again? Don't you remember the compliance warning last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop acting all high and mighty! If I hadn't taken the fall for you last year, you'd have been fired already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Send me the data then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the holdup? Now! Immediately! Fail this and you're betraying the whole team!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! Quit rushing me to death!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better know your place. No results by morning and you'll pay dearly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, have you finished that report section yet? Please don't leave it to the last minute again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, not yet. This part is really challenging because the materials are tough to locate. I'm quite annoyed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please stop with the excuses. You delayed things last time. Could you speed up a bit? I'd rather not share the blame.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the nagging! If you think you can handle it, feel free to step in. It's easy to comment without doing the work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not offering help. Just suggest that if you can't manage it, say something sooner to avoid affecting others. Sort it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave it be! I don't need your input. I'll post it in the group once I finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, the kid's really set on that school spot. What if we can't snag it? I'm all worked up about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pulling strings is risky these days. Policy's too tight—gotta be careful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid keeps going on about it. It really gets to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is tough. I'm afraid I can't be much help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you know a lot of people? Can you ask around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll look into it. But don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's great! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that kind of character in Lao Zhang's son, I'd say you'd better not recklessly introduce him and ruin someone's life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It can't be that bad, can it? The young man seems quite decent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What good is decency? How dare that pauper even dream of climbing the social ladder?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Someone still needs to give matchmaking a try...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you insist on shoving people into the fire, huh? Where's your conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget I mentioned it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wise decision! Recommending trash like him is just asking for a scolding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The clients are blowing up! We need an apology letter ASAP—write one now to put out the fire!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My own project is about to implode. Can I get a breather?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang always taught us to go the extra mile. Now the younger folks are counting on the older generation to carry the team. Don't let the team down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, swamped... but since you put it that way...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A team's reputation hinges on these little things. Remember how Sales replied instantly last emergency? We need to learn from them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Wouldn't feel right if I didn't help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate you stepping up. The team leans on you to keep things steady.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Just send me the materials already. Stop dawdling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, skipping the hospital today is inexcusable since you've been putting it off since last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, just leave me be. I'm perfectly fine, why all this fuss...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This attitude of yours shows zero consideration for us! Get checked immediately and spare us this worry!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always spouting nonsense, it's downright demoralizing to hear...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Medical bills would be the least concern if you get seriously ill - what's truly unacceptable is your irresponsible attitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll go with you, happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! Had you been this reasonable earlier, we wouldn't have all this hassle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, is it okay if I bring my pet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way, rules say no pets. What if they damage things?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! My pet's well-behaved. You're such a pain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stop your nonsense here. No means no!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, what if I pay extra for cleaning? You landlords are such a hassle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not happening. Get out now, you're annoying me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, I'll find another place then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, you have to cover for me on this client report screw-up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I? You made the mistake, you own it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Because you're the boss! Covering for your subordinates is your duty - refusing makes you cold-blooded!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You dare lecture me about responsibility? Expecting others to clean up your mess?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Your guilty conscience should be killing you. Help me or I'll report you to the CEO for shielding incompetence!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, look who's grown a backbone! Resorting to moral blackmail and threats now, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello officer, the mahjong downstairs is so loud it's making my child cry. Are you going to do anything about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll send someone over. Could you tell us the exact location?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's Building 9. You patrol officers should really patrol more often. Would have been better if you'd caught it earlier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll increase our patrols. May I ask which unit number?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unit 3. It's the middle of the night. Shouldn't we at least get a decent night's sleep with you police around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll handle it immediately. Could you specify the floor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's that first-floor apartment. Handle it as you see fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you should go for your follow-up checkup. Let's stick to the doctor's advice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been feeling pretty good these days. Maybe we can postpone it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Regular checkups are all about prevention, right? Think of it as a little outing—I'll go with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it'll make you take time off work again... I hate to disrupt your schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll only take half a day—I'll just swap shifts. Don't worry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll listen to you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! We'll grab a nice meal after the checkup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I borrow your notes? I really need to catch up before the exam—do me a solid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need them too though. Maybe grab them later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, lend them to me now. I promise I’ll treat you after the exam!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Just use them quick, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you were the best!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to return them early—I need to study too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given how close we are, you could at least give me some hint about your salary, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I really don't want to discuss that—I'm just used to keeping it private.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Everyone else told me theirs. What kind of friend keeps secrets like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not hiding; it just feels pointless to mention...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, just share a little? Otherwise, I'll feel like we're drifting apart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's around average, I suppose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, as a friend, you ought to help me get a Jay Chou concert ticket, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, alright. But could you go yourself? I've been pretty swamped lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not right of you. Real friends should help each other out—you can't just shirk this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll give it a shot. But don't pull this again next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Friends gotta be there for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll take care of it tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you didn't notice the project update? Need to get this done ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry Manager Li, I was just having dinner with my kid. What's the new situation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client suddenly changed requirements, we need the new proposal by tomorrow morning. The team is already pushing hard—could you try to cooperate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I live really far from the office. It'd take me an hour to get there now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's stuck at this point. Why not take a taxi? Everyone's waiting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Alright, I'll get ready and head out now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to cover that meeting for me tomorrow morning—no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't—I have to take my mom to the hospital tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's this now? So unreliable—you never think about others' feelings!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that—I'm genuinely tied up. The doctor's appointment was scheduled ages ago.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all I did helping you move last time—and now you're making excuses? That's just unfair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—I'll squeeze some time to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it—don't let me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, for my wedding at the end of the month, how much are you planning to give? With our friendship, anything less than 5,000 would be insulting, wouldn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? 5,000? Buddy, I'm really strapped right now—this mortgage is killing me. How about 2,000? That's all I can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! That's just cold! When you got married, I gritted my teeth and gave you 4,800! You've got no shame—what an ungrateful wolf!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant... I was better off back then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If I'm your friend, you'll match my gift—you must make it to 5,000! Or forget about our friendship. Refusing to pay up—who do you think you're looking down on?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...You're forcing my hand here? I... I'll see if I can borrow more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! That's what I call a brother with a conscience who appreciates favors! The gift shows respect—don't you dare drop the ball!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey pal, it's an emergency! I gotta dash out—can you cover the shop for me? Be back in a flash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk, always at the worst time. Fine, fine, half an hour, right? Don't you forget!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Got held up! Bro, watch it for an extra hour, will ya?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! We said half an hour, now another hour? You taking me for a fool?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't plan this either! Who knew it'd be such a mess? Quit your moaning!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dammit! I've got dinner plans tonight! You're so bloody unreliable—total nightmare!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough already, stop the racket! Just cover another half hour max! Or screw it—ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scram! Out now! Lock the door! You annoying pest! Never bloody ask me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, I need a guarantor for my leave request. Could you sign for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You at it again? Think I run a damn guarantee shop? Piss off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck's sake, it's just a signature! Why so harsh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Harsh my ass! Who cleaned up the last mess from your guarantee?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was an accident! What's the fucking point digging up old shit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Point is—get lost! Sick of seeing your face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't you dare ask me for shit when you're croaking, old bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beg you? I'd be your damn grandson! Now scram!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I've got nowhere to crash tonight. Can I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk, my place is cramped with the wife and kids. Not really feasible to host you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! So stingy! Won't even help an old classmate out? What a selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit making a scene here! Hosting someone overnight is troublesome. I give one excuse and you start this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Fine, don't help. Plenty of others will take me in. Don't need an ungrateful bastard like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then stop yapping! Figure it out yourself. Can't be bothered with this crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Don't bother coming around anymore. Real fucking loyal, huh!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must sign in for me at tomorrow's meeting—this is team responsibility, understand? Refusing just shows you're irresponsible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Responsibility my ass! When have you ever signed for me? Quit the moral blackmail bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You lack basic decency—are you even fit to be a colleague? Would helping kill you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My fitness isn't yours to judge! Last time you promised to get my package—what then? Stop acting so righteous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Skip helping now and you're banned from future department events—your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, my bad luck! But remember this ain't over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed earlier! Having conscience is basic integrity—that's how decent people behave!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, our department camaraderie thrives on mutual support - a pat on the shoulder here and there is perfectly normal. Don't act like an outsider.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm genuinely uncomfortable with this physical contact. Is this really how everyone interacts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely! See how naturally Xiao Wang and others handle it? Standing aloof makes you seem like you're not a team player.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it feels off to me. Isn't there a more appropriate way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's used to it. Just relax and you'll adapt naturally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must I really do this to fit in? It still doesn't sit right with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's how teamwork operates here. Don't overthink it, just go with the flow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best then. But if it keeps making me uncomfortable, I'll have to speak up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I'm heading to Suzhou next week. Their silk is renowned there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suzhou silk is absolutely stunning. Do grab some while you're there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you pick up two pure silk scarves for me? My wife's been longing for them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The high-speed rail baggage scanners are strict. I really can't carry extra items.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've already assured my wife you're the expert on fabrics!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My suitcase is packed full, no space left to squeeze anything in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Xiao Zhao asked you to bring embroidery, didn't you help quite readily?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All right, all right. I'll make some room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard you're competing for that internship spot? You know full well how capable our Mingming is.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, this opportunity means a lot to me...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Means a lot? Who helped your family when you were struggling? Now you're playing dumb when it's time to return the favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not playing dumb, I just feel...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feel what? Only an ingrate wouldn't understand gratitude! This is settled—withdraw immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've prepared for so long...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All that prep is worth squat! Ungrateful wretch, don't ever show your face at my place again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you repost that stray animal rescue campaign on Moments? Everyone else has shared it, only you haven't.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been bombarded with these lately, feeling kinda numb. Plus, my Moments are all clients.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you not help those poor little creatures? You're so heartless—it's just a click away!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that... I'm worried clients might find it annoying...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal? Compassion matters most! So-and-so has reposted several already—you're the only one being so unenthusiastic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. I'll share it after hiding it from clients.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! People should be kind-hearted!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, yesterday didn't go well with Mom and she's still sulking.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Helping you is a courtesy, not an obligation. Who are you to boss me around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't help then! But don't come crawling to me next time you need something, you ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Say what you want. I'm outta here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you free? Wanted to chat about my niece's internship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Here, what's up? You sound serious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Poor kid's struggling hard to find an internship. Saw you've got tons of connections on your feed—by any chance could you ask around if anything suits?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly swamped right now, got projects piled mountain-high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure, just throwing it out there. Maybe just keep an ear out when you have time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Market's brutal these days, but I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a bunch, Lao Zhang! Drinks on me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll check with my colleagues if they need anyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab me a meal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't leave right now. How about ordering delivery?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. Could you get me fried rice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure. Transfer the money via WeChat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sent. Should I add a fried egg?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Up to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll add one then. Thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhao, hi. My dad's hospital expenses are quite over budget—it's really distressing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, that's rough... How are things now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I set up a donation link. If it's convenient, could you possibly share it in your circle? Every bit helps.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, no problem at all! Send me the link. Money's tight here too, but I'll chip in what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, thank you so much! No pressure to donate though—sharing it would already be a huge help, really just whatever works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. Shared! Hope your dad recovers soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saw it! Truly grateful! I know what this kindness means—really appreciate it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be silly, just ask if you need anything. Gotta run for now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my brother needs money for his house down payment, wire 50,000 to him now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? That's all we have left in savings!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Can't I even decide this after marrying you? Useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your whole family are bloodsuckers! Not a single penny!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get out if you refuse! After all my parents sacrificed raising me? Ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Divorce it is! I'm done with your parasitic family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, your dad can hardly swallow his food lately, just stares blankly at the wall all day, and you're not the least bit concerned?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's always been like this before. He'll be fine after a while.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you mean 'before'? He's crying over your childhood photos now. How can you bear to let him suffer like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My new project is in its final phase...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that project more important than your own father? After all he sacrificed raising you, this is how you repay him when he needs you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine. I'll try to squeeze in some time this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this sooner. His health's crumbling while you delay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, my place is under renovation. Would it be convenient to crash at yours for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, it's pretty packed here lately, might not work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, forget it if it's inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I try clearing the sofa for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Don't trouble yourself, whatever works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll tidy up the living room - just give me a heads-up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, I'll keep everything neat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cool, let's touch base later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, mind if I crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... well, the place is kinda packed with stuff, might be a bit cramped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I can just sleep on the floor. Thing is, my landlord suddenly kicked me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... how about you take the sofa then? Though the soundproofing's pretty bad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! I'll treat you to dinner tomorrow, promise I won't be any trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but make sure you're here by 10 - gotta get up early for work tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! I'll be there sharp. Seriously owe you one for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Where the hell have you been? Did you just dump the kid on me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit nagging! I'm almost there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so slow! Don't you know you're messing up my poker game?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you yelling? It's only a little late!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have some shame! Don't expect me to help you ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As if I care about your help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I can't stand the sight of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the conference room free right now? Mind if we use it for half an hour if you don't mind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on—I've got a client video call scheduled for ten.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've got all our materials prepped, just need a quick huddle to finalize things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... that's cutting it pretty close with my schedule...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, no worries! We'll just squeeze into the small meeting room if that's okay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, don't do that—let me try rescheduling my call. The client should understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it! I owe you a bubble tea sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, no problem~

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you bring back my package from the courier station?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped right now. Can you get it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I helped you with yours last time. Could you return the favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please understand, I'm really tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li always helps without a word when asked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely not free right now. Sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, focus on your work then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm-hmm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! What gives you the right to ban my account? Unblock it now, damn it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, please calm down first. Could you tell me what happened specifically?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Your shady company scams people—not unbanning me today is downright immoral!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our system shows you posted fake ads. Per platform rules, a 3-day suspension is mandatory.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Does your platform have no conscience? My family's livelihood depends on this account!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For extenuating circumstances, you may appeal—provided you guarantee no further violations...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw your damn guarantee! Unblocking me immediately is the moral debt you owe me, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've noted your situation. Resolution will occur within three business days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you seen Xiao Zhang's payslip? How much does he make exactly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe we shouldn't pry, it's quite sensitive.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, tell me - we're so close anyway, and I'd never tell others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this just feels... kinda shady, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh lighten up! If everyone knew, there'd be no more guessing games. Perfect solution!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... it's around six thousand I think.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, save me an internship spot. It's not like it matters who does the job anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With those lousy grades, you want an internship? Bet you can't even fill out a resume!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the act! Your department only hires through connections! That guy last week wasn't half as capable as me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut your lying mouth! What company would take a useless leech like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Getting cocky with that pathetic manager title? Don't come begging when you crash and burn!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! With that attitude, you deserve to be jobless the second you graduate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Some family you are! Go your own damn way from now on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This shoot absolutely must have you—others simply lack the expertise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unfortunately, I've scheduled a meeting with an important client.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Lao Wang pulled through with a fever last time, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're making me feel guilty about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: An occasion this crucial simply cannot go on without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll reschedule my client.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Having you here puts my mind at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... understood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, don't you employees get discounts on tablets? My aunt needs a new one, could you hook me up with one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They've been cracking down hard lately. If I get caught pulling this off, I'll lose my job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you couldn't score a car for your wedding, didn't I sort it out for you overnight? And now you won't even help with such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I'm unwilling, it's just really dicey. This could seriously backfire.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of friendship, helping out shows who's got real loyalty. How else should I face my aunt otherwise?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to work something out, but no guarantees okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! I'll tell my aunt it's all your doing - she'll owe you big time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm moving next Saturday, you absolutely must come help—isn't that basic decency we owe each other as roommates?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I already have plans that day and honestly can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After living together this long, helping each other is just fundamental, don't you agree? I didn't bail when you moved last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's genuinely inconvenient this time—maybe I could help with packing instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ought to grasp priorities—friends can't dodge obligations like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair point, but I truly can't commit to the entire move.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Put yourself in my shoes—I'm deeply disappointed you won't help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll tweak my schedule and do my best to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please let Director Zhang know I've left the reimbursement form on the desk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No legs of your own? Think I'm your damn secretary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless piece of shit! Can't even handle this - you're just wasting oxygen!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the fuck are you? Go lick the boss's boots yourself if you're so capable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trash! Don't expect another favor from me ever again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! You actually think you're important?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dumbass! Just wait and see what's coming!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family's pushing me to get married so hard I could jump off a building! You absolutely owe me a matchmaking favor with our kind of relationship, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling all-nighters at work every day lately. When would I even have time for this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't give me that crap if we're real friends! With all the people you know, how long could it possibly take to pick someone for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project's hanging by a thread - I'd hate to half-ass this for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting torn apart at every family gathering makes me suicidal. If even you won't help, what's the damn point of living?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll squeeze in some time this weekend to ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time! Chop chop, I'm on standby!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's no room for negotiation on the bride price—what's owed must be paid in full.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, I just started this job; there's no way I can scrape together 300,000 yuan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at how grand Lao Wang's daughter's wedding was next door—we can't let ourselves look worse than others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her son-in-law runs a company; how can an ordinary salaried worker like me compare?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We raised you for over twenty years waiting for this day—do you want to become the neighborhood laughingstock?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Loan interest rates are sky-high; just paying monthly installments would leave me broke.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is saving face more important than money? Borrow from loan sharks if you must, but get this done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new project is urgent, you must take it over! As a partner, do you even have this little sense of responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why me again? I'm swamped too lately, can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Busy my ass! You've been slacking off daily. You must fulfill partner obligations, or just quit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that supposed to mean? I am working! There're tons of projects, can't we share the load?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Share nothing! You finish this immediately. Partners should contribute unconditionally - lazybones don't get negotiating rights!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you win. Waving that moral baton around, what can I say? Guess I'm taking the fall?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right you are! Your duties are crystal clear. Stop whining and move it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can I borrow your power bank? My phone's about to die.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, I need it when I head out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck? How can you be so selfish? Shouldn't roommates help each other out? Get it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! I'm not lending it, what are you gonna do about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You heartless bastard! Living together and you won't even lend a hand? Are you even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! You always cause trouble! Go borrow from someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're not lending it? Don't expect my help if you ever need it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Like I'd ever want your help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey? Lao Li, it's me, Zhang Qiang from back home. I've hit rock bottom lately—you gotta pull me through this, brother!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Qiangzi? What's the big hurry? What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, I can't even pay my rent! We're from the same hometown, you're living the high life—you absolutely have to lend me five grand to tide me over! If you won't help, are you even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, well... I'm strapped for cash too, buddy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You're fucking loaded with gold and jewels—who the hell got you started working back then? You ungrateful wretch! Can't even lend a hand with this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, alright, I'll try to figure something out, but I honestly don't have five thousand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, do you have that big gold chain? My cousin's wedding's coming up and I wanna borrow it to wear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? You think that's some dollar-store crap? Lose it and you'd need a miracle to replace it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Was the yelling necessary? Just asking a question! Such a tightwad!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who's the tightwad here—me or the one with zero self-awareness? Remember last time with my watch? Gone in a blink!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, keep your stuff! Like I'd skip the wedding over this? Ridiculous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! But hands off my things—period.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetheart, Grandma has a severe allergy to dog hair, so it might be inconvenient for her to stay with us long-term.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... what should we do then? Couldn't we keep the dog in a separate room?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The doctor said fur is hard to control completely, and elderly health comes first. Do you have alternative suggestions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about temporarily fostering it with a friend? I'd really hate to give it up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That option could work. But we'd need reliable arrangements - pets get stressed in new environments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll ask Xiao Wang since he's experienced with dogs. If that fails... we'll figure something else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's settle this quickly. Grandma's moving in next month and we must prepare the house.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll handle the arrangements within days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, are you coming to the team-building? Don't make excuses again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't make it this time, family matters came up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really? Something always comes up when there's a group activity. That's rich.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm serious this time, my child has a school event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself. You never been much of a team player anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not really appropriate for you to say, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think whatever you like. Someone who always dodges collective events speaks for itself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I bought two extra boxes of this collagen drink—would you like to try some?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My recent checkup showed elevated liver enzymes, so I probably shouldn't consume oral supplements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh but this actually supports liver health! I've been pulling all-nighters binge-watching dramas thanks to this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't—my medication requires avoiding certain things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll save some for you after you've recovered!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, thanks for thinking of me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for thanks—you should focus on getting well!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it—let's catch up later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, you gotta come to the team building this weekend. Everyone's looking forward to having you there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What activity is it again? Might have to work overtime this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Wang pulled through last week with a cold. A core member like you certainly can't afford to miss it, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project timeline is really tight. Not sure I can free up time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang mentioned things get dull without you, and the boss expects the whole team to be present.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This... what's the best way to handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing some friends to liven things up could work. Xiao Chen really added some spark last time when he brought people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to adjust my schedule then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Sis, would you mind using your points to get me a hairdryer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm actually saving points for a new suitcase, so I'm running a bit low right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me check once you've used up your remaining points?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, I'll give you a heads-up when I get new points next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Just say the word if you need me to chip in for the annual fee.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it's just that we'll need to wait a while for the exchange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll wait for your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll message you on WeChat later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you help me write a report? Time's a bit tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my own plate's full right now, probably can't help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the friendship we've got, you ought to help out. That's what showing you're a true friend looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, I genuinely don't have time. Figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As classmates, we have a responsibility to help each other. You need to step up to this obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to help with part of it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You need to hold responsibility for the whole thing. Don't let me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, 996 is our company tradition. It's your responsibility to prioritize the team's interests, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I physically can't endure this anymore. Is this so-called 'blessing' really worth such a steep price?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people should embrace hardship! Slacking off now is pure irresponsibility—how does that repay the company's investment in you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Investment? You call working 16-hour days slacking? Your standards are truly exceptional, aren't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! You must demonstrate dedication—your year-end bonus hinges entirely on this attitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. You're basically saying if I don't grind enough, I don't deserve pay. Crystal clear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, I'm having a business promotion event this Sunday. You free to come show some support?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm a bit swamped and might not make it. Sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. Friends should back each other up, but totally your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate you understanding. I'll try to squeeze it in, otherwise next time for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotcha. Friendship's about mutual consideration—you decide what works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll figure something out. Don't sweat it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks man! Hit me up if you ever need anything!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've got an urgent package to ship—you need to handle this for me right this instant!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're processing orders in sequence; there are three ahead of yours. You'll have to wait half an hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Half an hour? Are you out of your damn mind? These are life-saving meds—they can't wait! Do you even understand basic human decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Truly can't speed it up. Others have urgent packages too; rules can't be broken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Rules are rigid but you're not! Ever heard of empathy? If your mom were hospitalized, wouldn't you be frantic? Don't make me call you heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Expedited service costs fifty extra. Otherwise, jumping the queue isn't fair to others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Extorting money now, you shady shop? Preaching morals while demanding cash? Fine! But you will handle this immediately—or I'll sue you for endangering lives!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Never again! Hand me the package.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, Nini counts on you so much — she's been so down since you stopped coming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's a sweet kid, but I've got my own plate full.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With her dad gone since she was little, you're the only reliable relative we have. I'm terrified of her suffering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know it's tough for you, but I'm stretched thin myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nini keeps asking for her uncle, saying you're the only one who truly cares for her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Let me think it over, see if I can lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Having your support would lift such a weight off my shoulders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Zhang, you must attend all three dinners next Monday, Wednesday, and Friday! Missing even one means you're disrespecting me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Li, I'm genuinely swamped. How about Tuesday or Thursday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think this is some marketplace haggling? Skipping such an important occasion clearly shows you look down on people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's truly not about disrespect—my wife's hospitalized and needs my care...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! If you can't even handle basic networking in business, no wonder your venture can't grow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll try to adjust my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Try? Listen here: missing even one of the three is a slap in my face. Don't blame me when I stop recognizing you as a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab a carton of milk on your way back? The convenience store downstairs has some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm wiped out today, just want to head straight home and crash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's growing and drinks it daily. Do me a solid, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I get it tomorrow? Honestly can't move another step today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't neighbors help each other out? Remember when I fixed your busted pipe last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the organic one. Gotta be careful with what goes into the kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine. Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, how's the consideration going for that internship spot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still comparing candidates. It's quite competitive this time, with several strong applicants.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Xiao Wang is truly exceptional—top grades and solid experience, far outshining the others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know Xiao Wang is good, but with limited company resources, we must allocate spots cautiously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I believe Xiao Wang fits our needs perfectly; giving him this chance would bring significant value.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I appreciate your input, but we need comprehensive evaluation for allocation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, take your time deciding. We just shouldn't miss out on opportunities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, text me your home address right now! Need it for the courier!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I give my address? I'm not comfortable sharing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You dumbass! Colleagues should help unconditionally! Can't even do a tiny favor—how morally bankrupt!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look... it's not that I refuse, but addresses shouldn't be shared casually!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough bullshit! Send it already, or can you even call yourself a colleague?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine! Sent you the address, but don't be so demanding next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a risky site job coming up. Mind lending me your drone for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A risky site? What if the equipment gets damaged? Repairs are such a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'm really careful with the controls. Any knocks, I'll cover the repairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This gear is delicate. I'm barely comfortable using it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it. I'll check with someone else then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really wish I could help. Maybe try Lao Zhang? He's got more equipment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anytime! Let's catch up over tea later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get my kid into your company school through back channels now, and cut the crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you lost your mind? That's illegal! I won't do shady deals.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing holier-than-thou! You climbed the ladder through connections too. Cut the act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bug off! I'm immune to that crap. Figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even do this? What good are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rant all you want. I'm done. Have fun solo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Quit pretending if you're useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, get me a logo ASAP, this freelance job's urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell can't you do it yourself? I'm pulling overtime every damn day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Are you doing it or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you, asshole! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a fucking dickhead, wasted all these years knowing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go see a shrink, psycho! One more word and I'll block your ass.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking blind to ever call you a friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Zhang, I desperately need your last quote for reference—it's a real emergency, help me out here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on man, don't put me in this spot—leaking this stuff could get me fired.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My whole bonus goes down the drain if this project fails! How could you just watch all my hard work go to waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly not refusing to help, but they audited someone just last week over this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I just glance at the formatting? I'll take full responsibility if anything happens, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... let me mull it over a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my landlord kicked me out today. Mind if I crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my sister's friends are visiting and staying over right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, your place is way nicer than my rented dump anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With three girls staying over, it's seriously cramped here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last month when you had nowhere to go after overtime, I didn't hesitate to put you up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... this is so last-minute, I can't really accommodate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind then, forget I asked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come to my class reunion tomorrow. It's your obligation as my partner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's awkward crashing your alumni gathering where I don't know anyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Supporting me is what partners do, or I'll be deeply disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I always feel like a prop at these events. It's genuinely uncomfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relationships require compromise. You need to attend this one with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have to twist my arm? Can't we find a middle ground?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Non-negotiable. It's fundamental relationship duty. Be there at 7 PM sharp.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Since you're insisting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, Nini's been crying all day without seeing you. How could you bear to let her suffer like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm struggling too. Just switched jobs and the pressure's crushing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That child's grown up without a father—you're the only uncle she can rely on! Don't you dare shove off responsibility like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know she's pitiful, but I can barely keep my head above water with this mortgage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nini says you're the only one who can cheer her up. She won't feel better unless you go—it's your call now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...But I'm drowning in my own problems. Let me think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just help out, will you? If she cries herself sick, who else can I turn to? It's all riding on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll play hooky sometime to see her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you absolutely must come to my business event this Sunday. The venue's been decked out incredibly fancy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't make it this time. Got to take my family for medical appointments, just no wiggle room in my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After I've been bragging to everyone about how dependable you are? The whole crew rearranged shifts expecting you. Wouldn't it be disrespectful if you flaked?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pushing people to swap shifts last-minute feels unreasonable though, wouldn't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole setup was tailored for you specifically. Without you there, the event loses its prestige.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll see if I can possibly carve out some time to swing by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! While you're at it, bring a few colleagues along too—classier that way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you help me sign in tomorrow morning? My kid's kindergarten suddenly called for a parents' meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I've got a pile of reports this week—can't you just take leave yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being a dad is tough, you know. Look how Xiao Chen helped me last time with no issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But last time I helped Lao Zhang, I got called out. Honestly, it's a bit scary.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, your skills are top-notch—the boss totally trusts you. I'll buy you drinks next week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright, but this is absolutely the last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd pull through! I'll have my kid call you godfather someday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey dumbass! I've got legal trouble, can you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit, what mess did you get into now? Can't you figure it out yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's this divorce mess, need a lawyer. Know anyone? Help or not, up to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what if I do? You're too dumb to solve it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Help or don't, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll do it as a favor. Just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, could you handle that bill when you have a moment? Senior staff should know the drill, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I just paid my kid's tuition. Could you give me a two-week extension?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We all have our struggles, but even Xiao Liu covered the cost upfront. The accounting process needs wrapping up, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm stressed too, but I'm truly cash-strapped right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Settle this by weekend? Everyone's pitching in to help, don't be the weak link.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll scrape together the money by weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it - saves us all headaches.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, have you thought about donating eggs? You're the only one healthy and suitable in the family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not sure yet, the risks are way too high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Are you even human if you refuse to save a life? Don't you care about blood ties?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you talk to me like that? What about my own health?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must donate! How dare you be responsible if our family line ends? You cold-blooded thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you crazy? Moral blackmail AND insults? Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not donating, huh? Then don’t ever call me family again! The whole damn family will see you as an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? I left my passport behind and need you to fetch it for me urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not really available right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends would never say no. You won't let me down, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's that urgent, maybe I could do it tomorrow...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't wait till tomorrow! Friends should support each other unconditionally, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're really putting me in a tough spot...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of friend balks at helping? Just go get it now - no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'm heading over now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, do me a favor and vote for me in the Most Outstanding Employee contest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whoa, I'm swamped right now, can't deal with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You call that being a friend? Supporting each other is basic decency! What the hell's wrong with your conscience if you don't vote?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop nagging! I'm genuinely busy—talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Vote NOW! What kind of friend won't lift a finger for such a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll vote, god you're annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Vote DAILY—no slacking off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll vote.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, could you leave the marketing materials on my desk when you're done? They're urgently needed tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director Zhang, isn't this supposed to be the Planning Department's task? I need to visit my family at the hospital tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, Xiao Chen's been praising how reliable you are. The whole team's completely swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really impossible tonight. Maybe we could postpone it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Once these materials are ready, the project's set. I'll make sure you get some extra bonus then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good on you! Helping out is always appreciated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even consider me a brother anymore? You're always keeping things to yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been really tired lately. I just don't feel like talking about this stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you went through a breakup, I stayed up all night crying with you. And now you won't even talk to me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you stop pushing me? I just need some time to myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li and the others are always there for a heart-to-heart. Are we even friends if we're like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Give me a break, I really don't have the energy for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you at least spare an hour for coffee this weekend? As a favor to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Another time maybe. I need to get back to work now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you switch exam times with me tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm actually tied up that day, might not be able to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, totally get you're busy—just thought I'd ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, really sorry about that—maybe next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no problem! You handle your things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, we'll catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's leave it at that for now—appreciate it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
