turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, it's just unacceptable that you still haven't spoken up about this internship! I'm waiting with my heart racing to death—you can't just leave me hanging like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's cracking down hard right now. Pulling any strings for recommendations will get me chewed out. You'd really be better off finding your own opportunities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so unfair! You bent over backwards for Cousin, but when it comes to me, you just turn a blind eye? Is this how little I mean to you? Was all that 'auntie' for nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, it's not that I don't want to help! If the leadership finds out, I'll be in deep trouble. I just can't take that risk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't step in, how am I supposed to face my mom? This is truly heart-wrenching, Auntie. Are you really going to treat me like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll try. But you absolutely must keep your mouth shut about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! I knew you cared about me, Auntie. Blood is thicker than water, after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you must handle reimbursing the team-building costs for me. This is an inherent colleague responsibility – you can't dodge it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped lately, plus the reimbursement process is painfully slow. I really can't take this on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Excuses won't cut it. You have to get this done – it's a fundamental team duty. Stop evading your obligations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The reimbursement system is genuinely problematic. Can't you show some understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This concerns team integrity. You're obligated to push through difficulties without exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll squeeze in time to sort it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the responsible approach. Owning your duties is how you honor trust – don't fail us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll update you when it's processed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come to tomorrow's event - it simply won't work without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely swamped with work; the project deadline's tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How disappointing would it be if you skipped! The whole group's looking forward to seeing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to squeeze in some time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The class monitor specifically demanded your presence, said the event's incomplete without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... what time does it start?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! Who in their right mind would bail on a group event?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These plants have been dumped at my place for over half a year—you haven't lifted a finger. How could you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately. Can't you just look after them a few more days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping you is a favor, but dumping all your responsibilities on me—is that justifiable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll swing by this weekend to deal with them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weekend's too late! The property manager's warned us multiple times—we'll get fined if they're not cleared out. You wanna risk us both paying fines?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it really that urgent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, so we should wait until they all waste away? Is that what it takes for you to care?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, are you using the car this weekend? I was wondering if I could borrow it for a couple of days. Is that convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, this weekend? I might need to use it on Sunday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... Then let me see if I can get things done on Saturday and return it to you early Sunday morning? Is that okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can take it on Saturday, but can you be back by 4 PM on Sunday? I need to go out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 4 PM... That might be a bit tight. If I don't make it back in time, could you take a taxi? I'll cover all the gas and taxi fares.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That could work. Try to be punctual.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no problem, Uncle. Thanks a lot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, you need to get this done quickly; the whole family's depending on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The form's too complicated, I can't figure it out at my age.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't handle this, the child's schooling will be delayed - what are we supposed to do then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, wouldn't it be worse if I filled it out wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how busy we all are - you're really the only one who can step up for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I'll try when I have time, but don't blame me if it's wrong.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll definitely manage it - our family's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, we need to talk about that scholarship thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? What are you on about? I'm busy right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so selfish! You should just give it up! What kind of decent person refuses to help classmates?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I? I earned this through hard work. You're just spouting nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole class is watching. This unfair behavior of yours is letting everyone down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! Stop using classmates as an excuse. I need this opportunity!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must give it up immediately, or everyone will see you for the trash you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Talk shit all you want. I don't care anymore. Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you dare skip this gathering, Mom will flood the house with her tears.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly swamped—the project deadline is brutal, and the boss is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She talks about you every single day. Does your job really weigh more than your own mother, her real son?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promised my colleague I'd help out last time—can't just go back on my word, can I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even the neighbors say you're the cold-hearted one in our family. How could you bear to leave Mom waiting in vain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! I'll squeeze out half a day this weekend. Honestly, you people are impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My interview's tomorrow, mind if I borrow your car?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing, I'm driving my wife to work all week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you messed up that project, I stayed up all night fixing it without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't squeeze it in, my schedule's packed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, so much for counting on you when it counts, are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, next week when I'm free I'll definitely help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll remember that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, I heard you made a fortune this year. You can't just ignore your nephew's education, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tight on cash lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You bought a new car already. Isn't supporting your own nephew's education your damn family duty? How heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's way too harsh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Harsh? Too shameless to help family? Only when the whole clan curses you behind your back will you feel good?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, after all the time the company has invested in you, is it really too much to ask you to grab a coffee on your way? Show some appreciation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I have a hospital follow-up appointment today and might not make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teamwork is all about mutual support. Can't you even do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My appointment slot is coming up soon. If I'm late I'll have to redo the whole queue...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a senior employee you must understand sacrifice. How can young people grow if they're always calculating gains and losses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright I'll go now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember skim milk. That's what responsibility looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, why don't you quit those grad school and civil service exams? The family's barely hanging on, step up and help out already, you selfish brat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell's it to you? I've been grinding for this forever, why should I back out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw those exams! We're practically starving here. Either pitch in or get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? I need prospects too! Who's getting hurt by me taking these exams?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! With the family struggling this bad, would it kill you to help? Your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Get bent, I couldn't care less about your problems!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I sent you my resume—surely you'll do an old classmate this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your recent jobs were all under a year—it's really tough for me to recommend you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when you were job hunting, I pulled all-nighters helping you edit resumes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know, but the company vetting is strict now—even if I refer you, it won't get through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With our friendship, you're not gonna refuse such a small favor, are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll look at the resume... but seriously, don't expect much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what bros are for! Helping you back then wasn't for nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Xiao Zhang, it's me. Could you pull some strings to get my kid into the school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's tricky. Backdoor deals are risky—I probably can't help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't help? What's the point of having connections if you won't use them? That's just stupid!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stupid? Are you insane? You think this is some trivial favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, be that way! Forget it—shouldn't have asked you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say what you want, I won't do unethical favors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph Stingy much? Whatever—pretend I never asked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard you're in charge at that mall?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'm the manager. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I want to buy a phone. Could you hook me up with an employee discount? We're family, help a brother out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, tricky. Employee discounts have strict rules—can't just hand them out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you won't even save me a few bucks? So damn rigid! And I thought we were blood! What a stingy asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Buy it full price or don't—your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, help me grab Jay Chou concert tickets tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that! I'm trying to get mine too—got my hands full already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell kind of brother are you? Didn't I help you countless times before?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! These tickets are impossible to get, you realize?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! If you won't even do this, don't come crawling to me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn moral blackmail huh? Think I owe you or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right! Real brothers must help out, or you're just an ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Fine, fine! I'll grab yours! I'm so fucking done with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey? Lao Zhao! Lend me 5000 yuan pronto!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Who do you think you are, asking for a loan so bluntly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Fatty Liu from the hometown village! You pretending not to know me? I lost at gambling, hurry up! Quit dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gambling again?! No money! Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Cheapskate! Can't even cough up this little cash? What a disgrace to our fellow villagers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go find whoever you want, just don't bother me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your dad hasn't been doing well lately. Maybe consider visiting him if you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you want me around? Where was he when I needed him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you're hurt. But he's really lonely now. He'd be happy if you'd visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... We'll see. It's just awkward meeting him now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just think about it. After all, you're father and son. Reconnecting would be good for you both.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see your point. It's just hard to get past this mental block.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure, it's up to you. Reach out if you need help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li, is the material ready yet? Everyone else has already submitted theirs, why are you still dragging your feet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry professor, I'm stuck on it. Could you spare me a bit more time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stuck or not, you'll finish it! I've put so much faith in you – it must be submitted tomorrow morning, no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... could I possibly have one more day? I just want to polish it properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't give me that! Liu already turned his in yesterday – your pace is unacceptable. Get moving now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll pull an all-nighter then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Remember how much I expect from you – don't embarrass me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right, got it professor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, hello! Could you speed up my exam? I'm terribly anxious!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll try our best, but queue order can't be disrupted. We must follow protocol.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Protocols aside, I'm in such distress—how could you bear to make me wait, Doctor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every patient is urgent, but rules can't be bent. We must maintain fairness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm in excruciating pain right now. Shouldn't a doctor show compassion to patients?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright. I'll try to arrange it for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! You're truly a considerate doctor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Li, could you lend a hand with the move tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doubtful, my mother-in-law's coming for a medical appointment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The timing's tricky - I'm really short on helpers here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I swing by in the afternoon? I'll come straight after her appointment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be perfect! Focus on your family matters first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moving's exhausting work - better recruit some younger folks for help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely, that wardrobe's unbelievably heavy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll call you later - I'll come if possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These plants have been with me for almost half a year. How do you think they're doing now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I've been swamped lately. How about you look after them for another week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd actually love to tend to them, but I've been pulling overtime so much that I'm afraid I can't care for them properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll squeeze in some time this weekend to pick them up, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property management brought up how the balcony clutter is bothering the neighbors recently, so we ought to think about sorting it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this timing a bit tight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The weather's turning chilly soon, so we must find them a warm spot before it gets cold, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard you're going away for quite some time to study. Is everything at home arranged properly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, I've asked my mom to come help with the kids, and hired a housekeeper.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting kids to and from school every day can be quite a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've arranged for the school bus service. More convenient that way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just worried your child might keep talking about missing Dad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll make video calls every day to talk with him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang's wife also went through the same thing when he was away on business last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rest assured, I'll wrap up my studies and come back as soon as possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rock climbing in Guilin is such a thrill! TikTok says if you love me, you should join my adventures.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I vomited all day after bungee jumping last time? Let's pick something calmer, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang took his wife there already. Are we young folks really less capable than middle-agers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My heart genuinely can't take it – needed half an hour to recover after that rollercoaster.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom says she'll only feel assured seeing her son-in-law has guts. Is backing out even acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about taking Mom to hot springs instead? She'd hate these extreme activities too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All those couples post extreme sports online. We'll be laughingstocks if we chicken out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, mark the quality inspection report as passed. We'll handle the actual issues internally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, isn't that approach not quite proper? The underlying problems remain unresolved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project timeline is stuck. The report must look presentable, or we can't afford the consequences.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm concerned it could backfire later if discovered...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your hesitation, but you need to grasp how critical this is right now—our hair's on fire. Get me the required report version ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you allow me some time to reconsider?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Decide quickly. Tomorrow afternoon is the absolute deadline. I expect your cooperation to wrap this up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, I'll handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, could you be a loan guarantor for my neighbor? He's pretty reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What good is reliable? Will you take responsibility if things go south?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Coward! No wonder you're going nowhere with that spineless attitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're so capable, why don't you do it? Easy to talk big when it's not your neck on the line!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Idiot! Can't even recognize a golden opportunity when it's handed to you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you're the genius! Just wait till you get swindled out of your pants!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unbelievable! No wonder you'll rot in mediocrity forever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad have been a bit lonely these years, and it's not easy to meet someone suitable, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still have some reservations—it feels a bit sudden...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's alright, take your time. We totally understand how you feel.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you think Mom and Dad can be truly happy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's nice they can find companionship. We can keep them company more often.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I need to think it over...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush. We respect your decision—whatever you choose is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't seen Xiao Li today, heard anything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, probably family matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're his closest buddy - seems off you're not checking on him, doesn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that you mention it... I guess I dropped the ball.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! Look how proactive Xiao Wang was last time. We can't be slacking like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh Alright, I'll reach out now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Get on it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, the passing grade for the midterm is ridiculously high—you're obligated to lower it to 50. All of us have been grinding nonstop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The 60-point benchmark is school policy; I've got zero authority to alter it. Exams exist to gauge learning—adapt or get left behind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this'll flunk half the class! How's that fair? Step up—it's your damn duty as our educator to bail us out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get the pressure, but slashing standards won't fix anything. We'll tackle the tough concepts next lecture.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is an emergency! We've poured our souls into this—quit hiding behind rules and fulfill your obligation to adjust the grading!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll raise it with administration—no promises though. Quit badgering me and actually study for once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, jump into this MLM with me right now, you'll strike it rich in no time! Stop dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Is MLM even legit? I heard it's easy to lose money...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! You're so unreliable! We're brothers - can't even count on you for support? Quit stalling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant, just worried it's too risky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Risks my ass! You're spineless! Wanna stay broke forever? Only a coward would bail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine... doing this for your sake. Don't screw me over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's loyalty! Pulling you in - no backing out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you planning to join the family fund this year?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't decided yet. Probably not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What?! You're hesitating? How selfish! Paying is a non-negotiable duty for family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish? I have financial pressure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit pressure! Stingy over this? You ungrateful brat! Remember when your mom got sick last year? The family bailed you out! Now you MUST repay!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dragging up the past! I'm discussing this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Discuss WHAT? There's NO discussion! An unfilial son like you should pay willingly, or don't expect ANY family help EVER again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll pay. Damn annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's only natural for relatives to help each other out—you must come support my store this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My company's keeping me tied up with overtime lately—how about another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you care about family reputation? People will say you're heartless if this gets out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't twist my words—I'm trying to discuss this reasonably!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: One should remember favors—I was the first to arrive when your family had that event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is a genuine exception—I'll definitely attend next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relatives should be on call—if you skip this, how can we keep in touch?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you free right now? Got a bit of trouble and need your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sort of. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need a guarantor for my leave request. Knowing me this well, you wouldn't leave me stranded here, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guarantor duties are serious – I'm worried I can't handle the fallout.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think about it: friends should help when in trouble. If you were taking leave, I'd sign for you without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, that really puts me on the spot... but I'm still nervous about messing up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine if you want to bail, but isn't pulling each other up what real friends do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright alright. I'll try to make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I really can't hold on anymore—sleepless nights, stomach pains—you absolutely must help me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? Did you screw up again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're our leader who always looks out for us! Last time Xiao Zhang messed up, you covered for him. If you don't bail me out now, I might as well die!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you want me to be the fall guy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this collapses, the reputation and bonuses you worked so hard for will be ruined. How could you bear watching everyone go down with me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, hearing this makes my hairs stand on end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to help me grab tickets tomorrow—can't afford to miss this concert!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got client meetings—really can't squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I stayed up all night pulling strings for your sneakers? I did.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't forgotten, but the timing's genuinely tight this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Surely you can spare half an hour? Consider it returning the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Fine, I'll set an alarm and try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! Knew I could count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just saying upfront—don't blame me if they're sold out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, mind if I borrow your membership? Just need to grab a discount coupon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account's been acting up lately, worried it might glitch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you use it first, I can wait till after you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time it got flagged for suspicious login location, took me ages to unlock it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll figure something else out if needed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and log in yourself then, just don't click around randomly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, two minutes tops and I'm done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? Could I borrow your home address? Need it for a delivery.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Why use mine? Can't you use your own place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As colleagues, helping each other is a basic duty. You ought to do this for me—it shows your sense of responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have some concerns, but I'll try to help anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must help! This is your moral obligation—no reason to hesitate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, sent you the address. Consider it my duty fulfilled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you hurry up? Everyone's waiting for you to distribute the supplies—you're the only one missing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got something urgent on my hands. Could you all start without me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be like this? Team matters should come before your selfish personal issues!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't get away... Can we do this half an hour later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you make everyone wait just for you? Have you no conscience? Do you even understand team spirit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Alright, fine. I'll be right there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed earlier instead of holding everyone up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll grab my things and head over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, all the relatives are coming for the move this Saturday. As family, you wouldn't want to miss it, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't make it this Saturday, got overtime at work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just take leave. The relatives all want to see you, family should support each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's tough to request time off with this tight project deadline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how I ran around helping when your dad was hospitalized? Now your sister's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll try to swap my shift then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the family spirit! I'll have everyone wait for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll do my best to come in the morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, isn't this our regular parking spot? Move your car right away and stop hogging it all the time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you say that? My father's leg pain is so bad he can't even get out of bed—can't you show a little compassion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our car suffered when parked outside—can't your family figure something out? What kind of behavior is it to always take over the spot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as neighbors, how can you be so utterly heartless? If the old man falls, wouldn't you feel guilty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we paid for this spot and have a contract—isn't it unreasonable for you to act this way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just for a few days—can't you bear to see the elderly suffer? What's so difficult about lending a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab me some food? Can't be bothered to go downstairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe order delivery? I'm about to finish this game.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But last week when you worked overtime, I brought you food. It's really no trouble to do this small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I go right after this match? Just ten minutes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, just get me some chow mein.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want any chili in it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mild spicy, thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No biggie, wrapping up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must lend me the new camera this weekend! It's Great-Aunt's once-in-a-lifetime 90th birthday!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've barely gotten to use it myself. Are you sure you know how to operate it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you possibly do that to the elderly? The whole family is counting on you to preserve these memories!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thing is... I just dropped the lens last week...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doesn't it count that Great-Aunt constantly praises your filial piety? You won't even help with this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... But guard it with your life—if it gets damaged, repairs will bankrupt me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I need five days off for a family emergency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Five days? The project deadline is looming. How can you just drop everything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mother's hospitalized for surgery—shouldn't a son be there? Have you no compassion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! The whole team's killing themselves while you act privileged? Have some conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're this heartless, I'll take this straight to the big boss!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Threatening me? Fine. Take the leave—but your bonus is forfeited. Your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck this! You're openly screwing me over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screwing you over? Either take the deal and get lost, or pack your shit and get lost right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you possibly find some time to help with this logo design?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped right now – got three or four projects piled up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that this is pretty urgent, and I'm worried no one else could handle the details properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't free up any time right now. Maybe next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client's breathing down my neck... mind if I send you the materials to look over first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to squeeze it in, but don't expect it super quick, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a million! I'll treat you to barbecue sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'd be so boring going alone to the class reunion tomorrow—I'd have nobody to chat with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't know your classmates well, wouldn't know what to talk about—it'd just be awkward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard Xiao Li's husband always goes with her. Looks so sweet—I really envy that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm too introverted. I'd just stand there looking stupid—so embarrassing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you really don't want to go, it's fine. I'll manage on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I could pick you up later? Then you wouldn't need to stay long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I did mention to everyone you might come. But it's totally fine if you can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll go with you. No problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me boost my performance? I'm two thousand short of my target.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time, can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit acting all high and mighty! You had people boost your stats last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! I'll do what I want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Won't even lift a finger to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're so great, do it yourself! Why the hell are you barking here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's all good! Friends should always cut each other some slack!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just holler if you need me to bring drinks or anything!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real one! Thanks in advance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang, you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About my daughter's primary school enrollment—you know Director Zhang from the Education Bureau, right? You must figure this out for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is tricky. My connections aren't strong enough for something like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 'Not strong enough'? After all these years as neighbors, if you won't lend a hand, you're not being humane! That's downright inhumane!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll try, stop pushing me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Hurry up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must be exhausting squeezing onto buses lately? You should be getting rides from me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, but that's too much trouble. I'll stick with the subway...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Real friends got to have each other's backs—not letting me drive you is basically looking down on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't mean that at all... Just concerned about wasting your time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knock it off! I'm doing this 'cause I genuinely see you as a brother—all this dodging is downright ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then... I'll take you up on it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Friends ought to step up! 7 AM sharp tomorrow—just try being late and see what happens!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah... got it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you sign in for me at tomorrow's meeting? Your desk is closer—it's on your way anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a report due tomorrow morning too, might not be able to manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The team leader is cracking down lately—latecomers lose the whole month's attendance bonus. Didn't you help Xiao Zhang when he took leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'm barely keeping up with my own workload.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember that time your project went sideways? I pulled strings all night fixing it. Aren't we friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. But just this once—I'm really at my wit's end here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! Must sign in before 9 sharp!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, could I have a word? With the project at its crunch time, do you think you could hold off on taking that leave? The team really needs everyone right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, this leave was approved a while ago. My family specifically coordinated schedules and everything's already arranged...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your situation, but work is about responsibility. The whole team is in the final sprint now. If you, a key player, leave, everyone's hard work could go to waste. Couldn't you think about others and try to overcome this difficulty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But coordinating things on my end is genuinely troublesome... and there would be significant financial loss too...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Difficulties are inevitable, but we have to be responsible—can't just think about ourselves, right? The project's success is a shared responsibility. Make this sacrifice for the greater good this time, and next time you need leave, the company will prioritize you. It really isn't the time for vacation now—I can only ask you to bear with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright then. I'll try to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad are exhausted, and you're still only focused on studying? Do you even have the heart?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but the exam is this week. What a shame it would be to give up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial piety can't wait! The house is short-handed right now. You should put down the books and take care of the family first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... I'll help out fully after the exam. Can you all hang on for a few more days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year when you were sick, Mom and Dad stayed up all night caring for you. Now the family needs you, and you're hiding out? What kind of filial son is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright, I get it. I'll find some time to come back in the next couple of days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you know why Xiao Li didn't come to work today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No idea, maybe something came up. Does it really matter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You work with him regularly, you ought to know something. That's your team obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly don't know. Come on, you're putting pressure on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must care about this. Not asking around means you don't take team responsibility seriously. You'll end up letting everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, stop with the moral pressure. I'll try asking around, I guess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, good. You'd better hurry up then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Missed my train tonight—could I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... it's just that the place isn't really tidied up, afraid you might not find it comfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's inconvenient, could you suggest a budget hotel?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me see... there's a decent chain hotel on the next street.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Mind calling me a ride?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll cover the fare since you came to see me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're too kind! Next time I'll book a room in advance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with work lately, so I haven't been able to spend much time with the kids. You don't mind, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, though I hope you can help out more when you can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, once things calm down at work, I'll definitely be more involved with the kids.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, your work is important, but kids also need their parents' time and attention.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know. Thanks for still being so understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries. It's all about mutual understanding in a family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's up to you whether to join Friday's team event. Just letting you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I won't go. Got stuff at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, such a busybody you are, always pretending to be swamped!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say what you want, I just can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! We'll have more fun without you, party pooper!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a problem? Mind your own damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heh, don't come begging for group photos later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been working late every night recently, my back's about to give out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It is exhausting, but we're in the final sprint for the project. Hang in there and take care of yourself, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still have three reports piled up on my desk waiting to be written.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how Lao Wang came in to work last week even with a fever? Let's all just push through a bit longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I guess I'll grab some late-night snacks after overtime to recharge.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Just grit your teeth and it'll be over soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab a bottle of cooking oil when it's convenient? We're running low at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been crazy with overtime lately—would it be okay if I bought it this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all, focus on your work first. No rush these couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any brand preference? Jinlongyu or Fortune?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Either works—just get whichever one's on sale.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll pick it up Saturday and bring it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Drive safe on your way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's your take on the D situation? For or against? Spit it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of my damn business. I'm not involved, so spare me the pressure. Do whatever you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! How heartless! What's wrong with supporting him? Only a brainless fool stays neutral—pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who you calling brainless?! What's wrong with neutrality? Forcing people to pick sides—you're insane!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're just a coward! Choosing D's side is easy, but you play the hypocrite—disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw your disgust! I'll choose whatever I want, got it? Stop yapping here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself! But D's supporters will mock you for playing the righteous one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, the company would like to transfer you to the tech department for some support. Would you consider it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, I have zero technical background and worry I'd create more problems. Could we assign someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but the tech team is critically understaffed. How about giving it a shot? We can always reassign you if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm concerned about underperforming and dragging down team results. Would any training be provided?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We can assign basic tasks only. The choice is entirely yours though – we respect personal preferences.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I take two days to decide? I need to check my family commitments first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, it's completely your call. No pressure from the company – just update me when you've decided.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feeling a bit tired, could you grab me some food?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I'm really swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were sick, I took care of you without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's different this time, I'm genuinely in a rush.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries. I just feel friends should look out for each other more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, what do you want to eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you. That's what real friends do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're our only hope for this shoot, nobody else can capture that magic touch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't make it today, got a big client meeting lined up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang hauled himself over with a 39°C fever last time, what's a little thing like that to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, you're making me feel awful about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team's been grinding for two weeks—if you bail, it'll send all that effort down the drain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll reschedule the client.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! We'd be totally lost without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, you got me. I'm at your mercy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Regarding the documents for Manager Li, can you help me tell him quickly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really tied up right now, can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After I bailed you out big time last time, you won't even lift a finger for this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a meeting this afternoon and honestly can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang and the others are so dependable—why can't you take a page from their book?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll squeeze in some time if I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling—get it done by 3 PM today, no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey HR, I need tomorrow off. Approve it immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you kidding me? The project's in full swing and you want to take leave? How's that even acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly family member's sick—I have to care for them. Do you even have a conscience? After everything I've sacrificed for this team!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap. Leave requires advance notice—you're deliberately sabotaging us, aren't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules? I've slaved for you for years! Now with a family emergency you won't budge? Is this how you repay loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's beyond offensive. I shouldn't waste breath on your type.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dragging your feet. Approve it now or I'll tell the boss you're shirking responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, exception this time. But you owe me big.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, you really should decide on having a baby soon. Mom and Dad won't stop talking about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really worried—what if my health can't handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's there to worry about? With so many of us at home, we've got plenty of hands to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I break down completely? Can you all really manage that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll recover after some rest. A child would complete our family—don't let us down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm feeling overwhelmed... need some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you hurry it up? Think of it as doing us this huge favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm so dizzy, could you grab me some food?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't make it, just order takeout yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you were late last time, did I complain? I even covered for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was totally different, I really can't today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, since you're my friend, forget takeout - it's unhealthy anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, what do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd come through! Real friends help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, my business is tight on cash—could you lend me thirty grand to tide me over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's been tight with household expenses lately—I genuinely can't spare any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you turn your back on family? Don't you owe it to Uncle who looked after us all those years?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kinship isn't transactional—I'm truly in a bind myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help me through this pinch, and I swear I won't bat an eye when your family needs help. Doesn't family got each other's backs—am I right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll scrape together ten grand for you. But you must pay me back next month—no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, I don't think it's really appropriate to share our family's hypertension issue with outsiders, what do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But chatting with friends should be fine, right? Might even get some advice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, if the elderly find out, they'll probably worry constantly about it. That would really burden them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll just play it by ear and try not to bring it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like what happened with Lao Wang's daughter's family – it got around and made things really awkward. Let's just be mindful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll keep that in mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, that way we can ease their minds a bit too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I've been working like a dog lately - haven't visited my mom in three months.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As children, we're duty-bound to care for our parents. How could you neglect her? You must make time this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's about to go through final review - I'm pulling all-nighters every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial piety isn't optional, it's an obligation. Work can wait - this isn't up for discussion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My stress is through the roof already - can you stop pressuring me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No amount of busyness justifies forgetting your roots. Think hard about where your priorities should lie.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you give our new project a quick shout-out on your feed? The whole team's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd rather not mix work stuff into my personal account lately. Let's skip it, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? That's not cool! While the rest of us are killing ourselves, you're just slacking off? Share it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It clashes with my personal brand vibe. Feels super awkward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit making excuses! Everyone else shared it—what makes you think you're so special? Team responsibility isn't optional.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll handle it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Teamwork only works when everyone pulls their weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma keeps talking about wanting a great-grandchild all day, doesn't it bother you at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with my promotion review lately, really can't spare time for dating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Chen's the same age as you and already expecting her second child—at least her family can relax.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really just want to secure my career first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Liu expects us to meet this Saturday—don't you dare stand her up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got mandatory overtime this weekend, genuinely can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's waiting with bated breath—can't you take this seriously?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, has that payment been arranged?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's tight right now, could we push it back two weeks?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With finance under pressure, it'd really help if we could settle this by the end of the week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This week's really tough, but I'll definitely clear it before month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We really can't go beyond early next week—any later will affect our accounts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll find a way to sort it before month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, I'll wait to hear from you this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, isn't your uncle in the Education Bureau? Get my kid into that key school—should be just a word from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's... really not appropriate. My uncle despises pulling strings for favors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing the saint! Won't even help after all these years working together? Guess I never mattered to you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that... it's just lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save the excuses! Who covered your shift last time you took leave? Ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll try...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've said yes earlier! Get it done by Friday—or this isn't over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, got a minute now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped right now, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really urgent! Can you pass along a message for me? Can't count on anyone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly tied up at the moment... What's so time-sensitive?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the bond we share, can you really not lend a hand? It'd be wrong. You see, nobody else is reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, this is really tough timing for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, hurry up! The whole team's waiting on you. Can you afford to let everyone down like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm so stressed out; I've got over a dozen boxes piled up at my place that need moving. It's making me tear my hair out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This weekend's tricky – my mother-in-law is insisting we come over for dinner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, totally get it! Just checked with movers though – they're charging five hundred bucks for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That quote's pretty steep. I know a guy, Master Li, who'd do it cheaper. Want me to ask?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be fantastic! You always know the right people. My wife was just saying I'd find someone reliable to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll text you his number later. Just mention I referred you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This damn platform has a loophole! Wanna create multiple accounts and cash in together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The risk is high... We could be held accountable if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chicken! Fortune favors the bold, not the timid. Take it or leave it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly worried about account linking...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Poor sucker deserves to stay poor! Free money and you reject it? Are you nuts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? I refused and you're still insulting me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't you dare come crawling back to me for help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Block me then, you lunatic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've got a landlord dispute, legal stuff. Could you help me with this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? Tell me the specifics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The landlord might be trying to overcharge on rent. I feel it's unfair. If you have suggestions, you can share any advice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped lately, can't really help. Can you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, that's fine. I'll figure it out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, feel free to reach out if you need to talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Working till midnight every day, my eyelids are heavy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't we all? But your part is crucial—don't hold up the progress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got too much on my plate. What should I do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li pulled all-nighters drafting the proposal without a peep. Can't we be understanding? Try to adjust?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll push through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hang in there. It's all for the team.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, as the newcomer you should proactively propose toasts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I genuinely can't drink due to alcohol allergy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Traditions can't be broken - how else will you integrate into the team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I nearly got hospitalized from an allergic reaction...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every newcomer must go through this initiation. Refusing shows disrespect for our traditions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... could I substitute with a soft drink?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is fundamental protocol. How can we build camaraderie without drinking?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll just take a tiny sip.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm off for a business trip for two months. Just gonna dump these pots at your place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine. Leave 'em on the windowsill.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real pal! Drinks on me when I'm back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! It's been five months! You fucking die out there? Come get this shit now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the rush? What's the big deal leaving them a few extra days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I ain't your damn maid! This junk is taking up space!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jesus! Toss it if it bothers you! Stop bitching about fucking trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, drop everything and make a PPT for me. My wife needs it for her company presentation, and it absolutely must be done tonight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I haven't even finished my own project yet, it's due tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Isn't it basic decency for colleagues to help each other? I helped you when you were renovating your place!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was on a weekend, but this time I'm genuinely swamped with deadlines, man.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If you refuse to lift a finger for such a tiny favor, what kind of human are you? Get it to me by 10 tonight or don't ever ask me for help again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine, you've got me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking. And don't forget to add animation effects.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you should bring back some local specialties from your business trip. After all the hard work everyone's put in over the past two weeks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my suitcase might be too full...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li brought back two whole suitcases last time, and everyone was full of praise. You can't manage a little something like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
