turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! Colleagues should support each other. Don't let everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll try my best to bring some back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang's haul last time was raved about for ages. Everyone's still talking about it. Make a good impression.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be on time for the weekend shoot, no dilly-dallying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, family emergency—can I take leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave? You picking a damn fight? Can't even handle this tiny task without excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My child's sick, really can't leave...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! No-show means docking half a month's bonus!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This... that's too harsh.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! One more word and I'll mark it as an unexcused absence!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Zhang, all the other families have installed monitors to watch their kids—we should really get ours set up soon before it's too late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Won't the child feel like we don't trust him enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You of all people, such a wonderful parent, understand how chaotic society is these days. What parent could feel at ease? Not installing one is just being irresponsible toward your child!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But... I still feel it's not quite right to keep such close watch on the kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since you care so much about your child, you surely want him safe, right? What parent isn't doing this nowadays?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let's install it then. When will they come by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it—it shows you're truly a responsible parent who has your child's best interests at heart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I'm moving this Saturday. Would it really be proper for family to skip helping out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moving again? Can't you hire movers? Such a goddamn hassle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kinda talk is that! Who landed you that job? Now you won't even lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save the act! One job referral and you own me for life? Disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Be at my place by 9 AM sharp Saturday, or I'll take this to your mom!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hiding behind my mother? Who the hell are you? Find someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Treacherous snake! Don't ever call me again - we're through!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You're a walking curse! Fine, I'll come, but shut your trap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my packages keep getting stolen. Mind if I ship them to your place? Could you help me receive them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way, my place is already packed like a warehouse—literally no space left.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, this is the third time they've gone missing! Can't you be considerate? Is this how friends act when someone needs a simple favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You always have something going on. I'm swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you worked overtime, I covered your shift without hesitation. Now it's my turn and you're making excuses? That's absolutely heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, fine. Send me the address. I'll take them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li! My wife's going into labor—can't just leave the shop like this. Cover for me an hour!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Childbirth comes first! I'll hold down the fort, don't worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need you till evening. With our kind of bond... you wouldn't just let me shut down, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a contract negotiation tonight... this is...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last year when you were hospitalized, I stayed three nights straight! Shouldn't that count for something, pal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right... but this involves a huge deal...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how bad my hands are shaking—how am I supposed to manage if you bail on me now? Help a man see it through!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. I'll reschedule the client.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you repost the new project promo for our company on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, mind if I do it later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your sense of team responsibility? Can't even lift a finger for something this simple - how's that acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly the content doesn't sit right with me. Can we discuss this first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even show basic colleague solidarity? With zero accountability like this, how do you expect future teamwork?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the guilt-tripping already. I'll decide whether to repost based on my own judgment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just square it with your conscience. Everybody's watching anyway - can't believe you'd refuse such a tiny favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The competition class deadline is approaching, and you still haven't made a move?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The pressure is overwhelming; I really don't want to add more burdens.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's such a rare opportunity. With all our support, shouldn't you at least make an effort?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My foundation's too weak - I'll just fall behind and embarrass myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How will you ever compete with others if you don't push yourself now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, just sign me up then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up, don't miss the last few spots.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, could you vouch for my leave request?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's been strict with approvals lately, so it might be risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand. Should I prepare a backup plan first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You might want to ask Xiao Liu – he hasn't sponsored anyone recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll check with him. If not possible, no worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, it's a crucial period for performance reviews.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all, work priorities come first. I'll manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate your understanding – I'll definitely help when possible next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Wang, may I take two days off to handle some family matters, if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project is quite tight lately. Which specific days did you need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thursday to Friday. I'm truly sorry for the inconvenience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The workload will have to be arranged. Can Xiao Li cover for you temporarily?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already spoken with him and handed over all the materials.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Remember to submit the system approval process.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll make up the progress with overtime when I return.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, system approved. Wrap up your family matters and come back as soon as you can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Liu, what've you been up to lately? Haven't even gotten a text back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, buried under this new project. What do you need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been jobless for six months, and that opening at your company is tailor-made for me. After all these years of friendship, how could you not help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Employee referrals are super strict now, really tough to pull off...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a click of your fingers for you! I'm struggling this bad and you're still dodging? That's not decent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... whatever. I'll give it a shot for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nini's studies are really tough, and you know how driven this kid is.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my mortgage is really stressing me out too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Aunt Zhang next door—she sends tutoring materials to her niece every single day. Our Nini is so determined; we can't let her down, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just can't scrape together the funds right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With the kid pushing herself so hard, shouldn't we as the older generation step in to help? Or else, who's she going to resent later on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, let's discuss this another time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind grabbing dinner for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't leave yet, still stuck with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My stomach's a bit upset today, really don't feel like moving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about later? I'll grab you something once I'm done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome! Just no cilantro.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure the lid's on tight, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Know it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the inspection is coming up, we have to work overtime tonight to get the documents ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my wife is ill, I need to go home to take care of her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand. Could you spare some time to help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to come by tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks. As long as we work together, we'll pass the inspection.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll be there on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. Appreciate it. We'll pull through this together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetheart, since you've apologized, don't keep harping on it. The constant gloom is scaring the child.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Harping on it? My heart feels ripped apart from the pain. Don't push me, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you see how listless the child's been these days? Don't let your father's mistake steal their happiness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Talk about the child's unhappiness? Who cares that my heart is breaking?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear I'll change, but the child needs a whole family. We have to think of them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can I care about 'whole' when I can barely hold myself together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Zhang's kid next door – grades in shambles after their divorce. Let's not put our child through that suffering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get what you're saying, but this betrayal... you need to give me time to process the hurt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I totally screwed this up and haven't slept a wink all night—you really need to bail me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How exactly are you thinking I should help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When Xiao Li got into trouble last time, you personally stepped in to fix it. You've always been the type who looks out for us underlings...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're basically expecting me to shoulder the blame for this mess?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Otherwise, the team's reputation will go down the drain. Wouldn't that just throw away all your years of blood and sweat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, your mindset is seriously...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, are you home? I wanted to talk about my niece's internship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, I'm here. Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Poor thing's been running around to interviews every day, breaks my heart to see. Since you're senior at your company, could you put in a recommendation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're actually going through layoffs right now, very few openings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got great connections though—could you brainstorm some options? Think of it as helping your own kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This timing is really tricky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I pulled strings for your son's internship? Do this as a personal favor for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll ask around with some contacts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you come with me to a party tomorrow night? I'd feel pretty bored going alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only a damn nutjob would go! Go by yourself if you're so keen!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell are you acting all high and mighty for? What's wrong with asking for a simple favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what? I don't feel like it! Who do you think you are to tell me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're hot stuff? Don't come sobbing to me when you're in a bind later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beg you? Dream on, jerk! Get lost and stay out of my face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crap! I must've been blind to ever know someone like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the hell out! Quit acting insane here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, I'm from upstairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kids might make some noise while playing, could you perhaps be more tolerant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the noise is indeed loud at night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to keep it down. How about you try earplugs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but please keep it down after 10 PM.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll pay attention.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, I'm having some financial difficulties and was hoping to find roommates to share the rent. Would that be possible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The lease explicitly prohibits group rentals, so that wouldn't be quite appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know it's against the rules, but as a landlord, shouldn't you show some understanding for tenants' hardships?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understanding is one thing, but rules can't be broken. I hope you'll appreciate that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you insist on refusing, I genuinely won't be able to afford this place. Isn't this your responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't about responsibility but contractual obligations. Let's adhere to our agreement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really should reconsider—after all, helping others is a virtue.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I must stand by my original decision. Sorry, I can't agree.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Sun, we've hit a rough patch at home — paying for Dad's treatment has wiped out all our savings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goodness... is the situation stable now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We started a fundraiser. You're known as the most reliable in our circle — who else would I turn to at times like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... mind sending the link? I just switched jobs and money's a bit tight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given our bond, if you don't step up for the old man, what'll become of him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll share it on my Moments for now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! With your clout, if you'd donate to set an example, others would definitely follow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it. I'll decide after seeing how things play out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Delete that bad review now! What nonsense are you even writing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you are? Can't handle criticism for your crappy product? Got rocks in your head?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit nagging! Delete the review and I'll refund you ten bucks—don't be an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ten bucks? That's insulting! Think I'm some beggar?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Fine, keep it up. Don't ever shop here again—I'll cuss you out every time I see you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trying to scare me? This dump'll go bankrupt soon anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll drag your name through the mud before then! Enjoy those complaint calls, idiot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Keep harassing me and I'm calling the cops!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's already dark and you're not inviting me to stay at your place? What kind of friend does that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is too sudden. It's really not convenient to host anyone overnight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I traveled all this way to see you, and you'd make me sleep on the streets? Doesn't your conscience ache? Selfish much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant... How about I help you find a hotel?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Expecting me to pay for the hotel? Can't even fulfill this basic obligation after meeting online? How cold-blooded!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you be reasonable? This moral coercion is exhausting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then! You heartless piece of work. Let's just block each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you so late? The child has been waiting anxiously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, something urgent came up. I'm on my way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a parent, you must properly manage your time instead of making children and helpers wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll absolutely be punctual next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is mere awareness sufficient? You're obligated to take responsibility rather than exploiting others' tolerance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I'll correct this. Truly appreciate your help this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember your duties—ensure this never happens again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Repost that in your moments! I'll pay you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! Your crap product will embarrass me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hypocrite! Forgetting when you peddled fake sneakers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Mine were legit overstock, unlike your knockoff trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too proud to help? Won't die from sharing a damn post!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! One more word and we're done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it! Who needs a judgmental relative like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get me that supervisor position.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The vetting is strict now; it has to go through proper channels.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If you can't handle such a trivial thing, what kind of leader are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you talk to me like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All bark and no bite! Help or don't—I couldn't care less!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're absolutely unreasonable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang Jie, could you use your membership points to redeem a fan for me? It's sweltering hot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm saving up for an air-conditioning fan myself—maybe you could wait a bit longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't wait! Our fan at home broke, and the kids have heat rash already. Couldn't you spare those points for a close friend first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promised the kids that air-conditioning fan ages ago...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who drove you to the hospital overnight when your husband was admitted last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really appreciate that... but the kids have been dreaming of this fan forever...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kids suffer terribly with heat rash! Can't you even do this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... how about I get you a small desk fan to tide you over for now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so boring here in the hospital. I wish you could come keep me company if you're free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents have a doctor's appointment this weekend. Might not make it, is that alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I helped you with your packages last time when you were traveling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing—my kid caught a cold and I need to stay home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Liu dropped by today and brought me a book.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to swing by the hospital to see you on Tuesday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come whenever it's convenient—we can just chat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We must take a stand on this, or how can we even call ourselves brothers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The issue isn't even investigated yet—how can we pick sides?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Liu and the others have already spoken up; if we stay silent, what will people think? We've got to show some support!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But if we're wrong, it'll be so awkward—better wait for updates.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How did he help you last time? Hiding now isn't proper, is it? At least post on Moments to back him up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I guess I can at least give it a thumbs-up then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Brothers have to stand by each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhao, my mom was suddenly hospitalized. I need to stay at the hospital next week. Can you cover my workload for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next week? I'm at a critical point in my project—even working overtime every day isn't enough to finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your daughter had a fever, I covered your shift without hesitation. What do you say now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, I get it. But the workload is huge. I'm afraid I'll mess up and drag everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're old buddies. Helping each other out is the right thing to do, isn't it? You can't just not repay a debt, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Tell me what needs doing, and I'll try to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! I'll make it up to you properly—I owe you one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, it's time for your hospital check-up today. Let's go on schedule, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm feeling much better; maybe we can skip it this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being filial means ensuring your health! How worried do you think we are when you act like this? Getting check-ups on time is what being responsible looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The check-up isn't cheap; it's a burden on you...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is a child's duty; you have to cooperate with us to fulfill our filial piety. Don't make it hard for your children.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... then let's go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's right; sensible elders should act like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, it's over an hour late now. This really isn't acceptable, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My apologies, the traffic was horrendous.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Neighbors ought to show mutual consideration - you're putting me in an impossible position here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll set a reminder next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Proper neighbors should respect punctuality, wouldn't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely, my mistake this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just remember - mutual assistance is a neighborly obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? Got an emergency, could you watch the shop for me? Just one hour max, thanks buddy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, no worries, I'm free actually. One hour works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, this is messier than expected. Mind covering two more hours? I know you're a good guy who gets my predicament, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Two hours? But... I've got evening plans too. This is kinda last-minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just this once! Friends ought to help each other out. Remember all those times I covered your shifts no questions asked? Wouldn't ask if I weren't desperate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... that's true... but tonight I really...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how I'm begging here – if you bail now, I'm totally screwed. Throw me a lifeline and I'll owe you big time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, fine. Just hurry back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Engineer Wang, you've been revising this proposal for two days now. Shouldn't it be close by now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet. It requires coordination across three departments. The earliest I can finish is by the end of the day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li's team pulled an all-nighter until dawn to get theirs done the day before yesterday. We shouldn't hold the team back, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This work demands precision. Rushing it will lead to errors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're our most experienced member. If you wrap it up by noon, our whole team can breathe easier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll streamline the process.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, you must be free this weekend, right? Lend me your car, please!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped this week...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're my own aunt—if you don't help me, I'll be so pitiful as your nephew. How could you possibly bear to see that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to think of something...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since you care for me so much, you must help me, right? I'll keep the car safe for sure—we're family and need to look out for each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, come get it Sunday morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great! Auntie, you've been a massive help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, you gotta accept this package I sent to your address!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why on earth should I? My place isn't a damn delivery hub!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even do this tiny favor for a neighbor? What kind of lousy neighbor are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell do you think you are? Take your crap somewhere else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Selfish bastard! Don't come crawling to me next time you need help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! I'm blocking your ass right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been working overtime every day lately and I'm completely worn out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got an urgent matter this weekend that I just can't handle on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe try asking someone else? I'm honestly at my limit here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do remember how you helped me last time when you were free - really appreciated that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, just look at these dark circles under my eyes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No no, it's fine - getting proper rest is what matters most for you now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Haidian house paperwork is burning down our necks and must be done tomorrow - why are you still dragging your feet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tongzhou to Haidian takes two damn hours, and my schedule's packed solid this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm hanging by a thread here! As my brother, shouldn't you step up? This is downright heartbreaking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can we do next week? I swear I'll make it up to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you moved last year, I blew off year-end bonuses to help. Now it's my turn and you bail? Is our friendship not worth one lousy day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try swapping shifts. This is brutal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've said yes from the start! Beers on me later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Send the documents over. I'll bust my ass getting there tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must attend the Zhangs' wedding reception next month—everyone's watching to see if you show.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped that day and likely can't make it; my schedule's packed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't just some casual party—it's about family reputation. Skipping would be downright improper.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I genuinely can't spare time. Maybe I could swing by later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the excuses! Basic human decency demands you come. How disgraceful would it look if we all bailed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to shuffle things, but quit hounding me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've got to preserve this relationship. Everyone's banking on your presence—don't screw this up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go. But mark my words: never again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, do you think we should share some baby photos on Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe we shouldn't, we need to be mindful of privacy issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, won't post then. Protecting our child comes first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You could share some blurry ones if you'd like, just avoid showing the face.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, then I'll post a back view photo to let people know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just control the frequency—don't post too often.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll follow your lead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, that's settled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, help me share that crappy company project on WeChat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped—can I do it in a couple of hours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so damn picky! Dragging your feet over this trivial crap, don't you have any sense of responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The content looks sketchy—what's wrong with not wanting to share?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit, you think you're so noble! Making a simple favor seem like life or death, you selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? It's none of your damn business whether I share or not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! You heartless jerk, stay away from me from now on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you absolutely must be the guarantor this time! With our relationship, it'd be unreasonable if you didn't help, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not dodging, but being a guarantor carries huge responsibility. I'm strapped for cash too - if things go south, I couldn't handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your son got married and needed money last time, I lent you fifty thousand without hesitation. Now it's my turn and this is your attitude?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember the money, but if this backfires, I could lose my house.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone knows you're the most loyal friend. If you bail now, how could we ever face each other again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... since you're putting it like this, I'll consider it these next couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll expect your answer Friday! With our bond, I know you couldn't bear to watch me crash and burn.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, could you hold a queue spot for me? You understand better than anyone how pressed I am for time, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped tomorrow too, probably can't make it to queue.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other is what colleagues do – how can you refuse? You must secure that spot tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm genuinely overloaded and won't make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unacceptable! Lending a hand is mandatory. Be there before 6am sharp tomorrow – don't disappoint everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try. But don't pull this again next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, you simply must share that promotion post on your Moments—the whole family is watching you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I haven't even looked into what it's about yet. Doesn't seem right to share it blindly...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so inconsiderate? You're the only one in the family holding out. What will our relatives think of us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with a project deadline lately—really haven't had time to check my phone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too busy even during bathroom breaks? Is our family's face worth nothing to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll share it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. If your own family won't support you, who else would?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li didn't come to work today, any idea what's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really, maybe something came up at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all a bit concerned, maybe you could check on him when you've got a moment?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll try reaching out to him later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's good, just want to make sure he's okay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, no worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, keep me posted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I feel empty inside. It would be so good if things could be like before.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not ready yet. You really hurt me last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Li and them—they patched things up quickly. We can't just stay stuck in this rut forever, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every couple's situation is different; I might need more time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I reminisce about the past every single day. Don't you miss those times?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop talking—I'm really confused right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but feelings fade if you drag them on too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, my paper's stuck. You're the best wordsmith—could you polish it for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with work lately, my own tasks are piling up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You saved me with the data last time—you're the only one I can count on now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, when's the absolute deadline?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next week's fine. Honestly, I wouldn't trust anyone else to edit it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll try to squeeze in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! I'll treat you to dinner later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor Li, would it be possible to add Director Liu as a co-author on the paper?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director Liu didn't participate in the actual research, so that may not be appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you perhaps reconsider? Director Liu did help coordinate lab resources for us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But academic standards mandate that authors must have made actual contributions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see. Would it be acceptable to mention him in the acknowledgments instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That shouldn't be a problem—I'll add that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thank you for accommodating that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, have you shared that poll in Moments? Could you support our class?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, always with this crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you answer without cursing? If you won't support it, get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only a dumbass shares this crap daily. What's wrong with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, just shut your trap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business, piss off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you're so impressive. I'm out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my shop's about to go under—you gotta bail me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The platform's cracking down hard lately, it's way too risky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you needed help, I backed you without a word. You wouldn't just leave me hanging now, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... mostly worried about getting banned...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just consider it paying me back—a simple interaction is all I need.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... what do I need to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real bro! Sending you the details now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm thinking about having a third child. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not the best time with how high expenses are now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the elders do want more grandchildren, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need more time to recover physically though. Can we revisit this next year?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair enough, let's focus on arranging the eldest's schooling first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding—this really can't be rushed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want the bride? Hand over a fat 8888 red packet right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm no tycoon - this amount is ridiculous!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You stingy bastards! Can't even show basic sincerity? Don't you love the bride?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, since when does money prove love? This is straight-up extortion!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! No red packet means no dignity - fulfill your damn duty to honor the bride!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! 5000, take it or leave it! Un-fucking-believable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, I need a guarantor for my leave request. Would you mind helping out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not really available to guarantee lately. I have to consider the responsibility issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. Do you think Uncle might be able to help then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He should have free time recently. Why not ask him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks for the suggestion. If that doesn't work out, who else could I approach?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your third aunt might also be an option, but you'd better clarify responsibility obligations beforehand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll check with them then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, reach out if you need anything else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, isn't your uncle a hospital executive? Get me a specialist appointment, and make it quick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's all real-name registration now, genuinely can't circumvent the system.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even handle this little thing? What about all that hot air you blew about having connections?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Watch your tone! The system's like this—what am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the excuses! Should've known you'd be useless. I'll find someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Go to the ER if you're sick—stop freaking out here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't expect me to cover your shifts next time you're swamped!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Remember to grab me a pack of cigarettes after work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't, I've got plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? I'm doing you a favor asking, stop acting like you're so damn busy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you fucking go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna get slapped? Think I can't make sure you don't last your probation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... what brand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pain in the ass! Could've just gone without the damn attitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's convenient, could you share my first WeChat Moments post? My child is participating in a competition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't been checking Moments much lately, might not be feasible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand. Perhaps you could take a look when time permits?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These voting campaigns flood feeds too much—I personally avoid participating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely respect your choice. Just check it out if you're ever free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What truly matters is whether the competition itself is meaningful for the child.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Indeed, the spirit is participation. Carry on with your work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm so stressed out, the divorce agreement is driving me crazy. I'm really counting on your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong this time? Give me the details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The court is breathing down my neck, and all my friends say they can't help. You're the only one who can fix this - don't you dare bail on me now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped lately. Can we postpone this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, if even you're dodging me, I'm completely helpless. Been so upset these past days I can't even eat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. For friendship's sake, I'll squeeze it in ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you free? My paper revisions are killing me, mind taking a quick look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Projects have been piling up lately - wouldn't want to hold you back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, if you're swamped I'll just ask around elsewhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How urgent is it? Maybe I could check it for you day after tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Much appreciated! But seriously don't force yourself though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No big deal, I'll carve out some evening time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a legend! I owe you some grilled skewers next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want to join the New Year's Eve performance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll pass this year, not really feeling up to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, that's fine too. Participation is purely voluntary.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, thanks for understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feel free to join the fun anytime if you change your mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll let you know if I do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, glad that's settled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, how about installing facial recognition? It’s crucial for everyone’s safety—surely you agree this deserves attention?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Access cards work perfectly fine. Why change? It’d cost money and seems unnecessary.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you cut corners on safety? If something happened, could you live with that guilt? We’re all relying on you to protect us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract doesn’t mandate upgrades. What we have suffices—no need for extra hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every surrounding complex has upgraded except ours. The neighbors must think you’re not taking this seriously!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It’s not that dramatic. Sticking to the contract is enough—stop overcomplicating things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Safety is non-negotiable! You can’t prioritize pinching pennies over letting everyone live in constant fear!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough. Drop it—we’re done here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You arrived an hour later than scheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, some urgent work came up last minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you let me know in advance if you need to adjust the timing next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll try to plan better.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all, I have my own evening commitments too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I've caused you trouble today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's alright, just be mindful of it next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Send me the code package now, immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I developed this independently...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Lab resources belong to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But copyright issues...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep yapping and you're out! Ungrateful wretch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll send it tonight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dare be one minute late! Good-for-nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: On it right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know how much Nini cares about her studies, but she's been struggling with her schoolwork lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mortgage payments are really weighing me down—it's tough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Wang downstairs even hired a tutor for her niece. It'd be such a shame to hold back such a bright kid like Nini.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, money's tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could we live with ourselves if such a driven child gets left behind just because she missed fundamentals?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, your membership points are about to expire, right? My hairdryer broke—could you hurry and redeem one for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was actually planning to get some skincare products this time; the discount is pretty big.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing how busy you are with work every day, your hair's all messy—it wouldn't be too much to ask for you to help me out, would it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need them too. I can't always give way to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, I helped you plenty when we were kids. Now it's your turn to look after me. Don't be so stingy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why do you always bring up the past? Can I at least think about it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's visiting this weekend, and she'll need to dry her hair. She'd be so pleased knowing you helped me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... alright, alright. Just tell me earlier next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there, any chance you could hook me up with an employee discount? Doesn't your uncle work at the mall?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not sure that's right... those discounts are strictly for personal use.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If we're real brothers you'd help out—what's this about 'not having the decency'?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, it's against the rules. Don't put me in this spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You treating me like some outsider? Do this or I'm cutting you off for good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, is that guy who liked your Moments post still there? My best friend mentioned it might not be appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? He's just an old classmate. Doesn't seem like a big deal to me. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I've noticed Xiao Li's Moments are so neat and tidy—everyone really likes her for that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just social media, no need to overcomplicate things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know, their boyfriends all deleted stuff like that on their own. It feels more reassuring that way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, fine, I'll tweak it then, so you don't get worried.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, dear. I'm glad you get where I'm coming from.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All done. Next time, try not to be so sensitive about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor Li, your paper progress is way too slow. Professor Wang must be the second author, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Professor Wang wasn't involved in the research. Wouldn't it be totally improper to add him like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you know the damn rules? Professor Wang sacrificed so much for the department's projects—listing him is your bloody duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we at least consider academic integrity issues?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're so high and mighty? You selfish piece of trash! Still want that promotion or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... could I think about it a bit more?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to hand in the revised author list by tomorrow—don't be such an ungrateful fool!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, are you there? I've got a ticket I can't handle, could you help take a look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of ticket? The reimbursement review's been really strict lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a regular meal ticket. Since you've got connections everywhere, could you help smooth it over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really tricky to manage, the new system's locked down tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guess I'll have to figure something out myself then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe try asking Xiao Liu in finance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deadline's day after tomorrow, so keep an eye out for any openings, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll give it some more thought.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, could you grab me an iced Americano on your way out? It's unbearably hot today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Zhang, I've got a personal trainer session booked—they charge a penalty fee for tardiness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a few steps away! Skipping a couple gym minutes won't hurt, will it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This trainer's schedule is packed—being late automatically cancels the whole session.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But isn't this what we do? We help each other out. Always.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll make it quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember easy on the sugar—too sweet isn't good for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you've got connections for company registration, right? Help me get a business license.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Using me as a tool again? Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Why let those ready connections go to waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do I look like your personal genie? Last time helping with your promotion docs nearly got us in trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit whining over tiny favors! Fine, don't help – what a damn cheapskate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You pull this shit every time I help. Find someone else then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Come begging for my help later? Over my dead body!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my elderly relative is hospitalized and I need to request three days off to care for them. Could this be approved?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Taking leave at this critical juncture? The project's at its peak intensity—even Xiao Chen's holding out despite his wife's due date. Are you certain you must go?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've no alternatives—the elder fell and fractured bones with no one to care for them, and my wife's out of town. Didn't you adjust schedules for personal matters last year too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our team operates on self-discipline. When Xiao Wang's mother had surgery last time, he wrapped up overtime before leaving. Such matters require measured consideration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If absolutely necessary, I'll take just two days and compensate by working night shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave can be approved, but do weigh its impact on next month's performance review. Delayed projects harm everyone, wouldn't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This forces an impossible choice—both fronts demand immediate attention.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our team's cohesion is paramount. Remember Lao Li skipping his wife's fever to meet deadlines? You should gauge where your priorities lie.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can I borrow your expensive gear? Need it for this risky thing I'm doing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Risky? What exactly? That stuff's pricey, I'm worried it might break.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so petty? Friends are supposed to help each other! You're really refusing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not refusing, but there's genuine risk involved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll take full responsibility, just lend it! This is what friends do - you owe me this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine... take it. But be extremely careful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man, knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure it comes back in one piece.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there? Could you check out my new product video?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, just saw this. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's sharing it in the group chat - could you support it too when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a lot on my plate these days, might take a while.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All our friends have pitched in already - only you're missing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze it in when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! A like would be much appreciated though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Go queue for that bubble tea shop right now, drop everything and go!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your fucking mind? I'm swamped with my own shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! Real bros should have each other's backs no matter what! Can't you see how heartless you're being by refusing this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Playing the moral blackmail card real smooth, aren't you? Got no shame at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough crap! Where's your loyalty? Bailing on me now means you've got no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Go be a beast yourself and leave me out of it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey sis, this workload at the company is suffocating me every single day. Haven't been able to visit mom and dad for ages, and I really miss them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard Lao Li's kid next door always makes time to visit no matter how busy. Seeing how happy it makes the elderly warms my heart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd love to go too, but the boss is breathing down my neck with this project deadline looming. Honestly can't get away right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When we talked last, Dad was coughing badly but insisted he's fine. Just hearing that made my heart sink.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, hearing that makes me feel even worse. Can't help feeling I'm failing our parents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No matter how demanding work gets, you've got to carve out time for filial duties. Wouldn't want future regrets over this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Uncle, lend me the car this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaowei, this weekend... I might need to use the car myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, what urgent thing could you possibly have? A grown man like you, holed up at home all day, letting the car collect dust! What's the big deal lending it to me? Making excuses over such a small favor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I really have something going on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh please! You're just stingy! So tight-fisted! Can't even do this little favor—what kind of elder are you? Unbelievable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you talk to me like that! Forget it, I'm not lending it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pah! Fine, keep it! Who cares!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your sketch was quite popular last year. Thinking of doing another act this year?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't really have fresh ideas. Worried it might fall flat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not try a simple magic act? They're easy to pick up, and everyone's just here for some fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got this tight project deadline lately. Working overtime daily—no time to practice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure then. The main thing is just getting together for the holidays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You make it sound so easy... now I'm tempted to give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's great! Just treat it as a relaxing way to have fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss: Xiao Wang, could you cover the Spring Festival shift? We're a bit short-staffed at the company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang: Boss, my parents back home are expecting me for the family reunion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss: I see... Would you consider coming back early for the shift? Even starting from the third day would work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang: Rescheduling train tickets is tricky, and I've got relatives to visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss: How about this - see if Xiao Li could swap shifts with you for a couple days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang: I'll check with him, but I believe he's also traveling back to his hometown.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss: Alright, if it's truly impossible then never mind. I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang: Thanks for understanding, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With scores like this, do you expect to amount to anything? You must cram yourself studying day and night!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely lost in math class and just can't grasp the material.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Slack off now and don't come crying when you can't afford food later—got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm burning the midnight oil till 2am every night... I'm hitting my limit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All this worrying I do is for your own future! How can you not take it seriously?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll try to squeeze in more practice problems.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of crap business is that? The money-losing loser's at it again, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even know how to talk? I've been planning this for half a year!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that kind of character, you think you'll succeed? Forgot how you lost your last penny down to your shorts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing up old history again? It'll work this time for sure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep dreaming! Not a penny from me—take my life if you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who wants your stinking money! I'll figure it out myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and wreck yourself then. Don't come crying to me when you're bankrupt!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just wait and see! Even bankrupt, I'd still be better than a miser like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you submit a paper this shoddy? Pull an all-nighter and get me the revised version tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've been swamped with lab work. Could I have two more days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're the only one busy? What about our research group's reputation? Is this how you repay my mentorship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This section is genuinely tough to revise. I'll try to expedite it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save your excuses! You're pulling an all-nighter or forget about passing your defense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll start revising immediately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Email it to me by 8 AM sharp tomorrow. Don't forget this is your obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Share your location right now. It's a basic requirement, you got that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the rush? I'm about to have a meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone who genuinely cares wouldn't make excuses. Your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This again? I just want some damn privacy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you won't even do this much, you're completely irresponsible in this relationship!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll turn it on. But this is so damn suffocating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. You'd better remember this for next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get my leave approved for family matters next Monday!
