turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Requesting leave during crunch time? Not a chance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! My stuff trumps this project—none of your business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dare walk out and it's AWOL! Say goodbye to your paycheck—your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dock away! I quit this job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! We're better off without you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! May this rotten company rot in hell!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, come help clean up the yard this weekend. As a senior employee, you ought to have this basic awareness, shouldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my mother-in-law is visiting this week, I genuinely can't get away...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone has their own problems, but you should still distinguish your obligations to the company, shouldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but this time it's really...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, but if you can't even shoulder this minor responsibility, how are you supposed to be a key player?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to work something out...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. A person ought to know how to repay kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, cousin, work has been quite busy lately, time is really tight, so visiting parents back home is temporarily on hold.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I understand work is busy. Filial piety doesn't always mean visiting often; we can video chat and arrange time slowly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, the project is tight recently. Once I'm free, I'll go back to fulfill my filial duties. You don't need to worry too much about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's fine. Prioritize work when it's important—just give them a call. Filial piety is in the heart, not just in formality.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I feel a bit relieved. After this busy stretch, I'll definitely go back to visit; family affection shouldn't be overlooked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just arrange it yourself. Take good care and don't overwork.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's convenient, could you set up a temporary access pass for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The system's being upgraded right now, so approvals are required for access permissions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any idea when it'll be ready? My friend needs to pick something up tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to sort it out today, but no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it - if possible go ahead, otherwise I'll figure out an alternative.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: OK, I'll update you the moment I have news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got notified to work overtime last minute, could you please pick up my daughter after school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unfortunately, my kid has a dental appointment today, and the timing clashes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is such a headache—our supervisor said if I don't pick her up, I'll lose my full attendance bonus. I really had no choice but to ask you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The dentist appointment has been booked for two weeks; it's tough to reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, forget it. I'll try to take leave—if I get docked pay, so be it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I ask my mom to head to the clinic at three, and I'll squeeze in time to pick up the child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're too kind! I'll treat you all to dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sister Wang, I've got an emergency the day after tomorrow, could you help feed Little Douding? It'll just take a few minutes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The day after tomorrow? I'm taking my son to register in the provincial capital—my schedule is jam-packed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, Sister Wang, you always go on about neighbors being like family, and now you're dodging such a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The registration can't be delayed; I might not make it back in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of attitude is that? Too lazy to lend a hand? Don't expect anyone to help you out when you're in a bind!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine, I'll squeeze in a visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it, Sister Wang, you're a real champ! The key's still under the flowerpot by the door.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you liked our aunt's new store's social media post yet? Shouldn't you go show some support?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped lately, haven't gotten around to checking

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family members must support each other - that's basic human decency

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll get to it later

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it now. The whole family's already shown support except you - this isn't acceptable

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must it be right this second? I'm buried in work here

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It takes literally one minute. Can't you even bother with this tiny gesture?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, I need a favor from you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Go ahead and tell me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My niece wants to get into your workplace—can you pull some strings to help out? It should be a breeze for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't quite appropriate, right? Using backdoor methods violates ethical principles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as friends, you've got to do this for me, haven't you? Think back to when I helped you—you can't just turn ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, I'll see if I can arrange something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, it's settled—that's the friend I know! No backing out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've absolutely got to grab this opportunity—there won't be another chance like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I kind of want to try something different...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all we've sacrificed to put you through school, who does that make you worthy of?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How did my internship choice turn into this huge lecture?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how well your buddy's doing after his internship—don't you want to bring honor to the family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Here we go again. Can you stop comparing me to others?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A sensible child should cherish this chance and stop worrying their parents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you see that contest post on Moments? Help me vote real quick, please!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saw it, but I don't really use Moments. Can't be bothered.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, help me out? Everyone else has voted—you're the only one left. This is urgent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my Moments are all family. Posting this stuff wouldn't be appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Almost there! The scores are neck and neck—just one click!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Li shared it for me! I'll send you a red packet if you vote!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone has given red envelopes for the cousin's wedding; look, even Auntie's family has chipped in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh no, I used up all my money on home renovations last month, I'm tight on cash now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin is one of our own; we seniors must make a gesture, or else folks will talk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So, is 800 yuan enough? I can't afford more than that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These days, red envelopes start from 1000 yuan; giving less might make cousin feel like you're being distant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to scrape together 1000 yuan then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it; between relatives, it has to be this way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how have you been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not bad, and you? What do you need?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our class is organizing a cross-district reunion, and we expect you to come help out—this is your obligation as an old classmate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, so it might not work out for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on you to attend; you absolutely must come, or the whole reunion will fall apart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks. Old classmates are supposed to back each other up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll give it my best shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, have you completed the supporting documentation? As a student, this is your non-negotiable duty to fulfill.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must exhaust every effort to finish this. Your future development hinges on it. Submit it tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're refusing kindness with spite! Do you really think I'll let you get a single cent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop bluffing! Go ahead and try if you dare!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You contemptible wretch! Let's settle this in court!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think I'm afraid? We'll see who comes out on top!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, what are you up to? I've got this health insurance to recommend - ensures safety and fits relatives perfectly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, insurance? Don't really see the need, risks seem minimal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be this selfish? As family, you're obligated to back me up! That's your duty - otherwise you're utterly heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How's that selfish? Money's tight, risks are low, benefits seem negligible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut your mouth! Dodging responsibilities? The whole family's bought it, only you're this moron! Buy it or screw off - our family ties end here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll support you then. I'll buy! But quit screaming at me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's proper. Never forget - the duty rests on you to safeguard security.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Zhang, you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yep, I'm here. Spit it out quick, don't drag it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You idle slacker, how about hooking my cousin's kid up with an internship? Quit faking busy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bugger off! Who's free? Internships ain't my problem!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crap, you're useless! Just asking for a lead—can't you handle a simple internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Give it a rest, sort it yourself. I'm not your servant!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're no help at all, what neighbor is that? Can't you just arrange an internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, got it. Stop pestering me so much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How's Zhang San been? You must know something about him, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've really lost touch, no idea how he's doing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's worried about him, and since you're his best buddy, it'd be pretty unreasonable if you didn't check in, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, couldn't possibly find the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't you always rush to help him before? Why the hesitation now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll see what I can do, but don't bank on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it - that's how classmates should look out for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, I want to transfer my course spot. Would you consider taking it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm swamped right now, probably can't. Really sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, totally understand. I'll check with others then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, maybe try posting it in the group chat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll give that a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just update me if you find someone. Appreciate it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's convenient, could you vote for me? I've shared the link in the group chat - no need to vote every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting quite a few voting requests lately, might not be able to get around to all of them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just vote whenever you have a moment. Don't feel pressured about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does it require registration? Might be too complicated if it's involved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Super simple, just one click! Really no problem if you're too busy though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to do it if I have time, but don't get your hopes up too high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks! Appreciate it regardless of whether you vote or not~

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been on this project for almost three months and handled all the reports clearly. Shouldn't I be considered for the Outstanding Award?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li has been working hard too, and he delivered some solid results last month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just last week during training, I did help take notes that everyone found practical.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The award is primarily based on actual output, not just handed out casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what specific areas do you think I should improve in my work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll put in a word for you during the nomination process.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Clear the conference room immediately! Our team of seven or eight people is waiting to start the meeting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've booked it for a client meeting that's about to begin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client can wait! Who's going to take responsibility if our project fails? This represents the entire team's hard work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This... seems really rushed? My clients are already waiting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li and the team have been working overtime on this. Wouldn't it crush their spirits if it fell through? You wouldn't want that, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then, I'll reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real team player! Knew we could count on you. Just say the word if you ever need a favor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heh, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's got her follow-up hospital appointment tomorrow — you MUST take leave and go with her!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with the project wrap-up tomorrow — can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you no humanity? What kind of daughter lacks basic filial decency? You heartless ingrate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you call me unfilial? Didn't I pull all-nighters during her hospitalization last month?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! You're going this time, or the whole neighborhood'll know what an unfilial wretch you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop morally blackmailing me! Can you shoulder the blame if I get fired?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Job or mother — which matters more? Skip this and you're branded unfilial. The consequences are on YOUR head!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can we talk? We should deal with this mess our relationship has become.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're pretending to be nice? How disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I admit I was wrong, but isn't that attitude of yours way too harsh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the act! You were the cruelest when you cheated!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'm a fucking idiot. Regretted knowing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the hell out! Sick of seeing your face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consider this shitty relationship dog food!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Miss Li is still single at her age. Shouldn't we neighbors step in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This month's been so hectic I can barely catch my breath...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saw her wiping tears yesterday—how can we old neighbors pretend not to see?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young folks are home during May Day break. Hurry up and set up some dates for her!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll make arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This concerns her entire future—you can't afford to be careless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, I need to postpone the grad school prep for now. With everything going on at home, I should help out more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, wouldn't all those years we've pinned our hopes on you go to waste if you put this on hold? Our family's counting on you to make us proud.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the landlord just came for rent money... we really don't have it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Zhang's daughter worked while prepping and still got admitted. If you back out halfway, the whole village would gossip about us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We still haven't scraped together money for Grandma's medicine this month...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's NOT your burden to bear! If you put down those books now, where would this family find any hope?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, send me your promo code! Trying to save on takeout—quit dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is your mom sick? Always freeloading—would you drop dead if you got your own membership?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Just send the damn code—stop babbling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine! Sending it—damn annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up! Sharing a promo shouldn't take this long!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Sent it—don't bother me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking. Sharing costs nothing—why make it complicated?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, done. So you'll finally shut up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's coming to the weekend shoot; it just wouldn't feel complete without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly family member hasn't been well lately, so I need to stay home to look after them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I see. Everyone's really looking forward to working with you—maybe you could spare just half a day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly can't get away; they can't be left alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, what a shame. Without you as the anchor, everyone will feel off, but family matters are important.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I really can't make it this time, but I'll definitely join next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, no problem. You focus on family first; we'll catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks for your understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I must request an extension for this assignment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's your reason? Everyone has the same deadline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As our educator, isn't it your obligation to nurture students AND make allowances for our difficulties?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That obligation includes following rules. Other students submitted on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this lack of consideration makes you seem uncompromising. Other professors would understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules. Submit it on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, do you really think this stubborn stance lives up to your role as an educator?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely. Submit on time or it will be handled in accordance with regulations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you free? I forgot my passport at home and need someone to grab it urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, not sure I can step away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this, but my flight's tight and I'm pressed for time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I could swing by tonight to pick it up on my way?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: By then it'd be too late. Any chance you could squeeze in a quick trip now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, I'm completely tied up at the moment...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll sort it out myself. Thanks anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what—I can head over in about half an hour?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account's frozen, you have to unfreeze it ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the suspension reason? Let me check first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My whole life depends on this account! Don't you claim 'users come first'? How responsible is that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We detected promotional violations. Policy requires penalties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Users rely on this platform! This handling isn't cool – everyone will be disappointed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can appeal, but we must follow procedures.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just unban me already. Make the right choice – don't risk disappointing your users.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Transferring your case now. Keep your phone on for updates.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, I left the reimbursement form for the last business trip on your desk two weeks ago. Would it be possible to get it approved today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quarterly reports have me completely swamped, and I've got a client meeting this afternoon. Let's deal with it tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that my landlord is pressing for rent. Could you possibly make an exception and handle it today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Company procedures take three to four days. Pressuring me now won't help. Go check with Finance on the process status.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finance said it's stuck at your stage and needs to be finalized before month-end closing...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Urgent matters come first. It's not like yours is the only reimbursement form here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any idea when you might have time to look at it, then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Before Friday. Pushing won't help—things have to be done in order.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, you work at XX Appliances, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our fridge broke down and all the food spoiled. Could you get us a new one with your employee discount?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gee, the quota's super tight this year—I'm afraid not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Uncle, shouldn't family help each other out? You work there—can't you pull some strings? We can't even cook with the fridge dead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah fine, fine... I'll try to figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, the numbers look awful. Mind giving me a hand with them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that pushing it a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all your experience, you can't even help with something this small? Where's the loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got too much on my plate right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss is gonna blow his top. You really have the heart to watch me suffer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't swing it. Figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, guess I misjudged our friendship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have any connections for company registration? I'm trying to get a business license.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a bit tricky lately, the authorities are really cracking down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you give it a shot? If not, it's fine. My process is just stuck at this point.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time helping with your professional certification almost caused issues. I'm a bit concerned.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand. Do you think using an agency would be reliable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I can ask about compliant channels? It might be slower but safer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good! Really appreciate it. I'll treat you to dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must perform at this year's reunion dinner! The relatives have been raving about last year's skit nonstop!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been buried in overtime lately, completely drained to prepare any act.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even singing one song would do! The whole family's dying to see you shine - imagine how deflated everyone'll feel if you bail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This year-end evaluation pressure is crushing me, pulling all-nighters daily to meet deadlines.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just take half a day off! What kind of reunion is it without your star power? The whole clan's banking on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll give it a shot then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! With your promise, I can finally give everyone the good news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that registration channel of yours still workable? My license has been stuck for three months and it's killing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Handling this at such a critical juncture would mean taking responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't we closer than strangers? Do this as a favor among friends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped your cousin with that deal, it drew the oversight department's attention.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't we just be extra careful this time around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The rules are crystal clear—who'd dare take that risk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Should've known you'd be too chicken to step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you let Li know Manager Zhang needs to see him urgently if he passes by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm on fieldwork duty now - afraid I might miss him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure. Just mention it if you see him, skip it otherwise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The meeting room's still locked and my spreadsheet's stuck halfway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're usually so thorough about things. Just a quick mention would do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll swing by to check.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks. Having reliable folks like you around is a real relief.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a lovely garden you have! I was hoping to borrow it for my birthday gathering—it'd be perfect for hosting relatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The grass is newly laid, and I'm concerned it might get damaged with too many people walking on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see. Maybe I should consider other options then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Actually, how long exactly did you need it? My main worry is the grass rotting if it rains several days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just half a day the day after tomorrow. If that doesn't work, no worries at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, you can use it that afternoon. I'll lay down some planks in advance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! I'll remind everyone to be extra careful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I need to handle something at home. Could you approve the leave? Family is important after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's such a critical juncture for the project. Isn't it inappropriate for the whole team to cover for you if you leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's quite urgent. I really don't want to disrupt work, but I must deal with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, go ahead. But come back quickly, or the delay will create problems for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll be as fast as possible. Thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then get moving. Don't dawdle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll go handle it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With such a pathetic math score after all our sacrifices for your education, who on earth do you think you're not letting down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
