turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of my damn business! Is your mouth just for show? Didn't you twist the story?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, anyway you kicked up the biggest fuss! Now this disaster, just say if you'll go talk to Mom or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own crap! You damn well apologize with your rotten mouth first! Think you can boss me? Dream on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you stubborn mule, take it or leave it! Dare not speak to Mom ever again! See who she'll favor more!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop dead! Whether I talk to Mom ain't your worry! Shut your stinking trap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, moving's worn me out. Could you lend a hand tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, unfortunately I've got prior commitments tomorrow. Probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, what a pity. Was really counting on an old neighbor to pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just can't swing it - this matter's extremely urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you switched jobs last time, I even recommended opportunities for you. Thought we had each other's backs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to squeeze out some time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, waiting to hear from you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, let me figure out how to arrange it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I did act rashly just now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need some time to cool down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could we see if we could let this one slide?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't the first time; I think it's time we part ways.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll change, can you give it another chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't promise anything right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, we're this close — come on, give me the scoop on your salary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... that's pretty personal, I'd rather not say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, whatever. Was just curious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate you understanding. Wanna change the subject?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, hoops this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bet, same court as always!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You made this mess, so clean it up yourself—you must contact the client and resolve this today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All contact methods are blocked...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ambush them at their office! If this isn't fixed by tomorrow morning, don't bother clocking in!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll go wait at their office building now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring high-end gifts! Fail to salvage this, and our quarterly targets go to zero!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can the gift expenses be reimbursed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pay out of pocket! If you don't fix this, pack your bags and get out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, how have you been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too good, feeling a bit down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's normal to feel sad. Time will help you heal. You'll gradually feel better.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for your concern.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it. I hope you can find happiness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, take care of yourself. Reach out if you need to talk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If Xiao Li passes by, you must tell him Manager Zhang needs to see him urgently!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My reports are piled sky-high, swamped with tasks. Can't spare a second.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Xiao Wang covered your proposal while you were sick? Xiao Li's situation takes priority now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The meeting room lock's broken, and these spreadsheets are a total disaster.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping each other's non-negotiable. Stop making excuses and do this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine. I'll go check immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd see reason. Much appreciated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, take these tickets and get them reimbursed for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What again? I just dealt with this last month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the chatter! Will you do it or not? Fine, forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finance is auditing strictly; it's really tough to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even manage a tiny thing? Useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Watch your language!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reimburse or don't—only an idiot would count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just buzz off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you lend me some points to exchange for a gift? I need it urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, I really need to use them myself since they're about to expire.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! That's so damn inconsiderate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, so cursing makes you feel good? Serves you right I won't help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moron! Fine, I won't ask you anymore!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Think you're royalty or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Never contact me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get outta here! Like I give a damn!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? My uncle's kid's looking for an internship. Heard your place is hiring?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We are recruiting interns. But what's his background? The bar's not low.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, just some third-tier college grad, not the sharpest tool in the shed—grades are mediocre. But he's my uncle's kid, wouldn't bother otherwise. If you could squeeze him in, saves him wrecking other places.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yikes...third-tier might be tough. HR won't even glance at that resume.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you schmooze with HR? No connections at all? Tch, your company's that rigid? Forget it, I'll ask someone else. Useless counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not rigidity, just policy. He can try if you send his resume through formal channels, but no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! If formal channels worked, why'd I come to you? Whatever, doubt he'll land anywhere decent anyway. His problem!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. Reach out anytime if he wants to apply.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaoming, you haven't seemed busy lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not at all, I'm swamped with the project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must take Grandpa and Grandma for their medical check-up; they won't feel secure with anyone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The full attendance bonus this month is critical; taking leave would really throw a wrench in things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know how much the elderly cherish you; after you accompanied them last time, they were delighted for days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it a bit off for me to always be the one going?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't it look terrible if word got out that a grandson couldn't even handle such a small matter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, mind lending me your drone for a couple days? My buddies wanna shoot some bungee jumping footage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bungee? Come on man, that thing costs over twenty grand! What if it gets wrecked?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You think I'm not good enough? Who helped you when you were the family's biggest loser?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's completely different! This drone really isn't built for that kind of abuse...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! Who took you in after your divorce? Too big for your boots now, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. When do you need it? Damage means you pay, just so we're clear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've said yes fucking earlier! Bring it tomorrow. And remember who owes this family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my kid's had a fever lately, and taking care of him is such a pain—it's totally distracted me from work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you even think like that? Your child is sick; as a parent, you've got to drop everything and care for them—that's your duty and responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the project deadline's breathing down my neck, and the boss is on my case—what am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time for second-guessing; your child's health is top priority—you must take leave, or how else can you justify being a parent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to rearrange my shifts, but kiss this month's bonus goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit—parents should make those sacrifices; work can wait, no big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll head off and handle things now—catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li, get over here and drink! Stop playing dead!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I've really hit my limit...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't know what's good for you? Feeding you is a waste of rice!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll definitely drink more next time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless lump! Just looking at you kills my appetite.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stop spoiling the mood here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, yes...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client seems upset; we might need an in-person meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just contacted them—they're not willing to discuss this now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Company protocol requires mandatory follow-up in these situations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll squeeze in a visit tomorrow then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Watch your tone during discussions—remember how a colleague got reported for attitude issues last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But won't barging in unannounced just irritate them further?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just stick to procedure and don't overthink it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I sprained my ankle the day before the exam. Could you take it for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That sounds pretty risky—the professor knows me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents said they'll cut off my allowance if I fail this subject again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But getting caught would mean academic misconduct.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been roommates for three years—I'm really counting on you here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh...let me think about it again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll need you to look after my grandma this weekend—just keep her company for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saturday afternoon works, but keep it simple. Got other things on my plate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She insists on fresh handmade dumplings daily. Buy the ingredients ahead—respecting elders is our fundamental duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dumplings take ages. Can't we just get frozen ones from the supermarket?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's this small joy she lives for. Shouldn't we care wholeheartedly? Put yourself in her shoes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best, but don't blame me if it's beyond me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, remember—this is your chance to shine at embodying filial piety.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, help me revise this contract, it's urgent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time right now, my own workload's piled sky-high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, can't even handle a tiny favor? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the fuck you calling pathetic? Handle your own damn mess!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Quit faking busyness—I saw you slacking last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your fucking business! Do it yourself if you're so capable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't expect any favors from me ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to watch the kids this Saturday – your aunt has done so much for your family, after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might be tied up; I've got a client meeting scheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you really going to disregard family obligations? Do those 'Uncle' titles from the kids mean nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll shuffle my schedule, but I may need to bring them to the meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. Family should always make sacrifices for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But next time give me advance notice, will you? Last-minute changes are a headache.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since when do we set terms for family favors? That's downright hurtful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, move aside, I've got an emergency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go queue up, don't you know the rules?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your business! Stop acting all high and mighty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Asking for trouble?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at yourself! Shabby but pretending to be classy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Sick of seeing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, you there? I'm fucked this time, need help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What now? What's the fuckup this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! I'm seriously screwed! Lend me another 50k to bail me out! With our bond, who else should help me? When you messed up before, wasn't it ME taking the heat in the office for you? Time to repay the favor! Have some damn conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! Again? Think I'm your ATM? Last loan's still MIA!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the fucking excuses! Refusing this favor means you're no brother! Ungrateful bastard! Did dogs eat your conscience? Listen up: refuse today, and we're fucking DONE!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You addicted to moral coercion or what? Digging up ancient history? Do I fucking owe you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Knew you were unreliable! My bad trusting a decade-long bond with a worthless bastard! Go to hell!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, my mom's been feeling pretty lonely at home lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll drop by when I'm free and take her out for dim sum.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's so kind of you! She still remembers helping you with soup when you moved last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh stop, it was nothing—just doing what anyone would.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She'll light up when she sees you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll swing by Saturday afternoon to keep her company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you could take her to the park too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all—I'll arrange everything properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! Order me some fried chicken delivery, I'm starving!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you do it yourself? I'm gaming here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Cheapskate! Won't even do this little thing, no wonder you're single!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Eat or don't eat, I don't care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trash! Don't ever ask me to team up again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who you trying to scare? Like you're some hotshot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Big shot! Don't sit with me at the library anymore!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Like I'd miss you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, why are you so late? I've been waiting forever - the kids are tearing the place apart!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, traffic was awful. Really sorry about that, I'm on my way now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 'Sorry'? That's all? As a parent you ought to have basic responsibility - you've wasted so much of my time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly didn't mean to. Won't happen again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time? You must compensate me or you're utterly irresponsible! What kind of parent even are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? How can you be this unreasonable after I apologized?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What damn good is your apology? Trash like you shouldn't have kids - you're a bloody menace!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to take a stand on this! What kind of brother are you if you don't pick sides?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The truth isn't even clear yet. Why rush to choose sides? Wouldn't that just create more chaos?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang and everyone else have spoken up. How do you think it looks when you stay silent? Staying neutral is downright disloyal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if we're wrong? It'd be so embarrassing. Better play it safe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how he helped you through that crisis last time? How can you pretend not to see now? At least give his post a like!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess I'll repost it then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's worthy of our brotherhood! Real friends show up when it counts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, I'm feeling so lonely being single all the time, seeing others in relationships just stings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't help with this, I haven't met many young people lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it that hard to find someone reliable? Shouldn't you help your own nephew more?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The good catches got snapped up long ago, what's left isn't ideal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You were so enthusiastic arranging dates for cousin, but when it's my turn there's just dead silence?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll try contacting my colleague's son to set up a meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on now, put some real effort in—just find someone who meets basic standards.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, go vote for that 'Most Beautiful Employee' contest!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw voting! I'm too busy for this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk, lazy bum! Voting only takes a few seconds!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's it to you? I'm not voting, so what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're damn annoying! Fine, don't vote then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stop pestering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, you're such a jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell is it to you? Shut your mouth!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, hello, could we speed up the examination? I'm really anxious and freaking out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to hurry, but we can't skip any steps in the process—it has to be done properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rigid but people can adapt. You're so kind, doctor—surely you could make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but we need to be fair to other patients too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm suffering terribly here! Shouldn't doctors prioritize urgent cases first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll see if I can shuffle some things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a lot, you're truly a wonderful doctor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, happy to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got so many points, mind redeeming that speaker for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do, I'm saving these for flight miles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help with this tiny favor? How inconsiderate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My travel plans are already locked in...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that helped you move last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's... totally unrelated...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't friends support each other? You're absolutely heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over, we'll talk later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you introduce someone to me? Quit dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you find one yourself? Why keep bothering me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You know tons of people—what's the big deal introducing one? Useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? That's so rude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough nonsense! Help or get lost, you good-for-nothing friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll ask around for you. Happy now? Annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Hurry up—no dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kid, we really can't keep this dog any longer. The family's health comes first, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, the doctor said it's just a mild allergy. I'll clean more diligently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm saying this for your own good. With your studies so demanding, getting distracted by a pet could ruin your future. It breaks our hearts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Walking the dog helps me relax. I don't think it affects anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thoughtful children understand their parents' sacrifices. Let's find it a new home by month's end, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... need more time to think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all we've raised you these years, can't you even make this decision? It's time to grow up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh... Alright, I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This new project is super urgent—would you be able to take it on? The timeline's tight; let's discuss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I've got my hands full here. Why not consider distributing the workload?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Distributing works too—responsibility shouldn't fall on one person. Would that fit your schedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me check my calendar. Partners should help each other, but I worry I might not have the bandwidth.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood—obligations shouldn't be forced. Could you adjust your schedule? Let me know if you can take it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I know partners share responsibility. I'll update you tomorrow on whether I can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine—let's share the pressure. It's entirely up to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, the company project's deadline is insane. I've been pulling all-nighters every day, and putting off going home just leaves this void inside.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Aunt Wang's daughter – no matter how swamped she is, she visits her parents every week and beams with joy. Shouldn't we follow her example?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to come home. The boss is breathing down my neck about deadlines, and the project's at a standstill. Let's wait till this crunch passes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Mom's leg was killing her last month? She bit her tongue to avoid bothering you at work, but I caught her crying in secret. Just picturing that twists my gut.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... after hearing that, it's like a boulder's crushing my chest. What an unfilial son I've been.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work will always matter, but our parents' time won't wait. Carve out some time and go see them soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, would you grab me some local specialties while you're on your business trip? Don't tell me you're too busy, for goodness' sake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my suitcase might be a bit tight for space...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you serious? Just ship it! Why make such a fuss over something so trivial?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The shipping costs could add up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! I'll reimburse you after you buy it, alright? Stop dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll pick something out then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to get the expensive stuff. Don't bring back anything cheap and embarrassing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been a full week since the elevator broke down. The elderly in my family are suffering from severe knee pain from climbing the stairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The parts are temporarily out of stock. The manufacturer says they'll try to ship them next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When I saw the maintenance notice posted by the property management last week, I was hoping for a quicker fix.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The parts are genuinely in short supply this time; even the warehouse can't allocate any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elderly have been stuck ordering takeout these past couple of days. It's really inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll keep pushing the manufacturer and install immediately upon delivery.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If only the repairs could move faster. The elderly residents are really struggling with the stairwell situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're already coordinating expedited delivery. Everyone just needs to hang on a few more days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stuck working late—can't get back! My dog's howling with hunger, and you're the only one who can handle this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed with back-to-back meetings today—absolutely no wiggle room!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's about to tear up the sofa! Remember when your dad had that fall? I rushed him to the ER and stayed till dawn! Is this how decent people act?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do owe you for that... but today's genuinely impossible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That dog's tail goes wild just seeing you! Now you're pretending not to see? Have you no shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scooping kibble takes ten minutes tops. Does our bond not even warrant this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? Get your ass moving and leave me a good review right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Last time my account nearly got deleted because of you. You're so damn annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such an idiot! Can't you just be more careful? Can't even handle a simple thing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Do it yourself, don't bother me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, whatever! You're a shitty friend anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say whatever you want, I'm logging off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Bye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, how's the quality inspection report coming along? Following the approach we discussed earlier, everything's on track, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, the actual situation doesn't quite match the plan, I'm a bit concerned...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of obstacles are you running into? Could you walk me through the specifics?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The data isn't lining up properly. Just reporting it as-is might cause issues down the line.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... But the project timeline is really tight. Do you think you could push to wrap it up per the original plan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to accelerate and make more progress then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate the extra effort. If you hit any roadblocks, just flag them - we'll tackle them together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll dive back into the work now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, you've gotta take my new store's promo shots for free! Charging friends? That's just shameful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got too many paid gigs now, rates are steep... honestly can't squeeze it in...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You backstabbing snake! Who pulled you through that failed exam? Now you're dodging free help like some cheap coward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I owe you for that, but this workload feeds my family...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me the bullshit! Trashing classmate bonds like this—no wonder you're a friendless loser!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe... I could free up half a day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Full event coverage or we're DONE!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... put it on my tab.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, regarding the QC report, you need to state it passed inspection as per the unified stance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm afraid that doesn't align with the facts? My conscience isn't clear about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is necessary for collective interests. Everyone's year-end bonus depends on this project. You need to see the bigger picture, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand the difficulty, but principles...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being responsible to the team is the principle. Look how hard everyone has worked – we can't let minor issues waste all that effort, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consider it settled. I trust you'll handle it. You should be willing to make contributions for the team.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Okay, understood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Bao was in tears, saying you're the only parent who's never been to a meeting - it's mortifying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's insane right now. Can't you just go?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The teacher asked me yesterday if you even care about our child. Xiao Bao can't hold his head up in class.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm pulling daily overtime shifts - can't even get proper sleep.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing our kid huddled alone while others' parents showed up - doesn't that gut you as a father?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who says it doesn't? But if I lose this job, how do we eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other parents make it work. Are you that special? Is this child even yours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll figure out how to take leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, if it's convenient, could you bring me some local specialties from your business trip? No worries if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my luggage space is a bit tight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, or we can mail them - I'll cover the shipping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I pick some up at the airport duty-free if they have any?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect, I really appreciate you going through the trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should I note down any specific varieties you'd like?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just any pastries will do - please don't feel obligated!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, Boss. I'll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, a friend of mine's going through a rough patch - could you do me a solid and cosign for him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guaranteeing for someone I barely know? Honestly, that makes me uneasy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I've been losing sleep over this for days. Don't bail on me now, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This feels like way too much risk to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last year when you were strapped for cash? I helped you out immediately. Now my buddy's in trouble - how could you not lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over. I'll get back to you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better settle this today. After all these years, you're the one person I trust most to come through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're going to Guangzhou for business, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'm flying on Tuesday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's convenient, could you bring me some cured sausages? No worries if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check the luggage space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, if needed, I can transfer the money to you first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing two bags should work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! Just let me know if it's inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, it's nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you must attend tomorrow's team building—it's a crucial chance to show your sense of collective honor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I genuinely have family matters to handle and can't make it this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Skipping team activities—do you even care about your career prospects here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly mean no disrespect; my elderly family member is hospitalized and needs care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Everyone else overcomes difficulties—why must you act special?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Try isn't good enough. Face the consequences if you're absent tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Excuse me, could I cut in line? I'm in a hurry—left something behind and need to fetch it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm pressed for time too. You'll have to wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You see I've made two trips already. Do me this favor? Everyone has emergencies sometimes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't accommodate you. I'm on a tight schedule myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh. Not easy for anyone, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly. Maybe ask the people behind you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, the inspection is coming up, you have to stay late tonight to finish the documents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my wife is sick and I need to go home to take care of her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't just about work—it's your obligation. The team is counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my family situation is quite urgent too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please understand, personal sacrifices must be made at times like this. You're a good employee and should lead by example.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Team responsibility isn't something you can shirk—don't let anyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I cheated. Forgive me or not, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bastard! How dare you say that after doing this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've apologized. Forgive me or don't, I don't care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't care? You trash! You've destroyed all trust!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Handle family and kids yourself—I'm not forcing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Handle it yourself? You shameless jerk! Acting generous now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah I messed up, but think what you want—just leave me alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave you alone? You traitorous scum! Get out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I've been saving these clothes especially for you. I didn't even have the heart to give them away when others asked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, you're too kind, but I really have enough clothes already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how Xiao Liu next door is scrambling for them! If you don't take them now, you'll regret it later when they're gone? After I've gone out of my way thinking of you...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe leave them for Aunt's kids instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this how you repay me after all I've done for you? I'll be heartbroken if you don't take them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll take them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You never come back to visit, so selfish! Only care about your own comfort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish? You have no idea how hard I work to support this family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always making excuses, you're just lazy! Can't even come home without dragging your feet, so annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you even understand me? Nagging all day! It's not like I have nothing to do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself! Wasted raising you, really regret it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll come back later then, stop nagging!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! You're impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, there's a platform loophole for cash-out—need you to do the real-name verification.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this even legal? Kinda worried here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trust is everything between friends. You're not actually refusing to do this small favor, are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mostly scared of info leaks... way too risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember who stayed up all night fighting your landlord over the deposit? Now when I need backup, you vanish into thin air?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's completely different... that was legit维权.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A decent person would never turn down a friend. Tell you what—I'll cut you in 30%. Fair enough?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. Just get it done and delete the account asap.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, you're being ridiculous. Suit yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I'm definitely not going, so what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello landlord, may I ask if pets are allowed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, house rules prohibit pets.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But pet ownership demonstrates responsibility—you must recognize the value of compassion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are non-negotiable on this matter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A decent landlord has an obligation to permit family pets—it must be allowed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but you're required to guarantee safety and hygiene.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, thanks for understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That guy at your company who handles registrations—you're tight with him, right? Hook me up with a business license.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's shady as hell. If we get caught, we're both screwed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends ride or die for each other, got it? Quit dragging your feet—are you even a decent friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I pulled strings for your cousin's doctor appointment, I almost got fired. Ring a bell?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! If I'm your bro, make it happen now. Or else don't ever ask me for favors again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, get real! You think my connections are your damn vending machine?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful bastard! Who moved your crap until the ass crack of dawn last time? Now you're playing saint?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, the marketing report is needed urgently tomorrow morning, just leave it on my desk when you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager Zhang, isn't this actually the Planning Department's task? I have dinner plans with my family tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh well, just see what you can do then. Though everyone always mentions how responsible you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly that family plans were made early, wouldn't want to cause any delays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, help if you can, no pressure. You know the project timeline best after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to find some time to finish it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, appreciate your hard work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I've been having a bit of trouble finding housing lately. Would it be convenient for me to stay at your place for a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry about that, my mother-in-law is staying in the spare room to help with the kids.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it. Do you know of any affordable short-term rentals nearby?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The apartment building east of our complex seems to have vacancies. Want me to check their rates for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be a huge help! Feel free to update me anytime you hear back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it—we're hometown folks after all. I'll get back to you tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate you going out of your way for this. I'll treat you to dinner sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No trouble at all. Go ahead with your day—I'll reach out once I have details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Zhang, you've got to put in a word with the boss for me on this urgent matter!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why me again? Can't you go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you won't even help when it's this critical? After all these years of friendship, you'll just stand by and watch me go down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, honestly can't deal with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just do me this solid—who else is as reliable as you? What kind of friend would refuse to help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright alright, I'll squeeze in time to mention it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great, make it quick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's really looking forward to tomorrow's team building. What do you say?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Something came up at home last minute. I'll try to sort it out and rush over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, family comes first. We'll have other chances to get together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks bud. Next time I'll treat everyone to dinner to make it up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't sweat it. We'll have fun without you too—just focus on your family stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You guys enjoy yourselves! I'll definitely come if I can make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Catch us up on what happened when you're back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kitchen's trashed like a dump, and I'm dead tired.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's got me swamped, no time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at the neighbors next door—they tidy up together daily. How come you can't even lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the rush? It's not like the house is on fire.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if the kid gets sick from eating here? How could you live with yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, so annoying. I'll deal with it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, doing WeChat business is awesome, hurry up and join to make big money!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: WeChat biz? Sounds like a damn pyramid scheme to me! Stop the nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Only broke losers hesitate, you clueless moron!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: WTF, why the insults? Can't even ask questions? You psycho!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stay poor if you won't join! Quit yapping here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a dumbass, not worth my time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blocked! Don't come crawling to me, you penniless scrub!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone flaunts their new relationship—we've been together over half a year and you're still hiding me. Am I really that embarrassing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with overtime lately—really not in the mood for this. Can we drop it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly cared, posting one photo wouldn't kill you. My bestie's boyfriend does it no matter how busy he is—your attitude is shattering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop comparing me! I'm under insane pressure right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom says if someone refuses to go public, something's fishy—I can't even defend you anymore.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whatever. I'll post some random pic tomorrow to get you off my back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My lease is up and I'm stuck without a place. Could you help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got friends staying over too, might not have space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't colleagues help each other? If you don't, I'll be sleeping on the office floor tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but there's literally no room. Maybe wait it out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is urgent—morally you ought to lend a hand. I'll cover your shifts later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, we can squeeze you in, but only for two nights.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! You've done your moral duty. I'll repay the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just pack and come over quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, you're the one who has to take care of this school thing for the kid—who else can we turn to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, my workload is piling up like a mountain, I really can't spare a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're his own aunt—his future is in your hands. You can't just wash your hands of this, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I didn't say I wouldn't help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The deadline is next week! How could you bear to see him get held back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's cutting it awfully close... I'll try to make some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've always doted on him most. Who else could we possibly rely on at a crucial time like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Alright, I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My new shop is about to open. Could you possibly take some promotional photos for me when you have time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is pretty packed lately, might not be able to fit it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand, it's great that your business is booming.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Commercial shoots all come with fees, and the costs aren't low.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this then? Could we go with the lowest rate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't free up the time. Maybe check with someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, let's catch up over a meal sometime soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good! Wishing you huge success with the opening!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to sign this prenup—it's a commitment to our relationship!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The terms are completely skewed in your family's favor—you call this a fair commitment?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True love means putting each other first—don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this strips me of all security—it feels downright suffocating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Accept it if you want to be together! That's what responsibility looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You keep emotionally blackmailing me with this—is that even reasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Marriage requires mutual understanding—signing is the only right choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiaoming, would you mind checking on the bank transfer for Grandma when you pass by these next couple days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've got project deliverables due this week, maybe this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Elderly folks can't figure out those self-service machines. I actually took half a day off and am rushing over now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My supervisor's breathing down my neck. Slipping away now would mean a performance penalty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, focus on your work. I'll just push myself to get there before 4.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got about forty minutes left on my lunch break. Want me to see if I can manage?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't go to the trouble, work comes first. I'm already in line here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just send me your location when you get to the bank. I'll give you a ride back when you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhao, with the heavy workload, occasional physical contact is normal. You can understand that, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I feel this crosses the line—it's not trivial. What's your take?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, it might be a misunderstanding. Handle it as you see fit—we respect staff opinions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I might report it to HR. How does that sound to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: By all means, that's your call. But given the team's workload pressure, maybe weigh the priorities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, but we can't just sweep it under the rug forever, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, it's your decision. I'll document the feedback on my end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it some thought and circle back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, Niu Niu's been having some trouble with her schoolwork lately, studying really hard.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my mortgage is weighing me down, finances are pretty tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I notice Niu Niu's quite sensible, always studying quietly by herself. It'd be ideal if we could afford a tutor for her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tutoring fees aren't cheap, are they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child's very self-motivated, I'm just concerned about holding her back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll make a note of that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Zhang, this is quite urgent—could you help me bring it up with the manager?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? Can't you just go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've been swamped lately, no time at all. Just do me this small favor, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze in some time to mention it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, bro. I'll treat you to a meal later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No biggie, don't sweat it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll count on you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, got a minute? Need a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? Shoot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My niece hasn't landed an internship yet. Any chance you've got industry connections?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Opportunities are scarce this year. Best I can do is keep an ear out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, appreciate you looking into it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No guarantees though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand. Just ping me if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, mind if I reference your team's proposal for inspiration? Been stuck on this project lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't share this one – company confidentiality policy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just wanna peek at the framework structure, promise I won't copy content. Do me a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Audits are crazy strict right now. Could get flagged if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get it. I'll figure something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, man. Lunch on me next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking have to forgive me this time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you beat me up like this... how can I possibly explain it to people?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut the hell up! As my wife, you gotta take it. Don't you fucking dare refuse!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this time it's really too much...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You wanna keep yapping? I'll fucking beat you dead! Think about the kid—you want the kid to grow up without a dad, you worthless piece of trash?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I get it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, you been busy lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped actually, back-to-back meetings till midnight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie's been in the hospital for days now. Shouldn't we younger generation visit her after all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't get away, sis. Got performance reviews this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So all that love she gave us was for nothing? How heartbreaking would it be if we don't go now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah don't put it like that... I'll try my best. Worst case I'll make it up next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. My conscience is clear either way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, could you do me a favor? My friend's buddy needs a guarantor—would you consider signing for them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, a stranger? That feels risky. I'm not comfortable taking on that liability, so I'll pass.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, there are risks involved, and the responsibility ultimately falls on your side. Are you okay with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The problem is I don't know them—I can't shoulder that risk. Why aren't you being the guarantor yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've weighed the risks, and sharing responsibility would be fairer. No pressure though—friends help each other out, after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, it's just too much risk for me. I'll have to decline. Maybe someone else can help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, never mind. Responsibility really requires thorough consideration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just hand over the spot! With your skills, you'd just be wasting it—cut it out and stop draining company resources!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your damn mind? The boss assigned the spot, none of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough crap! Hand it over or I'll make things very difficult for you—then we'll see who suffers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you trying to scare? Think you can actually pull that off? Dream on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're pushing your luck, huh? Tomorrow the whole department will know how you snatched that spot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! Let's see if they'll believe a lunatic like you or me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, we'll see about that! You'll be crying soon enough!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm thinking of borrowing your backyard for my birthday gathering – all the relatives are coming to liven things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We just had it resodded recently; I'd hate to see it get trampled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you remember how I ran around helping during your baby's full-month celebration? Consider this returning the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's just that this turf was quite expensive...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They'll all wear soft-soled shoes the day after tomorrow! If anything gets damaged, I'll pay for it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then... but you'd better keep an eye on them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it! If you ever need anything, just say the word.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get me a train ticket for Friday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Busy! Got no hands of your own or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless loser! Can't even handle this crap? You're just wasting oxygen!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Who d'you think you are? Not lifting a finger for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! Don't ever call me your aunt again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Acting like the damn Empress Dowager now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I've got some extra furniture. Could I leave it in the hallway corner for just a couple of days? It's really too packed inside—could you help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hallway is shared space; leaving things there gets in the way and people could trip over them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's only for two days, and moving it won't be a hassle—could you cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Community rules say you can't pile up junk in public areas—get caught, and you'll face fines.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise it won't be messy, and I'll clear it out right after two days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, two days then—don't let it drag on too long, to steer clear of any headaches.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
