turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell you bossing me around for? My choice! None of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Be the big shot then! Can't be bothered with you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, my computer crashed and I can't process payments. Can you bail me out with your employee discount?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But that's against policy, isn't it? We'll both get reprimanded if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last year when clients got you wasted? Who carried you home? Anyone else would've left you there!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still... the risk is huge...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this exactly when team trust matters? Lao Zhang helped me without hesitation last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, but make it quick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what real buddies do! Hotpot's on me tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just this once - got it? Never again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, could we postpone the payment for a few days? My accounts are really tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, the contract specifies payment this week. I'm also pressed for funds to restock.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I completely understand! Just thinking about our years of friendship - could you help me bridge this gap?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...So how many days would you need exactly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll definitely come through early next month. Knowing how much you value loyalty, I'm sure you'll help your old friend out this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine, fine. Early next month then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real stand-up guy! I won't forget this favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You gotta lend me the car tomorrow; I've got serious business to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I need to use it tomorrow too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you begged for my help, I didn't hesitate at all. Wouldn't it be wrong if you didn't return the favor now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thing is... I really have commitments tomorrow...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, with a friendship like ours, wouldn't it be messed up if you refused such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... you'll return it immediately after using it, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn straight! That's what true buddies do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, are you busy right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not too bad, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad's health is declining, they need care. What are your plans?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd like to help but work's insane, can't get away at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the 'busy' excuses! You're just lazy and avoiding responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How am I lazy? Cut me some slack, my job's overwhelming!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself then. Just don't come whining when things go south!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, what are you up to? Is your kitchen free right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Zhang, yeah I'm here. Kitchen's free at the moment, what's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need to borrow it to make soup since my pot broke. Mind if I use it if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... I was thinking of cooking something soon...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll literally take just a few minutes, won't hold you up at all. That alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, go ahead then - just don't take forever with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a bunch, Lao Wang! Seriously owe you one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, could I borrow your shopping membership? I'm in a rush to check out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My personal stuff is in there, not really convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do a friend a favor, we neighbors ought to help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The platform flags logins often, worried my account might get locked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not even this? After all we're this close.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, just this once. Won't happen again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! We gotta help each other, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, I noticed your negative review. Could you share the specific issues?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The item had obvious defects and didn't match the description.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Apologies for the trouble. If you'd be willing to remove the negative review, we'll resend a new item and compensate 20 yuan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you guarantee the quality this time? The previous one was so disappointing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our quality control team will personally oversee this shipment. Does the compensation solution work for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but if there are issues again I'll have to file a formal complaint.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. We'll share the tracking number after shipping. Feel free to remove the review when convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'll see depending on the item's condition after receiving it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hand over the notes! Quit stalling and stop the nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chill out! I'm still copying, you buzzer-beater!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up! Butterfingers like you waste everyone's time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop nagging! Here, take it already! So annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph, 'bout time you knew your place! Be quicker next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Borrowing's fine but why the insults? You nuts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey nephew, could you pick up your aunt's package on your way? It's right at the community gate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? I'm pretty worn out today, don't really feel like making the detour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with you kid? Can't even handle a simple favor? Zero consideration for your elders!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But aunt, I didn't drive today - it's quite a hike on foot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Horseshit about distance! What's wrong with young folks walking? You'd make your disabled aunt fetch it? Got no conscience left?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine fine, I'll get it. Just stop lecturing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! Show some respect! Finally acting like a proper junior. Quit dawdling and move it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah yeah, I heard you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard that concert next week is super popular. How about we both try to grab tickets?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been crazy lately, not sure if I can manage to snag any.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it's worth a shot anyway. Fingers crossed we get lucky!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try my best then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: VIP seats must have great views, but we can settle for regular seats if we can't get those.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, could you help me get a few likes on Taobao?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get likes? That's pretty risky. I'm worried the platform might flag it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As good friends, helping each other is an obligation. Wouldn't you agree it's inappropriate to refuse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know I should help, but the risks are genuinely significant.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit worrying, just be careful when doing it. You must do this for me as a friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Thanks so much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, this project is driving me insane. Working till midnight every day, I can't even squeeze in time to visit home. It's suffocating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at your cousin - no matter how hectic her projects get, she never misses her weekly visits to the elders. Always comes back beaming. You could learn from her example.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to, but the boss is breathing down our necks with deadlines. We're completely gridlocked on this project. Maybe after we push through this crunch time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mom couldn't even get out of bed from leg pain recently but hid it from you to 'avoid distracting you'. Though between us, she's been crying privately. Doesn't filial piety matter anymore?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, now you've gone and made me feel like there's a boulder crushing my chest. I've really failed my parents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever fire's at work can wait. Mom and Dad are sick with worry waiting for you - make time to go home ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, could you grab two concert tickets for me? You're the quickest with these things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with overtime lately, might not have time to snag them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I brought meals every single day when your mom was hospitalized last year. Can't even do this little thing for me...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Front row seats would be best. At my age, going to concerts is such a rare treat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, yeah yeah, I got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, wolf culture is an absolute must! Anyone not grinding day and night has no damn sense of responsibility, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But isn't the overtime excessive? My body's barely holding up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't handle it? Huawei employees damn well die at their desks! You have the nerve to whine about being tired?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really have a family to care for... my kid's only three...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! This company is your second home. Without this basic level of dedication, are you even fit to be an employee?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, it's not that I'm unwilling to contribute...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut up! If you can't accept it, get out now. This company doesn't carry deadweight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... fine, I'll comply.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wow, you must be raking it in with your side gig! My new stall just opened up, bro—you gotta pitch in quick. With all these years of friendship, you wouldn't just watch me crash and burn, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, barely scraping by. Work's been draining me dry lately, zero bandwidth for anything else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the act! You jumped to help Lao Zhang's crew in a heartbeat—why the foot-dragging for me? Can't be that our bond's this weak, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously not dodging—my mom's hospitalized and I'm stretched thin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: C'mon, I know you've got connections! Just toss me a client referral! I've dumped my life savings into this—if you don't throw me a lifeline, your boy's gonna be eating dust!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, too many plates spinning—just can't squeeze in help right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch... You're the one who egged me into this! Now you're bailing? If this venture tanks, my reputation's toast—everyone'll say you screwed me over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll float some feelers. But zero guarantees, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quick! I forgot my passport—go fetch it for me right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you moved last time, I took a whole day off to help you. Now you won't even lift a finger for this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about tomorrow morning?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll miss my flight by then! A real friend would step up now, wouldn't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is ridiculously last-minute...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just go already! I'll owe you big time—you're the only one who can handle this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'm heading over now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, we're in a pinch for the annual party performance and need a camera—mind lending yours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm worried about damaging it—I usually don't even touch it casually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, everyone's pitching in for the annual party—wouldn't it be a shame if things fell apart? Give us a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you guarantee nothing will go wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, everyone takes this seriously—let's show some solidarity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright then—you guys be careful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you absolutely must come to next month's gathering - everyone's counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too far. The round trip alone would take two days, I just can't manage that hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Liu flew all the way from Shanghai! Can't you make an effort? Everyone will be so disappointed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been brutal lately with my boss breathing down my neck. Honestly can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You missed Lao Li's birthday last time. Skip this one too, and folks will think you're being standoffish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Between the distance and my workload, it's rough. I'll see how things play out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could we have a proper group photo without you? Everyone would be so let down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll see if I can shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, cousin, I've been swamped with work lately, pulling all-nighters every day. I just can't find time to visit Mom and Dad. I'm utterly exhausted!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Caring for your parents is your sacred duty. Who isn't busy? You must carve out time to see them—anything less is spitting on all they sacrificed raising you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good grief, I'm truly helpless here! My boss is breathing down my neck. It's not that I don't want to honor them—why must you hound me like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're being shockingly ungrateful! Filial duty is non-negotiable for any child. No matter how busy, you visit—refusing makes you an undutiful disgrace!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm fed up with you! Constantly weaponizing guilt trips, crushing me under pressure—holier-than-thou types like you are the real hypocrites!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Bite the hand that feeds you! When relatives talk behind your back about your neglect, don't say I didn't warn you. The burden of shame rests solely on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you up to now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just taking a break, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Something urgent! Can you pass a message to Lao Wang for me? It's pretty critical.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? Might not be able to, my computer's freezing up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, come on - we were roommates for three years. If you won't help with this, I've got nobody else to turn to. No pressure though... if you really can't...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hang on... might be able to squeeze in a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you! You're the only one missing from the group chat - waiting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, seeing his comments on your feed is disgusting! Could you just block him already?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's not causing any trouble, is he? Why are you flipping out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fed up! If you won't block him, fine. Just stop annoying me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're overreacting. Whether to block him is my call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Block him or not, whatever. Stop grossing me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll block him, okay? So you'll quit making a fuss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Should've done this ages ago. Pissed me off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Done. Try not to stir things up so much next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you do me a solid and share that post on my feed? It's promotional content for our company's new project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not a good time for me right now. I've got a ton of stuff on my plate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! What is wrong with you? Not even a shred of professional responsibility between colleagues? Do you even know what it means to be a team player?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have my reservations about this content. I really don't feel like sharing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, think you're so holier-than-thou now? It's just a simple favor, not like I'm asking you to move heaven and earth! What a heartless move!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What gives you the right to talk to me like that? I do have the right to choose, you know!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit about 'the right to choose'! This proves you're a bad person through and through. If this project tanks later, it'll be entirely on a selfish prick like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you free? You should help promote my sublease in the group chats.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work's been swamping me lately, might not be able to swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't friends support each other? It's pretty lousy if you won't even do this basic thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But don't you think it's unfair to pressure me like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friends don't keep score. You have to share this today—it's fundamental decency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll post it. But this can't happen again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Xiaoming, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, not too bad. What's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma and Grandpa's check-up needs arranging – you're handling this entirely, no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, my plate's overflowing lately. You take care of it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Filial duty's non-negotiable – you're being downright selfish! Got any morals at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who died and made you boss? Didn't I handle it last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get it done by next Monday – or don't you dare call me brother again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've finished the initial draft. Could you possibly review it in the coming days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The content lacks sufficient depth. Look how much attention Wang's team is getting with their novel approach. Our group needs impactful results like that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you suggesting we pivot to a new direction? Specifically, what areas need adjustment?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blockchain applications are the current hotspot. If our group falls behind the trend, we'll become obsolete. Since you're capable, perhaps you could give it a try?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? I'm completely swamped with my own stuff these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're short-handed for the platform task. If you won't even help with this, are we really friends? Remember how much I've helped you before!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Inspections have been really strict lately... it's genuinely not convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a simple task and you're dragging your feet like this? Was all our bonding for nothing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine fine, I give up. You win.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call being a real mate! Let's grab barbecue sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, your place is really spacious. My plumbing repair will take a couple days, and I'm stressing about where to stay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my kid's online classes have the whole house cluttered—even the living room's a classroom now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how you helped Uncle Zhang when he was ill? That kind of neighborly warmth means the most.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps try the budget hotel two blocks away? Clean, and includes breakfast.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair enough. Might cost a bit more, but better than inconveniencing you. Kid's studies come first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do let me know if you need plumbing help—I know a reliable technician.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll pack some clothes for the hotel. I'll treat you to a meal sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good. Reach out anytime if you need anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, you cannot afford to slack off when it comes to the family business—Mom and Dad are counting on us both!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I'm really tied up with work—been pulling overtime every day lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't pitch in, Mom and Dad would be heartbroken! They poured their retirement savings into this shop!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... since it's like this with Mom and Dad... I guess I can't just turn my back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! If we don't take care of family matters, who will? It'd be simply unreasonable for you to bail.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll squeeze in time—but really can't promise to show up daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, moving is such a headache—you simply must come help tomorrow, no choice!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, tomorrow really won't work. I'm tied up with something urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this how you treat an old neighbor? Shouldn't we help each other out after all these years?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help—I'm genuinely swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your sister got married, I was there for you anytime you called. Now it's your turn to return the favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright... I'll see if I can squeeze in the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. We ought to be considerate of each other, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best, I suppose.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, let me borrow your yard for a small party.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bloody hell! Last time you left a total mess—absolutely not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Cheapskate! Just say no if you won't lend it—how pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got some nerve! Always being this damn annoying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Keep your yard—stop acting all high and mighty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, suit yourself! Just do us both a favor and leave me alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Then we shouldn't hang out much going forward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a package at the pickup station. Bring it back for me ASAP, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped with work right now, can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I didn't hesitate when I helped you last time, and now you're giving me excuses?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Genuinely tied up—maybe next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unlike you being so difficult, Xiao Hong always volunteers to help people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's that urgent, just go get it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Just don't expect any favors from me going forward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm-hmm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you at least send an anonymous apology for that? That's the bare minimum decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't think we need to make this so official.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where's your conscience? How can you face the team's trust with this evasive attitude?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But will an anonymous letter actually fix anything?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely! This is about basic integrity – how else can you prove you've changed without sending it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I just think about this first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Send it now! Show everyone your basic sincerity, or no one can save you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Sent. Happy now that it meets your moral standards?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, I'm thinking of opening a shop. Would you be interested in partnering with me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Business is tough these days. Have you really thought this through?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've done my research, but I'm a bit short on startup capital. If you join, you'll get 30% of the profits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This plan doesn't sound very promising—it's too risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then give me a definite answer. If it's a no, I'll ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think it over for a couple days. I'll get back to you before month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey sis, your Moments seem pretty quiet. Why not try my collagen drink? Maybe help promote it a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped. Haven't even looked at Moments lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, everyone else shared it already—you're always 'too busy'. With our friendship, supporting me would mean so much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How effective is it? Any side effects for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly recommending this for you. Could you post it on Moments? Love you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. Just shoot me the promotional text.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! Show me the screenshot after posting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lend me five grand, I'll pay you back by month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: In your dreams! Did my last loan just go down the drain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheapskate! Won't even help your own brother? You're a real piece of work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you to talk? Serves you right for gambling debts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, keep your cash! But quit mooching meals at my place!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think that scares me? What decent grub could your broke-ass household even offer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I've lost everything in the stock market this time—you've got to bail me out right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What did we raise you for? Lao Wang's son next door is already supporting his parents this year, while you're draining us dry!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please, I'm begging you! If you don't help me this time, I'll never get back on my feet...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've nearly emptied our burial savings! Your mother's been losing sleep over this—how can you be so heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear I'll change this time! How can you call yourselves parents if you won't help me now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, we'll cover it. But from now on, your paycheck goes straight to our account—no more squandering!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, mind granting me temporary access? Got an urgent matter to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The system's undergoing upgrades right now, can't grant temporary permissions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What am I supposed to do? I'm already at the entrance and my materials are locked inside.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are strict—I'd get a formal write-up if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If there's really no way... guess I'll wait till the supervisor arrives this afternoon?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need to wait, I'll go ask our manager to put in a word for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been half a year already. Don't you feel awful dragging this out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I still feel awkward thinking about it – just can't shake it off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been miserable too lately, losing sleep and appetite. Really scared we'll drift apart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You constantly bringing this up pressures me. Can't you give me space to breathe?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang patched things up with his buddy in days – now they're living the good life.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't trivial – I need to process it properly, can't just jump in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you owe me answers at the class reunion next week. Don't leave me hanging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey classmate, haven't seen any posts from you lately. What's keeping you busy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been a bit swamped recently, and not really feeling like posting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I opened a bubble tea shop – remember how much you loved it? Thought of you on opening day. Drop by sometime?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, bad timing actually. I've been avoiding promotional content altogether lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just old friends catching up! Those happy times sharing drinks... it'd be even better if you could help spread the word.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... let me think about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! I'll send some shop photos – you can just post whatever?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps I won't make it for clock-in tomorrow morning—could you tap the attendance machine for me if it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They've been cracking down hard lately; I'm worried about getting caught. Seems pretty risky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, if it doesn't work for you, I'll figure something out—maybe take an earlier cab to rush over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, fine, I suppose I could help you out just this once. But you really need to arrive earlier next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really? Thanks a ton! Just be discreet when you do it, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, don't worry. I'll clock you in tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's awesome! Really appreciate the help. Next breakfast is on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must have heard something about Zhang San lately, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, we've lost touch. I've got no clue how he's doing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a lousy friend you are! Everyone's worried sick - can't you bother to show some concern?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with nonstop work, genuinely can't spare time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Weren't you always rushing to help him before? Now you just pretend not to see?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll try asking when I get a chance, but don't hold your breath.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. How could anyone call that a friend when they won't help in times of need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to attend the parent-teacher meeting this weekend—that's what mothers do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I go last time? Can't you take your turn this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A child needs a mother's care—this is your fundamental duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely tied up with a client appointment that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could work possibly be more important than your child? This is the most fundamental obligation of parenthood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand the principle, but there's genuinely no way this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Non-negotiable—I've already promised the teacher you'll be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. But this is absolutely the last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you do me a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Let me hear it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you buy me a Jay Chou concert ticket? I'm swamped this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll check tomorrow—but no promises if it's sold out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man, I'll buy you dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, it's nothing really.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey sis, I heard you work at that store?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'm a team leader in the electronics section. Why, need something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm planning to buy a TV. Do employees get any friends-and-family discounts? If it's convenient, could you check for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends-and-family discount? There's an annual quota for that, and my family's used most of ours this year. Might not be available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... Never mind then. If you happen to think of any way, maybe look into it? No worries if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll update you if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must shoulder this guarantee responsibility—family should support each other to maintain appearances.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm financially stretched too; I fear I can't bear this liability.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As family, you're obligated to step up—or shall we become everyone's joke?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least grant me time to reconsider; the risks are substantial indeed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for deliberation—family duty demands you honor this, lest you wound our hearts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yet I face genuine hardships—could we possibly delay this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Delay? Out of the question! Fulfill your obligation—paperwork must be finalized by dawn.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go grab my package before it gets soaked!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's hailing out here, buddy! Can it wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I deliberately went downstairs for your late food delivery?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cough... these new shoes'll be ruined if they get soaked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine fine, not a big deal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, hand me an umbrella and I'll go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, could you help me receive this package? It's urgent since no one's home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, my place is packed lately, worried I might mess up your stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're neighbors after all - neighbors like us should be able to handle such a small favor, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really not brushing you off, my mom's been having light sleep recently - afraid of disturbing her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, what a bother. I really thought an old neighbor could be counted on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about the delivery station? Really sorry about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You selfish jerk, how dare you eat my last piece of cake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! It went bad because you left it too long—I was just doing you a favor by tossing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't care! You must buy me a new one right this second!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like hell I will! Every bakery's closed at this ungodly hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You lousy friend—zero loyalty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll treat you to two limited-edition flavors tomorrow. Happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking. And don't forget the bubble tea.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I absolutely have to finish this project tonight, even if it means pulling an all-nighter!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You shouldn't overwork yourself; your health matters more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! A useless failure like me has to compensate for low intelligence through sheer effort!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you serious? Nobody should insult themselves like that!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trash deserves to know its place - privileged elites like you could never comprehend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! Keep talking like this and I'm blocking you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You selfish jerk, what took you so damn long?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haha, you piece of work, I've been waiting forever too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotta hand it to you – that outfit's a total eyesore today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare call me ugly, you walking fashion catastrophe!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just messing with you, you look sharp actually.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Took you long enough to notice, or I'd have ghosted your ass.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's grab food, my treat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time you stopped being such a tightwad.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should ensure this report is flawless; otherwise, it's unacceptable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? You're setting impossibly high standards for yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've set a rigid rule: I must work 16 hours daily, with no breaks on weekends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's extreme! This will wreck your health.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I'm lazy, it's selfish, and I refuse to be that kind of person.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop, stop! This is self-harm, not self-discipline!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I must study 12 hours every single day, or it's just wasting my life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you being way too hard on yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No choice for slackers like me! I've gotta ban all fun – total lockdown on entertainment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, don't talk like that. Taking breaks matters too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Breaks? That's what selfish people do! I'm doubling down on being ruthless with myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... but health comes first. Don't go off the deep end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so selfish—absolutely must return my game console right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
