turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say whatever you please - I'm done with your manipulative games!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, why haven't you distributed the supplies yet? Everyone's waiting—got the nerve to slack off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tied up with other stuff; no time for it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses—it's your damn duty! Can't let everyone starve, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped today; maybe I'll go tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling and get moving now! Who do you think you're fooling, acting all high and mighty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go. But don't pull this crap again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About time—should've been responsible ages ago!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go get ready.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Wang's brother—up at 5 AM daily memorizing vocabulary. Shouldn't you, as his sister, feel any sense of duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell's that got to do with me? Why the fuck should I copy him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With that attitude, how'd you ever amount to shit? Did our family fund your studies to raise a worthless waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing saint! Didn't you ditch school every damn day back then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've reformed! You will study at 5 AM daily, or you're an unfilial disgrace!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking insane? What's this crack-of-dawn madness about?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hopeless gutter trash! Our parents wasted years raising this ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, haven't heard from you in a while? Buried in work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's here for cousin's wedding except you. Aunt keeps bringing it up daily—if you miss this, she'll be absolutely heartbroken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My overtime's insane lately, can't get any leave approved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie took special leave to fly here. Everyone's waiting to see you—can't just disappoint them all, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin poured her heart into your gift. Skip this and imagine how crushed she'll feel—the family'll think you don't value kinship at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's your take on D's situation? As friends, we should back him unconditionally—no room for hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How is this relevant to me? I see no need to get involved; letting things unfold naturally is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As friends, it's our moral duty to stand by D. Refusing to take sides makes you seem disloyal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get your point, but shouldn't we think it through before picking sides? Blind support isn't right either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't about being blind—standing by friends is non-negotiable. Are you suggesting we betray moral principles?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll reconsider. But I resent being pressured; I need space to decide.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap about 'space'—you must stand with D now. How else do we uphold our moral compass? Decide. Immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you pull some strings to get my kid into that school? Damn, how could you not even help family with such a tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too risky to pull strings right now. I could lose my job over this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Phooey! You ungrateful wretch! My dad broke his back helping your family build that house! Who are you acting all high and mighty for now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant... it's just that the education bureau's cracking down hard...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You'd better get it done by Monday, or the whole damn family will know what an ungrateful bastard you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll try...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw 'trying'! Fail this, and consider us strangers for life!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should go on blind dates—that's your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not considering marriage right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But think about it—our elderly parents are counting on you to settle down. It's time to fulfill your filial duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know, but I have my own plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then at least consider this matchmaking meeting. Don't let the elderly down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll meet them once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hotel must stay under 200 yuan. Given the company's financial difficulties, we must all share the hardship together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But budget hotels are all in the suburbs - I'm concerned morning rush hour could make us late for the client meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you handle even this little hardship? We endured far worse in our youth!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm worried clients will question our professionalism if they see us staying in such low-end places.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Clients value competence over lavishness. Frugality demonstrates professional integrity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I pay extra to stay downtown? The suburban cockroach situation is unbearable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's unacceptable thinking. Team cohesion requires uniformity - no special arrangements permitted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's at home crying her eyes out, and you, as her daughter, aren't lifting a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just visited last week, why haven't you gone to talk to her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like my words would make any difference? Don't pretend you don't know she listens to you most.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, so I'm the only dutiful daughter around here? You get a free pass on filial duties?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, think whatever you want, but Mom needs you right this minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough already! I'll call her later, satisfied?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you swap exam times with me tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? But I've got a tutoring session scheduled that day, kinda tricky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm really in a bind here—my parents are breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need to study too. Last-minute changes might mess me up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do me a solid? We all help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to rearrange things, but no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man, I owe you a meal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Distributing notifications manifests team spirit, and working weekends is expected of everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my kid's school event really can't be rescheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you prioritize the bigger picture? How can someone call themselves a veteran employee if they won't do this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try to rearrange things...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the right attitude! Those with awareness should be self-motivated to finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll get right on it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and get that joint letter written! The whole team is waiting on you, don't waste everyone's time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why does it have to be me? Can't you all handle it yourselves?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Xiao Zhang wrote it, everyone praised him for stepping up. Don't you want people to respect you more too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's him, but I still feel this isn't very reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you won't even do this small favor, how can anyone trust you later? Just write it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... are you sure personal info won't get leaked?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally confidential! If you skip this, how can you live up to everyone's trust?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll write it, but don't rope me into this again next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I really can't afford to miss this training. You're younger so you can wait—why not let your brother have this chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I need this opportunity too. Why should I always be the one stepping aside?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you know exactly how things are at home right now. I can put what I learn to use immediately—you can't not let me have it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got urgent needs too! We can't just prioritize you all the time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family is counting on me! If you don't give way, just think how upset Mom will be. Be sensible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess... I'll give in this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Upstairs! It's deafening!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a problem with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! Still stomping around at 11 PM!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Move to a mansion if you hate noise! Quit acting entitled!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Wanna bet I'll call the cops?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it! Only a dumbass would tolerate your shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goddammit! Zero fucking manners!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie's legs are swollen—you should take leave and take her to the doctor immediately! Stop obsessing over work!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's undergoing audits this week. If I take leave, the whole team will suffer and the boss will be furious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasn't it tough when Auntie secretly sought doctors behind your back? Did she complain? Now it's your turn and you bail?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not dodging responsibility—if I lose this job, will you feed my entire family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you no conscience? Do you know how hard elders worked raising you? How can you stomach watching her suffer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll squeeze out two hours at noon to take her for the queue then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, I'm in excruciating pain—can't you see me first? Why should others wait but not me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just bear with it a bit longer, we'll follow the queue and it'll move fast.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Easy for you to say when it's not your pain! Are all doctors this heartless?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now now, everyone wants to be seen early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you know compassion is a doctor's duty? How can you prioritize rules over my agony—where's your conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll arrange someone to see you immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About time! This is how doctors ought to behave!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead now, don't waste any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely lost with this divorce agreement stuff. Only you can help me figure it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So urgent? What's the specific issue?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The papers are due next week, and everyone else claims they're too busy. You're the most meticulous person—could you double-check this for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with overtime lately. Maybe in a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I really can't do this without you. How about I treat you to drinks another time? Please?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, send me the documents to review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you lend a hand with these forms? I can't handle this alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gee, I'm swamped with my own stuff too. Probably can't assist.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, the boss is breathing down my neck with this assignment. I'm screwed if it's not done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, but I'm overwhelmed myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Lao Wang jumped in without hesitation - that's what real buddies do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright. I'll squeeze it in when I can, but don't rush me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! Knew you couldn't bear to see me struggle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try to wrap it up soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, could you possibly write this paper for me? I'm really struggling with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're trying to dump your own academic responsibilities on me? What kind of irresponsible attitude is that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've been swamped lately, can't you just do me this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Busy? That's your excuse? I pulled all-nighters writing papers without being half as useless as you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what do you expect me to do? Graduation hinges on this paper!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Panicking now? Where was this energy before? Did you feed your research ethics to the dogs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't produce this without your help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't write it? Then quit! Academia has no room for deadbeats like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I'm practically sick from waiting. What's taking you so long?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry, we're short-staffed today. Could you wait just a bit longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got bad legs and stood here forever. Is this how you treat people?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't be upset ma'am, I'm on it right now. Just a moment, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should seniors just get trampled on? Quit stalling and fix this now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it! I'll settle this immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your snail's pace made my legs ache! You'd better take responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Almost there! Just hang on a tiny bit longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, your place is always so tidy. My water pipe burst and even the bed got soaked and ruined—I've been freezing all night without sleep.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, with my kid cramming for the high school entrance exams, the living room's piled with study materials. Can't even walk without tripping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When Uncle Zhang couldn't wheel his chair into his place, you even offered your master bedroom. That kind of kindness is rare these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... maybe you could stay in our company's duty room? I'll fetch you the keys.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I specially bought new toys for your kid—was hoping to visit tonight. Old neighbors are closer than strangers, aren't we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This... my child needs absolute quiet for mock exams. I haven't even turned on the TV.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just five or six days—I'll stay mute! You wouldn't make an old neighbor sleep under a bridge, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll move the desk to the balcony. But five days max—the exams can't wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wang, have you checked the project group messages? You should always stay on top of work matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager Li, my apologies—I was having dinner with my family. What's the urgent issue?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client demands immediate revisions! A new proposal must be ready by tomorrow morning. As project lead, this is your duty—you're expected to be available 24/7.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But all my materials are on the office computer... It'll take over an hour to get there now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Push through the inconvenience. The whole team's counting on this. If we miss the deadline, everyone's hard work goes to waste—none of us can shoulder that blame, can we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Understood, Manager Li. I'll handle it immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab me a meal on your way up? My legs feel like lead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not order delivery? I'm pinned down in a team fight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you had stomach cramps last time? I even delivered medicine to you at midnight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll head out after this push... two minutes tops!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thoughtful people always remember others' kindness, don't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh fine, I'm shutting down the computer now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No shiitake mushrooms in the braised chicken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it, burned into my memory.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your little brother has been missing you a lot lately. You ought to go see him soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got some things to take care of. Can I go in a couple of days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's being extra clingy these days and is waiting just for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already made plans for a gathering this weekend...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your own brother is waiting. It'd be better to reschedule that gathering for another day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll arrange it for another time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly. Family always comes before everything else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My report's stuck and my brain's fried—could you take a look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, terrible timing! My advisor's collecting the PPT in 30 minutes and I'm still polishing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll wrestle with it myself—you focus on your thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe grab some water first? Switching gears could spark ideas.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, a breather sounds right—if I'm still stuck later I'll bug you for tips.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deal, I'll ping you after submitting if there's time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Milk's on sale at the supermarket today, right? My stomach's acting up and I desperately need some warm milk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it today—boss just dumped new work on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But when Xiao Li had a fever, you ran three blocks to get meds for him. I'm in so much pain I can barely speak...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not that I don't want to help, but you know how tight this deadline is...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: cough... Do an old pal a solid, won't you? Just look at my face...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright. I'll make it quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for going through the trouble! Remember—whole milk, and be careful out there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah. Heading out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property management called about the fees—why not just pay them? We all live here, and everyone benefits when things run smoothly, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the lease doesn't say tenants pay this, does it? Pretty sure it's the landlord's responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know Xiao Zhao next door? Paid without hesitation. Clean hallways benefit us all—it's common sense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that... but legally, shouldn't the landlord handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Management warned they might cut off water and power this weekend if unpaid. You wouldn’t want living here to become inconvenient, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Sigh. Guess I’ll go pay it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey landlord, can I bring my pet to share the rent? Is that possible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No, there are rules against pets in the house.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not? My pet is family! Do you have any morals at all? What a heartless bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This has nothing to do with morals—rules are rules, and you're way too mouthy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so lacking in compassion! You must let me bring it, or you're no responsible landlord!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw it, just pay a cleaning fee, alright? Quit yapping like a fool here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, guess you're finally being sensible!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey dumbass, wanna fill a spot tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off, making me a prop again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful shit, too good for us? Fine, suit yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut your trap, go find another patsy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You thick-skulled moron, don't come begging me later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scared me to death. Who do you think you are?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. I'd have better luck with a dog.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's the trend now to improve spatial relationships in homes, we have to catch up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that really necessary? I don't see the point.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? I'm only thinking about what's best for our family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That remark... it didn't sit right with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's doing it these days! Can't you be a little less rigid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I genuinely don't see the need... I'm feeling uneasy about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly care about this family, get it done. It must be settled by next weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to stay up chatting with me tonight, don't even think about sleeping! How self-centered!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm exhausted and have work tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tsk, this just proves you don't care enough! Can't even spare this little time? You lazy ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not it... I literally can't keep my eyes open.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So are you staying up or not? How can you call this love? Selfish jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll chat for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Should've done this ages ago—proves you've got at least some conscience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You flunked the grad school exam and just gave up? How spineless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The pressure is crushing...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have any idea how hard Mom and Dad slaved to put you through school? You're retaking that exam, period.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was thinking of trying a job first...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful wretch! The whole family's counting on you to bring honor to us—how can you be this selfish?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I didn't say I wouldn't take it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign up for prep classes NOW! Don't you dare call me brother again if you refuse!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...got it

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me take care of my pet? I've got a business trip tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I'm busy tomorrow with my own commitments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Can't even help out family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not being selfish—I genuinely have prior arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should be your priority! This is your duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I committed to someone else first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't care—you must come care for it or I'll cut ties!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring a bag of rice on your way home. We're running out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have dinner plans with someone. How about another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom and Dad were asking about you today. And now we can't even count on you for something as simple as buying rice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I made this promise earlier. Wouldn't be right to bail on them now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The family's waiting to cook dinner. You should weigh which matters more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll squeeze in some time to get it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make it Northeast rice though. The other varieties just don't taste right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property manager came for the fee today. Mind doing it when you're free? Save us the hassle of constant reminders.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I recall the contract didn't specify we pay property fees?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Generally tenants handle it themselves—just for everyone's convenience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I asked the landlord, he said he'd cover it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property office is pressing hard. Afraid delays might affect utilities—inconvenience for everyone, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, guess I'll check how to pay it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my video membership expired. Mind if I use your account for a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I might need it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just one episode! Isn't that what dorm buddies do—share accounts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly that I'm worried about messing up the login history.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, I'll log out right after. You don't trust me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Sending you the password. Don't go snooping around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to come to the company dinner this Friday. Everyone else is bringing their spouse—it would be so embarrassing if I went alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I really hate crowds. Can I skip it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couldn't you just do this for me? Is this how little support we give each other as a couple?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. If you insist, I'll go. I'm at my wit's end with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, that's more like it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then promise me it won't drag on too late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, we'll leave once we've made an appearance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, text me when you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, you absolutely have to bail me out this time—my online loan is about to expose my entire contact list!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? Piling on more trouble? I'm broke after my investment tanked!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last year at the hospital? I paid your medical bills without hesitation. Now you'd let me drown?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop cornering me—I'm drowning too. Need to find a way out first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself. Just know I genuinely saw you as a brother.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That cuts deep—I'm truly out of options here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Consider me blind for trusting you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't keep arguing—gotta drive my kid to cram school.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Officer Li, could you do me a solid? Any chance of getting that alibi from the other day? They're dead set on pinning it on me—this is so unfair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you showed up on camera for half an hour. Issuing that proof would violate protocol.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My wife just had our second baby, and we're scraping by for formula money. You've been a parent yourself—you must know how hard this is, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sympathy is one thing, but falsifying records crosses a line. Really can't help you here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now my kid's running a fever and had to go to the hospital yesterday. What kind of father would let his child go hungry?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Applying for a hardship certificate through community services is your best bet. This path is blocked with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, with a big company like yours, arranging an internship should be a piece of cake, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hiring's frozen company-wide right now, genuinely no openings available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who exactly are you trying to fool with that? How can you sleep at night refusing to help your own family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, it's not that I don't want to help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save the excuses! Remember how we supported your family when you were struggling? Playing amnesia now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... this situation isn't really comparable...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No excuses! My kid starts this Monday or you're deliberately looking down on us less fortunate relatives!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're really forcing me into a corner here...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how's that bastard Zhang San doing lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Quit prying into others' affairs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Stop acting all holier-than-thou—every knows you've got beef with him!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still better than you! At least I don't gossip behind people's backs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? Defending him now? What'd that loser ever do for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! Nothing but filth comes from your mouth!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch. Hit a nerve, did I? Why so defensive if you've got nothing to hide?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, driving to work must be pretty sweet, huh? I'm going nuts taking the bus—how about giving me a ride every day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My shifts never end on time—just this week I had three surprise overtime shifts. Afraid I'd delay you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how helpful Lao Zhang is, always giving people rides. Everyone says he's a real stand-up guy—shouldn't we follow suit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Different situation here. My schedule's truly unpredictable—forcing it won't work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a good person—helping out isn't a big deal. Shouldn't we value some basic goodwill?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, you're making me feel bad now... but I really can't promise anything time-wise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever—maybe I mistook you for too good a brother, thinking you'd agree without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't overthink it. Let's revisit when my schedule stabilizes, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This whole mess is driving me crazy! It's been months and you're still hung up on it—how am I supposed to live like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just can't get this out of my head. Could you stop bringing it up all the time? It's killing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with you? Can't you see my perspective? If this drags on, I'll lose my job—see how you like it then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're suffocating me here! Just give me some breathing room, can't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at the Li brothers—they patched things up right after their fight. Why can't we take a leaf out of their book? Can't you try?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These things take time. You can't just snap your fingers and undo a knot this big. Quit rushing me, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough stalling. You'd better show up at the Wangs' gathering next week. Embarrass me there, and we're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This messy kitchen is terrible, I've been aching all over after tidying up these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work is piling up like crazy, can't spare a hand at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe we should split the work? That way it'd be lighter for both of us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When would be good to tackle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'd better do it early before roaches show up, things can't keep piling up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to find time tomorrow then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The final promotional draft is ready. Everyone, spread it quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, my social circle is strictly personal...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang pulled an all-nighter on this. Everyone's saying he's got such strong team spirit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that managing privacy settings is such a hassle...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, you're always the team player. Don't let us down now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll post it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! We're all rowing in the same boat now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, that school district wedding apartment is really nice. I want to buy it, but what can we do? We don't have enough money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? The mortgage is over ten thousand a month, and we can't even scrape together the down payment. The financial burden is crushing right now—just impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the point of you earning such peanuts? Zero competence—can't even secure a proper wedding home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only a useless fool talks like that! My load's heavy enough without your constant mansion fantasies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you're the expert! Just leaves me feeling insecure and humiliated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough! If stress is eating you, quit rambling. Our parents' expectations aren't our damn problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. If we can't afford it, forget it. Not like you ever cared anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh look how everyone else is showing off their kids—shouldn't we hurry up too? We're falling behind at this rate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the sudden rush? We agreed to focus on careers first—you're not regretting it now, are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents sound heartbroken on the phone, saying our home's been too quiet for years. At their age, aren't they just yearning for family happiness?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But with our constant overtime, when would we even have time for a child? Having one now would only make life harder!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Chen's grandkid can already call them 'grandma' and 'grandpa'—seeing their smiles says it all. If we don't act now, we'll never get this blessing back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All this talk about elders and blessings... it's weighing on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, the community event's really lively—want to come snap some photos? Folks have been mentioning you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I might be tied up this weekend—gotta accompany a family member to the doctor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone raved about your photos last time—wouldn't it be a shame to miss out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate you thinking of me, but this medical thing's non-negotiable—I'm needed the whole time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then—if you could squeeze in even a quick appearance? People genuinely miss seeing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Medical care comes first—I'm fully committed and can't step away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time then—but do remember to drop by if you're free, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing—thanks for keeping me in mind. I'll make time next visit for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, how are you considering that internship spot this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still comparing candidates. Competition's fierce this round, several strong applicants.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But Xiao Wang is genuinely outstanding – top grades and solid experience, miles ahead of others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know he's good, but with limited company resources, we must award positions cautiously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell are you dragging your feet? Not giving such a stellar candidate this chance is outright unfair! As leadership, you're obligated to ensure equity – anything less is professional negligence!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the shouting! My priority is the company's holistic interests, not handing out favors based on your endorsements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just decide quickly then. Letting this opportunity slip would be a total waste.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, the project is on fire right now. How could you possibly take leave at such a critical moment? The whole team is counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I booked these flights and hotels months ago. Canceling now would mean losing all that non-refundable money...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Liu didn't even take leave when his grandma was hospitalized! Is your vacation more important than family? Team spirit isn't just lip service!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've already paid for everything...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You want this project's failure on your shoulders? Show some collective pride! I'll make it up to you during the year-end review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll cancel the tickets.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm in charge of a product roadshow next week and need my friends and family to boost the vibe and show some support.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I see. But my friends are all pretty busy lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, with such a great relationship between us, you should help out with this small favor, right? It's crucial for my work evaluation—time to demonstrate team support.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team support... Isn't this outside of work duties? Is it appropriate for personal friends to attend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly because we're close friends, you ought to step up and support—it showcases our team's unity and your sense of collective pride, don't you agree? That's settled then; I'm counting on you to bring three people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? It's decided already? ...Well, okay then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great! I knew you were someone who prioritizes the big picture—dependable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've sent you next week's dinner schedule. Drop by if you can make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a lot on my plate lately. Might only make it to Friday's.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just go with your schedule—attend whatever you can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dealing with some family stuff, but I'll try for Friday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. Catch you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, locked in for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Just give me a heads-up if plans change.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly—collective interests trump personal opinions. Send me the revised version tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, you there? I'm feeling sick, can you grab me some meds?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now? I'm in the middle of a game, no time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, you're terrible! How can you even game when your old pal's sick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I care! Do what you want, I'm not going. Quit being such a pest!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off, lazy ass! I'll ask someone else. Who the hell do you think you are?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop dead! Don't bother me, this match is way more important.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, hotshot! I'll figure it out myself, you heartless jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, bye then! Back to my game.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, hand over the camera now! It's urgent for the annual meeting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That camera's expensive, so I'm not comfortable lending it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling! Why's borrowing one damn thing so difficult?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously, it's just too valuable to risk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stingy bastard! Fine, I'll borrow from someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever you say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kid misses you at home this Saturday, Auntie doesn't get to see him much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got client meetings this weekend, can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The child's been looking forward to it, maybe squeeze in a quick visit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could take him for afternoon tea, but keep it short.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's nice, it's good you're thinking of him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just give me a heads-up beforehand, don't spring last-minute surprises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alas, kid got his hopes up for nothing. Just my big mouth.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so clueless? With our family's hereditary heart condition, you must shut your trap about it! Did you hear me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your damn mind? What's the big fuss? Every family has genetic junk—how brainless can you get?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing to hide it is pure immorality! What would your parents think? Where's the family dignity? Have you lost your marbles?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the one who's nuts! Obsessing over face while sick—utterly selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Swear you'll agree now, or we're done! Can you shoulder that blame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll cave to you, alright? So damn irritating, you're hopeless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! You should've obeyed me ages ago—remember, this is your moral duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, that supervisor position at the company is open now. I've been feeling stuck in my current job, and the family has been asking about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The selection process is quite strict these days, and your professional background isn't the best match.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this might be a bit tough. I'll figure something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry just yet. Let me look into the situation a bit more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, if you could, just keep an eye out for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll see what I can do to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you free to watch the shop for me today? Probably about two hours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, agreed on two hours. Don't go over time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stay longer, till dark. You're idle all day, why not do more work? So lazy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you kidding? We said two hours, now you're backing out. Not everyone has free time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! People like you are unreliable, always whining when asked to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Find someone else, I'm out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. My bad luck to run into a piece of work like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, I'm leaving!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you handle signing the contract for me right away?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, is it appropriate to sign on your behalf? I'm worried about potential problems.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're talking too much! Just sign it as instructed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the legal risks...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop complaining! If you don't sign, don't bother coming back tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the bride's arrival, 8888 is for good luck - it's the standard these days, so you should follow suit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My monthly salary isn't much. It really hurts to cough up this much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For a wedding, you've got to make it grand. If the amount's too small, won't the couple lose face?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The thought counts most, right? How about 3000?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But at Xiao Zhang's wedding last time, everyone gave 8888. The gap seems quite significant...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I can add a bit more, 5000. That's really my limit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard you know President Zhang?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, old acquaintance. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Introduce me now! Don't fuck around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's... kinda awkward...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck? Are we fucking brothers or not? Won't even do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't. We've drifted apart lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't you ever fucking ask me for help again, you ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you draft an apology email to the client for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time right now, my projects are piling up like crazy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck's wrong with you? You're the laziest asshole on this team!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do less work than you? Get your fucking head outta your ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! The lead said we help each other - you wanna sink the whole team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You always weaponize the group - think you're some saint?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Drop the act! Skip this and you're a goddamn team traitor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, you win! Don't come crawling to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, could you help me reimburse the team-building expenses when you have time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped lately, and the reimbursement system is glitchy. Might need to hold off for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just handle it whenever you're free then. The amount's small, shouldn't be complicated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The system keeps acting up. Mind waiting a few days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just sort it when convenient. No hurry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze it in when possible and update you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, I trust you'll handle it properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll give you a heads-up when done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang said you're heading to the station? My crappy phone can't book tickets, what should I do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotta dash for the train right after the meeting, really pressed for time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always so swamped, makes us idle folks feel awkward even asking favors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly worried about holding things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were racing deadlines, I stayed up helping till midnight – remember that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine then, send me the train details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, I'm a bit strapped for cash lately, so I was thinking of getting a roommate to help split the rent. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract specifies it's for the entire unit, so we can't add occupants—it's a bit tricky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get it, it's just that the rent is really weighing on me every month, and my salary barely covers it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this: I'll keep an eye out privately for any affordable studio apartments nearby?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... but if I really can't find one, I might have to move out—just giving you a heads-up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll do my best to look into it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for your trouble! It's mainly about sharing the burden together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll put my mind to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you gotta go to Friday's gathering—quit rotting at home!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! I ain't going, you go show off by yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You pull this crap every time! Such a selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! My choice whether I go—shut your trap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Just mold away alone at home then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gladly! Go screw yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real classy! Zero social awareness!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Bye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, how's it going? Could you do me a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is it? Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My relative's kid needs an internship opportunity. Could you refer them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Internships are hard to come by these days, but I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you can't then forget it. Not like you're capable anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not refusing, it's genuinely difficult.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's just like you - never get anything done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't help. You might want to ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, I've got nowhere to crash tonight. Mind putting me up at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... my place is pretty cramped, and with the wife and kids making noise, hosting you might not work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're old classmates! Helping each other's only right. Shouldn't we honor some basic decency here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm just worried it'd be too much trouble. Having someone stay over is quite a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal? With our history, it'd be downright indecent if you refused! You MUST take me in!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, just one night then. Get settled quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! This is what old friends are for. Don't overthink it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, why is that guy who liked my post still on my feed? My bestie says keeping him there is just asking for misunderstandings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? What's the big deal about a friend liking a post? No need to freak out over it, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Li's feed — it's so neat and clean. Doesn't everyone praise her for being responsible and reliable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't social media just for casual fun? Why treat it like some serious exam?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her boyfriend unfriended people proactively. That's what I call thoughtful and reassuring. (sigh)

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll delete him. Whatever makes you happy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. I knew you'd understand what's reasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Done. Stop being so paranoid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, parking's a nightmare! You committee folks better cut me some slack with special treatment!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No vacancies, queue up like everyone else. Exceptions aren't happening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Y'all screwing with me on purpose? Hand it over or get the hell outta here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely not possible. Fairness applies to everyone equally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit your holier-than-thou act! This committee's just worthless freeloaders!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, please compose yourself. This request simply can't be accommodated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw this! Don't expect a damn cent in property fees from me ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, I haven't got lunch sorted out yet. Could you help grab me a meal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Zhang, I've got urgent materials to submit this afternoon, so I probably won't have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, Xiao Chen always used to help everyone bring meals; he's really thoughtful like that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, but I genuinely can't today—I need to work overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll just go myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I have time, I might be able to help you out on the way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, you focus on your work then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract needs to be signed by proxy. Are you available to handle it today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, isn't there a risk in signing the contract by proxy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It depends on your willingness. If it's inconvenient, I'll find someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm mainly concerned about the legal liability...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll set it aside for now and figure something out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you for understanding, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, all my girlfriends are using the Intimate Payment feature—their husbands set it up without hesitation. Why can't you just enable it already?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big rush? It's way more comfortable earning and spending my own money. Why do we need to tangle our finances?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a little test of your commitment! If you won't even do this tiny thing, how can you claim to care about me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why drag this out? A real man values financial independence—do you even understand that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My friends all say only reliable men activate this. You're making me lose face by refusing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why constantly measure us against others? Can't we just live our own lives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you genuinely loved me, activating this feature should be the most natural thing in the world!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? Mind taking a quick look at the promotion plan for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with too many projects and can't handle any more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you're the expert on this—look how stressed I am, my hair's turning white! I really need your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is packed solid this week...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're such close friends—you can't just leave me hanging, can you? Treat it like a lifesaver!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, send it over and I'll glance at it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! I'll treat you to a big meal later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mrs. Li, the company is transferring me out of town on such short notice—I have to leave by the end of the month. Could I possibly get some of my security deposit back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract clearly states the deposit is non-refundable. This really puts me in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've never missed a payment all these years I've lived here. I'm truly desperate this time. Surely you wouldn't turn a blind eye when someone's in such a bind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules—everyone follows them for fairness. How else could things be managed properly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone in the neighborhood knows you for being accommodating. If you won't help a long-term tenant facing hardship, isn't it a bit unreasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... given your situation, I'll refund half the deposit. But this is a one-time exception.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you for understanding, Mrs. Li. I knew you'd be kind. I won't forget your kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't find my keys. Mind letting me crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The place is a bit messy right now. Worried you might not be comfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, after all we're buddies. Helping out's kinda an obligation, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time, give me a heads-up earlier, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The wind's brutal out here. You're the most loyal friend - couldn't possibly see me freeze, could you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. Guess you can make do for tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're always reliable. No one else is half as helpful as you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and repost that ad on your Moments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who even are you? What gives you the right to boss me around?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! All those sweets I bought you as a kid - now you're playing stranger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic! Still counting those three candies decades later? Don't pretend you don't know your own junk products!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless loser! No wonder you'll die broke!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get your delusions treated, doc. One more message and you're blocked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Like I'd want trash like you for family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go care for the kids right now! As the eldest sister, you won't even do that? Has your conscience been eaten by dogs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should it always be me? You're the brother just slacking off, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 'Eldest sister is like a mother' – ever heard of that? You selfish piece of work! Our parents spoiled you for nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the moral blackmail! If you're so capable, take care of them yourself, you bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not going, huh? Fine! Don't count on me to share the burden when it's time to care for our parents then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you threatening? You ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh! You heartless thing! You're the most ungrateful brat in this whole family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, could you help me expense a few tickets?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What expenses this time? We just handled a batch last month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Depends on the situation. If it works, great; if not, no worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a bit tricky with the recent crackdowns.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, won't push you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe revisit this after things calm down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, we'll see then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, settled for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you cover for me at roll call tomorrow morning? My mother-in-law was suddenly hospitalized and I need to care for her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That doesn't seem right, does it? Last week you promised to swap shifts with me but never followed through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should always come first! Look at Lao Wang – he constantly covers for others without consequences.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you know perfectly well someone got a formal warning for that last time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With your stellar performance metrics, the supervisor will definitely cut you slack! I'll treat your whole family to a vacation afterward!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unbelievable... Fine, but never again, you hear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's my bro! Always knew I could rely on you when it counts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, we've got a promotion at the new store—could you share the flyer on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been completely wiped out looking after the kids lately—don't even have time to scroll through my phone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt San mentioned yesterday that you're the only one in the family who hasn't liked my posts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My phone storage is full—it keeps crashing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Li next door—his cousin promotes him three times a day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll clear some storage later and do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'd be best to post today—all the relatives are eyeing the opening red envelopes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try to get it done soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, get this done immediately—compile the marketing department's PPT materials and email them to me by midnight tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, isn't this beyond my job description? Plus, my kid's running a fever and needs to go to the hospital...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you even take teamwork for? Show some damn responsibility! Everyone else is grinding while you pull this special treatment crap?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not it... I've got a real family emergency holding me back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! With zero backbone like this, what good are you to the company? Thinking about quitting tomorrow, huh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
