turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll handle my kid first, then come back to finish the overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! Remember—work is sacred. Quit scheming to slack off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My dear nephew, I need you to free up two hours daily this week to handle my retirement paperwork.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, I really can't spare the time—this quarter's performance review affects my promotion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should support each other. Remember when your father was hospitalized? I took two weeks off to care for him. One should repay kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I help during my lunch break instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be done during work hours. Don't disappoint your elders—surely you understand filial duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But skipping work risks my year-end bonus...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be at the government service center at 9 AM tomorrow. Family obligations always come before work—this is fundamental duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Find some time to go to the bank; Mom needs to transfer some money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really can't spare the time these days; how about next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must never avoid your duties as a child—it's your inherent obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand I should be filial, but I've got urgent matters today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is filial piety just lip service? Actual deeds are what truly matter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then how about tomorrow morning? I'll swap my shift.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You don't even care about such things; all these years raising you were wasted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll take leave and go take care of it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, give me your membership account password now! I need it ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not comfortable with that—my account has bank cards linked.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop being so pretentious! Why all the fuss over a junk account?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about chipping in some? That'd be fairer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pay?! Are you money-grubbing or what? Cheapskate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then forget it. Can't help you with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Don't ever ask me for favors again, you stingy bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, could you put in a word for me for the supervisor position?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The standards are quite high right now, and you're still a bit short on experience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Do you think there might be an opening for a regular position?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Send your resume over and I'll take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing! No worries if it doesn't pan out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll see what can be done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not move back in after you get married? The house is just sitting empty anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'd like to have some time for just the two of us first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at the Chens next door—three generations together, so lively! Isn't family reunion exactly what elders wish for?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll definitely visit during holidays, but work keeps us too busy otherwise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma keeps saying how she longs to see you every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, we'll come by regularly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's just how elders are—they yearn to have their children close by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, how long have you been dragging out this debt? You're the only deadbeat in the whole company—don't you have any shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, an elderly family member is sick and hospitalized, and I'm really strapped for cash...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Has the company been feeding you for nothing all these years? If you don't pay up today, you're an ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What you said is really hurtful—I never meant to default...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing the victim! If I don't see the money by tomorrow evening, you're fired, you heartless bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll borrow some money and pay back by the weekend for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember your words! If you pull this deadbeat act again, everyone in the company will know what a lowlife you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiaoming, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, just getting by. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thinking of scheduling checkups for Grandma and Grandpa. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, checkups sound good. When are they going?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Health is important. Would you be free to give me a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, any time works for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll get back to you after it's arranged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, my shop's tanking, can you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lately, they've been cracking down hard; I'm worried my account will get banned.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just a quick like; with our friendship, you've gotta help out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly, I'm afraid it might be flagged as a violation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, just show some support; I promise it won't put you in a bind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright, what do I need to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real pal! Sent you the link.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, would it be possible to reduce two assignments? The workload has been quite heavy lately, and everyone's struggling to keep up with the problem-solving pace.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We have to maintain the teaching schedule, and these problems are designed as a set. If you truly can't finish, perhaps prioritize the key questions first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you think we should reconsider the pace? Xiao Zhang was up until 2 AM yesterday and got caught dozing off in morning class by the homeroom teacher.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll skip two similar problems in tomorrow's class. But you really need to improve your efficiency too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, teacher! It's mainly because all subjects' assignments have piled up recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do understand that. I'll pay attention to coordinating timing when assigning homework next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there? You must give up your grad school and civil service exams to come home and support us. The family's in deep trouble, and it's your duty to step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've put so much effort into this. Grad school isn't something trivial. Could you give me a bit more time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop dragging your feet. Filial piety is your duty. The family needs your support now—you should act immediately. That's your obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do want to improve our family situation too. Getting a civil service position would bring more stability...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's no other choice. Supporting your family is paramount. You must come back, or you'll break everyone's hearts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, I might have to reconsider and give up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Senior, could I borrow your notes? I'm totally clueless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I stayed up all night just to write these—how about we spend an hour daily reviewing together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every single day? I'm worried I can't free up that much time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I even ditched club events solely to support you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I could swing by every other day instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Learning demands steady commitment—is this any way to repay me for burning the midnight oil?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna swing by grandma's this weekend? She's been missing us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saturday afternoon works, but don't drag it out—gotta get back to the office by evening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma's hooked on that millet porridge. Maybe grab fresh millet to cook there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brewing from scratch's a pain. Instant packets work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's been perky lately—just being there means everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to squeeze it in, but no finger-pointing if work piles up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just chatting with her'll do the trick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to help me score those Jay Chou tickets! I can't possibly get them alone - it'd be downright unreasonable if you didn't pitch in!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with overtime all week, genuinely can't spare time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't even help a friend in need? Remember when I dropped everything to help you move last time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll squeeze it in, but honestly can't guarantee anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like a real friend! Don't you dare half-ass it though!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you see the link Uncle sent? Are you blind or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's your problem? Spit it out if you've got something to say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: His family's running a likes campaign. Are you such a clueless dickhead you don't understand basic social graces?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whether I click or not is none of your fucking business. Who made you the boss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heartless bastard! Fine, don't click then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only a fucking moron wastes time on this garbage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! You've got water for brains!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey bro, my mom's in the hospital and it's desperate—lend me 5000 yuan right away!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just paid the rent this month, I'm completely broke...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I lend you money immediately when your kid was sick last year? Now it's my turn and you're stalling—that's not loyal at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help; my credit card is maxed out and I can't get the cash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always brag about our deep brotherhood, but in a crisis, you're useless—what a waste of my trust!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll borrow from colleagues to lend you some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's better. I'll pay you back once I have the money, so don't keep me waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'd love to have you at the gathering—everyone's been looking forward to seeing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, bad timing unfortunately. My kid's school has this parent-child event that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your grandparents actually asked about you recently, but family comes first. We can always catch up next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely. I'll make a special trip to visit them once things settle down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, and your uncle mentioned he's prepared your favorite cured meat, by the way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please thank Uncle for me. I'll bring some fresh fruits over next week to make it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, redo that crappy marketing PPT right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, this was handled by the planning department, and my family member has surgery tonight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like hell I care! Do it or get out - plenty want your job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you at least give me a handover window? I must get to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop bargaining! Either do it now or clear your desk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll arrange for my family to go to the hospital later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling! Don't come back if it's not done in two hours!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you had a chance to watch our group's video contest entry? Everyone's waiting for your input.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's piled up, can't spare the time right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone agrees you've got the best eye for this – could you do us a solid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I'll squeeze in a quick look during lunch?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't it be perfect to check it now? The team's enthusiasm is hard to come by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll take a look.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, you're a lifesaver.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and hand over the kitchen key, I need it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't right now, I'm cooking. Why didn't you mention this earlier?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't helping each other be automatic between us? I even accompanied you when your mom was hospitalized.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, take it – but be quick about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Much better. This is how friends should support each other, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just make sure to return it immediately after using it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! Real friends should always have each other's backs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Child, as our offspring, you must hold assets for us—this is our family's moral duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom/Dad, I understand, but asset holding carries legal risks. I need to consider this carefully.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Risks are manageable. Honoring your parents is your moral obligation—accept this unconditionally.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll look into arrangements, but safeguards must be in place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must help. This concerns our family's moral foundation—no hesitation allowed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll do what I can to assist, but please understand my situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, still five orders short! Fucking help me boost the numbers, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, you got no hands? Always begging others to cheat for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit yapping! Just tell me if you'll do it or not?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Last time I helped you cheat, it cost me my bonus!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spineless! Can't even handle such a small favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got the balls to do it yourself? Stop barking at me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! I'd rather ask a damn stranger than beg your sorry ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, we're as close as they come — you won't even share your salary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Salary's kinda personal — I'd rather keep it private.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, what's there to hide between us? Feels like you're keeping me at arm's length.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not keeping distance — just don't see why salary matters...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. If you don't wanna talk about it, forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Glad we're on the same page. Dinner's on me next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind if I borrow the drone? I want to film a bungee jump.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bungee jumping is pretty risky; the equipment could get damaged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. So, what's the deposit for renting it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's set it at 5000 yuan, and we just need to sign an agreement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll cover any damages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, bring the agreement tomorrow and come see me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll buy you a meal after I'm done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing. Stay safe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The renovation might take a few extra days. You know how it is with these projects, neighbor. Would you mind cutting us some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But didn't we agree no construction at noon? Won't this disturb everyone's rest?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a bit tricky, but we'll push hard to wrap it up quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's acceptable, I suppose—but timing needs watching after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rest assured, we'll definitely keep the noise down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then. Hope you finish up soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! We'll treat you all to dinner when it's done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, can I ask you a favor? Could you help my son get an opportunity at your company's school? Maybe pull some strings?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, that's a bit tricky. Using connections could be risky. I'll need to consider it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, just asking. It's fine if not, whatever works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to figure something out, but don't get your hopes up too much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, thanks then. Do let me know if there's any update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll reach out to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll wait for your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit, you're late again? The kid's going nuts waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My bad, got stuck in traffic. Be right there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Traffic my ass! You pull this every time—so damn irresponsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It wasn't intentional, alright? Quit nagging already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hell no! Look how starved the kid is—pathetic parenting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic beats your screeching any day. Fine, I'm taking the kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Next time don't ask me for help—bloody nuisance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, where are you at? Need to discuss something with you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just got home, what's up? Shoot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got my eye on a car but the paperwork's messy. Wanted to borrow your name for registration - help me out, bro?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's pretty risky though. What if something goes wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get your concern, no worries if it doesn't work for you. I'll figure something else out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lemme think it over and give you a definite answer in a couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cool, don't stress about it. If not, I'll check with others.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll get back to you by Friday latest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Son, you're sneezing nonstop—don't you think keeping the dog indoors is the problem?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, allergy meds will fix it—quit dragging the dog into this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Liu's kid bounced with health after they rehomed their dog. What parent wouldn't want that for their child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Walking the dog counts as exercise—it's not half as bad as you claim.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mom wakes up nightly! Both are our flesh and blood—must you chase selfish pleasure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just... weighing options here...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandparents are moving in—their health matters. Shouldn't we juniors be more considerate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll see about finding it a home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, we're thinking of skipping the wedding and just having a destination marriage instead. It's more straightforward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely not! Traditional rites must be honored – showing filial devotion means following ancestral customs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why must we hold one? Wouldn't a simple, hassle-free approach be better?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is our family obligation. The elders are counting on it – you ought to recognize this duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Recognize what? Traditions aren't always right.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family rules are non-negotiable. Filial piety demands a proper ceremony – how else can we face our forebears?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you save me a front-row seat tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might not make it in time, ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this what friends are supposed to do? How can you be this inconsiderate?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely have prior commitments, don't do this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends help each other—it's fundamental morality. You have to agree.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my birthday party's gotta be at your place – your living room's huge enough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? I'd need to check with my parents first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your parents ain't worth shit! Real bros help out, got it? Can't even show basic loyalty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! You owe me gratitude, understand? Or you forgot how I covered for you cheating last time? Do this or we're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't be like this... I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Make sure you clear out the living room by then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, how come you haven't been posting on Moments lately? Work keeping you swamped?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, just not really feeling like posting these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know I opened that bubble tea shop—I remember how you love bubble tea best. You were the first person I thought of on opening day!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But it's kinda tricky for me to post that sort of thing on Moments right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: (Sigh) Was just chatting with Xiaoming about you yesterday, reminiscing about those good times we had sharing bubble tea back in the day. Would be amazing if you could help spread the word.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... I see.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on my old classmate! Sending you the photos—you'll definitely make them look great!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... guess I could give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, I'm begging you to write me a recommendation letter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've been working hard lately, kid, but your skills still need more polishing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll regret this for the rest of my life if it falls through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must proactively report your progress more often - how else could I confidently write it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my schedule's completely packed right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can I believe you're serious about this if you won't even make time for it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Niu Niu's pushing herself way too hard with studying, burning the midnight oil every single night. Shouldn't we elders feel for the poor child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my mortgage isn't paid off yet, and things are stretched thin.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our neighbor Lao Li sold everything but the kitchen sink to hire his son a tutor. With Niu Niu being so bright, shouldn't our family at least chip in? We'd be crushing her spirit otherwise, wouldn't we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't free up any cash right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your own daughter's striving like this, who's supposed to back her up if not her parents? And who's she meant to resent if she bombs the exam?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, we'll figure it out down the road.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our in-laws are counting on us to be generous with the gift. We can't afford an embarrassment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The most I can scrape together is 5,000. My year-end bonus hasn't even been paid yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who could possibly present just 5,000 these days? We'd become a laughing stock among the younger generation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what amount would you suggest?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given our relationship, shouldn't we at least make it look respectable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll manage 8,000 if I absolutely must.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, can I borrow your drone for a few days? Want to shoot some bungee jumping footage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't bungee jumping too risky? What if the equipment gets damaged?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're blood, man. Remember when you hit rock bottom? Didn't the whole family rally behind you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But extreme sports come with serious risks...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think about who stayed overnight at Uncle's hospital bedside? Backing out when family needs help now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... just be extra careful when using it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what family's about. I'll pick it up tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah. Make sure you get insurance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what's your exact salary? Just spit it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd rather not discuss that. How about we switch topics?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you playing dumb for? Hiding such a trivial matter, how miserly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell does my frugality have to do with you? Mind your own damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! With your cheap-skate ways, no wonder you're stuck like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bugger off! Ask the boss about wages, don't be a fool here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, you can't be a total shirker when the family opens this shop! Mom and Dad are counting on us both to pull our weight—how could you hide away seeking leisure? That's just irresponsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, my job's slammed—I'm working nonstop, pulling overtime every night lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you realize how heartbroken this makes Mom and Dad? They sank their entire retirement savings into this shop! Do you think it's right to ditch them now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I know it's tough for them, but I genuinely can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't even care about family matters, what will outsiders think? We're the only ones holding this family up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll squeeze in time to come by, but I absolutely can't promise to show up daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your kid had a fever, I pulled an all-nighter babysitting! Now you absolutely must pick up my daughter—I'm completely swamped!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't make it—my kid's got piano class this afternoon. Latecomers can't even enter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you be like this? Last time I didn't even tend to my own kid! Now you won't even help with this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We put down a three-thousand-yuan deposit for piano lessons. Skip it and the money's gone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal about skipping once? I might even lose my job over this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, I'll reschedule the lesson and pick up your girl first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. At least last time wasn't wasted on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me with a bank transfer when you have time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm working late today, would it be possible to handle it tomorrow instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush, just whenever works for you. I've left the materials on the desk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll squeeze it in during my lunch break.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If the line's too long, another day is totally fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll bring my phone to handle work while waiting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! I'll make it up to you with some homemade soup later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all! I'll head back to work for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign up if you can work overtime tomorrow - the whole team needs to push sales numbers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fucking overtime again? I've been grinding three weeks straight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't come if you don't fucking want to! If this project tanks, we'll just cut pay and get fired!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All you fucking know is exploitation! Why don't you pull an all-nighter yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking moron! Kiss your year-end bonus goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dock it then! I'm fucking done putting up with this shitshow team!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come for the weekend shoot! Skipping it means you're dragging the whole team down!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I have family obligations – I requested leave in advance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always something with you? Others manage just fine, only you're being difficult! Zero sense of responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mom's hospitalized and I need to care for her, I really can't...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit excuses! You wanna take full blame if this project tanks? Don't you know what being a team player means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you be reasonable? We need to discuss this properly...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No discussion! Skip this and you're a selfish prick – kiss your place in this team goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll come. You happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, since my new store just opened, why not take some promo shots for me? Free of charge, obviously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's booked solid right now, honestly can't squeeze anything in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been friends for over a decade and you're telling me you're 'busy'? Don't you think that's incredibly selfish?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Commercial shoots require payment though, my equipment costs alone...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! With your dinky skills, you think I'm begging you? Real friends help out for free, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with you being so unreasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be here Saturday at 10 AM sharp. If you don't show, we're done. You spineless jerk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whatever you say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, my child is about to start middle school. You work at a school and know a lot of people—I was hoping you could check out the admission details for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nowadays, admissions are all handled through official websites. It might not be right for me to step in directly, as it could lead to issues with regulations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fair enough. I'm just a bit anxious about my child missing good opportunities. Sis, do you think sticking to the standard process would work out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Actually, with your child's grades, just apply as per the selection system—no need to rely on favors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hearing that really puts my mind at ease. And my child is quite diligent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm, if your child struggles with anything, I'll try to help with tutoring. Rest assured.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's so kind of you, sis. Thanks for going out of your way!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The paper revisions won't get done in time - you need to take over immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I don't have time to cater to your bullshit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you taking this over or not? If not, I'll submit blank pages right now - we'll both look terrible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead! Let's see who gets embarrassed more, you fucking trash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'm noting this attitude. We'll settle this during the annual performance review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Give me all the bad reviews you want! See whether the department head believes you or me, dumbass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're walking on thin ice here - whoever cracks first will see who's really doomed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help set up the exhibition? You're good at design.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might not have time due to project deadlines.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand. How about paying you? The budget is tight though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this? I'll do the basic design for free. That's fair, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! When you move next month, I'll arrange help for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's nothing. I'll send you the files on Sunday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure it doesn't delay your important work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I've got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're over thirty and still not married? How can you face your parents after all they've sacrificed for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just started my career and want to establish stability first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Staying single is filial disrespect - the whole neighborhood's laughing at us!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I decide about my own life?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You think you have a choice? If you're still single next year, don't even think about coming home for Spring Festival!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that completely tyrannical of you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've utterly disgraced me! Did I raise you all these years just to breed an ungrateful viper?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After we're married, I must be in charge of the money. That's what true commitment to the family looks like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I manage mine just fine. Why shouldn't I be allowed to make my own decisions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly cared about this family, you'd hand it over. What's mine is yours, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. But don't be too stingy with my allowance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, small stuff is up to you. For big expenses, trusting me is the responsible move, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you handle it. Less hassle for me anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's being sensible! A family needs to pull together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, do you want these old clothes? If not, I'll just get rid of them rather than letting them go to waste.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I don't really need them right now. You can dispose of them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll find a place to recycle them later. Good to reuse resources.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, being eco-friendly is good. It's entirely up to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll start sorting them out. I'll ask if you need anything next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll head off now. Take care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So it's happened, what do you plan to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you fucking ask? I'll call the cops, see if I don't!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, is it necessary? I only touched you a few times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell do you call a few times? Look at this bruise!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, suit yourself. Love it or leave it—after divorce, see who'd want trash like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, with work pressure being high, a bit of physical contact is normal among colleagues. You should be more understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, isn't this physical harassment unreasonable? I think we should avoid it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't fuss over such a minor issue. In the workplace you need to cooperate with the team, otherwise you're being irresponsible to the team, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I really don't think this approach is proper. How do you plan to address it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just endure it and it'll pass. This is professional ethics—you should prioritize the bigger picture.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but I'm still concerned. Couldn't this lead to problems?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need to worry, everyone does this. You ought to learn to adapt—it's crucial for workplace harmony.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try my best, but I maintain my objections.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you try to grab Jay Chou tickets for me tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try, but I need to get my own tickets too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, if it's convenient, could you try getting one for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, but tickets are insanely hard to snag.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just trying is fine. No pressure if you can't get it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll focus on mine first, and help you if any extras are available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: OK, thanks! Let me know the result.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll tell you after I finish grabbing them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, the shop just got this new wellness tea – tastes pretty good. Wanna give it a try? Oh, and by the way, could you post the new product info on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been posting ads quite a bit recently on my Moments, kinda worried people might find it annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The shop rent's been really tight this month, so I'm hoping to reach more people with our new stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what's the main benefit of this tea?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's great for digestion, and we use quality ingredients. Why not try it first? If you like it, you could share your thoughts later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheers, sis! Just mention how it tastes casually if you write a review, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should call Mom right away; she hasn't been eating properly these past two days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of project review—can't you keep her company for a while?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Elderly folks just love hearing your voice, remember how well you cheered her up last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? It's always me—aren't you her child too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you know you're her favorite? This is exactly when you should step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine—I'll squeeze in a call when I get a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard Meituan coupons are amazing. You got membership? Wanna share an order?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I prefer using membership solo. Sharing might be tricky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: C'mon, everyone's sharing orders these days. With our friendship level, just try it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... I'm kinda concerned about usage limits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you treated me last time? I haven't forgotten. Friends should help each other, no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, just this once.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heh, thanks! Saved cash means I'll get you boba!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Sent you the code.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, your place is so tidy. But look at my leaking roof - bedding's soaked through, shivered all night.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my daughter's prepping for college exams, rooms crammed with workbooks, tiptoeing around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your elder was hospitalized? I pulled three all-nighters watching over them. Now I'm in trouble, neighbors should help out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe camp in my storage room? There's an old sofa there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brought brain-boosting milk for your girl. After decades as neighbors, you won't just watch me drown, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Kid's taking practice exams these days - even a dropped pin's too loud.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll bed down silently! You'd make me sleep under a bridge?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... balcony space then. Four days max - exams can't wait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come bungee jumping this weekend - no backing out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me the agony, my legs turn to jelly just thinking about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of friend chickens out like this? You ought to push your limits!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit joking around, I'm seriously not built for this stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've dodged every single invite - that really stings our friendship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine fine, I'll give it a shot already - happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, don't go blabbing about your family's diabetes history everywhere – how stupid can you be!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! I'll say what I want, who do you think you are? Psycho!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're unbelievable! What's the point of shouting it out? Did a door crush your brain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your brain's the crushed one! I'll talk if I want, got a problem? Beat it if you can't stand it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Have it your way, don't come whining to me when it backfires, idiot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save your advice! Who made you the boss? Quit acting high and mighty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Do as you please, see if I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, Uncle Zhang and the others are all taking this protein powder—I bought it specially for you. You should really keep up with them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good grief, wasting money again! Nothing works on my constitution anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle Zhang used to be even weaker than you, now he climbs stairs without panting. If you don't take this, we'll be terribly anxious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anxious about what? I'm perfectly fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can we children feel at ease when you're this stubborn? Just do this to ease our minds.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, I'll drink it already! Honestly, you're impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, if you see Li, tell him to haul ass to the 4th floor meeting. Boss Zhang's been waiting ages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My damn printer's jammed, can't deal with this shit right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck's wrong with your legs? It's two steps - you gonna die walkin'?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit bustin' my balls! Lemme stuff these goddamn papers first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, not my circus. If he screws up, Zhang'll skin him alive anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jesus, you wanna kill me? Fine, I'm goin' now, happy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck's sake, shoulda moved your ass earlier instead of draggin' like a snail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhou's daughter is looking for a partner. Perhaps you have some connections to set them up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do know a few single young men, but I'm concerned they might not be well-matched.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's worth a try. Succeeding counts as doing a good deed, and there's no harm if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll find an opportunity to ask both parties how they feel?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, the girl has good qualities. The chances of a good match seem quite possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's get this straight first—don't blame me regardless of whether it works out or not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry. Just think of it as giving the young people an extra opportunity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom has a follow-up appointment at the hospital tomorrow morning. Can you spare some time to accompany her? I'm swamped with work these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a client meeting tomorrow morning and can't break free. Could I come over in the afternoon instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The appointment only takes two hours in the morning—you'd be done by noon. Mom mentioned how smooth it was when you drove her yourself last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What about switching to Wednesday? Mom doesn't absolutely need to go tomorrow, right? I'm available on Wednesday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hospital set the appointment time, so it can't be rescheduled. I'm stuck with an afternoon meeting and truly can't swap it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll juggle my client meeting schedule, though I'll head over a bit later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks a lot. Mom brought up last time how patient you are with her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey! 110? The mahjong parlor downstairs is unbearably loud! Send someone immediately!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please provide the exact location; we need it for the record.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's so complicated? Building 2, XX Community! Can't you move any faster? Quit dilly-dallying!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, we'll dispatch officers to verify shortly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Soon? Don't give me that hot air! I'm waiting—this racket is splitting my head! Unacceptable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The officers are en route. Please keep your line open for updates.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Handle it yourselves! If it's not fixed, I'll just keep calling to complain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you receive a package for me? Ship it to your place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? To my place? Not really, that'd be super inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, can't even do such a small favor? What kind of friend are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you freaking kidding me? Why the hell should I help you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piece of shit! Forget I asked!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Don't bother me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, how's it going lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Same old, same old. Just spit it out if you've got something to say.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's cough is getting pretty rough. If you've got any free time, you really should spend more time with her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My project's super tight right now—I genuinely don't have the time lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's always just zoning out on the couch these days. It's really painful to watch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm anxious about it too, but I'm stuck here and can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you find some time, go check on her. Even just having a chat with her would be nice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to squeeze some time to swing by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elevator's been broken for seven days now. Have you even tried to help the elderly struggling up six flights of stairs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a nationwide parts shortage. We're urging the manufacturer daily.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other complexes fixed theirs in three days. What's the hold-up here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Circumstances differ. The manufacturer's inventory hit rock bottom this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you ensure basic facilities? Who takes liability if an elderly person falls?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're equally concerned. Repairs will be prioritized once parts arrive.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You promised to care for seniors when collecting fees. Now we see nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Expedited processing is underway. Please bear with us a couple more days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ming, hurry up and get ready for your extracurricular class!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma, I don't want to go. I'm exhausted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so inconsiderate? Do you think your parents earn every single penny easily? Don't waste all their efforts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm really sleepy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You lazy bum! Want to live off your parents forever without learning any skills?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma, you're scolding me again...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Skipping it proves you've got no conscience. Get moving now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, Uncle Wang has been taking these calcium pills and says his legs feel much better. I brought you two bottles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why did you buy this? My old bones can manage just fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how energetic Uncle Wang is now when he takes walks—we should take care of our health too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You young folks don't make money easily. Don't always worry about this old bone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it all about hoping you stay healthy so we, as your children, can feel at ease?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you guys... well, just leave it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buying a house is a huge deal—you should use Agent Li. Dealing with acquaintances feels more secure; others really aren't reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already scheduled with an agent. Haven't dealt with Agent Li, not keen on switching.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That won't do. All the elders in the family vouch for him. Your parents lost sleep over this for nights—don't make them feel unappreciated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've paid the deposit. Switching agents now is such a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so inconsiderate? The whole family's pulling strings for you—Agent Li even offered a commission discount! Is this how you repay the kindness?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll check with him. But don't count on me committing to use him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You look like a wilted vegetable. What happened?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got laid off... can't breathe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Was it easy for your parents to put you through school? Hiding this makes you wolf-hearted dog-lunged!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Afraid they'd worry themselves sick...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly care, confess NOW! What kind of filial son keeps it under wraps?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... just can't bring myself to say it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I video-called my folks THE DAY I got axed last month! This is how decent people act!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Got it. I'll call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, let's just sign the prenup, don't you think it'll give us peace of mind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But all your clauses favor your family—how's that fair to me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Li and her husband signed one, and their relationship improved! Why should we be any different?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I get the short end of the stick? This makes me uneasy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly cared about our future, would you nitpick like this? Would I ever do you wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You keep saying that, but how is signing papers related to trust?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is for our long-term stability! Signing it lifts a burden!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Chen, would it be convenient to grab me a milk tea when you head downstairs? I noticed you're going out anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sister Li, I've got urgent bank matters to handle – afraid I won't make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, in that case I'll just order delivery myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The bank closes at four sharp, and I'm racing against the clock here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, focus on your important errands first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll head off then, we'll figure it out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead, I've got this covered on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt needs to register for her follow-up appointment. Could you help queue up tomorrow morning?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tomorrow? Why didn't you mention it earlier? I've got a client meeting scheduled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about after you finish? We just need to secure a spot before 10.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The meeting will run till noon. Maybe ask our cousin?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's on a business trip... Forget it, I'll just go if there's no other option.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't! I'll squeeze in some time. You should stay with Aunt.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, what's with the messages in the group? Everyone's freaking out here—couldn't you respond quicker?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My grandma suddenly has a fever, I need to take care of her. Is the proposal in trouble now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client's pushing for delivery overnight! Zhang can barely keep his eyes open—aren't you letting the team down? Nobody has it easy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But all the materials are on my office computer... It'll take me over an hour to get there now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Figure something out fast! We're all giving our all—if you drop the ball now, our whole effort goes to waste. How could you live with yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll get a cab to handle it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom said she's feeling worn out; how about you go with her to the checkup? You're the most thoughtful one, and she really enjoys your company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, the overtime at work is brutal; I just can't break free. Maybe have little sister handle it instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Wang, if it's convenient, could you buy me a ticket? You know the station well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I haven't been able to go lately, too busy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, won't even help with such a small favor? That's just plain heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All you do is complain! Got working legs, can't you go yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! Can't be bothered arguing. Don't expect my help ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Who'd want it anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, I'm three orders short of saving my skin—you've gotta help a brother out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this too risky right now? Risk controls are breathing down our necks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, Group Two already exceeded their target ages ago. If our group comes last, we'll kiss our quarterly bonuses goodbye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll figure out how to make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Time is ticking—this data's gotta be submitted tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll put in overtime tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! I owe you big time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Zhang next door, always jumping to do chores every day. What a sensible kid! You should take a page from his book.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's his good behavior got to do with me? I'm dead tired from work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've raised you for twenty years—can't even be bothered to help sweep the floor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't say I wouldn't do it. Why keep comparing me to others?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then clean the kitchen right now. With Mom and Dad's bad backs, how can you just stand by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, fine I get it! Quit harping on it already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it only natural for kids to show some filial respect? Yet you're still making excuses over such a small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all counting on you for the gathering tomorrow night, it wouldn't be right if you didn't come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been going through a rough patch lately, really not in the mood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All the old classmates are here, you're the missing piece.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't flatter me like that, seriously can't be bothered.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone came specifically to see you, standing us up wouldn't be cool.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Here we go again? I've had enough damn trouble lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, guess I'm just wasting my breath here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll treat you to dinner another time to make it up, really can't do today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These plants have been sitting here for over half a year—can't you even bother to check if they're alive or dead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped and dizzy with work—can't you just look after them a few more days for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd be happy to help, but you can't just dump everything on me, right? It's time you took some responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll find time to deal with them this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property management has warned us repeatedly—they say the balcony plants are bothering others. We've got to handle this ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That soon?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's getting cold—if we don't deal with them now, are we just going to let them all freeze to death?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elevator's been down for seven days! What if an elderly person falls on the stairs? Can you shoulder that responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been pressing for the parts multiple times, but the manufacturer simply can't supply them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How come every other building functions fine while we're stuck with this? The management never dragged their feet collecting fees!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This specific part is extremely scarce - there's a citywide shortage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seniors are trapped indoors starving! Does that sit right with your conscience? Find a solution now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're arranging alternative measures - meals will be delivered to elders tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only now you spring into action? Where was this urgency before? Are elders not human beings?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Expedited parts arrive tomorrow. We appreciate your patience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you work overtime tonight? The project timeline is quite tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid not—I need to care for a family member in the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could we adjust for tomorrow then? Or perhaps handle some tasks remotely?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Working remotely is possible, but I'd expect compensatory time off later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Comp time requires formal approval, but I'll advocate for your request.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood—I'll prioritize the urgent components now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, let's use your place for the team dinner this weekend. Your huge living room's wasted otherwise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That won't work - my family needs downtime this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck you mean by that? Colleagues ain't family? Refusing this tiny favor makes you human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You goddamn psycho! Who pays when shit gets wrecked?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Always your bullshit! No wonder you're office poison with that cheap-ass attitude!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the hell out! Beg someone else - my house ain't serving you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't you dare ask colleagues for shit later, you ungrateful snake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've got my draft ready. Would you mind taking a look when it's convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
