turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, the content could use more depth. Xiao Wang's team is getting positive feedback on their new approach—maybe draw some inspiration from them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the topic not innovative enough? Where specifically should I focus the revisions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: AI applications are trending now. With your solid foundation, why not give it a try? It'll benefit your future development.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I haven't explored much in this direction—it'll take time to get up to speed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No rush. How about we chat next week? We can identify entry points then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll prepare materials and come find you next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, when you get a moment, could you share my new store on your Moments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped lately, might not get around to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Supporting family is an obligation—isn't it inappropriate for you to refuse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My phone's acting up, makes it hard to operate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least save face for family—everyone else has shared it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to make time later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It must be posted by tomorrow night. That's basic family obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll remember.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you gotta change my schedule for next week—get it done pronto, no procrastinating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Changing plans last minute is super inconvenient. I'm up to my neck in work—cut me some slack, will ya?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, I'm a loyal customer—shouldn't you show some human decency? Or else who's gonna keep your business afloat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules aren't meant to be bent. Changes mess things up for everyone—let's not get too pushy here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't being accommodating the whole point of service? Rethink my request and at least do me this favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, got it. But let's stick to the rules to avoid chaos—we both need to cooperate, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, working 996 on this urgent project is your duty and obligation! What else can young people do if not striving?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've pulled three consecutive weeks of overtime. Whoever wants this 'privilege' can have it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of attitude is this? Devoting yourself to the company is the natural order! Selfish individuals go nowhere!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish? Me collapsing from overtime is selfish? You sure know how to spin pretty lies!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Show some fighting spirit! Quit if you won't comply – plenty would kill for this chance to contribute!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right, right. You're absolutely right. Ungrateful trash like me deserves the 996 grind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Wang, bail me out now! Only three orders left, and if you don't help, no one can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But won't we get in trouble for messing with this now? Getting caught would be disastrous.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If even senior staff won't back us up, our team's definitely hitting rock bottom. Do you want to kiss your bonus goodbye?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright alright, I'll figure something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: By 9 AM tomorrow at the latest! The whole team's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, crunch time it is.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See how painless that was? Finally knew better.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, I got fucking nowhere to crash tonight. Can I shack up at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is a total pigsty, spare yourself the trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Quit beating around the bush over such a small favor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously bad timing, my roommates are all here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Should've known you'd be this spineless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, but the answer's still no.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Selfish prick! I'll find someone with actual decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get my son's job sorted out, you hear me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This carries too much risk—I can't help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even handle such a small thing after all these years in the game!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the insults? I genuinely can't assist.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the holier-than-thou crap! Everyone knows you take bribes! Playing the saint while acting like a whore!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep this up and I'm hanging up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Worthless scumbag—don't you dare come begging at my door later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, moving this Saturday, got time to lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hell no! Can't you handle it yourself? Always bothering people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The fuck is wrong with you? Asking for a fight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who you cursing at? Useless piece of shit! Get away from me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't you dare ask for my help later. Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Who needs your help? Think you're special?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn idiot relatives! Moving out is my escape!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up! Sick of seeing your annoying ass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro Wang, my computer crashed, can you help me pay with your employee card?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If we get caught, it'll be a disaster; maybe you hold off for now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't forget, last time you worked late, I drove you home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is clearly against the rules, man...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't colleagues look out for each other? I even fixed the printer for you last time it broke.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... please don't let the manager find out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it! I'll cover the barbecue this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just this once, all right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: New faces always bring fresh energy to the group.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My apologies, my stomach condition is flaring up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just show some gesture at social occasions, won't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My doctor strictly advised complete alcohol abstinence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Newcomers should adapt to social settings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps I could offer you juice in place of a toast?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, just for formality's sake then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me pour you some juice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old friend, heard you're quite close with Mr. Zhang?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sort of, why? Is something up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My business hasn't been great lately, so I was hoping to meet Mr. Zhang to discuss a potential collaboration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really not convenient right now—Mr. Zhang is swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, it's fine, I'll just figure out a way on my own then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, as long as you understand how things are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, catch you next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I wanted to discuss the wedding red envelope—what's your budget looking like?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, things are tight at home—would 2000 be alright? The kids' tuition is due for school.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand, things are tight for everyone. Whatever works within your situation is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should I go with that for now? I can add more next month when things ease up after payday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, don't burden yourself. The thought truly counts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to help out early that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great! We'll definitely catch up over drinks then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm attending a wedding next month. Lend me your luxury watch, will you? Refusing means you look down on me - what kind of friend won't even do this basic favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That watch is pricey though. I'm worried about damaging it. Don't you have other options?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit about damaging it! You're being totally unreasonable. Won't even help a friend in need? You have to lend it to me - otherwise how dare you call yourself a true friend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on, I'm just concerned. Is this event really that crucial?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ridiculous! Why are you so calculating? I make one simple request and you keep dodging - refusing just proves you're selfish and petty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, take it. But for heaven's sake don't lose it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Ming, you're running late for the extracurricular class! Why are you dawdling?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma, I feel completely drained. I really don't want to go to class.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your mother works so hard to earn money for these classes, and you're just wasting it? How embarrassing would it be if people found out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finally showing some sense? Grab your bag and move it quick! Don't let the teacher think our child is unmotivated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't just 'oh' me! Get moving! The whole family is busy for your sake – you must not let everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely burnt out, pulling all-nighters every day, it's like I'm putting my life on the line.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who isn't exhausted? Xiao Liu couldn't even visit his hospitalized father - now that's real responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been three months already, surely this has to end sometime?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss just praised you yesterday for being our rock. Quitting now would be a total slap in his face! Who else can our team rely on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So I'm just supposed to be a pack mule? Is there no justice in this world!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one who can steer this ship. Walking away now would crush everyone's morale - how do you think that'll look during year-end reviews?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll try to manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, the project is literally on fire, how can you even think about taking leave? The whole team is pulling overtime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, this trip was planned ages ago and everything's already paid for...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Xiao Li didn't take leave when his father was hospitalized, yet you're being so leisurely? Don't you ever think about the team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my flight tickets are non-refundable... I'd lose a fortune.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this project goes down, can you afford that responsibility? Get back here now. We'll make it up to you with extra bonuses when it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess I'll cancel it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's meet and talk this out. Who can stand this state of our relationship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So now you're in a hurry? You seemed pretty laid-back before.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As friends, we should cut each other some slack. What's with the hiding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where were you when I was the one cutting you slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit being stubborn. Can't you let me make it up to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why drag others into this? Our situations aren't comparable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years of connection, just dropping it like this is downright heartless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I made some mistakes in my report. If the boss asks, could you not mention it? It's your call after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... covering it up doesn't seem quite right? I'd recommend you explain the situation proactively.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's indeed a tough spot. Just handle it as you see fit—won't pressure you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Taking initiative to admit fault might minimize the damage. Want me to help analyze it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but I still hope you won't bring it up proactively. Ultimately your decision to make.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll handle this with care. Try not to stress too much for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you do me a favor and pass along the documents to Manager Li?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'm a bit swamped right now, afraid I might forget.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries! Just mention it whenever you get a free moment, no rush at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I've got a meeting this afternoon. I'll see after that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alrighty, I'm really counting on you for this one. Appreciate it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll handle it when I have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Even later today works.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You didn't even come back for something as important as moving? Was all our love for nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely tied up right now; it's the final sprint for the project.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least Xiao Wang next door takes leave whenever there's family business. And you? We can't move this stuff ourselves, how can you just stand by and watch?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you just hire movers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Movers? Out of the question! If you're not here to pack things properly, who'll be accountable if stuff gets broken? How can you shirk such basic responsibilities as a son?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll see what I can figure out then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After raising you all these years, you're still dragging your feet over such a small thing as moving!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to swap shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard that fake divorce can help avoid taxes when buying a house. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That seems too risky. What if it accidentally becomes real?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this could save us hundreds of thousands, and it would give our kids better access to schools.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe we should look at other options? I'm really not comfortable with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just let me know your decision by month-end. Won't pressure you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll think it through and get back to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyone who can come in this weekend to push the project forward will get double comp time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! You think we're cattle to be worked to death?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Slackers can forget about promotion eligibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ha! Who wants your lousy position? We've seen your true colors!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't even think about clocking in late next month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see who gets reported for labor violations first!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, my shop just opened—you absolutely must share this on your Moments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been pulling overtime till 10 every night this week, just swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle straight up asked if you've got some grudge against me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My phone's such a brick it can't even load high-res images.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're literally the only relative who hasn't done it! How's it right for family to blow this off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll try posting from my computer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it right this second! Everyone else sent me proof—only you're missing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah yeah, on it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, you absolutely must help me with this data batch! I'm falling apart here, you know how rough my situation's been.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My hands are completely tied right now, projects are stacked mountain-high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you stand by watching me crash and burn? Isn't this where friends should have each other's backs? You won't even lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm drowning in deadlines too, cut me some slack will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how Lao Li jumped in without hesitation last time? That's what real friends do. And you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll carve out time somehow, but seriously don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a legend! Knew you'd never abandon a sinking ship - this friendship's worth its weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, the annual party desperately needs your camera to save the day—bring it over now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just bought this new camera and I'm terrified of dinging it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be this unreliable? We're supposed to be brothers, yet you bail when it counts!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely couldn't afford to replace it if it breaks...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling! The entire team's counting on you—Zhang offered his gear without hesitation while you're making excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. But for God's sake, handle it with extreme care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I borrow your calculus notes to copy? I'm totally stuck on this problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a sec, I need them right now myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last time you forgot your textbook? I let you use mine for the entire class without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh that time... yeah, I'd left my book in the dorm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you do me this favor? It's due before evening self-study ends.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but make it quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, where the hell has that bastard Xiao Ming been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the fuck's it to me? Can't you ask him yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, is it gonna kill you to give me a straight answer? Quit playing dumb!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking idiot! Go bother someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit, knew you were useless! Worthless piece of crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Psycho!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Stay the hell outta my sight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know Mr. Zhang, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, why?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just send me his WeChat contact now! Hurry up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That doesn't seem appropriate...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit dragging your ass! Can't even handle this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you talk like that...?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You useless waste! I'd get more help from a damn dog than you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ought to give up the property—I've taken on the bulk of caring for our parents. It's your duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's that got to do with me? I've done my filial duty too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you be so heartless? Mom and Dad are looking down from heaven!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop using them against me! You're the greedy one here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing means you're unfilial—the whole family will look down on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let them stare! I won't bow to this nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Math failed again? What's wrong with you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The problems were too hard, I tried my best...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tried your best? Nonsense! How can you be that dumb and still play with your phone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what should I do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! But if you fail to get into college, don't blame me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll figure out how to make it up myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need help moving. Are you free this Saturday?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way, you bastard! Handle your own shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Can't even lift a finger to help? How fucking pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not my fucking problem! Can't move it? Hire movers, dumbass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you fucking speak without being a total dick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with your broke ass! Get the fuck out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! I'll remember this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember my ass! Fuck off right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing you commute by bus every day looks exhausting—how about I give you a ride?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't trouble yourself, it'd take up your time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's on my way anyway—refusing would make me look stingy, wouldn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly worried about inconveniencing you, especially with your busy schedule...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how Xiao Li often gives colleagues rides—everyone praises his kindness. Aren't you being a bit ungrateful?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... alright then. Sorry for the trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Be here sharp at 7 tomorrow morning—no being late!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you cover a shift tomorrow? My colleague called in sick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got prior commitments tomorrow, so I can't.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really hope you'll reconsider—the team desperately needs you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I made the commitment first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a team member, it's your damn duty to step up. That's non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must rearrange your schedule—this affects everyone's interests.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The elevator's been broken for a week—you property management MUST fix it immediately. This concerns everyone's safety and CANNOT be delayed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Zhang, parts are out of stock till next week. We ask for your patience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Patience? UNACCEPTABLE! You're OBLIGATED to protect our rights—handle this TODAY—it's your DUTY!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please understand, without parts we're doing all we can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understanding goes BOTH ways! No repair? NO fees! That's FAIR, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fee payment is homeowners' duty; repairs await parts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then BLAME yourselves when we withhold payment! You MUST compensate our losses—NO dodging responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Compensation's unrealistic. Follow proper channels. Let's ALL be REASONABLE.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help me build a website? It's for my new store.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with project deadlines right now, might not be able to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just whenever you're free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Or how about I recommend a friend to help you with it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, send me their contact info.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've sent it to you. He specializes in this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll treat you to a meal sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm feeling awful. Shouldn't a good friend be here for me right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely drained. My mind is mush.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't talk to me, I'll definitely be up till 3 AM again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a major client meeting tomorrow morning. Seriously can't chat now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't even give me ten minutes? A friendship like ours deserves better than this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, you win. Talk fast.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you when it matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what have you been up to lately? Grandma keeps talking about you every day; she really misses you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project is really tight; I just can't spare any time right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandma always loved you most since childhood. Now she's old, and you won't even visit her? How can you be so cold-hearted!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to go; I genuinely can't manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at your cousin—his job is insanely busy, yet he visits Grandma every weekend. Why can't you do the same?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come this Saturday—Grandma's waiting, so no more excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'll try to squeeze in some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what do you want? Spit it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A big shot like you ought to help family out! Get my niece an internship—consider it your damn duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! I've got no time for other people's business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You selfish bastard! What kind of neighbor refuses to help? You must get her that internship, or you've got no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Why the hell should I be responsible for your niece?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Helping proves you're decent—refusing proves you're immoral. Can't even handle a simple internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, you're such a pain. I'll look into it, but no promises!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, why'd you park in my spot? Don't you know this is an assigned space?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't I park here temporarily? Why so inflexible? Don't you understand neighborly decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Anyone with common sense knows priority belongs to the owner. Move your car NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be this selfish? My elderly parent can barely walk! Young people nowadays show utter lack of decency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me the moral blackmail! Occupying others' resources isn't justified. Move within 3 minutes or face consequences!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bah! You cold-blooded thing! Don't expect neighborly help when YOUR family has troubles!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, you there? I'm feeling sick, could you grab me some meds?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I'm in the middle of a game, kinda inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, alright. If you're free later maybe you could help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, once I finish this round I'll check for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks pal! The pharmacy's right on the corner - just get fever reducers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll drop it off in half an hour.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it! I'll wait for your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, what are buddies for? Later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Little sis, you should reach out to Mom and properly apologize to her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? Why me? What about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You were too harsh yesterday. Mom was so upset she couldn't even eat. As children, when we cause our parents this much pain, we should step up and apologize. It's the bare minimum expected of any decent person, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who doesn't know that? Didn't you talk back too? Why do you think I'm the one who should apologize?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're her favorite daughter who she dotes on most. She's waiting for you to comfort her right now. Filial piety can't wait—you're best positioned to handle this, and frankly, it's your responsibility. Go now, don't keep her waiting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll go. But that doesn't mean I accept all the blame.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, I can't show up to the wedding without a decent watch and embarrass myself! Lend me that one you showed off last time to save face?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's brand new, I'd hate to see it scratched. Wouldn't dress cufflinks work just fine?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cufflinks?! What good are those! Would our friendship even mean anything if you couldn't help me with this? Remember when you moved last year? I ran around like crazy helping you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cough... it's just that weddings get crowded and messy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax! If it gets damaged, I'll pay. Talking money ruins the vibe between us, but friends gotta step up in times like this, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, fine... take it. Just... please be careful with it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, the agent says school district housing prices will jump next month. Shouldn't we at least check it out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These prices are insane. Maybe we should save up more first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li downstairs bit the bullet and bought last year - now his kid's thriving in the advanced program. See how well that turned out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But they're dual-income! Could our salaries even cover the mortgage payments?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about we just swing by this weekend for a peek? It's not like looking costs anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... we'll go look. But just looking, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, you simply have to pull strings for this internship—family obligations shouldn't be shirked, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But your major is completely irrelevant. Forcing this would be unfair to other interns.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You promised to look after us juniors back then. Prioritizing outsiders over family now? That's just unreasonable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't about obligation—company policies exist for a reason. Exceptions can't be made lightly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's too much trouble, forget it. Though the elders all know I came to you for help...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It is a tough situation... But since you put it that way—I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you wouldn't let family down! Maintaining face between relatives matters most after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be at the hospital by six tomorrow to grab Third Uncle's appointment slot. Got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? I need my damn sleep!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sleep my ass! Was Third Uncle's love wasted on a useless piece of shit like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Last time I helped you, not even a thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Don't expect my help down the road!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who d'you think you're scaring? Screw off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is this the police station? The mahjong game downstairs is unbearable! Are you officers just sitting around doing nothing? It's disturbing the elderly all night long!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please provide the exact location, we'll handle it immediately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Building 6! If you patrolled more proactively, would this even happen? Is our hard-earned tax money going to waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll increase patrols. Please specify the unit number now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Unit 2! Aren't you officers supposed to handle such matters proactively? What are we paying your salaries for?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Officers are being dispatched. Could you tell us the approximate floor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: First floor! If you don't come immediately, I'll file a complaint with the inspector—see if you'll still ignore this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, bringing back local specialties for the entire department is non-negotiable. It's the cardinal rule, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm afraid my luggage allowance won't suffice...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that all the responsibility you can muster? Where's your sense of team spirit? Not bringing them means you're not giving a damn about your colleagues!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try my best to manage...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just 'try'? Have some gratitude! Who covered your ass on the last project?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll definitely bring them...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make sure they're premium gift sets, not some cheap street stall junk! If you can't even handle this properly, you might as well get the hell out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yes, Boss. I will do exactly as you require.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The scores aren't improving this time; don't you think you should put in more effort?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I want to, but I just can't grasp the math problems—it's giving me a headache.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I help you go over the mistakes this weekend? We can take it step by step, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in classes and tackling problems every single day; I'm practically falling apart.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you buckle down now, it'll pay off later and be easier, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to squeeze in some time to catch up on math.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my kid's hospitalized with a high fever and my wife's frantic. Could I take three days off to care for them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave? The project's launching soon. Even Xiao Li toughed it out with a cold. How could you possibly leave and derail the whole team's work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's seriously ill—the doctor insists a parent stays. Didn't you leave early last time for your family matter? Let's not be hypocrites here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules. When Lao Chen's wife had surgery, he worked till dawn before leaving. Abandoning the project now—is that fair to everyone killing themselves?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll go to HR myself. Save you the trouble of always scolding me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave can be approved, but kiss your performance bonus goodbye. This project feeds us all. Is your personal issue worth sabotaging the team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're forcing me to abandon my sick child for work? This heartless approach is downright disheartening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work demands responsibility. When Xiao Wang's mom was hospitalized, he persevered. Learn from his tenacity instead of whining over this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you help watch my kid this Saturday? Something urgent came up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, I've got a work report to finish.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, work comes first. I'll ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about Sunday? I'm less busy that day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sunday works. Can you handle the homework tutoring?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can manage third-grade math. Don't blame me if I'm not great at teaching though!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll treat you to dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li's daughter isn't getting any younger. As neighbors, it's our bounden duty to lend a hand, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm truly swamped lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For neighbors to stand by doing nothing is utterly unconscionable. You've got an inescapable obligation here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me consider it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll bring matchmakers next week - that's your non-negotiable duty as a neighbor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to fit it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mark my words! The entire neighborhood's goodwill hangs on this affair.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you finished the low-income support documents?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet, I've been swamped lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so unreliable! Always dragging your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must you be so harsh?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you were capable, you'd have sorted the documents by now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just give me two more days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Such poor efficiency—unbelievable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll have them by Friday.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's urgent—draft a customer apology letter for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now. Can we do this later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't mentoring juniors your duty as a veteran? I went through the same damn grind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my schedule's packed solid—can't you cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Show some team spirit! Your refusal is tarnishing our department's reputation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This guilt-tripping is unfair—it implies I'm irresponsible for saying no.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly. Enduring hardship is what separates real professionals from failures.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. Email me the materials.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get over here now! My fur baby's got no one while I'm away, going to starve!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling ten-hour shifts all week, really tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't bail on me now! If anything happens to him, I'd never forgive myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're really backing me into a corner? This project deadline's non-negotiable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years, that counts for nothing? He's hanging by a thread waiting for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll slip out at lunch. Just this once!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! Key's under the mat, kibble's in the right kitchen cabinet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello? I've been waiting for half an hour. Is your customer service department dead or something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I sincerely apologize, sir. We're experiencing a high volume of inquiries right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! It's literally your job to be available 24/7. Do you even know what service means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We are doing our absolute best to handle it. Please bear with us a little longer...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bear with you my ass! You call this customer service without an ounce of responsibility? Fix my problem right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I am truly sorry. I'll escalate this for you immediately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough talk! An attitude like yours deserves to be reported. Handle it now, no delays!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It is being handled as we speak. You'll get a response very soon...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I heard your department is recruiting interns?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, but it requires a degree from a top-tier university.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your cousin may be from an average school, but he's incredibly diligent. You should really help him out with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the company policies are really strict...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't family more important than rules? Don't forget how I used to carry you to the hospital when you were little!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember... it's just really difficult for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No difficulty at all. Consider it repaying your elders. Have him start next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind keeping my dog for a few days? I've got a business trip next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your fucking mind? I'm swamped with my own shit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless piece of shit! Can't even handle such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take care of your damn dog yourself. Stop bothering me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful bastard! Last meal was on my dime, remember?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're hot shit for treating once? None of my damn business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Don't come crying to me for help later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost. You're blocked for good.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, you're responsible for Mom's check-up! Don't you know the eldest brother should act as a father? You ungrateful son stop pretending to be busy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Why the hell should it be me again? Who're you putting on this filial piety show for?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Has your conscience been eaten by dogs? Mom wasted her life raising you! Get this done by week's end or I'm cutting ties!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who're you to play saint? How many times have YOU taken Mom to the doctor? Selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough bullshit! Don't you know a child's basic duty? I'll see that payment slip by next week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! You're the perfect son aren't you? Just my fucking luck to have this family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've agreed earlier! Remember to snap the check-up report in the group chat - no half-assing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey sis, you should give that study spot to your brother; I need it more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why? I worked hard for it; why should I give it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a sister, you ought to put the family first and be more responsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is my own opportunity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't yield, I'll be disappointed—family duty comes before everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine then, I'll think about it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been exhausted lately. You must go with her for this checkup—you're her son after all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm swamped. Can't little sis take her instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom specifically wants you! Can't you just take half a day off? So ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... could you at least schedule it for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the son—handle your own responsibilities! Stop dumping everything on me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. I'll take Thursday off to take Mom.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. She didn't raise you for nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, what are you up to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My rented place suddenly sprang a leak. Any chance I could crash on your couch tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing, I've got my mother-in-law over right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I've been having such a streak of bad luck lately. Just need a quiet spot to catch my breath.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room's jam-packed with luggage, no space to spare.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll figure out something else then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The class reunion roster closes tomorrow—you're the only one left who hasn't confirmed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things have been hectic at home lately; I genuinely can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li still made it last month despite his father's hospitalization—we can't afford to drop the ball here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do appreciate everyone's kindness, but...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone has chipped in for the venue fees—if you skip this, won't our money go to waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll see if I can rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've missed three reunions straight—it really won't sit right if you bail this time too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: (Sigh) Alright... I'll try to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, go buy health supplements at the Renmin Road store.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's too far. My knees hurt and I can't walk that distance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You old good-for-nothing! All you do is lie around faking illness!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you talk like that? I'm genuinely in pain!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the excuses! Go or don't go—I couldn't care less!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Child, your words are truly heartless...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Don't come running to me next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, you absolutely have to come to the company team-building this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What event? I'm probably swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of attitude is that? Trying to dodge something this crucial? This is team obligation - don't you understand basic rules?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, I've got real commitments. Show some understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understanding my ass! You're just selfish! Not recruiting others shows zero responsibility - even the boss mandated full attendance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why're you being like this? My friends are genuinely busy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All excuses! Morally you must recruit people or you're sabotaging the team - you're utter trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll try. Just stop pestering me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did the results come out? You seem down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah... I didn't make the passing mark.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't blame yourself, you can try again next year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm torn about whether to start working.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think it through. Your parents will understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid to let them down...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever you choose, we support you. Want to go shopping this weekend to cheer you up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, thanks sis.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you have to raise my kid—that's your duty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I help raise your kid? I don't owe you anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so selfish! We're blood brothers—you're supposed to help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm barely scraping by myself; how could I possibly take on this responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must help, or you're just unfilial and dishonorable!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the moral blackmail—I've got my own struggles.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't care! If you refuse, I'm disowning you as my brother!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever you say—I can't do this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey colleague, what are you doing with your side hustle? Could you help me promote it for free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Promotion is too demanding; free help just isn't feasible. You should manage it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that how a friend acts? You won't even post it on your Moments? Seriously, would promoting it kill you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It wouldn't kill me, but forced promotion isn't happening. I'm choosing not to assist.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whether you're a real pal or not is up to you. I'll handle the promotion myself, but forget about me helping you out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough already! For promotion, find whoever you want; free help can just buzz off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish jerk! Fine, don't help then. I'll get someone else for the promotion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a lousy request! Handle the promotion yourself; dreaming of free help is ridiculous.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, Yuan Yuan's tuition is a bit short, could you lend us some? I'll pay you back next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just paid my mortgage...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's alright, no worries, I'll ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, times are tough for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, let me know if something comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you hear? The Zhangs' wedding banquet is next month. Come or not, totally your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why bother? I don't give a damn about these annoying affairs. Got better things to do!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell do you think you are? All you care about is money, can't even show basic decency. No wonder you'll die alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Stop dragging me into your family crap. Annoying as hell!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Like anyone's begging you to come. Too proud for your own good!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You psycho! Stop nagging! Get lost and leave me the hell alone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Can't be bothered arguing. Your loss if you skip it – saves me the trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough yapping. Hanging up now. Bye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you share that donation campaign on Moments? Just think of it as doing a good deed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What project? I'm a bit strapped for cash lately, so I might not be able to pitch in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need to donate, just reshare it—plenty of others have already done so.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... I'll take a look at the details first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's almost closing, so just do me this favor, it'll only take a second.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, it's just a quick tap anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Knew I could rely on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up! I left my passport in the office—go get it for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got my hands full with something urgent right now, really can't step away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I spent three nights nursing you in the hospital last time! Now you won't even lift a finger for this? For heaven's sake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about tomorrow morning? Promise it won't mess up your plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The plane'll be gone by tomorrow morning! Isn't this what friends do—help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the timing's impossibly tight...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit stalling! I'll treat you to a feast another day. You're the only one who can handle this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll make a run for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you seen Manager Li's medical report? Any issues?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not very convenient to discuss this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, understood. Could you at least give a general idea?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perhaps it's best we don't discuss this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll stop asking for specifics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, thanks for understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, as a core member, you absolutely must attend the weekend cleanup event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my mother-in-law is visiting the kids this weekend, I genuinely can't make it...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Lin and the other newcomers are counting on you to lead by example. You can't drop the ball as a role model!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given the situation... family commitments really prevent me from leaving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone nominated you as a model worker last appraisal. Group activities demand accountability too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to rearrange family schedules then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew we could count on you! The department relies on veterans like you to maintain standards!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, translate this business document for me for free—it's not like your skills are anything special anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professional translation is paid work, and I'm swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the act! You're treating that mediocre skill of yours like gold?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even my worst work beats freeloading—do it yourself if you're so skilled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That desperate for cash? Scamming your own classmates?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still better than shameless moochers like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You stingy cheapskate! No wonder nobody hires you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Find some sucker to serve you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom's been complaining about exhaustion lately. How about you take her to the physical? You're the one who knows her situation best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm slammed with a project deadline this week and can't break free. Could sis go with her instead? She's closer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom does prefer your company, but if you're tied up, it can't be helped. She can manage on her own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind checking the schedule? I'll carve out some time next week to take her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I could inquire, but you'd better sort out the timing. Old folks really mind this stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then Thursday it is—I'll take a half-day off to accompany Mom.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, Mom'll be over the moon hearing that. Thanks a bunch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get the package at the door now! Waiting for it to grow mold?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the rush? I just got chewed out by the boss. Can I catch my breath for a sec?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you bought durian, I hauled it back for you under the blazing sun. How can you live with yourself after all I did?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bringing that up again? Can we just drop it already?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you still consider me a friend, go get it right now! Can't even count on you for such a small thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, you win. Nagging me to death over it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See? Was that so hard? Isn't that what friends do – look out for each other? Don't you know the basics?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right. Fetching a package somehow makes me a moral paragon now. Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My stomach's killing me. Could you grab me some food?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't make it. Just order delivery yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how late I stayed with you when you worked overtime last time? And now you're giving me the runaround over bringing a meal?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Today's different—I'm rushing to finish this report.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends should look out for each other, right? I'm literally doubled over in pain here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... What do you wanna eat?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could've been like this from the start. Being petty like this isn't what friends do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, lend me your car tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really convenient, I need it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you're such an ungrateful bastard! Forgetting all I did for you last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jesus, moral blackmail much? Go find someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Backstabber! Heartless piece of shit. Pathetic excuse for a human.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go fuck yourself! I ain't lending shit to an asshole like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Don't you fucking come crawling to me next time you need help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my car got impounded. Could you help me pay the fine every afternoon this week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you crazy? I'm pulling all-nighters every day this week for the bidding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't want to help, just say it! Making a fuss over such a trifling matter—you're heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not get a designated driver? I genuinely don't have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, raising you is worse than keeping a dog! Like it or not, we go our separate ways from now on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why don't you pester someone else? If I quit, will you foot my bills?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scram! Just act like I never had kin like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We should distribute the supplies right now; everyone's counting on your help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm dealing with other things and might not have enough time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone must do their part; if you don't go, it won't get done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work today; can I lend a hand later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This affects team fairness; you need to cooperate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze in some time to go.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it; you can't shirk shared responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll go check the supplies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the paper revised ASAP, I must have it by tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got multiple deadlines piling up, could I have a bit more time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang pulled an all-nighter to finish his edits. You're not slower than him, are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These content adjustments genuinely take time and effort.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I expect the most from you. Don't let us down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll start working on it right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely must send it to me before 8 PM. The whole team's waiting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at you! Too scared to have a second kid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Can't you handle your own crappy stuff?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pathetic! Will having a kid kill you? I had three and I'm still kicking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! Your nonsense is outdated—broke as hell but still putting on airs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't expect us to help with childcare ever again, you good-for-nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Who wants your help? Stop causing trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I saved a few nice pieces especially for you. Wanna come try them on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really no need, sis. I've got clothes to last years.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feel this fabric—top quality! Didn't even offer them to Xiao Wang, made a point to save 'em for you. Know you're too busy to shop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't they suit our younger cousins better?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family shouldn't stand on ceremony. Take them—it'd really make me happy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll take two for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you've got a Tencent Video subscription, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
