turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, been binge-watching lately. Need it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given our friendship, mind if I use it? Just catching a new show, promise I won't mess around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my account's linked to my bank card...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, I'll log out right after! Bubble tea's on me this weekend~

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, don't you dare change the password.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man, you're the best!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you pick up my package on your way? It's just at the community Cainiao station.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got dinner plans with someone today, can't swing by in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'd literally take five minutes. Last time I fetched your takeout in a torrential rainstorm—twice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Umm... maybe I'll grab it after dinner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's perishable inside—what a shame if it spoils. Shouldn't friends help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just text me the pickup code...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to check the packaging—we should do things properly, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, cousin. I've run into a bit of trouble lately. Could you lend me twenty thousand to help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm pretty strapped myself, under all this mortgage and car loan pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help your own blood cousin? Who was it that drove your mom to the hospital overnight back then? Have you no sense of gratitude at all?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The way you're putting it... if I had the money, would I really say no?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful wretch! If you won't lend it, then stay out of my house for good! Consider our family ties severed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'll scrape together five thousand for you. Just don't you ever bring up 'family obligation' again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, regarding the wedding gift money, how much do you think you could contribute? Any ballpark figure in mind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, Lao Li, things are pretty tight financially right now. I might only be able to offer a token amount, around a thousand. Hope you don't mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... I see. I kinda thought you'd be able to help out a bit more, given our relationship. Guess I was expecting too much. A little disappointed here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I get you're disappointed. But I'm truly doing my best. The gift amount doesn't necessarily equate to the sentiment, right? My presence and genuine blessing are what matter most, aren't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... there's some truth to what you're saying. It's just that a larger amount feels more face-saving, makes the occasion look better, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saving face is important, sure, but why strain yourself just for appearances? This is what I can manage. It's up to you, and I won't insist either way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then... a thousand it is. The gift is about the thought, and the amount is your choice – I respect that. Still can't help feeling a bit disappointed though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I'm having a business promo event this Sunday – you absolutely gotta show up and back me up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? I actually can't make it, got prior commitments. Sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Supporting each other is a friend's fucking duty – don't you get that? Are you brain-dead or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're way too toxic with your words. Can't I have my own damn schedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! Real friends show up – that's the whole point! You're just being selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, whatever, I'll go! But quit pressuring people like this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call a real friend! And don't forget to tell the others they'd better show up too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come to the gathering tomorrow night! Everyone's counting on you to liven things up. It'd be so disappointing if you missed it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been pulling insane overtime lately, I'm just dead tired.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This whole party was basically set up for you! Wouldn't all our efforts go to waste if you don't show?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I honestly can't push through. You guys have fun without me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all the trouble we went through arranging this, this is your attitude? How is that fair to everyone's effort?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please, stop pressuring me, okay? I'm already run ragged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. Guess all my goodwill was wasted. Should've known it was pointless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll treat you all to dinner in a couple days. Seriously, I'm hitting my limit today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Zhang, all the parents are installing those baby monitors nowadays, shouldn't we hurry up and get one too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would the child really feel comfortable with it always on? I'm thinking it might not be the best idea.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being parents these days is so challenging - how can we feel secure without proper supervision? Just last week there was news about kids getting hurt home alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but don't older children deserve some freedom?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, even Teacher Li's family in our complex installed one. Surely someone as family-oriented as you would prioritize the child's safety?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... when should we arrange this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The sooner the better - it's all for the child's wellbeing after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, my shop's been having cash flow issues lately. Could you lend me ten grand to tide me over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With all the hospital bills for our elderly folks this year, I'm really strapped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, if things are that tight for you, no worries—I'll try hitting up someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe check with Wang Qiang? He's been sitting prettier financially these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it—I'll take you out for a proper meal once I get back on my feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't sweat it, that's what mates are for. Wishing you the best!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, got a sec? Family emergency next week - need you to cover my workload ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave? Are you fucking kidding me? I'm buried in overtime while you slack off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop whining! Just cover a few goddamn days! Not like you're doing it for free! Useless bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I'm about to get fired myself! Handle your own shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Remember this when you come crawling to me next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crawl to you? Go to hell! Sick of seeing your face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll pay for this! Mark my words!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you be available to care for my dog next week? I'll be traveling for work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been working a lot of overtime lately, worried I might not give proper care.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understand, I'll make other arrangements then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe ask Xiao Wang? He's quite fond of dogs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could work, but if you're free this weekend perhaps check on him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should be available Saturday afternoon to take him for walks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! I'll leave dog food in your mailbox.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, just WeChat me if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, I'm thinking of blocking Xiao Wang's Moments, what do you think? He's always posting ads.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I hadn't noticed. Just go ahead and set it up if you want.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I'm worried about affecting our relationship. Do you think I should block him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He does post quite a bit, actually. Blocking or grouping him is entirely your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go ahead and block him then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, let me know once it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All set. It'll be quieter from now on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's good to hear.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hotel must be under 200 yuan. We all have to practice frugality during the company's difficult times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But budget hotels are too far out. What if we're late rushing in the early morning?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even endure this bit of hardship? Back in my day, we did business without hot showers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm concerned clients will see us staying in the boonies and doubt our capability to partner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real professionalism needs no showboating! Thrift is our obligation – your mindset is flawed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I pay extra to stay downtown myself? The roach-infested suburbs ruin my sleep.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Special treatment, huh? Everyone suffers but you get a pass? Follow the damn arrangement!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work overtime tonight, no excuses allowed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have a parent-teacher conference at my kid's school, absolutely can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who gives a damn? You wanna tank the project? Worthless idiot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least pay overtime? Last time you...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep yapping and you're fired! Replacements are a dime a dozen!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck it! I'll do it! Bloodsuckers like you always get theirs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Zhang, everyone's looking forward to seeing you at the gatherings next week. Could you join us for the fun?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, Friday's packed for me—might not make it with all the things going on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang and others are all coming. The group just wants to get together and have a good time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't spare the time—swamped with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's completely up to you, of course. But it's a rare chance for everyone to catch up—what matters most is enjoying ourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me see if I can free up some time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Great! Getting everyone together is all about having fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Wang, I heard you're heading to the station for tickets? With this scorching heat and exhausting queues, would you mind grabbing one for me while you're at it? I'll pay you back shortly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, no problem at all! My back's holding up fine - an extra ticket's no bother.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Much appreciated! I'll leave the money here now. Do take care not to overexert yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll take my time in line. I'll hand it to you when I'm back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're going, better head out early - avoid the hassle of heat and crowds.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'm off now. Just relax and wait, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You damn well better use Agent Li I recommended! Family connections are rock solid—don't go hiring fly-by-night strangers or you'll fucking deserve it when they screw you over!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of bullshit 'reliable' is that? I've already found my own agent—haven't even met this Li guy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell do you know?! Since when would family ever stab you in the back? Turning this down makes you an ungrateful bastard—is this how you repay your parents' blood-sweat savings?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How am I ungrateful? Just 'cause you recommended some agent means I owe you now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You clueless little shit! The whole family's breaking our backs for you—even negotiated your damn commission—and this is the attitude you give?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, have it your way! My money, my choice to waste—happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really want this internship opportunity. Everything's piling up lately, I'm so stressed out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need it too, gotta fight for it properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you were struggling before, I always helped you out, didn't I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You did help, but this opportunity thing...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's help each other out, that's what friendship's about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We should still compete fairly though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fairness is fairness, but isn't friendship more valuable than an internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, business is tough these days. You gotta lend me a hand, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, it's not that I don't wanna help, but this mortgage is killing me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your dad was hospitalized, I was running errands and bringing meals every single day. Now it's my turn, and you're backing out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember, man. But things are really tight right now. Can't squeeze out a single penny.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't even help with something this small? Does that even make us real brothers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh... how much at the very least would tide you over?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotta be five crates, right? Family should step up for each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I can manage three crates for now. Any more is really impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those bad reviews are so glaringly awful—got any tricks to help your buddy out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the product's genuinely subpar—wouldn't honesty be simpler?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pulling consecutive all-nighters is wrecking my liver—desperately need a lifeline here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't you worried about getting busted pulling this off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our last collab went smoothly—surely you owe your bro a solid this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's... completely unrelated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll legit have a breakdown if nobody lends a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine—let's just scrap the damn thing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, could you talk to the boss about my situation? I'm having a bit of trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why don't you go yourself? I've been pretty busy lately too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It just seems like you'd be more appropriate for this. Maybe you could consider it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, I get what you're saying, but this isn't an obligation—it depends on whether it's convenient for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, help if you feel you can. No pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what, I'll see how things go next week. Should be able to give it a try for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay then, thanks. We'll catch up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come to the company party with me Friday night—if you don't, I'll lose face in front of my colleagues. How can you not understand this basic spousal obligation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh! I'm not going! Those parties are painfully boring—cut this crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so selfish? Supporting each other is marriage 101! Refusing proves you don't respect family responsibilities!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Moral blackmail again? Can't I have any personal space? Disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being there for me is your duty! Stop being self-centered and immature!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Duty duty duty—enough already! You just want to show off!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, skip it. But don't expect my help with anything ever again—see how you manage!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go! But your hypocritical act makes me sick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's just drop the dowry! True love shouldn't involve material things! Don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What gives? Can't even afford this little dowry? Your family's way too selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish? Your family's the greedy ones! Who still clings to dowry nonsense these days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you know? Dowry's a must—it's our filial duty to parents! Stop pretending you get it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Forget it if you won't drop the dowry, gold digger!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it then! Someone like you clearly has no sincerity!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Ming, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Eh, not much. What's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thinking about scheduling checkups for Grandma and Grandpa. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Checkups again? You're always coming up with something! Stop making such a fuss!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with that attitude? Is health not important to you? How heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well if you're so capable, you do it! Don't just flap your gums!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Forget it. I'll handle it myself. Count on you? Dream on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind letting me borrow your lab report? This section has me completely lost.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I haven't finished compiling it yet. The data isn't even complete.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I pitched in to finish your part during last week's group project?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... that was just because we were really pressed for time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now I'm the one racing the clock. You wouldn't just leave me hanging, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, take it. Just make sure you tweak the data.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should really give up the inheritance; this property was never rightfully yours to begin with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Horseshit! The law clearly grants me my share.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing innocent—you're completely clueless about family affairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, suddenly you're the expert? You money-grubbing leech!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself—don't come crawling to me for help ever again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I'd want it! Consider us permanently done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, lend me your place for a few days, you hear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's gotten into you? Got no room!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Last week you said your study was empty, you tightwad!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even if it's empty, you ain't staying! You'll turn my place into a pigsty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Who wants it! Asking you was doing you a favor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't bother me with this crap again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cheapskate! No wonder you're stuck in this dump forever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Blocked!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, is now convenient? Got a tiny favor to ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, what's up? Shoot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need someone to vouch for my leave paperwork - boss requires it. Mind signing it real quick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Vouching? If anything backfires, not sure I can handle the fallout.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, usually just a signature. Totally cool if you're uncomfortable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, piece of cake. When should I sign?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Bubble tea's on me later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haha, no sweat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, how's the job search going? Your company is so solid, you've gotta hook me up with a referral!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The referral system's locked down tight now, might not be doable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm crazy jealous of you. Sent tons of resumes with radio silence – wouldn't ask if we weren't tight like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Legit can't swing it, it's tricky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I hear ya, but my folks grill me daily. If you bail on me, I'm screwed explaining this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh... fine, I'll see what I can ask around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and bring in the courier packages! Don't waste time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you rushing me to my grave? My head's splitting after that three-hour meeting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that ran those errands when you bought fruit online last time? Got convenient amnesia now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You've nagged about this a million times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you actually cared about our friendship, you'd hustle up. Don't make me feel unappreciated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There you go again... Fine, fine, I'm going.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've been like this from the start. What's wrong with cutting each other some slack between friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? You've turned fetching a package into some grand moral lesson.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, we absolutely must buy this school district apartment—my parents keep talking about how convenient it’ll be for the kids. Settle this ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our down payment’s falling way short, and the mortgage pressure would be crushing. Just can’t swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our parents just want what’s best for us—buying this will give us peace of mind. It’s worth paying extra rent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why do we have to get a school district place? Can’t we make do with our wedding home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else has upgraded to bigger homes—we can’t afford to fall behind. Figure this out now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I’m terrified of being crushed by mortgage payments… but I’ll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We absolutely must secure the down payment by month-end—my parents are looking forward to it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, does your company still have any internship openings?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're full. Why didn't you mention it sooner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the 'too busy' act! Is it really that hard to squeeze someone in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't. The boss keeps close tabs on hiring.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? And here I was praising how well you're doing at this multinational. Worthless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's really harsh...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Harsh? If you don't like my tone, then do something about it! Useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll check with other departments. Happy now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The delivery packages downstairs are piled up like a mountain. Do me a favor and bring them up when you come?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm stuck in the middle of something urgent. Can we do this in half an hour?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My fridge is completely empty! If the fresh food rots, you gonna compensate me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, my arthritis is flaring up. Going downstairs feels like torture right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's be mutually understanding here. Remember when I made two trips for your mom's pickled veggies last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Here we go again, bringing up past favors... Fine, fine. Let me put on my knee pads first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. Neighbors should help each other out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get the principle, but your nagging is making me anxious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about coming back home this weekend to see your parents? They're not getting any younger, so spending quality time matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload is overwhelming, and I can't take time off. It's really impossible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know how often the neighbors' kids visit home? Your parents would be so touched if you went.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can we talk after my project wraps up? Money's tight right now, and travel costs are too high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial piety shouldn't wait. Time won't stand still for anyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you mean? I video call them regularly! How does that make me unfilial?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They long to chat with you in person. Even if they don't say it, your presence would mean the world.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The registration for the Math Olympiad training class is closing soon. What do you think about signing up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I feel like I might struggle to keep up. Maybe let's skip it this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. But you'll have to wait half a year if you miss this chance. Perhaps reconsider?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... mainly because the tutoring fee is quite pricey. I'm concerned about the actual benefits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry about the cost. It really depends on whether you feel it would help - we'll sign up if you think it's worthwhile.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll give it a try for now. I can always withdraw if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. Be sure to complete the form today. Just ask if you need help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, what are you still doing there? My medical bills have been piling up lately - you need to cover them for me now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm really strapped for cash myself, can't possibly afford this expense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell's that? Won't even help family? Are you even human? This is your damn responsibility!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop cursing at me! I'm genuinely in a bind here, not refusing deliberately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit difficulties! You're paying these medical bills or you're an ungrateful bastard disgracing our family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. But I've got my own survival to worry about next time - stop pressuring me like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Survive my ass! Zero consideration for others. Get this handled immediately, don't waste my damn time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll sort it out now. But never again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li's hosting a gathering next month—you absolutely must come! Everyone's counting on you to liven things up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped here, genuinely can't spare the time. Such a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you skip it, how disappointed everyone would be! Makes you seem unsociable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could I arrive late? I'll try to squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still making excuses? That's hardly considerate—the party'll be flat without you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, fine. I'll shuffle things around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're absent, the whole gathering'll be lifeless. Do this for everyone's sake!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll come. Stop nagging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I had an affair; I'm truly sorry. I hope you can forgive me, but it's entirely your decision.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is really hard for me to accept, since I've trusted you for such a long time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My apology is sincere; whether you forgive me or not is fine—I'll respect it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With family and kids involved, I'm feeling overwhelmed right now and need some space to think.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not pressuring you at all; just handle this however you see fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Betrayal cuts deep, and I need time to sort through my feelings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I promise I'll change, but forgiving me is entirely your call—no obligation at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood; I'll give it some thought and get back to you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at that pathetic math score you got! It's a total disgrace! You're going to cram school immediately, no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the exam was really hard, and I did try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries! For charity work, it's the thought that counts. I'll treat you to breakfast tomorrow as thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! Always knew you were a champion for charity causes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, we're having some cash flow issues with that project. Could you possibly provide a temporary guarantee?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, the amount is quite substantial. I need to consider the risks involved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Completely understand. If it's too much trouble, no worries—I'll explore other options.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly due to recent policy tightening. It's really inconvenient for me to proceed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get it. You focus on your work—I'll check with Xiao Wang about the situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this. Wish I could help, but it's just not feasible right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all—business is business! Let's catch up over dinner sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Send me your ID photo! Need it for urgent registration!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What for? Not really comfortable sharing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the holdup? Scared I'll screw you over? Such a petty jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why so nasty? Can't you ask properly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, don't! Don't fucking come to me for anything later! Selfish jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Like I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, you know about my startup project, right? I really need you to do me a huge favor this time—go to the bank and sign as my guarantor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? A guarantor? That's way too risky! And I'm not exactly flush with cash right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell kind of attitude is that?! Are we even brothers? Think of all the times I've helped you in the past! You won't even do this one damn thing? That's just plain disloyal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not about being disloyal! It's just... if something happens to your end... I'd be ruined!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ruined my ass! If you're too damn cowardly to take this little risk, what kind of man are you? You ungrateful wretch! Are you telling me our decade-long friendship meant nothing? You HAVE to sign, no arguments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Sigh. You're really putting me in a tough spot here...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tough spot my ass! Real brothers go through hell for each other! Nine AM sharp, day after tomorrow, bank entrance. If you don't show, you're not human! It's settled!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, my mom's feeling quite lonely at home by herself. Could you go check on her when you have time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been swamped with overtime lately, not sure I can manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you moved last time? I looked after your kids for days without hesitation, didn't I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I haven't forgotten, but the project deadline's really pressing now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She'd be overjoyed to see you. Don't disappoint her by making her wait in vain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hearing you say that just makes me feel worse about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about squeezing in some time to visit her this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, we're short on people for the club event—you MUST come help out this week!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! With this selfish attitude, don't you dare expect our help with dorm issues later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll cancel my plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! People should understand gratitude and learn to contribute!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You haven't been looking well lately; it'd be best to squeeze in a doctor's visit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm swamped with this project—can I hold off until next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, your health matters most; don't overwork yourself. Just see how Xiao Wang manages to take good care of himself.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: A short delay for the check-up should be fine, right? I'm completely tied up at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, as long as you're on top of things. I'm just feeling a bit concerned.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rest assured, I'll get it done right after this busy spell.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, remember to bring your health insurance card along.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one who can handle this logo design job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been working overtime every day, I just can't take it anymore.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client specifically asked for your style. After all these years of friendship...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, alright. Looks like I'll have to pull two more all-nighters.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! I'll email you the materials tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time give me more heads-up, this is way too rushed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I knew my old classmate would come through!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you free to come home this weekend? We've been missing you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's keeping me swamped lately, might not be able to break away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should have some availability after the 10th next month, I'll look into tickets.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't push yourself if you're truly tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do my best to make arrangements, no need to worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, just handle it as you see fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You look awful and you're still dragging your feet? Get yourself to the hospital for a check-up, don't brush it off like it's nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's breathing down my neck. Can't I just go next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since when is your health negotiable? Remember how Lao Wang pushed himself until disaster struck? You're going today, no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, you're impossible. I'll squeeze in a quick trip then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. And don't forget your health insurance card.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: My parents sacrificed so much raising me—you must give them 2000 monthly for their retirement! That's the bare minimum duty of a child!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have you no conscience? Honoring parents is sacred! Refusing makes you morally bankrupt!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not helping makes you heartless scum! The whole neighborhood will brand you an unfilial monster!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah well, if you failed the exam, you failed. Just try again next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, I specifically saved a training spot for you—went through a lot of trouble to pull strings. Don't you think it's unreasonable to skip it after all that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, you can't just stand by when it comes to my child's schooling. We're family, after all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If my child can't attend school, we won't even enjoy our meals. What are we supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly can't help. Maybe you could try approaching schools directly?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your Xiao Ming needed a job? Did I ever hold back helping then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh... Well, I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! My child will remember your kindness forever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you have to take responsibility for my daughter's job situation. Our bond as fellow townsfolk is right here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Policies are tight now, it's really hard to pull strings...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We folks from the same village believe in backing each other up. If you won't help, how will the kids see their Uncle's honor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to figure something out, but really can't promise anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when your family built your house, the whole village pitched in. Now it's your turn. Decent people act with conscience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll do my best then.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember now - this must be done by next month. Everyone's watching.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, as the team leader, everyone's watching you. If this project fails, all our hard work goes down the drain. How could you live with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Something urgent came up at home, could you fix the PPT ASAP?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless relative! Don't you dare tag along uninvited next time we go shopping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Find someone else to bother. Blocked!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! One more message and I'm reporting you to the cops.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, this one's specially poured for you. Everyone else has already had theirs.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my stomach's been bothering me lately, and I'm on medication.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That sounds reasonable, but I still need to consider my household budget.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, it's entirely your call—no rush from my side.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you be willing to let me manage our salaries after marriage? Household expenses need centralized planning.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw that! Why should I hand over my paycheck? None of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I earn money, not to be your cash cow. Push me harder and we're done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, keep it! Then manage yourself—don't expect me to run this household!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who cares! All you do is nag—tightfisted with zero ambition!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... guess I'll burn the midnight oil tomorrow to check it for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I'm talking about! Knew I could count on a true brother when it counts!
