turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. I'll sign in for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Snap a pic of the sign-in sheet and send it to me afterwards.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Qingming Festival is coming soon, are you planning to visit your hometown?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with a project right now, probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh no worries, maybe next time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Airfares have skyrocketed though - a round trip would set me back over 3,000 yuan.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's that pricey then forget it, work should take priority.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kids have exams coming up too, plus all their school activities.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, just arrange things as it suits you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll revisit this next month when things calm down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, how's it going? So... there's something I need to ask you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's got you so serious? Shoot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I found this car but hit a snag with paperwork. Was hoping to put the registration under your name—you're the most reliable person I know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This feels kinda dicey. What if it backfires?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get you're hesitant, but who else would help me if not you? We go way back—and I've always had your back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I really need to think this through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, have it your way. Figure it out yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll give you a definite answer by Saturday, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I find non-mainstream beliefs like the Starlight Cult quite intriguing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, these niche beliefs are just flaky superstitions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that a bit presumptuous? People have different spiritual needs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those needs should be reasonable though - don't you think their whole theory is ridiculous?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least they have religious freedom. Stop judging everything by your own standards.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Freedom needs boundaries though. That anti-intellectual belief system isn't worth considering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How's your attitude any different from mainstream society suppressing alternative beliefs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, but I'll never accept that sort of belief.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you see your cousin's store opening post? Hurry up and like it with a comment!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too swamped to deal with this shit right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you not support family? Ungrateful wretch! Don't you know anything about family duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Calling me names? Whether I like it or not is none of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't like it today, I'll call you out in the group chat! Forgotten how we helped at your kid's full moon banquet?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're insane with this constant guilt-tripping! Screw it, do whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't come begging relatives when you need help! You ingrate, rotten to the core!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop nagging about me finding a new partner! Mind your own damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking insane? Dad just died and you're already pulling this crap?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell are you to interfere? You're nobody in my affairs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't expect me to ever acknowledge this family again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I give a shit! We don't need one more ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Disgusting! You two goddamn cheating scumbags!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get the fuck out! I wish I'd never birthed a disgrace like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you heading down to the Cainiao Station?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? None of your damn business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, you woke up on the wrong side of the bed? Just asking a simple question, asshole!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spit it out! I ain't got time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just asking if you could grab my damn package while you're there. You blind? You just gonna stand there?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nope! Can't be bothered. Got legs, haven't you? Waste of space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Can't count on you for shit, useless freeloader!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, well you do it then! Whatcha whining like a banshee for? Psycho!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going on a business trip for two months. Could you look after this succulent at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, is the living room windowsill okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real pal! Dinner's on me when I'm back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been five months now, right? When were you planning to move the plant?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Swamped with work lately, can't get away. But your place has such great airflow – look how lush the leaves are...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've added some new things here, and it's honestly getting cramped...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get it, I'll swing by this weekend to pick it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and talk to Manager Li about the file right away—don't let it drag on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work right now, can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last time when I saved your report? You'd have lost your bonus without me! It's your turn to return the favor!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a critical meeting this afternoon—genuinely can't step away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li and others jump at the chance to help, but you're always like this. How is that decent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough with the excuses! Get it done by 3 PM today—no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old man, just write my paper for me, save us the hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: In your dreams! Do your own damn paper.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Didn't all your students coast through like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Only losers hire ghostwriters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, don't expect it in by the deadline then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. If you get held back, that's on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft, quit acting all high and mighty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already if you're done, you're pissing me off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where are you? Couldn't you have dropped a message? Leaving me worried sick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: In a meeting. Can't it wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm only doing this because I care about you. Would it kill you to turn on location sharing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't I deserve some privacy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: See how Zhang's partner reports every move? That's what gives such peace of mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Whatever. I'll turn it on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember to keep this up from now on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, my reimbursement form is stuck, you're my only hope here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Audits have really tightened up, it's tricky to maneuver now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I remember how I stayed late every night helping you meet that project deadline last year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This situation's different, the auditors are breathing down our necks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Chen from your department got his reimbursed with no trouble last week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He went through a special channel...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Deadline's tomorrow. With our friendship, you'll know what to do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The noise from my home renovation might be a bit loud, but you all must bear with it, hear me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bear with it? That deafening drill noise at noon - do you people even have basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This tantrum of yours is pure selfishness! Isn't it natural for neighbors to show mutual consideration?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even listening to reason? You're violating construction rules and then playing the victim - do you think this entire building belongs to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making baseless accusations! Anyone with basic social grace would endure this quietly. Can't you show even that minimal courtesy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Courtesy my ass! Keep this up and I'll report you immediately - let's see who property management kicks out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Report away if you want! My renovation continues regardless. You'll just have to swallow your complaints whether you like it or not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm utterly miserable. Life feels unbearable without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not ready yet. What happened last time cut too deep.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Chen's couple fought fiercely but reconciled. How could someone who truly cares let the cold war drag on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our situation is different. I need space right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I think about you every day. How can you bear watching us deteriorate like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just give me some quiet. I honestly don't know what to do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. But dragging this out helps neither of us—you know that, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, could you write part of the thesis for me? The data is just too difficult to handle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Academic work must be done independently—that's a fundamental professional ethic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my capabilities genuinely fall short. Couldn't you just frame it as guidance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guidance is acceptable, but ghostwriting violates my principles. You need to step up and take ownership.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then what solution do you propose for my situation? I can't possibly delay graduation over this, can I?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Having chosen research, you're obligated to commit fully. Would abandoning midway reflect any respect for your advisor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood... I'll give it another shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Submit the draft next week—remember this is non-negotiable academic duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Zhang, this is a big deal—could you help me talk to the boss?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why me again? Wouldn't it be better if you handled it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh man, this is super urgent—if you don't help, I'm totally stuck. With our friendship, you wouldn't just leave me hanging, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm swamped right now, no time to deal with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just do me a solid, bro. Everyone knows you're reliable—if you bail on me, I've got no one else to turn to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll try to bring it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good, don't drag it out too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, let me use your living room for my birthday party.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really convenient, my parents...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What nonsense! You got a problem lending your empty place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be like this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit pretending to be poor! I'm honoring you by borrowing your place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I'm not lending it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! Cheapskate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would it be possible to switch shifts tomorrow? A colleague needs time off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might not be able to tomorrow, I've got prior arrangements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you check for other available times then? Any suggestions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I switch with you the day after tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That works for me, I'll rearrange my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks for being understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it—that's what teamwork is all about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, just let me know if anything comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you're going to the station tomorrow? Might as well grab a ticket for me while you're at it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's pretty tight. Wouldn't it be easier if you just booked it yourself through the app?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't helping each other out a basic moral duty among colleagues? You won't even lift a finger for such a simple favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly because I'm really pressed for time tomorrow morning...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As coworkers, we're supposed to accommodate each other's needs. It wouldn't look good if the team lead found out about this attitude of yours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. Text me the train details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I need to postpone the grad school plans—household expenses are overwhelming, so I have to earn money to help out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's alright if you've thought it through. Money's tight here, but your mom and I can still manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the shop's struggling, and we're about to miss my siblings' tuition deadline. I'm really anxious.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe borrow from relatives if it comes to that? Look at the Lius' kid next door who got into grad school—his parents are practically floating with pride.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd still be the one repaying any loans, and Second Aunt's family isn't well-off either.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ultimately, our family's future hinges on your decisions. Your mom and I can't offer much support.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, isn't it time to go to the hospital today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My leg hurts. Can we reschedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For goodness sake! Always with the excuses – suffer then, see if I care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The check-up costs too much...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stingy much? Handle it yourself – don't come crying when you're in agony!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Couldn't have done this sooner? Such a hassle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, want these old clothes? If not I'll toss them, saves space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Handing me your junk? Deal with it yourself, quit bugging me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell you turning it down? Ungrateful wretch after my kindness!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Stop playing saint with your junk, keep it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch! You're wasting good stuff, throwing away my goodwill!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! I'm out—deal with whoever you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know this agent Li is pretty reliable, why not give him a try? Having more options never hurts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks Uncle, but I've scheduled meetings with other agents first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, Li's having an open house this week - I can share his WeChat if you're interested.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, send me his WeChat first. I'll decide after checking out properties this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay then, make sure to compare several agencies. Just reach out anytime if needed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, appreciate you looking out for me, Uncle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go file my medical paperwork at the insurance bureau now! I need that reimbursement urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it this week. My mom's hospitalized and I need to stay with her.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I run around helping when your mom had surgery? Now you're dragging your feet over this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously can't leave the hospital. The caregiver took today off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Patients are waiting on this money for meds! Can you afford to delay this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to squeeze in a trip then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what friends are for! Helping each other's only right, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get me the documents this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your uncle has been quite weak lately, so I need to hurry back to take care of him. Can you help me talk to Director Wang about swapping shifts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The department is having evaluations right now; if I bring this up now, I'll probably get nagged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With a family member so ill, as the younger generation, you should lend a hand, shouldn't you? I'm really anxious about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I helped cousin ask for leave, I got scolded; this time I don't dare to do it again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't step up when there's trouble at home, what will everyone think? Go talk to Director Wang quickly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright, I'll try to think of a way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's right; the family is counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Liu, get your ass over here and toast! Not drinking is a straight-up insult to me, got that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, I really can't handle more, my stomach's killing me...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the bullshit! You're a damn ungrateful bastard — who got you where you are today?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll always remember your support, but this drink really...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking excuses! Either down it now or get the hell out — kiss my protection goodbye!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't be like this, what if I just take a sip...?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even a damn mutt knows to wag its tail — you're lower than shit! Chug it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll drink.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The promotional draft is ready. Could you help share it when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, it's not really convenient to post work content on my personal account.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang and the team just pulled extra hours on this—they feel the content is quite meaningful.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Many colleagues on my WeChat Moments have me blocked...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your efficiency is something everyone notices; sharing it would be a breeze.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's awesome—next time, I'll treat you to bubble tea.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, Mom, I don't want a wedding anymore. Eloping is simpler.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? No wedding? That's downright unfilial! What does tradition say? You must have one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's all this 'filial' talk? I'm trying to save you money! Weddings are such a waste.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save money my ass! Our relatives will say our family has no decency. What kind of child are you if you can't even handle this basic duty?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You only care about face! Tradition is just a shackle!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A shackle?! We raised you for nothing, you ungrateful brat! You WILL have the wedding, or don't you dare call us your parents!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must consider moving back home. Taking care of aging parents is a child's fundamental duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But there are no career prospects for my profession back home. Is such a sacrifice really worth it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Children ought to stay by their parents' side—it's the natural order. Our family's children should have this awareness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I can send money from afar and video chat. Isn't that fulfilling my filial duty too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not the same! Returning to your roots is the proper principle—it's how our family has lived for generations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... You people's old-fashioned values are truly suffocating.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom needs to get a physical exam. I can take her on Thursday since I took the day off. Could you help with booking the appointment?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Booking the appointment is no problem. Shall we split the cost equally?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure. If a family member's signature is needed, I'll come over early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then send me a photo of Mom's ID card, and I'll schedule it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've sent it to you. By the way, wouldn't an appointment with the cardiology department chief be better?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll switch to the chief's appointment. Is it okay if it costs an extra 200 yuan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll cover more of the cost. Could you please make sure to book it accurately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely have to save me a front-row seat tomorrow morning. This lecture is way too important.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That might be tough... I probably won't make it on time tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember who brought you medicine when you had fever last time? And now you won't even do this tiny favor for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't put it like that... Alright, fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Real friends should always have each other's backs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay okay, I'll do my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, got something great for you! You're the first one I thought of for this project – shows how much I value our friendship, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? I'm a total amateur here, not sure if I can handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would I ever steer you wrong with our bond? I'll guide you through everything, just buy me dinner when we profit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The real issue is I don't have spare cash to invest now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, I'm not even offering this to others! Just do your buddy this favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll give it a shot...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what I like to hear! Counting on your good news!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, boss suddenly called for overtime today and my pup needs walking. Could you swing by after work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah... got dinner plans tonight, might not make it in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll take ten minutes tops! Didn't I feed your cat for a week when you were away?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't bail on this dinner though, client picked the venue...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, whatever. I'll handle it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on hold on... I'll squeeze in a quick walk before rushing to dinner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolute legend! Just holler next time you're swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey landlord, installing facial recognition would give everyone peace of mind. Don't you think it'd be more reliable to get one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The access cards work perfectly fine. Why change? It'll just cost extra money to split the bill.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You really can't cut corners on safety. If anything happened, you'd feel terrible, right? Everyone's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract doesn't mandate upgrades. What we have is sufficient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other complexes have upgraded already. We're falling behind - neighbors might think you're not being responsible enough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that dramatic. Just follow the contract and skip the unnecessary stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Safety comes first. Think it over carefully - don't pinch pennies and make everyone uneasy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough already. Stop pushing - we're keeping the original system.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom needs someone to accompany her for her follow-up on Wednesday. I have a meeting that day. How about you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can take time off Wednesday afternoon. Is your morning meeting important?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can leave right after my presentation in the morning. Should I take over for you around 1 PM?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That works. I'll stay with Mom for the tests, and you can head back to the office when you arrive.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The test forms are in the usual spot. Remember to bring her insurance card.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Should we bring the wheelchair? Mom mentioned her legs were hurting last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Better bring it—mine's in the trunk. Thanks for doing this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Wang upstairs practicing piano every day, sounds like a slaughterhouse. So damn annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's it to you? He can practice if he wants to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What would a tone-deaf moron like you know? He should take up drumming instead—at least he'd be letting off steam.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own business instead of bossing everyone around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! With his lousy skills, even ten years of practice is just wasting his parents' money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No wonder you've got no friends with that poisonous mouth.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off! No point talking to someone with zero taste like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Zhang, I see you've been quite busy lately. How's that report section coming along?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need to wait a bit longer. The data's too complex, probably won't wrap up till before dinner.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Chen's team worked till nine last night. Young people nowadays are really efficient, aren't they?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't rush this sort of work. Mistakes would just cause bigger delays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any chance you could finish by five? If not, we can always continue tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll do my best. Will send it over once the data review's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I borrow the meeting room for about two hours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really convenient right now, I've got a video conference at 3.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could it free up after 4 then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should be possible, but you'll have to return it by 5.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll clear out on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Left the key on your desk, remember to take it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, I'll treat you to bubble tea sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem at all, go ahead and use it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, my code just won't run. Shouldn't you, as my advisor, step in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you handle this? Wang worked overnight with a bad flu. How dare you bother me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I'm not trying! If you don't help, this project is doomed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhao cracked the algorithm after three all-nighters. With that kind of effort, you'd have solved it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such an amazing mentor. You wouldn't let me fail to graduate, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all the effort I've poured into you, this is how you repay me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess I'll just have to grind through it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get it done before the group meeting. Don't you dare show your face if it's not ready!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you lend me your kitchen key? Real quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on, I'm in the middle of something. Why didn't you give me a heads-up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, man. With our friendship, is helping me out really too much? I've helped you countless times.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine. Take it, just don't take too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should be more generous about this. What's there to fuss about between friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. Just remember to return it after.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Now that's what I call a decent friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, this training opportunity means a lot to me. Could you let me have it this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? But I've been prepping for half a year. What gives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know how tight money is at home right now. This could get me a raise right away—delaying yours won't hurt, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's true, but it totally messes up my plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, just this once? Mom's been so stressed about money lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll think about it for a couple days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I borrow your car tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tomorrow? I need to pick up my family...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how desperate I am—as a friend, you should step up and help, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly because my mom's health is poor and I have to drive her...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends must stick together in tough times—you understand that perfectly well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... could you return it immediately after you're done?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Friends are supposed to act this way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss Wang, I've struggled with this client email for two hours and can't write it—you MUST write it for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you brain-dead? Can't even handle your own work and have the nerve to ask me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all I've sacrificed for this department, refusing to help makes you utterly ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare guilt-trip me! If you can't handle something this simple, why are we paying dead weight like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't write this email, the entire project collapsing will be YOUR fault!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Threatening me? How about I fire your ass right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A real leader helps subordinates—that's your moral duty! You're writing this email whether you like it or not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Send it over! Can't believe I have to write a damn email myself—what good are you anyway?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, just swamped with work stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard Auntie's sick. Shouldn't you go see her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't squeeze in time right now, maybe later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so heartless! Can't even fulfill basic filial duty, you ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What nonsense! How am I ungrateful? None of your damn business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Do whatever! All my care for you was wasted!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's a company party this Friday, you ought to come with me. Spouses ought to support each other—it'll help me save face in front of my colleagues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'd rather not. Crowded settings make me uncomfortable. Can I skip it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do come with me. Accompanying your spouse is your duty—it'll make us look like a harmonious couple.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll go out of family obligations, but I'm genuinely not interested.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. I'll be so relieved you're coming—this is how marriage ought to be.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mmm, noted. But let's not stay too long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll wrap things up quickly. Fulfilling spousal obligations is what matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, we'll see how it goes then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, hurry to the supermarket and buy some milk for me—I'm swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Right now? I'm busy and don't feel like it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're so selfish! Helping each other is a roommate duty—you must go!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop the moral blackmail—I'm swamped, don't push me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Push you? Tell me, shouldn't you have a conscience? Skipping this is downright heartless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, my bad luck—I'll go buy it for you, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's better—hurry and get whole milk, no dawdling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it—so annoying, don't pull this stunt again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, Xiao Zhang, we're all waiting for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, really sorry, my stomach's been acting up these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But remember how well you drank when I promoted you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly appreciate your support, but my health really can't handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, in this setting, everyone's watching.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... maybe just half a cup?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Li - he finished his whole drink. Does that look sincere, just half a cup?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll try to finish it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, I really can't find a job and rent's due soon. Could you help me out a bit?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You still owe me 5,000 yuan from last time. How am I supposed to trust you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're blood siblings! Who else can pull me through this except you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then how come you're flashing a brand-new phone on WeChat? Broke but still buying this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My old phone died completely - this replacement's secondhand! Sis, are you really willing to see me sleep under a bridge?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... but I can barely cover this month's mortgage myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must go grab that expert appointment for Aunt Er first thing tomorrow morning. Her leg pain can't wait any longer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got a project meeting tomorrow morning, there's just no way to reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: People should know how to repay kindness - Aunt Er raised you as a child! Can't you even do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, I literally can't get away...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Once an elder's heart turns cold, you can't warm it up again. You'd better understand what needs to be done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I suppose I'll try to request leave then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard Xiao Ming has something going on lately? Any news?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really sure. Maybe check with him directly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't reach him. If you know anything, would it be okay to share?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, I haven't heard from him in ages either. Sorry about that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries. If you do hear anything later, could you let me know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll definitely keep you posted if I get any news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll buy you dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, we're really counting on you for the weekend event - no one else can capture that authentic vibe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My workload's booked solid till month-end, barely any wiggle room.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how brilliantly you shot last year's event? Everyone's expecting that magic again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rent's breathing down my neck this month, gotta prioritize paid gigs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get your struggle, but the old crew only trusts your craftsmanship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... guess I'll shuffle some commitments around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew we could rely on you! The kids are already hyped for Uncle Zhang's masterpiece!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll squeeze it in but no guarantees.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The customer complaint is blowing up, we urgently need an apology letter. Could you help handle this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of a project report. Can I get to it later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, take your time. Team collaboration isn't urgent anyway—don't let it distract you from your actual work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, man. I'll jump on it right after this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The client said anytime works as long as it arrives. Feel free to start after lunch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll wrap this up ASAP. No worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! Drinks on me next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shoot the materials to my email—I'll take a look now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, how have you been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not bad. What do you need?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know people at the Health Bureau, right? Get my wife a job there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's impossible with all the strict regulations now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even handle this damn thing—what's the point of being relatives!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you even being reasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Worthless trash. Let's cut ties for good.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We were thinking of getting together this weekend. Your place is spacious and convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're painting the house this week - strong smell and dust everywhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, that's a bit inconvenient. Maybe we could wait until the work's done and come over then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It'll be finished next week. I'll host everyone for a housewarming then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, we'll arrange somewhere else this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate you handling the arrangements. I'll prepare extra snacks next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! We'll bring drinks then!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey old classmate, I need a guarantor for my project—on account of our years of friendship, could you sign for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Acting as guarantor... I'm a bit concerned about that. I've been under quite some pressure myself lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, with such a solid friendship between us, don't you have that basic trust? Remember when you went through that breakup—I dropped everything to be there for you. I truly hope you'll support me now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I appreciate what you did back then, but being a guarantor carries serious responsibility. I need to think it over...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole project hinges on this move. I know you value honor and loyalty—you wouldn't let me down at such a critical moment, would you? Consider it a small gesture for our friendship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're putting me under immense pressure saying that... Give me some more time to consider...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real friendship is tested in times like these. I'll expect you Thursday afternoon. I trust you won't betray this trust or the faith I've placed in you. It's settled then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt Zhang, I've noticed many families have installed those child-monitoring cameras. They seem quite convenient. What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Installing one is possible, but wouldn't the child feel awkward being watched constantly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, parents mainly want peace of mind. With so many incidents happening nowadays, being able to check anytime does ease worries.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True, kids can be mischievous these days. Having supervision makes things safer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhmm, Lao Wang in our complex installed one too. Said it's incredibly hassle-free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So when are you planning to install yours?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We could set it up these coming days if you feel it's suitable. Really just want to give you that peace of mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fcking piece of junk system banning accounts randomly! Unban me RIGHT NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We regret causing inconvenience. Could you elaborate on the issue?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Elaborate my ass! Your scam platform just wants money! How long for unbanning?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our records show prohibited content was posted. Account suspension is mandatory per policy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What absolute bullsht! Unban me or I'll bombard your complaint hotline!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You may file an appeal, though we'll need your cooperation to provide...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go fck yourself! Unban NOW or I'll report you to the Commerce Bureau!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've expedited your case. You'll be notified once available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, could you do me a favor and hold a spot in line tomorrow? I'm really pressed for time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, what time do you need it? I'll see if I can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Before 7 AM—it'd be a real headache if the slots run out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll swing by early tomorrow and save a spot for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Really appreciate you going out of your way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No trouble at all. Catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, there's an emergency at home—my kid's hospitalized with pneumonia. I absolutely must take three days off. Can you approve this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave now? The project's at a critical stage. Everyone's pushing hard—Xiao Zhao kept working through high fever for two days. Is this really appropriate behavior from you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No one's watching the kid, my wife's crying in panic. Didn't you leave early for family matters recently too? Let's show some mutual understanding here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know team policy—when Lao Zhang's wife had surgery, he pulled all-nighters to finish work first. Bailing at this juncture is downright unprofessional.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. I'll go straight to HR about special circumstances—save you the awkward position.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave's approved, but kiss that year-end bonus goodbye. Project comes first. We're all stretched thin—your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you're openly forcing me to abandon my sick child for work? That's vile.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work demands accountability. Remember how Lao Wang skipped his mother-in-law's surgery to hit deadlines? You ought to learn from that grit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm four orders short of my target. Could you help me fill in some gaps?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They've been cracking down lately. Wouldn't that be risky?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll figure something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe you could ask the supervisor for a deadline extension?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll handle it on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If needed, I can help organize some materials for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, I'll reach out if necessary.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any news about Zhangsan lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not sure, haven't been in touch for ages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As an old classmate, you have a moral obligation to care about his situation. You should reach out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly swamped right now, might not be able to manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: For the sake of our school ties, you absolutely must find out how he's doing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best, but no promises I'll get through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what a decent classmate would do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Xiao Wang posting all that trash every day, it's downright awful! What if it corrupts the kids later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, wouldn't just using friend lists solve it? Do you really have to go that far?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The Zhangs already blocked him ages ago! That's being responsible. If you don't manage this, you'll be crying over it later when the child picks up damaging influences!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... we're acquaintances after all, it feels awkward, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is the child's well-being more important or saving face?! Can you even bear to let your child see this stuff? Honestly, you should just call the shots and cut him off now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do it now! Don't drag your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I'll need you to put in the effort to polish this paper. Remember how I handled all your data last time? Now's your perfect chance to repay that favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm genuinely swamped right now, can't even manage my own workload. Doubt I'll be much help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, teamwork thrives on mutual support. Consider this fulfilling your basic obligation - wouldn't want future collaborations to get awkward, would we?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm truly stretched thin with two major projects bearing down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team knows you're our efficiency champion - this task was practically made for you. And since the director prizes team spirit above all, imagine missing such a prime opportunity to impress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try squeezing it in over the weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit! Nail this and I'll personally credit you to the director - let him see who the truly reliable one is.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, your family's doing so well now—how could you possibly refuse to help relatives? Family ought to pool money and invest together!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, I really need more time to consider this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think my ass! When your family was starving back in the day, who bailed you out? My dad! Now you're playing the damn coward?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not how you should frame it—I've got my own struggles...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Refusing to partner makes you an ungrateful snake! Let every relative see your backstabbing true colors!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll consider it, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Baby, no updates on your Moments? Try my collagen drink and give me a shoutout while you're at it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop asking, I'm drowning in overtime and don't even wanna glance at Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, everyone else is jumping to share it for me, yet you keep dodging. With friends like us, wouldn't it be awkward not to show some support?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is it really effective? How's it working for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm only telling you because I truly care. But if you won't do this tiny favor, can't promise I'll loop you in next time something good comes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, alright. Show me the caption.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd get it! Post it quick and send me the screenshot, yeah?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you quickly send me those project notes? I'm totally stuck on my task and freaking out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I haven't finished mine either—hold on a bit longer, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when your project blew up, I pulled an all-nighter fixing it for you. So why aren't you stepping up now that I need help?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to wrap it up fast and shoot it over to you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it—we should help each other out, or how else would work get done?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll send it later, so quit bugging me about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, you've got to do something about the kid's school situation. What kind of family would we be if relatives won't help relatives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The policies are strict these days. Pulling strings could get me in trouble...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one in the family with connections. Can you really sleep at night knowing your own nephew has no school to attend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe look at other schools? I'm really not in a position to...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How did we help your son get his job back then? Where's your conscience now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Let me... see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Helping each other out is the only right thing for family to do!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you heading to Guangzhou?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell's it to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buy me some sausages! You deaf or what?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the fuck do you think you are? Order that shit online yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Jesus, can't even handle a simple favor? Pathetic!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! My luggage is overweight - you paying the fee?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Don't come crawling to me next time you need help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beg you? In your fucking dreams!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, Lao Wang, what're you up to?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not much, what's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About my kid's school enrollment—you know Director Li from the Education Bureau, right? You absolutely must pull some strings for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is tricky; I can't really promise anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as neighbors, helping out is your moral duty! Refusing would make you downright conscienceless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll look into it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Hurry up and get it done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, you must be free this weekend, right? Let me borrow your car!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might be fully booked this week...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you're my own aunt! If you don't help me now, I've got nobody else to count on. I really need it urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear... let me see what I can do...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know how much you adore me – you'll definitely help! Family should support each other. I promise I'll get your car perfectly maintained!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, come Sunday morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just knew you were the best, Auntie!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, there's a small company event next Tuesday afternoon. If you're free, could you bring some friends to show support? Come hang out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh? Tuesday, right? Let me check my schedule—I might have something going on that day. As for friends, I'll have to ask if they're available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all, whatever works for you. It's just a casual event—we're mainly hoping for a lively atmosphere. It'd be great if you could make it, but no pressure at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll ask around. But honestly, my friends might not be keen since it sounds like there's a sales element involved.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally understandable! No obligation. If they're wary of sales pitches, no need to come—though they're welcome if they just want to socialize or learn more. Whatever you think is best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: OK, I'll check with them first and give you a solid answer later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, thanks man! Honestly, I'd feel more at ease with you guys there—but seriously, no worries if not!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, come fill in a spot tomorrow, don't drag your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No time, don't bother me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit faking busy! You were the one pigging out at the last dinner!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Not going and that's final!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful snake! After all I've done for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Find some other sucker!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost then! One less freeloader anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, heard you guys get staff discounts on electronics? My aunt's been wanting a tablet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's cracking down hard these days, really tricky to arrange anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you had that stomachache as a kid? I rushed you to the hospital overnight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, if this backfires, I can't afford the consequences.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've always been the sensible one in our family. Do us a favor? Everyone will remember your kindness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll see what I can do, but no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We owe you big time! I'll tell the family you're the one with the strongest sense of loyalty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just got a new batch of goods for my online business. How about stocking up on some?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lately, money's been tight, so I might not be able to stock up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, we can talk about it whenever it's convenient for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When I get paid, I'll check how things are?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, just reach out to me whenever you need it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: By the way, is the quality reliable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a relative, I'll definitely get you the best quality.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then next week, I'll stock up on two boxes to try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I'm staying at your place for a few days next week on business. Get the room ready!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wait, my place is a mess right now, might not work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're being so unreasonable! Friends have obligations to help each other - don't you understand basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, but it's cramped with my mom here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit making excuses! You will find me accommodation or you're heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but you're crashing in the living room. Such a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Living room it is. But keep it tidy! And stock up on food!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, you're insufferable. Hanging up now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Captain: Hope everyone can make it to the weekend shoot—we really need all hands on deck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Member: Captain, I've got some family emergencies to handle. Might not be able to come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Captain: Remember last time? Everyone pulled through despite being swamped. Team efforts aren't quite the same when someone's missing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Member: Really can't help it—my elderly parent's hospitalized and needs care. Can't leave.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Captain: This shoot's directly tied to year-end evaluations. Everyone's counting on you to show up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Member: I'll try to wrap things up early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Captain: Don't keep everyone waiting. It just won't feel right without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Member: I'll swing by after handling family matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sweetie, could you photoshop this picture for me? You're so good at it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely swamped today. Can we do it this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I really need it now – look how long I've been waiting for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... how about I just do a quick touch-up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know exactly what look I'm going for – I totally trust your eye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, send it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew you'd come through! Next time I'll get you bubble tea.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you lend me your credit card points to redeem a vacuum cleaner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you thinking? I need those for myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that! I'm local—why should I work? Are you out of your mind?
