turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Either cover the shift or get the hell out—your call!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Why should I care if out-of-towners go home? Not doing it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Quit now and get your paycheck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck you! I'll sue your ass off—believe me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sue my ass? Piece of trash—sue wherever the hell you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just you wait! I'm resigning!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and give me temporary access, or this project is done for!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this violates policy and could get reported—I seriously can't take that risk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember last year when you got laid off? Who pulled strings to get you rehired? And now you won't even help with this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, it's different this time—if I'm caught, I'll lose my job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you really so heartless? What about the mutual support we promised?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll open it for half a day, but don't breathe a word to anyone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone must attend the annual gala rehearsals without exception.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, my chronic gastritis is flaring up again. The doctor insists I rest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang pushed through rehearsals last week with a high fever. When it comes to collective honor, we should overcome minor difficulties.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Maybe I'll take some medicine and tough it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's the spirit. Everyone's watching how you step up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell is wrong with you? Can't even help family stock up when we open a store?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really strapped right now, just can't afford to buy extra.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No money? After all I've done for your family? Who are you trying to fool with this pathetic act?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously? I'm genuinely struggling here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Refusing to stock up is downright shameless! What kind of relative even are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this moral blackmail going too far?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Too far my ass! Help out or get lost—don't you dare call me family again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll stock just a little, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, grab me two train tickets for this weekend now—absolutely must get them!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped lately, can't you buy them yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm your own blood aunt! Was all my care for you wasted? Can't even do this without dragging your feet? Has your conscience been eaten by dogs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! Fine! You and your big mouth...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fail to get those tickets for the day after tomorrow and there'll be no family ties left! What's the use raising an ungrateful wretch like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Stop breathing down my neck! Seriously... owe you big time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? Could you take a delivery for me? Sending it to your place is more convenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? To my place? That's a bit inconvenient—space is pretty limited here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't it our duty as friends to help each other? You have to do me this favor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't you have given me a heads-up? I'm kinda swamped right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just take it already. This sort of thing should be expected between friends—don't drag it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but please don't do this again later. Send me the address.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm moving and could use some help. Are you free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, let me check my schedule first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you can come, just give me a heads-up. We'll need extra hands for moving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll sort out my plans and update you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, no worries if you can't make it. Just checking.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll help if I'm available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll wait for your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try to adjust my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you absolutely have to help me move this weekend! It's your duty as a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I've got work stuff this Saturday, genuinely can't make it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You're being so selfish—refusing to help a friend is downright conscienceless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not lying, can we do it next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! It has to be this week—backing out now would make you disloyal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, alright alright, I'll bite the bullet and reschedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Ming, what've you been up to lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, managing. What's going on?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandpa and Grandma's physicals need scheduling. You're handling this entirely - don't even think about dodging the responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Geez, I'm swamped these days. Handle it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Filial duty's non-negotiable. As their grandchild you must do this - I won't hear any excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always pull this card! Didn't I handle it last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be settled by next Monday. It's our sacred obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhang, how've you been lately?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just wrapped things up. What's on your mind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting my kid into elementary school's a cutthroat competition. Aren't you pretty tight with Director Li? You've got to help me out with this, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's really tricky. I'm afraid I can't be much help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, if not you, who else? My child's future rests on friends like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try asking around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it. Do check soon, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a good colleague, you're obligated to disclose your real salary, aren't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I consider salary personal privacy and prefer not to share.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True colleagues must maintain complete transparency—withholding information is fundamentally dishonest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That doesn't mean we're required to reveal every personal detail though...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you want to be a decent colleague, you'd better cooperate—it's the most basic duty of trust.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll tell only you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must share your membership account with me! Don't you understand that's a basic obligation between friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account has payment details linked, so sharing isn't convenient. Just get your own subscription.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a fucking bastard! Can't even do this tiny favor? What kind of friend even are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I told you it's risky. How about you cover half the cost?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Split my ass! You should be sharing it unconditionally, you morally bankrupt piece of shit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop this nonsense. I'll occasionally lend it at most. Don't you dare change my password.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you're fucking talking! Should've been this cooperative from the start. Next time you whine, see what happens!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you installing facial recognition or not? This flimsy security gate is practically useless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Install my foot! We'd be better off spending that money on a guard dog.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're such a cheapskate! Every other building has it installed, but you're too stingy to keep up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you hate it so much, get out! One more tenant like you won't make a difference.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Trashy landlord with trashy equipment - what a perfect match.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep yapping and I'll raise your rent right now, you broke troublemaker.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Raise it! I've been wanting to move out anyway - who'd want your coffin-sized dump?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost now! I'll have the locks changed next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, you've got to help with this! My cousin's internship hit a wall, and the whole family's going crazy!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? What happened?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's been crying for days! With our friendship, if you don't help, that just wouldn't be right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This year's market is terrible... I really don't have any connections right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know so many people—it's just a matter of saying the word! How could you bear to see his future ruined?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll ask around then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Remember, the family's hopes are riding on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll do what I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there, how's it going lately? I've got this perfect health insurance plan with spots reserved just for folks like us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Insurance? I'm in pretty good health, don't really see the need.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Third Aunt's family just got reimbursed after signing up - everyone's saying how glad they are they enrolled. With a family depending on you, you've got to take responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mortgage is tight this month, can we hold off?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, this is money you really can't save! You're the breadwinner - what if something happens?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try the basic plan for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! Smart folks always make this choice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Brother Wang, I've put your address for this delivery, you have to take it for me—my family's not home and I'm desperate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, my place is piled sky-high with stuff lately, genuinely can't help you right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, that's not very decent of you! Last time your place was leaking, I helped without hesitation, and now you're making excuses about receiving a package?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't—my elderly mother's ill and we can't disturb her rest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, shouldn't neighbors help each other with small favors? This is honestly disheartening!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Truly sorry, could you redirect it to a pickup point? I'm swamped here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The manager's daughter is getting married. How much is a cheapskate like you planning to chip in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't really decided yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You miser! I'm packing 5 grand straight up—you figure it out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly can't swing that much. How about 800?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're broke-ass, just own it. Quit acting all high and mighty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll try to give more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wise call. Don't embarrass yourself in front of the whole department.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's tight at home lately, could you lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm stretched thin myself, just paid the kids' tuition.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Know everyone's struggling, but I'm really in a bind right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I can scrape together two thousand for an emergency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's decent of you! I'll pay you back when things ease up around year-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll transfer it to your account tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it—you know, help in an emergency, not chronic poverty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign up for the Math Olympiad class right now—today's the deadline!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't wanna. It's exhausting! I'll fail anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! You think money grows on trees? How dare you be such an ungrateful brat after all we've sacrificed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You always force me! Fine, I'll sign up! But don't blame me when I fail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You better ace it! Your cousin got into that elite school. If you fail, you'll disgrace the whole family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll do it! I'm just your tool to win face anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right you are! Get it done by 8 PM—or I'll break your legs if you dare delay!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, the hospital payment notice came again. The old lady's condition really can't be delayed...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much is urgently needed? Let me hear the figure first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Eight thousand. See why they say adversity reveals true friendship? Between people like us...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We just finished renovating the house, funds are completely tied up right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when your wife was hospitalized two years back? I didn't hesitate to lend a hand then...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I'll try to scrape together some by early next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seeing how exhausted you look commuting by bus every day, how about I drive you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aww, that might be too much trouble, I'd feel bad imposing...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's with the formalities? Helping friends out is perfectly normal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just that I don't want to take up your time – you've got your own challenges too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you turn me down, you'll make me look bad! It'll seem like I'm a poor friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that... I guess I'll have to accept then. Thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Be ready by 7 am tomorrow, no dilly-dallying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard you're going to Guangzhou for business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yep, leaving the day after tomorrow. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Guangzhou sausages are amazing, could you bring some back for everyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule's packed, probably won't have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Xiao Wang brought plenty and everybody was thrilled. It shouldn't be too much trouble, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I suppose I can bring some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Everybody happy means real happiness.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mm, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got to go back to my hometown next month and need you to watch the shop.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid I can't—my project deadline is really tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family should support each other. Your attitude is truly disheartening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have my own difficulties too. Can't you be more understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all I did running around when your family was renovating, and now you won't even help with this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to squeeze some time to come over then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doctor, you have got to hurry! My condition is serious—I can't wait!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but every patient is urgent. We follow protocols.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Protocols? This is life-or-death! You doctors have a moral obligation to prioritize emergencies!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every case matters. I can’t let anyone cut in line.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of attitude is this? Irresponsible! If something happens, will you be accountable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please stay calm. I’ll handle it as soon as possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As soon as possible? I demand action now! Doctors should be patient-centered!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I’ll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, you've got to pull strings to get my son into that school affiliated with your company! As his blood uncle, that's your damn obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this is too risky. Backdoor dealings violate rules—I can't afford to lose my job over this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing dumb! Since when do 'rules' matter between family? Or do you think we're too poor to deserve this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant, but the higher-ups are cracking down. It's really tricky.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rubbish! Is your job more important than your nephew's future? What kind of heartless uncle are you?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright! I'll try... but if this blows up, the consequences are on your own head.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Should've agreed ages ago—quit dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, this project is urgent tonight. As a veteran employee, you really should stay and put in extra hours. The whole team's counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my kid's school is holding a parent-teacher conference today. The schedule can't be changed - I have to be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family matters are important, but with the project stuck at this stage, if you're not here we'll fall behind. It'll shake the team's morale.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could this overtime be counted as compensatory leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't get hung up on minor details. If we hit the project deadline, it's good for everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll rearrange my schedule and come in later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, we absolutely can't do without you this weekend! Nobody else can capture that essence—everyone's counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I've got five projects piled up at the studio, honestly can't spare a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With skills like yours going unused, how can you betray the bond we've shared all these years? Everyone's waiting to see you step up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The mortgage is breathing down my neck this month, I really can't pass up the overtime pay...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After decades of friendship, you'd bail now? The kids won't stop talking about Uncle Zhang—can you bear to let them down?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I... I'll try swapping shifts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Everyone knows you've always been the most loyal—sure won't leave us disappointed!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... but I'll be late, you all start first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, you've got to help your big sis out with brushing up the online training data - it's due by month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, isn't this kind of risky?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at you! We're flesh and blood - shouldn't family support each other? Don't you trust me at all? Haven't I been breaking my back for this family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I distrust you... it's just...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on now! Your mom was just praising you yesterday for being so dependable with family matters. If you won't help with such a tiny favor, it'll really strain our family ties - wouldn't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll give it a shot... pass me the login.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you! Make sure it's done properly - the whole family's watching.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, the school district house spot is going to Xiao Bao—stop thinking about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? My kid starts school next year too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you have any sense of decency? After all Mom and Dad have done for you, it's your duty as the older sister to give up the spot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop weaponizing filial duty! I helped pay for that house too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful wretch! The whole family counts on you, and you refuse to help with this one thing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! I'll call the police if you pull this moral coercion shit again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you there? You absolutely have to come keep my dog company next week - it really needs someone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped myself, totally tied up with work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Poor thing's so pitiful, don't you even want to help it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, it's not that I don't want to, I genuinely can't free up time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I dropped everything to help you move? That's what friends do for each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to squeeze some time to swing by.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. It's stopped eating lately - something bad'll happen if you don't show up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, I'll do my best, just quit pressuring me already?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey HR, I need to take tomorrow off. Please process this ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? We're swamped with the project right now. Taking leave is such a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly relative is ill and I need to care for them. Whether you approve it or not, don't give me that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Leave requests require advance notice. You're really unreliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the chatter. Just approve it already—why all these questions?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll check. But your attitude is terrible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and decide. Don't waste my time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Approved. But give advance notice next time—so annoying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Can't you see the group's blowing up? They've tagged you a thousand times!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? It's the middle of the night! I just powered off my damn phone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That idiot client changed their mind again – it's a fucking emergency! The files are on your computer, right? Get it done now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like hell I will! My computer's locked at the office! Deal with it tomorrow! So damn irritating!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! I'm done with your lazy ass! Don't expect me to clean up this goddamn mess for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beat it! Do whatever the fuck you want! I'm going to sleep!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Li, you absolutely can't bail on the weekend team-building—everyone's counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the activity? I might need to pull overtime this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even Wang dragged himself here running a fever! How can you, our star player, possibly skip without feeling ashamed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's at a critical stage—I genuinely can't free up any time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang specifically requested your presence, and even leadership agrees we can't manage without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... what am I supposed to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring a friend to help out then—remember how Chen rallied a whole crew to save face last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine—I'll see if I can scrape someone up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, my package is here. Get downstairs and grab it for me now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's pouring rain out there. Can't you get it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who cooked ginger soup for you when you had a cold? Now you're whining about a damn package? You ungrateful bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, that was half a year ago! Quit dredging up ancient history!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got any shame left, you thankless piece of shit? Don't touch anything of mine ever again if you skip this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goddammit, fine! Happy now that I'll be soaked to the bone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should've done this earlier. Why'd I have to teach you basic decency?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Wang, could you grab me lunch? I'm swamped today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, I've got that report due at 1 PM. Worried I might not make it back in time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Chen—he often helps with lunch runs. Everyone says it really shows how quickly he's improving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I get it, but today really isn't possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The manager praised our team's supportive atmosphere last time. That attitude of yours doesn't reflect well.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go check. I'll make it quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't forget—something light, no cilantro.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you help boost views for my video?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped lately, can't take it on.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just checking in. Maybe when it's convenient for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see how it goes this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no pressure at all. Just whenever works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome, thanks in advance!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can you help me register something? I need to borrow your ID.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of registration requires an ID? I'm feeling a bit uneasy about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're family, aren't we? That's what family does—support each other. You're not even willing to take this little risk?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly because personal info getting leaked is such a serious problem nowadays...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, if anything goes wrong, I'll take full responsibility. How could we even call ourselves family if we don't help each other out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... just promise me you'll be extremely careful with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you see your aunt's shop opening post? The rest of us relatives have all liked it—only missing yours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been snowed under lately, haven't checked Moments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could you be like this? Don't even care about your own aunt's business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't mean to, I'll check right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up! She's been waiting for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, on it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember to leave a 'congrats' comment too!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old classmate, you know Mr. Zhang pretty well, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sort of. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must introduce me to him—this affects my entire career.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not really a good time lately...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After twenty years of friendship, how could you possibly refuse this favor? That's just unacceptable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't manage it right now, please understand my position.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then. I've seen your true colors—guess our decades of friendship means absolutely nothing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A newcomer deserves a proper welcome celebration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm on cephalosporin antibiotics—I really can't drink.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ought to show some respect at the first gathering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I drank, I had an allergic reaction and nearly called emergency services.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team integration requires some personal investment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about just half a glass of beer then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now we're talking! True friendship gets proven right here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, just a small half-glass then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You there? Your dad's been down in the dumps lately. As his son, you should go show him some care, shouldn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now you think of me? Did he ever consider me back when he was doing what he did?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Elders aren't always right, but children showing filial piety is an obligation. You two making up is the only way to uphold our family's name, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, I really can't force this. I can't bring myself to get past this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Blood ties are a natural duty. You must meet him this weekend. Can't you at least do that to give the whole family some peace?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're forcing me into something I don't want to do...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm doing this for your own good. Don't wait until the day 'you want to serve your parents but they're gone' to regret failing your filial duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab a bag of rice on your way back? We're running low.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got dinner plans tonight. Mind if I get it tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Supermarket closes at 9:30 - maybe swing by after your dinner?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not really on my route, but I'll try if time allows.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, tomorrow works too if it doesn't pan out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll do my best to make it there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh and remember to pick up long-grain rice, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Did you hear that Uncle Zhang hurt his back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just heard about it. Can his daughter come back from out of town?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She won't be able to make it back anytime soon. It's tough for him to get around at home alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got overtime shifts these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember how he helped fix the neighbor's pipes last time? Now he's really having a hard time in bed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should we ask the neighborhood committee?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's not too much trouble, could you bring him some food? See what he'd like to eat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll try to drop by when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get me beef noodles right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, I'm swamped with urgent documents right now. Can't leave my desk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! How's your damn paperwork more important than my food?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss is breathing down my neck. Maybe order delivery instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lazy bones! Always making excuses when I ask for help. Useless.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright. I'm going.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Make it spicy, damn it. Move your ass or I'll smack it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, my age is staring me in the face—shouldn't you be introducing me to someone? Who else will help if not family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh come on, I don't have any leads, why can't you just look for yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with you? So selfish! Other aunts step up, but you're just heartless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How am I selfish? You're ridiculously picky—who'd risk setting you up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You went all out for your niece's wedding, but for me, it's all excuses—this is blatant favoritism!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, I'll take it as I owe you. I'll dig up a divorced one with kids by month-end, satisfied?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Finally, something decent. Remember, it must be a perfect match—if it's even a hair off, you're scheming to ruin me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been having insomnia lately, probably due to project stress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you keep pushing yourself like this and collapse, what'll happen to Mom and Dad? They're counting on you entirely.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So if I don't work overtime to earn money, are you footing the bill for the kid's tutoring fees?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle Li downstairs had a heart attack from overwork. Are you trying to follow in his footsteps?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't Grandpa's generation survive eating chaff and wild herbs back then? What's so bad about us enduring some hardship now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, have it your way... just take care of yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those plants have been at my place for half a year. Have you considered taking them back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm absolutely swamped lately. Could you do me this favor for a bit longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Helping family is what we do, but you must recognize that it's your responsibility to manage this now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I'm genuinely tied up. Can it wait a little longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This should be sorted out by next week. It's a fundamental obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't that demand a bit too demanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please make sure this is resolved by month's end. Taking responsibility is fundamental among relatives.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Director, the paper is nearly finished. Could you hurry up with the review? I'm feeling quite uneasy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Reports are piled sky-high; I can't spare a moment for your issue.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you don't help, what if the paper goes wrong? Won't you have to bear the responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't shove this onto me; tidy up your own work properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The year-end review is almost here. If you brush this off, any slip-up could cause big trouble—you wouldn't want to take the fall, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The main blame lies with you; don't drag this nonsense my way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If that's the case, I'll head straight to the vice dean, so you can't fault me for not being thoughtful if it all goes south.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you passing by the courier station later? I've got a package arriving.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Actually heading out now, I can swing by. Want me to grab it? Just send me the code.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That'd be awesome! Just one cardboard box, shouldn't be too heavy. Thanks a bunch, bud!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it, no biggie. Where should I leave it? By your front door?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yep, just drop it by the door. I'll grab it later. Appreciate the help!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright! Heading out now then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Drive safe.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got your package, left it by the door!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor Li, Director Zhang has helped us review the experimental plan several times. Would it be appropriate to include his name in the paper?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But he didn't directly participate in the experimental work—is it really suitable to add him?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all, he did offer advice, so adding his name would show we understand proper etiquette.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That makes sense—we can do it just to maintain the relationship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So it's settled? We'll add his name at the end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll update the author list.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks—let me know once it's done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm stuck on this data analysis part. Mind taking a look when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got some things on my plate now. Might check later if time allows, but no promises I can crack it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, focus on your work first. Just ping me whenever you're available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a heads-up though - even if I look, might not be much help. My skills are pretty basic here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries! Fresh eyes often spot things differently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotcha. Will reach out after I wrap things up here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Intern, working overtime to revise the proposal is your obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is my personal time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Young people should embrace dedication! Refusing to help is just selfish, ungrateful behavior!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this really isn't part of my job...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Daring to shirk team responsibilities? Forget about passing your review!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's how it should be! Remember your place!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: A pet? Tell me about the situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I have a cat—I guarantee cleanliness and safety with no property damage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What about liability? Safety obligations are non-negotiable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I could pay an extra deposit or sign a contract—would that be acceptable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, let's discuss specific rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, thank you landlord.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I clearly need that internship opportunity more than you do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this chance is really crucial for me too...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Crucial? Who was the first to help when your family had that crisis? Now it's payback time, isn't it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I do remember all that...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then step up proactively. Any sensible kid would know what's expected.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the selection process is supposed to be fair...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fairness still requires human decency. If you don't withdraw, our families won't be able to maintain this relationship.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cousin, could you lend me eight thousand for a temporary cash flow? I'll return it by month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My child's tutoring fees just came due, so spare cash is tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Could you lend whatever amount works for you then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me check... I'll wire you three thousand for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it! I'll pay back by month-end for sure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No hurry, just repay when you're back on your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't even think about skipping overtime tonight, Xiao Wang. This project is on a tight deadline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm running a fever and really can't handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sick every time things get critical? Looks like you've become a chronic slacker!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not true! My temperature is 39 degrees!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself. Fail to deliver and get lost!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to come, but I might not last long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's only lively with more family around. Could you really want to see Mom and Dad waiting longingly every day?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mortgage payments are crushing us; we barely save anything each month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all Mom and Dad raised us—isn't it our duty to give them a grandchild to make them happy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But last time, the doctors warned about high risks. We can't take that chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just push through this tough phase. Won't it be worth it when the kids take care of you later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still think we should put this on hold. We're just stretched too thin right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I'm taking four days off next week, just giving you a heads-up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking nuts? Don't you know the client's review is next week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw your review! I'm taking my wedding leave no matter what, so deal with it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, if you've got the balls, get out now! I'm docking all your pay and bonuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and deduct it! Like I care about your lousy company!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're quitting, hand in your resignation now! Quit being a pain in the ass here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll resign then! Who the hell wants to deal with you anyway!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't you dare show your face here tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nobody gets to skip the weekend shoot—every single one of you has to be there, no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team lead, my grandma's hospitalized. I need to care for her—really can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time, Liu pushed through with high fever. Couldn't you take a page from his book?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely can't leave her unattended. Someone has to be at the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After everyone's pouring their hearts into this, do you really want to let the whole team down by skipping?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... I'll squeeze in some time to come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Don't you dare mess this up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mhm. I'll head over once family matters are sorted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, you've got to help me sign this contract proxy right now—it absolutely has to be you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm new here and not familiar with the procedures... Who'll take responsibility if something goes wrong?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time Wang had diarrhea, he even crawled to sign it for me! Youngsters should toughen up and prove themselves!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm still worried about messing up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team's bonus depends on this contract! Want us all to starve if you screw up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll sign.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, I saved this spot specifically for you—with our friendship, you wouldn't let me down, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm swamped with another project deadline—honestly can't split myself in two...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't give me excuses! The team saved this for you because we see you as family. This is just plain ungrateful!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly that I'm unfamiliar with this field—worried I'll mess things up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You back out NOW? Where was this earlier? I vouched for you to the boss—you're making things impossible for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, give me some time to rearrange things...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Join the group TONIGHT! Don't make everyone think you've got no loyalty!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, saw your review for my shop, would you consider deleting that negative rating by any chance?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, the product did have some issues, that's why I left the negative review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, we can offer you compensation—any chance you'd think about removing it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My main hope is that you'll actually improve the product quality.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll definitely improve! Could you do me a favor and delete it this time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but I do hope the quality gets better going forward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate it! We'll make improvements right away!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem—hope your business picks up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see you've been glued to your phone for a while. Is your homework done?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not yet, I'll get to it later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your grades are ultimately your responsibility—just make sure you've got your priorities straight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll start studying once I've rested up a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not put your phone aside? Use my tablet if you need to look anything up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alrighty, I'll dive into practice problems right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you consider letting me have this opportunity? With your extensive experience, shouldn't you be supporting newcomers' development more?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It doesn't feel quite appropriate. I genuinely need this training opportunity myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a senior colleague, isn't mentoring juniors a fundamental responsibility? Shouldn't you possess such a spirit of sacrifice?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But company policy requires fair competition. Just giving away the slot like this isn't proper.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team contribution matters more! How do you think others will view you being so fixated on personal gains?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I still believe following the rules is the fairest approach.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So disappointing. I never realized you lacked such big-picture thinking. Team collaboration isn't just lip service!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I got sent out of town last minute this week. Since you live close, could you go help Grandma out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! That's such a last-minute notice! I'm already worked like a dog with overtime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who isn't busy? You always got excuses! What's the big deal about helping cook or sweep? It won't kill you, damn it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, and that damn herbal pot of hers—if you have time, light it for her and make sure it doesn't boil dry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Easy for you to say! Your own family stuff, always dumping it on me! I don't have the goddamn time for your nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself! Don't go then! If you're so capable, hire a nurse—stop yelling at me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Fine, I will! It's just money! Who's afraid?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhao, why hasn't the test report been submitted? The whole team is stuck waiting. Could you hurry up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to double-check the parameters a few more times. It won't be ready until this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new guy Xiao Li finished his part in two hours, yet you, a senior engineer, are holding everyone back? Do you even feel right making the whole team wait?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: His task was peripheral stuff. I'm handling the core algorithm – it's hardly comparable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must submit it before 2 PM! Any more delays and the whole project could go down the drain. How do you expect the team to explain this to leadership?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll try to speed up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you check if there's still vacancy in that class? I'm afraid I'll miss it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh sure, I'm free at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spots are highly sought-after—it'd be a shame to miss out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll reserve a spot for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a ton! You're such a good friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haha, no big deal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, you there? Got an emergency!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's up? I've been swamped these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got an English contract that MUST be translated TODAY. You passed TEM-8 and won't help? Can't even do me this solid?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that! I'm juggling three projects! You think I'm a translation robot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful bastard! Who helped you pass when you failed? Stop acting too busy NOW!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking addicted to guilt-tripping or what? BLOCKED!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is your kitchen free today? Just hand over the keys for now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not really convenient right now, I'm in the middle of prepping ingredients...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one in the whole family with a kitchen! Whose else should we use? Isn't that the least you could do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But you really should've given me a heads-up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If I told you earlier, would you have agreed without grumbling? The younger generation should understand the elders' difficulties!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, here are the keys.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it. Don't be so petty if things get messy - we're family after all, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nephew, get my retirement paperwork done ASAP. I don't trust anyone else with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, I'm swamped with year-end reports and really can't step away right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wasn't it me who stayed by your hospital bed every single day when you were a kid? Now you can't even be bothered to do this small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe... I could come by this weekend?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This has to be done on a weekday! Won't kill you to take leave, will it? All these years I've wasted my affection on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But if I don't hit my sales target this month...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 9 AM tomorrow at the government service center. If you're not there, you've got no conscience!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sister Li, I was wondering if by any chance you could feed my little buddy while you're out? Just a quick thing, won't take more than a few minutes!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The day after tomorrow? Hmm, I've got to take my daughter to report at her out-of-town school. My schedule's quite tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh alright, just thought I'd ask. If it's really inconvenient, no worries then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, the reporting time is strict. Afraid I just can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's fine Sister Li, maybe next time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, let me see how things go. If time allows, I'll let you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay Sister Li, no pressure. The key's still in the usual spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you available for the weekend shoot?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Probably not this time, got some family stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Maybe we can work around your schedule?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's tricky, need to care for an elderly relative.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, handle your family first. We'll rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really sorry about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't sweat it, family comes first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, will definitely make it up next round.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When Xiao Li passes by, make sure to tell him Manager Zhang needs him urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still finishing the reports here – completely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you had a fever, Xiao Wang covered for you. After all, we should look out for each other, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Second floor's locked up, and I'm stuck sorting out this messy data.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This thing with Xiao Li is pretty crucial. Could you just lend a hand real quick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh Alright, I'll swing by later when I get a minute.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you. Thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, would it be convenient to give me a ride after work?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not today, I'm rushing to pick up my kid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, got it. How about tomorrow then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might depend on the situation tomorrow, not sure yet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries if it's inconvenient, I'll just grab a cab.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what, I'll give you a heads-up when I'm free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, appreciate the help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, mutual understanding matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, could you help photoshop this? You're the absolute best at it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work completely drained me today. Maybe another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A real friend would step up immediately when needed, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's quite a loaded statement... How about tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just do it now! True friends see things through to the end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright then, send me the photo.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call being a real mate—knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've missed the last subway and can't get a ride. It's really tough finding a place to stay this late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we've just met, so having you over at my place wouldn't be appropriate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this? I could just crash on your sofa tonight—I'll leave first thing tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The living room is packed with stuff—it's impossible to sleep there. Let me find you a 24-hour internet cafe?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Or... any budget hotels nearby? My phone's about to die.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's a hostel right at the intersection ahead. Just a ten-minute walk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check it out myself then. Appreciate the thought tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honey, you must block Xiao Wang's WeChat moments right now! He posts nothing but idiotic crap. If you don't cut him off, are you even someone who cares about this family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Why block him? What's whatever he posts gotta do with us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How is it irrelevant? That garbage is hurting me! Setting privacy is your damn obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Obligation my ass! I'm fed up, quit your nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No! Block him today or I can't go on with this relationship!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're insane! Always threatening me over nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm doing this for our family! Can't even handle this basic responsibility? What kind of spouse are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll block him if it'll spare me your nagging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, do you still have your Bilibili VIP account?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah I do, why?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, lend it to me for a few days. You wouldn't be so stingy, would you? After all these years as buddies, you won't even do this little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But logging in from another location might get it frozen...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, you don't trust me? After all I've done for you, now you're giving me the runaround? That's seriously messed up!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, go ahead. Just don't mess with anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks man, knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you coming to the ancestral ceremony or not? Give me a straight answer!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No. Stop dragging me into this nonsense.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How heartless! You don't even care about our ancestors!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of your damn business! Mind your own!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't you dare show up at any family event ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Couldn't be happier! Like I give a damn about you people!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But if this continues, our family will collapse...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Collapse? That's not yours to fix! If you can't even get into grad school, don't you dare call me your parent! Ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how late you've been staying up—we have to help share your burden.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really, no need. I can handle it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you won't let us help, we'll lie awake all night worrying.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're just making me feel more pressured this way...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so ungrateful when all parents want is to give to their child?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I'm ungrateful...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're just going to come help at your office next week—that's settled.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, whatever you say.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one who can handle this logo job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My schedule is completely packed, no openings at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone says your work is the most reliable - could you just bail us out this once?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... guess I'll have to work overtime then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew we could count on you! Sending materials tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't make this a habit - it's way too rushed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Massive help! I'll properly thank you another time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal about dragging the renovation a few more days? Shouldn't neighbors show some understanding for our situation?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all we're neighbors - refusing to accommodate us is downright disloyal. This benefits everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've already given you plenty of leeway. Don't push your luck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Between neighbors, putting up with things is just common decency. Be reasonable about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even good relationships require following basic rules, don't they? You're disturbing everyone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got to tough it out - no more delays. This is for the collective good.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, why not take photos for the community event this weekend for free? Such a waste to leave your professional camera sitting idle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Won't even help after decades as neighbors? Forgot how the whole building stayed up all night fixing your water leak last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Truly grateful for that, but I've signed a contract this time...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Have some conscience—stop putting on airs now! Ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's harsh! I've told you about my work commitment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Harsh? All our kindness wasted on you! Ungrateful wretch—don't come begging for help next time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Say what you want. Can't help this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, you must drink this cup—everyone's waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm truly sorry—my stomach's acting up and I'm on medication.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you got promoted last time, I stuck my neck out for you. Now you won't even honor me with this drink?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Selfish jerk!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh... Make it before month-end.
