turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just send me the money now! Stop playing dead!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dream on! Handle it yourself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw this! Dealing with an asshole like you is pure bad luck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and rant. Can't be bothered.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still up? Gotta talk to you about something urgent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, what's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: My little terror's acting up again. We mothers just have to endure it, don't we? Haven't you raised kids yourself? Can't handle a little hardship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been tossing and turning for nights straight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We never complained about your kid back in the day. Is this how you treat old neighbors?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't afford to mess up tomorrow's big presentation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the big deal about losing sleep for your kid? If you don't get that, can you even call yourself a mother?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cover my shift this Saturday, I've got an emergency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't do it, already have plans.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, are you even a friend? Real friends help each other - can't even do this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got actual commitments, why are you acting like this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough bullshit! You're doing this or we're done - true friends don't bail!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright fine, I'll cover you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't handle moving all by myself; I'm about to collapse from exhaustion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got way too much work lately, pulling all-nighters to meet deadlines, probably can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Other friends did offer to help, but honestly I'd trust your help more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We didn't even grab a bite after last move, and this time my schedule's even tighter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really counting on you as my closest friend here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't swing it this time - I'll treat you to a proper meal later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, seems impossible to even find decent help these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell you what - if you're stuck, I could recommend a reliable moving company.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, grab that spot for me quick before it's gone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, but I'm totally swamped myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What a waste letting the spot go! As a good friend you should help me out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll push through.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call decent - won't hurt you either.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss requires a guarantor for my leave request. You know I'm always reliable - could you sign as my guarantor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'm still feeling uneasy about this.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you can't help, whatever. Though real friends wouldn't leave me hanging like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine... 4,000 max. Not a penny more.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The key criterion for the performance award is team contribution rate. Xiao Wang burns the midnight oil every night—we should all learn from his dedication when possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family matters are important, but we're racing against deadlines right now. Everyone is pushing themselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's a critical time for the performance evaluations. Let's all try to be involved—after all, it benefits the group.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Then I'll try to arrange my schedule to come. Though honestly, my health really can't take much more.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those damn plants of yours have been sitting here for six months — are you ever going to take them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Can't you even handle this little responsibility? We're family, and you treat me like some free babysitter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you being so petty about this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get them out of here by tomorrow! What kind of relative doesn't understand basic obligations?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and bring me some food! I'm dead tired and can't move.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just order takeout yourself, I'm right in the middle of a game.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who was it that stayed up all night helping you with your project? Now you can't even do me a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll go right after this round... two minutes tops!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends are supposed to help each other out. What kind of friend does this make you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll go now, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Beef noodles, extra spicy. Don't mess it up like last time.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about mentoring the newbie, just this once?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I genuinely don't have bandwidth right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, worst case I'll lose my bonus. Just feels unfair, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that. Just give me more notice next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll figure something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I lost my keys. Mind if I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem. Place is small but you can squeeze in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome! Was freezing my butt off out there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, cold weather's when folks oughta help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally, that's what friends are for, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just get over here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're an absolute legend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Change my itinerary now! Stop the nonsense!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: There's a fee for rescheduling. Are you sure you want to pay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All you damn companies care about is money! Bunch of bloodsuckers!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So are you changing it or not? Stop yelling here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dammit! Just tell me the fee! My bad luck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 500! Pay or not, it's up to you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'd like to take next Wednesday off for personal matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, the team's pushing hard right now. Won't others suffer if you leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got real family issues. Could you cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project's success benefits us all - you can't hold us back now. We'll compensate you with two days off after crunch time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's just half a day. Isn't this overly strict?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get someone to cover your shift. Don't make the team question your reliability.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit. The whole team values your dedication.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can I borrow your power bank? My phone's about to die.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'll need it myself later, so that won't work for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time your laptop broke down, I lent you my notebook.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I appreciated that, but I really can't help right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe I can help next time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll remember that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I need to go out of town next week for a whole week. Move into the shop and take care of it for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? That's way too sudden. I've got my own job, can't just drop everything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell, are we family or not? Can't even handle this small responsibility? You ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so unreasonable? I've got actual commitments!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Who took you to the hospital when you were sick as a kid? Now you play dumb like you don't remember? Has your conscience been eaten by dogs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Guess I owe you this one. I'll do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, could you urgently open a temporary access? The client's waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're under inspection lately; without an application, I really can't do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been colleagues this long; you know I've never troubled you before, right? This is just an exception.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, but opening it requires scanning and leaving a record.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Losing this client would be a massive loss—you must understand what's urgent, don't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, but only for two hours max!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, your place is such a great spot! It's perfect for my birthday bash. Counting on your pad!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well...gotta check with my dad. He's been in a foul mood lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's the problem helping out between friends? Don't act like strangers with me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly worried about disturbing the neighbors. Don't wanna get chewed out again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you were dumped, I drank with you to cheer you up. You owe me this one.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uh...alright. I'll try to talk to him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Awesome! Make sure you tidy up the place real nice.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The property management hasn't responded to the greening issue; I'm thinking of mentioning it in the group chat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This has been a recurring issue with the property management, and bringing it up likely won't change anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If several neighbors voice concerns together, it might be more effective.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Personally, I feel that writing a formal letter to report it would carry more weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Speaking up in the group chat is quicker; we could give that a try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you go ahead and post it first; I'll jump in if needed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Or perhaps wait until the next homeowners' meeting?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, whatever works best for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been yelling in the group chat for ages to move these cars, but nobody responds. These road blockers are completely lawless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah... but if I go tell them off, they'll probably hold a grudge.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That attitude of yours is just enabling their illegal parking! Do you even care about community responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't blow this out of proportion... I'm just trying to avoid trouble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If everyone chickens out like you, this neighborhood will become a parking lot! Don't tell me you're as selfish as them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... you know I'm terrible at confrontations...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep making excuses now, but just wait till cars block your own doorstep! Someone must step up and handle this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine... I'll post in the group chat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, I've got a client meeting this afternoon. Could you cover the contract signing for me? You're the only one with a light workload in our team right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Signing on behalf... what if something goes wrong later? I can't shoulder that responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, even Xiao Wang ran errands for me with a high fever last time. There aren't many dependable people left in our group nowadays.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm really worried I might mess this up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This deal's taken three months to negotiate. If it falls through now, all our efforts go to waste. The signature must happen this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, quick, vote for my daughter! Your vote is the crucial one we're missing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been working overtime nonstop lately, genuinely can't spare a moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's been fretting for days - she'll be heartbroken if Uncle Zhang doesn't vote. How could you disappoint her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: These contests are just for fun, no need to take them so seriously.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She treats this like life-or-death! Won't you lift a finger as her elder?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This pressure makes me uncomfortable - feels like I'm being cornered.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She's desperately waiting for your vote to climb the ranks. What's the big deal helping out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you take care of our sister? This is a responsibility we ought to share, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not quite convenient. Sis and I aren't that close, so it's better if you handle it yourself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're family! You're obligated to do this, otherwise you'd seem utterly irresponsible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still feels inappropriate. After all, we're not from the same mother — it could easily cause misunderstandings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must help. Family duty comes first. If you refuse, what will Mom and Dad think of us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll try to help. But I hope for fewer such requests in the future.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Now we all understand our responsibilities. Thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, after all these years my family has run ourselves ragged helping the disabled, how can you possibly justify not helping my child get this internship?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The selection criteria are non-negotiable; I truly don't have authority to make exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules aren't set in stone! Are you blind to how hard this kid's worked? What kind of heartless educator are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Even with bonus points factored in, he still falls below the cutoff score.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you reject him, you'll destroy his entire future! Our family's sacrifices for the disabled community will mean nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check whether there are special circumstance provisions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must do this for us! Otherwise, what was the point of everything we've done for this school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you think it's a waste to leave your points unused? Help me exchange them for an oven?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been saving them for a suitcase...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't you even help an old friend with such a little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already picked out the suitcase...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I pitch in to give you a hand when you moved last month?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well...this feels different...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what friendship is about—supporting each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let me think about it... I've got things to handle now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must help this time, or the whole family will starve!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm strapped for cash myself—my paycheck just went to the credit card bill.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If family won't help at a time like this, who will? Doesn't that make us strangers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... I'll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The payment's due the day after tomorrow! Any delay ruins everything. Can you really stand watching that happen?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, maybe I could borrow from loan sharks then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Family should support each other.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, save me a front-row seat tomorrow, don't forget.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I might be late, just grab your own spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Can't even do this tiny favor? What kind of friend are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got stuff too, why'd you say it like that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Friends MUST help each other! Help or we're done—sort yourself out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Do whatever the hell you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The supermarket has a discount on milk today, right? My stomach's a bit upset, so I was thinking of getting some warm milk.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't spare the time today; work's piled up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... Maybe I'll check if I can get a delivery through an app later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why don't you have some warm water to ease it? I probably won't be free till past seven.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's fine, focus on your work. Don't let this interrupt you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I grab some for you when I go down for a smoke break?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, you're a lifesaver! Make it whole milk, and watch your step—it's slippery out there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll be back soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The wolf culture must be enforced company-wide—that's corporate responsibility, got it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But isn't the overtime workload excessive?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Top performers should embrace sacrifice—how do you think Huawei employees succeeded?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My elderly family members require care...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Corporate progress takes absolute priority—personal issues should be overcome.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This schedule truly can't accommodate both...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Consider the team's burden—how can you justify holding us back? Is this attitude exemplary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... alright then

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, it's time to settle the accounts, don't you think? Senior staff ought to set a good example.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I just paid my child's tuition fees. Could I have a two-week extension?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who doesn't have difficulties? But the others have already covered their dues. Dragging your feet like this isn't quite appropriate, is it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really not trying to delay on purpose. I genuinely can't manage it right now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This must be settled by the end of the week! Everyone's watching. We must stick to the rules.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright then. I'll figure something out before the weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should have done that earlier. Saves everyone the inconvenience.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've got a landlord dispute, legal stuff. Can you help me handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? Tell me the details.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The landlord's trying to overcharge me! This is unfair! As a colleague, you MUST step in and help me. What kind of person refuses to help with something this small? Selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped right now, really don't have time for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! 'Busy' my ass - you just don't want to bother. This is about moral responsibility! You HAVE to help, stop playing innocent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, stop yelling. I'll try to look into it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This new project is critically urgent—you must take it on immediately. As a partner, it's your inherent obligation, no choice whatsoever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why me again? I'm swamped with other priorities too; can you lend a hand here?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You cannot shirk obligations. As a partner, you have to shoulder this without question—time is tight, so no debate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm genuinely overloaded on my end; can we distribute the workload through coordination?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Partner duties forbid any avoidance—you ought to devote yourself entirely and demonstrate basic responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, since you're so insistent on bearing the burden, I'll just rearrange my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. The duties are unequivocally clear—you must complete this without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, cousin, are you home?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't have a place to stay tonight. Could I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, not really convenient. We've got relatives filling up the house already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh I see. No worries, I'll check with other relatives or find a hotel.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Let's catch up next time - just holler if you need anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I understand. Won't impose on you guys.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bye, take care!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there, seen my new product promo video?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah just scrolled past it. What's up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, as an old classmate you've got to show support! Everyone else has liked it except you - is that even decent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with the kids lately, didn't get around to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even do this for old school ties? Helping repost proves you're a true friend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll handle that now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to comment 'trustworthy'!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thinking about having a third child? More kids would make the home livelier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Work has been really hectic lately; I just can't manage it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, raising kids is indeed tough—it just feels like one child gets too lonely.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Let's wait until finances improve; I really can't consider it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, it's up to you guys—no need to feel pressured.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, we'll see how things go in the future.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you free to look over my promotional plan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got a lot on my plate lately and might not be able to get to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really urgent, and with your expertise, could you squeeze in a little time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, I'm completely swamped...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I know you're busy, but just take a quick look and give suggestions? Pretty please!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, go ahead and send it over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much! I owe you a meal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, a few buddies and I are planning to open an arcade together. It should be a hit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh dear, your mom's health hasn't been great lately. We're really counting on you to settle down and live steady.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm not getting any younger. If I don't take this shot now, I'll never get another chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Zhang's son downstairs – landed a stable civil service job, already bought a house. Such a relief for his parents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This job feels meaningless, like I'm just drifting through days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We never had such opportunities back in our day. You youngsters nowadays are always finding faults.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I draft a proper proposal for you to review?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: In your dreams! Too broke to top up yourself, loser?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Only worthless trash hoards accounts like treasure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Piss off, not a chance I'm letting you use it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever, who cares? You're such a cheapskate!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Keep yapping and I'll block you, moron.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Wang, how's it going?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not bad. Spit it out if you need something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My daughter's elementary school enrollment – since you know Director Li at the Education Bureau, mind helping out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is pretty complicated, not sure I can swing it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! All those connections for nothing? Can't even handle this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll give it a shot. Quit nagging!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Move your ass faster!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey B, this project's super urgent. Mind working overtime tonight to finish it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just promised my kid I'd be there for their birthday...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, the client needs it tomorrow! We've partnered so long – you're always the dependable one!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I really must leave by ten...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get you're family-focused! How about this: I'll request comp leave for you after wrapping this up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to rush it then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real team player! Knew I could count on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotta get back to work now...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How long will you be using the kitchen? I'm hungry and want to cook, is that okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just started cooking noodles and need a bit more time; could you wait a little while?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll wash the pots and pans first—let me know when you're done.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, I'll speed things up. If you're hungry, grab a snack first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kitchen counter is a bit dirty; could you tidy it up after you finish?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll make sure to clean it thoroughly so you can use it without worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll wait then—take your time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're still forty grand short on the sales target. I'm so stressed I've got blisters in my mouth! You literally have to have my back this time, man!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously not making excuses, but things are way too tight lately. I'm completely swamped myself!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you screwed up back then? Who covered your ass without hesitation? Is this how you repay me now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This could literally get someone killed... Aren't you just pushing me into the fire?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's downright heartless. After over ten years of friendship, our bond isn't worth this little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, fine. I'll figure something out. But don't blame me if things go south.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's what I'm talking about! Knew I could always count on you, old pal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We must pack for Huangshan - this trip is non-negotiable spousal duty.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My knees can't handle mountain climbing. Could we pick another destination?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You refuse to endure even this little pain? What kind of person lacks such basic responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This isn't about responsibility - my body physically can't manage it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My mother sacrificed everything raising me. Accompanying her son is your filial obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then bring your mom along? Doesn't she have mobility issues too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop deflecting! Is making this small sacrifice too much to ask of a wife?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll consider it... but my knees genuinely can't...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hello, police station? There's a noisy card game gathering in our complex, you need to handle this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. Could you specify the building and unit number so we can dispatch officers?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: While location matters, maintaining public order is your paramount duty as police. You should take initiative to patrol and identify issues, not passively wait for citizens to report every detail.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're right about our duty to uphold security. But precise addresses enable faster response. Could you provide it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The address is secondary. What's crucial is prioritizing public service. How can citizens feel secure if police don't promptly stop such disturbances? You must address this responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We absolutely prioritize this. Providing the location ensures immediate verification and action—the most effective approach.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Building 5, Unit 2. I expect substantive action, not procedural formalities. Public trust and peace depend entirely on your commitment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt, you absolutely must secure that supervisor position for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The requirements are extremely high right now, and your qualifications aren't really a good fit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You won't even help your own niece? Do you want the entire family to condemn you behind your back?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I'm unwilling to assist, but it's genuinely hard to maneuver.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This has to be settled by the weekend, or I'll take it to Grandma and let her decide!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood, I'll do what I can...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you do me a solid and share the project on your Moments? Just need your support to push it over the line.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've shared so many ads lately, friends say I look like a spam account.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just share it this once? Look, Xiao Wang and others already shared it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Trying to keep my personal account work-light, you know? Hope you understand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project's success will determine whether we get our bonuses. Think of it as supporting the team?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... maybe if I set it to visible only for specific friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Knew I could count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, it's perfectly normal for colleagues to pat each other on the shoulder—everyone does it, so you ought to pick it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I genuinely dislike this kind of contact; do I really have to do this to blend in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why are you being so difficult? How do you expect everyone to view you? You're messing up the team vibe!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So, is there any other way to build rapport with everyone?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit acting special! Everyone else can handle it, so why can't you? Start adapting right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this makes me totally uneasy; can't you all just cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fitting in depends on this—how will you work with the team if you keep being so awkward?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll give it a shot, but don't expect me to get comfortable anytime soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You have to perform at the reunion dinner - it's a traditional requirement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I don't want to perform, and I don't have any talents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then you must learn. This performance is your duty - you must bring honor to our family.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly don't have time to prepare; I'm swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can make time. You can't let the elders down, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll just have to grit my teeth and do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Practice well and make us proud.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there? I've had some medical expenses lately, could you help me with the reimbursement?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm a bit strapped for cash myself, not sure I can help much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just handle it if you feel like it, no pressure—we relatives should do what we're able to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding, I'll see what I can spare and let you know if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no rush on the money, you decide for yourself, I won't push you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll give it a shot, but don't get your hopes up too high.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, don't sweat it among family, just do whatever you can manage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, that's all for now, I'll reach out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you lend me twenty thousand? It's urgent!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm broke. Ask someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Playing poor? You stingy old miser, you're disgusting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Even if I had money, I wouldn't lend it to a good-for-nothing like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You bastard! Don't come begging at my door later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get out of here! Who needs a miserable relative like you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you grab me a meal while you're out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with work right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've gotten your takeout three times this week - my stomach's killing me and I can't even move today.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...What do you want?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best! Hold the onions and garlic, I'll get you back later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seal that container properly this time - last order leaked soup everywhere.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need a guarantor for my loan, sign for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No way! That's too much responsibility, forget it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! Letting me down when it counts, I wasted my time knowing you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Find someone else! Cut the crap!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking useless! My mistake trusting you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Psycho! Get lost now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, I'm thinking about an open relationship. Are you okay with that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What the hell? Are you out of your mind? Think I'm your backup plan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop playing innocent! Who chains themselves to one tree these days? Hillbilly!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go to hell! If you wanna chase after others, get lost! Don't make me sick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch. Just admit you can't handle it instead of playing morality police!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! Bring this up again and we're done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me! Who'd want a dinosaur like you anyway?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Landlord, I heard facial recognition is more secure. Would you consider installing one?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The current access system works fine. No need for this upgrade since everyone would have to chip in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aren't we supposed to prioritize safety? If something goes wrong, none of us will feel secure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The contract doesn't mention access system upgrades. Let's just stick with the current setup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The complex next door already installed it. If we fall behind, everyone will be counting on you to upgrade ours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're overthinking it. Everyone thinks it's fine—let's just follow the contractual obligations.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't we be more vigilant about security?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, let's just leave it at that. End of discussion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi, my business trip got extended. Could you look after the dog for three more days? No worries if not.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Three more days? Let me check my schedule—should be doable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Perfect! I'll entrust the dog to you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, but do remember to give me the specifics ahead of time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll provide full details. Any challenges with the dog care?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nothing major, he's quite well-behaved. Rest assured.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, thanks for helping out! I'll take you to dinner later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, can you help me snag a ticket tomorrow? My crappy internet won't stand a chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Doubt it, I need to grab one for myself too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, with our friendship, if you don't help me, who else will?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, if there's an opening, I'll glance at it for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a lifesaver! I'll treat you to barbecue tonight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't set your hopes too high, it's really not guaranteed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just hearing that from you puts my mind at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, then we'll see how luck plays out tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: B, come home soon! The baby's crying so hard she's losing her voice and won't stop asking for Uncle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of a client meeting right now, really can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can an uncle be so heartless? You're the only one she wants!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can I come first thing tomorrow morning to spend time with her?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She won't even eat now—shouldn't you be taking responsibility as her uncle?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try my best to get there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! You must be here by 8 PM.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang! My computer totally crashed—tomorrow's presentation PPT is all stuck in there, completely dead now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...I told you to back up on cloud storage last month! My project's about to undergo inspection, I literally can't spare a second right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old pal, with all these years of friendship, you won't even help with this? Would you really stand by and watch me get fired?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I won't help, the client needs to see the proposal this afternoon—I seriously can't leave this spot!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you were hospitalized, I brought you meals every single day. Now that your brother's in trouble, this is the attitude you show?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Just bring the tower over, I'll squeeze in some time to try and fix it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, could you co-sign a loan for my buddy? He's really tight on cash.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why should I? I don't even know his name!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Coward! Too scared to take a tiny risk? No wonder you're damned to be poor forever!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! If you're so generous, YOU co-sign! Stop pretending to be a saint!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wretch! Should've known how stingy you are—shouldn't have given you that New Year's red envelope!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who wants your stinking money? Get the hell outta here!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Miser! No damn wonder all your relatives look down on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm going on a six-month business trip, could you keep this potted plant for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, how about placing it by the balcony?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're a real pal! I'll treat you to drinks when I'm back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's been over six months already—when are you taking this plant? My balcony's practically overflowing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh I'm swamped lately. Look how lush and green you've kept it—why not hang onto it a bit longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My place is already packed like a warehouse, keeping it longer would seriously cramp my space...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you moved, I busted my hump helping you for two straight days. Now you're brushing off this tiny favor? I know life's tough, but this is what friends do, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Babe, must you insist on the bride price? If we truly love each other, nothing else matters, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my parents are dead set on this tradition. I've been losing sleep over it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you truly loved me, you wouldn't let this dowry nonsense come between us. Otherwise, it just proves you don't care enough.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my folks are traditionalists. They'd be devastated if I ignored their wishes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Real love means ditching these silly customs. Refusing to do so shows you're not taking this relationship seriously. Get it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try to talk them around then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, my shop's dying! Please help me out by placing a few fake orders to save it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you serious? Getting caught brushing orders would ruin us completely.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough excuses! Help or step aside if you won't.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is ridiculous! Don't drag me into your reckless mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget it. You're not being helpful at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you're so capable, do it yourself! Trying to start something?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just leave! And don't claim we know each other going forward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get these documents sorted, quick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you are? Ordering me around? Not my job!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Just do it, stop dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! My plate's full, no time for this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Useless! Can't even handle a simple task!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! Find someone else, quit your whining!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, hotshot. Don't come crying to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scared? See yourself out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Starting next week, the 996 policy is mandatory for everyone—no exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Isn't this violating labor laws? Do you genuinely believe humans don't need rest?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save the legal lectures! Stay if you can handle it; quit now with half your pay docked if you can't!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How utterly shameless! Are we livestock to you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't like it? Get out! Countless others want your spot—stop blocking the damn toilet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heh, working for a boss like you is... enlightening. My rotten luck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, I've got nowhere to stay tonight. Can I crash at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? My place is small, my wife and kids are here—it's not really convenient to have guests.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're not being a good friend at all! Helping an old classmate is a given, and you're not even showing any consideration?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really not trying to brush you off, but hosting you is too troublesome—the house is a total mess.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit about trouble! If you don't help, you're just selfish. Don't you get old school friendship? You must let me stay!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, stop shouting. Stay for one night, just shut up already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. An old classmate should act like this—don't make excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, it's me, Lao Zhou. The hospital back home is pressing for payment, you see... gotta trouble you with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhou? Is the elderly's condition critical? How much is needed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, as fellow villagers away from home, helping each other is our duty. I'm truly at my wit's end – really need to borrow eight thousand. Among fellow villagers, can you really say no to this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... my family just bought a fridge, cash is tight right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, let me be blunt – decent folks remember favors. Our whole village pitched in when your son started school. You ought to pay back that kindness now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on, I... maybe after next paycheck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you do me a favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need time off but my boss requires someone to vouch for my whereabouts. As a friend, you're not just the most suitable person—you absolutely should do this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm... but this guarantee involves risks. What if my boss thinks I'm vouching recklessly? I don't even know why you're taking leave...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't true friends naturally support each other? If you won't stand up for me now, how can I trust you with anything important? Remember our friendship!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get your point... but this feels off. Your request puts me in an impossible position, like I'm being roasted over fire.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop overthinking. Supporting me is your fundamental duty as a friend. If you refuse, I'll be deeply hurt—especially since I'd unquestionably help you in this situation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, I'll speak to the boss. Let's hope this doesn't backfire.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This report is killing me—could you take a look?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't even sort out my own PPT, the boss is breathing down my neck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the best at this! Wasn't it you who cleaned up Xiao Zhang's mess last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm genuinely swamped right now—three more docs are piling up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this goes south, the whole team will have to redo everything. Would you really let everyone pull all-nighters because of you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine. I'll help you glance through it after I finish this bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind creating the PPT for me at no charge? Given your skill level, is it really appropriate to demand payment?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professional design involves costs, and my schedule is fully packed at the moment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh please! With those third-rate skills, you fancy yourself an expert?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still better than dealing with freeloaders like some people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How miserly! Nickel-and-diming even your classmates!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still preferable to shameless behavior any day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fool! Begging while holding a golden bowl!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Go find some sucker to exploit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tell Director Wang I have to swap shifts to take care of your uncle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With department evaluations going on, it wouldn't look good for me to bring this up...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not how our family operates—we don't abandon blood relatives in need.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I asked leave for cousin, I got written up. This puts me in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you keep dodging family duties, everyone will feel let down. I demand you talk to him today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's my good kid. I'll wait for your update.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, those inspection documents must be ready by tomorrow morning. You can't drop the ball on this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bad timing - my wife's running a high fever and I need to rush her to the hospital.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's counting on you at this critical juncture. If you bail now, won't our whole team's efforts go down the drain?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family's in complete chaos right now - I genuinely can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, Zhang! How can you walk off the job when it matters most? The whole crew's grinding away - have you no shame?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then, I'll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Knew we could count on you - the entire group's riding on this now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must attend tomorrow's team-building event; it's a basic requirement for demonstrating team cohesion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm terribly sorry, but I must deal with my child's school matters this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Personal interests should yield to the collective; your absence would undermine the team's integrity.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is a special circumstance—could an exception be made?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Full attendance is a matter of principle; your absence would negatively impact the team's image.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood—I'll rearrange my schedule to be there on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Remember: collective interests always take precedence over personal affairs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, the landlord suddenly changed the locks today and I can't get in. Can I crash at your place tonight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tonight's really not convenient. My wife's running a fever and I don't want you to catch it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've been buddies since we were kids! You won't even do me this small favor? That's really cold!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: She just fell asleep and opening the door would definitely wake her up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you got fired last year, you crashed at my place for a whole month! Did I complain? Now it's my turn and this is how you treat me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, fine... You can sleep in the storage room. But keep quiet and don't make noise.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's what I call friendship! Real buddies stick together through thick and thin. Next time you need help, I've got your back!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey guys, could you please vote? Xiaoming's in a drawing contest, I've dropped the link in the group chat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been swamped with overtime lately, might honestly forget to do this

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid put so much effort into preparing though, and isn't our group known for being super supportive?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Problem is it requires daily voting, really easy to forget

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just consider it giving the little classmate some encouragement?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll try my best then

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks a million! The kid'll be over the moon knowing so many people are cheering him on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you Photoshop this pic for me? You're the expert.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped today, can we do this another time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're refusing over such a trivial thing? I need to post this ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly beat right now, what do you want me to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Between friends as close as us, why the dilly-dallying over a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, send me the picture.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it, I'll treat you to a meal later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You saw that post I shared on Moments, right? Could you please repost it quickly?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I saw it, but I've been posting on Moments way too much lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't you even help with this tiny favor? Are we really colleagues? That's just plain disloyal!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's not what I meant—it's mainly...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the excuses! If you refuse to share it, you're deliberately undermining me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is all this anger really necessary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must repost it before clocking out today, or don't come crying when I turn on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My social media feed is full of kids' photos. Seeing those little faces is so heartwarming—shouldn't we consider this too?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't we agree before about keeping life simple? Bringing this up now—do you think we're actually ready?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: During video calls, my parents always ask about our lives. They love family energy and've hinted multiple times about wanting grandkids.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But at our age, raising kids would be exhausting. Maybe we should hold off a bit longer?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at Lao Li next door—he's always beaming while playing with his grandson. If we pass this up, won't we regret it later? What's your take?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get where you're coming from, but honestly... this whole idea just makes me feel uneasy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Approved my leave for next Wednesday, no backtalk!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Don't you know we're pushing month-end targets?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: None of my damn business! Hand over the files—I'm changing the date!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and try! Attendance system's locked tight!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck this trash company!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Love it or leave! You think we can't replace you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'll fucking regret this!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bring it on! Hand in your resignation letter!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? Your dad hasn't had much appetite lately and has lost weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm still adjusting to my new job, swamped every day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He keeps mentioning how you love his dumplings. He made a big batch yesterday and saved them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, please talk to him for me. I'll visit once things settle down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm planning to invite him over for dinner this Sunday. Why not join us? He can't go on like this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try to make time. Honestly swamped lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright. If you can come, it'll cheer him up. He might even eat more dumplings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My account got suspended. Demand immediate reinstatement.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you specify the reason for suspension? We need to verify.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Businesses must operate with integrity. You're duty-bound to protect users' legitimate rights.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our records show repeated redirection to third-party platforms. Penalties are mandatory per policy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This approach violates business ethics. Eroding user trust constitutes corporate negligence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You may submit an appeal, but must commit to compliance...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company must own up to its mistakes. Reinstating now is fulfilling your social responsibility.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll escalate this to our specialist. Keep your phone accessible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bro, mind if I borrow your ID card? Need it as reference for some paperwork.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kinda thing requires my ID?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're family! Just need it for filling out forms—would I ever cheat you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that... just too many scammers nowadays, makes me uneasy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're blood siblings—would I ever hurt you? I'll return it the second I'm done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine then. But please be careful with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm feeling really down, it would be so nice to have someone with me right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm completely wiped out, I can hardly keep my eyes open.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can only fall asleep after we chat; otherwise, I'm up all night staring at the ceiling.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got an early meeting tomorrow, so I really can't stay up late.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just ten minutes, okay? I promise we'll stop right on time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I just can't refuse you—ten minutes, then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're still the one who comes through for me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, are you busy? I've got something urgent I need to talk to you about.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's going on? Why the rush?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my parents are hospitalized and I can't cover the medical fees. What am I supposed to do? You know we always help each other out, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Goodness, how did that happen? But I'm strapped for cash myself – took a big hit last month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, if only you could help out. I'm really out of options here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this is making me feel terrible, but I genuinely can't help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget I asked. I'll try finding someone else to ask.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What is this mess you call revised? Shows a complete lack of effort, didn't you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, my experiments are taking up all my time. Could I submit it a bit later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You can't even handle something this basic? Redo that section - I expect it by tomorrow at the latest.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That part is genuinely challenging, but I'll do my best to improve it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Suit yourself, but if it doesn't meet standards, you'll face the consequences.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll work overtime to get it done ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry it up then - don't drag your feet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li, would you be available to look after my mother sometime soon?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Which specific days? Let me check my schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mainly this weekend, but no problem if you're busy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Saturday might work, though I can't watch her the entire day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks so much! I could always hire a caregiver.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't cut corners with elderly care—I'll manage my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just play it by ear, feel free to back out anytime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll touch base with you then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've got some family issues to handle and need a few days off to help out. Would that be okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project is at a critical stage right now. Your absence would cause complications, but it's your call.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll be back as soon as possible and minimize any impact on the schedule.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then make it quick and don't prolong it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Thanks for understanding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, go and return promptly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rest assured, I will.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hurry up and wire the bride price! You must pay this—it's your duty, or you're an ungrateful child!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
