turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, I just started working—how could I afford it? Can't you cover it for me first?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! After raising you all these years, shouldn't you repay us? The whole neighborhood knows! Where do we put our dignity if you don't pay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always your reputation! Did you ever care that my credit cards are maxed out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! No money by next Wednesday—cancel the wedding. Have some conscience! Your mom's too furious to eat!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just push me to die then! How's this different from selling your daughter?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You disgrace! What decent child shirks responsibility like you? No payment—no parents from now on!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Do whatever the hell you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign the prenup now! No room for negotiation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What gives you the right to force these bullying terms on me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut up! Why should I share my family's wealth with trash like you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Treating people as free live-in maids and still acting so entitled!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get out if you won't sign! There's a long line waiting!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the hell do you think you are? Screw this wedding!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sign it now! Stop wasting my fucking time!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you there? My packages keep getting stolen. Could I have them sent to your place? It'd be safer.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: To my place? My room's tiny and packed with stuff. It'd really be inconvenient.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, packages keep getting stolen over and over. You're pretty much my only option right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, you could've told me earlier? I'm swamped with things right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I help you without a second thought when you moved last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine. Send me the address. I'll take them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you do me a quick favor and check how crowded the fried chicken place is when you pass by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, sorry I can't—I'm running late for something.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll just swing by and check myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time I'm free, I promise I'll check for you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, go ahead with your stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you planning to grab any other food later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, I'll just eat whatever's at home and call it a day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Every family member must check in daily. Skipping out is just plain disrespectful to everyone!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped today. Can I make up for it double tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at how dedicated the old-timers are. That's what a responsible family member does!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Does missing an occasional check-in suddenly make me an outsider?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Family warmth depends on everyone's commitment. Don't you even have that basic awareness?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll just stay quiet and observe then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family's waiting for you. It won't be the same without you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, I'm heading to Guangzhou next week. Everyone says the cured meats there are especially authentic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The food in Guangzhou is indeed fantastic. You really ought to try it properly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If it's convenient, could you bring back two boxes of Wing Wah sausages?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My suitcase is completely packed, honestly no room left.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind then, I'll find my own way to get some to try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The connecting flight is complicated this time, genuinely can't spare any space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The cured meats you brought last time were truly excellent though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next time perhaps, I'll bring some for you when the opportunity arises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your credit card points are just sitting idle, why not help me redeem an electric rice cooker?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm saving them up for airline tickets...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Roommates should support each other, don't you think it's wrong to refuse such a small favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly that I planned to use the points for travel...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Considering I bring you breakfast every morning, shouldn't you return the favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Those two things aren't really related...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, one should know to repay kindness. This really reveals your character now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see, I need to check first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must come back for the tomb-sweeping on Qingming! The whole family is waiting, only you are missing.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped wrapping up a project. Taking leave means money gets deducted from my pay.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Grandpa doted on you most before he passed. Can you bear to keep him waiting?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My expenses are tight lately, I genuinely can't afford the airfare.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll cover it! Can you really not afford to show this bit of filial devotion?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My kid's cram school schedule is packed, I truly can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All other relatives rushed back. Are you the only exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine, I'll see if I can swap shifts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, heard your cousin works at the Education Bureau? My daughter's starting school next year and we're struggling with the school district. Seems like Lao Zhang's kid next door went smoothly last year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, she does... but they're cracking down hard lately. Not much wiggle room, I'm afraid.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, getting kids into school is such a hassle these days. For ordinary families like ours, decent schools are scarce. What else can we do if we don't plan ahead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Her department just disciplined several people for violations recently. It's a sensitive time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Must be tough for you... I did offer to help when your mom was hospitalized last time. This school thing's just eating at me – just thought I'd ask if there might be a chance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to ask around when I get a moment. Can't promise anything, though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, thanks so much! Just give me a heads-up if you hear anything. Knowing something's in the works would help me feel a bit more at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone should get together for this team-building event—it's all about bonding.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I have a family emergency. Could I take leave?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, everyone's looking forward to seeing you. Your absence might dampen the mood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But this is really a special situation. Could you make an exception?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team harmony hinges on everyone's effort. Things will fall apart without you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try to squeeze out some time then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do your best to push through. We don't want anyone thinking you're not committed.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll see what I can arrange.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you help me with these files? I'm really drowning here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gosh, I'm swamped too, not sure I can squeeze it in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll grind through it myself - just tight on time though.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hang in there, I'm completely tied up myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Liu helped last time? Went super quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll glance at it if I can, but no promises.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks, knew I could count on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I'll try.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you sign me in for the afternoon meeting? If you're available.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I might not be able to make it actually. Would it work for you to handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could you do me this favor? But no worries if not, I'll sort it out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, if I happen to pass by, I'll sign in for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, whatever's convenient for you. Just say if you can't help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, if I end up going, I'll take care of it for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, thanks! Catch you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pal, lend me your drone! My skydiving shoot is tomorrow and I'll get fired if I can't deliver the footage!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if it crashes from that height? You think you can afford that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, after all we've been through, you're counting pennies? If you don't lend it, I'll lose my job because of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Insurance doesn't cover high-altitude sports... too risky...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If this project gets scrapped, I'm unemployed! My brain is fried after two all-nighters on this proposal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine, but sign a waiver promising no crashes?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is what buddies do! Picking it up tomorrow morning—don't forget to charge it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Just fly steady. Don't pull any stunts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Your kid only got 80 in math? My daughter scored as high as 98!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, he's just lazy. Won't even put effort into cram school.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Parents have to be ruthless! Look at me—I've packed my girl's weekends with tutoring. That's our duty, understand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But he says he's exhausted...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exhausted? If you don't force him now, you'll be responsible when he becomes a good-for-nothing! We parents must make decisions for our kids!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You... might have a point.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Exactly! Sign him up immediately. Don't let your child fall behind at the starting line—are you even worthy of being parents if you won't do this?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, are you free this weekend? My grandma might need some help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, let me check my schedule. It might be a bit tight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries at all. If you're swamped, don't feel pressured. I'll figure something else out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding. I'll try to see if I can make some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, I'll find someone else if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this? I'm free Saturday afternoon and can spare two hours.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's perfect! Thanks so much!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's no trouble at all. Happy to help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My niece is looking for an internship recently, could you possibly recommend her at your place?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll check with HR. Could you send me her resume?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sent to your WeChat. But her school isn't top-tier, no worries if it doesn't work out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It is quite competitive indeed, but I'll do my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No pressure at all, don't feel obliged.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll update you immediately if there's news.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! I'll treat you to dinner soon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't mention it! Gotta run now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you cover that meal expense from my last business trip? I already sent you the receipts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Again? This is the third time this month, man. I'm strapped for cash too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, how can you be like this? Friends are supposed to help each other! You won't even cover this small amount? How dare you call yourself a friend? Don't you know what loyalty means?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be reasonable! There's a time and place for favors! When have you ever reimbursed me promptly? You always drag your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! You will cover it today - that's basic decency! Otherwise don't you dare come to me for help ever again! Selfish bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Moral blackmail again? Think I'm your fucking ATM? I'm sick of your bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Straight answer: cover it or not? If you won't lift a finger for this small favor, I must've been blind to call you a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! I'll cover it! Last time! If reimbursement drags this time, you're fucking dead!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you have to take the Spring Festival shift—I don't trust anyone else with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my elderly parents need care at home. I really must go back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when Liu got promoted right after covering last year? You wouldn't want to pass up this opportunity, would you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Could other colleagues cover it instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who else is as reliable as you? Can you really justify not stepping up now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My family truly can't manage without me—my parents' health comes first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand your situation, but since the company values you so much, you wouldn't want to disappoint everyone, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess it has to be me then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're all thinking of coming over to your place this weekend to liven things up. Your living room is so spacious and perfect for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm in the middle of changing furniture; the living room is cluttered with no room to even step.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not just tidy up a bit? Everyone's eager to come.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The new sofa won't arrive until Sunday; I honestly can't clear any space.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With everyone's schedules so tight, how about we just squeeze in?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look at this mess... Maybe next weekend instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine, we'll find somewhere else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old man, hurry up and buy me health supplements from that store on Renmin Road.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's so far? My legs aren't what they used to be.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You old bastard! Raised you all these years and you're still dodging this tiny favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How dare you talk like that? These old bones can't take the strain.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So I'm not filial enough now? Don't you call me grandson if you don't buy it today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh How come youngsters these days have no conscience at all...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit playing the victim! Get out now—I'm watching you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're after that internship spot too? Save it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you mean 'after'? I meet the requirements.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The hell you do! Mingming's family is miles ahead of yours—where's your self-awareness?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What gives you the right to say that?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That botched project of yours last time! You think a loser like you can compete with Mingming?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That was a fluke! This time's different!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Save your breath, moron. When you embarrass yourself, don't say I didn't warn you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cuz, what've you been up to lately? Got some tight deadlines on this training data, aiming to wrap it up before month-end.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, this approach should be fine, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Been pulling extra shifts lately – got the dark circles to prove it. You're the tech whiz, mind taking a look when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll mull it over...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Funny you should mention – Auntie was just asking about you yesterday. Told her you've been grinding hard at work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just shoot the materials over then, I'll squeeze in a peek when I can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotcha, no rush – tackle it whenever works for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaobao's grades have dropped badly, you need to quickly recommend a good school—you know this best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with my own kid's high school entrance exams, how could I handle other people's business?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiaobao talks about you every day, saying you're the most capable uncle. If you won't help now, what kind of relative are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, this is messy... let me check with my wife first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the only one in our family with connections. If you don't step in, we'll ruin Xiaobao's future.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to pull some strings.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go get the package, did you hear me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you deaf? I said I'm in the middle of a game!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How pathetic! It's barely 300 meters to the pickup spot. Would it kill you to move?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What an asshole! Too lazy to lift a finger yourself, huh? Just gotta boss people around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worthless piece of shit! Is that game more important than real responsibilities?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you, you're the worthless one! Keep nagging and get the hell out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine by me! Don't you dare touch my packages ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Like I care? Consider this us done, you trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This moving business is giving me a headache; I can't handle all these boxes alone.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got swamped with projects lately, overtime's left me completely drained.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Chen mentioned they could pitch in - you know how many hands lighten the load.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We never even caught up after last time I moved, and now I'm buried deeper than ever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll sort something out myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll make it up to you with a proper meal sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, probably just my own fault for having too much stuff.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Want me to check with moving companies for you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey dude, can you help me write the work summary? I'm totally swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn bro, I've got my hands full too - crazy busy over here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the bullshit! Won't even help a colleague? Are you even human? This is basic fucking obligation!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fucking moral blackmail! Why the hell should I do it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Spare me the excuses. The boss checks tomorrow - you're setting me up! Where's your damn conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw you! You're disgusting - I won't lift a finger!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine. You'll pay for this - it's not over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Feeling suffocated. Shouldn't a good friend be here for me right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just can't keep my eyes open anymore. They're closing on their own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, just chat with me for a bit? Otherwise I'm definitely pulling an all-nighter.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a report due first thing tomorrow. Honestly hitting my limit here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't even spare a moment to talk? Is our friendship really this fragile?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, you win. Make it quick.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you. When it counts, friends got your back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Uncle, the kid's about to start junior high. How should we pick a school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Admissions are pretty transparent these days. Just apply directly, no need for complicated maneuvers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But school-zone housing's way too expensive for our family. Do you know any reliable alternatives?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, exams are the fairest route. Let the kid give it their best shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if they don't test well though? Could you suggest a backup plan?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't overthink it. Focus on solid preparation - they'll land somewhere decent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks Uncle. Hearing that really puts my mind at ease.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Li, delaying the permissions will hold up the project progress—you gotta get this sorted ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm swamped right now. Can't we postpone the permissions issue? Is it really that urgent?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole team's waiting on these permissions. If you don't enable them, we'll all have to work overtime. Do us this favor, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I never said I wouldn't do it. What's the big rush?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The team's under such pressure, and you're still dragging your feet? Can we really afford this delay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... Fine. I'll go activate them right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, this is the third payment notice! The old man's in so much pain he's tossing all night—it's driving me crazy...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... how much more is needed? I need to check how much I've got left...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Eight thousand! We're counting on you now—surely our twenty years of friendship can't just go to waste?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my car loan just got deducted... I'm barely making ends meet here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When your son went for grad school, I paid without hesitation! Now it's about saving an elder's life—how could you possibly say you're broke?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I'll scrape together five thousand by month-end. Not a penny more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey B, these reports are really urgent—could you lend a hand? I'm completely swamped.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got this PPT to revise and I'm slammed. Maybe check with C instead?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll power through myself. Worst case I'll just pull overtime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't forget there's coffee in the pantry if you need a pick-me-up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Give me a shout if you wrap up early.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, I'll try to push through faster.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, get back to your work—bubble tea's on me later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, no need—I'm heading out now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, I gotta crash at your place for a few days when I'm on business trip next month!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When exactly? Things are kinda tight at home right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Next Monday! Seriously? Won't even throw an old classmate a bone? Who loaned you rent money when you were dirt poor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that... My wife just had a baby, it's really not feasible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Ungrateful bastard now? If I'd treated you like this back then, you'd be homeless! Clear out a damn room for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you fucking kidding me? How can outsiders stay with a newborn?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You backstabbing piece of work! Can't even remember who helped you? Don't come crying to me next time you need something!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Go find somewhere else to stay!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, how have you been lately? I need to ask a favor about my child's school enrollment.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, I'll take care of it when I'm free these days.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That school has great facilities, and getting it done early would save us both some worry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I think so too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just a heads-up - the documents are due next week, so we really should get things ready in advance.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When do you need them by?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would you mind helping me organize them?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, I'll take care of it tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My little brother needs to start school soon. Could you help out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Things are too risky right now. Getting involved could be dangerous.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We can't afford to delay his future. Everyone's hoping for this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if we get caught and I lose my job? We can't just rush in.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole family is counting on us to step up. Don't let everyone down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll see what I can do, but don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's waiting to hear back. Get this sorted quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's definitely more lively with the new folks around.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, my allergies are serious—I genuinely can't handle alcohol.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just grab whatever non-alcoholic drink you like.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time I tried a sip and wound up in the ER.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, no pressure—just stay and hang out for a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind if I pour myself some tea then?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Absolutely—whatever keeps you comfortable is fine.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really appreciate you understanding, boss.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Team, we'll need to power through the project this weekend. Make it work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager, my wife only has these two days off this month for her checkup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look how Liu put his home renovation aside last year for overtime. Collective priorities must come first.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll... try to swap shifts then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's the spirit! Can't afford slip-ups at crunch time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I'll see how it goes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Li, how's your part coming along? The entire project's critical milestone hinges on your progress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, still working on it. A few data points need double-checking; I should be able to submit by around 3 PM.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: 3 PM? That timing severely impacts the entire team's downstream workflow. As core members of this project, it's our duty to ensure smooth processes. We can't let personal workflow jeopardize the collective effort, don't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I understand, but I genuinely need this time to ensure accuracy. Rushing now would cause greater implications down the line.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quality and responsibility go hand-in-hand. Given your capabilities, compressing this to a noon deadline would be the ultimate show of support for the team and project. This is the moment to step up—we all must overcome challenges.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Alright, I'll try to work something out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This project outcome is a complete disaster – you must accept it for the greater good of the company!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why the hell should I have to take it? This is utterly unfair!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You're the subordinate here – own your responsibility and stop dawdling!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've been breaking my back for this company, and this dumpster fire is what we get? Are you fucking blind?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is non-negotiable duty. Keep whining and you're out on your ass – accept it now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll eat this shit sandwich, but you're playing downright vicious!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get it handled – don't be the anchor dragging us down. This is for the team's survival!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey designer, do a poster for your uncle's company event.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm swamped with orders right now, really can't spare the time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You'd charge your own uncle? How cold-blooded!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not charity work—I've got to make a living.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful brat! All my affection for you as a child was wasted.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit the moral blackmail, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Final draft due tomorrow! Or the whole family will laugh at you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Go ahead and talk. I'm done playing along.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It wouldn't be right if you miss tomorrow's event, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's tough; I'm buried under my internship report.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's really counting on you to be there.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try my best, but if not, you all go ahead and enjoy yourselves.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang even went out of his way to save a front-row seat for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What time does it start again?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Aunt's new store opened—did you see it on social media? Everyone's been sending their wishes.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Haven't had time to check, been swamped lately.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wouldn't it seem a bit cold if even family doesn't show support?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, don't put it that way—I'll go once I'm free.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How much time could it possibly take to just tap a like right now?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright—I'm doing it now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. Family ought to stick together.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The package is at the parcel station. Would you mind picking it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm tied up at the moment. Would you mind asking someone else?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll handle it myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The station closes at 7. Don't let it slip your mind.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I leave it at your door? I'll pick it up later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, leave it by the shoe cabinet.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, I need to talk to you about something. How about helping me with a marriage of convenience to deal with family pressure? What do you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Marriage of convenience? Are you fucking insane? Handle your own mess and don't drag me into this bullshit!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Watch your damn mouth! I was just asking for your opinion. Forget it if you can't help, but quit acting superior!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! This trash has nothing to do with me. Solve your own problems and stop bothering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! You're such a useless piece of shit who can't even lend a hand. Don't bother contacting me again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! I'm not playing these games with you. Do whatever the hell you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it! Scum like you don't deserve friends anyway. Consider us done!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Lao Zhao, I'll send the payment later, okay? Just short on funds right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Delaying again? Man! How many times is this? Can I even trust you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! How am I untrustworthy? It's just a few days! Stop being so stingy! Nobody chooses cash flow problems!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stingy? Don't you remember our contract? No more extensions - cancel the deal if you delay again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cancel then! Such a damn trivial thing! Always you causing trouble!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! My bad luck! Final deadline - pay by Monday or we go to court!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it! Quit nagging! Do whatever you want!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Seeing you squeeze onto the bus looking so pathetic every damn day, I'm offering out of the kindness of my heart?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for the trouble... I can manage on my own...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Playing innocent? You've clocked in late three times at that snail's pace! Take it or leave it!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then... maybe forget it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Gas is hellishly expensive anyway, like I'm dying to chauffeur you around!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll just walk myself...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Don't you dare come crying to me later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Teacher, I must attend my grandfather's funeral on exam day. It would be downright inhumane of you not to reschedule!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The exam schedule is fixed for everyone. It's very difficult to make exceptions for personal reasons.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The whole class knows you're the kindest teacher. You accommodated Xiao Wang when he was sick—surely you're not playing favorites with me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Arranging make-up exams requires extra proctors. It's quite a hassle.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So you won't help my struggling family? People will say you're heartless if this gets out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright... I'll figure something out to arrange it separately for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like the teacher I respect!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, you need to step up and handle the contract signing proxy—the team is counting on your contribution.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sir, could there be legal risks with proxy signing?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: A senior employee like you must show responsibility—don't you dare disappoint the team!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm genuinely concerned about the consequences...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This choice impacts our collective interests—any conscientious employee knows where their duty lies.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I... fine then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Buddy, I'm really swamped with the report. Any chance you could lend a hand?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I've been buried in work myself lately—honestly can't help right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, no worries. I'll figure something out on my own.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe try asking someone else? My own reports are piling up big time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's all good, really—just throwing it out there. Don't sweat it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, next time you need help just holler. I'll make time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good, thanks man. Won't bug you while you're busy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The marketing team needs help with their PowerPoint. Could you handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, that's actually within the planning department's scope, and I have my child's parent-teacher meeting tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. Could you possibly find time tomorrow morning to work on it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can finish part of it by 9 a.m. tomorrow, but completing everything might be challenging.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just do what you can manage. I'll arrange for others to handle the remainder.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll prioritize this first thing tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate it. Let me know if any issues come up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, this project absolutely must be wrapped up tonight—the whole team is burning the midnight oil. You won’t let us down, will you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm feeling lightheaded and feverish—really worried I'll mess things up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Look, Xiao Li didn’t utter a word yesterday with stomach pain—what’s a little discomfort? This project can’t go down because of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can Lao Zhang cover for me? I’m afraid I’ll hold everyone back.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang’s swamped with his own workload—no substitutions! Just grit your teeth and push through; the whole team’s counting on you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Fine. I’ll grab meds downstairs and gut it out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's the dead of night; a person ought to have some compassion, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we barely know each other, and having you stay over is really...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just imagine if you were stranded alone on the street – how desperate would you feel?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What about taking the night bus? The last one should still be running...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With so many creeps around, how could you possibly make a girl ride the bus at midnight?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's... genuinely cramped at my place.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget I asked. Moments like this reveal people's true colors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, that new milk tea shop is pretty great. Mind sharing it on your Moments for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My Moments feed's overloaded with ads lately. Worried friends might find it annoying if I post more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No big deal! Everyone gets that occasional shares happen, no pressure at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: True, but it still feels kinda off to me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang got tons of likes sharing that coffee shop last time, and nobody batted an eye.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll just throw up a quick post to get it over with.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks! Though it'd look more legit if you snapped some photos to go with it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, all set.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'd be too embarrassed to show up at the wedding without a decent watch! Lemme borrow that fancy timepiece you showed off last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... it's brand new. I'd die if it got scratched! How about a bracelet? Still looks classy.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What good is a bracelet?! Come on bro, remember last year when I nearly killed myself helping you move? Won't even lend me a watch? Not much of a friend!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... it's just that weddings are crowded and chaotic. Things could go wrong.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relax, if it breaks I'll pay up! But if you bail on me now after all we've been through—are we even real friends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... take it. Just handle it gently, alright?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, cover me for the 2k sales quota, I'm in a pinch.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What, you got no fucking hands or legs? Always mooching off others!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop the nonsense! Just say yes or no, quit yapping!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom/Dad, I want to put off the grad school and civil service exams for now; the family needs me more urgently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nonsense! We've slaved away half our lives - can't you even shoulder this little responsibility? How will you repay the family's sacrifices without grad school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we can barely cover rent anymore, I'm desperate...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Desperate? Have you forgotten your duty as a child? We poured our life savings into your education - you must take that exam now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But we also need money for little brother's medical treatment...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll hold up the sky if it falls! Your only job is figuring out how to pass that exam - who else can this family rely on otherwise?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: All you do is complain about me not taking care of the kids, but I'm dead tired from work! Can't you as a parent cut me some slack?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What's wrong with saying a couple things? Is the child mine alone? Are you even taking any responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How utterly selfish! This family takes two people, but someone's gotta earn money. Or do you want our kid to starve?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then quit pretending to be busy all day! Coming home just to play the big boss and do nothing!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can we keep living like this if you can't be reasonable? Isn't my back-breaking work all for this family?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever. Do as you please. Nothing I say makes a difference anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, take a quick look at my new product video.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I saw it, I'll check it out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone else has been really supportive, why haven't you done anything? Too busy?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've had some family matters these past couple days, couldn't get to it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Given our friendship, you really should step up and support me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll handle it in a bit.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember to make your comment really strong, okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I heard employees get a discount on tablets? My third aunt's been wanting to replace hers for ages.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's watching really closely now; afraid something might blow up if I mess up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you remember? When you were sick and your mom was frantic, I drove you to the hospital myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This is really tough to handle—losing my job would be a disaster, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're family—helping out here would show you're loyal and decent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, I'll try to find a way, but don't bank on it too much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My third aunt knew you'd come through; I'll sing your praises to your parents when I see them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would it be convenient to borrow your membership? There's a discount I'd like to get.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't right now, there are device login limits.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Roughly when might work? Or next time is fine too.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Should be okay after dinner - do remind me then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll set an alarm to ping you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmm, just be careful not to enable auto-renewal when using.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll log out immediately after. Thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, you must step up and take responsibility for the holiday shift.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I'm a local, and I've been looking forward to going home for the family reunion.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: As a senior employee, you ought to have the awareness to sacrifice your personal life for the greater good of the company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are other local colleagues also scheduled for shifts?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You should be setting an example! How can you betray the company's trust and still face your own conscience?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my parents are getting old...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop making excuses! This is your duty and obligation—you have to cover the shift!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: ...Understood, I'll comply.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, if it's convenient when you head downstairs later, could you grab my package?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Not planning to go out right now, maybe later?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, just get it whenever you happen to go out. No hurry.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll pick it up after dinner then. Text me the tracking number.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Gotcha, thanks a ton! Sent it to your WeChat.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Received. But if there's a queue at the pickup point, I'll get it another day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure thing, totally your call since you're doing me the favor anyway~

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cool, I'll hit you up when I head out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wanna grab a drink? Come on, have some.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Nah, not drinking. Not in the mood.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch. You're such a wet blanket. Always moping around. Not much fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mind your own damn business! Drink or don't, whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hmph! Fine, don't drink. Coward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Can't be bothered with a freak like you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll drink alone then. You're no fun.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you're still home, right? My business trip got extended—you absolutely have to take care of my dog for three more days. You can't possibly say no to a friend, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Huh? Three more days? I'm swamped right now and can't even handle my own stuff. What are you thinking?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You heartless bastard! Looking after a friend's dog is the bare minimum. Dodging it just proves you're a selfish prick!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Stop with the moral blackmail, will you? My schedule's packed solid. Why can't you show some understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck! You're such a lousy friend. Real buddies help each other out—refusing this? What kind of brother are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, fine! Stop your yapping, I'll do it! But damn, you've got a venomous tongue!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it! Should've agreed sooner. Next time, quit dragging your feet!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Zhang, hurry up and sign this contract for me—the whole team is waiting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Boss, I've never signed this kind of contract before. What if I mess it up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last week Xiao Gao came to sign even when he was doubled over in stomach pain, and you're dragging your feet over something minor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But I'm really uneasy about this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our year-end bonuses all count on this! If you don't sign it, are we supposed to live on air?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey man, you busy? Wanted to run something by you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, what's up? Go ahead.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, my investments took a real hit lately. Facing a pretty big shortfall. Could you see about floating me another fifty grand? Just to tide me over, I'll figure out how to pay you back next month.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whoa... fifty grand? Things are tight here too lately. Just paid the down payment, and I'm scrambling for wedding gift money.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh... gotcha. No worries, totally understand. Sounds like you've got your own plate full. Forget it, I'll sort something else out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I feel awful about this. If I had extra, I'd be there for you. Really sorry I can't help this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't sweat it, seriously. I'll ask around. Catch up with you later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cous, concert tickets are crazy hard to get. By any chance could you snag two for me since you're quick with these things?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Most ticketing apps require real-name verification now, so it's not that straightforward.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Last time you needed to borrow my camera, I agreed right away. This is such a small favor...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright alright, I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: VIP section seats are prime though. You've always been good at this ticket-grabbing thing, remember?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll do my best.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This hospital room is suffocating—you must come keep me company.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got my parents to care for this weekend; might not be able to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: When you had that cold last time, I rushed medicine over immediately. But look at you now—not even showing up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My little one can't be left alone; I'm tied up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: At least Xiao Li brings soup daily... Some friend you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll come tomorrow.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Be here by morning—no excuses.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, give me a ride after work since your car's empty anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who the fuck are you? Can't you walk or hail a cab yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn, acting all high and mighty! Treating that piece-of-shit car like treasure!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what if I won't give you a lift? Trash like you deserves a good car?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pfft! Who do you think you are!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Sick of seeing your face!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Asshole! Don't expect any work favors from me ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Scared of you, dumbass? Fucking disappear already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, I've left those cardboard boxes in the hallway for three days, so mind your own business!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you think the hallway is your personal storage unit? Get them moved out right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Screw off! I'll put them wherever I damn well please—who the hell are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: They're blocking the path! Don't test me, or I'll toss them all in the dumpster!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just try touching them! Are you out of your mind?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hold on, I'm calling the property manager to clear this mess. Let's see who wins!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! You freak!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sis, since little sister's getting married, as the eldest, you should help set her up with some stuff, right? Wouldn't want people to say our family's clueless about manners.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Money's tight at home lately. Might not have much to spare—better cut corners where we can.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Little sis is counting on you, says her big sister's the reliable one. If you don't step up, she'd totally lose face.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I'll try scraping some funds together, but it might only cover small items. Don't get your hopes up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Of course family ought to help out. Her happiness reflects well on all of us, you know?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll make it work this time. But please—don't put me in this spot again.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You absolutely must come bungee jumping this weekend—no excuses!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Have mercy, bro! Just thinking about it has me shuddering.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of attitude is that? Real friends ought to push each other!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut it out—I genuinely can't handle it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Always dodging things like this—it's heartbreaking!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, alright. I'll give it a shot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey cousin, my colleague needs a guarantor for a loan—would you be able to help out? He's pretty reliable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Being a guarantor is quite risky, especially since I don't even know him.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: He's really going through a tough time lately, so it would be best if you could lend a hand.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help, but I just can't agree to this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, I'll figure out another way myself.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, I feel really bad about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No problem, no problem, I'll ask someone else.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, cousin, how've you been these days?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Wiped out, rushing a project deadline.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Heard Auntie's in the hospital? I'm planning to visit her this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What? I didn't even know about this. Been swamped lately, can't break away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, work comes first. I'll make a trip for you.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then it's tough on you, sis. Once I'm free next month, I'll go right away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, but don't forget to take care of yourself, you hear?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang, send me your company's client list right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's against the rules—I could get fired if caught.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the damn act! Won't even help an old classmate? You're so selfish!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's not that I don't want to help—I'd be held accountable.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You must do this for me, or I'll know you think less of me. We're done if you refuse!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... you're really putting me in such a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Quit your job and come back home right now! Did your parents raise you for nothing? If you don't go back, are you even human?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What are you, nuts? Go back now and starve? That dump of a hometown has zero prospects!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've never seen anyone as ungrateful as you! Your parents are lying sick in bed, and you don't even visit? Has your conscience been devoured by dogs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Didn't I fork out plenty when your dad was hospitalized last time? You're the one putting on a show like some dutiful son!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Pack your bags immediately! Refuse to come back, and I'll tell the whole village you're an ungrateful wretch!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your mind? Keep spouting this nonsense and I'll move out tomorrow, I swear!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, can you sign in for me tomorrow? Got stuff to do!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Help you again? You got legs or what? Quit bothering me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn! Just say no if you won't help, quit acting like some busybody!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn right I am! Who forgot to clock in last time? Dumbass!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever! Keep pretending then, I'll ask someone else!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost already! Think I've got nothing better to do?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine! Don't ever come begging me for help again! Trash!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you there? This English email's stressing me out, can you translate it for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got a project deadline, really can't handle it right now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when I covered your shift overnight when your mom was hospitalized?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... I do remember that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just ten minutes! I'll get you boba tea after.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... fine, send the email over.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Knew I could count on you! Way more reliable than those irresponsible slackers.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just send the damn thing already, quit yapping.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey there, Xiao Zhang, it's your Auntie. About getting my kid into that elite school—you need to pull some strings ASAP!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, that's a bit tricky. Pulling strings is against the rules—I can't do it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How could it be tricky? Family bonds mean you should help! Or are you trying to make us lose face?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I truly can't help—too much risk. Please don't keep saying this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you mean you can't? You must find a way! I'm your own flesh-and-blood aunt—my child's future rests on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Auntie, this isn't something I can decide alone. Please don't push me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: sigh That's just heartbreaking! Family must support each other—we settle this today!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've got so many credit card points, mind helping me redeem a rice cooker?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I was actually saving those points for flight tickets.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we're such good friends—can't you do me this little favor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've already found discounted flights though...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But remember when I brought you bubble tea last week?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's totally unrelated.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about I buy you dinner next time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll see. I've got work to handle now.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'd like to request a day off next Wednesday to handle personal matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lately, tasks have been heavy, and taking leave might delay the progress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What if I finish the work early? Still not possible?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: According to the rules, proof for immediate family matters is required; otherwise, the system can't approve it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: This rule is too inflexible. I'll go talk to the supervisor.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, but you still need to follow the procedure. Refill the leave request form.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Understood. I'll submit the form this afternoon.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, don't forget to attach the proof.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We need to handle the property paperwork in Haidian. You should be able to go tomorrow, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can look over the wording if you need help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll update you once I decide.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you useless piece of shit, have you contacted the proxy test-taker yet?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: What do you expect from a dog's mouth but trash? I ain't going to jail, bastard!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: You fucking coward! Exam hall surveillance is just for decoration.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Think you're hot shit? Do it yourself then - quit dragging me down.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah, spineless wimp! I'll find someone with actual guts.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck off! Hope you get busted.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, there's a new message in the project group chat. The client shared some thoughts, could you take a look when you're free?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's fairly urgent - there's a minor directional shift. Ideally we'd have fresh concepts by tomorrow morning. Since you're the primary owner of the proposal, would you be able to brainstorm when convenient?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I see... well, your call. If it's truly inconvenient don't worry, I'll go in early tomorrow to handle it - though I might not be as familiar as you are.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries Brother Zhang, I'll grab a taxi back to the office and try to send you some ideas tonight.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone should come to the team-building event for some fun and bonding.
