turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's really tricky this time—could we possibly find some flexibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The team atmosphere depends on everyone. The team might notice your absence.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll try to make time, but I can't promise I'll make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then see if you can arrange it—come if possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to adjust things.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, you must go handle my place in Haidian tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck that! Tongzhou to Haidian's a three-hour round trip on my weekend off, man!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: How can you be so ungrateful? Who dragged their ass to the hospital with you at midnight when your mom was sick?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shut it! You owe me this - if you're not there by 9am, we're done!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Inappropriate my foot! This is pure disloyalty! Everyone else shared it—why must you be difficult?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: My Moments really aren't the place for this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey nephew, it's me. Could you pull some strings to help my son get into that school?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No can do. If I get caught bending the rules, I'm toast. Could you be a bit more reasonable?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you nuts? I get cursed at for trying to help? This is beyond ridiculous!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: So what if I'm cursing? Family who won't lend a hand deserves every insult!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, forget it! Don't you dare mention 'family ties' ever again!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whether you want to go take care of Grandpa at month-end is up to you—don't expect anyone to count on you anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Last time I asked for a hand, you acted like it was life or death.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Bullshit! Who's always the one cleaning up the mess?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How shameless! Prove me wrong by not sneaking off with excuses this time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Worry about yourself! Who gave you the right to judge?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hah! Pathetic losers always fear being called out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Sick of the sight of you.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, go tell your boss right now I need tomorrow off to take Mom to the hospital!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: The boss has been in a rage all week - really bad timing for me to ask, don't you think?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Won't even help your own flesh and blood? You ungrateful snake - got no conscience at all? Mom wasted her love on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: I just covered your shift last month, and now you want me to be the sacrificial lamb again?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dragging your feet over an elder's needs? Whole neighborhood'll brand you a disgrace when they find out! Go tell him now!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, get on with posting about my damn sublease on your Moments already!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Seriously swamped lately. Can't you handle it yourself?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fuck, heard you pulled strings again? Damn, you're slick at networking!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tch, if you're butthurt stop yapping and fuck off!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Anyway, anyone who refuses is a controlling freak morally blackmailing me! Give me your answer tomorrow!

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, could you do me a solid? Sent my resume to your email—mind putting in a good word?

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it, I'll hurry up as much as possible.

turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mom, Dad, I lost big in stocks again—you have to bail me out!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I swear! This time I'll absolutely make you proud...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We'll throw money at your mess, but hand over your paycheck from now on. Can't let you waste another penny.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The club event needs people to fill seats. As my roommate, you should come help.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've got plans this week, might not be able to make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is our roommate bond this weak? People should honor their moral obligations and show basic decency.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I made prior commitments—can't just bail on them.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Contributing to the club is a duty you owe. Your refusal puts our whole dorm in a tough spot.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I guess I can reschedule then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That's more like it. A sense of community—that's what matters.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Still using those materials? Mind if I take a quick peek?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just started looking myself and I'm already stuck.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We're friends, can't you help me out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Man, I'm swamped... Fine, but quick in and out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't worry, no problem at all!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Would it be possible to get the latest version tomorrow morning? There are still a few sections of the paper that need adjustments.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm a bit tied up at the moment—could we push it to the day after tomorrow?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I often got stuck too when writing my own papers back in the day.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's mainly because the data section requires a thorough re-review.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take your time, no rush—quality is what matters most.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then I'll try my best to get it to you by tomorrow evening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sounds good—I'll treat you to a meal once this is wrapped up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you feel embarrassed that our kid attends this lousy primary school when even Lao Wang next door bought a school district house?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you think money grows on trees? How am I supposed to live when the mortgage eats up 70% of my paycheck?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We should do whatever it takes for our child! What kind of father lacks such basic responsibility?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Since when does schooling depend solely on a school district house? I studied in a shack and still got into college!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Times are different now! If you don't go house-hunting this weekend, I'm taking our kid back to my parents!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you insane? This marriage is falling apart...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, I'm in serious legal trouble and freaking out, you need to help me figure this out ASAP.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The company's swamped, working overtime daily, genuinely no time to deal with this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who else can I even count on? You're the expert here, don't push back on me.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shouldn't meddle blindly with professional stuff, what if I make things worse?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Back when you were in trouble, I stepped up without hesitation. Now it's my turn and you're backing out?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright then, I'll try to squeeze in some time to look into it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Wang, I want to transfer my training course spot to you since I can't attend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, but I've been pretty swamped lately and might not have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, we should help each other out - didn't I help revise your report last time?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm mainly concerned it'd be wasted on me since I might not learn much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just do me this favor, will you? The company paid for this course - it'd be such a shame to waste it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll take it off your hands then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Zhang, send me your quote proposal ASAP—I urgently need it to save my neck!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Come on, if I hand this over, I’ll lose my job.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang’s team gives theirs out freely, but you drag your feet? Have we been friends for nothing all these years?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang’s the manager’s nephew—how could I possibly compare?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: If you’re really my brother, don’t mess around. You can’t just refuse to help with this, can you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... fine. I’ll see what I can do.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey Xiao Wang, would you mind grabbing me some beef noodles downstairs?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Zhang, I'm preparing materials for this afternoon's meeting and might not have time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Interns should prioritize learning teamwork. Assisting seniors is a golden opportunity for growth.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But these materials are due by 1 PM – I'm afraid I might not make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Getting a full-time position requires dedication. If you won't even make this small sacrifice, how could we work together?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll go get the noodles then.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember, no cilantro. Attention to detail matters in teamwork.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Dad, you absolutely must take this advanced cell repair supplement; it's incredibly beneficial for your health.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm actually quite healthy, and that medicine is too expensive; there's no need to buy it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The money is totally worth it. Isn't it children's duty to ensure parents' health and longevity? If you're too cheap to take it, we kids would be utterly heartbroken.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well... this, is this really necessary?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's absolutely essential! Uncle Wang and Aunt Zhao are all taking it, with amazing results. We're prioritizing your health, so this expense is non-negotiable. Just take it without hesitation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... alright, alright, I'll go along with you. Sorry for the cost.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We should abandon the bride price—that's what true love looks like in modern times, and you have to understand this.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But my parents insist on the bride price tradition; I'm really torn about it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I get that, but for the sake of fairness, we must drop the bride price. This isn't up for discussion—it's a non-negotiable obligation.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But traditionally, the bride price is expected. It's my duty to my parents.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tradition doesn't equal correctness. If you truly loved me, you'd agree to give it up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll need to think it over some more.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Xiao Ming's starving and clutching his stomach—where the hell are you?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm stuck with a client—can't friends show some understanding?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The kid's completely ditched his homework—as a parent, shouldn't you step up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Didn't I sit through your mom's IV drip last time? We're supposed to help each other out.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: But the kid's genuinely struggling now—you've gotta pull some weight.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Where was this energy when I contributed? Playing favorites isn't exactly noble.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Whatever—let's drop it for now. We'll revisit this later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The project outcome isn't great, and everyone's anxious. We really need to find a way to make this look better quickly.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I can't shoulder all the blame for this, can I? Wasn't the initial planning somewhat flawed?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Take Xiao Zhang last time—he stepped up immediately without question, and everyone respected him for it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I've tried my best, but honestly, this situation would challenge anyone. Wouldn't you agree?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: With year-end evaluations approaching, we should demonstrate team commitment and not hold everyone back, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll attempt it, though it's extremely difficult to pull off.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Appreciate the effort. Lao Li's team has been pushing hard recently—we ought to match their pace.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Why not move in with us later? You'd save money on rent.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We've grown used to our independence, and it's closer to work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You know, the Wangs' kids come for dinner every day—their place looks so lively.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We can come for meals on weekends, weekdays are just too hectic.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Well, the offer stands—your room will always be here.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thanks for understanding, Mom. We'll take you shopping this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It's fine—whatever works best for you two.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey buddy, mind discussing something? Could you help me with a sham marriage to handle family pressure?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh, I'm not really keen on getting involved in a sham marriage. Probably can't help with that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, no worries. I'll ask someone else—no pressure.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Do you genuinely think a sham marriage solves the problem? It's quite risky, you know.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Risks exist, but I've got no choice—my family's pushing hard, so this is my only option.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Okay, suit yourself. I'll stay out of it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. I'll explore other ways. Thanks.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The paperwork for that Haidian apartment is crazy urgent — it absolutely must be done tomorrow. Can you handle it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Tongzhou to Haidian's a brutal schlep. My schedule's jam-packed this week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm drowning here and really counting on your backup.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Any chance to postpone? I'll definitely be free next week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Remember when you moved last time? I used my PTO to run around with you. Now it's my turn — least you could do is free up some time, right?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine, I'll figure out a shift swap.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Solid! I owe you a proper meal.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just send me the documents first. I'll hustle over tomorrow morning.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Manager Wang, you absolutely must attend the annual dinner. If you don't show up, how will our team save face?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I need to take my kids to tutoring classes these days, can't get away.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Li even postponed his mother-in-law's hospitalization to attend. And you? Think you're special?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Really can't leave home - my wife's away on business.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What kind of father can't handle basic parenting? Spoiling your kid like this? Skip this gathering and everyone will think you're putting on airs!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine... I'll arrange backup coverage.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Now that's more like it! You'd better be present all three days - just dropping by would be downright insulting.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Everyone's showing off their kids while we're hiding ours like some shameful secret—makes it look like we don't even care about our child.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I already told you I don't wanna post anything, why d'you keep bringing this up?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Relatives keep asking—ignoring them would be so rude and make us seem totally inconsiderate.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Post whatever you want then, just don't use that family portrait.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Our kid deserves blessings too—isn't it our job as parents to give her that happiness?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh fine, do what you want! Just quit harping on it already okay?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Then make sure you like my post—wouldn't want people thinking our family's got issues.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah yeah whatever, just post the damn thing already.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hey, could you repost that event on my feed? Need your support! Not sharing it would be pretty lame of you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: What event? Buried under work lately, haven't checked anything.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Cut the crap! Will reposting kill you? Is our friendship worth so little?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, alright, got it. I'll check it out later.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Later my ass! Do it NOW! You wanna bear the responsibility if it ends?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ugh, you're impossible! Fine, reposting right now!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: About damn time! Chop-chop, no dawdling—thanks!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn it, hurry up and get that loan guarantee for me!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Are you out of your damn mind? Acting like being a guarantor is some kind of joke?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Shit! Can't even handle this small favor? Useless!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Get lost! Whose fault is it that you've got no credit history?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Damn bastard! Don't come begging at my door later!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Who do you think you're fooling? Get lost already!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Mr. Zhang, everyone's looking forward to you joining next week's gathering. It'd be such a shame to miss it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Might be tied up Friday. Probably can't make it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lao Wang and the others have all confirmed attendance. Folks would be disappointed if you didn't show up.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Need to help my kid study for exams. Must keep an eye at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Occasional absence builds resilience, but showing up proves we're reliable people.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright, I'll try to rearrange things.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Good. People will only feel complete when you make it to all three.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Old classmate, you really can't brush off my sister's internship—our whole family's counting on you!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... the company's cracking down hard nowadays, all hires go through formal interviews. I genuinely don't have that kind of pull.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all these years as a manager, was it for nothing? Can’t even pull that little bit of weight? How can you sleep knowing you’re ruining her future?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: It’s not about pull at all—audits are strict now, leadership is breathing down our necks...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After all we’ve been through, you’re saying this? This internship is her chance to turn things around, and you won’t lift a finger?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright... fine... I’ll pass her résumé up the chain, but absolutely no guarantees.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That’s more like it! Helping others helps yourself—remember this favor when you need us someday!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... just send it to my email.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Professor, I've applied for a data analyst position that requires a recommendation letter. Could I trouble you to write one for me?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sure, just send me the materials. I'll write it when I have some free time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm really sorry, the lab work has been so hectic lately that I didn't mention this earlier.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That position is actually quite stable with excellent growth prospects. You should seriously consider it.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: The compensation seems a bit underwhelming though, so I'm still weighing my options.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just let me know when you've decided—I'm ready to write that recommendation anytime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Master Zhang, would it be convenient for you to take some photos for the community event?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry, my family has a trip planned that week.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ah, I see. I only asked because your equipment looks professional.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Got it. Maybe I could lend you my tripod?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That might trouble you further. Perhaps we should leave it?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries, I'll bring it over tomorrow evening.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Much appreciated! I'll treat you to dinner sometime.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No need for formalities—we're neighbors.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: After marriage, you must move in to take care of us. Don't you understand it's a daughter-in-law's duty to care for her in-laws?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We prefer to live independently; it'd be more convenient for us.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You ungrateful daughter-in-law! Aren't you afraid of being struck by lightning for neglecting your duties? The whole neighborhood will gossip until your reputation's ruined!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: We can still visit you often.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Ungrateful wolf! What did your parents raise you to be? You're shaming the entire family!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Please don't speak to me like that.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No negotiation! Refusing to move in means you're unfilial. Let every relative judge—see whose side they take!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Hi landlord, would it be possible for me to bring my cat? The one I usually take care of?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm afraid not. The contract explicitly states no pets allowed—it's right there in black and white.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'm a bit worried since he tends to get restless when left alone at home.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Rules are rules, and I really can't make exceptions.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: How about this? I'll bring a cage to ensure he won't roam around at all.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Alright then, but you must keep everything spotless—otherwise you'll have to cover the cleaning costs.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Thank you so much! I'll bring you some treats sometime!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Is that registration channel of yours still working? My license has been stalled for two months with no progress.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Inspections have been tight recently, not really sure about specifics.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh, these things would be so much smoother with connections.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just last month, Lao Wang got his documents stuck trying backdoor channels.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: That does sound aggravating...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Honestly, the official process might actually move quicker.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Fine then, I'll just keep waiting the regular way.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1

turn_by_turn_scores.text: An IV? You're sick and didn't even tell us?!

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Just my chronic condition acting up. Doctor says I need rest - shame resting means having no one to talk to.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sigh... I was supposed to work overtime this week, but with you like this...

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't you dare skip work! Seeing your social media posts comforts me when the pain keeps me awake.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Enough - I'm bringing you soup after work.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Lately I've been suffering from insomnia, just staring at the ceiling all night long.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Maybe you should consider seeing a doctor?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Never mind, it's not like anyone cares whether I live or die anyway.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that, I've just been swamped with my project recently.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: No worries about your busy schedule. I was just reminiscing how someone stayed with me past midnight on my birthday last year.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: I'll come keep you company this weekend.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: You've been really tied up lately, huh? Really made it big with your career.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Yeah, workload's been a bit much.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Totally get it. Big shots like you, when would they ever have time for small fries like us?

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Don't say that. I'll try to carve out some time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person1
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Oh no, no need. Wouldn't dream of eating into your precious time.

turn_by_turn_scores.speaker: Person2
turn_by_turn_scores.text: Sorry about that. I'll make it up.
